description.zh-cn: 文化大革命，简称文革，全称无产阶级文化大革命，于1966年5月16日—1976年10月6日间发生在中国大陆境内，是中华人民共和国历史上一场由中国共产党主席毛泽东发动和领导的全国性政治运动。在此期间，中央书记处及其总书记职务被撤销，对包括薄一波、石双琪在内的许多领导人造成了严重迫害，中共三明地方委员会等地方机构也陷入瘫痪。此次运动的开始也标志着中共第一代中央领导集体格局的终结。各方对文革发动的目的存在不同看法，但一般认为其正式开始于1966年5月16日出台的《五一六通知》，普遍认为文革长达十年之久，对中国社会产生了巨大而深远的影响。运动受到邓小平等人及其后中央领导层的全面否定，被后世负面评价为“十年内乱”、“十年动乱”、“十年浩劫”。在运动初期，魏京生曾参加红卫兵。在此期间，巩俐的父亲曾被调往山东大学，导致全家迁往济南。
description.en: The Cultural Revolution, referred to as the Cultural Revolution, the full name of the Proletarian Cultural Revolution, occurred in Chinese mainland from May 16, 1966 to October 6, 1976, and was a national political movement launched and led by Mao Zedong, chairman of the Communist Party of China, in the history of the People's Republic of China. During this period, the Central Secretariat and its general secretary were abolished, and it resulted in severe persecution of many leaders, including Bo Yibo and Shi Shuangqi, and local organizations like the CPC Sanming Prefectural Committee were also paralyzed. The beginning of this movement also marked the end of the collective pattern of the first generation of the central leadership of the Communist Party of China. There are different views on the purpose of the Cultural Revolution, but it is generally believed that it officially began with the 'May 16 Notice' issued on May 16, 1966, and it is generally believed that the Cultural Revolution lasted for ten years and had a huge and far-reaching impact on Chinese society. The movement was completely rejected by Deng Xiaoping and his subsequent central leadership, and was negatively evaluated by later generations as 'ten years of civil strife', 'ten years of turmoil', and 'ten years of catastrophe'. During its early stages, Wei Jingsheng participated in the Red Guards. Also during this period, Gong Li's father was transferred to Shandong University, causing the family to move to Jinan.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党、中华人民共和国、中国人民解放军的主要缔造者和领导人，中华人民共和国第一代最高领导人。他曾任中国共产党中央委员会主席，在此期间，他下令开展抗疟药物研究。1950年10月，他决定派兵入朝作战，组建中国人民志愿军。他率领部队在井冈山建立了第一个革命根据地。他十分赏识梅兰芳的艺术。他是文化大革命和大跃进运动的主要发动者和领导者，中共第一代领导集体的核心，并确定了民族区域自治制度。其执政时期普遍实行领导干部职务终身制。此外，他在中共八届十中全会上就小说《刘志丹》问题发表的言论，为该案的升级和扩大化提供了支持。1972年会见访华的田中角荣。阎明复曾为他与赫鲁晓夫的会谈担任翻译，并于1975年在其指示下获释。毛新宇的祖父，毛泽民之兄。魏京生因大跃进的后果而认为其是“刽子手”。
description.en: The main founder and leader of the Communist Party of China, the People's Liberation Army, and the People's Republic of China. He was also the first-generation paramount leader of the People's Republic of China. As Chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, he ordered the commencement of antimalarial drug research. In October 1950, he decided to send troops into Korea, forming the Chinese People's Volunteer Army. He led troops to establish the first revolutionary base in the Jinggang Mountains. He greatly admired Mei Lanfang's art. He was the main initiator and leader of the Cultural Revolution and the Great Leap Forward, the core of the first generation of CCP leadership, and established the system of national regional autonomy. During his rule, the lifelong tenure system for leading cadres was widely practiced. Furthermore, his remarks on the novel 'Liu Zhidan' at the Tenth Plenary Session of the Eighth Central Committee of the CCP provided support for the escalation and expansion of the case. He met with Kakuei Tanaka during his visit to China in 1972. Yan Mingfu served as a translator for his meeting with Khrushchev and was released from prison in 1975 under his instruction. He was also the elder brother of Mao Zemin. Wei Jingsheng considered him a 'butcher' due to the consequences of the Great Leap Forward.

birth_place.zh-cn: 长沙府宁乡县花明楼镇炭子冲村

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中华人民共和国的重要缔造者之一，曾任中华人民共和国第二任主席、中国共产党中央委员会副主席。他推动了中国人民大学的建立，并在七千人大会上对大跃进提出批评。阎明复曾随他率领的中共代表团出席苏共十九大并担任翻译。最终在文化大革命中被打倒并被迫害致死。
description.en: A former major leader of the CCP and PRC, once served as the Chairman of the People's Republic of China. Yan Mingfu attended the 19th Congress of the CPSU as a translator with the CPC delegation led by him.

birth_place.zh-cn: 四川省广安市广安区协兴镇牌坊村

death_place.zh-cn: 北京市海淀区中国人民解放军总医院

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党第二代中央领导集体的核心人物，改革开放的总设计师。在抗日战争和第二次国共内战期间，曾与李达、刘伯承长期共事。曾任晋冀鲁豫野战军及第二野战军政治委员、中国共产党中央书记处总书记。文革中被打倒。文革后，他领导拨乱反正并推动改革开放，成为中华人民共和国第二代最高领导人，但也被魏京生批评为独裁者。其曾担任中共中央军委主席、国家军委主席，提出“一国两制”构想，并主导推动了废除干部领导职务终身制。他在处理八六学潮问题上持强硬立场，批评胡耀邦，推动了随后的“反对资产阶级自由化”运动，是六四戒严及清场的主要决策者。他还曾在1958年主持会议批判粟裕，并支持了中国人民大学的复校。
description.en: A Chinese revolutionary and statesman, and the core figure of the second generation of central leadership of the Communist Party of China. He served as the second-generation paramount leader of the People's Republic of China from December 1978 to November 1989, and was known as the chief architect of Reform and Opening-up, though he was also criticized by Wei Jingsheng as a dictator. He worked closely with Li Da and Liu Bocheng during the Second Sino-Japanese War and the Second Chinese Civil War. During his leadership period, he also served as Chairman of the Central Military Commission. He led and promoted the abolition of the lifelong tenure system for leading cadres. He took a hardline stance on the 1986 student demonstrations, criticized Hu Yaobang, and promoted the subsequent 'Anti-Bourgeois Liberalization Campaign'.

birth_place.zh-cn: 湖北省黄州府黄冈县回龙山镇林家大湾村

death_place.zh-cn: 蒙古人民共和国肯特省巴特瑙劳布县苏布拉嘎盆地

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的现代政治人物、军事家，中华人民共和国元帅，林立果之父。他曾任国防部部长、中共中央副主席、国务院副总理，是原中国共产党和中华人民共和国主要领导人之一。毛泽东在中共九大上确立他为接班人，后在九一三事件中坠机身亡。在文化大革命期间，他曾迫害贺龙，并支持韦国清在广西镇压造反派。
description.en: A modern Chinese politician and military leader, a Marshal of the People's Republic of China. He served as Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council, and Minister of National Defense.

birth_place.zh-cn: 清朝江苏省淮安府山阳县驸马巷

description.zh-cn: 中国政治家、革命家、外交家，中国共产党、中华人民共和国及中国人民解放军的创建者和重要领导人之一，也是南昌起义的领导者之一。在四一二事件中指挥上海工人武装，后被南京国民政府通缉。中华人民共和国第一任国务院总理，曾长期担任中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会主席等要职。他也是南开大学校友。曾与毛泽东一同下令开展抗疟药物研究，并组建了523项目。在文革期间，他努力维持国家正常运转，但后期也曾支持韦国清镇压“4·22”派。他曾设法营救毛泽民等人。
description.en: The first Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, an important leader of the Chinese Communist Party, and one of the leaders of the Nanchang Uprising. He commanded the armed workers in Shanghai during the April 12th Incident and was later wanted by the Nanjing Nationalist Government. He was also an alumnus of Nankai University. He established Project 523 and, along with Mao Zedong, ordered the commencement of antimalarial drug research. During the Cultural Revolution, he strived to maintain the normal operation of the state, but later also supported Wei Guoqing in suppressing the 'April 22' faction. He also attempted to rescue Mao Zemin and others.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东第四任妻子，毛岸青继母，中国政治人物、演员、文艺理论家，原国家级副职领导人，曾任中央文化革命小组副组长。她是文化大革命期间中国共产党的主要领导人之一，“四人帮”之首，魏京生在文革期间曾对其产生怀疑。
description.en: Mao Zedong's fourth wife and a prominent member of the Gang of Four, of whom Wei Jingsheng became suspicious during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命时期中华人民共和国的重要政治人物，中国共产党高级领导人，原国家级正职领导人。四人帮核心成员，曾任上海市革委会主任、中央文革小组副组长、中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理。

birth_place.zh-cn: 浙江省诸暨县直埠镇姚公埠村

description.zh-cn: “四人帮”成员之一，中央文革小组成员，文革的理论旗手，发表《评新编历史剧〈海瑞罢官〉》。中国文化大革命时期的重要政治人物，原国家级副职领导人。

birth_place.zh-cn: 吉林省长春市绿园区西新镇开源村

death_place.zh-cn: 北京市首都医科大学附属复兴医院

description.zh-cn: “四人帮”成员之一，原正国级领导人，曾任中共中央副主席、中共中央政治局常委。
毛泽东指定的接班人，在他逝世后领导粉碎“四人帮”，成为中国最高领导人。中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，曾兼任中国共产党中央委员会主席、中华人民共和国国务院总理、中央军事委员会主席，是至今唯一一位同时出任党政军三大最高领导职务的领导人。
description.en: Mao Zedong's designated successor, who served as Chairman of the CCP Central Committee and Premier of the State Council.

birth_place.zh-cn: 广东省嘉应直隶州雁洋

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中华人民共和国开国元帅，中共元老之一，中国共产党和中华人民共和国的创建者和缔造者之一。曾任全国人大常委会委员长、中共中央副主席、国防部部长等职，在粉碎“四人帮”事件中起了决定性作用。他提出设立台湾特别行政区的构想，也是凌孜的父亲。
description.en: Marshal of the PRC, played a decisive role in the smashing of the Gang of Four.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级领导人，文化大革命时期重要政治人物。曾任中共中央办公厅主任、中央警卫部队领导，直接参与并负责粉碎“四人帮”事件的具体执行，其中深度参与了怀仁堂事变。阎明复任中央办公厅翻译组组长后期，汪东兴是其直接上级。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China. He served as Director of the General Office of the CCP Central Committee and was deeply involved in the Huairentang Incident that smashed the Gang of Four. During the latter part of Yan Mingfu's tenure as head of the translation group of the General Office, Wang Dongxing was his direct superior.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要领导人之一。他曾任中国共产党安全和情报部长、中共中央副主席、中央文革小组顾问。作为文化大革命的主要人物和关键支持者之一，他是四人帮集团主犯，并因在文化大革命中的罪行而受到批判。他也是一位书法家。在“反党小说《刘志丹》案”中起主要作用，并曾在北京接见时抨击“4·22”派。死后被认定为林彪、江青反革命集团主犯之一。
description.en: A former major leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, criticized for his crimes during the Cultural Revolution.

birth_place.zh-cn: 福建省泉州市惠安县洛阳镇梅岭村

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党高级领导人，曾任毛泽东的政治秘书、中央文革小组组长、中共中央政治局常委。中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物及理论家，原国家级正职领导人。后被划入林彪反革命集团，也是四人帮集团主犯之一。九届二中全会后被隔离审查。
description.en: A member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the Chinese Communist Party, political secretary to Mao Zedong, and a principal member of the Gang of Four.

death_place.zh-cn: 北京市东城区北京医院

description.zh-cn: 伟大的无产阶级革命家、政治家，杰出的国务活动家，坚定的马克思主义者，我国社会主义法制的主要奠基人，党和国家的卓越领导人，中共八大元老之一。曾任北京市委第一书记、文化革命五人小组组长，文化大革命初期被打倒。后曾任全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员长、宪法修改委员会副主任委员。阎明复任全国人大常委会副秘书长期间，彭真是其直接上级。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, one of the Eight Elders of the CCP, formerly Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. Peng Zhen was Yan Mingfu's direct superior when Yan served as Deputy Secretary-General of the NPC Standing Committee.

birth_place.zh-cn: 大清四川省顺庆府南充县
birth_place.en: Nanchong County, Shunqing Prefecture, Sichuan Province, Great Qing

death_place.zh-cn: 西德巴登-符腾堡州海德堡

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国副国级领导人之一，无产阶级革命家、军事家。曾任中共中央书记处书记、国务院副总理、解放军总参谋长（文革初期被打倒）、中华人民共和国公安部首任部长、国防部副部长等职，被授予中国人民解放军大将军衔。另有记录描述此人为罗瑞卿的第三任妻子。
description.en: One of the sub-national leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a proletarian revolutionary and military strategist. He served as Secretary of the CPC Central Secretariat, Vice Premier of the State Council, Chief of the General Staff of the PLA (purged during the Cultural Revolution), the first Minister of Public Security of the PRC, and Deputy Minister of National Defense. He was awarded the rank of PLA General. Another record describes this person as the third wife of Luo Ruiqing.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的领导人之一，曾任中宣部部长。文革初期被打倒。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, former head of the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee.

death_place.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军总医院

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物、原国家级正职领导人、中国人民解放军高级将领。曾任中共中央办公厅主任（期间作为阎明复的直接上级，并推荐其出任中共中央统战部部长），文革初期被打倒。历任中华人民共和国主席，中共中央政治局委员、中共中央军委副主席兼秘书长，是中共八大元老之一。他任国家主席、中央军委副主席兼秘书长期间，曾负责部署军队执行戒严；并以实际退休行动支持废除领导职务终身制。
description.en: A Chinese politician, former national-level state leader, and high-ranking general of the People's Liberation Army, he was one of the Eight Elders of the CPC. He served as Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee (during which he was Yan Mingfu's direct superior and later recommended Yan to be the head of the United Front Work Department), and was purged during the early stages of the Cultural Revolution. His career also included serving as President of the People's Republic of China, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, and Vice Chairman and Secretary-General of the Central Military Commission. During his tenure as President and Vice Chairman of the CMC, he was responsible for deploying troops for martial law and demonstrated support for abolishing the lifelong tenure system for leading positions through his own retirement.

birth_place.zh-cn: 清朝湖南省湘潭县石潭镇

death_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京市海淀区中国人民解放军总医院

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的杰出领导人之一，中华人民共和国元帅，中国人民解放军的创建者与领导者之一，军事家、政治家。他参与创建了井冈山革命根据地，后于1930年因杀害袁文才、王佐而被迫率部撤离。曾任八路军副总指挥、第一野战军司令员，在朝鲜战争期间担任中国人民志愿军司令员，是《朝鲜停战协定》的签署人之一，并在粟裕任总参谋长时任国防部长。1958年曾批判粟裕，后在庐山会议上因批评大跃进而被打倒，最终在文化大革命中被迫害致死。
description.en: One of the prominent leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a Marshal of the PRC, and one of the founders and leaders of the People's Liberation Army. He was a military strategist and politician. He participated in establishing the Jinggangshan Revolutionary Base, but was later forced to withdraw his troops in 1930 after the killing of Yuan Wencai and Wang Zuo. He served as Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Eighth Route Army, Commander of the First Field Army, and Commander of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army during the Korean War, and was one of the signatories of the Korean Armistice Agreement. He later served as Minister of National Defense when Su Yu was Chief of the General Staff. In 1958, he criticized Su Yu. He was purged during the Lushan Conference for criticizing the Great Leap Forward and subsequently persecuted to death during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国元帅，中国工农红军与中国人民解放军的主要创始人之一，南昌起义领导人之一。他曾指挥红二军团（李达曾协助其指挥），并与任弼时共同指挥红二方面军。曾任中华人民共和国国务院副总理、中央军事委员会副主席。在文化大革命中被迫害致死。
description.en: A Marshal of the People's Republic of China, one of the principal founders of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army and the People's Liberation Army, and one of the leaders of the Nanchang Uprising. He commanded the Red Second Army Corps (assisted by Li Da) and later the Second Front Army with Ren Bishi. He served as Vice Premier of the State Council and Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission and was persecuted to death during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的领导人之一，原中共中央政治局常委，曾在广东担任主要领导职务，曾任中央文革小组顾问。在文化大革命中被打倒并迫害致死。
明史学家、中国历史学家，因其剧作《海瑞罢官》在文革初期受到批判，被迫害致死。北京市副市长。
中国近现代小说家、散文家、剧作家，被广泛认为是中国近现代文学的代表人物。在文革初期因不堪迫害而投湖自尽。
中国著名翻译家，在文革初期与夫人一同自尽。

中国共产党和中华人民共和国第二代主要领导人之一。曾任中共中央主席、总书记。文革后，主持平反冤假错案，派出工作组调查广西屠杀事件，积极推动真理标准大讨论、拨乱反正、改革开放并支持废除干部终身制，是改革开放早期的主要领导人之一，被视为改革派代表人物。在担任中共中央总书记期间，阎明复任中共中央统战部部长初期，胡耀邦是其直接上级。1986年，他批示认为党史题材作品不应虚构重大史实，导致小说《刘志丹》再次被停止发行。后因处理八六学潮的方式被党内保守派批评为纵容“资产阶级自由化”，而被迫辞职。其逝世是六四事件的导火索。
description.en: A Chinese political figure, one of the second generation of leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He served as Chairman and General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee. After the Cultural Revolution, he presided over the redress of unjust, false, and wrong cases, dispatched working groups to investigate the Guangxi Massacre, actively promoted the great discussion on the criterion of truth, rectified past errors, and pushed for reform and opening up, supporting the abolition of the lifelong tenure system for cadres. He was one of the main leaders in the early stages of Reform and Opening-up, and was regarded as a representative of reformists. During his tenure as General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, Hu Yaobang was Yan Mingfu's direct superior when Yan first served as head of the United Front Work Department. In 1986, his instruction that works on Party history should not fictionalize major historical facts led to the novel 'Liu Zhidan' being withdrawn from distribution again. He was later forced to resign due to his handling of the 1986 student demonstrations, which was criticized by party conservatives as condoning 'bourgeois liberalization'. His death was a catalyst for the Tiananmen Square protests of 1989.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要领导人、政治人物，曾任国务院总理和中共中央总书记，被视为中共党内改革派领袖。在胡耀邦辞职后代理中共中央总书记，他通过讲话限制了“反对资产阶级自由化”运动的扩大化，使其在1987年夏天基本结束。文革后支持改革开放，但在六四事件中，因同情学生运动、反对戒严而被免去中共中央总书记职务并被长期软禁。在阎明复任中共中央书记处书记期间，赵紫阳是其直接上级。
description.en: A prominent political figure and former major leader of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China. He served as Premier of the State Council and General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, and was regarded as a reformist leader within the Party. After Hu Yaobang's resignation, he became the acting General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee and delivered a speech that curbed the expansion of the 'Anti-Bourgeois Liberalization Campaign', effectively ending it by the summer of 1987. While supporting reform and opening up after the Cultural Revolution, he was dismissed from his post as General Secretary and placed under long-term house arrest for sympathizing with student movements and opposing martial law during the Tiananmen Square incident. He was also Yan Mingfu's direct superior when Yan served as a secretary of the CPC Central Secretariat.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治家，中国共产党第五代中央领导集体的核心人物，自2012年起担任中华人民共和国最高领导人。现任中国共产党中央委员会总书记、中华人民共和国主席、中央军事委员会主席。他在中共二十大上获得第三任期，并于其任内通过宪法修正案取消了国家主席的任期限制。他于2013年9月和10月首次提出“一带一路”倡议。曾任浙江省人大常委会主任，并于第十一届全国人民代表大会期间当选为中华人民共和国副主席。他曾是薄熙来在中共十八大前的政治竞争对手，其一些政策被部分学者视为可能导致“文革2.0”。他也是曾被公开信要求辞职的对象。
description.en: Chinese politician and the core figure of the fifth generation of central leadership of the Communist Party of China. He has served as the supreme leader of the People's Republic of China since 2012, currently holding the titles of General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the PRC, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission. He secured a third term at the 20th CPC National Congress, and during his tenure, a constitutional amendment was passed to remove the term limit for the presidency. He first proposed the 'Belt and Road' initiative in September and October 2013. He formerly served as Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress, and was elected as Vice President of the People's Republic of China during the 11th National People's Congress. He was a political rival of Bo Xilai before the 18th CPC National Congress, and some of his policies are considered by certain scholars to potentially lead to a 'Cultural Revolution 2.0'. He was also the target of an open letter demanding his resignation.

en: Member of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党是中华人民共和国的执政党。根据列宁主义，它是领导无产阶级专政的唯一政党。该党在第二次国共内战中取得胜利并建立了中华人民共和国。它曾在井冈山地区建立了其第一个革命根据地，领导敌后战场抗日武装力量，是军统局的主要对手之一。该党也是四一二事件中的主要被清剿对象，曾指示在台湾建立省工作委员会。李达于1932年加入该党。徐发淦亦是其党员。
description.en: The founding and sole ruling party of the People's Republic of China. According to Leninism, it is the only party leading the dictatorship of the proletariat. The party was victorious in the Chinese Civil War, leading to the establishment of the People's Republic of China. It established its first revolutionary base in the Jinggang Mountains area, led anti-Japanese armed forces behind enemy lines, and was a major opponent of the Military Statistics Bureau. Historically, it was a main target of the purge during the April 12th Incident and directed the establishment of the Provincial Work Committee in Taiwan. Li Da joined the party in 1932, and Xu Fagan is also a member.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命时期中国大陆的青年学生组成的群众性组织，以学生为主体，是文革初期冲击社会秩序的主要力量，进行了破四旧、大串联等活动。
description.en: Mass organizations of young students in mainland China during the Cultural Revolution.

location.zh-cn: 北京市海淀区钓鱼台国宾馆

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命的实际指挥机构，取代了中央政治局和中央书记处的部分职能。文化大革命期间设立的中央权力机构，直接指挥文化大革命。
由王洪文、张春桥、江青、姚文元四人组成的中共党内政治集团，在文化大革命期间形成并掌握重要权力。
description.en: A political faction composed of Wang Hongwen, Zhang Chunqiao, Jiang Qing, and Yao Wenyuan during the Cultural Revolution.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院
en: State Council of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的最高国家行政机关，是最高国家权力机关的执行机关。其前身是设立于1949年的中央人民政府政务院，皆属中华人民共和国中央人民政府的行政机构。国务院本身亦是中华人民共和国中央人民政府。在2015年的记者会上，其总理李克强回避了关于《穹顶之下》的提问，且官方文字实录删除了相关内容。
description.en: The chief administrative authority of the People's Republic of China, and the executive body of the supreme organ of state power. Its predecessor was the Government Administration Council of the Central People's Government, established in 1949. Both were administrative organs of the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China. The State Council itself is also the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China. At a 2015 press conference, Premier Li Keqiang avoided a question about 'Under the Dome', and the question was omitted from the official transcript.

description.zh-cn: 文革前夕负责文化工作的领导小组，由彭真领导，后被撤销。中央文化革命小组的前身，由彭真担任组长。
文革期间夺权后成立的地方各级政权组织。
指1950年代末期中国共产党在中国大陆推行的“社会主义建设总路线、大跃进、人民公社”三项政策和运动。这是文化大革命前的政治运动，其挫败也是文化大革命的背景之一。
description.en: Refers to the three policies and movements promoted by the CCP in mainland China in the late 1950s: the General Line for Socialist Construction, the Great Leap Forward, and the People's Commune.

description.zh-cn: 指中华人民共和国在1959年至1961年期间，大跃进后发生的大规模饥荒，导致数千万人非正常死亡，并导致毛泽东退居二线。
description.en: Refers to the widespread famine that occurred in the People's Republic of China from 1959 to 1961.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央召开的扩大的工作会议，总结了大跃进的经验教训。会上刘少奇提出“三分天灾、七分人祸”，加剧了与毛泽东的矛盾。
大跃进失败后，毛泽东为解决干部作风和经济管理等问题，在城乡开展的清政治、清经济、清组织、清思想的政治运动，被视为文化大革命的预演。
文革初期由红卫兵发起的社会运动，旨在破坏旧思想、旧文化、旧风俗、旧习惯。这场运动对文物古迹和传统文化造成巨大破坏，导致大量文物被毁。
文革初期全国范围的红卫兵流动交流活动。
1966年8月，文化大革命初期红卫兵运动最为暴力的阶段，在北京发生大规模的批斗、抄家、暴力事件和屠杀。
description.en: In August 1966, the most violent phase of the early Cultural Revolution's Red Guard movement, characterized by mass struggle sessions, home raids, and violence.

description.zh-cn: 上海工人造反派夺取党政大权的事件，开启了全国范围的夺权运动。
全国范围的造反派夺取各级党政机关权力的运动。
文革期间各派群众组织之间的武装冲突，导致全面内战状态。
文革用语之一。文攻指口诛笔伐，武卫指用武力捍卫。
文革期间，数千万知识青年被派往农村地区进行劳动，接受再教育的政治运动，习近平曾参与其中。
文革中期全国范围的政治清洗运动，造成大量冤假错案。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第九次全国代表大会
en: 9th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 在文革高潮中召开的中共全国代表大会，将林彪确立为毛泽东的接班人并写入党章。

location.zh-cn: 蒙古人民共和国温都尔汗

description.zh-cn: 1971年9月13日，林彪、叶群等人乘飞机叛逃，飞机在蒙古温都尔汗坠毁，机上人员全部遇难，标志着林彪集团的覆灭。
description.en: On September 13, 1971, Lin Biao, Ye Qun, and others attempted to flee by plane, which subsequently crashed in Öndörkhaan, Mongolia, killing everyone on board. This event marked the demise of the Lin Biao group.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命后期，由毛泽东发动、江青等人积极推行的政治运动。名义上批判林彪和孔子，实则针对周恩来等人。
中国文化大革命末期由毛泽东发起的最后一次大规模政治运动，旨在批判邓小平在1975年推行的整顿政策，导致其第三次被打倒。
description.en: The last large-scale political movement of the Cultural Revolution in China, initiated by Mao Zedong to criticize the rectification policies implemented by Deng Xiaoping in 1975, which led to his third political downfall.

description.zh-cn: 群众自发悼念周恩来、抗议四人帮的运动，后被定性为反革命事件。悼念周恩来、反对“四人帮”的群众运动。
1976年10月6日，由时任中共中央第一副主席华国锋、中共中央副主席叶剑英、中共中央办公厅主任汪东兴等人策划发动，在北京市中南海怀仁堂拘捕“四人帮”及其在北京的骨干成员的政治事件，标志着文化大革命的结束。
description.en: A political event planned by Hua Guofeng, then First Vice Chairman of the CCP Central Committee, Ye Jianying, Vice Chairman of the CCP Central Committee, and Wang Dongxing, Director of the CCP General Office, to arrest the Gang of Four and their associates.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命结束后，由邓小平等人领导的，旨在纠正文革期间及以前“左倾”错误的思想、政治、组织路线的运动，为改革开放奠定了基础。
description.en: Refers to the correction of the 'leftist' errors in ideology, politics, and organization during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 文革结束后，由邓小平等人启动的，中华人民共和国于1978年12月起推行的一项以经济建设为中心，对内改革、对外开放为核心的社会经济政策与运动。这项政策带来的思想解放氛围，也是后来八六学潮发生的宏观背景。
description.en: The economic reform and opening-up policy implemented by the People's Republic of China since 1978. The atmosphere of intellectual liberation brought about by this policy provided the macro context for the 1986 student demonstrations.

zh-cn: 林彪、江青反革命集团案
最高人民法院特别法庭
en: Case of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques
Special Court of the Supreme People's Court

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国最高人民法院特别法庭对林彪、江青等反革命集团主要成员进行的公开审判。该特别法庭是专门为审判此案而设立的。
民主柬埔寨（红色高棉）时期，由柬埔寨红色高棉政权进行的大规模屠杀事件，受中国文革影响。
法国发生的学生和工人抗议运动，受到中国文革的影响。
文化大革命发生的主要地点。指中华人民共和国实际管辖的领土，不包括香港、澳门和台湾。
description.en: Refers to the territory under the actual jurisdiction of the People's Republic of China, excluding Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 全称《中国共产党中央委员会通知》，是指导“文化大革命”的纲领性文件，标志着文革的全面发动。

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会关于无产阶级文化大革命的决定

description.zh-cn: 简称“十六条”，是文化大革命的又一纲领性文件。中共中央于1966年8月8日通过的关于“文化大革命”的决定，赋予了中央文革小组极大的权力。

zh-cn: 评新编历史剧《海瑞罢官》
评新编历史剧〈海瑞罢官〉
en: Commentary on the New Historical Drama 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office'

description.zh-cn: 由姚文元撰写的批判文章，被认为是文化大革命的导火索之一。
全称《关于当前学术讨论的汇报提纲》，由彭真等人草拟，试图将对《海瑞罢官》的批判局限于学术范围，后被撤销。由彭真主持的文化革命五人小组起草的报告提纲，试图将学术批判限制在学术范围内，后遭毛泽东严厉批评。

zh-cn: 炮打司令部——我的一张大字报

description.zh-cn: 由毛泽东撰写，矛头直指刘少奇和邓小平。

zh-cn: 关于建国以来党的若干历史问题的决议
en: Resolution on Certain Questions in the History of Our Party since the Founding of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中共中央对建国以来若干重大历史问题（包括文化大革命）作出的官方定论文件，全面否定文化大革命，并对毛泽东的功过进行了评价。
description.en: A document that provided the official conclusion on several major historical issues of the CCP since the founding of the PRC, evaluating Mao Zedong's merits and demerits.

description.zh-cn: 苏联政治家、领导人，曾任苏联共产党中央委员会总书记、苏联部长会议主席，二战期间同盟国“三巨头”之一。在雅尔塔会议上，他承诺对日作战，其领导的苏联出兵对日本的投降决策造成了重要影响。赫鲁晓夫对其的全盘否定是中苏论战和文革的重要背景。他还同意并决定由苏联帮助中国建立中国人民大学。
description.en: General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union and a prominent leader of the Soviet Union. As one of the 'Big Three' Allied leaders during World War II, he promised at the Yalta Conference to enter the war against Japan, and the subsequent Soviet invasion had a major impact on Japan's decision to surrender.

zh-cn: 关于个人崇拜及其后果
en: On the Cult of Personality and Its Consequences

description.zh-cn: 赫鲁晓夫在苏共二十大上发表的秘密报告，全盘否定斯大林，深刻影响了毛泽东。
对彭真、罗瑞卿、陆定一、杨尚昆等人的政治清洗运动。

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会
en: Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 1927年由中国共产党中央执行委员会改组而来，是中国共产党的最高领导机构。它由中国共产党全国代表大会选举产生中央政治局、中央政治局常务委员会和中央委员会总书记。该机构曾于1979年正式为《刘志丹》案平反，但在1986年又决定停止该书发行。此外，它还于2002年10月批准了神舟五号的飞行方案。
description.en: The highest leading body of the Communist Party of China. It officially rehabilitated the 'Liu Zhidan' case in 1979, but decided to halt the book's distribution again in 1986. Additionally, it approved the flight plan for Shenzhou 5 in October 2002.

description.zh-cn: 由毛泽东领导的中国共产党在中华人民共和国发动的政治、经济及社会运动，旨在利用国家庞大的人力资源和群众热情，以农业和工业的平行增长追求脱离现实的“跃进”，迅速将国家从一个以农业为主的经济体转型成为一个现代化的共产主义社会，并试图实现超英赶美的目标。然而，这场运动最终导致了严重的经济困难和大饥荒。魏京生目睹其后果后，对毛泽东产生了极其负面的看法。
description.en: An economic and social movement in the People's Republic of China, initiated by Mao Zedong, aimed at rapidly transforming the country from an agrarian economy into a modern communist society through parallel growth in agriculture and industry, utilizing its vast human resources. This campaign ultimately resulted in severe economic difficulties and a great famine. After witnessing its consequences, Wei Jingsheng developed an extremely negative view of Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 1957年在中国大陆发起的，针对知识分子和党内不同意见者的，反对资产阶级右派的政治运动。
description.en: A political campaign against bourgeois rightists launched in mainland China in 1957.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命的核心理论和实践之一。
中共八大元老之一，中国政治家、经济管理家，中国共产党和中华人民共和国第一代和第二代中央领导集体的重要成员。他以实际退休行动支持废除领导职务终身制。在文革中被下放。曾任中纪委第一书记，后任中共中央顾问委员会主任。他是六四事件中的保守派代表人物，曾支持对学生运动采取强硬措施，并曾推荐和保护李锐。
description.en: One of the Eight Elders of the CPC, who supported the abolition of the lifelong tenure system for leading positions through his own retirement.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东发动文革时提出的需要防止的政治趋向。
“走资本主义道路的当权派”的简称，是文革中用于攻击党政领导干部的罪名。
指在中国共产党第一代领导集体退下后，于1980年代至1990年代间，在中华人民共和国政治决策中拥有实际最高决策权的八位或更多位中国共产党、中华人民共和国、中国人民解放军元老。
description.en: Refers to the eight veteran members of the Communist Party of China who held actual decision-making power in the People's Republic of China during the 1980s and 1990s.

description.zh-cn: 文革期间摧毁公安、检察、法院体系的口号和行动。
文革期间对毛泽东的个人崇拜达到顶峰。
由工农兵组成的宣传队伍，进驻各单位领导斗批改。

zh-cn: 第四届全国人民代表大会

description.zh-cn: 文革后期召开的全国人民代表大会，通过了《七五宪法》。

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国宪法 (1975年)

description.zh-cn: 简称“七五宪法”，将文革的理论和实践写入宪法。

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国宪法 (1978年)

description.zh-cn: 简称“七八宪法”。
毛泽东思想理论体系，是以毛泽东为主要代表的中国共产党人，根据马克思列宁主义的基本原理，把中国长期革命和建设实践中的经验作了理论概括而形成的指导思想。
指“大鸣、大放、大字报、大辩论”，文革中主要的群众斗争形式。
文革期间在广西发生的系统性大屠杀，并伴有食人事件。
文化大革命期间在内蒙古自治区发生的大规模冤假错案，具体指对内蒙古人民革命党进行的大规模政治清洗和屠杀。
description.en: A large-scale case of wrongful convictions that occurred in the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 文革期间在广东发生的系统性大屠杀。
文革期间在云南发生的系统性大屠杀。
以道县大屠杀为代表的文革期间湖南发生的大屠杀。
吴晗创作的历史剧，对该剧的批判成为文革的导火索。
文化大革命期间，中共元老与中央文革小组之间发生的一场政治斗争，元老们对文革的混乱局势和错误做法进行了抵制。此事件后被张春桥等人称为“二月逆流”。
description.en: A political struggle between veteran CCP leaders and the Central Cultural Revolution Group during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的领导人之一，中国革命家、军事家、外交家，中华人民共和国十大元帅之一。他曾任国务院副总理、外交部部长、上海市市长。他参与创建了井冈山革命根据地。在“二月逆流”中反对文革。长期担任粟裕的直接领导和政治搭档。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a revolutionary, military commander, and diplomat, and one of the Ten Marshals of the PRC. He participated in the establishment of the Jinggangshan Revolutionary Base.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党革命家，中国人民解放军高级将领，中华人民共和国政治人物。曾任国务院副总理，为原国家级副职领导人。其在“二月逆流”中反对文革。
中华人民共和国于1955年授予建国元勋的最高军衔。
因毛泽东将芒果转赠给工宣队而引发的对芒果的崇拜现象。

习仲勋是中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物，原国家级副职领导人，陕甘边区革命根据地的主要创建者和领导者之一。他也是中共八大元老之一，并以实际退休行动支持废除领导职务终身制。曾任西北野战军副政委、国务院副总理。在1962年，他因审阅小说《刘志丹》手稿并提出修改意见，被打成“习贾刘反党集团”核心成员，遭受长期审查、关押和迫害。他还曾任中共广东省委第一书记，并向中央建议在深圳等地建立“贸易合作区”。他是习近平之父。
description.en: Xi Zhongxun was a prominent political figure in the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He was one of the main founders and leaders of the Shaan-Gan Border Revolutionary Base Area, and later served as Deputy Political Commissar of the Northwest Field Army and Vice Premier of the State Council. He was also one of the Eight Elders of the CPC, notably supporting the abolition of lifelong tenure for leading positions through his own retirement. In 1962, he faced severe persecution, being labeled a core member of the 'Xi-Jia-Liu Anti-Party Clique' after reviewing and providing suggestions for the novel 'Liu Zhidan,' leading to long-term investigation, detention, and persecution. Post-Cultural Revolution, he served as the First Secretary of the CPC Guangdong Provincial Committee, where he famously proposed establishing 'trade cooperation zones' in Shenzhen and other areas. He is the father of current Chinese leader Xi Jinping.

birth_place.zh-cn: 山西省忻州直隶州定襄县蒋村
birth_place.en: Jiang Village, Dingxiang County, Xinzhou Prefecture, Shanxi Province

death_place.en: Peking Union Medical College Hospital, Beijing

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，中华人民共和国开国元勋，原副国级领导人，邓小平主政时期的中共八大元老之一，中国共产党和中华人民共和国的第一、二、三代主要领导人之一。曾任国务院副总理、中共中央顾问委员会副主任。在文化大革命中被打倒监禁。曾就读山西省立国民师范学校。他是薄熙来之父，并以实际退休行动支持废除领导职务终身制。该人物还有一位二女，其生卒年为1946年至2019年11月24日，以及一位三子，生于1951年，和一位四子。
description.en: A Chinese Communist Party and People's Republic of China political figure, a founding father of the People's Republic of China, a former Vice Premier of the State Council, and a former deputy national leader. He was one of the Eight Elders of the CCP during Deng Xiaoping's administration and one of the main leaders of the first, second, and third generations of the CCP and PRC. He was also imprisoned during the Cultural Revolution and studied at Shanxi Provincial National Normal School. He was the father of Bo Xilai and supported the abolition of the lifelong tenure system for leading positions through his own retirement. This individual also had a second daughter, who lived from 1946 to November 24, 2019, a third son, born in 1951, and a fourth son.

description.zh-cn: 位于东亚的社会主义国家，通称中国，成立于1949年。派遣中国人民志愿军参与朝鲜战争，是停战谈判的重要一方。由中国共产党执政，拥有香港主权，也是金砖国家创始成员国。其下辖的省份包括浙江省和江西省（井冈山位于其境内）。作为神舟五号任务的执行国，使其成为世界上第三个独立掌握载人航天技术的国家。田中角荣于1972年访问并与之建立了外交关系。在越南战争期间支持北越，后因边境及柬埔寨问题与越南发生战争。朱德曾担任副主席。它也是艾未未的国籍国，长期作为其社会活动和批评的对象，其政府部门曾多次对其进行打压。此外，由于其网络审查政策和黑客攻击，导致Google于2010年将其搜索服务移出中国大陆。同时，该国也被指控向俄罗斯提供经济支持和可用于制造武器的零组件。石双琪和徐发淦曾是该国政治人物。
description.en: A socialist country in East Asia, commonly known as China, founded in 1949. It dispatched the Chinese People's Volunteer Army to participate in the Korean War and was a key party in the armistice negotiations. It is governed by the Chinese Communist Party, holds sovereignty over Hong Kong, and is a founding member of BRICS. Its provinces include Zhejiang and Jiangxi (where the Jinggang Mountains are located). It conducted the Shenzhou 5 mission, making it the third nation to independently master human spaceflight technology. Kakuei Tanaka visited China in 1972 and established diplomatic relations with it. It supported North Vietnam during the Vietnam War, and later engaged in a war with Vietnam over border and Cambodian issues. Zhu De served as its Vice Chairman. It is also Ai Weiwei's country of nationality, and the subject of his long-term activism and criticism. Its governmental bodies have suppressed him on multiple occasions. Furthermore, its internet censorship policies and alleged hacking attacks led Google to move its search service out of mainland China in 2010. The country is also accused of providing economic support and components that can be used for manufacturing weapons to Russia. Shi Shuangqi and Xu Fagan were political figures in this country.

location.zh-cn: 中国大陆及台湾海峡沿岸岛屿

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党与中国共产党之间为争夺中国执政权而爆发的内战，亦称第二次国共内战，是国共内战的第二个阶段。该内战始于1945年抗日战争结束，至1949年12月以中国共产党取得决定性胜利、中华人民共和国成立告终。在此期间，中国共产党在其控制的“解放区”内已开始推行土地改革。石双琪曾率民兵团支援前线参与此战争。
description.en: The Chinese Civil War, also known as the Second Chinese Civil War, was a conflict fought between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party of China for control of China. It was the second phase of the war, commencing in 1945 after the end of the Second Sino-Japanese War and concluding around December 1949 with the decisive victory of the Chinese Communist Party and the establishment of the People's Republic of China. During this period, the CCP had already begun implementing land reform in the 'liberated areas' under its control. Shi Shuangqi participated in this war by leading a militia regiment to support the front lines.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国中央人民政府成立典礼
en: Proclamation of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 标志中华人民共和国中央人民政府正式成立的典礼。
1989年4月中旬开始，由高校学生发起，持续近两个月的学生民主示威运动。广义上指波及中华人民共和国全境的示威活动；狭义上特指发生在北京天安门广场的学生示威运动及随后的清场行动，最终以6月4日凌晨的武力清场告终。八六学潮被认为是其前奏，为该事件埋下伏笔。阎明复因在此事件中的表现而被免去中共中央书记处书记等职务。
description.en: A series of student-led pro-democracy demonstrations in China in 1989, primarily held in Tiananmen Square, Beijing, which ended with a military crackdown. The 1986 student demonstrations are considered a precursor that set the stage for this event. This political event led to Yan Mingfu's dismissal from his post as secretary of the CPC Central Secretariat and other positions due to his actions.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中华人民共和国国务院总理，在中共二十届一中全会后成为排名第二的中共中央政治局常委。曾任中共上海市委书记、浙江省省长。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员长、中共中央政治局常委，曾任中共中央纪委书记、中共中央组织部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国主要领导人之一，中国共产党中央政治局常委。现任中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会主席（接替汪洋），曾任中央书记处第一书记（蔡奇的前任），并担任中共二十大秘书长。
description.en: Chinese politician, one of the principal leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He is currently a member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (succeeding Wang Yang). He previously served as First Secretary of the Central Secretariat (predecessor to Cai Qi) and Secretary-General of the 20th CPC National Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国首都，是叶剑英、华国锋、周恩来、毛泽东、董必武、陈云、康生、姚依林、蔡畅、任弼时、李维汉、高岗、江青、赵紫阳、载沣、李毅章、徐旭生、李达的逝世地。其中，叶剑英曾任市长，华国锋、江青、赵紫阳、载沣在此长期居住或工作，江青在此被审判。屠呦呦的主要居住和工作地，艾未未的出生地及长期居住地，以及魏京生和闫仲秋的出生地。此外，它也是六四戒严及清场事件的主要发生地，以及中国科学技术大学的创校地点。
description.en: The capital of the People's Republic of China, where Zaifeng lived for a long time and passed away, Li Yizhang passed away, Xu Xusheng passed away, Li Da passed away, Tu Youyou had her main place of residence and work, Ai Weiwei was born and resided long-term, and Wei Jingsheng and Yan Zhongqiu were born. It is also the main site of the Tiananmen Square Massacre and the founding location of the University of Science and Technology of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国人口最多的城市，一个直辖市，也是中国的经济、金融、贸易、航运中心。此外，这里也是李克强的逝世地。

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京市西城区人民大会堂

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的最高国家权力机关和国家立法机关，负责选举和罢免最高人民法院院长。
中华人民共和国的省级特别行政区，实行一国两制和高度自治。它与深圳相邻，是全球重要的国际金融、贸易和航运中心。同时，这里也是著名作家古龙的出生地，仓颉输入法在此地非常普及。
description.en: A special administrative region of the People's Republic of China, Gu Long's birthplace, and where the Cangjie input method is very popular.

description.zh-cn: 1919年5月4日发生于中国北京的爱国运动，以青年学生为主体，并有广大公民、市民和工商人士等中下阶层广泛参与，形式包括示威、请愿、罢课、罢工、暴力对抗政府等。该运动因巴黎和会山东问题而爆发，对中国近代史影响深远。
中国国民党领导的国民政府与中国共产党领导的政权之间的第一次内战，是国共内战的第一个阶段，始于国共分裂，终于西安事变后的第二次国共合作。
description.en: The first phase of the Chinese Civil War, beginning with the KMT-CCP split and ending with the Second United Front after the Xi'an Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在第一次国共内战期间建立的政权。
第一次国共内战期间，中国工农红军主力被迫退出中央苏区，从长江以南各革命根据地向陕甘革命根据地进行的一次重要大规模战略转移。毛泽民在此期间负责后勤供给工作。
description.en: A massive military retreat undertaken by the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army to evade the pursuit of the Kuomintang army. During this strategic retreat, Mao Zemin was responsible for logistical supplies.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期中国国民党与中国共产党的第二次合作，是为共同抗日而结成的统一战线。
中国共产党在第二次国共内战时期的主要武装力量，前身为中国工农红军、八路军和新四军。后改编为中华人民共和国的主要武装力量。曾计划进攻台湾，但因朝鲜战争爆发而被迫放弃，并曾执行六四戒严和清场任务。
description.en: The main armed force of the Chinese Communist Party during the Second Chinese Civil War, formerly known as the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, Eighth Route Army, and New Fourth Army. It was later reorganized into the primary armed force of the People's Republic of China. It had planned to attack Taiwan but was forced to abandon the plan due to the outbreak of the Korean War, and carried out the June Fourth martial law and clearing operations.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在解放区及中华人民共和国建国初期，在中国大陆进行的土地所有制改革运动。
1950年至1953年间在朝鲜半岛爆发的一场战争，它是朝鲜民主主义人民共和国（朝鲜）与大韩民国（韩国）之间的军事冲突。一方为朝鲜、中国人民志愿军，另一方为韩国、美国领导的联合国军。作为冷战时期的一场区域性冲突，它也导致美国介入台湾海峡，阻止了解放军攻台计划。战争最终以《朝鲜停战协定》的签署而告终，但未签订和平条约。
description.en: A war fought on the Korean Peninsula from 1950 to 1953. It was a military conflict between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea) and the Republic of Korea (South Korea). On one side were North Korea and the Chinese People's Volunteer Army (China), and on the other were South Korea and a United Nations force led by the United States. As a regional conflict during the Cold War, it also led to U.S. intervention in the Taiwan Strait, preventing the PLA's plan to invade Taiwan. The war ended with the signing of the Korean Armistice Agreement, but no peace treaty was signed.

description.zh-cn: 全球性的国际组织，二战后成立，旨在促进国际合作和防止未来冲突。罗斯福是其关键推动者。其大会多次通过决议谴责俄罗斯的入侵行为。
description.en: An international organization founded after World War II, with Roosevelt as a key driving force. Its General Assembly has passed multiple resolutions condemning Russia's invasion.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要领导人之一，亦是中华人民共和国政治人物，是1989年至2002年中国的实际最高领导人，也是中国共产党第三代中央领导集体的核心人物。他曾任上海市委书记，因处理《世界经济导报》事件获保守派赏识。六四事件后接替赵紫阳成为中共中央总书记，此后先后担任中国共产党中央委员会总书记、中华人民共和国主席、中央军委主席。主政期间，他延续了废除干部领导职务终身制的政策，也是985工程思想的提出者，并在此期间发动了对法轮功的镇压。此外，在阎明复任中共中央统战部部长后期，江泽民是其直接上级。卸任中共中央总书记和中华人民共和国主席后，他继续担任中央军委主席，并在2003年获悉神舟五号任务成功后打电话表示祝贺。
description.en: A former major leader of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, and also a politician of the People's Republic of China, who was the paramount leader of China from 1989 to 2002. He was also the core figure of the third generation of central leadership of the Communist Party of China and a former General Secretary. During his time in power, he continued the policy of abolishing the lifelong tenure system for cadres and initiated the suppression of Falun Gong. Furthermore, Jiang Zemin was Yan Mingfu's direct superior during the latter part of Yan's tenure as head of the United Front Work Department. After stepping down as General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President of the PRC, he continued to serve as Chairman of the Central Military Commission, and in 2003, he called to congratulate the successful completion of the Shenzhou 5 mission.

description.zh-cn: 1992年1月至2月，邓小平对中国南方城市，包括武昌、深圳、珠海、上海等地进行了巡视，并发表了一系列重要讲话（即南方谈话）。这些讲话对推动改革开放有重要意义，不仅重新启动了因六四事件而停滞的改革开放进程，也深化了改革开放。
负责监管国家之间贸易规则，并监督成员经济体之间执行各项贸易协定的国际组织。
description.en: An intergovernmental organization that regulates and facilitates international trade.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛是中华人民共和国第四代主要领导人、中国共产党第四代中央领导集体的核心人物。他曾任中国共产党中央委员会总书记、中华人民共和国主席、中央军委主席，是习近平的前任，被视为李克强的政治导师。在任中共中央总书记、国家主席期间，他曾亲临神舟五号发射现场观看发射过程，并在航天员出征仪式上发表讲话。他作为时任中共中央总书记，主持了决定对陈良宇进行立案调查的中央政治局会议。2012年卸任所有党政军职务实现“裸退”，此举被认为是完善废除干部领导职务终身制的表现。薄熙来曾对其进行窃听，在薄熙来事件中，胡锦涛是处理该事件的主要决策者之一。
description.en: Hu Jintao was the former paramount leader of the People's Republic of China and the core figure of the fourth generation of central leadership of the Communist Party of China. He served as General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, President of the People's Republic of China, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission. He was Xi Jinping's predecessor and was regarded as Li Keqiang's political mentor. While serving as General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee and President, he personally watched the launch of Shenzhou 5 on-site and delivered a speech at the astronaut's departure ceremony. As the then General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, he presided over the Politburo meeting that decided to launch an investigation into Chen Liangyu. In 2012, he implemented a 'naked retirement' by relinquishing all party, government, and military positions, a move seen as perfecting the abolition of the lifelong tenure system for cadres. Bo Xilai conducted surveillance on him, and during the Bo Xilai incident, Hu was one of the key decision-makers in handling the case.

birth_place.zh-cn: 天津市北辰区宜兴埠镇

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。他曾任中华人民共和国国务院总理，在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命。还曾担任抗震救灾总指挥。在总理任内，他曾与杨利伟成功返回后与其通话表示祝贺。此外，他曾任中共中央办公厅主任、中共第十六、十七届中央政治局常委。他是温云松的父亲。据报道，他曾反对薄熙来晋升，并在薄熙来事件中公开要求重庆反思。他曾于2018年探望阎明复。据称曾被陈良宇顶撞。
description.en: A Chinese politician. He was appointed as Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China during the 11th National People's Congress, and also served as the commander-in-chief for earthquake relief. During his tenure as Premier, he spoke with Yang Liwei after his successful return to congratulate him. He also served as Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and a member of the Standing Committee of the 16th and 17th Politburo of the CPC Central Committee. He is the father of Wen Yunsong. He reportedly opposed Bo Xilai's promotion and publicly called for Chongqing to reflect on the incident during Bo's downfall. He visited Yan Mingfu in 2018. Reportedly confronted by Chen Liangyu.

description.zh-cn: 在北京举办的第29届夏季奥林匹克运动会。
description.en: The 29th Summer Olympic Games.

description.zh-cn: 李克强是中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共中央政治局常委、中华人民共和国国务院总理，原正国级领导人。在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为中华人民共和国国务院副总理。他曾是薄熙来在中共十八大前的政治竞争对手，并主持二十大开幕会。在任国务院总理期间，他曾在亚洲和欧洲访问时推广“一带一路”倡议，并曾在屠呦呦获得诺贝尔奖后致函祝贺。在记者会上被问及《穹顶之下》时，他回避了直接评价。
description.en: Li Keqiang was a political figure of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, formerly a national-level leader. He served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China. During the 11th National People's Congress, he was appointed as a Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China. He was a political rival of Bo Xilai before the 18th National Congress of the CPC and presided over the opening ceremony of the 20th National Congress. During his tenure as Premier, he promoted the 'Belt and Road' initiative during visits to Asia and Europe, and also sent a letter of congratulations after Tu Youyou won the Nobel Prize. When asked about 'Under the Dome' at a press conference, he avoided a direct comment.

description.zh-cn: 由中华人民共和国政府于2013年倡议并主导的国际经济合作倡议（由习近平提出），旨在加强区域互联互通，并形成跨国经济带。

zh-cn: 亚洲基础设施投资银行

description.zh-cn: 一个由中国倡议设立的多边开发银行，为“一带一路”等亚洲基建项目提供资金。

zh-cn: 反对逃犯条例修订草案运动

description.zh-cn: 一场在香港发生的大规模社会运动，旨在反对《逃犯条例》修订草案。
description.en: A large-scale social movement in Hong Kong against the proposed amendments to the Fugitive Offenders Ordinance.

description.zh-cn: 由严重急性呼吸系统综合征冠状病毒2（SARS-CoV-2）导致的2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）所引发的全球大流行疫情。
description.en: A global pandemic caused by Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2).

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国为应对2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）大流行而采取的严格公共卫生防控政策。
description.en: A public health policy adopted by the Chinese government in response to the COVID-19 pandemic.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院发布的优化新冠疫情防控的十条措施，标志着清零政策的结束。
一个横跨东欧和北亚的联邦共和国，是与中国接壤的北邻国家，也是苏联的主要继承国，继承了其航天能力。该国是金砖国家创始成员国，与北约东扩存在持续紧张关系，并于2022年2月24日全面入侵乌克兰。
description.en: A federal republic spanning Eastern Europe and Northern Asia, it is a northern neighbor bordering China and the main successor of the Soviet Union, having inherited its space capabilities. The country is a founding member of BRICS, experiences persistent tensions with NATO expansion, and launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 北美洲的联邦共和国，实行总统制。作为世界主要大国，它是第二次世界大战同盟国主要成员，也是二战期间苏联的盟国之一。它对日本使用原子弹并主导了战后的占领。作为苏联在冷战时期的主要对手，它在朝鲜战争中领导联合国军，是停战谈判和《朝鲜停战协定》的主要参与方。苏联解体后，它成为世界唯一超级大国，也是世界上第二个实现载人航天的国家。它与中国有复杂的竞合关系，在第二次国共内战期间支持中国国民党，并在越南战争期间支持南越。它对“一带一路”倡议持批评态度，指责其为“债务陷阱外交”并推出竞争性基建计划。同时，它还是乌克兰的主要军事援助国之一。此外，李洪志于1998年起定居于此，第四代仓颉输入法也于1985年在此发表。
description.en: A federal republic in North America that operates under a presidential system. As a major world power, it was a principal member of the Allied powers in World War II, and one of the Soviet Union's allies during the war. It used atomic bombs against Japan and led the subsequent occupation. As the Soviet Union's main rival during the Cold War, it led the United Nations Command in the Korean War and was a principal party in the armistice negotiations and the resulting agreement. After the collapse of the Soviet Union, it became the world's sole superpower and is also the second country to achieve human spaceflight. It supported South Vietnam during the Vietnam War and the Kuomintang during the Chinese Civil War. It has a complex competitive-cooperative relationship with China and is one of the main providers of military assistance to Ukraine. Additionally, it is the country where Li Hongzhi has resided since 1998, criticizing the "Belt and Road" initiative as "debt trap diplomacy" and launching competing infrastructure plans, and where the fourth generation of the Cangjie input method was released in 1985.

description.zh-cn: 由中国、俄罗斯等国发起的欧亚政治、经济和安全组织。
由巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国、南非等新兴市场国家组成的合作机制，是世界经济增长的主要动力之一。

en: State Administration Council of the Central People's Government

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期的中央人民政府，是最高国家行政机关，职权相当于后来的国务院。
description.en: The highest state administrative organ during the early years of the People's Republic of China, with functions equivalent to the later State Council.

en: Constitution of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的根本大法，历经多次修改，是设立浙江省人民代表大会的法源。
description.en: The fundamental law of the People's Republic of China, which is the legal source for the establishment of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国宪法 (1982年)

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的第四部宪法，也被称为“八二宪法”，是现行宪法。该宪法的颁行加强了民族区域自治制度的建设，其第三十一条规定了设立特别行政区的法律依据。它还规定了国家主席等领导职务的任期制，正式从法律上废除了领导干部职务终身制。
description.en: The fourth constitution of the People's Republic of China, also known as the '82 Constitution'. It stipulated term limits for leading positions such as the President, formally abolishing the lifelong tenure system for leading cadres in law.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国宪法 (1954年)

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的第一部宪法，该法案的通过使国务院取代了原政务院的行政职能。
中华人民共和国地方各级国家行政机关。

en: Constituent departments of the State Council
Constituent Department of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 国务院组成部门是中华人民共和国国务院的组成机构类别，承担国务院的基本行政管理职能。

en: Directly Subordinate Institution of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院的组成部门之一，主管国务院某项专门业务。
description.en: A constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for a specific specialized business.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物、前领导人，曾任国务院副总理（原国家级副职领导人），也是一位农业政策专家。
description.en: A former leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, who served as Vice Premier of the State Council.

birth_place.zh-cn: 山西省归化城土默特塔布村

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫，蒙古族，是中国共产党和中华人民共和国的高级领导人、政治人物，原正国级领导人，有“蒙古王”之称。他曾任中国人民解放军开国上将、中华人民共和国副主席、全国人大常委会副委员长、国务院副总理、中共中央统战部部长等职，是中华人民共和国历史上官阶最高的少数民族人士。他曾在文革中被打倒，并领导并完成了《民族区域自治法》的制定。
description.en: An ethnic Mongol, a senior leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, known as the 'Mongol King'. He was an opening general of the People's Liberation Army and served as Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级领导人，曾任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。在文革中受冲击。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物、原正国级领导人、中国人民解放军高级将领。曾任中华人民共和国主席、全国政协主席。他是中共八大元老之一，中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要领导人之一。在文化大革命中受到冲击，后参与策划粉碎四人帮事件。阎明复任全国政协副主席期间，他曾是阎明复的直接上级。
description.en: A Chinese Communist Party and People's Republic of China politician, former national-level leader, and senior general of the People's Liberation Army. He served as President of the People's Republic of China and Chairman of the National People's Political Consultative Conference. He was one of the Eight Elders of the CCP. Purged during the Cultural Revolution, he later participated in the planning to crush the Gang of Four. He was Yan Mingfu's direct superior when Yan served as Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee.

birth_place.zh-cn: 四川省江津县吴滩乡石院子

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国元帅，中国共产党和中华人民共和国的军事家、革命家和政治家，中华人民共和国十大元帅之一，曾任北京市市长，粟裕的前任代总参谋长，后在政治运动中批判粟裕。
曾任中共上海市委第一书记、上海市市长、国务院副总理。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国高级领导人，中华人民共和国开国上将。文化大革命期间的重要人物，曾任北京市革委会主任、公安部部长。
description.en: A General of the People's Liberation Army, former Minister of Public Security of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 曾任国务院副总理。
曾任国务院副总理。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，中国人民解放军开国上将，中共八大元老之一。曾担任中华人民共和国副主席，接替乌兰夫。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, who succeeded Ulanhu as Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国人口福利基金会会长。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the president of the China Population Welfare Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国元帅，中国共产党和中华人民共和国的军事家、革命家和政治家。曾任国防部部长，曾是许世友的上级。
中共元老，中华人民共和国政治家、外交家、军事家。曾任国务院副总理、国防部部长，习近平早期的上司。
description.en: CCP veteran, former Vice Premier and Minister of Defense, Xi Jinping's early superior.

description.zh-cn: 曾任国务院副总理、全国政协副主席。
中国共产党高级领导人，曾任中央文革小组副组长、国务院副总理、全国政协副主席。
姚依林是党和国家的优秀领导人、杰出的无产阶级革命家、我国经济工作的卓越领导人。他曾任中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理、中共中央办公厅主任，并被认为是保守派人物。
中华人民共和国政治人物、外交家。
description.en: A politician and diplomat of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国原正国级领导人，中共八大元老之一，中共党内改革派代表人物。他在改革开放初期在安徽推行农村改革，曾任国务院副总理、全国人大常委会委员长，并以实际退休行动支持废除领导职务终身制。
description.en: One of the Eight Elders of the CPC, who supported the abolition of the lifelong tenure system for leading positions through his own retirement.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国上将。曾任国防部部长，并指挥一江山岛战役。他也是联名签署反对武力镇压学生示威抗议信的七名退役将军之一。
description.en: A senior general of the People's Liberation Army who commanded the Yijiangshan Islands Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国务院秘书长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Secretary-General of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国务院秘书长、中共四川省委书记等职。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Secretary-General of the State Council and Secretary of the Sichuan Provincial Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院的组成人员之一，是国家级副职领导人。
description.en: A member of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, holding a rank equivalent to a vice-premier.

description.zh-cn: 前中华人民共和国电力工业部部长
中国政治人物，现任中华人民共和国国务院总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，周恩来义子。曾任国务院总理、全国人大常委会委员长、中共中央政治局常委。他曾于六四事件期间宣布戒严令，被认为是中共党内保守派的代表人物。阎明复任民政部副部长期间，李鹏是时任总理。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, foster son of Zhou Enlai. He served as the fourth Premier of the People's Republic of China and the Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. He declared martial law during the Tiananmen Square protests of 1989 and was considered a representative figure of the conservative faction within the CCP. Li Peng was the incumbent Premier when Yan Mingfu served as Vice Minister of Civil Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级党和国家领导人，曾任中共中央政治局常委、全国人大常委会委员长。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治家，原正国级领导人，曾任中共中央政治局常委、中共中央组织部部长。
中国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物。曾任中华人民共和国国务院总理、中共中央政治局常委、上海市市长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, former Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 李维汉与金维映之子，曾任全国人大常委会副委员长。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国的政治人物、军事领导人，中国人民解放军上将（1988年授予），曾任中华人民共和国国防部部长。秦天与秦卫江之父。
description.en: A political figure and military leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a General of the People's Liberation Army (awarded in 1988), former Minister of National Defense of the PRC. Father of Qin Tian and Qin Weijiang.

description.zh-cn: 原中共北京市委书记，后因贪腐案下台。
中国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要领导人之一，曾任中共中央政治局常委、中央政法委书记。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原国家级正职领导人，曾任中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理、对外贸易经济合作部部长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, a former national-level principal leader, who served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council, and Minister of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级领导人。曾任中共中央政治局常委、上海市委书记，并在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间担任全国人大常委会委员长。
description.en: Politician of the People's Republic of China and a former national-level leader. He served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee, and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
中华人民共和国上将，曾任国防部部长，时任解放军总参谋长，参与指挥戒严部队。
中国维吾尔族政治人物。
description.en: Chinese politician of Uyghur ethnicity.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原副国级领导人，有“中国铁娘子”之称。曾接替李岚清任对外经济贸易部部长，并担任过国务院副总理、国务委员、卫生部部长等职。据报道，她与薄熙来交恶，并阻止其接任副总理职位。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a former Deputy State Leader, known as the "Iron Lady of China." She succeeded Li Lanqing as Minister of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation, and also served as Vice Premier of the State Council, State Councilor, and Minister of Health. She reportedly had a poor relationship with Bo Xilai and blocked his succession to the Vice Premier position.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国人口福利基金会会长。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the president of the China Population Welfare Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共上海市委书记、国务院副总理、中共中央政治局常委。其患病离职为中纪委调查上海社保案提供了契机。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council, and a member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo. His illness and departure from office provided an opportunity for the CCDI to investigate the Shanghai social security case.

description.zh-cn: 回族，中华人民共和国政治人物。曾任中共安徽省委书记。在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: A Chinese politician of Hui ethnicity, appointed as a Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 原中共中央政治局常委、中央政法委书记。他因腐败问题在反腐运动中落马，被判无期徒刑。在本案中，曾作出批示，要求正确引导舆论，被指意图掩盖政府干预司法的事实。
description.en: Former Politburo Standing Committee member and Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission. He fell during the anti-corruption campaign due to corruption and was sentenced to life imprisonment. In a specific case, he issued an instruction to 'correctly guide public opinion,' which was seen as an attempt to cover up government interference in the judiciary.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国上将。曾任国防部部长、中央军委副主席，在神舟五号飞行期间与航天员杨利伟进行了“天地对话”。
description.en: Then Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission and Minister of National Defense, who conducted a 'space-to-ground call' with astronaut Yang Liwei during the Shenzhou 5 mission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间担任全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as a Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国女性政治人物，在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间担任全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: A female Chinese politician who served as a Vice Chairwoman of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，原正国级领导人，曾任全国人大常委会委员长、中共中央政治局常委、中华人民共和国国务院副总理，并在薄熙来被免职后接任中共重庆市委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, appointed as a Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，原正国级领导人，曾任中华人民共和国副主席、北京市市长、中共中央纪律检查委员会书记，并在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, formerly a national-level leader, who served as Vice President of the People's Republic of China, Mayor of Beijing, and Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the CPC. He was also appointed as a Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国女性政治人物，曾任中共中央政治局委员，并在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为国务委员。
description.en: A female Chinese politician, appointed as a State Councilor during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国上将，曾任国防部部长。在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为国务委员和中央军事委员会委员。
description.en: A general in the People's Liberation Army, appointed as a State Councilor and a member of the Central Military Commission during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为国务委员。
description.en: Chinese politician, appointed as a State Councilor during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共上海市委副书记，在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为国务委员。
description.en: Chinese politician, appointed as a State Councilor during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国土家族政治人物、高级外交官。在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为国务委员，并曾担任中央外事工作领导小组办公室主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician and senior diplomat of Tujia ethnicity. He was appointed as a State Councilor during the 11th National People's Congress and served as Director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Leading Group.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国前正国级领导人，曾任中共第十八届中央政治局常委、国务院副总理（并担任推进“一带一路”建设工作领导小组首任组长），以及中共天津市委书记。
description.en: Former member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CCP and Vice Premier of the State Council of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级领导人。曾任第十三届全国政协主席、国务院副总理、中共广东省委书记、中共重庆市委书记，是薄熙来在重庆市委书记职务上的前任，也是其政治竞争对手。

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国中央军事委员会，通称中央军事委员会，简称中央军委、军委，是中国共产党和中华人民共和国武装力量最高军事领导机构的总称，包括中国共产党中央军事委员会、中华人民共和国中央军事委员会两个机构。受中国共产党中央委员会和全国人民代表大会领导。在土地革命战争后期、抗日战争和第二次国共内战时期，它是中国共产党的最高军事领导机构。——机构沿革：1926年11月上旬，为准备上海工人武装起义，中共中央决定将中央军事部改为中央军事委员会兼上海区军事委员会，周恩来任书记。1927年5月25日召开的中共中央政治局常委会将中央军事委员会改称中央军人部（仍习惯性称中央军事部）。1930年2月，军事部与军委合二为一。1931年11月25日，设中华苏维埃共和国中央革命军事委员会、负责红军作战和建设。仍设中央军事委员会。1937年7月，中革军委与中央军委改组中共中央革命军事委员会。1945年8月，新成立中央军事委员会。1949年，改称中国人民革命军事委员会，作为中华人民共和国成立初期的最高军事领导机构。1954年9月28日，通过首部宪法，设中共中央军事委员会。1982年12月4日，通过八二宪法，成立中华人民共和国中央军事委员会。此后，中共中央军委和国家中央军委的组成人员基本相同，实际上是“一个机构两块牌子”。
description.en: The supreme military leading body in the early days of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国清末民初的军事家、政治家，北洋军的创始者与领导者，也是北洋军阀的奠基人。曾逼迫清帝溥仪退位，后任中华民国临时大总统及第一任正式大总统，并意图建立中华帝国但未能正式登基。在山东巡抚任上，他上奏创办山东大学堂。他被广泛认为是刺杀宋教仁的幕后主使。
description.en: A Chinese military and government official during the late Qing dynasty and the early Republic of China. He was the founder and leader of the Beiyang Army, served as the Provisional and Formal President of the Republic of China, and later attempted to establish the Empire of China, although he was never formally enthroned. He was widely considered to be the mastermind behind the assassination of Song Jiaoren.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事人物，北洋军阀直系首领之一，也是直系的代表人物，为北伐战争的讨伐对象。
description.en: A military figure of the Republic of China, one of the leaders and a representative figure of the Zhili clique of the Beiyang Warlords, who was an object of the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党革命家、民主革命家、教育家，曾任中国史学会副主席，刘伯承入党介绍人之一，中共五老之一，中国人民大学首任校长。
description.en: Chinese Communist revolutionary, democratic revolutionary, and educator. He served as the vice-chairman of the Chinese Historical Association, was one of Liu Bocheng's introducers to the Communist Party, one of the 'Five Elders' of the Chinese Communist Party, and the first president of Renmin University of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军一级上将和政治人物，奉系军阀领袖张作霖长子，东北军将领，西安事变发动者之一。继承其父统治东北，后宣布东北易帜归顺国民政府。
description.en: Leader of the Northeastern Army and one of the instigators of the Xi'an Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期主要领导人之一，二十八个半布尔什维克成员，曾任张闻天的前任（中共中央总书记），是第五次反围剿期间的实际领导者之一，后在黑茶山空难中遇难。
共产国际派往中国的苏联军事顾问，曾在中国工农红军中担任指挥职务。
中国工农红军高级将领，1937年1月战斗牺牲
彝族沽基族首领
国民革命军将领
中国共产党和中华人民共和国的领导人之一，中国人民解放军高级将领。他曾任铁道部部长，并参与创建了井冈山革命根据地。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a senior general of the People's Liberation Army. He served as Minister of Railways and participated in the establishment of the Jinggangshan Revolutionary Base.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事及政治人物，晋系军阀首领，长期统治山西省。
description.en: A military and political figure of the Republic of China, representative of the Jin clique.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军一级上将，新桂系核心代表人物，中华民国首任国防部部长，华中剿匪总司令。他曾任淞沪戒严司令部司令，是四一二事件的主要执行者之一。他曾与杨宇霆在冀东会晤，并于事件后奉命来台宣慰。他是白先勇之父。
description.en: A first-class general of the Republic of China Army, a representative figure of the New Guangxi clique, and a prominent KMT general. He served as the commander of the Shanghai Martial Law Command and was one of the main executors of the April 12th Incident. He also met with Yang Yuting in eastern Hebei.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期军事领导人、中国人民解放军高级将领。曾在129师任职，与李达、邓小平、刘伯承共事并合影。
description.en: An early military leader of the CPC, who served with Li Da, Deng Xiaoping, and Liu Bocheng in the 129th Division and was photographed with them.

description.en: A major debate on practice being the sole criterion for testing truth (the criterion for testing truth issue) that unfolded in China's ideological and theoretical circles in 1978. This important ideological emancipation movement laid the ideological groundwork for the 3rd Plenary Session of the 11th CCP Central Committee and repudiated the 'Two Whatevers'.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党早期领导人之一，中华民国大陆时期政要、诗人。他曾是一位早期的革命者，策划暗杀时任摄政王的载沣。后任武汉国民政府主席，与蒋介石在分共方式上存在分歧，导致宁汉分裂。最终成为汪精卫政权的首脑。
description.en: One of the early leaders of the Kuomintang and a prominent politician and poet during the Republic of China era on the mainland. He was an early revolutionary who plotted the assassination of the then Prince-Regent Zaifeng. He later served as chairman of the Wuhan Nationalist Government, where his disagreements with Chiang Kai-shek over the method of purging communists led to the Nanjing-Wuhan split. Eventually, he became the head of the Wang Jingwei regime.

description.zh-cn: 中国军事家，北伐名将，中国人民解放军创建者之一，曾任新四军军长。

Its researchers first published the 'Economic and Philosophic Manuscripts of 1844' in 1932. It was a principal member of the Allied powers in World War II, providing aid to China and declaring war on Japan at the end of the war, invading Manchuria, and significantly impacting Japan's decision to surrender. description.zh-cn: 由中华人民共和国主席发布的法令。
中华民国大陆时期滇系军阀领导人，滇军将领，长期主政云南，曾任云南省政府主席，有“云南王”之称。
description.en: A military general during the mainland period of the Republic of China, who governed Yunnan for a long time and was known as the 'King of Yunnan'.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，曾任铁道部副部长。
description.en: A lieutenant general in the People's Liberation Army, formerly served as Vice Minister of Railways.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，曾任铁道部副部长。
description.en: An admiral in the People's Liberation Army of China, formerly served as Vice Minister of Railways.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，领导并完成了《民族区域自治法》的制定。
中国人民解放军开国上将，张又侠之父。
时任西藏军区司令员，战争期间任西藏军区前线指挥所司令员。
原国民党第一兵团司令，1949年与程潜共同起义。
中国人民解放军开国上将，时任第五兵团司令员，其部队在西南战役中俘虏了宋希濂。他是胡耀邦的表哥。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army, then commander of the 5th Army Group, whose troops captured Song Xilian during the Southwest Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期川军将领。
时任中共云南省委第一书记。他因不同意小说《刘志丹》出版，并向康生报告，成为引发此案的关键人物之一。
description.en: Then First Secretary of the CCP Yunnan Provincial Committee. He became one of the key figures in triggering the case by disagreeing with the publication of the novel 'Liu Zhidan' and reporting it to Kang Sheng.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军上将，曾任中共上海市委第一书记
中国人民解放军上将。
曾任中华人民共和国地质矿产部部长
中国共产党早期领导人、工人运动领袖。
description.en: An early leader of the Communist Party of China and a leader of the labor movement.

description.zh-cn: 新四军政治部主任，在皖南事变突围时阵亡。

zh-cn: 中国工农红军第二方面军

中国共产党高级干部。因对小说《刘志丹》提出修改意见，被打成“习贾刘反党集团”成员，后被迫害致死。
description.en: A senior cadre of the Communist Party of China. He was labeled a member of the 'Xi-Jia-Liu Anti-Party Clique' for offering suggestions on the novel 'Liu Zhidan' and was later persecuted to death.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在抗日战争和国共内战时期建立的政府。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国正国级领导人，现任中共中央政治局常委、中央书记处排名第一的书记、中共中央办公厅主任。曾任中共三明市委副书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently a member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, a secretary of the CPC Central Secretariat, and Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee. Former Deputy Secretary of the CPC Sanming Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任中共中央政治局常委、中央纪委书记。曾任中共广东省委书记，并出席孟凡利就任深圳市委书记的干部会议。
description.en: Chinese politician. Currently a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. He previously served as Secretary of the CPC Guangdong Provincial Committee and attended the cadre meeting for Meng Fanli's appointment as Shenzhen Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 1921年中共一大前在中国各地及海外成立的共产主义小组
中国第一个共产主义小组，在各地建党活动中起联络中心作用，是中国共产党的前身组织之一。
由列宁领导的布尔什维克发动的革命，推翻了俄国临时政府。
description.en: A revolution led by Lenin's Bolsheviks that overthrew the Russian Provisional Government.

zh-cn: 有中国特色的社会主义

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党根据本国国情，将马克思主义基本原理与中国具体实际相结合而形成的政治经济理论，也是中国共产党和中华人民共和国的官方意识形态及国策。
description.en: A political and economic theory formulated by the Communist Party of China by adapting the basic principles of Marxism to the specific conditions of China.

en: Communist Party of the Soviet Union

description.zh-cn: 苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟的执政党，将列宁主义纳入其官方学说。
description.en: The ruling political party of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会的机关报，在大跃进期间进行了大量宣传报道。
description.en: The official newspaper of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中共第二十届中央政治局委员。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，副国级领导人。现任中共中央政治局委员、中央书记处书记、中共中央宣传部部长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China and a national-level leader. He is currently a member of the Politburo of the CCP Central Committee, a secretary of the Central Secretariat, and the head of the CCP Central Propaganda Department.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中共第二十届中央政治局委员，时任中共中央政法委书记
中国政治人物，中共中央书记处书记，中华人民共和国国家监察委员会主任，中华人民共和国总监察官。

en: General Office of the Chinese Communist Party
General Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会的综合办事机构，负责日常文书、会务、安保、机要、通讯等工作，并为中共中央和中央直属机关提供服务。
description.en: The working body of the CPC Central Committee, responsible for daily clerical work, meeting arrangements, security, confidential matters, communications, etc.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会组织部
en: Organization Department of the Chinese Communist Party
Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee
Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.en: The functional department of the CCP Central Committee responsible for party organization and cadre work. In 1979, this department submitted a report to rehabilitate the 'Liu Zhidan' novel case.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会宣传部
中国共产党中央宣传部
en: Publicity Department of the Chinese Communist Party
Propaganda Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.en: The functional department of the Central Committee of the CCP responsible for propaganda and ideological work. It instructed the Workers' Publishing House to create a novel about Liu Zhidan, and reportedly ordered a complete ban on 'Under the Dome' several days after its release.

zh-cn: 中共中央统一战线工作部
中国共产党中央委员会统一战线工作部

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会主管统一战线工作的职能部门。
description.en: A functional department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China responsible for united front work.

en: Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission
Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会的直属机构，负责领导和管理全国政法工作。该机构牵头成立联合调查组，对陕西千亿矿权案卷宗丢失等问题进行了调查。
description.en: An agency directly under the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, responsible for leading and managing political and legal affairs nationwide. It led a joint investigation team to investigate the missing case files and other issues in the 'Shaanxi Hundred-Billion-Yuan Mining Rights Case'.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会政策研究室
国务院农村发展研究中心
中国共产党第六届中央委员会

中国革命家、政治家、外交家，中国工人运动领导人，曾任中联部部长，中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物，原国家级副职领导人。
description.en: A Chinese revolutionary, politician, diplomat, leader of the Chinese workers' movement, former head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee, and a political figure of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a former national-level deputy leader.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中共上海市委第一书记
中国共产党和中华人民共和国的早期领导人之一。曾任中共上海市委第一书记。
中华人民共和国政治家，原正国级领导人。曾任中共中央政治局常委、中央书记处书记、天津市市长。在六四事件中，他因反对实施戒严并支持赵紫阳而被免职。复出后曾任电子工业部部长、全国政协副主席等职务。他曾赏识李瑞环。
description.en: Politician of the People's Republic of China, former national-level leader. He served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee and a secretary of the Central Secretariat of the CPC. He was dismissed from his party leadership positions for sympathizing with the student movement and supporting Zhao Ziyang during the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests. After his political comeback, he served as Minister of Electronics Industry and Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间担任全国人大常委会副委员长和会议秘书长。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as a Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee and Secretary-General of the sessions of the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共上海市委书记、中共中央书记处书记。在六四事件中与阎明复一同被免职。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, former secretary of the CPC Central Secretariat. He was dismissed along with Yan Mingfu during the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，原国家级副职领导人。曾任中共中央书记处书记、中共中央统战部部长、全国政协副主席等职。因在六四事件中的表现被撤职，后复出任民政部副部长，并长期从事慈善事业。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China and a former deputy state leader. He served as a secretary of the Central Secretariat of the CPC and head of the United Front Work Department. He was dismissed for his actions during the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, later returned to politics as Vice Minister of Civil Affairs, and was long involved in philanthropy.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级党和国家领导人，曾任中共中央政治局常委、全国政协主席、天津市市长。
description.en: A former major leader of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, who served as Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆胞弟，解放军上将。曾任中共中央军委秘书长。在担任解放军总政治部主任期间，参与指挥戒严部队。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原国家级正职领导人，曾任中共中央政治局常委、中央纪律检查委员会书记、中组部副部长。
description.en: Former Politburo Standing Committee member, once served as deputy head of the CCP Central Organization Department.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共中央政治局常委、中华人民共和国副主席。
description.en: Chinese politician, former member of the Politburo Standing Committee and Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级党和国家领导人。曾任中央书记处书记、陈希的前任中共中央党校校长。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级领导人，第十七届中共中央政治局常委，曾任中央纪委书记。

zh-cn: 王刚 (中国全国政协原副主席)

death_place.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军总医院

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军前主要领导人之一，原副国级领导人，上将军衔（2014年被开除军籍），在反腐运动中落马。他曾在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为中央军事委员会副主席。
description.en: A general in the People's Liberation Army. He was appointed as a Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission during the 11th National People's Congress, and later fell during the anti-corruption campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国家副主席，原副国级领导人。
原中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共中央办公厅主任、中共中央书记处书记、全国政协副主席、中央统战部部长，是胡锦涛的首席助理。被指是操盘整倒陈良宇的人之一，在反腐运动中落马。
description.en: Former director of the CCP General Office and chief aide to Hu Jintao, who fell during the anti-corruption campaign.

description.zh-cn: 原中央宣传部部长
中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共中央政治局常委、全国人大常委会委员长。涉及胡锦涛二十大离场事件。
中国政治人物，曾任中共浙江省委书记（夏宝龙担任该职务时的前任），并曾担任浙江省人大常委会主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee (predecessor to Xia Baolong) and former Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress.

en: 20th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party

location.zh-cn: 北京市西城区府右街12号
location.en: No. 12 Fuyou Street, Xicheng District, Beijing

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党第二十次全国代表大会选举产生的中央委员会，是中国共产党在2022年至2027年的最高领导机关。
description.en: The central leadership body elected by the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, which is the highest leading body of the Communist Party of China from 2022 to 2027.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物、力学工程师及航天领域专家，中共第二十届中央政治局委员、中共新疆维吾尔自治区党委书记。曾任中国航天科技集团公司总经理，出身航天科技集团的省委书记之一
中国政治人物及环境科学家。曾任中华人民共和国环境保护部部长（在《穹顶之下》发布后曾对其公开表示赞赏）、北京市市长。现任中共第二十届中央政治局委员、中共上海市委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician and environmental scientist. He served as Minister of Environmental Protection (publicly praising 'Under the Dome' upon its release) and Mayor of Beijing. He is currently a member of the 20th CPC Central Committee Politburo and Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中共第二十届中央政治局委员，天津市委书记。此前曾任中共重庆市委书记，在唐良智担任重庆市市长期间，是袁家军的前任。
description.en: Chinese politician. While Tang Liangzhi served as Mayor of Chongqing, Chen Min'er was the Secretary of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物及空间技术专家，副国级领导人。现任中共中央政治局委员、中共重庆市委书记，曾任浙江省人大常委会主任，并曾担任神舟五号任务载人飞船系统总指挥。
description.en: Chinese politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a space technology expert, holding a vice-national level leadership position. Currently a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Party Secretary of Chongqing Municipality, and formerly Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress. He also served as Commander-in-Chief of the manned spacecraft system for the Shenzhou 5 mission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中共中央政治局委员、中国共产党广东省委员会书记。曾任中共杭州市委书记、中共中央宣传部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, serving as the Party Secretary of Guangdong.

en: National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party

中国共产党第一次全国代表大会后设立的中央领导机构，是中国共产党中央委员会的前身机构之一。

description.zh-cn: 决定设立中国共产党中央委员会的会议。此次会议后设立了中共中央政治局。
列宁提出的党的组织原则，后被斯大林进一步发展。它是中国共产党的根本组织原则。

en: General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party
General Secretary of the Central Committee of the CCP
General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在1956年至1967年间以及1980年至1982年间设立于中央书记处的领导职务，负责处理中央书记处运作。此职务并非中共中央的主要负责人，与1982年起设立的党内最高领导人职务不同。
description.en: A leading position established within the Central Secretariat of the Communist Party of China between 1956-1967 and 1980-1982, responsible for managing the operations of the Central Secretariat. This position was not the main leader of the CPC Central Committee and is distinct from the supreme leader role established since 1982.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第一次全体会议
en: First Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 审议通过了《中共中央政治局关于加强和维护党中央集中统一领导的若干规定》。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十七次全国代表大会
en: 17th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 自此次会议起，中央政治局不再设置候补委员职位。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第一次全体会议
en: First plenary session of the 20th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 选举产生了中共第二十届中央领导机构（包括中央政治局及其常务委员会）及其负责人。
description.en: Elected the 20th central leading bodies of the CPC and their leaders.

description.zh-cn: 中共第二十届中央政治局委员，北京市委书记。
原副国级领导人，曾任中共第十六届中央政治局委员、中共上海市委书记、上海市市长。因陈良宇事件被查处下台并判刑。
description.en: Chinese politician, former member of the 16th Politburo of the CCP, Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Committee, and Mayor of Shanghai. He was dismissed and sentenced due to his involvement in the Chen Liangyu incident.

zh-cn: 陈良宇受贿、滥用职权案
陈良宇同志严重违纪问题

description.zh-cn: 指在2006年上海市部分政府官员被中央指控违规动用社会保障基金进行投资活动而遭中央惩处的事件。该事件牵扯出大量政治、经济和法律问题，涉及贪污腐败案件，导致时任上海市委书记陈良宇被停止政治局委员职务。
description.en: Refers to the 2006 incident where some Shanghai government officials were accused by the central government of illegally using social security funds for investment activities and were subsequently punished. This event triggered numerous political, economic, and legal issues, involving corruption cases and leading to the suspension of Chen Liangyu, then-Shanghai Party Secretary, from his Politburo membership.

description.zh-cn: 薄一波的二子。中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任大连市市长、辽宁省省长、中华人民共和国商务部部长、中共重庆市委书记、中共中央政治局委员。2013年因受贿、贪污、滥用职权罪被判处无期徒刑。他被指是操盘整倒陈良宇的人之一，亦是习近平的政治对手。他曾是谷开来之夫，其前妻为李雪峰之女。
description.en: Bo Yibo's second son. A former Chinese politician who served as a member of the Politburo of the Chinese Communist Party, Party Secretary of Chongqing, Minister of Commerce, Governor of Liaoning, and Mayor of Dalian. 中华民国的创建政党。曾在中国大陆执政，是国共内战的参战方之一，在第二次国共内战中代表中华民国政府。战败后，其领导的中华民国政府迁至台湾，并至今是台湾（中华民国）的主要政党之一，也是卓荣泰内阁时期的主要反对党之一。在台湾执政期间，该党曾负责瓦解中共台湾省工委。该党由蒋介石领导，刘伯承、朱德（后脱离）、邓小平（在国共合作时期以个人名义）曾加入该党。在大罢免运动中，其多名公职人员成为罢免目标，同时该党也采取“以罢制罢”策略反制。
description.en: The founding political party of the Republic of China. It once governed mainland China and was a belligerent in the Chinese Civil War, representing the Republic of China government in the conflict. After its defeat, the Republic of China government it led retreated to Taiwan, becoming the ruling party of Taiwan after 1949. It remains one of the main political parties in the Republic of China (Taiwan) and one of the main opposition parties during the term of the Cho Jung-tai cabinet. During its rule in Taiwan, it was responsible for dismantling the Taiwan Provincial Work Committee of the CPC. The party was led by Chiang Kai-shek. Liu Bocheng, Zhu De (later defected), and Deng Xiaoping (in a personal capacity during KMT-CPC cooperation) were once members. During the Great Recall movement, many of its public officials were targeted for recall, and the party adopted a 'recall for recall' counter-strategy.
