description.en: A Chinese politician, revolutionary and military leader. He was the leader of the KMT's pro-purge faction and ordered the purge during the April 12th Incident. He served as the Commandant of the Whampoa Military Academy, Chairman of the Nationalist Government (during his tenure, he approved the death sentences for Mao Zemin and others), and President of the Republic of China, and was one of the Allied leaders during World War II. He ultimately decided to send troops to suppress the February 28 Incident. He imprisoned Zhang Xueliang for a long period after the Xi'an Incident. He was the grandfather of Chiang Hsiao-wu, and Song Xilian was one of his loyal generals.

description.zh-cn: 于1912年在中国大陆建立的共和制国家，在1912年至1949年间曾是中国的执政政权。现今治权范围主要为台湾、澎湖、金门、马祖。作为中国抗日战争的主要参战方之一，它不承认满洲国的合法性。该共和国曾被艾森豪威尔政府承认为代表全中国的唯一合法政府。1972年，田中角荣与中华人民共和国建交的同时，与中华民国断绝了外交关系。
description.en: A republic founded in mainland China in 1912, with its current jurisdiction mainly covering Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu. It was recognized by the Eisenhower administration as the sole legitimate government of China. In 1972, Kakuei Tanaka severed diplomatic relations with the Republic of China upon establishing relations with the People's Republic of China.

description.en: In this context, it refers to the Empire of Japan, an East Asian country that underwent rapid modernization during the Meiji Restoration and had a significant influence on Chinese politics during the Beiyang government period. The campaign resulted in the punishment of several intellectuals and officials.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治家，曾提议用日清战争赔款将第三高等学校提升为帝国大学，促成了京都大学的建立。
description.en: A Japanese statesman who proposed using the indemnity from the First Sino-Japanese War to upgrade the Third Higher School to an Imperial University, leading to the establishment of Kyoto University.

description.zh-cn: 1933年发生在京都大学的一起有关学术思想自由的事件。因法学部教授泷川幸辰的学说受到政府压制而引发，导致多名教授辞职，并引发社会对大学自治和思想自由的深刻反思。
description.en: An incident concerning academic freedom of thought that occurred at Kyoto University in 1933. It was triggered by government suppression of the theories of Faculty of Law professor Yukitoki Takikawa, leading to the resignation of several professors and prompting profound societal reflection on university autonomy and freedom of thought.

description.zh-cn: 日本刑法学家，京都大学法学部教授。因其刑法学说被指为“共产主义”，遭到政府弹压，引发了著名的“泷川事件”。战后曾任京都大学校长。
description.en: A Japanese criminal law scholar and professor at the Faculty of Law, Kyoto University. His criminal law theories were labeled as 'communist' and suppressed by the government, sparking the famous 'Takigawa incident'. He served as president of Kyoto University after the war.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治家，在泷川事件期间担任文部大臣，向京都大学施压要求罢免泷川幸辰教授。
description.en: A Japanese politician who, as Minister of Education during the Takigawa incident, pressured Kyoto University to dismiss Professor Yukitoki Takikawa.

description.zh-cn: 日本哲学家，京都大学哲学系教授，京都学派的开创者之一。
description.en: A Japanese philosopher, professor of philosophy at Kyoto University, and one of the founders of the Kyoto School.

description.zh-cn: 指与广东省有任职背景或与习仲勋主政广东有关联的官员群体。亦可指民国时期的军阀派系，主要势力范围在广东地区，受苏联支持。
description.en: Refers to a group of officials with a background in Guangdong or connected to Xi Zhongxun's governance in Guangdong. It can also refer to a warlord clique during the Republican era, with its main sphere of influence in the Guangdong region, supported by the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国最高人民检察院检察长。曾任中共上海市委副书记。
中央军事委员会办公厅原主任。

description.en: Chinese politician, who served as Minister of Justice (succeeding Fu Zhenghua) and later as Chairman of the Jiangxi Provincial CPPCC. He was investigated in 2024 for severe disciplinary violations.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯的叔父及嗣父。
袁世凯的长子，曾积极推动其父称帝。
description.en: Yuan Shikai's eldest son, who actively encouraged his father to become emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清末淮军将领，袁世凯早期的提携者。
description.en: A Huai Army general in the late Qing dynasty and an early patron of Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 清末民初政治家，袁世凯的盟友。
晚清重臣、政治家和军事家，满洲正白旗人，慈禧太后的心腹。他是载沣的岳父，也是溥仪的外祖父。
description.en: A prominent minister, statesman, and military leader in the late Qing dynasty, a confidant of Empress Dowager Cixi, and the father-in-law of Zaifeng.

description.zh-cn: 晚清维新派领袖、清末民初的政治家和思想家。他是戊戌变法的主要策划者之一，并曾试图将儒家改造为国教（孔教）。
description.en: Leader of the late Qing reformists, a politician and thinker active during the late Qing and early Republican eras. He was one of the main planners of the Hundred Days' Reform and attempted to establish Confucianism as the state religion (the Confucian Church).

description.zh-cn: 晚清维新派政治家，戊戌六君子之一。
description.en: A reformist politician in the late Qing dynasty, one of the 'Six Gentlemen of the Wuxu Reform'.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治家。曾任军政府鄂军都督、大元帅，以及中华民国临时副总统、第一任副总统；后继任第二、三任大总统。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the first Vice President and the second and third President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治家，北洋军阀皖系首领，曾是袁世凯手下重要将领。历任参谋总长、国务总理、临时执政等职。因在要求清帝退位、抵制洪宪帝制和讨伐张勋复辟中的作用，有“三造共和”之美誉。
description.en: A Chinese politician and warlord, leader of the Anhui clique. He served as Premier and Provisional Chief Executive of the Republic of China. He is known for his role in forcing the Qing emperor's abdication, resisting the Hongxian Monarchy, and suppressing the Manchu Restoration, earning him the moniker 'the three-time creator of the Republic'.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，袁世凯手下重要将领，“北洋三杰”之一，北洋军阀直系首领，曾任中华民国代总统。
description.en: A Chinese general, one of the 'Three Distinguished of Beiyang', leader of the Zhili clique, and acting President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代政治活动家，筹安会发起人，积极推动袁世凯称帝。
description.en: A Chinese politician active in the late Qing and early Republican periods, founder of the Chou'anhui, who actively promoted Yuan Shikai's monarchical ambitions.

description.zh-cn: 光绪帝的皇后，宣统帝（溥仪）的嗣母。她是清朝最后一位实际掌权者，宣统年间与载沣共同作为最高统治者，拥有重大事件的最终决定权。在宣统帝逊位时垂帘听政，并代表其颁布退位诏书。
description.en: The empress consort of the Guangxu Emperor and adoptive mother of the Xuantong Emperor. She was the last de facto ruler of the Qing dynasty. During the Xuantong era, she served as co-supreme ruler with Zaifeng, holding the final decision-making power on major events. She also issued the abdication edict on behalf of the emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝末年由袁世凯在小站编练的现代化新式陆军。该军原名定武军，后改称新建陆军，是北洋军的前身。
description.en: A modernized army established by Yuan Shikai at Xiaozhan in the late Qing Dynasty. Originally known as the Dingwu Army, it was later renamed the Newly Created Army, which served as the predecessor of the Beiyang Army.

en: Society for the Study of Self-Strengthening

description.zh-cn: 清末维新派在北京成立的政治团体，旨在推动变法维新。
description.en: A political group founded by reformists in Beijing during the late Qing dynasty to promote political reform and modernization.

description.zh-cn: 由宋教仁主导，将中国同盟会改组并联合其他党派而成的政党，在1913年国会选举中获胜，成为第一大党。
description.en: A political party led by Song Jiaoren, formed by reorganizing the Tongmenghui and uniting with other parties, which won the 1913 parliamentary election.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯发起复辟帝制、建立中华帝国的政治运动。这是一个由袁世凯筹备建立的君主立宪制国家，年号洪宪，计划取代中华民国。最终在护国运动的压力下被迫取消。
description.en: A political movement initiated by Yuan Shikai to restore the monarchy, leading to the planned establishment of the Empire of China. This constitutional monarchy, with the era name Hongxian, was intended to replace the Republic of China but was ultimately abolished under the pressure of the National Protection War.

description.zh-cn: 由杨度等人发起，旨在为袁世凯称帝制造舆论和理论支持的政治团体。

中国历史上继元朝之后的大一统王朝，也是最后一个由汉族统治的帝制王朝。其间改行中书省为承宣布政使司，俗称“行省”。
由忽必烈建立的中国历史上由蒙古族建立的大一统王朝，追尊蒙哥为宪宗桓肃皇帝。其设立行中书省作为一级地方行政区划，官场上使用空印文书的习惯做法被明朝沿用，并最终引发了空印案。
description.en: A Chinese dynasty founded by Kublai Khan, and established by the Mongols, which posthumously honored Möngke as Emperor Xianzong Huansu. The bureaucratic practice of using empty-sealed documents, inherited from the Yuan, led to the Empty Seal Case in the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 元朝末年红巾军领袖，朱元璋的义父。
description.en: A leader of the Red Turban Rebellion during the late Yuan dynasty, and the adoptive father-in-law of Zhu Yuanzhang.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋的皇后，郭子兴的养女，朱高煦之祖母。

description.en: A founding military marshal of the Ming Dynasty, ranked first among the six founding 'kings', enfeoffed as Prince of Zhongshan. He was the maternal grandfather of Zhu Gaoxu.

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国名将。体貌奇伟，勇力绝伦，猿臂善射，统军有方。官至中书平章军国重事，兼太子少保。曾封郑国公、鄂国公。北伐中原时暴卒军中，追封开平王，谥号忠武。
description.en: Founding general of the Ming Dynasty. Known for his exceptional bravery and military skill. He held high positions such as Grand Marshal and Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince, and was enfeoffed as the Duke of E. He died suddenly during the northern expedition against the Yuan and was posthumously created Prince of Kaiping with the posthumous name Zhongwu.

description.en: Four major political cases during the Hongwu era of the Ming Dynasty, initiated by Emperor Hongwu (Zhu Yuanzhang) to consolidate power, purge officials and meritorious subjects, and centralize authority. They include the Empty Seal Case, the Case of Guo Huan, the Case of Hu Weiyong, and the Case of Lan Yu.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋第四子，明朝第三位皇帝，明成祖。原为燕王，通过靖难之役从其侄建文帝手中夺取皇位，年号永乐。他下令编纂《永乐大典》。他是朱高煦之父。
description.en: The third Emperor of the Ming Dynasty, known as the Yongle Emperor, and the fourth son of the Hongwu Emperor. He seized the throne from his nephew, the Jianwen Emperor, through the Jingnan Campaign. He commissioned the compilation of the Yongle Encyclopedia, and was the father of Zhu Gaoxu.

description.en: The founder of the Later Jin, who unified the Jurchen tribes. He achieved numerous victories in wars against the Ming Dynasty but was defeated and wounded by Yuan Chonghuan at the Battle of Ningyuan, dying shortly thereafter.

description.zh-cn: 由女真首领努尔哈赤建立的政权，是清朝的前身。在其存续期间，与明朝在辽东地区展开了长期的军事对抗。
description.en: A regime established by the Jurchen leader Nurhaci, and the predecessor to the Qing Dynasty. During its existence, it engaged in long-term military conflict with the Ming Dynasty in the Liaodong region.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤第八子，后金第二位大汗，清朝的开国皇帝。他继续对明朝的战争，并于1629年发动己巳之变，绕道蒙古攻入明朝内地。
description.en: Son of Nurhaci, the second khan of the Later Jin and the founding emperor of the Qing Dynasty. He continued the war against the Ming and launched the Jisi Incident in 1629, bypassing the Ming defenses via Mongolia to attack the Ming heartland.

description.zh-cn: 明末农民起义领袖，大顺皇帝。其军队被认为是焚毁《永乐大典》正本的可能原因之一。
description.en: A leader of a peasant rebellion at the end of the Ming dynasty, whose army is considered a possible cause for the destruction of the original manuscript of the Yongle Encyclopedia.

description.zh-cn: 由李自成建立的政权。
明末清初军事家、政治家，吴周开国皇帝，三藩之一。
description.en: A military general and politician in the late Ming and early Qing dynasties, founding emperor of the Wu Zhou dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清初政治家、军事家，努尔哈赤第十四子，顺治帝摄政王，清朝入关初期的实际统治者。
清朝第四位皇帝，清朝入关后的第二位皇帝，年号康熙，庙号清圣祖。在位61年，是中国历史上在位时间最长的皇帝。雍正帝之父，隆科多的表兄。
description.en: The fourth emperor of the Qing dynasty, posthumously known as Emperor Shengzu. His 61-year reign makes him the longest-reigning emperor in Chinese history. He was also the cousin of Longkodo and father of the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝初年吴三桂、耿精忠、尚之信发动的反清叛乱。
中国清朝第五位皇帝，清世宗，年号雍正。康熙帝第四子，乾隆帝之父，孝圣宪皇后的丈夫。
description.en: The fifth emperor of the Qing dynasty, the fourth son of the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 由雍正帝设立的清朝中枢权力机构，主要在清朝中后期发挥作用。
中国清朝第六位皇帝，年号乾隆，清高宗，雍正帝第四子，孝圣宪皇后之子。他实际掌握中国最高权力长达六十三年零四个月，是中国历史上实际执掌国家最高权力时间最长的皇帝。在位期间，下令开四库馆并从《永乐大典》中辑佚。
description.en: The sixth emperor of the Qing dynasty, who held supreme power in China for 63 years and four months, making him the longest-reigning de facto ruler in Chinese history. During his reign, he ordered the establishment of the Siku Quanshu project and the recovery of lost texts from the Yongle Encyclopedia.

description.zh-cn: 清朝乾隆年间编修的中国历史上规模最大的丛书，其编纂过程中从《永乐大典》中辑佚了大量古籍。
description.en: The largest collection of books in Chinese history, compiled during the Qianlong era of the Qing dynasty. A significant number of lost ancient books were recovered from the Yongle Encyclopedia for its compilation.

The conflict was triggered by the Qing government's campaign against the British opium trade, which culminated in the destruction of opium at Humen. He recorded details about the Empty Seal Case in his works 'Biography of Ye and Zheng' and 'Conduct of My Late Father'. He was a Ming general who initially served as the chief commander of the Jianwen Emperor's forces during the Jingnan campaign. Despite his position, he suffered repeated defeats and eventually opened the Jinchuan Gate to surrender to Zhu Di, the Prince of Yan. In the Yongle era, he was stripped of his title and placed under house arrest.

description.zh-cn: 位于吉林省长春市，是以培养飞行人才为主的综合性高等军事院校，隶属中国人民解放军空军。其历史可追溯至由东北人民解放军航空学校于1949年5月更名而来的机构。学校于2004年6月9日由多所院校合并组建。其前身院校包括：1993年由空军第一飞行基础学校（该校前身为1986年由空军第一航空预备学校更名而来的机构，后于1993年升格为空军长春飞行学院）升格而来的机构；1992年10月由空军第二航空技术专科学校（该校前身为1986年由空军第二航空机务学校升格而来，并于1992年升格为空军第二航空学院）升格而成的机构；以及1986年6月更名并持续至2004年合并组建的空军第七航空学校（该校源于1949年由牡丹江航校定名，并于1952年1月更名为空军第七航空学校，活跃于1949年12月20日-1952年1月）。此外，由空军第十三航空学校于1986年7月升格而来的某机构，也于2012年4月并入空军航空大学。2017年在深化国防和军队改革中，学校进行了调整重组。
description.en: Located in Changchun, Jilin Province, it is a comprehensive higher military institution mainly for training flight personnel, affiliated with the PLA Air Force. Its history can be traced back to an institution renamed from the Northeast People's Liberation Army Aviation School in May 1949. The university itself was initially formed on June 9, 2004, by the merger of several institutions. Its predecessor institutions include: an institution upgraded in 1993 from the Air Force First Flight Basic School (which originated from the Air Force First Aviation Preparatory School, renamed in 1986, and later upgraded to Air Force Changchun Flight College in 1993); an institution upgraded from the Air Force Second Aeronautical Technical College in October 1992 (this college was upgraded from the Air Force Second Aeronautical and Mechanical School in 1986 and further upgraded to the Air Force Second Aviation College in 1992); and the Air Force Seventh Aviation School (which originated from the Mudanjiang Aviation School in 1949, was renamed the Air Force Seventh Aviation School in January 1952, active from December 20, 1949, to January 1952, and was later renamed in June 1986 and continued until the 2004 merger). Additionally, an institution upgraded from the Air Force Thirteenth Aviation School in July 1986 was merged into the Air Force Aviation University in April 2012. It was further reorganized in 2017 during the reform of national defense and the military.

对王立军徇私枉法、叛逃、滥用职权、受贿案的司法审判。

zh-cn: 郭维国、李阳、王鹏飞、王智徇私枉法案

description.zh-cn: 对郭维国等四名重庆警官在海伍德死亡案中徇私枉法的司法审判。
中国人民解放军上将，曾任火箭军司令员。

zh-cn: 美国空军中国航空航天研究所
中国人民解放军军事检察院

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军火箭军少将，曾任火箭军装备部部长。
中国人民解放军海军中将，曾任南部战区副司令员兼南部战区海军司令员。
中国人民解放军中将，曾任中央军委装备发展部副部长。
中国人民解放军中将，曾任中央军委装备发展部副部长。
中国人民解放军空军上将，曾任空军司令员。
中国人民解放军火箭军中将，曾任火箭军副司令员。
中国人民解放军陆军上将，曾任火箭军政治委员。
曾任中国航天科技集团董事长。
曾任中国兵器工业集团董事长。
曾任中国运载火箭技术研究院院长、长征七号运载火箭总指挥。
中国人民解放军火箭军中将。

zh-cn: 中国运载火箭技术研究院
en: China Academy of Launch Vehicle Technology

zh-cn: 中共十八大后的反腐败

description.zh-cn: 位于青藏高原与四川盆地之间的地震断裂带，是汶川大地震的主要成因。
地球主要构造板块之一，其向欧亚板块的持续推挤是龙门山断层活动和汶川地震的根本原因。
地球主要构造板块之一。

zh-cn: 卧龙国家级自然保护区
中国大熊猫保护研究中心

description.zh-cn: 位于都江堰玉垒山麓，是为纪念李冰父子而修建的祀庙。在汶川大地震中全部垮塌后重建。
description.en: Located at the foot of Mount Yulei in Dujiangyan, it is a temple built to commemorate Li Bing and his son. It was rebuilt after completely collapsing in the Wenchuan earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 中国大陆艺术家、社会活动家及异见人士，诗人艾青之子，活跃于建筑、艺术、影像和社会文化评论领域。他曾因调查川震遇难学生名单，其志愿者屡受地方政府扣留。
description.en: A Chinese contemporary artist, activist, and dissident. He is the son of poet Ai Qing and is active in the fields of architecture, art, film, and social and cultural criticism. He is notable for his investigation into the student casualties of the Sichuan earthquake, a process during which his volunteers were repeatedly detained by local authorities.

description.zh-cn: 中国异见人士，因帮助四川大地震死难者家长调查被判刑。
四川作家、维权人士，因致力于调查灾区学校豆腐渣工程并搜集川震遇难学生名单而被判刑。艾未未曾为其出庭作证。
description.en: Sichuanese writer and human rights activist, who was sentenced to prison for his dedication to investigating shoddy school construction in disaster areas and collecting lists of student victims of the Sichuan earthquake. Ai Weiwei testified in court for him.

description.zh-cn: 为悼念汶川大地震遇难者，中国首次为普通民众死难者设立的全国性哀悼活动。
汶川地震形成的最危险的堰塞湖。
时任四川省省长，于2012年宣布灾后重建完成。
1894年朝鲜爆发的农民起义，成为甲午战争的直接导火索。
朝鲜半岛历史上的一个王朝，统治时间为1392年至1897年。它当时是朝鲜半岛的统治政权，名义上为清朝的藩属国，是战争爆发的核心争端地区，并在征韩论时期采取锁国政策。在福泽谕吉的《脱亚论》中被视为应与之“绝交”的“恶友”。
description.en: A Korean dynastic kingdom that ruled the Korean Peninsula from 1392 to 1897. It was the ruling power on the Korean peninsula at that time, nominally a vassal state of the Qing dynasty, and a core disputed area for the outbreak of war. During the Seikanron debate, it adopted a policy of isolationism. It was also regarded by Fukuzawa Yukichi in 'Datsu-A Ron' as a 'bad friend' with whom Japan should break ties.

description.zh-cn: 甲午战争后清朝与日本签订的不平等条约，导致中国割地赔款并丧失多项主权。
description.en: An unequal treaty signed between the Qing dynasty and Japan after the First Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 清朝建立的近代化海军舰队，在甲午战争中全军覆没。
俄国、德国、法国联合干涉，迫使日本将《马关条约》中割占的辽东半岛归还给中国的事件。
日军在占领旅顺后对城内军民进行的大规模屠杀。
北洋水师提督，在威海卫之战后自杀殉国。
日本第122代天皇，大日本帝国第一代大元帅。作为国家元首，他在甲午战争和日俄战争期间积极推动军事扩张，并见证了日本从孤立的封建国家向工业化世界强国的转变。
description.en: The 122nd Emperor of Japan and the first Grand Marshal of the Empire of Japan. As head of state, he actively promoted military expansion during the First Sino-Japanese War and the Russo-Japanese War, and witnessed Japan's transformation from an isolated feudal state into an industrialized world power.

description.zh-cn: 日本近代政治家，明治维新元老，曾四次担任日本内阁总理大臣（亦是首任），甲午战争期间曾任日本首相，并任首任统监府统监。
description.en: Japanese politician, Meiji Restoration elder, served four terms as Prime Minister of Japan, and was the first Resident-General of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军大将，指挥第二军攻陷旅顺并发动旅顺大屠杀。
清朝醇亲王，道光帝第七子，载沣与光绪帝之父。曾负责海军事务，为迎合慈禧太后而挪用海军军费。
description.en: Prince Chun of the Qing Dynasty, the seventh son of the Daoguang Emperor, and the father of Zaifeng and the Guangxu Emperor. He was in charge of naval affairs and misappropriated naval funds to please Empress Dowager Cixi.

description.zh-cn: 清朝户部尚书，曾奏准暂停海军购买外洋枪炮船只。
东学党首领，领导了东学党起义。
甲午战争中双方海军主力进行的一场决定性海战。

zh-cn: 海峡两岸服务贸易协议

description.zh-cn: 由海峡两岸关系协会与海峡交流基金会签署的服务贸易协定，旨在开放两岸服务业市场。该协议在立法院的审查争议是太阳花学运的直接导火索。
description.en: A service trade agreement signed by ARATS and SEF, aimed at opening up the service industry markets across the Taiwan Strait. Its controversial review in the Legislative Yuan was the direct trigger of the Sunflower Student Movement.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，中国国民党籍立法委员，曾在国民党立委初选中击败李庆华。在立法院联席会议上宣布《海峡两岸服务贸易协议》视为已审查，直接引发了占领行动。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China who defeated Lee Ching-hua in a KMT legislative primary.

description.zh-cn: 2014年在台湾发生的一场学生与公民运动，是太阳花学运的开端与核心事件，期间示威者占领了立法院议场。
description.en: A student and civic movement in Taiwan in 2014, during which protesters occupied the legislative chamber.

description.zh-cn: 时任行政院院长，下令强制驱离占领行政院的群众。
太阳花学运期间，部分抗议群众转而占领行政院，后遭警方强制驱离。
负责执行驱离占领行政院群众任务的警察机关。
太阳花学运期间发起的大规模集会游行，主办单位宣称有数十万人参与。

zh-cn: 两岸协议监督条例草案

description.zh-cn: 为规范未来两岸协议的签订与审查程序、建立监督两岸协议的法律机制而提出的法律草案，是太阳花学运的核心诉求之一。
description.en: A proposed bill to regulate the signing and review process of future cross-strait agreements, one of the core demands of the Sunflower Student Movement.

zh-cn: 2014年中华民国地方公职人员选举

description.zh-cn: 俗称“九合一选举”，中国国民党在此次选举中遭遇重大挫败，被认为与太阳花学运有关。

zh-cn: 2016年中华民国总统副总统及立法委员选举

description.zh-cn: 此次选举中，民主进步党获得胜利，实现首次完全执政，其结果被认为受到太阳花学运影响。
中华民国政党，受太阳花学运影响而出现的“第三势力”政党。
description.en: A political party in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，太阳花学运主要的学生领袖之一。
太阳花学运主要的学生领袖之一。
中华民国政治人物、律师、法律学者。太阳花学运的主要人物与决策核心成员之一。曾为时代力量党员，在2016年立法委员选举中击败李庆华。现任台湾民众党主席、立法委员，曾任立法院党团总召。他曾发动“扫除绿卫兵”行动，参与罢免民进党籍民意代表。
description.en: A politician, lawyer, and legal scholar of the Republic of China. One of the key figures and core decision-makers of the Sunflower Student Movement. He was formerly a member of the New Power Party and defeated Lee Ching-hua in the 2016 legislative election. He is currently serving as Chairman of the Taiwan People's Party and a Legislative Yuan member. He previously served as the caucus convener of the Legislative Yuan party group, and during that period, he initiated the 'Sweep the Green Guards' campaign, participating in the recall of DPP representatives.

description.zh-cn: 由多个公民团体组成的联盟，是发起太阳花学运的主要组织之一。
由各校学运社团组成的学生团体，是发起太阳花学运的主要组织之一。
太阳花学运核心人物之一，因被控在占领行政院事件中煽惑他人犯罪而受审。
负责审理太阳花学运相关案件的法院。
蔡英文政府首任行政院院长，其内阁上任后撤回对126名占领行政院行动者的刑事告诉。
太平天国创始人之一，早期核心人物，与洪秀全一同传教，被封为南王。
太平天国早期核心领袖、东王，掌握军政实权，后在天京事变中被杀。
太平天国早期核心领袖，被封为西王。
太平天国早期核心领袖，被封为北王，发动天京事变。
太平天国早期核心领袖，被封为翼王。因天京事变及洪秀全猜忌而出走。
洪秀全长子，太平天国第二代领袖，幼天王。
由洪秀全、冯云山创立的宗教组织，是太平天国的前身。
太平天国运动的开端。
太平天国领导集团的内部冲突，导致其由盛转衰。
太平天国首都天京被湘军攻陷，标志着太平天国运动的失败。
由李鸿章建立的晚清地方武装，曾参与镇压太平天国，其旧部也成为北洋新军军官的来源之一。
description.en: A regional army in the late Qing Dynasty, established by Li Hongzhang, which participated in suppressing the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom. Its former members were also one of the sources of officers for the Beiyang New Army.

description.zh-cn: 由梁发编写的基督教布道书，对洪秀全创立拜上帝会产生重要影响。
基督徒，《劝世良言》的作者。
晚清时期活跃于华北的农民起义军，后期与太平军残部合并。
洪秀全族弟，太平天国后期重要领导人，被封为干王、军师。
石达开余部将领，被认为是最后一支覆灭的太平军。

en: Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea

description.zh-cn: 1919年至1948年间在朝鲜日治时期于中国上海成立的流亡政府。
description.en: An exile government established in Shanghai, China during the Japanese colonial period, active from 1919 to 1948.

description.zh-cn: 韩国军事将领、政治家，前总统和军事独裁者。他通过五一六军事政变上台，并且在金泳三的政治生涯早期是其主要政治对手。
description.en: Former South Korean president, military general, politician, and dictator. He came to power through the May 16 coup and was a major political opponent of Kim Young-sam during the early part of Kim's career.

description.zh-cn: 韩国前总统和军事独裁者，大韩民国第五共和国总统。他通过双十二政变上台，又发动5·17政变扩大权力。其宣布的戒严是2024年戒严事件的重要历史参照。金泳三执政期间，他因腐败和镇压光州民主化运动被起诉并定罪，后被金泳三赦免。
description.en: Former South Korean president and military dictator, and the fifth President of the Republic of Korea. He seized power in the Coup d'état of December Twelfth and further solidified his power through the May 17 coup. His declaration of martial law serves as a key historical precedent for the 2024 martial law event. During Kim Young-sam's presidency, he was prosecuted and convicted for corruption and for suppressing the Gwangju Uprising, and was later pardoned by Kim.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国前总统，韩国民主运动领袖，金泳三的继任总统。他曾推行“阳光政策”，并与金泳三、金钟泌并称为“三金”，在韩国政坛上既是竞争对手也是合作伙伴。其三个儿子也曾担任国会议员。
description.en: A leader of the South Korean democracy movement and Kim Young-sam's successor as president of the Republic of Korea. He implemented the 'Sunshine Policy'. Along with Kim Young-sam and Kim Jong-pil, he was one of the 'Three Kims,' who were both rivals and partners in South Korean politics. His three sons also served as members of the National Assembly.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国第16任总统。他曾延续对朝友好政策，并在公开演讲中提及黎明在韩国的知名度。
description.en: The 16th President of the Republic of Korea, who mentioned Leon Lai's fame in Korea during a public speech.

description.zh-cn: 韩国史上首位女性总统，后遭弹劾下台。
韩国共同民主党党代表，强烈反对2024年戒严令，并呼吁民众保护国会。他本人也在尹锡悦的计划逮捕名单上。
description.en: Leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, who strongly opposed the 2024 martial law, called on citizens to protect the National Assembly, and was on Yoon Suk Yeol's planned arrest list.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的第三代最高领导人，现任朝鲜劳动党总书记和国务委员会委员长，并于2018年与文在寅共同签署了《板门店宣言》。
description.en: The third supreme leader of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, currently serving as the General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and Chairman of the State Affairs Commission, and who co-signed the Panmunjom Declaration with Moon Jae-in in 2018.

description.zh-cn: 由朴正熙等人发动的军事政变，导致国会被解散，第三共和国建立。
description.en: A military coup led by Park Chung-hee and others, which resulted in the dissolution of the National Assembly and the establishment of the Third Republic.

description.zh-cn: 1987年6月在韩国爆发的全国性民主运动，迫使全斗焕政府接受了总统直选制等民主化要求。
description.en: A nationwide pro-democracy movement in South Korea in June 1987, which forced the Chun Doo-hwan government to accept democratic reforms, including direct presidential elections.

description.zh-cn: 李承晚独裁统治时期。
四一九革命后建立的民主政府。
韩国现行的宪政体制，始于1987年的民主化改宪，该改宪是六月民主运动的成果。自此建立的民主政府延续至今。
description.en: The current constitutional system of South Korea began with the democratic constitutional reforms of 1987, which were the outcome of the June Democratic Movement. The democratic government established since then continues to this day.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国的立法机关，是韩国三权分立宪政体制中的重要组成部分。在2024年戒严期间，国会议员集会并通过决议，成功废除了戒严令。
description.en: The legislative body of the Republic of Korea, an important component of the country's constitutional system of separation of powers. During the 2024 martial law, its members convened and passed a resolution to successfully nullify the martial law decree.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国宪法裁判机构。
指韩国经济高速发展的时期。
2024年12月3日由时任韩国总统尹锡悦宣布的紧急戒严，在约6小时后被国会决议废除，该事件引发了严重的政治危机。
description.en: An emergency martial law declared by then-South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol on December 3, 2024, which was nullified by a National Assembly resolution about 6 hours later, sparking a severe political crisis.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国国务总理。
韩国政治人物，现任韩国国会议长。2024年戒严期间，他召集国会会议，并宣布废除戒严令的决议获通过。
description.en: South Korean politician and current Speaker of the National Assembly. During the 2024 martial law, he convened a session of the National Assembly and announced the passage of the resolution to nullify it.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国大法院院长。
大韩民国宪法法院院长。
大韩民国最高司法机构。

zh-cn: 弗兰克-瓦尔特·施泰因迈尔

description.zh-cn: 德国政治人物，现任德国联邦总统。
德国政治人物，德国候任总理。
冷战期间位于中欧的国家，由苏联占领区成立。
德意志民主共和国（东德）并入德意志联邦共和国（西德）的政治事件。
德国政治家、外交家，首任德意志帝国首相。因其“铁血政策”而被称为“铁血宰相”，通过一系列战争主导了德意志的统一。
description.en: A German statesman and diplomat, and the first Chancellor of the German Empire. Known as the 'Iron Chancellor' for his 'iron and blood' policy, he orchestrated the unification of Germany through a series of wars.

description.zh-cn: 普鲁士国王及首任德意志皇帝。
description.en: King of Prussia and the first German Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 16世纪欧洲的基督教改革运动，始于德意志地区，导致神圣罗马帝国在宗教上分裂。
德国神学家，宗教改革的发起者。
罗马公教会。

zh-cn: 奥托一世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 德意志国王，首位神圣罗马帝国皇帝。
西德首任联邦总理。
德国主要政党之一。
德国主要政党之一。
中国政治人物，在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间担任全国人大常委会副委员长兼秘书长。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as a Vice Chairman and concurrently Secretary-General of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 张高丽的妻子。
description.en: Wife of Zhang Gaoli.

zh-cn: 彭帅指控张高丽性丑闻事件

description.zh-cn: 彭帅在微博发文指控前中国国务院副总理张高丽性侵的事件。
description.en: The event where Peng Shuai accused former Chinese Vice Premier Zhang Gaoli of sexual assault in a Weibo post.

nodes.id: BAIDU:第24届冬奥会工作领导小组

zh-cn: 第24届冬奥会工作领导小组

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后之妹，光绪帝生母。
光绪帝的妃嫔。
光绪帝的妃嫔，珍妃之姐。
由光绪帝于1898年颁布，标志戊戌变法开始的诏书。
清朝第八位皇帝，光绪帝和载沣的祖父，咸丰帝之父。其在位期间爆发了第一次鸦片战争。在鸦片问题上，他最初支持林则徐的严禁政策并下令终止鸦片贸易，但在战争爆发后态度转变，将林则徐革职。
description.en: The eighth emperor of the Qing dynasty, grandfather of Guangxu and Zaifeng, and father of Xianfeng. During his reign, the First Opium War broke out. On the opium issue, he initially supported Lin Zexu's strict prohibition policy and ordered him to end the opium trade, but changed his stance after the war's outbreak, leading to Lin's dismissal.

description.zh-cn: 王洪文的妻子，上海棉纺织十七厂工人。
赵乐际之父，曾任《青海日报》副总编、陕西人民教育出版社社长。
中国共产党成都市委员会书记

description.en: The governor of Shu Commandery in the State of Qin during the Warring States period, who presided over the construction of Dujiangyan.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代建设并使用至今的大型水利工程，位于四川省都江堰市城西。由鱼嘴、飞沙堰、宝瓶口等主体工程构成，主要作用是引水灌溉和防洪。
description.en: A large-scale hydraulic engineering project built in ancient China and still in use today, located west of Dujiangyan City, Sichuan Province. It consists of main structures such as the Yuzui, Feishayan, and Baopingkou, with its primary functions being water diversion for irrigation and flood control.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期蜀汉开国皇帝，刘禅之父。他被张松视为可以取代刘璋的明主，并在张松的协助下进入益州，最终夺取了该地。
description.en: Founding emperor of Shu Han, father of Liu Shan. He was seen by Zhang Song as a worthy ruler to replace Liu Zhang, and with Zhang Song's assistance, he entered Yi Province and eventually seized control of it.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期西南方的政权之一，由刘备建立。
description.en: One of the three major states that competed for supremacy over China in the Three Kingdoms period, founded by Liu Bei.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏将领，率军灭亡蜀汉。
description.en: A general of Cao Wei who led the conquest of Shu Han.

description.zh-cn: 清朝时期的大规模移民运动。
民国时期川军将领，四川省主席。

description.zh-cn: 联合国的专门机构之一，旨在通过教育、科学和文化促进国际合作。巩俐于2000年被任命为该组织的“促进和平艺术家”。
description.en: A specialized agency of the United Nations aimed at promoting international cooperation through education, science, and culture. Gong Li was appointed as a UNESCO Artist for Peace in 2000.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期秦国君主，秦朝开国皇帝，中国历史上首位完成华夏大一统的政治人物，也是中国首位称皇帝的君主。他下令实施“焚书坑儒”，导致《论语》等经典几近失传。
description.en: The first political figure to complete the unification of China, and the first monarch in China to be titled 'Emperor'. He also ordered the 'Burning of books and burying of scholars', which nearly led to the loss of classics like the Analects.

description.zh-cn: 南越国创建者。
19世纪中叶清朝与西方列强之间发生的两场冲突，包括第一次鸦片战争和第二次鸦片战争。
description.en: A series of two wars waged between the Qing dynasty and Western powers in the mid-19th century, comprising the First Opium War and the Second Opium War.

description.en: Leader of a major rebellion in the late Tang dynasty and emperor of the Qi dynasty.

五代十国时期的十国之一。
description.en: One of the Ten Kingdoms during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period.

description.en: Vietnamese politician, currently serving as the President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 由胡志明等人创办的越南革命组织，旨在反对法国和日本的殖民统治。
description.en: A Vietnamese revolutionary organization founded by Hồ Chí Minh and others to oppose French and Japanese colonial rule.

description.zh-cn: 由越南独立同盟会发动的起义，旨在夺取越南政权并宣布独立。
description.en: An uprising launched by the Viet Minh to seize power in Vietnam and declare independence.

description.zh-cn: 1945年由胡志明宣布成立，通常被称为北越。该国是越南战争中的一方，曾向中国请求抗疟药物援助。
description.en: A state proclaimed by Hồ Chí Minh in 1945, commonly known as North Vietnam. It was a party in the Vietnam War that requested antimalarial drug assistance from China.

description.zh-cn: 第一次印度支那战争中的决定性战役，越南民主共和国军队在此击败法军。
description.en: The decisive battle of the First Indochina War, where the forces of the Democratic Republic of Vietnam defeated the French.

description.zh-cn: 1955年由吴廷琰建立的国家，通常被称为南越，在越南战争中与北越对峙。
description.en: A state established by Ngô Đình Diệm in 1955, commonly known as South Vietnam, which opposed North Vietnam during the Vietnam War.

description.zh-cn: 越南共和国首任总统
指标志着越南战争结束的北越军队攻陷南越首都西贡事件，该事件直接促成了越南的统一。
description.en: Refers to the event where North Vietnamese forces captured Saigon, the capital of South Vietnam, marking the end of the Vietnam War and leading directly to the reunification of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 越南共产党于1986年开始推行的经济改革政策，旨在建立社会主义市场经济。
description.en: An economic reform policy initiated by the Communist Party of Vietnam in 1986, aimed at establishing a socialist-oriented market economy.

蒙古帝国的创建者及首任皇帝（大汗），后被元朝追尊为元太祖，是蒙哥的祖父。
description.en: The founder and first Great Khan of the Mongol Empire, and the grandfather of Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 元朝初年重要谋臣，金莲川幕府核心人物，曾劝说忽必烈定国号为“大元”。
中国古代典籍，元朝国号“大元”的出处。
忽必烈汗颁布的确立“大元”国号的诏书。
宋朝的南迁政权，是中国南方的汉人政权，是宋朝的后半期，由宋高宗赵构建立。蒙哥在位期间曾对其发动大规模进攻，最终被元朝所灭。
description.en: A Han Chinese dynasty in southern China, which was subjected to a large-scale invasion during Möngke's reign.

description.zh-cn: 元朝皇室退居漠北后的政权。
由女真族建立的统治中国北方和东北地区的封建王朝，后被蒙古帝国所灭。
description.en: A feudal dynasty established by the Jurchen people that ruled northern and northeastern China.

description.zh-cn: 成吉思汗的第四子，蒙哥、元世祖忽必烈、旭烈兀、阿里不哥的父亲。
description.en: The fourth son of Genghis Khan, and the father of Möngke, Kublai, Hulagu, and Ariq Böke.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国第四任大汗，拖雷长子，元朝追尊为宪宗桓肃皇帝。其在位期间发动了对南宋、大理、西亚等地的征服战争，但在征伐南宋的钓鱼城之战中去世，他的死引发了帝国分裂。
description.en: The fourth Great Khan of the Mongol Empire and the eldest son of Tolui, posthumously honored as Emperor Xianzong Huansu by the Yuan Dynasty. During his reign, he launched wars of conquest against the Southern Song, Dali, and West Asia. He died during the Battle of Diaoyu Fortress while invading the Southern Song, and his death triggered the division of the empire.

description.zh-cn: 拖雷第七子，忽必烈与蒙哥之弟，在蒙哥去世后、拖雷家族内战中与忽必烈争夺汗位。
description.en: Möngke's younger brother, who contended with Kublai for the khanship after Möngke's death.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥去世后，其弟忽必烈与阿里不哥为争夺蒙古帝国汗位而爆发的内战，导致蒙古帝国分裂。
description.en: A civil war that broke out after Möngke's death between his brothers Kublai and Ariq Böke for the succession to the khanship, leading to the division of the Mongol Empire.

description.zh-cn: 元朝末年爆发的大规模民变，直接导致元朝覆灭。
元军与南宋军队的最后决战，元朝在此战中彻底消灭南宋流亡政权，标志着南宋的灭亡。
明朝将领徐达领导的旨在推翻元朝统治的军事行动。
蒙古帝国第二任大汗，成吉思汗第三子和继承人，蒙哥的养父。
description.en: The second Great Khan of the Mongol Empire, third son and successor of Genghis Khan, and the adoptive father of Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国时期大臣，劝谏窝阔台汗在汉地实行汉法。
元朝最后一位皇帝，后退居漠北，成为北元开国皇帝。
中国春秋战国时期的哲学思想流派，以老子和庄周为主要代表人物，为道教的思想渊源之一。
description.en: A school of thought in the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods of China, with Laozi and Zhuangzi as its main representatives.

description.zh-cn: 太平道的开创者之一。
东汉末年的道教派别，由张角、于吉等人创立。
五斗米道的创立者，被尊为天师。

en: Way of the Five Pecks of Rice

description.zh-cn: 早期道教组织，由张道陵创立。
太平道的创立者，黄巾之乱的领导者。
一种世界性宗教和哲学体系，也是世界主要宗教之一。它对中国古代思想家，如皇侃，产生了影响，并与道教在中国历史上长期互动与论争。
description.en: A world religion and philosophical system that influenced ancient Chinese thinkers like Huang Kan.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年的一次大规模民变，刘备在此期间起兵。
中国历史上的一个朝代，是三国的前身。其末期许贡与孙策等人物活跃，周瑜名义上为其臣子，曹昂在此期间生活并被举为孝廉。
description.en: A Chinese dynasty, the predecessor of the Three Kingdoms. During its late period, figures like Xu Gong and Sun Ce were active. Zhou Yu was nominally its subject, and Cao Ang lived during this period and was nominated as Xiaolian.

description.zh-cn: 北魏道士，吸收佛教思想改革道教。
中国南北朝时期的北方王朝
唐朝第二位皇帝，开创“贞观之治”，被尊为“天可汗”，推崇道教，也是李泰之父。
description.en: The second emperor of the Tang dynasty, who initiated the 'Reign of Zhenguan' and was honored as the 'Tian Kehan', and was also the father of Li Tai.

description.zh-cn: 全真道掌教，改革道教戒律，曾与成吉思汗会面。
金元时期兴起的道教宗派，由王重阳创立。
全真道的创始人。
记述老子到西域、天竺教化胡人的道教经典，在佛道之争中被判为伪经并遭焚毁。
description.en: A Taoist scripture that promotes the 'Laozi huahu' theory.

description.zh-cn: 道教经籍的总集。
中国历史上三次由帝王发动的的灭佛事件。
北宋第八位皇帝，宋高宗之父。艺术家，自创“瘦金书”字体。笃信道教，自称“教主道君皇帝”，并追封庄周为微妙元通真君。因靖康之变被俘，客死异乡。
description.en: The eighth emperor of the Northern Song dynasty, an artist known for creating the "Slender Gold" style of calligraphy. A devout Daoist, he called himself "Jiaozhu Daojun Emperor" and posthumously honored Zhuang Zhou as Weimiao Yuantong Zhenjun. He was captured during the Jingkang incident and died in captivity.

description.zh-cn: 全真道掌教，丘处机弟子，曾与佛教发生激烈冲突。
元代曹洞宗高僧，少林寺住持。
西晋天师道祭酒，撰写《老子化胡经》。
description.en: A Celestial Master libationer of the Western Jin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 西晋大乘佛教高僧。
一种认为老子西出函谷关后，到天竺教化胡人、成为佛陀的观点，是佛道之争的核心议题之一。
description.en: A doctrine claiming that Laozi went to India after passing through Hangu Pass and converted the 'barbarians', becoming the Buddha.

description.zh-cn: 中国春秋时期思想家，道家学派和道教的创始人。
description.en: A Chinese philosopher of the Spring and Autumn period, founder of philosophical Taoism and religious Taoism.

description.zh-cn: 中国战国中期思想家、哲学家、文学家，道家学派的代表人物，被道教奉为祖师，其著作《南华经》为重要经典。
description.en: A representative figure of Taoism during the Warring States period in China.

description.zh-cn: 指儒教、道教、佛教三家思想的融合与调和。
三国时期曹魏的著名诗人和文学家，曹操与卞氏嫡出之第三子。在其作品《辩道论》中批驳道教神仙说。
description.en: A famous poet and writer of Cao Wei during the Three Kingdoms period, the third son of Cao Cao and Lady Bian.

梵蒂冈城邦的前身，是在756年由“丕平献土”事件后成立的政教合一主权国家，其领土曾广及意大利半岛中部。
description.en: The predecessor to the Vatican City State, a sovereign theocratic state established in 756 after the 'Donation of Pepin', which once controlled large territories in central Italy.

description.zh-cn: 由意大利王国与圣座为解决“罗马问题”而签订的条约，正式确立并承认梵蒂冈城邦为主权国家。
description.en: A treaty signed between the Kingdom of Italy and the Holy See to resolve the 'Roman Question', which recognized Vatican City as a sovereign state.

description.zh-cn: 天主教会第259任教宗，代表圣座签署了《拉特兰条约》。
description.en: The 259th Pope of the Catholic Church, who signed the Lateran Treaty on behalf of the Holy See.

description.zh-cn: 法兰克国王丕平将意大利中部的大片领土（包括罗马城及其周围区域）赠予教宗的历史事件，奠定了教宗国的基础。
description.en: A historical event in which Pepin, King of the Franks, granted the Pope large territories in central Italy.

description.zh-cn: 法兰克王国国王，将罗马城及其周围区域赠予教宗，史称“丕平献土”，奠定了教宗国的基础。
description.en: King of the Franks, who donated the city of Rome and its surrounding areas to the Pope, known as the 'Donation of Pepin', laying the foundation for the Papal States.

description.en: The 19th-century political and social movement that resulted in the consolidation of different states of the Italian Peninsula into a single state, the Kingdom of Italy.

欧洲联盟的前身之一。
法律上独立于欧盟的国际组织，但在欧洲共同体的管辖范围内。
由欧洲煤钢共同体、欧洲经济共同体和欧洲原子能共同体合并而成，是欧盟的前身。
时任法国外交部长

en: 2016 United Kingdom European Union membership referendum

description.zh-cn: 位于欧洲西北部的构成国，是荷兰王国的主要组成部分，也是欧盟创始成员国之一。
description.en: A constituent country located in Northwestern Europe, the main component of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, and a founding member of the EU.

description.zh-cn: 欧盟创始成员国之一
乌克兰总统，在俄罗斯全面入侵后领导乌克兰进行抵抗。
description.en: President of Ukraine, who has led the country's resistance following the full-scale Russian invasion.

description.zh-cn: 欧盟成员国
现任英国首相，工党领袖。
英国的最高立法机关。
英国的中右翼政党，马尔康·芮夫金是其成员。
description.en: A centre-right political party in the United Kingdom, of which Malcolm Rifkind is a member.

description.zh-cn: 英国哲学家，被广泛誉为自由主义之父和早期启蒙运动思想家。
一种哲学理论，认为知识仅来自或主要来自感官经验。
英国博物学家、地质学家和生物学家，以其对进化科学的贡献而闻名。
研究生命的自然科学。
英国摇滚乐队，被广泛认为是有史以来最有影响力的乐队。
乌克兰现任总理
乌克兰最高拉达主席
乌克兰的立法机关

description.en: A revolution that broke out in February 2014, ultimately overthrowing the Yanukovych government.

zh-cn: 维克多·费奥多罗维奇·亚努科维奇

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰前总统，因在2013年拒绝与欧盟签订联合协议而引发迈丹革命，最终被罢免并逃离乌克兰。
description.en: Former President of Ukraine, whose refusal to sign an association agreement with the EU in 2013 triggered the Euromaidan Revolution, leading to his ousting and flight from Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 成吉思汗长子术赤之子，金帐汗国的建立者，是推举蒙哥称汗的关键人物。
description.en: Son of Jochi, the eldest son of Genghis Khan, founder of the Golden Horde, and a key figure in the election of Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 2014年4月在乌克兰顿巴斯地区爆发的武装冲突，由俄罗斯支持的分裂分子与乌克兰政府军交战。
description.en: An armed conflict that began in April 2014 in the Donbas region of Ukraine, fought between Russia-backed separatists and Ukrainian government forces.

description.zh-cn: 指中华民国北洋政府时期，大总统府与国务院之间的权力斗争。黎元洪与段祺瑞是早期核心人物，后期主要发生在冯国璋与段祺瑞之间。
description.en: Refers to the power struggle between the Presidential Palace and the State Council during the Beiyang government period of the Republic of China. Li Yuanhong and Duan Qirui were key figures in the early phase, with the struggle later primarily involving Feng Guozhang and Duan Qirui.

description.zh-cn: 张勋率军进入北京，拥立清朝末代皇帝溥仪复辟的政治事件，仅持续12天便以失败告终。
description.en: A political event orchestrated by Zhang Xun, which involved leading troops into Beijing to restore the Qing dynasty and Emperor Puyi, but was short-lived and failed after only 12 days.

en: Republic of China declaration of war on Germany

description.zh-cn: 1917年中华民国国会讨论的是否对德意志帝国宣战的议案。
中华民国军事将领，直系军阀首领，曾任中华民国第五任大总统。
description.en: A Chinese warlord, leader of the Zhili clique, and President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国早期最重要的军阀势力之一，由袁世凯培植的北洋新军主要将领组成。该军事政治集团在民国初年控制北洋政府。袁世凯死后于1916年分裂为多个派系，形成军阀割据局面。
description.en: A military-political group that controlled the Beiyang government in the early Republic of China. It was one of the most important warlord factions, composed of the main generals of the Beiyang New Army cultivated by Yuan Shikai. After Yuan's death in 1916, it split into several cliques, leading to a period of warlordism.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期，由段祺瑞领导的北洋军阀主要派系之一，受日本支持。
description.en: One of the main warlord factions during the Beiyang government era of the Republic of China, led by Duan Qirui and supported by Japan.

description.zh-cn: 北洋军阀的主要派系之一，由冯国璋领导，以冯国璋、曹锟、吴佩孚为主要代表，并受英美两国支持。
description.en: One of the main factions of the Beiyang Warlords, led by Feng Guozhang and primarily represented by Feng Guozhang, Cao Kun, and Wu Peifu, supported by the United Kingdom and the United States.

description.zh-cn: 明初国都，今江苏省南京市。
明初四大案之一，丞相胡惟庸被指控谋反，导致数万人被株连处死，朱元璋随后废除丞相制度。
description.en: One of the Four Major Cases of the Early Ming Dynasty. Chancellor Hu Weiyong was accused of treason, leading to the execution of tens of thousands of people. Following the case, Zhu Yuanzhang abolished the chancellorship.

description.zh-cn: 明初四大案之一，大将军蓝玉被指控谋反，超过一万五千人被株连。
description.en: One of the Four Major Cases of the Early Ming Dynasty. General Lan Yu was accused of treason, resulting in the implication and execution of over 15,000 people.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代官职
明朝与瓦剌在土木堡发生的一场战役。此战中明英宗被俘，直接导致朱祁钰被拥立为帝，并成为明朝由盛转衰的转折点之一。
description.en: A military conflict between the Ming Dynasty and the Oirats at Tumu Fortress. Emperor Yingzong was captured in this battle, directly leading to Zhu Qiyu being enthroned, and it is considered a turning point from prosperity to decline for the Ming Dynasty.

birth_place.zh-cn: 大明北直隶顺天府紫禁城
birth_place.en: Forbidden City, Shuntian Prefecture, North Zhili, Ming Dynasty

death_place.zh-cn: 大明北直隶顺天府紫禁城
death_place.en: Forbidden City, Shuntian Prefecture, North Zhili, Ming Dynasty

description.zh-cn: 明朝第六位和第八位皇帝，明宣宗长子，景泰帝的异母兄长，年号正统和天顺。其在位期间，经历土木堡之变被俘，后发动“夺门之变”复辟，并最终废除了宫妃殉葬制度。
description.en: The Zhengtong and Tianshun Emperor (personal name Zhu Qizhen) was the sixth and eighth emperor of the Ming dynasty, and the elder half-brother of the Jingtai Emperor. During his reign, he was captured in the Tumu Crisis, later restored to the throne through the Duomen Coup, and eventually abolished the system of concubine burial.

description.zh-cn: 明朝宦官，在英宗首次在位期间专权，怂恿英宗亲征导致土木堡之变，并在此役中被杀。
description.en: A Ming Dynasty eunuch who monopolized power during Emperor Yingzong's first reign. He instigated the emperor to personally lead the expedition that resulted in the Tumu Crisis, where he was killed.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古族的一支，在土木堡之变中俘虏了明英宗。
description.en: A group of Mongol tribes that captured Emperor Yingzong during the Tumu Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 瓦剌太师，在土木堡之变中俘虏明英宗，后率军围攻北京并将其送还明朝。
description.en: The Taishi of the Oirats who captured Emperor Yingzong during the Tumu Crisis, later besieged Beijing, and eventually returned him to the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明朝名臣，官至兵部尚书、太子太傅。在土木堡之变后拥立朱祁钰（景泰帝）为帝，并领导北京保卫战取得胜利。后在夺门之变后被明英宗以谋逆罪杀害。
description.en: A famous official of the Ming dynasty, serving as Minister of War and Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince. He supported Zhu Qiyu (the Jingtai Emperor)'s ascension to the throne after the Tumu Crisis and led the Defense of Beijing to victory. He was later executed for treason by Emperor Yingzong after the Duomen Coup.

description.zh-cn: 明朝第七位皇帝（1449年-1457年在位），明宣宗朱瞻基次子，明英宗朱祁镇异母弟。因土木堡之变中兄长被俘而即位，后在夺门之变中被复辟的兄长废黜。
description.en: The Jingtai Emperor (personal name Zhu Qiyu) was the seventh emperor of the Ming dynasty, reigning from 1449 to 1457. He was the second son of the Xuande Emperor and the younger half-brother of the Zhengtong Emperor. He ascended the throne after his brother was captured in the Tumu Crisis, and was later deposed by his brother in the Duomen Coup.

description.zh-cn: 土木堡之变后，于谦领导明军成功抗击并抵御了瓦剌对北京的入侵。
description.en: Following the Tumu Crisis, the Ming army, led by Yu Qian, successfully defended Beijing against the Oirat invasion.

description.zh-cn: 明代宗景泰八年（1457年），由曹吉祥、石亨、徐有贞等人趁景泰帝病重发动，拥立被软禁的太上皇明英宗复辟的宫廷军事政变，导致景泰帝被废。
description.en: A military and palace coup launched by Cao Jixiang, Shi Heng, Xu Youzhen, and others, who took advantage of the Jingtai Emperor's illness to restore the imprisoned Emperor Emeritus Yingzong to the throne, leading to the deposition of the Jingtai Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明朝内阁首辅，万历初年改革的推行者，明神宗的帝师，明穆宗顾命大臣。
明神宗在位前十年，在张居正的辅佐下，明朝出现的短暂中兴局面。
明穆宗第三子，明朝第十三位皇帝，明代在位时间最长的皇帝，明光宗之父。
明神宗在位中后期，长期不理朝政的现象。
后金与明朝的战略决战，以后金大胜告终。
中国明朝末期宦官，天启年间权倾朝野，人称“九千岁”。他掌控朝政，与客氏结盟，拉拢齐楚浙党组成阉党，残酷打击东林党人。其党羽曾与袁崇焕在辽东事务上产生摩擦。崇祯帝即位后，他被清算，最终畏罪自杀，尸身被凌迟。
description.en: A Chinese eunuch who lived in the late Ming dynasty. Known as the 'Nine Thousand Years', he held immense power during the Tianqi era and controlled the court. He formed a political alliance with Madam Ke and created the 'Eunuch Party' by aligning with officials from the Qi, Chu, and Zhe factions, brutally persecuting the Donglin Party. His associates clashed with Yuan Chonghuan over Liaodong affairs. He was purged after the Chongzhen Emperor ascended the throne, eventually committing suicide to avoid capture, and his corpse was subjected to lingchi.

description.zh-cn: 天启年间以宦官魏忠贤为首的政治集团，与东林党进行了激烈的党争。
description.en: A political faction headed by the eunuch Wei Zhongxian during the Tianqi era, which engaged in a fierce power struggle with the Donglin Party.

description.zh-cn: 明朝末年的一个士大夫政治集团，主张开放言路、澄清吏治，在天启年间遭到阉党的残酷打击。
description.en: A political faction of scholar-officials in the late Ming dynasty who advocated for open criticism and clean governance. They were brutally suppressed by the Eunuch Party during the Tianqi era.

description.zh-cn: 儒家哲学流派
罗马教宗
根据《凡尔登条约》从法兰克王国分裂出的国家，为神圣罗马帝国的前身。
中世纪欧洲神圣罗马帝国皇帝与罗马教廷之间关于主教叙任权的斗争。

zh-cn: 亨利四世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝，叙任权斗争中的关键人物。
罗马教宗，推动克吕尼改革，与亨利四世发生冲突。
神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利五世与教宗和主教们达成的协议，结束了叙任权斗争。

zh-cn: 腓特烈二世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 霍亨斯陶芬王朝的神圣罗马帝国皇帝。
神圣罗马帝国史上没有一位国王能得到普遍认可的时期，导致诸侯权力扩大。
欧洲历史上一次大规模的国际战争，对神圣罗马帝国造成了巨大破坏。
结束三十年战争的一系列和约，确立了神圣罗马帝国内诸侯的主权。
哈布斯堡王朝的核心领地，神圣罗马帝国内的主要邦国。
由拿破仑一世在德意志地区组建的亲法邦联，其成员脱离了神圣罗马帝国。

zh-cn: 弗朗茨二世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国末任皇帝，奥地利帝国首任皇帝。

en: Dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国正式灭亡的事件。
法兰克王国国王，800年被加冕为“罗马人的皇帝”。
为查理曼加冕的罗马教宗。
由神圣罗马皇帝弗朗茨二世建立的国家。

zh-cn: 查理五世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 哈布斯堡王朝的君主，同时统治神圣罗马帝国和西班牙帝国。
伊朗第二任最高领袖。
现任伊朗第一副总统。

zh-cn: 穆罕默德-巴盖尔·加利巴夫

description.zh-cn: 现任伊斯兰议会议长。
伊朗伊斯兰共和国的最高立法机构。
导致巴列维王朝覆亡、伊朗伊斯兰共和国成立的革命。
统治伊朗的最后一个王朝。
伊朗伊斯兰革命的政治和精神领袖，伊朗伊斯兰共和国第一任最高领袖。
伊朗穆斯林群众占领美国驻伊朗大使馆并扣留使馆人员的事件。
巴列维王朝的创始人。
曾任伊朗民选首相，后被政变推翻。
由美国中央情报局策划的推翻伊朗首相摩萨台的政变。
巴列维国王推行的一系列农业与工业改革。
伊朗与伊拉克之间长达8年的边境战争。
伊拉克共和国。
前伊拉克总统，曾发动两伊战争，其政权在美国发动的伊拉克战争中被推翻。
description.en: Former President of Iraq, whose regime was overthrown in the U.S.-led Iraq War.

birth_place.zh-cn: 美国康涅狄格州纽黑文市

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，曾担任美国第43任总统。2008年，他曾在白宫会见魏京生等五名中国异议人士。
description.en: American politician who served as the 43rd President of the United States. In 2008, he met with Wei Jingsheng and four other Chinese dissidents at the White House.

description.zh-cn: 指参与伊朗核问题谈判的六个世界大国，包括联合国安理会五个常任理事国（中国、法国、俄罗斯、英国、美国）以及德国。
曾任伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队圣城旅指挥官。
一名22岁伊朗库尔德族女子在被道德警察逮捕后死亡的事件。
因玛莎·阿米尼之死引发的全国性示威活动。
以色列国。在军事上与新加坡关系紧密，曾派遣军官指导新加坡军队的建立。
description.en: Has close military ties with Singapore and once sent military officers to guide the establishment of the Singaporean army.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗伊斯兰共和国的武装部队之一，负责维护伊斯兰教义和国内秩序。
负责选举、监督、罢免伊朗最高领袖的机构。

en: Armed Forces of the Soviet Union

description.zh-cn: 国际联盟就九一八事变派出的调查团所做的报告，结论是满洲国非独立运动产物。
满洲国首任国务总理大臣。
日本陆军中将，九一八事变策划者之一。
清朝宗室，吉林省代理长官，向日本投降并推动建立满洲国。
满洲国成立前的过渡政权机构。
日本与满洲国签订的条约，规定日本承认满洲国并拥有驻军权，确立了日本对满洲国的控制。
溥仪于1945年8月18日宣读的诏书，宣告满洲国终结。

zh-cn: 阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·本·阿卜杜拉赫曼·本·费萨尔·阿勒沙特

description.zh-cn: 现代沙乌地阿拉伯王国的开国君主。

zh-cn: 萨勒曼·本·阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·阿勒沙特

description.zh-cn: 沙乌地阿拉伯第七任国王。
沙乌地阿拉伯王储兼首相。
沙乌地阿拉伯的国教。
沙乌地阿拉伯奉行的官方意识形态，属逊尼派一支。
沙乌地新闻工作者及异议人士。
沙乌地阿拉伯前王储。

zh-cn: 沙特·本·阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·阿勒沙特

description.zh-cn: 沙乌地阿拉伯第二任国王。

zh-cn: 费萨尔·本·阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·阿勒沙特

description.zh-cn: 沙乌地阿拉伯第三任国王。
伊斯兰教的主要教派之一，在沙乌地阿拉伯为少数派并受到压制。
伊斯兰教的核心宗教文本，被视为沙乌地阿拉伯的最高宪法。
沙乌地阿拉伯国家行事的法律依据。

zh-cn: 穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜

description.zh-cn: 瓦哈比派创始人。
第一沙特王国建立者。
原中共中央军委办公室主任。
原上海申能集团副总经理。曾任黄菊秘书，因涉嫌向陈良宇通风报信及受贿而在陈良宇事件中被捕。
description.en: Former Deputy General Manager of Shanghai Shenneng Group and former secretary to Huang Ju. He was arrested during the Chen Liangyu incident for allegedly tipping off Chen Liangyu and accepting bribes.

description.zh-cn: 原中共中央警卫局局长。
原中共中央警卫局局长。
原上海光明食品集团公司董事长。

en: Death and state funeral of Jiang Zemin

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上继五代十国之后的朝代，与南宋合称宋朝。其为宋朝的前半期，首都为东京开封府。
description.en: A dynasty in Chinese history following the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. Together with the Southern Song, it forms the Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北宋开国皇帝，政治家，军事家，原为后周殿前都点检，宋太宗的胞兄。
description.en: Founding emperor of the Northern Song dynasty, politician, military general, and elder brother of Emperor Taizong of Song.

description.zh-cn: 赵匡胤部下在陈桥驿发动兵变，拥立其为皇帝，建立宋朝。
description.en: A mutiny launched by Zhao Kuangyin's subordinates at Chen Bridge Post, which led to his enthronement and the founding of the Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 五代十国时期最后一个朝代。
后周最后一位皇帝，被迫禅位予赵匡胤。
宋太祖为加强中央集权，解除禁军将领及地方藩镇兵权的政治事件。
description.en: A political event where Emperor Taizu of Song relieved his generals of their commands to consolidate central authority.

description.zh-cn: 北宋初年重要将领，在“杯酒释兵权”中被解除兵权。
北宋第二位皇帝，宋太祖赵匡胤之弟。
description.en: The second emperor of the Northern Song dynasty, younger brother of Zhao Kuangyin.

description.zh-cn: 一份据称由杜太后（昭宪太后）口授、赵普记录的誓书，内容为兄终弟及，规定了宋朝初期的皇位继承顺序。宋太宗以此作为其继位合法性的依据。
description.en: A purported pledge dictated by Empress Dowager Du and recorded by Zhao Pu, which stipulated the imperial succession order in the early Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 金朝攻破北宋首都东京开封府，俘虏宋徽宗、宋钦宗二帝，导致北宋灭亡的历史事件。
description.en: A historical event in which the Jin dynasty conquered the Northern Song capital, Tokyo, and captured Emperors Huizong and Qinzong, leading to the fall of the Northern Song dynasty.

description.en: The last emperor of the Northern Song dynasty, the eldest son of Emperor Huizong. Captured along with his father during the Jingkang Incident.

description.zh-cn: 南宋开国皇帝，宋徽宗第九子，宋钦宗之弟。

description.en: A politician and reformer of the Northern Song dynasty who, with the support of Emperor Shenzong, implemented the New Policies, leading the Xining Reforms.

description.zh-cn: 由宋神宗任用王安石主持的，旨在富国强兵的一系列社会经济改革运动。该变法引发了朝廷内部守旧派与改革派长期的政治斗争。
description.en: A series of socio-economic reforms aimed at enriching the state and strengthening the military, initiated by Emperor Shenzong and led by Wang Anshi. The reforms led to long-term political struggles between conservative and reformist factions at court.

description.zh-cn: 北宋政治家、史学家，作为守旧派领袖，激烈反对王安石变法。
description.en: A politician and historian of the Northern Song dynasty. As the leader of the conservative faction, he vehemently opposed the Wang Anshi Reforms.

description.zh-cn: 北宋第六位皇帝，宋徽宗之父。在位期间，因对北宋积贫积弱的状况深感忧心，启用王安石推行熙宁变法，并对外发动熙河开边，意图富国强兵，但变法引发了剧烈的新旧党争，对外军事行动也遭遇永乐城之战的惨败。
description.en: The sixth emperor of the Northern Song dynasty, father of Emperor Huizong. During his reign, concerned about the state's poverty and weakness, he appointed Wang Anshi to implement the Xining Reforms and launched the Xihe Expansion campaign, aiming to enrich the state and strengthen its military. However, the reforms triggered intense factional struggles, and his foreign military campaigns suffered a disastrous defeat at the Battle of Yongle City.

由朱邦复于1976年创制的一种中文输入法，其初版名为“形意检字法”，目前是香港及澳门最常用的输入法之一。其商业衍生版本简化了拆码规则以提升输入速度，并被目前中文电脑输入最快速纪录保持者所使用。
description.en: A Chinese input method created by Chu Bong-Foo in 1976, originally named 'Glyph-meaning Indexing Method'. It is one of the most common input methods in Hong Kong and Macau. Commercial derivatives of Cangjie have simplified decomposition rules to increase input speed, with one such variant being used by the current record holder for the fastest Chinese computer typing.

description.zh-cn: 台湾发明家，被誉为“中文电脑之父”，是仓颉输入法的发明人。

Additionally, he was appointed as the general proofreader for the project to create a duplicate copy of the Yongle Encyclopedia.

李讷与徐宁的儿子。
曾任新华社代社长、全军文革小组成员。
毛泽东的卫士长。
成吉思汗的父亲，蒙古乞颜部首领。
成吉思汗的母亲。
成吉思汗的正妻。
成吉思汗的长子。
成吉思汗的次子。
成吉思汗的同父异母兄弟。
成吉思汗的安答（结拜兄弟）和后来的主要对手。
克烈部首领，成吉思汗早期的保护者和盟友，后成为对手。
成吉思汗麾下大将，被称为“四犬”之一。
位于中亚的突厥-波斯王朝，后被蒙古所灭。
由契丹人耶律大石建立的位于中亚的王朝，后被蒙古兼并。
蒙古高原的部落之一，与成吉思汗家族有世仇。
蒙古高原的部落之一，曾掳走成吉思汗之妻孛儿帖。
蒙古高原西部的强大部落，成吉思汗统一蒙古过程中的主要对手之一。
萨满，曾支持成吉思汗，后因试图离间皇室而被处死。

en: Mongol conquest of the Jin dynasty

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国对金朝的征服战争。
蒙古帝国对西夏的最后一战。

en: Mongol invasion of the Khwarazmian Empire

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国对花剌子模王朝的征服战争。
蒙古国的一个省，被认为是成吉思汗的出生地。
陈独秀原配妻子。
陈独秀第三任妻子（伴侣）。
陈独秀养女
由岳飞率领的南宋军队
南宋将领，参与诬陷岳飞
南宋大臣，弹劾并主审岳飞
岳飞率领岳家军对金朝进行的一系列军事进攻
岳飞之父
岳飞之弟
岳飞长子，与其父一同被害
岳飞次子
岳飞三子
岳飞之孙，岳霖之子
岳飞的出生地
南宋初期抗金名将，曾为岳飞的上级
岳飞的武艺师傅
原为乱匪悍将，后归顺岳飞成为岳家军猛将
南宋初期湖东路乱匪首领
南宋初期的军事将领，主战派将领，曾为岳飞鸣不平。
金朝扶植的伪齐政权皇帝
金朝扶植的傀儡政权，又称“伪齐”
南宋初期的军队番号之一
南宋初期的军队番号之一，由神武副军升格而来
李洪志的出生地。
description.en: Birthplace of Li Hongzhi.

description.zh-cn: 法轮功总部，李洪志的居住地。
description.en: Headquarters of Falun Gong and residence of Li Hongzhi.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命和改革开放之后，在中国掀起的气功流行潮。
description.en: A trend of widespread interest in Qigong that emerged in China after the Cultural Revolution and during the Reform and Opening-up period.

description.zh-cn: 促进全球警务合作和犯罪控制的国际组织。
description.en: An international organization that facilitates worldwide police cooperation and crime control.

description.zh-cn: 2019冠状病毒病在中国大陆的流行情况。
description.en: The outbreak of COVID-19 in mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 由柯文哲于2019年创立的台湾政党之一。在大罢免运动中，与中国国民党合作，发起“扫除绿卫兵”行动参与罢免民进党籍民意代表。
description.en: A political party in Taiwan, founded by Ko Wen-je in 2019. During the Great Recall movement, it collaborated with the Kuomintang and launched the 'Sweep the Green Guards' campaign to participate in the recall of DPP representatives.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物、医师，台湾民众党创党主席，曾任台北市市长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and physician, founding chairman of the Taiwan People's Party, and former Mayor of Taipei.

description.zh-cn: 指台北市京华城购物中心原址改建案，因容积率变更引发的图利争议及司法调查案件。
description.en: Refers to the redevelopment case of the former Core Pacific City shopping center site in Taipei, which sparked controversy and judicial investigation over changes in the floor area ratio, leading to allegations of illicit gains.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物、护理师，台湾民众党籍。
台湾网络名人、企业家，与黄国昌共同举办多场社会运动。

zh-cn: 「拒绝红色媒体、守护台湾民主」游行

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾为罢免运动目标。
台湾政治团体，曾发动对黄国昌的罢免案。
中华民国政治人物，曾连任七届立法委员。他曾是黄国昌2016年立委选举的竞争对手。因在立委任内诈领助理费而被以贪污罪起诉，后潜逃并被通缉。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, and Huang Kuo-chang's opponent in the 2016 legislative election. He served seven consecutive terms as a legislator, but was later indicted for corruption for fraudulently claiming assistant fees during his tenure and subsequently became a fugitive.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，中国国民党籍，傅兆林之子。现任立法委员、中国国民党立法院党团总召集人，并担任中国国民党中央委员会政策委员会执行长。曾任花莲县县长。他是大罢免运动中罢免泛蓝阵营的指标性人物之一，也是徐榛蔚的丈夫。
description.en: Taiwanese politician, son of Fu Zhaolin. He is a KMT legislator and currently serves as the caucus convener for the KMT in the Legislative Yuan, and also as the Executive Director of the KMT Policy Committee. He previously served as Hualien County Magistrate. He was one of the iconic targets of the recall effort against the Pan-Blue camp during the Great Recall movement, and is the husband of Hsu Chen-wei.

zh-cn: 中国国民党立法院党团

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党在立法院的议会党团。
中华民国政治人物，时代力量籍，时任时代力量党主席。
台湾政治人物。
台湾政治人物。
台湾政治人物、律师，党外运动重要人物，曾任第八届民主进步党主席。因其在反核运动中的形象，也被称为“斗笠人”。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, lawyer, a prominent figure in the Tangwai movement, and the 8th Chairman of the Democratic Progressive Party. He is also known as the 'Douli Man' for his image in the anti-nuclear movement.

description.zh-cn: 台湾人权工作者，时任民间司法改革基金会执行长。
明仁宗朱高炽的皇后，明宣宗朱瞻基之母。
description.en: Empress of the Hongxi Emperor, mother of the Xuande Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明朝第五位皇帝，明仁宗朱高炽长子，明英宗和景泰帝的父亲，朱高煦之侄。他平定了叔父朱高煦的叛乱，并非常器重于谦。
description.en: The fifth emperor of the Ming Dynasty, eldest son of the Hongxi Emperor Zhu Gaochi, father of Emperor Yingzong and the Jingtai Emperor, and nephew of Zhu Gaoxu. He suppressed the rebellion of his uncle Zhu Gaoxu.

description.zh-cn: 明仁宗和明宣宗统治时期，政治清明、经济发展的盛世。
description.en: A period of stability and prosperity during the reigns of the Hongxi and Xuande emperors.

description.zh-cn: 明朝重臣，历仕建文、永乐、洪熙、宣德四朝。
description.en: An important official of the Ming dynasty, serving four emperors.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，因劝谏触怒明仁宗而下狱。
description.en: A Ming dynasty official who was imprisoned for admonishing the Hongxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，因劝谏触怒明仁宗而下狱。
description.en: A Ming dynasty official who was imprisoned for admonishing the Hongxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明朝内阁首辅大臣，辅佐明宣宗。
description.en: Grand Secretary of the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 宋神宗的妃嫔，宋徽宗的生母，被追尊为皇后。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Shenzong and the biological mother of Emperor Huizong, posthumously honored as an empress.

description.zh-cn: 北宋第七位皇帝，宋神宗的第六子和继任者，宋徽宗之兄。
description.en: The seventh emperor of the Northern Song dynasty, the sixth son and successor of Emperor Shenzong, and elder brother of Emperor Huizong.

description.zh-cn: 宋神宗的皇后，在宋哲宗去世后，支持宋徽宗继位。
description.en: Empress of Emperor Shenzong who supported Emperor Huizong's succession after Emperor Zhezong's death.

description.zh-cn: 北宋宰相，曾反对宋徽宗继位。
description.en: A chancellor of the Northern Song dynasty who opposed Emperor Huizong's succession.

description.zh-cn: 北宋宰相，宋徽宗时期“六贼”之一，被认为是导致北宋灭亡的奸臣。
description.en: A chancellor of the Northern Song dynasty, one of the "Six Traitors" during Emperor Huizong's reign, considered a corrupt official who contributed to the fall of the dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北宋宦官、将领，宋徽宗时期“六贼”之一。
description.en: A eunuch and general of the Northern Song dynasty, one of the "Six Traitors" during Emperor Huizong's reign.

description.zh-cn: 金朝第二位皇帝，发动靖康之变，俘虏了宋徽宗和宋钦宗。
description.en: The second emperor of the Jin dynasty, who launched the Jingkang Incident and captured Emperor Huizong and Emperor Qinzong.

description.zh-cn: 北宋末年宋江领导的农民起义。
description.en: A peasant rebellion led by Song Jiang at the end of the Northern Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北宋末年方腊领导的农民起义。
description.en: A peasant rebellion led by Fang La at the end of the Northern Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北宋与金朝为联合夹击辽朝而订立的盟约。
description.en: An alliance formed between the Northern Song and Jin dynasties to jointly attack the Liao dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 由契丹族建立的统治中国北方的封建王朝，与北宋长期对峙。
description.en: A feudal dynasty established by the Khitan people that ruled northern China and was a long-term rival of the Northern Song.

description.zh-cn: 北宋末年东京的著名艺伎，与宋徽宗有交往。
description.en: A famous courtesan in Tokyo during the late Northern Song dynasty, who had a relationship with Emperor Huizong.

description.zh-cn: 北宋著名词人，传说与宋徽宗为李师师争风吃醋。
description.en: A famous poet of the Northern Song dynasty, rumored to have been a rival of Emperor Huizong for the affection of Li Shishi.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗的原配皇后，宋钦宗的生母。
description.en: Emperor Huizong's first empress consort and the biological mother of Emperor Qinzong.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗的继室皇后，靖康之变被俘。
description.en: Emperor Huizong's second empress consort, captured during the Jingkang Incident.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗的妃嫔，宋高宗的生母。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Huizong and the biological mother of Emperor Gaozong.

description.zh-cn: 金朝第三位皇帝，为改善与南宋关系，追封宋徽宗为天水郡王。
description.en: The third emperor of the Jin dynasty who posthumously honored Emperor Huizong as Prince of Tianshui Commandery to improve relations with the Southern Song.

description.zh-cn: 刘备之父
蜀汉第二位、也是最后一位皇帝，刘备之子。
description.en: The second and last emperor of Shu Han, son of Liu Bei.

description.zh-cn: 刘备三子，封为梁王、安平王
刘备养子
刘备的正室夫人，麋竺之妹
孙权的妹妹，刘备的继室夫人，曾试图将刘禅带往东吴。
description.en: Sister of Sun Quan and wife of Liu Bei, who attempted to take Liu Shan to Eastern Wu.

description.zh-cn: 刘备的继室夫人，吴懿之妹
刘备的妾室，刘禅的生母。
description.en: A concubine of Liu Bei and the biological mother of Liu Shan.

birth_place.en: Yangdu County, Langya Commandery, Eastern Han

description.zh-cn: 三国时期蜀汉丞相，刘备的主要辅佐大臣，受刘备托孤辅佐刘禅。他是一位杰出的政治家、军事家、发明家及散文家。曾于228年征集兵丁守护都江堰，并设立专职堰官进行管理。
description.en: Chancellor of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period. He served as regent for Liu Shan on Liu Bei's request and was an outstanding statesman, military strategist, inventor, and writer. In 228, he also conscripted soldiers to guard Dujiangyan and established specialized weir officials for its management.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年至三国时期蜀汉名将，刘备的义弟。
东汉末年至三国时期蜀汉名将，刘备的义弟，刘禅的岳父，五虎上将之一。
description.en: A military general serving under the warlord Liu Bei in the late Eastern Han dynasty and the state of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period of China, and the father-in-law of Liu Shan.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉将领，曾在长坂坡保护刘禅。
description.en: A general of Shu Han who protected Liu Shan at Changban.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年权臣，曹魏政权的奠基者。他是曹昂、曹丕之父，曹叡的祖父。许贡在上表中曾提及孙策对他构成威胁。张松曾奉命出使见他，但因其态度傲慢，未能招揽张松，反而使张松心生怨恨。
description.en: A warlord and the penultimate grand chancellor of the Eastern Han dynasty who rose to great power in the final years of the dynasty. He laid the foundation for the state of Cao Wei, was the father of Cao Ang and Cao Pi, and the grandfather of Cao Rui. Xu Gong mentioned in his memorial that Sun Ce posed a threat to him. When Zhang Song was sent as an envoy, his arrogant attitude failed to win him over and instead earned his resentment.

description.zh-cn: 孙策之弟，三国时期孙吴开国皇帝，六朝开拓者之首。
description.en: Younger brother of Sun Ce, and founder of the state of Eastern Wu during the Three Kingdoms period.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年名将及割据军阀。
东汉末年军阀，袁熙之父。
东汉末年军阀。其势力曾进入扬州，击败了割据江东的周氏兄弟，孙策曾一度在其麾下。
description.en: A warlord in the late Eastern Han dynasty. His forces entered Yang Province, defeated the Zhou brothers who controlled Jiangdong, and Sun Ce once served under him.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年荆州牧
东汉末年益州牧。为抵御张鲁和曹操，听从张松建议迎刘备入蜀，后因发现张松密谋而将其处死，并与刘备交战。
description.en: Warlord and governor of Yi Province during the late Eastern Han dynasty. He invited Liu Bei into his territory on Zhang Song's advice to counter threats, but later executed Zhang Song upon discovering his conspiracy and went to war with Liu Bei.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年军阀
东汉末年徐州牧
东汉最后一位皇帝，许贡曾上表于他，意图调走孙策。
description.en: The last emperor of the Eastern Han dynasty, to whom Xu Gong submitted a memorial proposing to transfer Sun Ce away.

description.zh-cn: 孙权、刘备联军在长江赤壁一带大破曹操大军的战役，是三国时期著名的以少胜多的战役，奠定了三国鼎立的基础。
description.en: A decisive naval battle in the winter of 208 at the end of the Han dynasty, where the allied forces of Sun Quan and Liu Bei decisively defeated the numerically superior forces of Cao Cao.

en: Liu Bei's takeover of Yi Province

description.zh-cn: 刘备夺取益州的战役
刘备从曹操手中夺取汉中的战役
关羽北伐曹操的战役，期间孙权偷袭荆州，导致关羽败亡。
刘备为关羽报仇并意图夺回荆州而讨伐东吴的战役，以蜀汉大败告终。
诸葛亮向刘备陈述的“三分天下”的战略规划。
蜀汉重臣，与诸葛亮同为刘备的托孤之臣。
description.en: A key official of Shu Han, co-regent with Zhuge Liang for Liu Shan.

description.zh-cn: 原为刘璋的部下，与张松关系良好。后与张松一同策划并协助刘备夺取益州，成为刘备的谋士。在取益州和汉中时多有贡献。
description.en: Originally a subordinate of Liu Zhang and an associate of Zhang Song. He later conspired with Zhang Song to assist Liu Bei in taking control of Yi Province, after which he became Liu Bei's strategist. He made significant contributions during the campaigns to take Yi Province and Hanzhong.

description.zh-cn: 刘璋的属下，后献图于刘备，促成刘备入蜀。
东汉末年大儒，刘备的老师。
汉献帝的岳父，衣带诏事件的主谋。
唐太宗李世民的第九子，也是嫡三子。他是李泰的胞弟。在李承干被废后，被立为皇太子，后继位为唐高宗，成为唐朝第三位皇帝。
description.en: The ninth son of Emperor Taizong Li Shimin, and also his third legitimate son. He was a full brother of Li Tai. After Li Chengqian's deposition, he was made crown prince and later succeeded the throne as Emperor Gaozong, becoming the third emperor of the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 唐高宗李治第五子，武则天长子。
唐高宗第六子，章怀太子，李显之兄。
唐朝皇子，即后来的唐中宗，曾两次在位，是唐朝第四位和第六位皇帝。
description.en: A prince of the Tang dynasty, later Emperor Zhongzong, who reigned twice as the fourth and sixth emperor of the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 武则天建立的朝代。
description.en: A dynasty established by Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 导致武则天退位，唐中宗复辟的政变。
唐朝、武周时期宰相，神龙政变策划者之一。
description.en: A chancellor of the Tang and Wu Zhou dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 武则天的男宠。
武则天的男宠。
唐中宗嫡长子，懿德太子。
唐中宗第七女。
唐朝、武周时期的著名宰相。
description.en: A famous chancellor of the Tang and Wu Zhou dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 武则天之侄。
description.en: Nephew of Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 武则天之侄。
道光帝皇后，咸丰帝生母。
清朝道光年间的军机大臣，被认为是鸦片战争期间主和派的代表人物之一，与林则徐政见相左，并对其进行排挤。
description.en: A Grand Councilor during the Daoguang era of the Qing dynasty, considered a leading figure of the peace faction during the Opium War. He opposed Lin Zexu's policies and worked to undermine him.

description.zh-cn: 清朝大臣。
清朝后期政治家、思想家、文学家和学者，以在广东发起的禁烟运动及虎门销烟而闻名，是第一次鸦片战争中的关键人物。他主张了解和学习西方技术，被认为是中国近代“开眼看世界的第一人”。
description.en: A prominent Chinese scholar and official of the late Qing dynasty, best known for his role in the First Opium War and the destruction of opium at Humen. He was a proponent of learning from Western technology and is considered the 'first person to open his eyes to the world' in modern China.

description.zh-cn: 咸丰帝次子，早夭。
唐朝开国皇帝，唐太宗李世民之父。隋末时于晋阳起兵，攻入长安，废隋恭帝杨侑后称帝。
description.en: The founding emperor of the Tang dynasty and the father of Emperor Taizong, Li Shimin. He rebelled in Jinyang during the late Sui, captured Chang'an, and proclaimed himself emperor after deposing Emperor Gong Yang You.

description.zh-cn: 唐高祖李渊的皇后，唐太宗李世民之母。
description.en: Empress of Emperor Gaozu of Tang and mother of Emperor Taizong, Li Shimin.

description.zh-cn: 唐高祖李渊四子，与李建成结盟，在玄武门之变中被李世民所杀。
description.en: The fourth son of Emperor Gaozu of Tang, allied with Li Jiancheng, and was killed by Li Shimin's forces during the Xuanwu Gate Incident.

description.zh-cn: 由李世民发动的宫廷政变，通过杀死兄长李建成和四弟李元吉，确立了其皇位继承权。
description.en: A palace coup launched by Li Shimin, securing his succession to the throne by killing his elder brother Li Jiancheng and younger brother Li Yuanji.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗李世民的皇后，李泰的母亲，以贤德著称。
description.en: Empress of Emperor Taizong of Tang, mother of Li Tai, known for her virtue and wisdom.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗在位期间出现的政治清明、经济复苏、文化繁荣的治世局面。
description.en: A period of political stability, economic recovery, and cultural prosperity during Emperor Taizong's reign.

description.zh-cn: 李渊、李世民父子在晋阳发动的反隋起义，为唐朝的建立奠定了基础。
description.en: An anti-Sui uprising launched by Li Yuan and his son Li Shimin in Jinyang, which laid the foundation for the establishment of the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 隋末群雄之一，建立夏国，后在虎牢之战中被李世民击败并俘虏。
description.en: A warlord during the late Sui dynasty who established the state of Xia, later defeated and captured by Li Shimin at the Battle of Hulao.

description.zh-cn: 隋末唐初的群雄之一。他在洛阳废隋恭帝杨侗自立，建立郑国。虎牢之战后投降唐朝。
description.en: One of the warlords during the late Sui and early Tang dynasties. He deposed Emperor Gong Yang Tong in Luoyang, established himself as emperor, and founded the state of Zheng. After the Battle of Hulao, he surrendered to the Tang.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝统一战争中的决定性战役，李世民在此一举击败窦建德与王世充两大势力。
description.en: A decisive battle in the Tang unification wars, where Li Shimin defeated the forces of Dou Jiande and Wang Shichong.

description.zh-cn: 位于蒙古高原的游牧汗国，是突厥汗国分裂后形成的主要部分之一。其与隋朝时而战争时而臣服，隋末时曾支持地方割据势力，是唐朝初年的主要外部威胁，后被唐太宗所灭。
description.en: A nomadic khaganate on the Mongolian Plateau, and one of the main parts formed after the split of the Turkic Khaganate. It engaged in both conflict and vassalage with the Sui dynasty, and supported local warlords at the end of the Sui dynasty. It became a major external threat to the early Tang dynasty, later conquered by Emperor Taizong.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝皇帝作为中亚和北亚各民族的国际同盟之主的称号，始于唐太宗。
description.en: A title for the Tang emperor as the head of an international alliance of various peoples in Central and North Asia, starting with Emperor Taizong.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗时期的著名谏臣和宰相，以直言敢谏著称。
description.en: A renowned chancellor and advisor during Emperor Taizong's reign, famous for his forthright remonstrance.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗时期的主要谋士和宰相，与杜如晦并称“房谋杜断”。
description.en: A key advisor and chancellor to Emperor Taizong, known for his strategic planning.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗时期的主要谋士和宰相，与房玄龄并称“房谋杜断”。
description.en: A key advisor and chancellor to Emperor Taizong, known for his decisive judgment.

description.zh-cn: 高句丽末期军事独裁者，其政变及对外扩张行为引发了唐朝的军事干预。
description.en: A military dictator of late Goguryeo whose coup and expansionist policies led to military intervention by the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 位于朝鲜半岛北部的古代王国，曾与隋朝和唐朝发生多次大规模战争，亦与新朝关系恶化。
description.en: An ancient kingdom on the Korean Peninsula that engaged in prolonged warfare with the Tang and Sui dynasties, and also had deteriorating relations with the Xin Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗嫡长子，原为皇太子，后因与李泰争储并图谋不轨而被废。
description.en: The eldest son of Emperor Taizong and original crown prince, who was deposed after plotting rebellion due to his rivalry with Li Tai.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗第四子，深得宠爱，与太子李承干争夺储位，后被贬。
description.en: The fourth son of Emperor Taizong, highly favored by his father, who vied for the crown prince position with Li Chengqian and was later demoted.

description.zh-cn: 吐蕃赞普，统一青藏高原，并与唐朝和亲。
description.en: Emperor of the Tibetan Empire who unified the Tibetan Plateau and established a marriage alliance with the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝宗室女，嫁予吐蕃赞普松赞干布，是唐蕃和亲的重要人物。
description.en: A Tang imperial clanswoman who married Tibetan Emperor Songtsen Gampo, a key figure in the Tang-Tibetan marriage alliance.

description.zh-cn: 位于青藏高原的帝国，与唐朝既有战争也有和亲。
description.en: An empire on the Tibetan Plateau that had both conflicts and marriage alliances with the Tang dynasty.

嘉庆帝的第二任皇后。

钦差大臣林则徐在广东虎门集中销毁了收缴的鸦片。此事激化了中英矛盾，成为第一次鸦片战争的导火索。
description.en: Imperial Commissioner Lin Zexu publicly destroyed confiscated opium in Humen, Guangdong. This historic event intensified Sino-British tensions and served as the direct trigger for the First Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 发生于新疆地区由张格尔领导的叛乱。
道光帝的皇后，奕䜣的生母。
清朝末期满洲贵族、大臣。在鸦片战争期间持主和态度，与林则徐政见不合，后接替林则徐任两广总督，与英方签订《穿鼻草约》。
description.en: A Manchu nobleman and minister of the late Qing dynasty. He held a pro-peace stance during the Opium War, clashing with Lin Zexu. He later succeeded Lin as the Governor-General of Liangguang and signed the Convention of Chuanbi with the British.

description.zh-cn: 明宣宗第二任皇后、明英宗的生母。在土木堡之变后，任命当时为郕王的朱祁钰为监国。
description.en: Second Empress of the Xuande Emperor and mother of Emperor Yingzong. After the Tumu Crisis, she appointed Zhu Qiyu, then Prince of Cheng, as regent.

description.zh-cn: 明朝第九位皇帝，明英宗长子。他原为太子，曾被景泰帝废黜，后复位并即位为帝。即位后，他恢复了叔叔景泰帝的帝号，并为于谦平反。他是明世宗之祖父。
description.en: The ninth emperor of the Ming dynasty. He was the eldest son of Emperor Yingzong, originally the crown prince, but was deposed by the Jingtai Emperor. He was later reinstated as crown prince and ascended the throne. Upon his ascension, he restored his uncle's imperial title. He was also the grandfather of the Jiajing Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗的护卫将军，在土木堡之变中杀死王振后战死。
description.en: Emperor Yingzong's guard general, who killed Wang Zhen during the Tumu Crisis and died in battle.

description.zh-cn: 明朝将领，夺门之变主谋之一。复辟后把持朝政，后因图谋叛乱被清算。
description.en: A Ming Dynasty general and one of the masterminds of the Duomen Coup. After the restoration, he controlled the court but was later purged for plotting a rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，夺门之变主谋之一。力主杀害于谦，后被清算流放。
description.en: A Ming Dynasty official and one of the masterminds of the Duomen Coup. He strongly advocated for the execution of Yu Qian and was later purged and exiled.

description.zh-cn: 明朝宦官，夺门之变主谋之一。复辟后与石亨把持朝政，后因发动曹石之变被凌迟处死。
description.en: A Ming Dynasty eunuch and one of the masterminds of the Duomen Coup. He controlled the court with Shi Heng after the restoration and was later executed by slow slicing for launching the Cao-Shi Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗的皇后。
description.en: The empress of Emperor Yingzong.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗的贵妃，明宪宗生母。
description.en: A noble consort of Emperor Yingzong and the birth mother of Emperor Xianzong.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗天顺朝内阁首辅。成功劝谏明英宗赦免汪皇后的殉葬。
description.en: Grand Secretary during the Tianshun era of Emperor Yingzong's reign, who successfully persuaded Emperor Yingzong to spare Empress Wang from being sacrificed.

description.zh-cn: 由曹吉祥和石亨策划的旨在反对明英宗的未遂叛乱。
description.en: An unsuccessful rebellion planned by Cao Jixiang and Shi Heng against Emperor Yingzong.

description.zh-cn: 秦国国君，秦始皇的父亲。原在赵国作为人质，后在吕不韦的帮助下返回秦国并最终继位。
description.en: King of the state of Qin and the father of Qin Shi Huang. He was originally a hostage in the state of Zhao and later returned to Qin and ascended the throne with the help of Lü Buwei.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇的母亲，秦庄襄王之妻。原为吕不韦的姬妾。
description.en: The wife of King Zhuangxiang of Qin and the mother of Qin Shi Huang. She was originally a concubine of Lü Buwei.

description.zh-cn: 中国战国末期卫国商人，后成为秦国相国（丞相）及政治家，对秦始皇亲政前有重要影响，并被秦始皇尊为“仲父”。传说他可能为秦始皇生父，并曾将嫪毐引荐给赵太后。他广招门客编撰《吕氏春秋》，是先秦杂家的代表人物之一，对秦王政统一六国的事业有重大贡献。
description.en: A merchant from the state of Wei during the late Warring States period, who later became the Chancellor and a politician of the state of Qin. He was influential during Qin Shi Huang's early reign and honored as 'Second Father' by him. He is also rumored to be Qin Shi Huang's biological father. He gathered scholars to compile the 'Lüshi Chunqiu' and is a representative figure of the Miscellaneous School of thought, making significant contributions to Qin's unification of the six states.

description.zh-cn: 战国末年秦国人物，秦始皇之母赵姬的面首。后因发动叛乱失败被车裂处死。
description.en: Lover of Queen Dowager Zhao, later executed for rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇长子，原定的皇位继承人。
description.en: The eldest son and original heir of Qin Shi Huang.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇幼子，秦朝第二位皇帝。
description.en: The youngest son of Qin Shi Huang and the second emperor of the Qin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇的异母弟，后叛秦降赵。
description.en: Half-brother of Qin Shi Huang, who later defected to Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝丞相，文学家、书法家，法家代表人物，韩非的同学。
description.en: Chancellor of the Qin dynasty, a key Legalist figure, and a fellow student of Han Fei.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝宦官，中车府令，与李斯合谋发动沙丘之变，后陷害李斯。
description.en: A powerful eunuch of the Qin dynasty and a key conspirator in the Sand Dune Coup.

description.zh-cn: 秦国将领，秦灭六国战争中的主要将领之一。
description.en: A leading general of the state of Qin during the wars of unification.

description.zh-cn: 战国末期韩国法家思想家，法家思想的代表人物与集大成者。他曾多次上书韩桓惠王，要求推行法治以图富强。后为李斯的同学，但最终被李斯所害。
description.en: A Legalist philosopher from the State of Han during the late Warring States period, he was a representative and synthesizer of the Legalist school. He repeatedly submitted memorials to King Huanhui of Han, advocating for the implementation of the rule of law to strengthen the state. He was a fellow student of Li Si and was later executed by him.

description.zh-cn: 楚考烈王之子，曾任秦国丞相，并以秦国公子身份奉命平定嫪毐之乱，后叛秦归楚。
description.en: Son of King Kaolie of Chu, who served as Chancellor of Qin, was honored as a Prince of Qin, and was ordered to suppress the Lao Ai rebellion, before rebelling and returning to Chu.

description.zh-cn: 战国末期刺客，受燕太子丹之托刺杀秦王失败。
description.en: An assassin of the late Warring States period, known for his failed attempt to assassinate Qin Shi Huang.

description.zh-cn: 汉朝开国功臣，出身于韩国贵族，其祖父与父亲曾五代相韩。曾策划博浪沙行刺秦始皇，后为汉初三杰之一。汉初，曾作为大臣为吕后出谋划策，保住太子刘盈的地位。
description.en: A founding father of the Han Dynasty, who came from the nobility of the State of Han, and whose grandfather and father served as chancellors to five generations of Han rulers. He plotted an assassination attempt on Qin Shi Huang at Bolangsha and later became a key strategist for the Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 燕王喜的太子，派遣荆轲刺杀秦王。
description.en: Crown Prince of Yan who dispatched Jing Ke to assassinate the King of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 中国周朝的诸侯国，战国七雄之一，最终统一六国并建立秦朝。在战国时期，李冰曾担任蜀郡郡守。
description.en: A vassal state of the Zhou Dynasty in China, and one of the Seven Warring States. It eventually unified the other six states and established the Qin dynasty. During the Warring States period, Li Bing served as the governor of Shu Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上第一个大一统的中央集权制王朝。
description.en: The first unified, centralized imperial dynasty in Chinese history.

description.zh-cn: 中国战国时代的诸侯国，姬姓韩氏，由三家分晋而来。作为战国七雄之一，它是第一个被秦国所灭的国家，也是著名思想家韩非的母国。
description.en: A vassal state during the Warring States period in China, of the Ji family name and Han clan. It originated from the Partition of Jin. As one of the Seven Warring States, it was the first to be conquered by the State of Qin and was the home state of the famous philosopher Han Fei.

description.zh-cn: 战国七雄之一。
description.en: One of the seven major states of the Warring States period.

description.zh-cn: 战国七雄之一。

description.zh-cn: 中国周朝的诸侯国，战国七雄之一。
description.en: A vassal state of the Zhou Dynasty in China, one of the Seven Warring States.

description.zh-cn: 古代中国南方和越南北部的各部落的统称。

en: Burning of books and burying of scholars

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇于公元前213年和前212年推行的极端政治行动与政策，旨在统一思想、压制思想异见。此举导致焚毁大量书籍、坑杀“犯禁者四百六十馀人”，特别是儒家经典被毁。
description.en: An extreme political action and policy implemented by Qin Shi Huang from 213 to 212 BC. It aimed to unify thought and suppress intellectual dissent, leading to the burning of numerous books, the burying alive of scholars, and the destruction of Confucian classics.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇死后，赵高、李斯等人伪造遗诏，拥立胡亥即位的政治事件。
description.en: A political conspiracy after Qin Shi Huang's death where Zhao Gao and Li Si forged the imperial will to enthrone Huhai.

He is currently the Chairman and Party Group Secretary of the Anhui Provincial Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，夏宝龙担任浙江省省长时的前任。
description.en: Chinese politician, predecessor to Xia Baolong as Governor of Zhejiang.

description.en: Deputies to the 13th National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China, who are members of the highest organ of state power.

description.zh-cn: 为中央军事委员会主席服务的办事机构。

曾任山西省革命委员会主任。
大寨大队原党支部书记，陈永贵的前任。
柬埔寨共产党总书记、红色高棉最高领导人，曾与陈永贵互访。
文化大革命期间山西省的权力机构。
抗日战争期间，日本当局在占领区建立的组织，旨在促进亚洲团结和发展。
description.en: A Japanese organization established by authorities in occupied territories during the Anti-Japanese War, aimed at promoting Asian unity and development.

description.zh-cn: 位于山西省昔阳县的村庄，在毛泽东时代作为“农业学大寨”运动的全国典型。
毛泽东发起的全国性农业运动，以大寨为榜样。
文革时期的一项极左政策，旨在取消农民的自留地和家庭副业。
段祺瑞和范瑾的母亲。
description.en: Mother of Duan Qirui and Fan Jin.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞的原配妻子。
description.en: Duan Qirui's first wife.

description.zh-cn: 清末由李鸿章在天津创办的军事院校，是中国近代第一所陆军军官学校。
description.en: A military academy founded in Tianjin by Li Hongzhang during the late Qing dynasty, it was the first modern army officer school in China.

description.zh-cn: 19世纪末德国的军事教育机构。
description.en: A military educational institution in Germany in the late 19th century.

description.zh-cn: 直系军阀与皖系军阀之间为争夺北京政府统治权而爆发的战争。
description.en: A war fought between the Zhili and Anhui cliques for control of the Beiyang government.

zh-cn: 中华民国临时政府 (段祺瑞)

description.zh-cn: 1924年甲子政变后，由段祺瑞在北京成立的政府，段祺瑞任“临时执政”。
description.en: The government established in Beijing by Duan Qirui after the 1924 Beijing Coup, in which he served as the 'Provisional Chief Executive'.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞执政府卫队开枪镇压北京学生和市民的请愿游行，造成大量伤亡。
