description.en: The German envoy to China. He was shot and killed on a Beijing street by En Hai, an officer of the Qing Manchu Banner Corps. This incident became one of the direct triggers for the large-scale military intervention by the Eight-Nation Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 清军神机营霆字枪队章京，在北京街头射杀了德国公使克林德。
description.en: An officer of the Qing Manchu Banner Corps (Shenjiying) who shot and killed the German minister Clemens von Ketteler on a Beijing street.

description.zh-cn: 晚清大臣，主和派官员，庚子被祸五大臣之一。因反对清廷对外宣战和利用义和团而被慈禧太后处死。
description.en: A late Qing official and a member of the pro-peace faction, one of the 'Five Ministers Executed in 1900'. He was executed by order of Empress Dowager Cixi for opposing the declaration of war and the use of the Boxers.

description.zh-cn: 晚清大臣，主和派官员，庚子被祸五大臣之一。因反对清廷对外宣战和利用义和团而被慈禧太后处死。
description.en: A late Qing official and a member of the pro-peace faction, one of the 'Five Ministers Executed in 1900'. He was executed by order of Empress Dowager Cixi for opposing the declaration of war and the use of the Boxers.

description.zh-cn: 晚清重臣，湘军重要将领，曾任两江总督。他是“东南互保”的主要策划者之一，拒绝执行清廷的宣战命令。
description.en: A prominent and influential official in the late Qing dynasty, an important general of the Xiang Army, and former Viceroy of Liangjiang. He was a key architect of the 'Mutual Protection of Southeast China', refusing to carry out the imperial court's declaration of war.

description.zh-cn: 晚清将领，甘军首领。他率领的甘军是围攻北京外国使馆和抵抗八国联军的主力部队之一。
description.en: A late Qing general and leader of the Kansu Braves. His troops were one of the main forces besieging the foreign legations in Beijing and resisting the Eight-Nation Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 英国海军中将，领导了八国联军的第一次远征（西摩尔远征），试图从天津进军北京解救被围的使馆区，但被义和团和清军击退。
description.en: A British Royal Navy admiral who led the first expedition of the Eight-Nation Alliance (the Seymour Expedition) in an attempt to relieve the besieged legations in Beijing from Tianjin, but was repulsed by Boxers and Qing troops.

description.zh-cn: 八国联军为镇压义和团运动而发动的军事入侵。联军先后攻占大沽炮台、天津和北京，最终迫使清政府签订《辛丑条约》。
description.en: A military invasion launched by the Eight-Nation Alliance to suppress the Boxer Rebellion. The coalition forces captured the Taku Forts, Tianjin, and Beijing, ultimately forcing the Qing government to sign the Boxer Protocol.

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后试图废黜光绪皇帝，立端郡王载漪之子溥儁为大阿哥（皇储）的政治事件。因遭各国公使反对而未成功，加深了慈禧及主战派对外国的仇视。
description.en: A political event where Empress Dowager Cixi attempted to depose the Guangxu Emperor and install Pujun, son of Prince Duan (Zaiyi), as the heir apparent. The plan failed due to opposition from foreign ministers, which deepened the hostility of Cixi and the pro-war faction towards foreigners.

description.zh-cn: 1928年北伐期间，国民革命军在济南与日本军队发生的武装冲突，导致中方人员重大伤亡。
description.en: An armed conflict between the National Revolutionary Army and Japanese troops in Jinan during the Northern Expedition in 1928, resulting in significant Chinese casualties.

description.zh-cn: 1927年8月，国民革命军在南京龙潭地区击败孙传芳军队的一次关键性战役。
description.en: A decisive battle in August 1927 where the National Revolutionary Army defeated Sun Chuanfang's forces in the Longtan area of Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院总理周恩来的逝世事件。
中国人民解放军少将，时任北京卫戍区司令员。
中华人民共和国武装力量的组成部分，是不脱离生产的群众武装组织。
四五天安门事件的前奏，南京市民和学生为悼念周恩来、抗议《文汇报》而发起的游行示威活动。
上海市的一家综合性日报。在文革后期受“四人帮”控制。
一部讲述南京大屠杀期间通过照片胶卷揭露日军暴行的电影。中国网民借用该电影主题，将江油事件代称为“江油照相馆”，以讽刺政府暴力执法和信息封锁。
description.en: A film about exposing Japanese atrocities during the Nanjing Massacre through photographic film. Chinese netizens used the film's theme to coin the term 'Jiangyou Photo Studio' for the Jiangyou incident, satirizing the government's violent enforcement and information blockade.

description.zh-cn: 在四川成都举办的国际体育赛事。江油事件发生在该运动会开幕前夕，给地方官员带来了维持稳定的巨大政治压力，可能影响了他们对事件的处理方式。
description.en: An international sports event held in Chengdu, Sichuan. The Jiangyou incident occurred just before its opening, placing immense political pressure on local officials to maintain stability, which likely influenced their handling of the situation.

description.zh-cn: 一个中国开发的生成式人工智能聊天机器人，在中国传媒研究计划的测试中，该模型未输出江油示威的相关信息，反映了审查延伸至AI领域。
description.en: A generative AI chatbot developed in China. In tests by the China Media Project, the model did not output information about the Jiangyou protests, reflecting the extension of censorship into the AI domain.

description.zh-cn: 百度公司开发的生成式人工智能聊天机器人，在中国传媒研究计划的测试中，该模型未输出江油示威的相关信息，反映了审查延伸至AI领域。
description.en: A generative AI chatbot developed by Baidu. In tests by the China Media Project, the model did not output information about the Jiangyou protests, reflecting the extension of censorship into the AI domain.

description.zh-cn: 一个中国开发的生成式人工智能聊天机器人，在中国传媒研究计划的测试中，该模型未输出江油示威的相关信息，反映了审查延伸至AI领域。
description.en: A generative AI chatbot developed in China. In tests by the China Media Project, the model did not output information about the Jiangyou protests, reflecting the extension of censorship into the AI domain.

description.zh-cn: 一个中国开发的生成式人工智能聊天机器人，在中国传媒研究计划的测试中，该模型未输出江油示威的相关信息，反映了审查延伸至AI领域。
description.en: A generative AI chatbot developed in China. In tests by the China Media Project, the model did not output information about the Jiangyou protests, reflecting the extension of censorship into the AI domain.

description.zh-cn: 威京总部集团主席，京华城案核心人物之一，被控为获取不当容积率而行贿官员。
description.en: Chairman of the Core Pacific Group, a central figure in the Core Pacific City case, accused of bribing officials to obtain improper floor area ratio.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党籍台北市议员，被控在京华城案中收受贿赂，为威京集团游说市府官员。
description.en: Kuomintang (KMT) Taipei City Councilor, accused of accepting bribes in the Core Pacific City case to lobby city government officials on behalf of the Core Pacific Group.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲市府时期的台北市长办公室主任，因京华城案被控违背职务收受贿赂罪。
description.en: Director of the Taipei City Mayor's Office during Ko Wen-je's administration, accused of accepting bribes against his duties in the Core Pacific City case.

description.zh-cn: 前台北市政府兵役局局长，后任威京集团子公司董事长，在京华城案中承认行贿。
description.en: Former Director of the Taipei City Government's Department of Military Service, later became the chairman of a Core Pacific Group subsidiary. He admitted to bribery in the Core Pacific City case.

description.zh-cn: 民进党籍台北市议员，在议会对柯文哲市府给予京华城高容积率提出质疑。
description.en: Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) Taipei City Councilor who questioned the Ko Wen-je administration's granting of a high floor area ratio to Core Pacific City in the city council.

description.zh-cn: 民进党籍政治人物，曾任台北市议员，早期曾指控官员图利京华城。
description.en: Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) politician and former Taipei City Councilor who had previously accused officials of improperly benefiting Core Pacific City.

description.zh-cn: 前台北市副市长，以证人身份表示在任内反对京华城增加容积率。
description.en: Former Deputy Mayor of Taipei, who testified as a witness that he opposed increasing the floor area ratio for Core Pacific City during his tenure.

description.zh-cn: 审理京华城案的法院，曾裁定羁押及交保多名被告。
description.en: The court responsible for trying the Core Pacific City case, which has made rulings on the detention and bail of several defendants.

description.zh-cn: 位于台北市松山区的已停业购物中心，其改建为京华广场的过程引发了容积率争议。
description.en: A defunct shopping mall located in Songshan District, Taipei. Its redevelopment into Core Pacific Plaza sparked the floor area ratio controversy.

description.zh-cn: 台湾关于都市更新的法律。京华城改建案被指违法引用此条例以获取容积奖励，因其并非都市更新案。
description.en: A Taiwanese law concerning urban regeneration. The Core Pacific City redevelopment project was accused of illegally citing this act to obtain floor area ratio bonuses, as it was not an urban renewal case.

description.zh-cn: 西魏和北周的将领，隋文帝杨坚的父亲，被追尊为隋武元帝。
description.en: A general of the Western Wei and Northern Zhou dynasties, father of Emperor Wen of Sui (Yang Jian), posthumously honored as Emperor Wuyuan of Sui.

description.zh-cn: 隋文帝杨坚的母亲，被追尊为元明皇后。
description.en: Mother of Emperor Wen of Sui (Yang Jian), posthumously honored as Empress Yuanming.

description.zh-cn: 中国南北朝时期的北朝之一，最后被杨坚篡位，建立隋朝。
description.en: One of the Northern dynasties during the Northern and Southern dynasties period in China, which was eventually usurped by Yang Jian, who established the Sui dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北周最后一位皇帝，被迫禅位于杨坚。
description.en: The last emperor of the Northern Zhou dynasty, who was forced to abdicate the throne to Yang Jian.

description.zh-cn: 隋文帝长子，原为太子，后被废黜并被其弟杨广所杀。
description.en: The eldest son of Emperor Wen of Sui, originally the crown prince, he was later deposed and killed by his younger brother Yang Guang.

description.zh-cn: 中国南北朝时期的南朝最后一个朝代，被隋文帝所灭。
description.en: The last of the Southern Dynasties during the Northern and Southern dynasties period in China, conquered by Emperor Wen of Sui.

description.zh-cn: 中国南北朝时期存在于江陵地区的一个割据政权，后被隋文帝所废。
description.en: A small state that existed in the Jiangling area during the Northern and Southern dynasties period, which was later abolished by Emperor Wen of Sui.

description.zh-cn: 隋文帝杨坚在位期间出现的政治稳定、社会经济繁荣的时期。
description.en: A period of political stability and socioeconomic prosperity during the reign of Emperor Wen of Sui (Yang Jian).

description.zh-cn: 北周末年官员，与郑译等人矫诏拥立杨坚辅政。
description.en: An official in the late Northern Zhou dynasty who, along with Zheng Yi and others, forged an edict to support Yang Jian as regent.

description.zh-cn: 北周末年官员，与刘昉等人矫诏拥立杨坚辅政。
description.en: An official in the late Northern Zhou dynasty who, along with Liu Fang and others, forged an edict to support Yang Jian as regent.

description.zh-cn: 北周将领，杨坚专政后起兵反对，兵败自杀。
description.en: A Northern Zhou general who launched a rebellion against Yang Jian after he took power, but was defeated and committed suicide.

description.zh-cn: 北周赵王，宇文泰之子。曾试图谋杀杨坚未遂，后被杨坚诛杀。
description.en: Prince of Zhao of Northern Zhou, son of Yuwen Tai. He attempted to assassinate Yang Jian but failed, and was later executed by Yang Jian.

description.zh-cn: 北周齐王，曾向北周武帝警示杨坚相貌非常，应尽早除掉。
description.en: Prince of Qi of Northern Zhou, who warned Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou that Yang Jian had an extraordinary appearance and should be eliminated early.

zh-cn: 隋仁寿宫唐九成宫遗址

description.zh-cn: 隋文帝杨坚的逝世地。
description.en: The place of death of Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿的儿子。
description.en: Son of Luo Ruiqing.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿的儿子。
description.en: Son of Luo Ruiqing.

en: State Council of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的最高国家行政机关。
description.en: The highest state administrative organ of the People's Republic of China.

en: Ministry of Public Security of the Central People's Government

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期的公安主管机关，后改组为中华人民共和国公安部。
description.en: The public security authority in the early days of the People's Republic of China, later reorganized into the Ministry of Public Security of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命前夕，时任解放军总参谋长罗瑞卿被林彪等人指控“反党篡军”而遭批判、撤职的政治事件。
description.en: A political incident on the eve of the Cultural Revolution, where the then PLA Chief of General Staff Luo Ruiqing was accused by Lin Biao and others of 'opposing the Party and usurping the army,' leading to his criticism and dismissal.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的高级领导人，曾任中共中央军委工作人员。
description.en: A senior leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, who once worked for the CPC Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在此次会议上，罗瑞卿受到批判，是“罗瑞卿事件”的关键环节。
description.en: At this conference, Luo Ruiqing was criticized, which was a key part of the 'Luo Ruiqing Incident'.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿的出生地，位于四川省。
description.en: The birthplace of Luo Ruiqing, located in Sichuan Province.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿的逝世地，位于西德巴登-符腾堡州。
description.en: The place of death of Luo Ruiqing, located in Heidelberg, Baden-Württemberg, West Germany.

description.zh-cn: 晚清主张引进、仿造西方的科学技术，以“自强”、“求富”为口号，来维护清朝统治的官僚集团。
description.en: A bureaucratic faction in the late Qing dynasty that advocated for the introduction and imitation of Western science and technology under the slogans of 'self-strengthening' and 'seeking wealth' to maintain Qing rule.

description.zh-cn: 晚清时期的一个政治派别，以敢于弹劾权贵、作风清廉、言辞激烈著称。
description.en: A political faction in the late Qing dynasty known for its integrity, sharp criticism, and daring to impeach powerful officials.

description.zh-cn: 晚清维新派人士，自立军起义的领导者。
description.en: A reformist in the late Qing dynasty and leader of the Self-Supporting Army Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 晚清时期的一位军事将领，因在中法战争中取得镇南关大捷而闻名。
description.en: A military general in the late Qing dynasty, famous for the victory at the Battle of Zhennan Pass during the Sino-French War.

description.zh-cn: 中法战争期间，清军在广西镇南关（今友谊关）一带击败法军的一场关键战役。
description.en: A key battle during the Sino-French War where Qing forces defeated the French army near Zhennan Pass (now Youyi Guan) in Guangxi.

description.zh-cn: 由张之洞撰写，系统阐述其“中学为体，西学为用”思想的著作。
description.en: A work written by Zhang Zhidong that systematically elaborates his idea of 'Chinese learning as the essence, Western learning for practical use'.

description.zh-cn: 清末由同盟会发动，在湖南、江西边界的萍乡、浏阳、醴陵地区爆发的武装起义。
description.en: An armed uprising launched by the Tongmenghui in the late Qing dynasty in the Pingxiang, Liuyang, and Liling areas on the border of Hunan and Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞的从兄，清朝大臣。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong's cousin and an official of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞的长子。
description.en: Eldest son of Zhang Zhidong.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞的幼子。
description.en: Youngest son of Zhang Zhidong.

description.zh-cn: 清末官员，戊戌六君子之一，张之洞的弟子。
description.en: An official in the late Qing dynasty, one of the Six Gentlemen of the Hundred Days' Reform, and a disciple of Zhang Zhidong.

description.zh-cn: 清末怪杰，精通多种语言，曾任张之洞幕僚。
description.en: An eccentric scholar in the late Qing dynasty, proficient in multiple languages, who served as an aide to Zhang Zhidong.

description.zh-cn: 清代古琴家，曾为张之洞的古琴老师。
description.en: A guqin master of the Qing dynasty who taught Zhang Zhidong.

description.zh-cn: 清朝在湖北和湖南地区的最高军政长官职位。
description.en: The highest-ranking civil and military position in the Huguang (Hubei and Hunan) region during the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 美国前第一夫人，乔治·赫伯特·沃克·布什的妻子，乔治·沃克·布什的母亲。
description.en: Former First Lady of the United States, wife of George H. W. Bush and mother of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，曾任佛罗里达州州长，乔治·沃克·布什的弟弟。
description.en: American politician, former Governor of Florida, and younger brother of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，在乔治·沃克·布什总统任内担任副总统。
description.en: American politician who served as Vice President during the presidency of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治家，曾任副总统。他曾在2000年美国总统选举中作为民主党候选人与乔治·沃克·布什竞争，并以其环保行动主义和主演的纪录片《难以忽视的真相》（关注全球变暖问题）而闻名。
description.en: American politician and former Vice President. He ran as the Democratic candidate against George W. Bush in the 2000 presidential election and is known for his environmental activism and the documentary 'An Inconvenient Truth'.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，在2000年共和党总统初选中与乔治·沃克·布什竞争。
description.en: American politician who competed against George W. Bush in the 2000 Republican presidential primary.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，在乔治·沃克·布什总统任内担任国防部长。
description.en: American politician who served as Secretary of Defense during the presidency of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治家、外交家和退役四星将军，曾在乔治·沃克·布什总统任内担任美国国务卿。
description.en: An American politician, diplomat, and retired four-star general who served as the U.S. Secretary of State during the presidency of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，在乔治·沃克·布什总统任内担任国务卿。
description.en: American politician who served as Secretary of State during the presidency of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 英国政治人物，前英国首相，在伊拉克战争等议题上与布什政府紧密合作。
description.en: British politician and former Prime Minister of the United Kingdom who worked closely with the Bush administration, particularly on the Iraq War.

description.zh-cn: 基地组织创始人，被美国政府认定为九一一袭击事件的主谋。
description.en: Founder of al-Qaeda, identified by the U.S. government as the mastermind behind the September 11 attacks.

description.zh-cn: 美利坚合众国的国家元首、政府首脑与三军统帅。
description.en: The head of state, head of government, and commander-in-chief of the armed forces of the United States of America.

description.zh-cn: 美国德克萨斯州的政府首脑。
description.en: The head of government of the U.S. state of Texas.

description.zh-cn: 阿富汗的伊斯兰原教旨主义运动和军事组织，在2001年被美国领导的联军推翻。
description.en: An Islamic fundamentalist movement and military organization in Afghanistan, overthrown by a U.S.-led coalition in 2001.

description.zh-cn: 一个由奥萨玛·本·拉登创立的伊斯兰军事组织，被美国认定为九一一袭击事件的策划者。
description.en: An Islamic military organization founded by Osama bin Laden, identified by the U.S. as the planner of the September 11 attacks.

description.zh-cn: 由美国及其盟友为回应九一一袭击事件而发起的一场全球性军事、政治、法律和意识形态斗争。
description.en: A global military, political, legal, and ideological struggle launched by the United States and its allies in response to the September 11 attacks.

description.zh-cn: 美国及其盟友为推翻塔利班政权、铲除基地组织势力而在阿富汗发动的战争。
description.en: A war launched by the United States and its allies in Afghanistan to overthrow the Taliban regime and eliminate al-Qaeda forces.

location.zh-cn: 美国墨西哥湾沿岸地区

description.zh-cn: 2005年8月发生在美国墨西哥湾沿岸的一场破坏性极强的飓风，对新奥尔良市造成了严重破坏。
description.en: An extremely destructive hurricane in August 2005 that caused severe damage along the U.S. Gulf Coast, especially in the city of New Orleans.

zh-cn: 中央民族大学附属中学
en: High School Affiliated to Minzu University of China

description.zh-cn: 一种急性、严重的心脏状态。
description.en: An acute, severe heart condition.

description.zh-cn: 于1945年成立的短暂政权，后被乌兰夫解散。
description.en: A short-lived regime established in 1945, later dissolved by Ulanhu.

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国功臣，岐阳武靖王，朱元璋外甥，李景隆之父。
李景隆的弟弟，永乐年间与李景隆一同被软禁。
明朝晋王，娶李景隆之女为妃。
明朝尚书，曾与李景隆共事。
燕军兵临南京城下时，李景隆与谷王朱橞开金川门投降，导致建文帝政权终结的事件。
明朝爵位。
中华民国政治人物，曾接任于右任为监察院院长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China who succeeded Yu Youren as the President of the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，于右任的前任监察院院长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China and Yu Youren's predecessor as President of the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期陕西省的最高行政机关，曾被指控在某案审理过程中发函干预司法。
description.en: The highest administrative body of Shaanxi Province during the Republic of China era, which was accused of interfering with the judiciary by sending a letter during the trial of a case.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任国务总理。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China who served as Premier.

description.zh-cn: 清末官员，曾任陕甘总督。
description.en: An official in the late Qing dynasty who served as the Viceroy of Shaanxi and Gansu.

description.zh-cn: 于右任在上海创办的具有革命倾向的日报。
description.en: A daily newspaper with revolutionary tendencies founded by Yu Youren in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 于右任在上海法租界创办的日报，因报导伊藤博文遇刺事件，遭清廷控告后被查封停刊。
description.en: A daily newspaper founded by Yu Youren in the Shanghai French Concession, which was sued by the Qing government and subsequently shut down for its coverage of the assassination of Itō Hirobumi.

description.zh-cn: 于右任创办的积极宣传民主革命的报纸。
description.en: A newspaper founded by Yu Youren that actively promoted democratic revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政府负责交通与通信事务的部门。
description.en: The department of the ROC government responsible for transportation and communications.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，曾推举于右任为陕西靖国军总司令。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China who nominated Yu Youren as the commander-in-chief of the Shaanxi Pacification Army.

description.zh-cn: 台湾社会运动人士，曾参与破坏玉山上的于右任铜像。
description.en: A Taiwanese social activist involved in the vandalism of the Yu Youren statue on Yushan.

description.zh-cn: 于右任次子，曾任中华民国外交官。
description.en: Yu Youren's second son, who served as a diplomat for the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 于右任女婿，于念慈的丈夫。
description.en: Yu Youren's son-in-law, husband of Yu Nianci.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚政治人物，曾任人民公正党署理主席。他曾是安华的长期追随者，但后来两人关系破裂，成为政治对手。他在2020年马来西亚政治危机中扮演了关键角色，带领一批议员退出公正党，导致希望联盟政府倒台。
description.en: Malaysian politician, former Deputy President of the People's Justice Party (PKR). He was a long-time follower of Anwar, but their relationship later soured, turning them into political rivals. He played a key role in the 2020 Malaysian political crisis by leading a faction of MPs out of PKR, which led to the collapse of the Pakatan Harapan government.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚第十六任最高元首。在2022年大选出现悬峙议会后，他委任安华·依布拉欣为第十任首相。
description.en: The 16th Yang di-Pertuan Agong of Malaysia. Following the hung parliament result of the 2022 general election, he appointed Anwar Ibrahim as the 10th Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚政治人物，安华·依布拉欣与旺阿兹莎的长女。人民公正党副主席，曾任国会议员。2023年被其父安华委任为首相经济和金融高级顾问。
description.en: Malaysian politician, the eldest daughter of Anwar Ibrahim and Wan Azizah Wan Ismail. She is a vice-president of the People's Justice Party (PKR) and a former Member of Parliament. In 2023, she was appointed by her father, Anwar, as a senior adviser on economics and finance to the Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 一个由安华·依布拉欣的支持者在“烈火莫熄”运动后成立的多元种族政党。安华是该党的实权领袖和现任主席。
description.en: A multi-racial political party formed by supporters of Anwar Ibrahim following the "Reformasi" movement. Anwar is the party's de facto leader and current president.

description.zh-cn: 1998年安华被革职后，其支持者发起的社会政治改革运动，要求司法独立、反对贪腐和裙带关系。该运动直接促成了人民公正党的诞生。
description.en: A socio-political reform movement initiated by Anwar's supporters after his dismissal in 1998, calling for judicial independence and an end to corruption and cronyism. The movement directly led to the formation of the People's Justice Party (PKR).

description.zh-cn: 安华·依布拉欣先后两次被控以鸡奸罪名，这些审判被广泛认为是出于政治动机，旨在终结其政治生涯。第一次定罪于2004年被推翻，第二次定罪后他于2018年获得全面特赦。
description.en: Anwar Ibrahim was twice charged with sodomy in trials widely seen as politically motivated to end his political career. The first conviction was overturned in 2004, and after the second, he received a full royal pardon in 2018.

description.zh-cn: 1987年马来西亚政府以内安法令进行的一次大逮捕行动。时任教育部长安华因派遣不谙华文的教师出任华小高职而引发的争议是此事件的导火索之一。
description.en: A major crackdown under the Internal Security Act by the Malaysian government in 1987. The controversy sparked by then-Education Minister Anwar's appointment of non-Mandarin-speaking teachers to senior positions in Chinese primary schools was one of the triggers for this event.

description.zh-cn: 刘仰峤之女，文化大革命期间北京师范大学女附中革命师生代表会主席。
description.en: Daughter of Liu Yangqiao, and the chair of the Revolutionary Teachers and Students Representative Council at Beijing Normal University Affiliated Girls' Middle School during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国马萨诸塞州波士顿的私立研究型大学。
description.en: A private research university in Boston, Massachusetts, United States.

description.zh-cn: 卞仲耘的丈夫。
description.en: Husband of Bian Zhongyun.

description.zh-cn: 美国芝加哥大学学者，研究文革历史，发表文章指控宋彬彬对卞仲耘之死负有责任。
description.en: A scholar at the University of Chicago who studies the history of the Cultural Revolution and published articles holding Song Binbin responsible for the death of Bian Zhongyun.

zh-cn: 高雄市立高雄高级工业职业学校

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾高雄市的一所高级工业职业学校，傅兆林毕业于此。
description.en: A senior industrial vocational high school in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, from which Fu Zhaolin graduated.

description.zh-cn: 位于日本东京的顶尖理工科大学，傅兆林曾在此留学。
description.en: A top science and technology university in Tokyo, Japan, where Fu Zhaolin studied abroad.

description.zh-cn: 台湾省政府下设的部门，傅兆林曾在此任职。
description.en: A department under the Taiwan Provincial Government where Fu Zhaolin worked.

description.zh-cn: 日治台湾高雄州旗山郡下辖的行政区，现为高雄市美浓区。为傅兆林的出生地。
description.en: An administrative district under Kizan District, Takao Prefecture, during the Japanese rule of Taiwan, now Meinong District, Kaohsiung City. It is the birthplace of Fu Zhaolin.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾花莲县的县辖市，为傅兆林的逝世地。
description.en: A county-administered city in Hualien County, Taiwan, where Fu Zhaolin passed away.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国台湾省的县，傅兆林曾在此工作并主导重大基础建设。
description.en: A county in Taiwan Province, Republic of China, where Fu Zhaolin worked and led major infrastructure projects.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国台湾省的县，傅兆林曾在此主导重大基础建设。
description.en: A county in Taiwan Province, Republic of China, where Fu Zhaolin led major infrastructure projects.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任行政院长。
description.en: Taiwanese politician, former Premier of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，大甲镇澜宫董事长。
description.en: Taiwanese politician, Chairman of the Dajia Jenn Lann Temple.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，前苗栗县长。
description.en: Taiwanese politician, former Magistrate of Miaoli County.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，前花莲县长。
description.en: Taiwanese politician, former Magistrate of Hualien County.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，前花莲县长。
description.en: Taiwanese politician, former Magistrate of Hualien County.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，前台东县长。
description.en: Taiwanese politician, former Magistrate of Taitung County.

description.zh-cn: 高力士的生父，曾任潘州刺史。
唐朝内侍省宦官，高力士的养父。
唐朝宦官，在唐肃宗时期当权。
唐朝第八位皇帝。
高力士的妻子。
中国政治人物，中共中央港澳工作办公室副主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, Deputy Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Work Office of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中共中央港澳工作办公室副主任、香港中联办主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, Deputy Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Work Office of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the Hong Kong Liaison Office.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中共中央港澳工作办公室副主任、澳门中联办主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, Deputy Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Work Office of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the Macau Liaison Office.

description.zh-cn: 中国外交官，中共中央港澳工作办公室副主任。
description.en: Chinese diplomat, Deputy Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Work Office of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国学者、官员，中共中央港澳工作办公室副主任。
description.en: Chinese scholar and official, Deputy Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Work Office of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中共中央港澳工作办公室副主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, Deputy Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Work Office of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，夏宝龙担任全国政协秘书长时的前任。
description.en: Chinese politician, predecessor to Xia Baolong as Secretary-General of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，夏宝龙担任全国政协秘书长时的继任者。
description.en: Chinese politician, successor to Xia Baolong as Secretary-General of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，夏宝龙担任国务院港澳事务办公室主任时的前任。
description.en: Chinese politician, predecessor to Xia Baolong as Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国经济学家，曾任北京大学校长，夏宝龙的博士生导师。
description.en: Chinese economist, former President of Peking University, and doctoral advisor to Xia Baolong.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军天津市军事管制委员会

description.zh-cn: 1949年中国人民解放军控制天津后设立的军事管制机构。
description.en: The military control commission established in Tianjin after it was controlled by the People's Liberation Army in 1949.

description.zh-cn: 曾任马来西亚最高元首。
description.en: Former Yang di-Pertuan Agong (Supreme Head of State) of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 苏丹前总统。
description.en: Former President of Sudan.

description.zh-cn: 香港机场管理局主席。
description.en: Chairman of the Airport Authority Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区政府律政司司长。
description.en: Secretary for Justice of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区政府环境及生态局局长。
description.en: Secretary for Environment and Ecology of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区政府财政司司长。
description.en: Financial Secretary of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 一种通过公开行进来表达政治或社会诉求的集体行动。
description.en: A form of collective action to express political or social demands through a public march.

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区政府律政司副司长。
description.en: Deputy Secretary for Justice of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 明朝末年将领，在辽东皮岛建立东江镇，以牵制后金。因其不受节制、虚报兵饷等行为，最终被袁崇焕以尚方宝剑斩杀。
description.en: A late Ming Dynasty general who established the Dongjiang garrison on Pi Island in Liaodong to harass the Later Jin. He was executed by Yuan Chonghuan with an imperial sword for insubordination, fraudulent reporting of military expenses, and other transgressions.

description.zh-cn: 明末政治家、军事家及帝师，曾任辽东督师。他支持并提拔了袁崇焕，主张修筑关宁锦防线以防御后金。后曾计划入京弹劾魏忠贤但未成功，并因柳河之败被魏忠贤排挤去职。
description.en: A late Ming statesman, strategist, and imperial tutor. He served as Viceroy of Liaodong, where he supported and promoted Yuan Chonghuan and advocated for the construction of the Guan-Ning-Jin Defense Line to defend against the Later Jin. He also planned to impeach Wei Zhongxian but failed, and was later forced out of office by Wei after the defeat at Liuhe.

description.zh-cn: 明朝与后金在宁远和锦州地区展开的系列战役。袁崇焕指挥明军再次成功抵御了皇太极的进攻，巩固了关宁锦防线。
description.en: A series of battles between Ming and Later Jin forces in the Ningyuan and Jinzhou areas. Ming forces under Yuan Chonghuan's command once again successfully repelled an invasion led by Hong Taiji, solidifying the Guan-Ning-Jin Defense Line.

description.zh-cn: 后金汗皇太极率军绕过关宁锦防线，经蒙古攻入明朝内地，兵临北京城下。此事件直接导致了袁崇焕的下狱和冤死。
description.en: An incident where the Later Jin khan Hong Taiji led his army to bypass the Guan-Ning-Jin Defense Line, invading the Ming heartland via Mongolia and laying siege to Beijing. This event directly led to the imprisonment and wrongful execution of Yuan Chonghuan.

description.zh-cn: 由孙承宗、袁崇焕等人主导构建的，以山海关为后盾，宁远、锦州为核心的纵深防御体系，用以抵御后金的进攻。
description.en: A defense-in-depth system primarily established by Sun Chengzong and Yuan Chonghuan, anchored by Shanhai Pass with Ningyuan and Jinzhou as its core fortresses, designed to defend against Later Jin invasions.

description.zh-cn: 明朝六部中兵部的最高长官，负责全国军事行政。
description.en: The highest official in the Ministry of War, one of the Six Ministries in the Ming Dynasty, responsible for the nation's military administration.

description.zh-cn: 德意志皇帝兼普鲁士国王，在位仅99天。
description.en: German Emperor and King of Prussia, who reigned for only 99 days.

description.zh-cn: 末任德意志皇帝及普鲁士国王。
description.en: The last German Emperor and King of Prussia.

description.zh-cn: 德意志帝国、北德意志邦联及普鲁士王国的政府首脑职位。
description.en: The head of government position for the German Empire, North German Confederation, and Kingdom of Prussia.

description.zh-cn: 德国将军和政治家，接替俾斯麦成为德意志帝国第二任宰相。
description.en: German general and statesman who succeeded Bismarck as the second Chancellor of the German Empire.

description.zh-cn: 普鲁士将军和政治家，曾短暂担任普鲁士首相。
description.en: Prussian general and statesman who briefly served as Minister President of Prussia.

description.zh-cn: 位于德国格赖夫斯瓦尔德的公立研究型大学。
description.en: A public research university in Greifswald, Germany.

description.zh-cn: 奥托·冯·俾斯麦的长子，德国政治家。
description.en: Eldest son of Otto von Bismarck and a German politician.

description.zh-cn: 将数百个独立邦国统一为德意志帝国的政治和行政一体化过程。
description.en: The political and administrative integration of hundreds of independent states into the German Empire.

description.zh-cn: 普鲁士和奥地利为争夺石勒苏益格和荷尔斯泰因而与丹麦发生的战争，是德国统一战争的第一场。
description.en: The first of the German unification wars, fought between Prussia and Austria against Denmark over the duchies of Schleswig and Holstein.

description.zh-cn: 普鲁士与奥地利为争夺德意志邦联领导权而爆发的战争，是德国统一战争的第二场。
description.en: The second of the German unification wars, fought between Prussia and Austria for dominance over the German Confederation.

description.zh-cn: 在普法战争胜利后，威廉一世在法国凡尔赛宫镜厅宣告德意志帝国成立的事件。
description.en: Following the victory in the Franco-Prussian War, Wilhelm I proclaimed the establishment of the German Empire in the Hall of Mirrors at the Palace of Versailles.

death_place.zh-cn: 奥匈帝国波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那共管领土萨拉热窝
death_place.en: Sarajevo, Condominium of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Austria-Hungary

description.zh-cn: 奥地利大公，奥匈帝国皇储及埃斯特大公，兼任奥匈陆军总司令。他于1914年在萨拉热窝遇刺，该事件（萨拉热窝事件）成为第一次世界大战的导火线。
description.en: Archduke of Austria, heir presumptive to the throne of Austria-Hungary, and Archduke of Austria-Este. His assassination in Sarajevo in 1914 (the Sarajevo incident) was the catalyst for World War I.

description.zh-cn: 奥匈帝国皇帝，弗朗茨·斐迪南的伯父。
description.en: Emperor of Austria-Hungary, paternal uncle of Franz Ferdinand.

zh-cn: 奥地利的卡尔·路德维希 (1833-1896)

description.zh-cn: 奥地利大公，奥皇弗兰茨·约瑟夫一世的弟弟，弗朗茨·斐迪南大公的父亲。
description.en: Archduke of Austria, younger brother of Emperor Franz Joseph I, and father of Archduke Franz Ferdinand.

zh-cn: 玛丽亚·安农齐亚塔 (两西西里公主)
en: Princess Maria Annunciata of Bourbon-Two Sicilies

description.zh-cn: 两西西里公主，弗朗茨·斐迪南大公的母亲。
description.en: Princess of Bourbon-Two Sicilies, mother of Archduke Franz Ferdinand.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨·斐迪南大公的妻子，两人因贵贱通婚，其子女无皇位继承权。与丈夫一同在萨拉热窝事件中遇刺身亡。
description.en: Wife of Archduke Franz Ferdinand. Due to their morganatic marriage, their children had no rights to the throne. She was assassinated alongside her husband in the Sarajevo incident.

description.zh-cn: 奥匈帝国皇太子，弗兰茨·约瑟夫一世的独子。他在梅耶林惨案中自杀后，弗朗茨·斐迪南成为皇储。
description.en: Crown Prince of Austria-Hungary, the only son of Emperor Franz Joseph I. After his suicide in the Mayerling incident, Franz Ferdinand became the heir presumptive.

description.zh-cn: 指奥匈帝国皇太子鲁道夫与其情妇的殉情自杀事件。此事导致弗朗茨·斐迪南成为皇位的第一顺位继承人。
description.en: Refers to the murder-suicide of Crown Prince Rudolf of Austria and his mistress. This event led to Franz Ferdinand becoming the heir presumptive to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 一种塞尔维亚民族主义思想，其追随者因弗朗茨·斐迪南主张“三元联邦体制”而憎恨他。
description.en: A Serbian nationalist ideology whose followers hated Franz Ferdinand for his advocacy of a 'Trialist' federal system.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利城市，弗朗茨·斐迪南大公的出生地。
description.en: A city in Austria, birthplace of Archduke Franz Ferdinand.

description.zh-cn: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那首都，弗朗茨·斐迪南大公夫妇在此地遇刺身亡。
description.en: The capital city of Bosnia and Herzegovina, where Archduke Franz Ferdinand and his wife were assassinated.

description.zh-cn: 奥匈帝国的地面部队。弗朗茨·斐迪南自幼加入并在其中服役，最终担任总司令。
description.en: The ground force of Austria-Hungary. Franz Ferdinand joined at a young age, served in it, and eventually became its Inspector General.

description.zh-cn: 一种婚姻制度，指地位悬殊的两人结婚后，其配偶和子女无法获得与丈夫同等的头衔、特权或财产继承权。弗朗茨·斐迪南的婚姻属此类。
description.en: A type of marriage between people of unequal social rank, which prevents the passage of the husband's titles and privileges to the wife and any children. The marriage of Franz Ferdinand was of this kind.

zh-cn: 马克西米利安·霍恩贝格

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨·斐迪南大公的长子，霍恩贝格公爵。因父母的贵贱通婚而无皇位继承权。
description.en: The eldest son of Archduke Franz Ferdinand, Duke of Hohenberg. He had no succession rights to the throne due to his parents' morganatic marriage.

description.zh-cn: 统治奥地利的王朝，弗朗茨·斐迪南是其成员。
description.en: The ruling house of Austria, of which Franz Ferdinand was a member.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利末代皇帝，在弗朗茨·斐迪南遇刺后成为皇储。
description.en: The last Emperor of Austria, who became the heir presumptive after the assassination of Franz Ferdinand.

en: Three Great Nobles of the Restoration

description.zh-cn: 对在明治维新中作出巨大贡献的萨摩藩的西乡隆盛、大久保利通和长州藩的木户孝允三人的称呼。
description.en: A term referring to Saigō Takamori and Ōkubo Toshimichi of the Satsuma Domain, and Kido Takayoshi of the Chōshū Domain, for their outstanding contributions to the Meiji Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 日本石川县士族，刺杀大久保利通的主犯。
description.en: A samurai from Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan, and the main perpetrator in the assassination of Ōkubo Toshimichi.

description.zh-cn: 指大久保利通在东京纪尾井坂遭到石川县士族岛田一郎等人暗杀的事件。
description.en: The assassination of Ōkubo Toshimichi by Shimada Ichirō and other samurai from Ishikawa Prefecture at Kioizaka, Tokyo.

description.zh-cn: 大久保利通的出生地，位于萨摩藩。
description.en: The birthplace of Ōkubo Toshimichi, located in the Satsuma Domain.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末时期萨摩藩的实际领导人，大久保利通是其心腹。
description.en: The de facto leader of the Satsuma Domain during the Bakumatsu period, of whom Ōkubo Toshimichi was a trusted confidant.

description.zh-cn: 明治初期日本政府内部关于是否应出兵朝鲜的政治辩论。西乡隆盛是主要倡导者，而刚从海外归来的木户孝允等人则坚决反对。
description.en: A major political debate in Japan during the early Meiji period over whether to invade Korea. Saigō Takamori was a leading proponent, while Kido Takayoshi and others who had just returned from overseas strongly opposed it.

description.zh-cn: 1873年因征韩论争议引发的日本政府高层分裂事件，导致西乡隆盛、板垣退助等征韩派官员集体辞职。
description.en: A political upheaval in the Japanese government in 1873 over the Seikanron debate, leading to the mass resignation of pro-invasion officials like Saigō Takamori and Itagaki Taisuke.

description.zh-cn: 指1874年日本以琉球漂流民在台湾被原住民杀害为由，出兵攻打台湾南部原住民部落的军事行动。大久保利通作为全权大臣负责与清朝交涉，而木户孝允则对此一贯持反对态度，并在政府决定出兵后辞去参议职务以示抗议。
description.en: A Japanese punitive expedition to Taiwan in 1874 in retaliation for the murder of Ryukyuan castaways by indigenous Taiwanese. Ōkubo Toshimichi was appointed as the plenipotentiary to negotiate with the Qing dynasty, while Kido Takayoshi consistently opposed this action and resigned from his post as Sangi in protest when the government decided to dispatch troops.

description.zh-cn: 清朝与日本于1874年就牡丹社事件签订的条约，由大久保利通代表日本谈判达成。
description.en: A treaty signed between the Qing dynasty and Japan in 1874 regarding the Mudan Incident, negotiated by Ōkubo Toshimichi on behalf of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 明治政府将琉球王国并入日本，设立冲绳县的过程。
description.en: The process by which the Meiji government incorporated the Ryukyu Kingdom into Japan, establishing Okinawa Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 大久保利通的次子，后过继给牧野家。
description.en: The second son of Ōkubo Toshimichi, later adopted into the Makino family.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治政府时期设立的官职，负责国内行政事务。
description.en: A cabinet position in the Meiji government of Japan responsible for domestic administrative affairs.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治政府时期设立的官职，负责国家财政。
description.en: A cabinet position in the Meiji government of Japan responsible for the nation's finances.

zh-cn: 国际关系及发展高等学院

description.zh-cn: 复旦大学下属的研究机构和国家高端智库。
description.en: A research institute and national high-end think tank affiliated with Fudan University.

zh-cn: 上海春秋发展战略研究院
en: Shanghai Chunqiu Institute for Development and Strategic Studies

description.zh-cn: 位于上海的民间智库。
description.en: A private think tank located in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 一个将国家合法性归因于其作为一种独特文明的代表，而不是作为一个民族国家代表的政治概念。
description.en: A political concept that attributes a state's legitimacy to its role as a representative of a unique civilization, rather than as a nation-state.

zh-cn: 历史的终结及最后之人
en: The End of History and the Last Man

description.zh-cn: 由弗朗西斯·福山提出的一种政治和哲学概念，认为人类社会演化的终点和最理想的政府形式是西方式自由民主制。
description.en: A political and philosophical concept proposed by Francis Fukuyama, arguing that the endpoint of human societal evolution and the ideal form of government is Western-style liberal democracy.

description.zh-cn: 2010年代初期在阿拉伯世界发生的一系列反政府示威、起义和武装叛乱。
description.en: A series of anti-government protests, uprisings, and armed rebellions that spread across much of the Arab world in the early 2010s.

description.zh-cn: 指继2010-2012年“阿拉伯之春”后，阿拉伯联盟国家出现的大规模暴力和不稳定时期。
description.en: Refers to the period of large-scale violence and instability in Arab League countries following the 2010–2012 'Arab Spring'.

description.zh-cn: 2011年在中国多个城市发生的受“阿拉伯之春”影响的短暂亲民主示威活动。
description.en: Brief pro-democracy demonstrations in several Chinese cities in 2011, inspired by the Arab Spring.

death_place.zh-cn: 江苏省南通县杨家港南
death_place.en: South of Yangjiagang, Nantong County, Jiangsu Province

description.zh-cn: 张维为的祖父，于1947年遭国民党还乡团杀害。
description.en: Zhang Weiwei's grandfather, killed by the Kuomintang Homecoming Corps in 1947.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战期间，由支持国民政府的地主和富农等组成的武装组织，对共产党控制区进行反攻倒算。
description.en: Armed groups formed by landlords and rich peasants supporting the Nationalist government during the second Chinese Civil War, conducting counter-attacks and reprisals in areas controlled by the Communist Party.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国外交部翻译司
en: Department of Translation and Interpretation, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国外交部内设机构，负责国家重要外事活动和外交文件的笔译、口译工作。
description.en: An internal department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the PRC, responsible for translation and interpretation for major state foreign affairs activities and diplomatic documents.

description.zh-cn: 复旦大学历史学系教授。
description.en: A professor at the Department of History, Fudan University.

description.zh-cn: 华东师范大学历史系教授，日内瓦国际关系及发展高等学院终身教授。
description.en: A professor at the Department of History, East China Normal University, and a tenured professor at the Graduate Institute of International and Development Studies in Geneva.

description.zh-cn: 英国学者、记者。
description.en: British academic and journalist.

description.zh-cn: 中华复兴社的前身，由黄埔军校毕业生组成的秘密政治团体。
description.en: The predecessor of the Fuxing Society, a secret political group formed by graduates of the Whampoa Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 中共情报“后三杰”之一，曾任胡宗南的机要秘书。
description.en: One of the 'Later Three Heroes' of CCP intelligence, served as Hu Zongnan's confidential secretary.

description.zh-cn: 中共情报“后三杰”之一，潜伏于胡宗南身边。
description.en: One of the 'Later Three Heroes' of CCP intelligence, who infiltrated Hu Zongnan's inner circle.

description.zh-cn: 中共情报“后三杰”之一，潜伏于胡宗南身边。
description.en: One of the 'Later Three Heroes' of CCP intelligence, who infiltrated Hu Zongnan's inner circle.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国将领，曾任海军陆战队司令。
description.en: A general of the Republic of China, served as Commander of the Marine Corps.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战期间的一场战役，胡宗南部队在此战中遭受重创。
description.en: A campaign during the Second Chinese Civil War where Hu Zongnan's forces suffered heavy losses.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国将领，在宜川战役中阵亡。
description.en: A general of the Republic of China who was killed in action during the Yichuan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国浙江省的最高行政机关。
description.en: The highest administrative organ of Zhejiang Province, Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中华民国陆军澎湖防卫指挥部

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军驻防于澎湖的军事部队。
description.en: A military unit of the Republic of China Army stationed in Penghu.

description.zh-cn: 国共内战后期国民政府在西南地区设立的军事指挥机构。
description.en: A military command established by the Nationalist Government in Southwest China during the late stage of the Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 中国抗日战争时期国民革命军的战区之一。
description.en: One of the war zones of the National Revolutionary Army during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 美国的两个主要政党之一，伍德罗·威尔逊是其成员。
description.en: One of the two major contemporary political parties in the United States, of which Woodrow Wilson was a member.

description.zh-cn: 美国的两个主要政党之一。
description.en: One of the two major contemporary political parties in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 伍德罗·威尔逊的第一任妻子。
description.en: The first wife of Woodrow Wilson.

description.zh-cn: 伍德罗·威尔逊的第二任妻子，在他中风后代为处理部分政务。
description.en: The second wife of Woodrow Wilson, who managed some state affairs after his stroke.

description.zh-cn: 由伍德罗·威尔逊总统在国会演讲中提出的一系列关于世界和平的原则声明。它成为德国停战和巴黎和会的基础。
description.en: A statement of principles for peace that was to be used for peace negotiations in order to end World War I, outlined in a January 8, 1918 speech on war aims and peace terms to the United States Congress by President Woodrow Wilson.

description.zh-cn: 美国共和党政治家，曾任参议员。他是伍德罗·威尔逊在批准《凡尔赛条约》和美国加入国际联盟问题上的主要政治对手。
description.en: An American Republican politician and a United States Senator. He was Woodrow Wilson's chief political opponent regarding the ratification of the Treaty of Versailles and U.S. entry into the League of Nations.

description.zh-cn: 由于共和党选票分裂，民主党人伍德罗·威尔逊在此次选举中获胜，成为美国总统。
description.en: An election in which Democrat Woodrow Wilson won the presidency due to a split in the Republican vote.

description.zh-cn: 美国第27任总统，伍德罗·威尔逊的前任。他在1912年总统选举中作为共和党候选人败选。
description.en: The 27th President of the United States and Woodrow Wilson's predecessor. He lost the 1912 presidential election as the Republican candidate.

description.zh-cn: 一种将人群按种族进行系统性分离的政策。威尔逊政府在美国联邦机构中实施了种族隔离措施。
description.en: The systemic separation of people into racial or other ethnic groups in daily life. The Wilson administration implemented segregationist policies within federal agencies.

description.zh-cn: 一种医疗紧急情况，指脑部血流中断。威尔逊在1919年经历了一次严重的中风，导致他部分瘫痪并丧失工作能力。
description.en: A medical condition in which poor blood flow to the brain results in cell death. Wilson suffered a severe stroke in 1919 that left him partially paralyzed and incapacitated.

description.zh-cn: 一部1915年的美国无声史诗电影，因其对三K党的英雄化描绘而备受争议。影片引用了威尔逊的著作《美国人史》中的段落。
description.en: A 1915 American silent epic drama film, controversial for its heroic portrayal of the Ku Klux Klan. The film quotes from Wilson's 'A History of the American People'.

description.zh-cn: 美国历史上和现存的奉行白人至上主义的仇恨团体。
description.en: American white supremacist hate groups, past and present.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治家，曾任威尔逊的国务卿。他在1912年民主党大会上支持威尔逊，但后因反对威尔逊的战争政策而辞职。
description.en: An American politician who served as Wilson's Secretary of State. He supported Wilson at the 1912 Democratic convention but later resigned in opposition to Wilson's war policies.

description.zh-cn: 法国总理，在巴黎和会上与威尔逊进行谈判。
description.en: Prime Minister of France who negotiated with Wilson at the Paris Peace Conference.

description.zh-cn: 英国首相，在巴黎和会上与威尔逊进行谈判。
description.en: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom who negotiated with Wilson at the Paris Peace Conference.

description.zh-cn: 秦国大臣，与李斯一同诬陷韩非。
description.en: A minister of the state of Qin who, along with Li Si, slandered Han Fei.

description.zh-cn: 韩非的著作集，是中国古代法家学派的代表作。宋神宗为太子时喜读此书，其思想对其后来的治国理念产生了影响。
description.en: A collection of works by Han Fei, it is a representative work of the ancient Chinese Legalist school. Emperor Shenzong enjoyed reading this book as crown prince, and its ideas influenced his later governing philosophy.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期法家代表人物，韩国宰相。他主张君主应以“术”来驾驭臣下。
description.en: A representative figure of the Legalist school during the Warring States period and Chancellor of the State of Han. He advocated that a ruler should use 'shu' (administrative methods/arts) to control his ministers.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期韩国君主，韩厘王之子。其在位期间，韩国国力日衰，面临秦国的强大军事压力。
description.en: King of the State of Han during the Warring States period, son of King Xili of Han. During his reign, the power of Han declined under strong military pressure from the State of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 韩国末代君主，韩桓惠王之子。
description.en: The last king of the State of Han, son of King Huanhui of Han.

description.zh-cn: 韩国君主，在位期间任用申不害变法，使韩国国力达到顶峰。
description.en: A monarch of the State of Han. During his reign, he appointed Shen Buhai to carry out reforms, bringing Han's power to its zenith.

zh-cn: 国务院防治艾滋病工作委员会

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任卫生部部长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Minister of Health.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任对外贸易经济合作部部长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Minister of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation.

description.zh-cn: 明朝洪武年间，因地方官员使用预先盖印的空白文书到户部核对账目，而被明太祖朱元璋视为欺君重罪，进而引发的一场大规模政治清洗事件。
description.en: A major political purge during the Hongwu era of the Ming Dynasty, initiated by Emperor Hongwu (Zhu Yuanzhang) who considered the widespread practice of officials using pre-sealed blank documents for auditing purposes a grave crime of deceiving the monarch.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代官署，掌管全国疆土、田地、户籍、赋税、俸饷及一切财政事宜。空印案的核心争议发生在地方官员与户部核对账目期间。
description.en: A ministry in imperial China responsible for land, census, taxation, salaries, and all fiscal matters. The core dispute of the Empty Seal Case occurred during the auditing process between local officials and the Ministry of Revenue.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，因在空印案中上疏为涉案者辩护而激怒朱元璋，后被罚去服刑。
description.en: A Ming dynasty official who angered Emperor Hongwu by submitting a memorial to defend those implicated in the Empty Seal Case, and was subsequently punished with forced labor.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，学者方孝孺之父。在空印案中受牵连，于狱中去世。
description.en: A Ming dynasty official and the father of the scholar Fang Xiaoru. He was implicated in the Empty Seal Case and died in prison.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，洪武九年因上疏直言批评朱元璋的政策而被下狱，死于狱中。
description.en: A Ming dynasty official who was imprisoned and died in prison after submitting a memorial in the 9th year of Hongwu (1376) to frankly criticize Zhu Yuanzhang's policies.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，郑士利之兄。因在河南任职时曾使用空印文书，在空印案中被牵连入狱。
description.en: A Ming dynasty official and the elder brother of Zheng Shili. He was implicated and imprisoned in the Empty Seal Case for having used pre-sealed blank documents during his tenure in Henan.

description.zh-cn: 明初四大案之一，户部侍郎郭桓等人被指控贪污，数万人因此案被处死。
description.en: One of the Four Major Cases of the Early Ming Dynasty. Vice Minister of Revenue Guo Huan and others were accused of corruption, leading to the execution of tens of thousands of people.

description.zh-cn: 明朝洪武年间发生的一场科举舞弊大案。
description.en: A major imperial examination scandal that occurred during the Hongwu era of the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明朝户部侍郎，郭桓案的核心人物。
description.en: Vice Minister of Revenue of the Ming Dynasty and the central figure in the Case of Guo Huan.

description.zh-cn: 曾任清华大学党委副书记，他向毛泽东写的信件成为“批邓、反击右倾翻案风”运动的导火索之一。
description.en: Served as the Deputy Secretary of the Party Committee of Tsinghua University. His letter to Mao Zedong was one of the triggers for the 'Criticize Deng, Counterattack the Right-Deviationist Verdict-Reversal Wind' movement.

description.zh-cn: 印度及其他南亚地区普遍存在的社会分层体系。
description.en: A system of social stratification prevalent in India and other parts of South Asia.

description.zh-cn: 印度教文献中提出的一种理论社会阶级制度，将社会构想为由四个阶层组成的结构。
description.en: A theoretical social class system in Hindu literature that conceives society as structured into four classes.

description.zh-cn: 与印度种姓制度相似的尼泊尔社会分层体系。
description.en: A system of social stratification in Nepal, similar to the caste system in India.

description.zh-cn: 尼泊尔首相，其出任后尼泊尔正式成为印度教王国，巩固了种姓制度。
description.en: Prime Minister of Nepal, under whom Nepal officially became a Hindu kingdom, strengthening the caste system.

description.zh-cn: 元朝将人民分为四个等级的制度。
description.en: A system in the Yuan dynasty that divided the population into four classes.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国户籍制度

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的一项户籍管理制度，被一些学者认为与种姓制度有类似之处。
description.en: A household registration system in the People's Republic of China, which some scholars consider to have similarities to a caste system.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜半岛历史上的国家之一。
description.en: One of the historical kingdoms on the Korean Peninsula.

description.zh-cn: 新罗时期实行的世袭社会等级制度。
description.en: A hereditary social ranking system implemented during the Silla period.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜王朝时期的严密社会等级制度。
description.en: A strict social hierarchy system during the Joseon dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 指美国黑人或祖先为非洲黑人的美国公民。
description.en: Citizens or residents of the United States who have origins in any of the black populations of Africa.

zh-cn: 中央军委深化国防和军队改革领导小组
en: Central Leading Group for Military Reform

description.zh-cn: 为领导深化国防和军队改革而成立的专门机构，由习近平亲自担任组长。
description.en: A special body established to lead the deepening of national defense and military reform, personally headed by Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军曾划分的战区级别组织，在2016年的改革中被五大战区取代。
description.en: Theater-level organizations of the People's Liberation Army, which were replaced by five Theater Commands in the 2016 reform.

description.zh-cn: 2016年军改后设立的中国人民解放军战区级别联合作战指挥机构，取代了原有的七大军区。
description.en: Theater-level joint operations command structures of the PLA established after the 2016 military reform, replacing the original seven military regions.

description.zh-cn: 原属武警部队序列的部队，在2018年改革中退出现役。
description.en: A force formerly part of the People's Armed Police, which was demilitarized in the 2018 reform.

description.zh-cn: 位于印度洋的岛国，在2004年印度洋海啸中遭受了严重的人员伤亡和经济损失。
description.en: An island country in the Indian Ocean that suffered severe casualties and economic losses in the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami.

description.zh-cn: 泰国却克里王朝第九位君主，其外孙蒲美·詹森在2004年印度洋海啸中遇难。
description.en: The ninth monarch of Thailand from the Chakri dynasty, whose grandson Bhumi Jensen died in the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami.

description.zh-cn: 德国一级方程式赛车手，为2004年印度洋海啸的救援工作捐赠了1000万美元。
description.en: A German Formula One racing driver who donated $10 million to the relief efforts for the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami.

description.zh-cn: 印度尼西亚政治家，在2004年印度洋大地震发生时担任印度尼西亚总统。
description.en: An Indonesian politician who served as the President of Indonesia at the time of the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 美国位于北美洲西北角的州。2004年印度洋大地震甚至在此地触发了远距地震。
description.en: A U.S. state at the northwest extremity of North America. The 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake even triggered remote earthquakes in this region.

description.zh-cn: 美国内政部下属的科学研究机构，对2004年印度洋大地震的震级等参数进行了测定和发布。
description.en: A scientific agency of the United States Department of the Interior, which measured and reported parameters such as the magnitude of the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 旨在结束中国对西藏的统治，并使西藏成为一个主权独立国家的政治运动。1989年拉萨骚乱被视为该运动的一部分。
description.en: A political movement seeking to end Chinese rule over Tibet and establish it as a sovereign state. The 1989 Lhasa unrest is considered part of this movement.

description.zh-cn: 西藏自治区的首府，是1989年骚乱事件的主要发生地。
description.en: The capital of the Tibet Autonomous Region and the main location of the 1989 unrest.

description.zh-cn: 藏传佛教格鲁派的最高精神领袖，在此事件相关期间提出了“五点和平计划”并多次发表演讲。
description.en: The supreme spiritual leader of the Gelug school of Tibetan Buddhism, who proposed the 'Five Point Peace Plan' and gave several speeches during the period related to this event.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任民政部部长。在1989年拉萨骚乱期间是政府方的领导人物之一。阎明复任民政部副部长期间，多吉才让是其直接上级。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, former Minister of Civil Affairs. He was one of the leading figures on the government side during the 1989 Lhasa unrest. Doje Cering was Yan Mingfu's direct superior when Yan served as Vice Minister of Civil Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争初期中日双方在山西太原地区展开的一场大规模战役。
description.en: A major battle fought between Chinese and Japanese forces in the Taiyuan area of Shanxi during the early stage of the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 1937年9月发生于山西大同的战斗，此次战斗失利直接导致了平型关战役的组织。
description.en: A battle that took place in Datong, Shanxi in September 1937. The loss in this battle directly led to the organization of the Battle of Pingxingguan.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间，由国民政府划分的战区之一，主要负责山西等地的防御。在平型关战役中担任中方主力。
description.en: One of the war zones designated by the Nationalist Government during the Second Sino-Japanese War, primarily responsible for the defense of Shanxi and other areas. It served as the main Chinese force in the Battle of Pingxingguan.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国陆军的一支军队，是侵华战争和太平洋战争中的主力之一，参与了平型关战役。
description.en: An army of the Imperial Japanese Army, one of the main forces in the invasion of China and the Pacific War, which participated in the Battle of Pingxingguan.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军将领，于1937年9月20日接替东条英机任察哈尔派遣兵团司令官。
description.en: A general in the Imperial Japanese Army, who succeeded Hideki Tojo as the commander of the Chahar Expeditionary Force on September 20, 1937.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国陆军的一个精锐师团，在平型关战役中是日军的主力部队之一。
description.en: An elite division of the Imperial Japanese Army, which was one of the main Japanese forces in the Battle of Pingxingguan.

description.zh-cn: 由日本关东军派遣的部队，在平型关战役中负责从侧翼进攻，最终突破了国军防线。
description.en: A force dispatched from the Japanese Kwantung Army, responsible for flanking attacks during the Battle of Pingxingguan, which ultimately broke through the Chinese defensive lines.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军中将，时任第十七军军长兼第八十四师师长，在平型关战役初期于团城口一线与日军激战。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the Republic of China Army, who was the commander of the 17th Corps and the 84th Division. He fought fiercely with the Japanese at the Tuanchengkou line in the early stages of the Battle of Pingxingguan.

zh-cn: 学习无产阶级专政理论运动
en: Movement to Study the Theory of the Dictatorship of the Proletariat

description.zh-cn: 1975年在中国发起的一场政治运动。由毛泽东和周恩来在长沙决策期间的理论问题谈话直接引发。
description.en: A political movement launched in China in 1975. It was directly triggered by the conversation on theoretical issues between Mao Zedong and Zhou Enlai during the Changsha Decision period.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统罗斯福的特别助理。
description.en: Special assistant to U.S. President Roosevelt.

description.zh-cn: 英国外交官，开罗会议英国代表之一。
description.en: A British diplomat and one of the British representatives at the Cairo Conference.

description.zh-cn: 苏联与日本于1941年签署的中立条约，苏联于1945年8月8日对日宣战时撕毁了该条约。
description.en: A neutrality pact signed between the Soviet Union and Japan in 1941, which the Soviet Union violated when it declared war on Japan on August 8, 1945.

description.zh-cn: 日本于1945年9月2日在东京湾密苏里号战舰上签署的正式投降文件，标志着第二次世界大战的正式结束。
description.en: The formal surrender document signed by Japan aboard the USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay on September 2, 1945, marking the official end of World War II.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾海峡的群岛。《开罗宣言》规定应将其归还给中华民国。
description.en: An archipelago in the Taiwan Strait. The Cairo Declaration stipulated that it should be returned to the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 东北亚的历史地理区域。《开罗宣言》规定应将其归还给中华民国。
description.en: A historical geographical region in Northeast Asia. The Cairo Declaration stipulated that it should be returned to the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 东亚的半岛。《开罗宣言》规定应使其在适当时期内独立。
description.en: A peninsula in East Asia. The Cairo Declaration stipulated that it should become independent in due course.

description.zh-cn: 埃及首都，开罗会议的举办地。
description.en: The capital of Egypt, host city of the Cairo Conference.

description.zh-cn: 一次大规模游行，旨在抗议《逃犯条例》修订草案。
description.en: A large-scale march to protest against the extradition bill amendment.

zh-cn: 2019年反对逃犯条例修订草案占领行动

description.zh-cn: 示威者包围立法会大楼，旨在阻止《逃犯条例》修订草案二读。
description.en: Protesters surrounded the Legislative Council Complex to prevent the second reading of the extradition bill.

description.zh-cn: 英国保守党政治家，曾任肯辛顿国会议员、苏格兰事务大臣、国防大臣以及外交及联邦事务大臣。他尤其在香港主权移交前夕担任英国外交大臣期间，发挥了重要作用。
description.en: British Conservative politician who served as a Member of Parliament for Kensington, Secretary of State for Scotland, Secretary of State for Defence, and Secretary of State for Foreign and Commonwealth Affairs. He notably served as the UK Foreign Secretary on the eve of the handover of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 潘晓颖命案的嫌疑人。
description.en: The suspect in the Poon Hiu-wing murder case.

description.zh-cn: 香港民主党成员，时任立法会议员，在《逃犯条例》法案委员会中担任主持。
description.en: A member of the Democratic Party of Hong Kong and a then Legislative Council member who presided over the bills committee for the extradition bill.

description.zh-cn: 香港工会联合会议员，在《逃犯条例》法案委员会会议期间与涂谨申发生冲突。
description.en: A member of the Hong Kong Federation of Trade Unions who clashed with James To during a meeting of the extradition bill's bills committee.

description.zh-cn: 香港建制派立法会议员，被建制派推举主持《逃犯条例》法案委员会主席选举。
description.en: A pro-establishment Legislative Council member in Hong Kong, nominated by the pro-establishment camp to preside over the election of the chairman of the extradition bill's bills committee.

description.zh-cn: 时任中华人民共和国驻英国大使。
description.en: Then Ambassador of the People's Republic of China to the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 由世界七个主要发达国家组成的国际组织。
description.en: An international organization consisting of the world's seven largest advanced economies.

description.zh-cn: 香港商人，曾就《逃犯条例》修订草案申请司法覆核。
description.en: A Hong Kong businessman who once applied for a judicial review against the extradition bill amendment.

description.zh-cn: 指1980年代初期，因英国对香港的管治将于1997年届满而引起的政治议题，最终通过《中英联合声明》解决。
description.en: Refers to the political issue in the early 1980s arising from the impending expiration of British rule over Hong Kong in 1997, which was ultimately resolved by the Sino-British Joint Declaration.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，曾任香港行政局首席非官守议员。在中英谈判期间曾赴北京会见邓小平。
description.en: Hong Kong politician, former Senior Unofficial Member of the Executive Council of Hong Kong. He met with Deng Xiaoping in Beijing during the Sino-British negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治及商界人物，曾任香港行政局议员。在中英谈判期间曾赴北京会见邓小平。
description.en: Hong Kong politician and businesswoman, former member of the Executive Council of Hong Kong. She met with Deng Xiaoping in Beijing during the Sino-British negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 指2021年由中华人民共和国全国人民代表大会主导的对香港特别行政区选举制度的重大修改。
description.en: Refers to the major overhaul of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region's electoral system led by the National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China in 2021.

zh-cn: 英属香港政治制度改革
en: Political reform in colonial Hong Kong

zh-cn: 中共中央办公厅毛主席纪念堂管理局
en: Chairman Mao Memorial Hall Administration Bureau

description.zh-cn: 负责管理毛主席纪念堂的机构，隶属于中共中央办公厅。
description.en: The agency responsible for managing the Chairman Mao Memorial Hall, subordinate to the General Office of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国书法家，为毛主席纪念堂瞻仰厅书写了“伟大的领袖和导师毛泽东主席永垂不朽”的隶书。
description.en: A Chinese calligrapher who wrote the clerical script inscription "Eternal Glory to the Great Leader and Teacher Chairman Mao Zedong" in the Hall of Reverence of the Chairman Mao Memorial Hall.

description.zh-cn: 中国雕塑家，曾担任毛主席纪念堂雕塑创作的顾问。
description.en: A Chinese sculptor who served as a consultant for the creation of sculptures at the Chairman Mao Memorial Hall.

description.zh-cn: 中国雕塑家、美学家，曾担任毛主席纪念堂雕塑创作的顾问。
description.en: A Chinese sculptor and aesthetician who served as a consultant for the creation of sculptures at the Chairman Mao Memorial Hall.

description.zh-cn: 一所天主教大学，曾于1937年购买并持有恭王府。
description.en: A Catholic university that purchased and owned Prince Gong's Mansion in 1937.

description.zh-cn: 时任中国艺术研究院院长，通过谈判完成了恭王府腾退工作的最后一步。
description.en: Then-president of the Chinese National Academy of Arts, who completed the final step of the relocation work for Prince Gong's Mansion through negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 中国的全国性博物馆行业组织。
description.en: The national industry organization for museums in China.

description.zh-cn: 与恭王府合作举办“非遗演出季”的学术组织。
description.en: An academic organization that collaborates with Prince Gong's Mansion to hold the "Intangible Cultural Heritage Performance Season."

description.zh-cn: 香港的政治派系，属于非建制派。支持香港全面推行普遍选举，并对中国人权状况常有所批判。
description.en: A political alignment in Hong Kong, part of the non-pro-establishment camp. It supports the full implementation of universal suffrage in Hong Kong and is often critical of the human rights situation in China.

description.zh-cn: 香港警方国安处针对2020年香港立法会选举民主派初选参与者进行的大规模拘捕行动。
description.en: A large-scale arrest operation conducted by the National Security Department of the Hong Kong Police Force targeting participants in the 2020 pro-democracy primaries for the Legislative Council election.

description.zh-cn: 香港资深大律师，民主党创党主席，被誉为“香港民主之父”。
description.en: A Hong Kong senior counsel, founding chairman of the Democratic Party, known as the 'Father of Hong Kong Democracy'.

description.zh-cn: 香港民主派的主要政党之一，由香港民主同盟与汇点合并而成。
description.en: One of the main political parties of the pro-democracy camp in Hong Kong, formed by the merger of the United Democrats of Hong Kong and Meeting Point.

description.zh-cn: 香港首个政党，后与汇点合并为民主党。
description.en: The first political party in Hong Kong, later merged with Meeting Point to form the Democratic Party.

description.zh-cn: 香港八十年代的论政团体，后与香港民主同盟合并为民主党。
description.en: A political commentary group in Hong Kong in the 1980s, which later merged with the United Democrats of Hong Kong to form the Democratic Party.

description.zh-cn: 曾为香港民主派第二大政党，于2023年5月27日解散。
description.en: Formerly the second-largest party in the Hong Kong pro-democracy camp, it was dissolved on May 27, 2023.

description.zh-cn: 香港激进民主派政党。
description.en: A radical pro-democracy political party in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 由社民连和公民党发起的政治运动，透过辞去五个立法会地方选区议席引发补选，作为争取2012年双普选的“变相公投”。
description.en: A political movement initiated by the League of Social Democrats and the Civic Party, which triggered by-elections by resigning from seats in five geographical constituencies of the Legislative Council, serving as a 'de facto referendum' to fight for dual universal suffrage in 2012.

en: 2020 Hong Kong Legislative Council mass resignations

description.zh-cn: 在四名民主派议员被取消资格后，其余民主派立法会议员宣布集体辞职以示抗议的事件。
description.en: An event where the remaining pro-democracy Legislative Council members announced their collective resignation in protest after four of their colleagues were disqualified.

zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会关于香港特别行政区立法会议员资格问题的决定
en: NPCSC decision on Hong Kong LegCo members' qualification

description.zh-cn: 由全国人大常委会通过的决定，规定了香港立法会议员丧失资格的情形，直接导致四名民主派议员被取消资格。
description.en: A decision passed by the NPCSC that stipulated the circumstances under which Hong Kong Legislative Council members would be disqualified, directly leading to the disqualification of four pro-democracy legislators.

description.zh-cn: 香港会计师，前立法会议员（会计界），2020年被取消议员资格。
description.en: A Hong Kong accountant and former Legislative Council member (Accountancy), disqualified in 2020.

description.zh-cn: 香港大律师，公民党创党成员，前立法会议员（法律界），2020年被取消议员资格。
description.en: A Hong Kong barrister, founding member of the Civic Party, and former Legislative Council member (Legal), disqualified in 2020.

description.zh-cn: 香港医生，公民党成员，前立法会议员，2020年被取消议员资格。
description.en: A Hong Kong doctor, member of the Civic Party, and former Legislative Council member, disqualified in 2020.

description.zh-cn: 香港保安局局长，前警务处处长。
description.en: Secretary for Security of Hong Kong, former Commissioner of Police.

description.zh-cn: 香港资深大律师，公民党创党成员及末任主席。
description.en: A Hong Kong senior counsel, founding member and the last chairman of the Civic Party.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院 (第十四届全国人大期间)

description.zh-cn: 在第十四届全国人大期间的中华人民共和国中央人民政府。
南非议会的上议院。
description.en: The upper house of the Parliament of South Africa.

description.zh-cn: 南非议会的下议院。
description.en: The lower house of the Parliament of South Africa.

description.zh-cn: 南非最高宪法法院。
description.en: The supreme constitutional court of South Africa.

description.zh-cn: 南非共和国的前身，为大英帝国的自治领。
description.en: The predecessor to the Republic of South Africa, a dominion of the British Empire.

description.zh-cn: 英国国会通过的一项法案，旨在成立南非联邦。
description.en: An Act of the Parliament of the United Kingdom which created the Union of South Africa.

description.zh-cn: 1948年至1994年间在南非实行的一套种族隔离制度。
description.en: A system of institutionalised racial segregation that existed in South Africa from 1948 until the early 1990s.

description.zh-cn: 从1948年到1994年统治南非的政党，是种族隔离制度的主要推行者。
description.en: The governing party of South Africa from 1948 to 1994, and the primary implementer of the apartheid system.

description.zh-cn: 此次选举导致国民党上台执政，并开始推行种族隔离制度。
description.en: This election brought the National Party to power and marked the beginning of the implementation of apartheid.

description.zh-cn: 南非政治人物，国民党领导人，在总理任内开始推行种族隔离政策。
description.en: South African politician and leader of the National Party, who as Prime Minister began implementing apartheid policies.

description.zh-cn: 一项旨在向南非政府施压，以结束种族隔离制度的国际运动。
description.en: An international movement aimed at pressuring the South African government to end apartheid.

zh-cn: 弗雷德里克·威廉·戴克拉克

description.zh-cn: 南非政治人物，南非种族隔离时期最后一位国家总统，在其任内废除了种族隔离制度，并与曼德拉共同获得诺贝尔和平奖。
description.en: South African politician who served as the last State President of apartheid-era South Africa, oversaw the end of apartheid, and shared the Nobel Peace Prize with Nelson Mandela.

description.zh-cn: 南非的执政党，自1994年种族隔离制度结束后一直执政至今。
description.en: The governing political party of South Africa, in power since the end of apartheid in 1994.

zh-cn: 纳尔逊·罗利拉拉·曼德拉

description.zh-cn: 南非反种族隔离活动家、政治家，曾任南非总统、非洲人国民大会主席及不结盟运动秘书长，被广泛尊为“南非国父”。
description.en: A South African anti-apartheid activist and politician who served as President of South Africa, President of the African National Congress, and Secretary-General of the Non-Aligned Movement. Widely regarded as the 'Father of the Nation' in South Africa.

description.zh-cn: 南非历史上首次不分种族的民主选举，标志着种族隔离制度的结束。
description.en: The first non-racial democratic election in South Africa's history, marking the end of apartheid.

description.zh-cn: 17世纪在南非建立首个欧洲殖民地的荷兰特许公司。
description.en: The Dutch chartered company that established the first European colony in South Africa in the 17th century.

description.zh-cn: 荷兰东印度公司在好望角建立的殖民地。
description.en: A colony of the Dutch East India Company established at the Cape of Good Hope.

description.zh-cn: 荷兰殖民地官员，在好望角建立了欧洲人在南非的首个定居点。
description.en: A Dutch colonial administrator who established the first European settlement in South Africa at the Cape of Good Hope.

description.zh-cn: 英国在非洲南部的殖民地，后成为南非联邦的一部分。
description.en: A British colony in Southern Africa which later became part of the Union of South Africa.

description.zh-cn: 19世纪初期，布尔人（阿非利卡人）离开开普殖民地向内陆迁移的运动，并建立了几个独立的布尔共和国。
description.en: An eastward migration of Dutch-speaking settlers (Boers/Afrikaners) who travelled by wagon from the Cape Colony into the interior of modern South Africa from 1836 onwards, seeking to live beyond the Cape's British colonial administration.

description.zh-cn: 由布尔人建立的独立共和国，后在第二次布尔战争后被英国吞并。
description.en: An independent republic established by the Boers, later annexed by the British after the Second Boer War.

description.zh-cn: 由布尔人建立的独立共和国，后在第二次布尔战争后被英国吞并。
description.en: An independent republic established by the Boers, later annexed by the British after the Second Boer War.

description.zh-cn: 大英帝国与两个独立的布尔共和国之间的战争，最终导致英国吞并这两个共和国。
description.en: A war fought between the British Empire and two independent Boer republics, which resulted in the British annexation of the republics.

description.zh-cn: 南非圣公会大主教和社会权利活动家，因反对种族隔离而闻名。
description.en: South African Anglican cleric and social rights activist, known for his opposition to apartheid.

description.zh-cn: 一个用于描述后种族隔离时期南非的术语，象征其多文化多样性与团结。
description.en: A term used to describe post-apartheid South Africa, symbolizing its multicultural diversity and unity.

description.zh-cn: 南非政治人物，曾于2009年至2018年担任南非总统。
description.en: South African politician who served as the President of South Africa from 2009 to 2018.

description.zh-cn: 指国民政府在1927年至1937年定都南京期间，中国在政治、经济、文化等方面取得一定发展的时期。
description.en: Refers to the period from 1927 to 1937 when the Nationalist Government was based in Nanjing, a time of relative development in China's politics, economy, and culture.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国民革命军将领，于1945年光复北平。
description.en: A general of the National Revolutionary Army of the Republic of China who recovered Peiping in 1945.

zh-cn: 关于中华人民共和国国都、纪年、国歌、国旗的决议
en: Resolution on the Capital, Calendar, National Anthem, and National Flag of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 由中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议通过，正式将北平改名为北京并定为中华人民共和国首都。
description.en: Passed by the First Plenary Session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, officially renaming Peiping to Beijing and establishing it as the capital of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任北平特别市市长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China who served as the mayor of Peiping Special Municipality.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事及政治人物，曾任北平特别市市长。
description.en: A military and political figure of the Republic of China who served as the mayor of Peiping Special Municipality.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任北平市市长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China who served as the mayor of Peiping.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任北平市市长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China who served as the mayor of Peiping.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事及政治人物，曾任北平市市长。
description.en: A military and political figure of the Republic of China who served as the mayor of Peiping.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事及政治人物，曾任北平市市长。
description.en: A military and political figure of the Republic of China who served as the mayor of Peiping.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任北平市市长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China who served as the mayor of Peiping.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事人物，最后一任中华民国北平市市长。
description.en: A military figure of the Republic of China and the last mayor of Peiping under the ROC.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军北京市军事管制委员会
en: Peiping Municipal Military Control Committee of the People's Liberation Army

description.zh-cn: 在北平和平解放后，由中国人民解放军成立的负责接管和管理北平市的临时权力机构。
description.en: A provisional authority established by the People's Liberation Army to take over and administer Peiping after its peaceful liberation.

description.zh-cn: 中国工商银行股份有限公司现任董事长。
description.en: Current Chairman of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited.

description.zh-cn: 中国工商银行股份有限公司现任行长。
description.en: Current President of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited.

description.zh-cn: 中国工商银行的主要股东之一。
description.en: One of the major shareholders of ICBC.

description.zh-cn: 中国工商银行的上市地点之一，其代理人公司也是工行的主要股东之一。
description.en: One of the stock exchanges where ICBC is listed. Its nominee company is also a major shareholder of ICBC.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国工商银行行长及董事长，并任中国工商银行（亚洲）有限公司主席。
description.en: Former President and Chairman of ICBC; also Chairman of Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (Asia) Limited.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国工商银行行长、副董事长。
description.en: Former President and Vice Chairman of ICBC.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国工商银行行长及董事长，也曾任中国证券监督管理委员会主席。
description.en: Chinese politician, former President and Chairman of ICBC, and former Chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国工商银行行长。
description.en: Former President of ICBC.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国工商银行董事长。
description.en: Former Chairman of ICBC.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国工商银行行长。
description.en: Former President of ICBC.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国工商银行行长。
description.en: Former President of ICBC.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国工商银行行长。
description.en: Former President of ICBC.

description.zh-cn: 香港前财政司司长，曾任中国工商银行独立董事。
description.en: Former Financial Secretary of Hong Kong, served as an independent director of ICBC.

description.zh-cn: 高盛公司前总裁，曾任中国工商银行独立董事。
description.en: Former president of Goldman Sachs, served as an independent director of ICBC.

description.zh-cn: 美国伯克利加州大学经济系教授，曾任中国工商银行独立董事。
description.en: Professor of Economics at the University of California, Berkeley, served as an independent director of ICBC.

description.zh-cn: 香港股市指数编制公司，于2007年将工商银行纳入恒生指数成份股。
description.en: A Hong Kong stock market index compiler, which included ICBC as a constituent stock of the Hang Seng Index in 2007.

en: The Standard Bank of South Africa

description.zh-cn: 南非最大的银行之一，中国工商银行是其第一大股东。
description.en: One of the largest banks in South Africa, of which ICBC is the largest shareholder.

description.zh-cn: 中国工商银行的下属机构，是中国大陆首家银行背景的金融租赁公司。
description.en: A subsidiary of ICBC, it is the first bank-backed financial leasing company in mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 香港的银行，曾将其加拿大和美国子公司部分股权出售给中国工商银行。
description.en: A Hong Kong-based bank that sold stakes in its Canadian and US subsidiaries to ICBC.

en: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (Canada)

description.zh-cn: 中国工商银行的加拿大子公司，其前身为加拿大东亚银行。
description.en: The Canadian subsidiary of ICBC, formerly the Bank of East Asia (Canada).

description.zh-cn: 中国工商银行的土耳其子公司，其前身为Tekstilbank。
description.en: The Turkish subsidiary of ICBC, formerly Tekstilbank.

description.zh-cn: 中国工商银行的下属基金管理公司。
description.en: A fund management subsidiary of ICBC.

zh-cn: 中国工商银行（亚洲）有限公司
en: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (Asia)
Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (Asia) Limited

description.zh-cn: 中国工商银行在海外的业务旗舰，主要业务是提供银行、财务及其他相关服务。其前身为友联银行。
description.en: The overseas business flagship of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, mainly providing banking, financial, and other related services. Its predecessor was Union Bank of Hong Kong.

en: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (Macau)

description.zh-cn: 中国工商银行在澳门地区的下属机构。
description.en: A subsidiary of ICBC in Macau.

description.zh-cn: 日本君主的称号，为日本国及国民团结的象征，是名义上的国家元首。
description.en: The title of the monarch of Japan, who is the symbol of the State and of the unity of the people, and is the ceremonial head of state.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治人物，根据文书记载为时任内阁总理大臣。
description.en: A Japanese politician, serving as the Prime Minister according to the document.

description.zh-cn: 日本古代一场重要的政治和社会改革，旨在建立一个以天皇为中心的中央集权国家，仿效了中国隋唐制度。
description.en: A significant political and social reform in ancient Japan aimed at establishing a centralized state with the Emperor at its core, modeled after the Sui and Tang dynasties of China.

description.zh-cn: 日本在第二次世界大战后成立的实际上的国家武装力量，根据宪法第九条，其任务是维持日本的自我防卫能力。
description.en: The de facto armed forces of Japan established after World War II. According to Article 9 of the Constitution, its mission is to maintain Japan's self-defense capabilities.

description.zh-cn: 日本的国家行政机关，由内阁总理大臣领导。
description.en: The executive branch of the government of Japan, led by the Prime Minister.

en: Aftermath of the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami

description.zh-cn: 2011年发生在日本东北部太平洋海域的强烈地震，引发了大规模海啸并导致了福岛第一核电站事故。
description.en: A powerful earthquake that occurred off the Pacific coast of Tōhoku in 2011, triggering a massive tsunami and leading to the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster.

description.zh-cn: 由东日本大震灾引发的严重核事故。
description.en: A severe nuclear accident triggered by the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami.

description.zh-cn: 源于西亚的一神论宗教，基督宗教的思想和信仰实践多源自于此。
description.en: A monotheistic religion originating in Western Asia, from which much of Christian thought and practice is derived.

description.zh-cn: 古代欧洲的帝国，早期曾迫害基督徒，后将基督教定为国教。
description.en: An ancient European empire that initially persecuted Christians but later established Christianity as the state religion.

description.zh-cn: 罗马皇帝，于公元313年发布《米兰敕令》，结束了对基督徒的迫害。
description.en: Roman Emperor who issued the Edict of Milan in 313 AD, ending the persecution of Christians.

description.zh-cn: 由罗马皇帝君士坦丁一世于公元313年发布的敕令，标志着罗马帝国对基督教迫害的结束。
description.en: An edict issued by Roman Emperor Constantine I in 313 AD, marking the end of the persecution of Christianity in the Roman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 罗马皇帝，于公元382年左右通过《萨洛尼卡敕令》将基督教定为罗马帝国国教。
description.en: Roman Emperor who made Christianity the state religion of the Roman Empire around 382 AD with the Edict of Thessalonica.

description.zh-cn: 由罗马皇帝狄奥多西一世发布的敕令，将基督教定为罗马帝国国教。
description.en: An edict issued by Roman Emperor Theodosius I, establishing Christianity as the state religion of the Roman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 发生于1054年的教会分裂事件，导致基督教分裂为西方的天主教会和东方的东正教会。
description.en: The church division that occurred in 1054, leading to the split of Christianity into the Western Catholic Church and the Eastern Orthodox Church.

description.zh-cn: 基督教的主要分支之一，由东西教会大分裂产生，以君士坦丁堡牧首为名义领袖。
description.en: One of the major branches of Christianity, which emerged from the East-West Schism, with the Ecumenical Patriarch of Constantinople as its nominal leader.

description.zh-cn: 基督教的主要分支之一，产生于16世纪的宗教改革运动。
description.en: One of the major branches of Christianity, which emerged from the 16th-century Protestant Reformation.

description.zh-cn: 16世纪欧洲宗教改革的代表人物之一。
description.en: One of the representative figures of the 16th-century European Protestant Reformation.

description.zh-cn: 16世纪欧洲宗教改革的代表人物之一。
description.en: One of the representative figures of the 16th-century European Protestant Reformation.

description.zh-cn: 早期基督教会的关键人物，原为迫害基督徒的犹太教徒，后转变为基督徒，成为向非犹太人传播基督教的主要传教士，并撰写了新约中的多卷书信。
description.en: A key figure in the early Christian church. Originally a Jew who persecuted Christians, he converted to Christianity and became the primary missionary for spreading the faith to non-Jews, authoring several epistles in the New Testament.
