description.zh-cn: 一家已解散的计算机公司，其联合创始人安迪·贝托尔斯海姆是Google的早期投资者。
description.en: A defunct computer company whose co-founder, Andy Bechtolsheim, was an early investor in Google.

description.zh-cn: 一项由美国国家安全局进行的数据监控计划，据报道Google曾参与其中。
description.en: A data surveillance program conducted by the U.S. National Security Agency, in which Google was reportedly involved.

description.zh-cn: 新建陆军（北洋军）的原名。
description.en: The original name of the Newly Created Army (Beiyang Army).

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事人物，北洋军阀直系的代表人物。
description.en: A military figure of the Republic of China, representative of the Zhili clique of the Beiyang Warlords.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事人物，北洋军阀奉系的代表人物。
description.en: A military figure of the Republic of China, representative of the Fengtian clique of the Beiyang Warlords.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事人物，粤系军阀的代表人物。
description.en: A military figure of the Republic of China, representative of the Yue clique.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的省级行政区，是张家祥的籍贯地及其在全国人民代表大会中所代表的地区。
description.en: A province-level administrative division of the People's Republic of China. It is Zhang Jiaxiang's ancestral home and the region he represents in the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的一个省份。
description.en: A province of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的省份。
description.en: A province of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国法学家、翻译家，在《申报》发表时评《北洋正统》表达了对北洋军阀的唾弃。
description.en: A Chinese jurist and translator who published a commentary titled 'Beiyang Orthodoxy' in Shen Bao, expressing disdain for the Beiyang warlords.

zh-cn: 维托里奥·埃马努埃莱三世

description.zh-cn: 意大利王国国王，在向罗马进军后任命墨索里尼为首相，后于1943年将其解职并逮捕。
description.en: King of Italy who appointed Mussolini as Prime Minister after the March on Rome, and later dismissed and arrested him in 1943.

description.zh-cn: 意大利政治家，在墨索里尼通过向罗马进军上台前的最后一任意大利首相。
description.en: Italian politician, he was the last Prime Minister of Italy before the dictatorship of Benito Mussolini.

description.zh-cn: 意大利陆军元帅和政治家，在1943年墨索里尼被捕后接替他出任总理。
description.en: Italian general and statesman who became Prime Minister after Mussolini's arrest in 1943.

description.zh-cn: 贝尼托·墨索里尼的情妇，1945年与墨索里尼一同被游击队俘虏并处决。
description.en: Benito Mussolini's mistress, who was captured and executed alongside him by partisans in 1945.

description.zh-cn: 意大利的一个左翼政党，墨索里尼早年曾是其党员，后因主战立场被开除。
description.en: A left-wing political party in Italy of which Mussolini was an early member before being expelled for his pro-war stance.

description.zh-cn: 由墨索里尼于1921年建立的政党，是法西斯意大利的执政党。
description.en: The political party founded by Mussolini in 1921, which ruled Fascist Italy.

description.zh-cn: 在墨索里尼被希特勒救出后，于意大利社会共和国时期创建的法西斯政党。
description.en: The fascist party created during the Italian Social Republic period after Mussolini was rescued by Hitler.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战末期由墨索里尼在希特勒协助下于意大利北部建立的德国傀儡政权。
description.en: A German puppet state established by Mussolini in northern Italy with Hitler's assistance during the later part of World War II.

description.zh-cn: 一场由墨索里尼领导的政变，导致国家法西斯党在意大利取得政权。
description.en: A coup d'état led by Mussolini that resulted in the National Fascist Party's seizure of power in Italy.

zh-cn: 第二次义大利—衣索比亚战争

description.zh-cn: 法西斯意大利发动的殖民战争，旨在吞并埃塞俄比亚帝国。
description.en: A colonial war initiated by Fascist Italy with the aim of annexing the Ethiopian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 位于现今埃塞俄比亚和厄立特里亚地区的帝国，在第二次意阿战争中被意大利侵占。
description.en: An empire in the area of modern-day Ethiopia and Eritrea, invaded and occupied by Italy in the Second Italo-Ethiopian War.

description.zh-cn: 国家法西斯党的最高机关，于1943年7月通过对墨索里尼的不信任动议，导致其下台。
description.en: The main body of Mussolini's Fascist government, which passed a vote of no confidence in him in July 1943, leading to his ousting.

en: Fall of the Fascist regime in Italy

description.zh-cn: 由迪诺·格兰迪在法西斯大委员会会议上提出的对墨索里尼的不信任动议。
description.en: A motion of no confidence against Mussolini presented by Dino Grandi at the meeting of the Grand Council of Fascism.

description.zh-cn: 德国特种部队执行的一次军事营救行动，将在大萨索山被软禁的墨索里尼成功救出。
description.en: A military rescue operation conducted by German special forces to free the imprisoned Mussolini from the Gran Sasso.

description.zh-cn: 由意大利共产党领导的游击队组织，其成员在1945年俘虏并处决了墨索里尼。
description.en: Partisan units organized by the Italian Communist Party, whose members captured and executed Mussolini in 1945.

description.zh-cn: 墨索里尼和他的情人克拉拉·贝塔西被意大利共产党游击队员枪决的事件。
description.en: The event in which Mussolini and his mistress Clara Petacci were summarily executed by Italian communist partisans.

description.zh-cn: 贝尼托·墨索里尼的第一任妻子。
description.en: Benito Mussolini's first wife.

description.zh-cn: 贝尼托·墨索里尼的第二任妻子。
description.en: Benito Mussolini's second wife.

description.zh-cn: 曹操的妾室，曹昂、曹铄和清河公主的生母，因病早逝。
description.en: A concubine of Cao Cao, and the birth mother of Cao Ang, Cao Shuo, and Princess Qinghe. She died early from illness.

description.zh-cn: 曹操的原配正室，曹昂的养母。因曹昂之死而与曹操反目并最终决裂。
description.en: Cao Cao's first official wife and Cao Ang's adoptive mother. She turned against and eventually broke with Cao Cao over the death of Cao Ang.

en: War between Cao Cao and Zhang Xiu

description.zh-cn: 建安二年（197年），曹操征讨张绣时发生的战役。张绣先降后叛，曹操军大败，长子曹昂、侄子曹安民、大将典韦在此战中阵亡。
description.en: A battle that took place in 197 AD during Cao Cao's campaign against Zhang Xiu. Zhang Xiu surrendered and then rebelled, leading to a major defeat for Cao Cao's army, in which his eldest son Cao Ang, his nephew Cao Anmin, and general Dian Wei were killed.

description.zh-cn: 曹操的近身侍卫，为保护曹操在宛城之战中负责断后，力战而死。
description.en: Cao Cao's personal bodyguard who was killed in the Battle of Wancheng while covering the rear to protect Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 曹操的侄子，在宛城之战中与曹昂、典韦一同战死。
description.en: Cao Cao's nephew who was killed alongside Cao Ang and Dian Wei in the Battle of Wancheng.

description.zh-cn: 曹昂的同母妹，曹操的长女。
description.en: The full younger sister of Cao Ang and the eldest daughter of Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 曹均之子，后被过继给伯父曹昂作为继子，以承袭其爵位。
description.en: The son of Cao Jun, who was later adopted by his uncle Cao Ang as an heir to inherit his title.

description.zh-cn: 曹操之子，曹昂的异母弟，曹琬的生父。
description.en: A son of Cao Cao, half-brother of Cao Ang, and the biological father of Cao Wan.

description.zh-cn: 朱德的独子。
description.en: The only son of Zhu De.

description.zh-cn: 颜回的父亲。
description.en: Father of Yan Hui.

description.zh-cn: 中国山东省济宁市下辖的市辖区，古代为鲁国属地。
description.en: A district of Jining, Shandong, China. It was part of the State of Lu in ancient times.

description.zh-cn: 孔子门下在德行、言语、政事、文学四方面最杰出的十位弟子的合称。
description.en: A collective term for the ten most outstanding disciples of Confucius in the four areas of virtuous conduct, speech, governance, and literature.

description.zh-cn: 孔子门下最贤能的七十二位弟子的合称。
description.en: A collective term for the seventy-two most virtuous and capable disciples of Confucius.

description.zh-cn: 元朝第八位皇帝。
description.en: The eighth emperor of the Yuan dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 孔子弟子，儒家主要代表人物之一。
description.en: A disciple of Confucius and one of the main representatives of Confucianism.

description.zh-cn: 德国思想家卡尔·马克思在1844年撰写的一系列重要笔记，是其最早期的关于哲学和经济学的写作之一。其中最著名的内容是关于现代工业社会中工人异化的论点。
description.en: A series of important notes written by the German thinker Karl Marx in 1844, representing his earliest writings on philosophy and economics. Its most famous content is the argument about the alienation of wage workers in modern industrial society.

description.zh-cn: 俄国马克思主义理论家，于1927年整理并发表了《1844年经济学哲学手稿》的部分内容。
description.en: A Russian Marxist theorist who compiled and published parts of the 'Economic and Philosophic Manuscripts of 1844' in 1927.

description.zh-cn: 现代社会主义思想的早期流派，主要在19世纪上半叶的法国发展。
description.en: An early current of modern socialist thought, primarily developed in France during the first half of the 19th century.

description.zh-cn: 古希腊哲学家，柏拉图的学生，亚历山大大帝的老师。其思想被马克思在《1844年经济学哲学手稿》中引用和发展。
description.en: Ancient Greek philosopher, student of Plato, and teacher of Alexander the Great, whose ideas were cited and developed by Marx in the 'Economic and Philosophic Manuscripts of 1844'.

description.zh-cn: 马克思在《1844年经济学哲学手稿》中提出的核心理论，描述了工人在资本主义制度下与他们的劳动产品、劳动过程、自身以及他人相分离的状态。
description.en: A core theory proposed by Marx in the 'Economic and Philosophic Manuscripts of 1844', describing the separation of workers from their product, the labor process, their own nature, and other people under capitalism.

description.zh-cn: 蒋孝武的第二任妻子。
description.en: Second wife of Chiang Hsiao-wu.

description.zh-cn: 蒋孝武与汪长诗之子。
description.en: Son of Chiang Hsiao-wu and Wang Chang-shih.

description.zh-cn: 台湾著名的国际性黑社会组织。
description.en: A prominent international organized crime group based in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾女歌星，曾与蒋孝武有过一段恋情。
description.en: A Taiwanese female singer who once had a romantic relationship with Chiang Hsiao-wu.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国大陆时期的直辖市，战时首都，蒋孝武的出生地。
description.en: A direct-controlled municipality during the mainland period of the Republic of China, the wartime capital, and the birthplace of Chiang Hsiao-wu.

description.zh-cn: 蒋孝武曾担任其第一任董事长的公司。
description.en: A company where Chiang Hsiao-wu served as the first chairman.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的广播事业机构，蒋孝武曾任其总经理。
description.en: A broadcasting company in the Republic of China, where Chiang Hsiao-wu once served as general manager.

zh-cn: 中华民国驻日本大使列表

description.zh-cn: 中华民国在日本的外交职务。
description.en: A diplomatic position of the Republic of China in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国第8任副总统，曾出席蒋孝武丧礼。
description.en: The 8th Vice President of the Republic of China, who attended Chiang Hsiao-wu's funeral.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚的前身，于1957年8月31日从英国独立。
description.en: Predecessor to Malaysia, gained independence from the United Kingdom on 31 August 1957.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚的邦，位于婆罗洲北部，旧称北婆罗洲。
description.en: A state of Malaysia located on the northern portion of Borneo, formerly known as North Borneo.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚的邦，位于婆罗洲。
description.en: A state of Malaysia on the island of Borneo.

description.zh-cn: 一份合并北婆罗洲、砂拉越和新加坡与马来亚联合邦的文件，由此建立了马来西亚联邦。
description.en: The agreement which combined North Borneo, Sarawak, and Singapore with the existing states of the Federation of Malaya, the resulting union being named Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚第十七任最高元首。
description.en: The 17th Yang di-Pertuan Agong of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚政府与新加坡政府签订的协议，确认新加坡从马来西亚联邦独立。
description.en: The agreement between the Government of Malaysia and the Government of Singapore that confirmed Singapore's independence from the Federation of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 建立了马六甲苏丹王朝的王子。
description.en: The prince who founded the Malacca Sultanate.

description.zh-cn: 被普遍认定为马来半岛的第一个独立国家。
description.en: Widely considered to be the first independent state on the Malay Peninsula.

description.zh-cn: 由马六甲末代苏丹之子建立的王朝，曾是对抗葡萄牙的主要势力之一。
description.en: A sultanate founded by the son of the last Sultan of Malacca, which was one of the main forces opposing the Portuguese.

description.zh-cn: 在马来亚从事反殖民武装斗争的政党。
description.en: A political party that engaged in an anti-colonial armed struggle in Malaya.

description.zh-cn: 马来亚共产党游击队与英联邦军队之间的反游击队战争时期。
description.en: A period of anti-guerrilla warfare between the Malayan Communist Party's guerrillas and Commonwealth forces.

description.zh-cn: 印度尼西亚第一任总统，曾反对马来西亚的成立。
description.en: The first President of Indonesia, who opposed the formation of Malaysia.

zh-cn: 印度尼西亚—马来西亚对抗

description.zh-cn: 印度尼西亚因反对马来西亚成立而引发的武装冲突。
description.en: An armed conflict stemming from Indonesia's opposition to the formation of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 1969年大选后在吉隆坡发生的严重种族冲突事件。
description.en: A serious racial riot incident that occurred in Kuala Lumpur after the 1969 general election.

description.zh-cn: 一项旨在通过配额制提高土著经济权益比例的社会经济重组政策。
description.en: A socio-economic restructuring policy aimed at increasing the economic equity of the Bumiputera through a quota system.

zh-cn: 一个马来西亚发展有限公司

description.zh-cn: 由时任首相纳吉设立的战略发展公司，后卷入贪腐丑闻。
description.en: A strategic development company established by then-Prime Minister Najib Razak, which later became embroiled in a corruption scandal.

description.zh-cn: 由荷兰、阿鲁巴、库拉索和荷属圣马丁组成的君主立宪制国家。
description.en: A constitutional monarchy composed of the Netherlands, Aruba, Curaçao, and Sint Maarten.

description.zh-cn: 现任荷兰国王。
description.en: The current King of the Netherlands.

description.zh-cn: 现任荷兰首相。
description.en: The current Prime Minister of the Netherlands.

description.zh-cn: 荷兰各省反抗西班牙统治的独立战争。
description.en: The war of independence fought by the Dutch provinces against Spanish rule.

description.zh-cn: 由荷兰北方七省组成的联盟，被视为现代荷兰的开端。
description.en: A union of the northern seven provinces of the Netherlands, considered the beginning of the modern Netherlands.

description.zh-cn: 由荷兰北方七省组成的联邦共和国，是现代荷兰的前身。
description.en: A federal republic of the northern seven provinces of the Netherlands, the predecessor of the modern Netherlands.

description.zh-cn: 结束八十年战争的条约，西班牙正式承认尼德兰七省共和国的独立。
description.en: The treaty that ended the Eighty Years' War, in which Spain formally recognized the independence of the Dutch Republic.

description.zh-cn: 在法国占领荷兰后建立的傀儡共和国。
description.en: A client republic established after the French occupation of the Netherlands.

description.zh-cn: 南美洲国家，曾为荷兰殖民地，后于1975年获荷兰承认独立。
description.en: A South American country, formerly a Dutch colony, whose independence was recognized by the Netherlands in 1975.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，2021年12月接替胡锡进担任《环球时报》党委书记兼社长。
description.en: A Chinese political figure who succeeded Hu Xijin as the Party Secretary and President of Global Times in December 2021.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任人民日报社国际部副主任，2021年12月接替胡锡进担任《环球时报》总编辑。
description.en: A Chinese political figure, formerly the deputy director of the International Department of the People's Daily, who succeeded Hu Xijin as editor-in-chief of Global Times in December 2021.

description.zh-cn: 中国官方媒体《人民日报》的在线平台，是《穹顶之下》的首播平台之一，后应宣传部门要求将其下架。
description.en: The online platform of the official Chinese newspaper People's Daily. It was one of the initial distributors of 'Under the Dome' before being ordered to remove it.

description.zh-cn: 中国政法大学资本金融研究院院长。
description.en: Dean of the Capital Finance Institute at the China University of Political Science and Law.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治家，曾任美国众议院议长。魏京生曾在其2009年访华前与其会面，并于2023年向其颁发人权奖项。
description.en: An American politician who served as the Speaker of the United States House of Representatives. Wei Jingsheng met with her before her 2009 visit to China and presented her with a human rights award in 2023.

description.zh-cn: 中国网络评论员，红三代。
description.en: A Chinese internet commentator and a third-generation red princeling.

en: Jiangxi Industry Polytechnic College food safety incident

description.zh-cn: 前中国驻法大使、前外交学院院长。
description.en: Former Chinese Ambassador to France and former President of the China Foreign Affairs University.

description.zh-cn: 中国电影导演。
description.en: A Chinese film director.

description.zh-cn: 由贾樟柯执导的电影。
description.en: A film directed by Jia Zhangke.

description.zh-cn: 复旦大学国际政治系副教授。
description.en: Associate professor in the Department of International Politics at Fudan University.

description.zh-cn: 香港中文大学副教授。
description.en: Associate Professor at The Chinese University of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 后唐开国君主，李克用之子。他灭亡后梁，建立了后唐。
description.en: Founding emperor of the Later Tang, son of Li Keyong. He destroyed the Later Liang and established the Later Tang.

description.zh-cn: 后晋开国君主。原为后唐河东节度使，后借契丹兵力推翻后唐，建立后晋，并割让燕云十六州。
description.en: Founding emperor of the Later Jin. Originally the military governor of Hedong under the Later Tang, he overthrew the Later Tang with Khitan military aid, established the Later Jin, and ceded the Sixteen Prefectures.

description.zh-cn: 后汉开国君主。原为后晋河东节度使，在契丹灭后晋后于太原称帝，收复中原。
description.en: Founding emperor of the Later Han. Originally the military governor of Hedong under the Later Jin, he proclaimed himself emperor in Taiyuan after the Khitans destroyed the Later Jin and subsequently recovered the Central Plains.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝中后期至五代时期，地方节度使拥兵自重，不受中央控制的政治局面。
description.en: A political situation from the mid-late Tang Dynasty to the Five Dynasties period where regional military governors (jiedushi) held significant power and were not controlled by the central government.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝末年沙陀族军事将领，晋王，后唐庄宗李存勗之父，为后唐的建立奠定了基础。
description.en: A Shatuo military leader in the late Tang dynasty, Prince of Jin, and father of Emperor Zhuangzong of Later Tang (Li Cunxu). He laid the foundation for the establishment of the Later Tang.

description.zh-cn: 南唐开国君主。原为吴国权臣徐温的养子，后篡夺吴国政权，建立南唐。
description.en: Founding emperor of the Southern Tang. He was the adopted son of Xu Wen, the powerful minister of the Wu state, and later usurped the Wu throne to establish the Southern Tang.

description.zh-cn: 后蜀开国君主。原为后唐的西川节度使，后在后唐内乱时自立为帝。
description.en: Founding emperor of the Later Shu. He was originally the military governor of Xichuan under the Later Tang and later declared himself emperor during the internal turmoil of the Later Tang.

description.zh-cn: 契丹国（辽朝）第二位皇帝。他接受石敬瑭的请求，助其灭亡后唐，并获得燕云十六州。后又南下灭亡后晋。
description.en: The second emperor of the Khitan Empire (Liao dynasty). He accepted Shi Jingtang's request for aid, helped destroy the Later Tang, and acquired the Sixteen Prefectures. He later marched south and destroyed the Later Jin.

description.zh-cn: 位于今天津、北京及河北、山西北部的十六个州，在五代时期被后晋割让给契丹，成为此后数个世纪中原王朝的国防隐患。
description.en: Sixteen prefectures located in modern-day Tianjin, Beijing, and northern Hebei and Shanxi. They were ceded to the Khitans by the Later Jin during the Five Dynasties period, becoming a major national security vulnerability for the Central Plains dynasties for centuries.

description.zh-cn: 后周第二位皇帝，郭威的养子，被誉为五代第一明君。他在位期间，对内改革，对外扩张，为北宋的统一奠定了基础。
description.en: The second emperor of the Later Zhou and the adopted son of Guo Wei. He is regarded as the most capable ruler of the Five Dynasties period. During his reign, he carried out internal reforms and external expansion, laying the foundation for the unification by the Northern Song.

description.zh-cn: 吴国的建立者。唐末淮南节度使，在乱世中发展割据势力，奠定了吴国的基础。
description.en: The founder of the Wu state. As the military governor of Huainan in the late Tang dynasty, he developed a regional power base amidst the chaos, laying the foundation for the Wu state.

description.zh-cn: 前蜀开国君主。唐末将领，后割据蜀地，于907年称帝。
description.en: Founding emperor of Former Shu. A general in the late Tang dynasty who later established control over the Shu region and declared himself emperor in 907.

description.zh-cn: 马楚的建立者。唐末将领，割据湖南，后被后梁封为楚王。
description.en: Founder of the Ma Chu state. A general in the late Tang dynasty who established control over Hunan and was later enfeoffed as the Prince of Chu by the Later Liang.

description.zh-cn: 吴越国的建立者。唐末镇海军节度使，后被后梁封为吴越王。
description.en: Founder of the Wuyue kingdom. He was the military governor of Zhenhai Circuit in the late Tang dynasty and was later enfeoffed as the Prince of Wuyue by the Later Liang.

description.zh-cn: 荆南（南平）的建立者。原为后梁将领，后被封为荆南节度使，于924年被后唐封为南平王。
description.en: Founder of Jingnan (Nanping). Originally a general of the Later Liang, he was made the military governor of Jingnan and was enfeoffed as the Prince of Nanping by the Later Tang in 924.

description.zh-cn: 北汉的建立者。后汉高祖刘知远之弟，在后周代汉后于太原自立为帝，延续后汉国祚，并依附辽朝。
description.en: Founder of Northern Han. He was the younger brother of Emperor Gaozu of Later Han (Liu Zhiyuan). After the Later Zhou replaced the Later Han, he established himself as emperor in Taiyuan, continuing the Later Han's imperial line and aligning with the Liao dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国军将领，时任徐州剿匪总司令部总司令。
description.en: A general of the National Revolutionary Army, serving as the commander-in-chief of the Xuzhou Bandit Suppression Headquarters.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国军将领，其部队在淮海战役中被消灭。
description.en: A general of the National Revolutionary Army whose troops were eliminated in the Huaihai Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国军将领，其部队在淮海战役中被消灭。
description.en: A general of the National Revolutionary Army whose troops were eliminated in the Huaihai Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国军将领，其部队在平津战役中被消灭。
description.en: A general of the National Revolutionary Army whose troops were eliminated in the Pingjin Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国防科工委办公室副主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Deputy Director of the Office of the Commission for Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 张爱萍长子，曾任中国人民解放军第二炮兵部队副司令员，中将军衔。
description.en: Eldest son of Zhang Aiping, former Deputy Commander of the PLA Second Artillery Force, with the rank of Lieutenant General.

description.zh-cn: 张爱萍之女。
description.en: Daughter of Zhang Aiping.

description.zh-cn: 张爱萍胞弟，曾任中华人民共和国外交部副部长、最高人民检察院副检察长。
description.en: Younger brother of Zhang Aiping, former Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs and Deputy Procurator-General of the Supreme People's Procuratorate of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 张爱萍三子，原国防工办所属新时代公司副总经理，大校军衔。
description.en: Third son of Zhang Aiping, former deputy general manager of New Era Company under the National Defense Industry Office, with the rank of Senior Colonel.

description.zh-cn: 德意志帝国地理学家，于1877年首次提出“丝绸之路”的概念。
description.en: A German geographer who first coined the term 'Silk Road' in 1877.

description.zh-cn: 东汉时期的将领和外交家，重新打通了因匈奴问题而一度荒废的丝绸之路。
description.en: A general and diplomat of the Eastern Han Dynasty who reopened the Silk Road after it had been long neglected.

description.zh-cn: 古代中国与外国交通贸易和文化交往的海上通道，在宋元以后重要性日增，逐渐取代了陆上丝路的主力地位。
description.en: The maritime route for trade and cultural exchange between ancient China and foreign countries. Its importance grew after the Song and Yuan dynasties, gradually replacing the Land Silk Road as the main trade artery.

description.zh-cn: 751年唐朝与阿拔斯王朝在中亚发生的战役，此战成为造纸术西传的关键事件。
description.en: A battle in 751 between the Tang Dynasty and the Abbasid Caliphate in Central Asia, which became a key event for the westward transmission of papermaking technology.

description.zh-cn: 古代中国的四大发明之一，指制造纸张的技术。该技术通过丝绸之路传播至全世界。
description.en: One of the Four Great Inventions of ancient China, referring to the technology of manufacturing paper. This technology spread worldwide via the Silk Road.

en: Church of the East in China

description.zh-cn: 基督教聂斯脱里派的一个分支，在唐朝时期沿丝绸之路传入中国。
description.en: A branch of Christianity, the Church of the East (Nestorianism), which was introduced to China along the Silk Road during the Tang Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 唐武宗时期推行的打击佛教及其他外来宗教的政策运动，导致景教等宗教在中国走向衰落。
description.en: A policy campaign during the reign of Emperor Wuzong of Tang to suppress Buddhism and other foreign religions, leading to the decline of religions like Nestorianism in China.

zh-cn: 丝绸之路：长安—天山廊道的路网
en: Silk Roads: the Routes Network of Chang'an-Tianshan Corridor

description.zh-cn: 由联合国教科文组织认定的世界遗产项目，涵盖中国、哈萨克斯坦和吉尔吉斯斯坦境内的丝路遗迹。
description.en: A World Heritage Site designated by UNESCO, encompassing Silk Road sites within China, Kazakhstan, and Kyrgyzstan.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会调查部

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会的情报机构。
description.en: The intelligence agency of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共中央调查部部长。
description.en: A Chinese politician, former Minister of the Central Investigation Department of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 李克农的夫人。
description.en: Spouse of Li Kenong.

description.zh-cn: 李克农之子，曾任中国人民解放军总后勤部副部长，中将军衔。
description.en: Son of Li Kenong, former Deputy Director of the PLA General Logistics Department, with the rank of Lieutenant General.

description.zh-cn: 对中共三位著名情报人员钱壮飞、李克农、胡底的合称。
description.en: A collective name for three famous CCP intelligence agents: Qian Zhuangfei, Li Kenong, and Hu Di.

description.zh-cn: 中共早期情报人员，“龙潭三杰”之一。
description.en: An early CCP intelligence agent, one of the 'Longtan Three Heroes'.

description.zh-cn: 国民党特务机关中统的负责人之一。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Central Bureau of Investigation and Statistics (Zhongtong), a Kuomintang intelligence agency.

zh-cn: 八路军桂林办事处旧址

description.zh-cn: 中国作家、翻译家，在延安整风运动中被处决。
description.en: A Chinese writer and translator who was executed during the Yan'an Rectification Movement.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝末代君主。秦二世死后被赵高立为秦王。登基后不久，设计杀死了赵高。
description.en: The last ruler of the Qin dynasty. He was installed as King of Qin by Zhao Gao after the death of Qin Er Shi. Shortly after ascending the throne, he orchestrated the assassination of Zhao Gao.

description.zh-cn: 蒙恬之弟，秦朝大臣。曾依法判处赵高死刑，后遭赵高报复，被矫诏赐死。
description.en: The younger brother of Meng Tian and a minister of the Qin dynasty. He once sentenced Zhao Gao to death according to the law, but was later retaliated against by Zhao Gao and killed by a forged imperial edict.

description.zh-cn: 赵高为自保而发动的宫廷政变，派其女婿阎乐率兵包围望夷宫，逼迫秦二世自杀。
description.en: A palace coup initiated by Zhao Gao for self-preservation, in which he dispatched his son-in-law Yan Le to lead troops to surround Wangyi Palace and force Qin Er Shi to commit suicide.

description.zh-cn: 赵高的女婿，时任咸阳令。在望夷宫之变中，他奉赵高之命率兵逼迫秦二世自杀。
description.en: Zhao Gao's son-in-law, who was the Prefect of Xianyang at the time. During the Wangyi Palace coup, he led troops under Zhao Gao's orders to force Qin Er Shi to commit suicide.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝宦官。在秦王子婴的授意下，于斋宫中刺杀了权臣赵高。
description.en: A eunuch of the Qin dynasty. Under the instruction of Prince Ziying of Qin, he assassinated the powerful minister Zhao Gao in the fasting palace.

description.zh-cn: 中国京剧表演艺术家，老生“余派”创始人。
description.en: Chinese Peking opera artist, founder of the 'Yu School' of old male roles (laosheng).

description.zh-cn: 台湾企业家、外交官。
description.en: Taiwanese businessman and diplomat.

description.zh-cn: 中国第一位女性律师。
description.en: The first female lawyer in China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，杜月笙的门生和朋友。
description.en: Chinese political figure, a protégé and friend of Du Yuesheng.

description.zh-cn: 中国国画家。
description.en: Chinese traditional painter.

description.zh-cn: 英国发明家，改良了纽科门蒸汽机，是工业革命中的关键人物。
description.en: Scottish inventor and mechanical engineer whose improvements to the Newcomen steam engine were fundamental to the changes brought by the Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 一种利用蒸汽的能量来做功的热机，是工业革命中最重要的发明之一，为生产和运输提供了充足的动力。
description.en: A heat engine that performs mechanical work using steam as its working fluid, one of the most important inventions of the Industrial Revolution, providing ample power for production and transportation.

description.zh-cn: 18世纪英国将公共土地和零散的土地合并成更大、更集中的私有田地的过程，为工业革命提供了劳动力和工业原材料。
description.en: The process in 18th-century Britain of consolidating common land and scattered holdings into larger, privately owned fields, which provided labor and industrial raw materials for the Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 约16至18世纪欧洲的一系列科学思想和方法的变革，为工业革命奠定了理论基础。
description.en: A series of events that marked the emergence of modern science during the early modern period, when developments in mathematics, physics, astronomy, biology and chemistry transformed the views of society about nature, laying the groundwork for the Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 19世纪英国工人因反对机械化而自发捣毁机器的社会运动。
description.en: A social movement of 19th-century English workers who protested against mechanization by destroying machinery.

description.zh-cn: 工业革命的核心技术，取代了人力和畜力，实现了大规模生产。
description.en: The core technology of the Industrial Revolution, which replaced human and animal power and enabled mass production.

description.zh-cn: 工业革命的发源地。
description.en: The birthplace of the Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 继第一次工业革命后的又一次重大技术革命，以电力、内燃机和化学工业的兴起为标志。
description.en: Another major technological revolution following the First Industrial Revolution, marked by the rise of electricity, the internal combustion engine, and the chemical industry.

description.zh-cn: 20世纪以来以原子能、电子计算机、空间技术和生物工程的发明和应用为主要标志的技术革命。
description.en: The technological revolution since the 20th century, primarily marked by the invention and application of atomic energy, electronic computers, space technology, and bioengineering.

description.zh-cn: 指15世纪末以来，东半球与西半球之间在生物、农作物、人种、文化等方面的广泛交流。其导致的人口爆炸和生产需求大增是工业革命的背景之一。
description.en: The widespread transfer of plants, animals, culture, human populations, technology, and ideas between the Old World and the New World, starting in the late 15th century. The resulting population explosion and increased production demand were part of the background to the Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 18世纪英国农业生产方式的变革，导致劳动力过剩，为工业革命提供了人力资源。
description.en: The transformation of agricultural practices in 18th-century Britain, which led to a surplus of labor, providing human resources for the Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 英国发明家，于1712年发明了第一台实用的蒸汽机。
description.en: English inventor who created the first practical steam engine in 1712.

description.zh-cn: 英国国王，于1623年允许设立专利权，刺激了发明创造。
description.en: King of England and Scotland, who in 1623 allowed the establishment of patents, stimulating invention.

description.zh-cn: 保护新发明权利的法律制度，对工业革命期间的技术创新起到了激励作用。
description.en: A legal system for protecting the rights to new inventions, which incentivized technological innovation during the Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 在工业革命中崛起的新富阶层，拥有生产资料，与工人阶级形成对立。
description.en: The new wealthy class that rose during the Industrial Revolution, owning the means of production and standing in opposition to the working class.

description.zh-cn: 工业革命中产生的新社会阶层，主要由工厂工人组成，与资产阶级形成对立。
description.en: A new social class that emerged during the Industrial Revolution, primarily composed of factory workers, standing in opposition to the bourgeoisie.

description.zh-cn: 英国工人，卢德运动的象征性人物，据传于1811年捣毁机器。
description.en: An English worker, the symbolic figurehead of the Luddite movement, who reportedly destroyed machinery in 1811.

description.zh-cn: 英国发明家，于1733年发明飞梭。
description.en: English inventor of the flying shuttle in 1733.

description.zh-cn: 1733年由约翰·凯发明的织布工具，是工业革命早期纺织业的重要技术革新。
description.en: A weaving tool invented by John Kay in 1733, a key technological innovation in the textile industry during the early Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 英国发明家，于1765年发明珍妮纺纱机。
description.en: English inventor of the spinning jenny in 1765.

description.zh-cn: 1765年由詹姆士·哈格里夫斯发明的多轴纺纱机，是工业革命中的一项关键发明。
description.en: A multi-spindle spinning frame invented in 1765 by James Hargreaves, a key invention in the Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 美国工程师和发明家，于1807年发明了第一艘商业上获得成功的蒸汽轮船。
description.en: American engineer and inventor who is widely credited with developing the first commercially successful steamboat in 1807.

description.zh-cn: 一种使用蒸汽机驱动的船只，是工业革命在交通运输领域的重要成果。
description.en: A ship in which the primary method of propulsion is steam power, a significant achievement of the Industrial Revolution in transportation.

description.zh-cn: 使用蒸汽机作为动力来源的铁路机车，是工业革命最重要的交通工具之一。
description.en: A type of railway locomotive that produces its pulling power through a steam engine, one of the most important transportation means of the Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 工业革命的主要能源，为蒸汽机和钢铁生产提供了动力和原料。
description.en: The primary energy source of the Industrial Revolution, providing power for steam engines and raw materials for iron production.

description.zh-cn: 工业革命的关键材料，用于制造机器、铁路等基础设施。
description.en: A key material of the Industrial Revolution, used to manufacture machinery, railways, and other infrastructure.

description.zh-cn: 工业革命在19世纪传播到的主要地区之一。
description.en: One of the main regions to which the Industrial Revolution spread in the 19th century.

description.zh-cn: 黄兴的革命同志及第二任妻子。
description.en: A revolutionary comrade and the second wife of Huang Xing.

description.zh-cn: 清末由张之洞在武昌创办的新式学堂。
description.en: A new-style academy founded by Zhang Zhidong in Wuchang during the late Qing Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代民主革命家，华兴会创始人之一。
description.en: A Chinese modern democratic revolutionary and one of the founders of the Huaxinghui.

description.zh-cn: 1907年由孙中山、黄兴等同盟会成员在广西镇南关发动的旨在推翻清朝的武装起义。
description.en: An armed uprising launched in 1907 at Zhennanguan, Guangxi, by members of the Tongmenghui, including Sun Yat-sen and Huang Xing, aimed at overthrowing the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 1908年黄兴等人在广西钦州、廉州、上思地区发动的武装起义。
description.en: An armed uprising launched in 1908 by Huang Xing and others in the Qinzhou, Lianzhou, and Shangsi areas of Guangxi.

description.zh-cn: 1908年同盟会在云南河口发动的武装起义。
description.en: An armed uprising launched by the Tongmenghui in Hekou, Yunnan, in 1908.

description.zh-cn: 1911年由中国同盟会在广州发起的一次武装起义，虽然失败，但极大地鼓舞了全国革命斗志。
description.en: An armed uprising launched by the Tongmenghui in Guangzhou in 1911. Although it failed, it greatly inspired the revolutionary spirit across the country.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代民主革命家，黄花岗起义总指挥。
description.en: A Chinese modern democratic revolutionary and the commander-in-chief of the Second Guangzhou Uprising (Huanghuagang Uprising).

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义后在湖北成立的革命政权。
description.en: The revolutionary government established in Hubei after the Wuchang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 清末民初政治人物，曾任江苏都督。
description.en: A political figure in the late Qing and early Republican era, who served as the governor of Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 黄兴与廖淡如之长子。
description.en: Eldest son of Huang Xing and Liao Danru.

description.zh-cn: 黄兴与廖淡如之次子。
description.en: Second son of Huang Xing and Liao Danru.

description.zh-cn: 黄兴与廖淡如之五子，为遗腹子。
description.en: Fifth son of Huang Xing and Liao Danru, a posthumous child.

description.zh-cn: 黄兴与廖淡如之长女，中国政治人物。
description.en: Eldest daughter of Huang Xing and Liao Danru, Chinese politician.

description.zh-cn: 黄兴与廖淡如之次女。
description.en: Second daughter of Huang Xing and Liao Danru.

description.zh-cn: 黄兴与廖淡如之三女。
description.en: Third daughter of Huang Xing and Liao Danru.

description.zh-cn: 位于湖南省长沙市，黄兴的安葬地。
description.en: Located in Changsha, Hunan Province, the burial place of Huang Xing.

description.zh-cn: 女真族的一个氏族，建立了金朝。
description.en: A Jurchen clan that founded the Jin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 旺吉努之孙，历任内大臣、内务府总管兼佐领，封一等男。
description.en: Grandson of Wangginu, served as Grand Minister of the Imperial Household, General Manager of the Imperial Household Department, and Captain. Ennobled as a First-Class Baron.

description.zh-cn: 哈什屯之子，官至尚书。
description.en: Son of Hašitun, served as a Minister (Shangshu).

description.zh-cn: 米思翰之子，孝贤纯皇后和傅恒之父。
description.en: Son of Mishan, father of Empress Xiaoxianchun and Fuheng.

description.zh-cn: 富文之子，晋封承恩毅勇公，在清缅战争中兵败自缢。
description.en: Son of Fuwen, ennobled as Duke Chengen Yiyong. He committed suicide after being defeated in the Sino-Burmese War.

description.zh-cn: 清朝和缅甸贡榜王朝之间的一场战争。
description.en: A war fought between the Qing dynasty of China and the Konbaung dynasty of Burma.

description.zh-cn: 清朝第九位皇帝。
description.en: The ninth emperor of the Qing dynasty.

en: Grand Secretary of the Baohe Hall

description.zh-cn: 清朝内阁大学士之一，为文臣最高职位。
description.en: One of the Grand Secretaries of the Cabinet in the Qing dynasty, the highest position for a civil official.

description.zh-cn: 清代乾隆年间，清军对四川大小金川地区的嘉绒人土司进行的两次大规模征剿。
description.en: Two large-scale military campaigns launched by the Qing army against the Gyalrong chieftains in the Greater and Lesser Jinchuan regions of Sichuan during the Qianlong era.

description.zh-cn: 傅恒之子，因金川、台湾、廓尔喀等战功追赠嘉勇郡王。
description.en: Son of Fuheng, posthumously created Prince Jiayong of the Second Rank for his military achievements in the Jinchuan, Taiwan, and Gurkha campaigns.

description.zh-cn: 清朝乾隆年间在台湾发生的一次大规模民变。
description.en: A major popular uprising that occurred in Taiwan during the Qianlong era of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝与尼泊尔之间的一场战争。
description.en: A war fought between the Qing dynasty and Nepal.

description.zh-cn: 海西女真乌拉部末代贝勒。
description.en: The last Beile (prince) of the Ula tribe of the Haixi Jurchens.

description.zh-cn: 建州女真与乌拉部之间的一场重要战役。
description.en: A significant battle between the Jianzhou Jurchens and the Ula tribe.

description.zh-cn: 富察氏成员，官至武英殿大学士兼工部尚书。
description.en: A member of the Fuca clan who served as a Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall and Minister of Works.

en: Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall

description.zh-cn: 清朝内阁大学士之一，为文臣最高职位。
description.en: One of the Grand Secretaries of the Cabinet in the Qing dynasty, the highest position for a civil official.

description.zh-cn: 富察氏成员，官至保和殿大学士。
description.en: A member of the Fuca clan who served as a Grand Secretary of the Baohe Hall.

description.zh-cn: 康熙朝重臣，历任武英殿大学士兼吏部尚书。
description.en: An important minister during the Kangxi era, who served as a Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall and Minister of Personnel.

description.zh-cn: 阿兰泰之子，历任大学士、靖逆将军，击退准噶尔大汗策妄阿拉布坦。
description.en: Son of Alantai, served as a Grand Secretary and General Jingni, repelled the Dzungar Khan Tsewang Rabtan.

description.zh-cn: 准噶尔汗国大汗。
description.en: Khan of the Dzungar Khanate.

description.zh-cn: 富察氏成员，官至黑龙江将军，曾率清军出征雅克萨之战。
description.en: A member of the Fuca clan who served as the General of Heilongjiang and commanded Qing forces in the Battle of Yakesa.

description.zh-cn: 清朝与沙皇俄国在雅克萨（今俄罗斯阿尔巴济诺）发生的一系列军事冲突。
description.en: A series of military conflicts between the Qing dynasty and Tsarist Russia at Yakesa (modern Albazino, Russia).

description.zh-cn: 李荣保第四子，明瑞之父。
description.en: Fourth son of Lirongbao and father of Mingrui.

description.zh-cn: 殷达瑚齐次子，阿兰泰之父。
description.en: Second son of Yindahūci and father of Alantai.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期楚怀王之孙。被项梁拥立为楚王，成为反秦力量名义上的领袖。后被项羽尊为义帝，但随即被项羽派人刺杀。
description.en: Grandson of King Huai of Chu from the Warring States period. He was installed as King of Chu by Xiang Liang and became the nominal leader of the anti-Qin forces. Xiang Yu later honored him as Emperor Yi, but soon had him assassinated.

description.zh-cn: 楚汉战争中的一场重要战役。项羽率三万精锐骑兵奇袭，大败刘邦五十六万诸侯联军，是战争史上以少胜多的著名范例。
description.en: A major battle in the Chu-Han Contention. Xiang Yu led 30,000 elite cavalry in a surprise attack, routing Liu Bang's coalition army of 560,000. It is a famous example of defeating a vastly larger force in military history.

description.zh-cn: 《南京条约》的补充条款，具体规定了英人在通商口岸租地建屋的区域。
description.en: A supplementary treaty to the Treaty of Nanking, which specified the areas where British subjects could rent land and build houses in the treaty ports.

en: Treaty between the United States and China for the Relinquishment of Extraterritorial Rights in China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国与美国签订的条约，美国据此放弃在华治外法权等特权。
description.en: A treaty signed between the Republic of China and the United States, under which the U.S. relinquished its extraterritorial rights and other privileges in China.

en: Sino-British Treaty for the Relinquishment of Extra-Territorial Rights in China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国与英国签订的条约，英国据此放弃在华治外法权等特权。
description.en: A treaty signed between the Republic of China and the United Kingdom, under which the UK relinquished its extraterritorial rights and other privileges in China.

description.zh-cn: 首任英国驻上海领事，通过与中方谈判，确立了上海英租界。
description.en: The first British Consul in Shanghai, who established the Shanghai British Concession through negotiations with the Chinese side.

description.zh-cn: 时任上海道台，与英国领事巴富尔谈判并公布《上海土地章程》，辟设了上海英租界。
description.en: Served as the Shanghai Daotai, negotiated with British Consul George Balfour and promulgated the 'Shanghai Land Regulations', establishing the Shanghai British Concession.

description.zh-cn: 时任上海道台，与美国圣公会主教文惠廉交涉后，同意将虹口地区划为美商居留地。
description.en: Served as the Shanghai Daotai, and after negotiations with Bishop William Jones Boone of the American Episcopal Church, agreed to designate the Hongkou area as a residence for American merchants.

description.zh-cn: 美国圣公会主教，通过与上海道台吴健彰交涉，促成了美租界的形成。
description.en: A bishop of the American Episcopal Church who facilitated the formation of the American Concession through negotiations with Shanghai Daotai Wu Jianzhang.

description.zh-cn: 美国的一个基督教派别，其主教文惠廉在上海促成了美租界的建立。
description.en: A Christian denomination in the United States whose bishop, William Jones Boone, facilitated the establishment of the American Concession in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 首任法国驻上海领事，于1849年与上海道台麟桂商定开辟了上海法租界。
description.en: The first French Consul in Shanghai, who negotiated with Shanghai Daotai Lingui to establish the Shanghai French Concession in 1849.

description.zh-cn: 时任上海道台，同意了法国领事敏体尼开辟法租界的要求。
description.en: Served as the Shanghai Daotai and agreed to French Consul Charles de Montigny's request to establish the French Concession.

description.zh-cn: 小刀会首领，领导了在上海的起事。
description.en: Leader of the Small Swords Society who led the uprising in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 时任上海县令，在小刀会起事中被杀。
description.en: The county magistrate of Shanghai at the time, killed during the Small Swords Society uprising.

description.zh-cn: 租界的英美义勇队（万国商团）与清军之间的一场冲突。
description.en: A conflict between the Anglo-American volunteers (Shanghai Volunteer Corps) from the concessions and Qing troops.

description.zh-cn: 因法租界当局计划修路穿越宁波同乡会墓地而引发的两次大规模冲突。
description.en: Two large-scale conflicts sparked by the French Concession authorities' plan to build a road through the cemetery of the Ningpo Guild.

description.zh-cn: 中国民主同盟的早期成员团体之一。
description.en: One of the early member groups of the China Democratic League.

description.zh-cn: 中国民主同盟早期领导人，曾主持民盟机关报《光明报》。
description.en: An early leader of the China Democratic League who once presided over its official newspaper, the 'Guangming Daily'.

description.zh-cn: 中共台湾省工委在台北市发行的机关报，其被破获是导致省工委组织瓦解的关键事件之一。
description.en: The official newspaper published by the CPC Taiwan Provincial Work Committee in Taipei. Its discovery was a key event leading to the collapse of the committee's organization.

description.zh-cn: 中国民主同盟领导人，曾任民盟中央主席、中华人民共和国司法部部长。
description.en: A leader of the China Democratic League, served as Chairman of the Central Committee of the CDL and Minister of Justice of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国民主同盟领导人，曾任民盟中央代理主席、中华人民共和国文化部部长。
description.en: A leader of the China Democratic League, served as Acting Chairman of the Central Committee of the CDL and Minister of Culture of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1957年发生于湖北省汉阳县第一中学的事件，民盟成员杨焕尧因此事件被判处死刑。
description.en: An incident that occurred in 1957 at Hanyang No. 1 Middle School in Hubei Province, which led to the death sentence of China Democratic League member Yang Huanyao.

description.zh-cn: 中国民主同盟领导人，曾任民盟中央主席。
description.en: A leader of the China Democratic League, served as Chairman of the Central Committee of the CDL.

description.zh-cn: 中国民主同盟领导人，曾任民盟中央主席。同时也是阎明复之母。
description.en: A leader of the China Democratic League, served as Chairman of the Central Committee of the CDL. She was also the mother of Yan Mingfu.

description.zh-cn: 中国物理学家和政治人物。曾任中国民主同盟中央主席，并在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间担任全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: A Chinese physicist and politician. He was a leader of the China Democratic League and served as Chairman of its Central Committee, and also served as a Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国民主同盟领导人，曾任民盟中央主席。
description.en: A leader of the China Democratic League, served as Chairman of the Central Committee of the CDL.

description.zh-cn: 现任新西兰总督，是新西兰君主在国内的代表。
description.en: The current Governor-General of New Zealand, representative of the Monarch of New Zealand.

description.zh-cn: 现任新西兰总理，新西兰国家党党魁。
description.en: The current Prime Minister of New Zealand and leader of the New Zealand National Party.

description.zh-cn: 新西兰的主要政党之一，现任总理克里斯托弗·卢克森为其成员。
description.en: One of the major political parties in New Zealand, of which the current Prime Minister Christopher Luxon is a member.

description.zh-cn: 由部分毛利部落组成的邦联，是《怀唐伊条约》的签署方之一。
description.en: A confederation of Māori tribes, one of the signatories of the Treaty of Waitangi.

description.zh-cn: 英国与毛利人签订的条约，该条约的签订标志着新西兰成为英国殖民地。
description.en: A treaty signed between the British Crown and Māori chiefs, which established New Zealand as a British colony.

description.zh-cn: 19世纪英国殖民者与毛利人之间因土地问题爆发的一系列武装冲突。
description.en: A series of armed conflicts in the 19th century between British colonists and Māori over land issues.

description.zh-cn: 新西兰的原住民，属于波利尼西亚人的一支。
description.en: The indigenous Polynesian people of mainland New Zealand.

description.zh-cn: 新西兰在1841年至1907年间的政治实体，为大英帝国的一部分。
description.en: The political entity of New Zealand from 1841 to 1907, as part of the British Empire.

description.zh-cn: 英国在澳大利亚的第一个殖民地，新西兰曾一度被划入其管辖范围。
description.en: The first British colony in Australia, which once had jurisdiction over New Zealand.

description.zh-cn: 2019年基督城清真寺枪击案的袭击者。
description.en: The perpetrator of the 2019 Christchurch mosque shootings.

description.zh-cn: 包括新西兰、库克群岛、纽埃、托克劳和罗斯属地在内的政治实体集合。
description.en: The entire area in which the monarch of New Zealand functions as head of state, comprising New Zealand, the Cook Islands, Niue, Tokelau, and the Ross Dependency.

description.zh-cn: 与新西兰处于自由联合关系的南太平洋国家。
description.en: A self-governing island country in the South Pacific Ocean in free association with New Zealand.

description.zh-cn: 与新西兰处于自由联合关系的南太平洋岛国。
description.en: An island country in the South Pacific Ocean in free association with New Zealand.

description.zh-cn: 由新西兰管辖的南太平洋属地。
description.en: A dependent territory of New Zealand in the southern Pacific Ocean.

description.zh-cn: 由澳大利亚和新西兰联合举办的国际女子足球赛事。
description.en: An international women's football tournament co-hosted by Australia and New Zealand.

description.zh-cn: 荷兰探险家，首位有记载抵达新西兰的欧洲人。
description.en: A Dutch explorer, the first known European to reach New Zealand.

description.zh-cn: 荷兰的一个省份，新西兰（Nieuw Zeeland）因此得名。
description.en: A province of the Netherlands after which New Zealand (Nieuw Zeeland) was named.

description.zh-cn: 英国探险家，对新西兰进行了详细的勘察和地图绘制。
description.en: A British explorer who conducted detailed surveys and mapping of New Zealand.

description.zh-cn: 新西兰前总理，是该国第一位民选产生的女性总理。
description.en: A former Prime Minister of New Zealand, and the country's first elected female prime minister.

description.zh-cn: 台湾法学家，曾被李登辉总统聘任为无任所大使。
description.en: Taiwanese jurist, was appointed as an Ambassador-at-Large by President Lee Teng-hui.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国外交官，曾被李登辉总统聘任为无任所大使。
description.en: Republic of China diplomat, was appointed as an Ambassador-at-Large by President Lee Teng-hui.

description.zh-cn: 台湾企业家，曾被李登辉总统聘任为无任所大使。
description.en: Taiwanese businessman, was appointed as an Ambassador-at-Large by President Lee Teng-hui.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾台北市的国立大学，现已合并为国立阳明交通大学。
description.en: A national university in Taipei, Taiwan, now merged into National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University.

en: Ministry of Health and Welfare (Republic of China)

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的中央行政机关，是掌管卫生与社会福利事务的最高主管机关，负责全民健康保险、社会福利、照顾服务等事务。
description.en: A central government agency of the Republic of China, which is the highest authority responsible for health and social welfare affairs, covering matters such as National Health Insurance, social welfare, and care services.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，现任台湾永续能源研究基金会董事长，曾任外交部长及交通部长，被蔡英文及赖清德总统聘任为无任所大使。
description.en: Taiwanese politician, current chairman of the Taiwan Institute for Sustainable Energy, former Minister of Foreign Affairs and Minister of Transportation, appointed as an Ambassador-at-Large by Presidents Tsai Ing-wen and Lai Ching-te.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，前行政院环境保护署署长，被蔡英文总统聘任为无任所大使。
description.en: Taiwanese politician, former head of the Environmental Protection Administration, appointed as an Ambassador-at-Large by President Tsai Ing-wen.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国掌管环境保护事务的最高主管机关，现已升格为环境部。
description.en: The highest authority in the Republic of China responsible for environmental protection affairs, now upgraded to the Ministry of Environment.

description.zh-cn: 台湾网络界人士，蕃薯藤创办人，曾任中华电信独立董事，被蔡英文及赖清德总统聘任为无任所大使。
description.en: Taiwanese internet entrepreneur, founder of yam.com, former independent director of Chunghwa Telecom, appointed as an Ambassador-at-Large by Presidents Tsai Ing-wen and Lai Ching-te.

description.zh-cn: 台湾作家、企业家，PChome董事长，被蔡英文总统聘任为无任所大使。
description.en: Taiwanese writer and entrepreneur, chairman of PChome, appointed as an Ambassador-at-Large by President Tsai Ing-wen.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的电子商务集团。
description.en: An e-commerce group in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物、学者，时任民进党籍立法委员、国立台湾大学副教授、社会民主党召集人，被蔡英文总统聘任为无任所大使。
description.en: Taiwanese politician and scholar, then a DPP legislator, associate professor at National Taiwan University, and convener of the Social Democratic Party, appointed as an Ambassador-at-Large by President Tsai Ing-wen.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的政党。
description.en: A political party in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾田径运动员与政治人物，曾任国策顾问，被蔡英文总统聘任为无任所大使。
description.en: Taiwanese track and field athlete and politician, former National Policy Advisor, appointed as an Ambassador-at-Large by President Tsai Ing-wen.

zh-cn: 中华民国总统府国策顾问
en: National Policy Advisor to the President of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国总统府的无给职荣誉职位，由总统遴聘。
description.en: An unpaid honorary position in the Office of the President of the Republic of China, appointed by the President.

description.zh-cn: 台湾羽球国手，被赖清德总统聘任为无任所大使。
description.en: Taiwanese national badminton player, appointed as an Ambassador-at-Large by President Lai Ching-te.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的入口网站。
description.en: A web portal in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾电脑程式设计师及政治人物，曾任数位发展部部长，被赖清德总统聘任为无任所大使。
description.en: Taiwanese computer programmer and politician, former Minister of Digital Affairs, appointed as an Ambassador-at-Large by President Lai Ching-te.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国掌管数位发展事务的最高主管机关。
description.en: The highest authority in the Republic of China responsible for digital development affairs.

description.zh-cn: 发源于中国的宗教。
description.en: A religion that originated in China.

description.zh-cn: 台湾国际棒球女裁判，被赖清德总统聘任为无任所大使。
description.en: Taiwanese international female baseball umpire, appointed as an Ambassador-at-Large by President Lai Ching-te.

description.zh-cn: 台湾医师与政治人物，曾任无任所大使。
description.en: Taiwanese physician and politician, former Ambassador-at-Large.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国（台湾）政治人物，曾任无任所大使、行政院大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), former Ambassador-at-Large and Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 旅日棒球运动员及教练，曾任无任所大使。
description.en: Japanese-born baseball player and manager of Taiwanese descent, former Ambassador-at-Large.

description.zh-cn: 台湾作家，曾任无任所大使。
description.en: Taiwanese writer, former Ambassador-at-Large.

description.zh-cn: 台湾钢琴家与政治人物，曾任无任所大使。
description.en: Taiwanese pianist and politician, former Ambassador-at-Large.

description.zh-cn: 台湾医师与政治人物，曾任无任所大使。
description.en: Taiwanese physician and politician, former Ambassador-at-Large.

description.zh-cn: 黄春树命案的被告之一，历经21年诉讼，最终被判无罪。
description.en: One of the defendants in the Huang Chun-shu murder case, who was eventually acquitted after 21 years of litigation.

description.zh-cn: 黄春树命案的嫌犯之一，其供词导致徐自强被卷入案件。
description.en: One of the suspects in the Huang Chun-shu murder case, whose testimony implicated Hsu Tzu-chiang.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的检察机关，在徐自强被判无罪后坚持上诉。
description.en: The prosecutorial agency of the Republic of China, which insisted on appealing after Hsu Tzu-chiang was acquitted.

description.zh-cn: 时任中华民国检察总长，依据释字第582号解释为徐自强案提起第五次非常上诉。
description.en: The then Prosecutor General of the Republic of China, who filed the fifth extraordinary appeal in the Hsu Tzu-chiang case based on J.Y. Interpretation No. 582.

description.zh-cn: 对徐自强等人提起公诉的检察机关。
description.en: The prosecutorial office that indicted Hsu Tzu-chiang and others.

description.zh-cn: 对徐自强案进行一审并判处其死刑的法院。
description.en: The court of first instance that tried the Hsu Tzu-chiang case and sentenced him to death.

description.zh-cn: 中国江苏省下辖的地级市，周恩来的出生地。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Jiangsu Province, China, and the birthplace of Zhou Enlai.

description.zh-cn: 市民李文波之妻。李文波在被红卫兵抄家殴打时抵抗并被打死，随后周恩来下令将刘文秀判处死刑并枪决。
description.en: Wife of citizen Li Wenbo. When Li Wenbo resisted while being beaten during a home raid by Red Guards and was killed, Zhou Enlai subsequently ordered Liu Wenxiu to be sentenced to death and executed by firing squad.

description.zh-cn: 中国考古学家、诗人，因在红八月期间遭到批斗迫害，于北京自缢身亡。
description.en: A Chinese archaeologist and poet who committed suicide by hanging in Beijing after being persecuted and struggled against during Red August.

description.zh-cn: 凤凰卫视的创办人，曾任董事局主席及行政总裁。
description.en: Founder of Phoenix TV, former Chairman of the Board and CEO.

description.zh-cn: 凤凰卫视的主要股东之一。
description.en: One of the major shareholders of Phoenix TV.

description.zh-cn: 凤凰卫视常务副总裁兼总编辑，原中央广播电视总台央视副台长。
description.en: Executive Vice President and Editor-in-Chief of Phoenix TV, former Deputy Director of CCTV at China Media Group.

description.zh-cn: 凤凰卫视的前身公司之一，为星空传媒（STAR TV）旗下公司。
description.en: One of the predecessor companies of Phoenix TV, under STAR TV.

description.zh-cn: 凤凰卫视的前身频道，原隶属于卫星电视有限公司。
description.en: The predecessor channel of Phoenix TV, originally part of Satellite Television Limited.

description.zh-cn: 曾收购卫星电视有限公司并持有凤凰卫视股份的传媒集团。
description.en: A media conglomerate that acquired Satellite Television Limited and held shares in Phoenix TV.

description.zh-cn: 新闻集团主席，主导了对卫星电视有限公司的收购。
description.en: Chairman of News Corporation who led the acquisition of Satellite Television Limited.

description.zh-cn: 凤凰卫视的主频道，由卫视中文台改组而来。
description.en: The main channel of Phoenix TV, reorganized from the STAR Chinese Channel.

description.zh-cn: 凤凰卫视记者，曾在伊拉克战争期间进入巴格达采访。
description.en: Phoenix TV reporter who entered Baghdad to report during the Iraq War.

description.zh-cn: 全球最大私募基金公司之一，于2013年购入新闻集团持有的全部凤凰卫视股份。
description.en: One of the world's largest private equity firms, which acquired all of News Corporation's shares in Phoenix TV in 2013.

description.zh-cn: 凤凰卫视旗下首个粤语频道，后在香港免费电视落地。
description.en: Phoenix TV's first Cantonese channel, which later became available on free-to-air television in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 凤凰卫视的谈话类节目，于2017年9月停播。
description.en: A talk show on Phoenix TV that was suspended in September 2017.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国文学艺术界联合会主席。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Chairperson of the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，铁凝的中国作家协会主席职务继任者。
description.en: Chinese politician, successor to Tie Ning as Chairperson of the China Writers Association.

description.zh-cn: 经济学家，燕京华侨大学校长，铁凝的丈夫。
description.en: Economist, president of Yanjing Huaqiao University, husband of Tie Ning.

zh-cn: 河北省文学艺术界联合会
en: Hebei Federation of Literary and Art Circles

description.zh-cn: 负责管理法国国家博物馆和古迹，在法国和国外推广和保护艺术的政府部门。
description.en: The ministry of the Government of France responsible for national museums and historical monuments, promoting and protecting the arts in France and abroad.

description.zh-cn: 田汉的第四任妻子，中共特科成员。
description.en: Tian Han's fourth wife, a member of the CCP's special service.

description.zh-cn: 田汉与安娥之子。
description.en: Son of Tian Han and An E.

description.zh-cn: 电影《风云儿女》的主题曲，由田汉作词，聂耳作曲。1949年被选为中华人民共和国代国歌，1982年正式成为国歌。
description.en: The theme song of the film "Children of Troubled Times", with lyrics by Tian Han and music by Nie Er. It was chosen as the provisional national anthem of the People's Republic of China in 1949 and officially became the national anthem in 1982.

description.zh-cn: 位于湖南长沙的一所师范学校，田汉曾在此就读。
description.en: A normal school in Changsha, Hunan, where Tian Han studied.

description.zh-cn: 日本的一所大学，田汉曾在此留学。
description.en: A university in Japan where Tian Han studied.

description.zh-cn: 中国现代作家，田汉的挚友。
description.en: A modern Chinese writer and a close friend of Tian Han.

description.zh-cn: 由田汉创办的艺术团体，分文学、绘画、音乐、戏剧、电影五部。
description.en: An art collective founded by Tian Han, with five departments: literature, painting, music, drama, and film.

description.zh-cn: 中国音乐家，为《义勇军进行曲》谱曲。
description.en: A Chinese composer who wrote the music for "March of the Volunteers".

description.zh-cn: 一部中国电影，《义勇军进行曲》是其主题曲。
description.en: A Chinese film for which "March of the Volunteers" served as the theme song.

description.zh-cn: 1941年由田汉在桂林组建的剧社。
description.en: A drama society formed by Tian Han in Guilin in 1941.

description.zh-cn: 田汉创作的京剧剧本，在文化大革命中被批判为“大毒草”。
description.en: A Peking opera script written by Tian Han, which was criticized as a "big poisonous weed" during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间对田汉、周扬、夏衍、阳翰笙四位文艺界人士的合称贬称。
description.en: A derogatory collective term used during the Cultural Revolution to refer to four literary and art figures: Tian Han, Zhou Yang, Xia Yan, and Yang Hansheng.

description.zh-cn: 中国剧作家、小说家，“四条汉子”之一。
description.en: A Chinese playwright and novelist, one of the "Four Guys".

description.zh-cn: 韩国的主要政党之一。该党在第22届国会中曾是执政党，但在2024年戒严事件中作为主要在野党，坚决反对戒严令，并主导了后续的总统弹劾案。
description.en: One of the major political parties in South Korea. While initially the ruling party in the 22nd National Assembly, it became the main opposition party, strongly opposing the 2024 martial law declaration and leading the subsequent impeachment of the president.

description.zh-cn: 韩国的主要政党之一。该党曾是执政党，但在第22届国会中成为主要反对党。尽管总统尹锡悦出身该党，其党代表韩东勋及部分议员在2024年戒严事件中明确表示反对戒严。
description.en: One of the major political parties in South Korea. It was the ruling party but became the main opposition party in the 22nd National Assembly. Although President Yoon Suk Yeol was a member, its leader Han Dong-hoon and some of its lawmakers opposed the 2024 martial law declaration.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国临时政府的议会，是韩国国会的历史渊源之一。
description.en: The parliament of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea, one of the historical origins of the National Assembly of South Korea.

zh-cn: 大韩民国制宪国会议员选举

description.zh-cn: 为选举制宪国会议员而举行的选举，是韩国历史上的首次国会选举。
description.en: The election held to elect members of the Constituent Assembly, marking the first parliamentary election in South Korean history.

description.zh-cn: 朴正熙为谋求永久执政而发动的自我政变，解散国会并颁布维新宪法，建立第四共和国。
description.en: A self-coup by Park Chung-hee to secure permanent rule, which involved dissolving the National Assembly and promulgating the Yushin Constitution, establishing the Fourth Republic.

description.zh-cn: 第四共和国时期设立的选举人团，位于国会之上，负责间接选举总统及部分国会议员。
description.en: An electoral college established during the Fourth Republic, superior to the National Assembly, responsible for indirectly electing the president and some members of parliament.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国的国家元首和政府首脑。
description.en: The head of state and head of government of the Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 韩国政治人物，金大中之子。
description.en: South Korean politician, son of Kim Dae-jung.

description.zh-cn: 韩国政治人物，金大中之子。
description.en: South Korean politician, son of Kim Dae-jung.

description.zh-cn: 韩国政治人物，金大中之子。
description.en: South Korean politician, son of Kim Dae-jung.

description.zh-cn: 韩国政党，于2025年2月19日与共同民主党等组成政党联盟“结束内乱圆桌会议”。
description.en: A South Korean political party that formed a political coalition called the 'Roundtable Conference to End the Insurrection' with the Democratic Party of Korea and others on February 19, 2025.

description.zh-cn: 明熹宗的乳母，魏忠贤的政治盟友及对食伴侣，与其狼狈为奸，把持后宫。
description.en: The wet nurse of the Tianqi Emperor, and a political ally and 'paired-eater' partner of Wei Zhongxian. She colluded with him to control the imperial court.

description.zh-cn: 明朝天启年间，以魏忠贤为首的阉党与东林党人之间发生的激烈政治斗争。
description.en: The intense political struggle between the Eunuch Party led by Wei Zhongxian and the Donglin Party during the Tianqi era of the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 东林党重要人物，因上疏弹劾魏忠贤二十四大罪，遭其迫害致死，为“东林六君子”之一。
description.en: A key figure in the Donglin Party, known for impeaching Wei Zhongxian on 24 major crimes. He was persecuted to death by Wei and is one of the 'Six Gentlemen of the Donglin'.

description.zh-cn: 东林党重要人物，与杨涟一同弹劾魏忠贤，后被其诬陷入狱，酷刑折磨致死，为“东林六君子”之一。
description.en: A key figure in the Donglin Party who, along with Yang Lian, impeached Wei Zhongxian. He was later framed, imprisoned, and tortured to death, and is one of the 'Six Gentlemen of the Donglin'.

description.zh-cn: 阉党核心成员，魏忠贤的“干儿”，官至兵部尚书。崇祯帝即位后被弹劾，畏罪自尽。
description.en: A core member of the Eunuch Party and Wei Zhongxian's 'godson', who rose to the position of Minister of War. After the Chongzhen Emperor's accession, he was impeached and committed suicide.

description.zh-cn: 明末嘉兴贡生，上疏弹劾魏忠贤十大罪状，直接导致魏忠贤的倒台。
description.en: A tribute student from Jiaxing in the late Ming dynasty whose memorial impeaching Wei Zhongxian on ten major crimes directly led to Wei's downfall.

description.zh-cn: 魏忠贤的侄子，因魏忠贤得势而被滥封为宁国公。崇祯初年被除爵伏诛。
description.en: Wei Zhongxian's nephew, who was ennobled as Duke of Ningguo due to his uncle's influence. He was stripped of his title and executed in the early Chongzhen era.

description.zh-cn: 天启年间明军在辽东的一场败仗，此事件被阉党用作弹劾孙承宗的借口。
description.en: A military defeat for the Ming army in Liaodong during the Tianqi era, which was used by the Eunuch Party as a pretext to impeach Sun Chengzon.

description.zh-cn: 明末官僚集团，与东林党对立，其成员后来多依附魏忠贤，成为阉党的一部分。
description.en: A bureaucratic faction in the late Ming dynasty that opposed the Donglin Party. Many of its members later attached themselves to Wei Zhongxian, becoming part of the Eunuch Party.

description.zh-cn: 天启年间太监，与东林党人关系友善，后因与魏忠贤有隙而被其矫旨杀害。
description.en: A eunuch during the Tianqi era who was friendly with the Donglin Party. He was killed by Wei Zhongxian on a forged imperial edict due to a conflict between them.

description.zh-cn: 一部由美国前副总统艾尔·高尔主演的关于全球变暖的纪录片，其呈现方式对《穹顶之下》产生了影响。
description.en: A documentary film about global warming featuring former U.S. Vice President Al Gore, whose presentation style influenced 'Under the Dome'.

description.zh-cn: 中国大型视频分享网站，是《穹顶之下》的首播平台之一，后应宣传部门要求将其下架。
description.en: A major Chinese video sharing website that was one of the initial distributors of 'Under the Dome' before being ordered to remove it.

description.zh-cn: 中国官方通讯社新华社的官方网站，在《穹顶之下》发布后曾发表相关文章，但随后撤稿并删除相关内容。
description.en: The official website of China's state news agency, Xinhua. It published articles related to 'Under the Dome' but later withdrew them and deleted related content.

description.zh-cn: 由雷切尔·卡森所著的关于农药危害的环境保护书籍，被骆建华用来类比《穹顶之下》的社会意义。
description.en: An environmental science book by Rachel Carson about the harms of pesticides, which was used by Luo Jianhua to draw a parallel to the social significance of 'Under the Dome'.

description.zh-cn: 美国海洋生物学家和作家，其著作《寂静的春天》推动了全球环境保护运动。
description.en: American marine biologist and author whose book 'Silent Spring' advanced the global environmental movement.

description.zh-cn: 时任山西省环境保护厅厅长，曾在《穹顶之下》中出镜。纪录片发布后不久，他因涉嫌严重违纪违法接受调查。
description.en: Then Director of the Shanxi Provincial Department of Environmental Protection, who appeared in 'Under the Dome'. Shortly after the documentary's release, he was investigated for serious violations of discipline and law.

description.zh-cn: 元末明初军事人物，谢夫人之父。
description.en: A military figure during the late Yuan and early Ming dynasties, father of Lady Xie.

description.zh-cn: 明朝初年重要将领，淇国公，曾在储位之争中支持朱高煦。
description.en: An important general in the early Ming Dynasty, Duke of Qi, who supported Zhu Gaoxu in the struggle for the crown prince position.

description.zh-cn: 明朝驸马，曾在储位之争中支持朱高煦。
description.en: An imperial son-in-law of the Ming Dynasty who supported Zhu Gaoxu in the struggle for the crown prince position.

description.zh-cn: 朱高煦次子，因向明成祖告发其父的过恶而为人所知，后被明仁宗废为庶人，最终在宣德元年与父同死。
description.en: The second son of Zhu Gaoxu, known for reporting his father's wrongdoings to the Yongle Emperor. He was later demoted to a commoner by the Hongxi Emperor and eventually died with his father in 1426.

description.zh-cn: 明朝将领，封英国公。朱高煦谋反时曾试图勾结他作为内应。
description.en: A general of the Ming Dynasty, enfeoffed as Duke of Ying. Zhu Gaoxu attempted to collude with him as an insider during his rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 朱高煦长子，封汉世子，早逝。
description.en: The eldest son of Zhu Gaoxu, enfeoffed as the Heir Apparent of Han, who died young.

description.zh-cn: 朱高煦三子，封汉世子，后与父同死。
description.en: The third son of Zhu Gaoxu, enfeoffed as the Heir Apparent of Han, who later died with his father.

description.zh-cn: 总部位于香港的中国中央企业，是中国近代史上第一家轮船运输企业。
description.en: A Chinese state-owned enterprise headquartered in Hong Kong, and the first steamship navigation company in modern Chinese history.

description.zh-cn: 由招商局集团于1979年创办，是中国第一个对外开放的工业区，被誉为中国改革开放的“试管”。
description.en: Founded in 1979 by China Merchants Group, it was the first industrial zone in China to open up to the outside world and is known as the 'test tube' of China's reform and opening-up.

description.zh-cn: 1900年孙中山于三洲田村（位于现深圳市境内）一带发动的反清起义。
description.en: An anti-Qing uprising launched by Sun Yat-sen in 1900 in the area of Sanzhoutian Village (located within present-day Shenzhen).

description.zh-cn: 唐末的河中节度使，朱温早年曾向其投降。
description.en: The military governor (jiedushi) of Hezhong during the late Tang dynasty, to whom Zhu Wen surrendered in his early career.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝皇帝，在位期间爆发黄巢之乱。他接受了朱温的归降并赐名“全忠”。
description.en: An emperor of the Tang dynasty during whose reign the Huang Chao Rebellion broke out. He accepted Zhu Wen's surrender and bestowed upon him the name 'Quanzhong'.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝末年宰相，为对抗宦官势力而召朱温入京，后被朱温所杀。
description.en: A chancellor in the late Tang dynasty who summoned Zhu Wen to the capital to counter the power of the eunuchs, but was later killed by Zhu Wen.

description.zh-cn: 朱温第三子，后梁第二位皇帝。因不满朱温欲立养子朱友文为太子而发动政变，弑父篡位。
description.en: The third son of Zhu Wen and the second emperor of the Later Liang. He launched a coup and committed patricide to usurp the throne after becoming discontented with Zhu Wen's intention to make the adopted son Zhu Youwen the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 朱温的原配妻子，为人贤明，对朱温有一定影响力。
description.en: Zhu Wen's primary wife, known for her wisdom and virtue, who had a certain degree of influence over him.

description.zh-cn: 朱温嫡子，后梁末代皇帝。
description.en: The legitimate son of Zhu Wen and the last emperor of the Later Liang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 位于今安徽省，是朱温的出生地。
description.en: A county located in modern-day Anhui province, the birthplace of Zhu Wen.

description.zh-cn: 朱温的养子，原名康勤。因深得朱温宠爱，一度被考虑立为太子，引起朱友珪的嫉恨并最终被其杀害。
description.en: The adopted son of Zhu Wen, originally named Kang Qin. He was highly favored by Zhu Wen and was once considered to be made the crown prince, which incited the jealousy of Zhu Yougui and led to his murder.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，台湾民众党籍，现任新竹市代理市长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician of the Taiwan People's Party, currently serving as the acting mayor of Hsinchu City.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的产业技术研发机构，于1973年由经济部联合工业研究所、联合矿业研究所、金属工业研究所合并设立。
description.en: A technology research and development institution in Taiwan, established in 1973 by merging the Union Industrial Research Laboratories, the Mining Research & Service Organization, and the Metal Industries Research & Development Centre.

description.zh-cn: 台湾日治时期的最高统治机关。
description.en: The supreme ruling body during the period of Japanese rule in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾最早成立的工业研究机构之一，前身为台湾总督府成立的天然瓦斯研究所，后合并入工业技术研究院。
description.en: One of the earliest industrial research institutions in Taiwan, formerly the Natural Gas Research Institute established by the Office of the Governor-General of Taiwan, later merged into the Industrial Technology Research Institute.

description.zh-cn: 源自中国福建省南部地区的汉族民系，是台湾主要的族群之一。
description.en: A Han Chinese subgroup originating from the southern part of Fujian province in China, one of the major ethnic groups in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 明末清初的军事家、政治人物，建立了台湾的第一个汉人政权。
description.en: A military leader and statesman during the late Ming and early Qing dynasties who established the first Han Chinese regime in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 清朝福建泉州同安县人，于1691年获准带领亲族及同乡至竹堑地区进行拓垦，是早期开发新竹的重要人物。
description.en: A native of Tong'an County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian, during the Qing dynasty, who was granted permission in 1691 to lead his relatives and fellow villagers to develop the Zhúqiàn (Hsinchu) area, becoming a key figure in the early development of Hsinchu.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，无党籍，为新竹市升格为省辖市后的首任市长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, independent, who served as the first mayor of Hsinchu City after its promotion to a provincial city.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，中国国民党籍，曾任新竹市市长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician of the Kuomintang, who served as the mayor of Hsinchu City.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，中国国民党籍，曾任新竹市市长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician of the Kuomintang, who served as the mayor of Hsinchu City.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，民主进步党籍，曾任新竹市市长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician of the Democratic Progressive Party, who served as the mayor of Hsinchu City.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，中国国民党籍，曾任新竹市市长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician of the Kuomintang, who served as the mayor of Hsinchu City.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，中国国民党籍，曾任新竹市市长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician of the Kuomintang, who served as the mayor of Hsinchu City.

description.zh-cn: 位于新竹市的军用机场，为中华民国空军新竹基地的一部分，曾于1998年短暂开放军民两用。
description.en: A military airport in Hsinchu City, part of the ROC Air Force Hsinchu Base. It was briefly opened for joint military-civilian use in 1998.

description.zh-cn: 1998年国华航空公司一架自新竹起飞的班机发生坠毁事故，导致新竹机场停止民航服务。
description.en: In 1998, a Formosa Airlines flight crashed after taking off from Hsinchu, leading to the suspension of civil aviation services at Hsinchu Airport.

description.zh-cn: 香港模特儿及演员，黎明的前妻。
description.en: A Hong Kong model and actress, former wife of Leon Lai.

description.zh-cn: 黎明曾就读的中学。
description.en: A secondary school that Leon Lai attended.

description.zh-cn: 香港唱片公司，黎明于1986年至1989年间签约的公司。
description.en: A Hong Kong record label to which Leon Lai was signed from 1986 to 1989.

description.zh-cn: 香港唱片公司，黎明于1998年至2004年间签约的公司。
description.en: A Hong Kong record label to which Leon Lai was signed from 1998 to 2004.

description.zh-cn: 由黎明与林建岳合作成立的香港唱片公司。
description.en: A Hong Kong record label co-founded by Leon Lai and Peter Lam.

description.zh-cn: 1986年举办的歌唱比赛，黎明在此比赛中获得铜奖并进入演艺界。
description.en: A singing competition held in 1986 where Leon Lai won the second runner-up prize, launching his entertainment career.

description.zh-cn: 联合国属下机构，致力于维护全球儿童的权益。黎明自1994年起担任其大使。
description.en: A United Nations agency dedicated to protecting the rights of children worldwide. Leon Lai has served as its ambassador since 1994.

en: The Community Chest of Hong Kong

description.zh-cn: 香港的非牟利及非政府的慈善机构。黎明长期参与其活动，并担任名誉副会长。
description.en: A non-profit and non-governmental charitable organization in Hong Kong. Leon Lai has been a long-term participant and serves as an Honorary Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 香港作家，曾在第五届新秀歌唱大赛担任评判并给予黎明高分。
description.en: A Hong Kong writer who was a judge at the 5th New Talent Singing Awards and gave Leon Lai a high score.

description.zh-cn: 香港演员，曾将黎明介绍给歌唱老师戴思聪。
description.en: A Hong Kong actor who introduced Leon Lai to singing coach Dai Sicong.

description.zh-cn: 香港著名歌唱老师，曾教授黎明乐理和歌唱技巧，并助其签约宝丽金。
description.en: A renowned Hong Kong singing coach who taught Leon Lai music theory and vocal techniques, and helped him sign with PolyGram.

description.zh-cn: 香港音乐填词人及监制，时任宝丽金监制期间与黎明签约。
description.en: A Hong Kong lyricist and record producer who, as a producer for PolyGram, signed Leon Lai.

description.zh-cn: 香港电影制作人及经理人，曾任黎明的经理人。
description.en: A Hong Kong film producer and artist manager, formerly Leon Lai's manager.

description.zh-cn: 香港填词人，曾将雷颂德介绍给黎明的经理人陈善之。
description.en: A Hong Kong lyricist who introduced Mark Lui to Leon Lai's manager, Joe Chan.

description.zh-cn: 香港音乐人，与黎明长期合作，被视为乐坛中的最佳拍档之一。
description.en: A Hong Kong musician and long-term collaborator with Leon Lai, considered one of the best partnerships in the music industry.

description.zh-cn: 香港商人，寰亚音乐创办人，与黎明合作成立A Music。
description.en: A Hong Kong businessman and founder of Media Asia Music, who co-founded Amusic with Leon Lai.

description.zh-cn: 台湾音乐制作人，曾担任黎明概念专辑《一个故事》的监制。
description.en: A Taiwanese record producer who produced Leon Lai's concept album "A Story".

description.zh-cn: 香港电影导演，执导电影《甜蜜蜜》并由黎明担任男主角。
description.en: A Hong Kong film director who directed the movie "Comrades: Almost a Love Story" starring Leon Lai.

birth_place.zh-cn: 中华民国湖南省平江县
birth_place.en: Pingjiang County, Hunan, Republic of China

death_place.zh-cn: 北京市东城区北京医院

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党党史专家，曾担任毛泽东的兼职工业秘书。他曾任中共中央顾问委员会委员、中共中央组织部常务副部长。晚年成为中共党内著名的自由派人物，呼吁民主宪政。
description.en: An expert on the history of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) and a former part-time industrial secretary to Mao Zedong. He served as a member of the CCP Central Advisory Commission and Executive Vice Minister of the CCP Organization Department. In his later years, he became a prominent liberal voice within the CCP, advocating for democratic constitutionalism.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国信息产业部

description.zh-cn: 隋炀帝之孙，隋炀帝死后在洛阳被王世充等拥立为帝，后被王世充所废杀。
description.en: Grandson of Emperor Yang of Sui. After Emperor Yang's death, he was enthroned in Luoyang by Wang Shichong and others, but was later deposed and killed by Wang Shichong.

en: Sui's conquest of the Chen dynasty

description.zh-cn: 隋朝发动的统一战争，灭亡了南方的陈朝，结束了中国长达近三百年的南北分裂局面。
description.en: A unification war launched by the Sui dynasty that conquered the Chen dynasty in the south, ending nearly 300 years of north-south division in China.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝权臣，帮助杨广夺取太子之位。
description.en: A powerful official of the Sui dynasty who helped Yang Guang secure the position of crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝对高句丽发动的四次大规模战争，严重消耗了隋朝国力，是导致隋末民变的主要原因之一。
description.en: Four large-scale wars launched by the Sui dynasty against Goguryeo, which severely depleted Sui's national strength and was one of the main causes of the rebellions at the end of the dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝确立的中央官制，将相权一分为三，互相牵制，以巩固皇权，对后世影响深远。
description.en: A central government structure established by the Sui dynasty, which divided the power of the chancellor into three, creating checks and balances to consolidate imperial authority, profoundly influencing later dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝时期兴建的贯通南北的大型水利工程，连接了中国五大水系，促进了南北经济文化交流。
description.en: A large-scale water conservancy project built during the Sui dynasty that connected north and south China, linking the country's five major river systems and promoting economic and cultural exchange.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝的首都，由宇文恺设计，是当时世界上规模最大的城市之一，其规划对后世及东亚都市规划有深刻影响。
description.en: The capital of the Sui dynasty, designed by Yuwen Kai. It was one of the largest cities in the world at the time, and its layout had a profound influence on later and East Asian urban planning.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝著名建筑家，主持设计了隋都大兴城和东都洛阳城，并参与了广通渠的建设。
description.en: A famous architect of the Sui dynasty who led the design of the Sui capital Daxingcheng and the eastern capital Luoyang, and also participated in the construction of the Guangtong Canal.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝工匠，设计和修建了著名的赵州桥（安济桥）。
description.en: A craftsman of the Sui dynasty who designed and built the famous Zhaozhou Bridge (Anji Bridge).

description.zh-cn: 由李春在隋朝修建的石拱桥，是世界上现存最古老、跨度最大、保存最完整的单孔坦弧敞肩石拱桥。
description.en: A stone arch bridge built by Li Chun during the Sui dynasty. It is the world's oldest, largest-span, and best-preserved open-spandrel segmental stone arch bridge.

description.zh-cn: 隋炀帝之孙，隋亡后被东突厥立为隋王。
description.en: Grandson of Emperor Yang of Sui. After the fall of the Sui dynasty, he was installed as the King of Sui by the Eastern Turks.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国受政府委托处理海峡两岸事务的半官方机构。
description.en: A semi-official organization in the Republic of China (Taiwan) authorized by the government to handle cross-strait affairs.

zh-cn: 光复大陆设计研究委员会

description.zh-cn: 中华民国一个已裁撤的政府机构，其业务后移交给大陆委员会等单位。
description.en: A defunct government agency of the Republic of China whose duties were later transferred to the Mainland Affairs Council and other units.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国一个已裁撤的政府机构，其部分业务后由大陆委员会承接。
description.en: A defunct government agency of the Republic of China, some of whose duties were later taken over by the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，现任大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), currently serving as the Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，现任大陆委员会政务副主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), currently serving as a Deputy Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任行政院大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), former Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾代理行政院大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), former acting Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任行政院大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), former Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任行政院大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), former Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任行政院大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), former Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任行政院大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), former Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任行政院大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), former Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), former Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan), former Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 一种菊科蒿属植物，是提取青蒿素的天然来源。
description.en: A plant species in the family Asteraceae, the natural source from which artemisinin is extracted.

description.zh-cn: 一种由疟原虫引起的威胁生命的寄生虫病，通过受感染的蚊子叮咬传播给人类。
description.en: A life-threatening parasitic disease caused by Plasmodium parasites, transmitted to humans through the bites of infected mosquitoes.

zh-cn: 拉斯克临床医学研究奖

description.zh-cn: 一项著名的美国生物医学奖项，被誉为“美国的诺贝尔奖”。
description.en: A prestigious American award for biomedical research, often called 'America's Nobel'.

zh-cn: 诺贝尔生理学或医学奖
en: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine

description.zh-cn: 诺贝尔奖之一，旨在表彰在生理学或医学领域作出最重要发现的个人。
description.en: One of the Nobel Prizes, awarded for outstanding discoveries in the fields of physiology or medicine.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国。在毛泽东和周恩来指示下，启动了523项目以研发抗疟新药。
description.en: The People's Republic of China. Under the direction of Mao Zedong and Zhou Enlai, it initiated Project 523 to develop new antimalarial drugs.

zh-cn: 中国科学院上海有机化学研究所
en: Shanghai Institute of Organic Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences

description.zh-cn: 523项目的主要协作单位，在确定青蒿素的化学结构方面发挥了关键作用，其研究员周维善也完成了青蒿素的全合成。
description.en: A key collaborating unit of Project 523 that played a crucial role in determining the chemical structure of artemisinin. Its researcher, Zhou Weishan, also completed the total synthesis of artemisinin.

zh-cn: 中国科学院生物物理研究所
en: Institute of Biophysics, Chinese Academy of Sciences

description.zh-cn: 523项目的主要协作单位，通过单晶X射线衍射技术最终确定了青蒿素的相对构型和绝对构型。
description.en: A key collaborating unit of Project 523 that ultimately determined the relative and absolute configuration of artemisinin using single-crystal X-ray diffraction.
