日本于1940年9月27日与德国、意大利签署《三国同盟条约》，正式成为轴心国核心成员之一。
description.en: Japan signed the Tripartite Pact with Germany and Italy on September 27, 1940, formally becoming a member of the Axis powers.

description.zh-cn: 日本于1945年8月15日宣布无条件投降，标志着大日本帝国名存实亡。
1947年《日本国宪法》颁布后，日本官方不再使用“大日本帝国”国号，标志着大日本帝国的终结。
韩国刺客安重根在哈尔滨火车站刺杀了伊藤博文，此事件加速了日本吞并朝鲜的进程。
description.en: Assassinated Itō Hirobumi at Harbin Railway Station.

description.zh-cn: 统制派首脑，在太平洋战争期间担任首相。他作为日本首相，主张对英美开战，是日本军国主义的代表人物，也是发动太平洋战争的主要决策者之一。
description.en: Leader of the Control Faction and a representative figure of Japanese militarism. As Prime Minister of Japan during the Pacific War, he advocated for war against the US and UK and was one of the key decision-makers in launching the Pacific War.

description.zh-cn: 担任第一任内阁总理大臣，并在此后多次组阁。
杜月笙是上海青帮的头目之一。
与黄金荣、张啸林合开三鑫公司，并称“上海滩三大亨”。
与黄金荣、张啸林合开三鑫公司，并称“上海滩三大亨”。
抗日战争爆发后，因张啸林与日本合作，杜月笙策划了对张啸林的暗杀。
与黄金荣、张啸林共同开设，垄断上海法租界毒品交易。
与黄金荣、张啸林重组中华共进会，用于协助清党。
诱杀共产党工人领袖汪寿华，协助蒋介石镇压工人武装，推动了清党行动。
1927年4月11日晚，杜月笙诱杀了汪寿华。
在四一二事件中协助国民党清党，杀害共产党员。
在四一二事件中协助蒋介石清党，并长期担任其顾问。
通过募捐、运送物资、组织别动队、协助军统等方式积极抗日。
动员门生组织别动队协助国军作战，并秘密修建防御工事。
应潘汉年的要求，向八路军捐赠物资。
内战末期，杜月笙选择离开上海，前往香港。
在上海实行市值改革期间，以投机倒把罪逮捕了杜月笙的儿子杜维屏。
蒋经国在上海“打老虎”，逮捕了杜月笙的儿子，双方关系紧张。
在吴作栋担任总理期间，李显龙担任副总理。
description.en: Lee Hsien Loong served as Deputy Prime Minister during Goh Chok Tong's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 在李显龙担任总理期间，黄循财担任副总理。
description.en: Lawrence Wong served as Deputy Prime Minister during Lee Hsien Loong's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 李显龙在与马英九会面后，称其为“老朋友”。
description.en: After meeting with Ma Ying-jeou, Lee Hsien Loong referred to him as an "old friend".

description.zh-cn: 因李显龙关于南海仲裁案的言论，时任中国外交部副部长刘振民要求新加坡“少管闲事”。
description.en: Due to Lee Hsien Loong's remarks on the South China Sea arbitration, then Chinese Vice Foreign Minister Liu Zhenmin asked Singapore to "mind its own business".

description.zh-cn: 因李显龙的言论，时任中华民国外交部长陈唐山称新加坡为“鼻屎大的国家”，后正式道歉。
description.en: Angered by Lee Hsien Loong's remarks, then ROC Foreign Minister Chen Tang-shan called Singapore a "booger-sized country", and later formally apologized.

description.zh-cn: 因李光耀故居处置问题发表联合声明，表示对李显龙“失去信心”。
description.en: Issued a joint statement regarding the disposal of Lee Kuan Yew's house, expressing a "loss of confidence" in Lee Hsien Loong.

description.zh-cn: 因李光耀故居处置问题发表联合声明，表示对李显龙“失去信心”。
description.en: Issued a joint statement regarding the disposal of Lee Kuan Yew's house, expressing a "loss of confidence" in Lee Hsien Loong.

description.zh-cn: 李显龙因梁实轩转发关于1MDB丑闻的文章而起诉其诽谤。
description.en: Lee Hsien Loong sued Leong Sze Hian for defamation for sharing an article about the 1MDB scandal.

description.zh-cn: 强烈谴责李显龙就“越南入侵柬埔寨”发表的言论。
description.en: Strongly condemned Lee Hsien Loong's remarks about the "Vietnamese invasion of Cambodia".

description.zh-cn: 朱祁钰是明宣宗的次子。
胡善祥为明宣宗元配皇后，后被废。
朱高煦曾企图在明宣宗即位途中设伏，后于宣德元年（1426年）起兵谋反，是为高煦之乱，最终被明宣宗平定并处死。
description.en: Zhu Gaoxu attempted to ambush the Xuande Emperor on his way to the throne, and later in 1426, he launched a rebellion, known as the Gao Xu's Rebellion, which was eventually suppressed and he was executed by Emperor Xuande.

description.zh-cn: 宣德元年，朱高煦趁北京地震之机，在乐安州谋反，并企图勾结英国公张辅为内应。
description.en: In 1426, Zhu Gaoxu took advantage of an earthquake in Beijing to launch a rebellion in Le'an Prefecture, attempting to collude with Zhang Fu, the Duke of Ying, as an insider.

description.zh-cn: 明宣宗采纳杨荣建议，御驾亲征，迅速抵达乐安，迫使朱高煦出降，平定叛乱。
description.en: Accepting Yang Rong's advice, the Xuande Emperor personally led the campaign, quickly arrived at Le'an, forced Zhu Gaoxu to surrender, and suppressed the rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 宣德元年，明宣宗下令设置内书堂，教导宦官们读书。
黎利在安南反叛明朝统治，并屡次打败明军。
受明宣宗命令执行第七次下西洋任务。
宣德三年，亲率精骑击败入侵边疆的兀良哈军队。
明宣宗死后，何贵妃遭杀害殉葬。
于1940年至1955年担任保守党党魁。
description.en: Served as Leader of the Conservative Party from 1940 to 1955.

description.zh-cn: 两度出任英国首相。
description.en: Served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom twice.

description.zh-cn: 丘吉尔是希特勒和纳粹主义的坚定反对者，并领导同盟国战胜了轴心国。
description.en: Churchill was a staunch opponent of Hitler and Nazism, and led the Allies to victory over the Axis powers.

description.zh-cn: 作为战时首相，丘吉尔通过其演说和领导，鼓舞了英国人民和军队，赢得了不列颠战役。
description.en: As wartime Prime Minister, Churchill inspired the British people and military through his speeches and leadership to win the Battle of Britain.

description.zh-cn: 两人在二战期间建立了密切的个人友谊和政治同盟，对同盟国的胜利至关重要。
description.en: The two leaders developed a close personal friendship and political alliance during World War II, which was crucial for the Allied victory.

description.zh-cn: 艾德礼在丘吉尔的战时联合政府中担任副首相。
description.en: Attlee served as Deputy Prime Minister in Churchill's wartime coalition government.

description.zh-cn: 领导工党在1945年大选中击败丘吉尔领导的保守党，成为新任首相。
description.en: Led the Labour Party to victory over Churchill's Conservative Party in the 1945 general election, becoming the new Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 丘吉尔在乔治六世国王在位期间担任首相。
description.en: Churchill served as Prime Minister during the reign of King George VI.

description.zh-cn: 丘吉尔在伊丽莎白二世女王在位初期担任首相。
description.en: Churchill served as Prime Minister during the early reign of Queen Elizabeth II.

description.zh-cn: 艾登在丘吉尔的第二届政府中担任副首相，并最终接替他成为首相。
description.en: Eden served as Deputy Prime Minister in Churchill's second government and eventually succeeded him as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 时任第一海军大臣的丘吉尔批准并推动了达达尼尔海峡的进攻计划。
description.en: As First Lord of the Admiralty, Churchill approved and pushed the plan to attack the Dardanelles.

description.zh-cn: 战役的失败导致丘吉尔的政治声望严重受损，并被迫辞去第一海军大臣的职务。
description.en: The failure of the campaign severely damaged Churchill's political reputation and forced him to resign as First Lord of the Admiralty.

description.zh-cn: 受刘备白帝城托孤，辅佐后主刘禅，总揽蜀汉军政大事。
description.en: Entrusted by Liu Bei at Baidicheng, he assisted Emperor Liu Shan, overseeing all military and political affairs of Shu Han.

description.zh-cn: 养子关系
description.en: Adoptive relationship

description.zh-cn: 亲生父子关系，后过继给诸葛亮。
description.en: Biological father-son relationship; later adopted by Zhuge Liang.

description.zh-cn: 二人为至交好友。
description.en: They were close friends.

description.zh-cn: 二人为至交好友。
description.en: They were close friends.

description.zh-cn: 曹操在赤壁之战中被孙刘联军大败，统一中国的计划受挫。
description.en: Cao Cao was decisively defeated at the Battle of Red Cliffs, thwarting his ambition to unify China.

description.zh-cn: 为稳定后方，诸葛亮率军南下平定南中叛乱。
description.en: To stabilize the rear, Zhuge Liang led an army south to pacify the Nanzhong rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 孟获作为南中叛军首领被诸葛亮击败并降服。
description.en: As the leader of the Nanzhong rebels, Meng Huo was defeated and subdued by Zhuge Liang.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮为兴复汉室，五次率军北伐曹魏。
description.en: To restore the Han dynasty, Zhuge Liang led five military expeditions north against Cao Wei.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮在第一次北伐前上书刘禅，写下《出师表》。
description.en: Zhuge Liang wrote the 'Chu Shi Biao' as a memorial to Liu Shan before his first Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 在后几次北伐中，诸葛亮与司马懿作为蜀魏双方主帅多次对峙。
description.en: In the later Northern Expeditions, Zhuge Liang and Sima Yi confronted each other multiple times as the commanders of the Shu and Wei armies.

description.zh-cn: 马谡因在街亭之战中处置失当，导致蜀军大败，使得第一次北伐失败。
description.en: Ma Su's mishandling of the Battle of Jieting led to a major defeat for the Shu army, causing the failure of the first Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 因街亭之败，诸葛亮下令处斩马谡。
description.en: Due to the defeat at Jieting, Zhuge Liang ordered the execution of Ma Su.

description.zh-cn: 在第四次北伐撤退过程中，诸葛亮设伏射杀了追击的魏将张郃。
description.en: During the retreat of the fourth Northern Expedition, Zhuge Liang set an ambush and killed the pursuing Wei general Zhang He.

description.zh-cn: 第四次北伐时，李严负责督运粮草，因运粮不继而谎报军情，导致诸葛亮被迫撤军。
description.en: During the fourth Northern Expedition, Li Yan, responsible for grain transport, failed to supply the army and falsely reported military intelligence, forcing Zhuge Liang to retreat.

description.zh-cn: 事后查明真相，诸葛亮上表弹劾李严，将其废为平民，流放梓潼。
description.en: After discovering the truth, Zhuge Liang impeached Li Yan, had him stripped of his posts and titles, and exiled him to Zitong.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮临终前向后主刘禅推荐蒋琬作为自己的继承人。

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮临终前在蒋琬之后，推荐费祎作为第二继承人。

description.zh-cn: 因恐惧与太后私通事发，吕不韦找到嫪毐，将其伪装成宦官送入宫中侍奉太后，以转移太后的注意。

description.zh-cn: 在秦庄襄王去世、嬴政（即后来的秦始皇）年幼继位后，吕不韦曾与太后赵姬私通。
description.en: After King Zhuangxiang's death and during the young King Zheng's reign, Lü Buwei had an illicit affair with the Queen Dowager Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 珍珠港事件直接导致美国向日本宣战，正式加入第二次世界大战。

description.zh-cn: 罗斯福对战后世界秩序的构想中包括成立联合国，并发挥了关键作用。

指挥桂系军队在此战役中对解放军进行反击并获胜。
蒋经国派人检查白崇禧的住所，显示其在台受到严密监控。
谷正文回忆曾策划在白崇禧的补药中动手脚，导致其死亡。
在1968年美国总统选举中击败汉弗莱。
description.en: Defeated Humphrey in the 1968 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 在1972年美国总统选举中以压倒性优势击败麦戈文。
description.en: Defeated McGovern in a landslide in the 1972 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 作为美国总统对中华人民共和国进行历史性访问。
description.en: As President of the United States, made a historic visit to the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 与苏联等共产主义国家实施缓和政策，签订了SALT I和反弹道导弹条约。
description.en: Implemented the policy of détente with communist nations like the Soviet Union, signing the SALT I and Anti-Ballistic Missile treaties.

description.zh-cn: 访问莫斯科，与苏联领导人勃列日涅夫等人会面，展开激烈谈判。
description.en: Visited Moscow and met with Soviet leader Brezhnev and others for intense negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 水门事件的不断发酵导致尼克松失去政治支持，最终迫使他辞去总统职务。
description.en: The unfolding Watergate scandal caused Nixon to lose political support, ultimately forcing him to resign from the presidency.

description.zh-cn: 在尼克松辞职后，福特总统宣布给予其全面、自由且绝对的赦免。
description.en: After Nixon's resignation, President Ford granted him a full, free, and absolute pardon.

description.zh-cn: 作为众议院非美活动委员会成员，以调查阿尔杰·希斯间谍案而引起全国性关注，并坚信希斯是苏联间谍。
description.en: As a member of the House Un-American Activities Committee, he gained national attention for investigating the Alger Hiss spy case, believing Hiss was a Soviet spy.

position.en: National Security Advisor, Secretary of State

description.zh-cn: 在尼克松政府中担任关键外交职务。
description.en: Held key foreign policy positions in the Nixon administration.

description.zh-cn: 越战是尼克松总统任期内的主要挑战，他推行“越南化”政策以逐步撤军，但战争和国内反战运动给其政府带来巨大压力。
description.en: The Vietnam War was a major challenge of Nixon's presidency; he pursued "Vietnamization" to withdraw troops, but the war and domestic anti-war movements placed immense pressure on his administration.

在郝萌反叛时，倒戈对抗郝萌并斩其一臂。
挑拨吕布与袁术的关系，导致吕布与袁术终断盟约。
成功与曹操联络，作为曹操的内应以讨伐吕布。
于下邳之战中击败吕布，并将其缢杀。

贺兰氏后被武则天所杀。

description.zh-cn: 在唐高宗朝担任宰相。

position.zh-cn: 中书令、吏部尚书同中书门下三品、尚书右仆射

description.zh-cn: 在唐高宗朝担任宰相。

position.zh-cn: 中书侍郎参知政事、中书令、吏部尚书同中书门下三品、右相

description.zh-cn: 在唐高宗朝担任宰相。
发动昌都战役，向昌都进军。
description.en: Launched the Battle of Chamdo, advancing on Chamdo.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在昌都战役中击败藏军。
description.en: The People's Liberation Army defeated the Tibetan Army in the Battle of Chamdo.

description.zh-cn: 中情局西藏项目向藏人行政中央及相关武装活动提供资金支持，以对抗中国政府。
description.en: The CIA's Tibet program provided financial support to the Central Tibetan Administration and related armed activities to oppose the Chinese government.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件后，挪威诺贝尔委员会授予丹增嘉措诺贝尔和平奖，部分原因是为了对中国政府施加压力。
description.en: After the Tiananmen Square protests, the Norwegian Nobel Committee awarded the Nobel Peace Prize to Tenzin Gyatso, partly to exert pressure on the Chinese government.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀是人民行动党的创始人之一。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew was one of the founders of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 吴作栋在李光耀担任总理期间任副总理，后接任总理。
description.en: Goh Chok Tong served as Deputy Prime Minister under Lee Kuan Yew before succeeding him as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀在吴作栋担任总理期间任国务资政。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew served as Senior Minister in the cabinet during Goh Chok Tong's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀带领新加坡政府，配合马来亚及英国殖民政府发起“冷藏行动”，拘捕了大量左翼人士。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew led the Singapore government, in cooperation with Malayan and British colonial authorities, to launch Operation Coldstore, arresting numerous left-wing figures.

description.zh-cn: 林清祥在冷藏行动中被逮捕关押。
description.en: Lim Chin Siong was arrested and detained during Operation Coldstore.

description.zh-cn: 1961年，行动党内以李光耀为首的“反共分子”与以林清祥为代表的“亲共分子”决裂。
description.en: In 1961, the anti-communist faction led by Lee Kuan Yew split with the pro-communist faction represented by Lim Chin Siong within the PAP.

description.zh-cn: 在新马合并后，李光耀与东姑阿都拉曼在多项政策上产生严重分歧，最终导致新加坡被逐出马来西亚。
description.en: After the merger of Singapore and Malaya, Lee Kuan Yew had serious disagreements with Tunku Abdul Rahman on multiple policies, leading to Singapore's expulsion from Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀对邓小平十分尊重，两人在1978年首次会面后建立了良好关系。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew held Deng Xiaoping in high regard, and the two established a good relationship after their first meeting in 1978.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀于1976年首次访华，会晤了毛泽东。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew met Mao Zedong during his first visit to China in 1976.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀与时任中华民国总统蒋经国私交甚笃，此深厚友谊是促成新加坡军队移至台湾训练的重要原因之一。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew had a very good personal relationship with then-President of the Republic of China, Chiang Ching-kuo. This close personal friendship was one of the key reasons for facilitating the training of Singaporean troops in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀与李登辉的交往从密切转向分歧，李光耀后来指责李登辉。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew's relationship with Lee Teng-hui shifted from close to divergent, with Lee Kuan Yew later criticizing him.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀政府推行以英语为第一语言的教育政策，最终导致以华文教学的南洋大学在1980年关闭。
description.en: The Lee Kuan Yew government's policy of promoting English as the first language led to the closure of the Chinese-medium Nanyang University in 1980.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀政府使用《内部安全法令》将谢太宝未经审判监禁与软禁长达32年。
description.en: The Lee Kuan Yew government used the Internal Security Act to imprison and place Chia Thye Poh under restriction for 32 years without trial.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀以诽谤罪起诉反对党领袖邓亮洪，迫使其潜逃出国。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew sued opposition leader Tang Liang Hong for defamation, forcing him to flee the country.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪在其文章中提到他经常与李光耀交锋，是政治上的对手。
description.en: In his writings, Mahathir mentioned that he often crossed swords with Lee Kuan Yew, indicating a political rivalry.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀促成了两岸历史性的辜汪会谈在新加坡举行。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew facilitated the historic Wang-Koo summit between the two sides of the Taiwan Strait to be held in Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 王义川担任民进党政策委员会执行长期间，赖清德为党主席。

参加业余唱片骑师大赛获亚军后加入。
赏识并邀请周慧敏参与电影演出，后推荐其到唱片公司试音。
鼓励周慧敏参加香港电台主办的业余唱片骑师大赛。

在香港电台合作主持节目《二人世界》，并多次在音乐上合作。
加盟台湾福茂唱片，开拓国语市场。
为周慧敏的热播代表作《如果你知我苦衷》作曲。
与林隆璇合唱国语歌曲《流言》。
好友关系，古巨基曾担任其演唱会创作总监。
徐志摩在英国剑桥大学期间遇到林徽因，并产生爱慕之情。
徐志摩拜梁启超为师。
劝阻其与陆小曼的恋情，并在他们的婚礼上当众训斥。
徐志摩搭乘的飞机在济南附近坠毁，导致其罹难。
在胡佛总统任期内担任美国陆军参谋长。
description.en: Served as Chief of Staff of the United States Army during President Hoover's term.

description.zh-cn: 在罗斯福总统任期内担任美国陆军参谋长和二战指挥官。
description.en: Served as Chief of Staff of the United States Army and a commander in World War II during President Roosevelt's term.

description.zh-cn: 在韩战战略上与杜鲁门总统存在严重分歧，并公然反对其政策，最终导致被解职。
description.en: Had serious disagreements with President Truman over Korean War strategy, openly opposing his policies, which led to his dismissal.

description.zh-cn: 1903年以第一名的成绩毕业于西点军校。
description.en: Graduated first in his class from West Point in 1903.

description.zh-cn: 担任西点军校校长并推行了一系列改革。
description.en: Served as Superintendent of West Point and implemented a series of reforms.

description.zh-cn: 在胡佛总统命令下，指挥军队暴力驱逐了在华盛顿抗议的退伍军人。
description.en: Under President Hoover's orders, he commanded troops to forcibly disperse protesting veterans in Washington.

description.zh-cn: 不顾高层普遍反对，坚决策划并执行了仁川登陆，扭转了韩战局势。
description.en: Despite widespread opposition from high command, he planned and executed the Incheon Landing, turning the tide of the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民志愿军入朝作战，在清川江战役和长津湖战役中击败了麦克阿瑟指挥的联合国军，迫使其大规模撤退。
description.en: The Chinese People's Volunteer Army entered the Korean War and defeated the UN forces under MacArthur's command in the Battle of the Ch'ongch'on River and the Battle of Chosin Reservoir, forcing a major retreat.

description.zh-cn: 杜鲁门总统解除了麦克阿瑟在远东的所有职务，结束了他的军事生涯。
description.en: President Truman relieved MacArthur of all his commands in the Far East, ending his military career.

description.zh-cn: 作为驻日盟军总司令，主导了日本的战后民主化和非军事化改革。
description.en: As Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, he led the post-war democratization and demilitarization reforms of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 曾长期担任麦克阿瑟的副官；1935年，随麦克阿瑟来到菲律宾，担任菲律宾政府军事顾问。
description.en: Served as MacArthur's aide for an extended period; in 1935, he accompanied MacArthur to the Philippines to serve as a military advisor to the Philippine government.

description.zh-cn: 接任第8军团司令，在麦克阿瑟指挥下作战，后接替其联合国军总司令职务。
description.en: Took command of the Eighth Army, fighting under MacArthur's overall command, and later succeeded him as UN Commander.

description.zh-cn: 在一战期间，麦克阿瑟因越级抗议而得罪了远征军司令潘兴，由此结怨。
description.en: During World War I, MacArthur offended AEF Commander Pershing by protesting over his head, creating a lasting enmity.

description.zh-cn: 明宪宗极度宠信比他年长17岁的万贵妃，万贵妃去世后，宪宗因悲伤过度而病逝。
description.en: The Chenghua Emperor was extremely infatuated with Imperial Noble Consort Wan, who was 17 years his senior. After her death, the emperor fell ill from grief and died soon after.

description.zh-cn: 土木堡之变中明英宗被俘，导致朱见深被立为太子。
description.en: After Emperor Yingzong was captured in the Tumu Crisis, Zhu Jianshen was made the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 景泰三年（1452年），朱祁钰废黜了时为太子的朱见深（后来的明宪宗），将其废为沂王，并改立自己的儿子朱见济为太子。
description.en: In the third year of the Jingtai era (1452), Emperor Zhu Qiyu deposed the then Crown Prince Zhu Jianshen (later the Chenghua Emperor), demoting him to Prince of Yi, and appointed his own son, Zhu Jianji, as the new crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 成化二年，下诏为于谦平反昭雪，恢复其官职并赐祭。
description.en: Upon ascending the throne, he posthumously rehabilitated Yu Qian.

description.zh-cn: 任用李贤为内阁首辅等贤臣。
description.en: Appointed capable ministers like Li Xian, who served as Grand Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 设立西厂以加强特务统治。
description.en: Established the Western Depot to strengthen secret police rule.

description.zh-cn: 将汪直调离京城，并解散西厂。
description.en: Transferred Wang Zhi out of the capital and disbanded the Western Depot.

description.zh-cn: 在房县大石厂立黄旗起义，为郧阳民变的首领之一。
description.en: Raised a yellow banner and started an uprising at Dashi Factory in Fang County, becoming one of the leaders of the Yunyang refugee rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 受明宪宗派遣，讨伐并平定了郧阳民变。
description.en: Dispatched by the Chenghua Emperor, he campaigned against and suppressed the Yunyang refugee rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 成化年间，明朝与朝鲜联手进攻建州女真。
description.en: During the Chenghua era, the Ming and Joseon dynasties jointly attacked the Jianzhou Jurchens.

description.zh-cn: 1997年10月8日至2011年12月17日担任朝鲜劳动党总书记。
description.en: Served as General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea from October 8, 1997, to December 17, 2011.

description.en: Served as First Vice Chairman from 1990 to 1993, and as Chairman from 1993 to 2011.

description.zh-cn: 金正日于1997年发动了“深化组事件”清洗运动。
description.en: Kim Jong-il initiated the 'Deepening Group Incident' purge in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 普京访问朝鲜时举行会谈。
description.en: Held talks when Putin visited North Korea.

description.zh-cn: 金正日对中华人民共和国进行非正式访问。
description.en: Kim Jong-il made an unofficial visit to the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 金正日对中华人民共和国进行了多次非正式访问。
description.en: Kim Jong-il made multiple unofficial visits to the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 会晤并签署《日朝平壤宣言》，金正日承认并就绑架日本人问题道歉。
description.en: Met and signed the Japan–North Korea Pyongyang Declaration, where Kim Jong-il admitted to and apologized for the abduction of Japanese citizens.

description.zh-cn: 克林顿访问朝鲜协调释放美国记者事宜。
description.en: Clinton visited North Korea to coordinate the release of American journalists.

description.zh-cn: 在小布什任内，朝美关系陷入了僵局和对立。
description.en: During George W. Bush's presidency, US-North Korea relations reached a stalemate and were confrontational.

description.zh-cn: 金正男因2001年持假护照访问日本而失宠，丧失继承可能性，后有传闻称其曾遭金正日、金正恩父子暗杀。
description.en: Kim Jong-nam fell out of favor after a 2001 incident involving a fake passport to visit Japan, losing the possibility of succession. It was later rumored he was targeted for assassination by Kim Jong-il and Kim Jong-un.

description.zh-cn: 根据脱北者说法，金正日策划或指挥了1983年仰光爆炸事件。
description.en: According to defectors, Kim Jong-il planned or commanded the 1983 Rangoon bombing.

description.zh-cn: 根据脱北者说法，金正日策划或指挥了1987年大韩航空858号班机空难。
description.en: According to defectors, Kim Jong-il planned or commanded the bombing of Korean Air Flight 858 in 1987.

description.zh-cn: 金正日授意绑架韩国女演员崔银姬。
description.en: Kim Jong-il ordered the abduction of South Korean actress Choi Eun-hee.

description.zh-cn: 仰光爆炸事件是一次针对韩国总统全斗焕的未遂刺杀。
description.en: The Rangoon bombing was an unsuccessful assassination attempt against South Korean President Chun Doo-hwan.

description.zh-cn: 裕仁是大正天皇的长子。
description.en: Hirohito was the eldest son of Emperor Taishō.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇是明治天皇的第三子。

description.zh-cn: 在盟军占领日本期间，麦克阿瑟作为驻日盟军总司令实际掌控日本政权。
description.en: During the Allied occupation of Japan, MacArthur, as the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, effectively controlled the Japanese government.

description.zh-cn: 在虎之门事件中试图行刺摄政的裕仁。

description.zh-cn: 在樱田门事件中试图行刺裕仁。
description.en: Attempted to assassinate Emperor Hirohito in the Sakuradamon Incident.

description.zh-cn: 容忍关东军的行动并授权了对锦州的空袭。

description.zh-cn: 批准出兵中国的决议，并下令歼灭北京、天津的中国军队。

description.zh-cn: 作为上海派遣军司令，颁布了“杀掉全部俘获人员”的命令。

description.zh-cn: 因朝香宫鸠彦王攻克南京的“战绩”对其大加赞赏并予以褒奖。

description.en: After Lenin's death, Stalin engaged in a power struggle with Trotsky, eventually exiling and assassinating him.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林在与托洛茨基的斗争中曾与加米涅夫结盟，后将其作为“新反对派”清除。
description.en: Stalin allied with Kamenev against Trotsky, but later eliminated him as part of the 'New Opposition'.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林在与托洛茨基的斗争中曾与季诺维也夫结盟，后将其作为“新反对派”清除。
description.en: Stalin allied with Zinoviev against Trotsky, but later eliminated him as part of the 'New Opposition'.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林在清除“左派”后，将支持新经济政策的布哈林作为右倾投降主义集团清除。
description.en: After eliminating the 'Left Opposition', Stalin purged Bukharin, who supported the NEP, as a 'Right Deviation'.

description.zh-cn: 列宁在遗嘱中建议将斯大林从总书记的职位上调开，称其“太粗暴”。
description.en: In his testament, Lenin recommended removing Stalin from the post of General Secretary, calling him 'too rude'.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林强制推行农业集体化政策以解决粮食短缺问题并消灭富农阶级。
description.en: Stalin forced the policy of agricultural collectivization to solve grain shortages and eliminate the kulak class.

description.zh-cn: 强制集体化和过高的粮食征购导致了大规模饥荒。
description.en: Forced collectivization and excessive grain procurement led to a massive famine.

description.zh-cn: 以基洛夫被刺杀为契机，斯大林发动了对党、政、军的大规模清洗。
description.en: Using the assassination of Kirov as a pretext, Stalin launched a large-scale purge of the party, government, and military.

description.zh-cn: 托洛茨基及其支持者是斯大林大清洗的主要目标之一。
description.en: Trotsky and his supporters were one of the main targets of Stalin's Great Purge.

description.zh-cn: 签订《苏德互不侵犯条约》，形成暂时性合作关系。
description.en: Signed the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact, forming a temporary cooperative relationship.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国入侵苏联后，双方成为战争中的主要对手。
description.en: After Nazi Germany invaded the Soviet Union, the two became major adversaries in the war.

description.zh-cn: 该条约使德国得以入侵波兰而无后顾之忧，从而引发了第二次世界大战。
description.en: The pact allowed Germany to invade Poland without fear of a two-front war, triggering World War II.

description.zh-cn: 二战后，斯大林在东欧扶植社会主义阵营，形成了东方集团。

description.zh-cn: 作为东方集团的领导人，斯大林与西方国家展开对峙，形成冷战格局。
description.en: As the leader of the Eastern Bloc, Stalin engaged in a standoff with Western countries, leading to the Cold War.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，斯大林领导的苏联与中国结盟。

description.en: This speech marked the beginning of the de-Stalinization campaign.

description.zh-cn: 该运动旨在清除斯大林的个人崇拜和政治影响。

张学友与罗美薇于1986年因拍摄电影《痴心的我》相识，1996年在伦敦注册结婚。
description.en: Jacky Cheung and May Lo met in 1986 while filming "Devoted to You" and married in London in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 张学智是张学友的哥哥。
description.en: Zhang Xuezhi is Jacky Cheung's elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 因张学智于1993年在澳门豪赌欠下巨债后失踪，张学友代为偿还后两人决裂。
description.en: The relationship soured after Zhang Xuezhi disappeared in 1993 with huge gambling debts in Macau, which Jacky Cheung paid off.

description.zh-cn: 张学友获得首届十八区业余歌唱大赛冠军，从而进入歌坛。
description.en: Jacky Cheung won the first 18-District Amateur Singing Contest, which launched his career in the music industry.

description.zh-cn: 张学友于1999-2000年及2015年至今为环球唱片旗下歌手，环球唱片也是其经纪公司。
description.en: Jacky Cheung was an artist under Universal Music from 1999-2000 and from 2015 to the present. Universal Music is also his management company.

description.zh-cn: 出道后的张学友被陈自强看重，并在影坛刻意栽培。两人于1990年代中期结束经理人合约。
description.en: After his debut, Jacky Cheung was scouted by Willie Chan, who cultivated his film career. They ended their management contract in the mid-1990s.

description.zh-cn: 1992年与刘德华、黎明、郭富城被香港媒体获封为“四大天王”。
description.en: In 1992, he was named one of the "Four Heavenly Kings" by the Hong Kong media, along with Andy Lau, Leon Lai, and Aaron Kwok.

description.zh-cn: 张学友凭借在电影《旺角卡门》中的表演获得第8届香港电影金像奖最佳男配角，其演技开始受到瞩目。
description.en: Jacky Cheung's performance in "As Tears Go By" earned him the Best Supporting Actor award at the 8th Hong Kong Film Awards, bringing his acting skills to prominence.

description.zh-cn: 王家卫执导的《旺角卡门》让张学友的演技受到瞩目，此后张学友成为王家卫的御用演员之一。
description.en: Wong Kar-wai's direction in "As Tears Go By" brought attention to Jacky Cheung's acting, and he subsequently became one of Wong's regular actors.

description.zh-cn: 张学友参与策划、导演并主演了原创音乐剧《雪狼湖》。
description.en: Jacky Cheung was involved in the planning, directing, and starring of the original musical "Snow.Wolf.Lake".

description.zh-cn: 由于HKRIA与TVB的版税纠纷，作为环球唱片旗下歌手的张学友的歌曲被禁止出现在TVB的媒介中，对其宣传造成困难。
description.en: Due to the copyright dispute between HKRIA and TVB, Jacky Cheung's songs, as an artist under Universal Music, were banned from TVB media, causing difficulties for his promotion.

description.zh-cn: 张学友是梅艳芳的挚友，在她逝世后，其兄透露张学友曾秘密垫付其大部分医药费。
description.en: Jacky Cheung was a close friend of Anita Mui. After her death, her brother revealed that Cheung had secretly paid for most of her medical expenses.

description.zh-cn: 两人在1990年代早期合作多部经典港产片，配合默契，日后成为密友。
description.en: The two collaborated on several classic Hong Kong films in the early 1990s, had great chemistry, and later became close friends.

description.zh-cn: 张学友曾资助好友柯受良完成飞跃黄河的壮举。
description.en: Jacky Cheung funded his friend Blacky Ko to complete the stunt of jumping over the Yellow River.

description.zh-cn: 陈奕迅被外界认为是张学友的接班人，张学友曾称赞其应为“E神”。
description.en: Eason Chan is considered by the public to be Jacky Cheung's successor. Cheung once praised him as the "E-God" (Eason).

description.zh-cn: 胡枫是张学友的契爸（干爹）。
description.en: Wu Fung is Jacky Cheung's godfather.

description.zh-cn: 毛宁之父毛贻发与毛泽东之父毛贻昌同属贻字辈，毛宁被媒体称为毛泽东的堂妹。

description.en: Shao Ren Me was the elder brother of Run Run Shaw, also known as 'Third elder brother'.

description.zh-cn: 与兄长邵仁枚共同创立邵氏公司，并于1957年在香港成立邵氏兄弟（香港）有限公司。
description.en: Co-founded the Shaw Organisation with his brother Shaw Vee Meng, and established Shaw Brothers (Hong Kong) Limited in Hong Kong in 1957.

description.en: Co-founded with Run Run Shaw, Harold Lee, and others

description.en: Run Run Shaw served as the Managing Director while Harold Lee was the Chairman of Television Broadcasts Limited.

description.zh-cn: 邹文怀离开邵氏另立嘉禾电影，成为邵氏的主要竞争对手。
description.en: Raymond Chow left Shaw Brothers to establish Golden Harvest, becoming a major competitor to Shaw.

description.en: Run Run Shaw rejected a collaboration with Bruce Lee due to his high salary demands, leading Lee to join rival Golden Harvest.

description.zh-cn: 战争波及东南亚，邵氏兄弟的电影事业大受打击。
description.en: The war spread to Southeast Asia, and the Shaw brothers' film business was severely impacted.

description.zh-cn: 捐出1.1亿港元为香港中文大学兴建逸夫书院。
description.en: Donated HK$110 million to The Chinese University of Hong Kong to build Shaw College.

description.zh-cn: 册封邵逸夫为下级勋位爵士。
description.en: Knighted Run Run Shaw as a Knight Bachelor.

description.en: In consortium with Charles Chan and others, acquired the 26% stake in TVB held by Shaw Brothers, leading to Shaw's complete withdrawal from TVB's operations.

description.zh-cn: 迫使清源军纳土归降

description.zh-cn: 灭亡北汉

description.en: By conquering the Northern Han, he ended the era of warlordism and the Wars of the Reunification of the Northern Song.

description.zh-cn: 发动两次北伐攻打辽国，均告失败
description.en: Launched two northern expeditions against the Liao, both of which ended in failure.

description.zh-cn: 在高粱河之战中射伤宋太宗大腿，宋太宗的死因是箭伤复发
description.en: Wounded Emperor Taizong in the thigh with an arrow during the Battle of Gaoliang River; the emperor's later death was caused by the recurrence of this wound.

description.zh-cn: 试图兼并交趾但惨败

description.zh-cn: 宋军在此战中失败，导致统一交趾的计划失败
description.en: The Song army was defeated in this battle, leading to the failure of the plan to conquer Jiaozhi.

description.en: After Emperor Taizong's death, Lü Duan promptly saw through and thwarted Wang Ji'en's coup plot, thus ensuring Crown Prince Zhao Heng (Emperor Zhenzong)'s smooth accession.

description.en: After Emperor Taizong's death, he attempted to install Zhao Yuanzuo as emperor, obstructing Emperor Zhenzong's accession.

description.en: Was expelled from the party for her criticism of Xi Jinping and has openly criticized him.

description.en: The China-U.S. trade war impacted Sino-U.S. relations and the economy during Xi Jinping's term.

description.zh-cn: 狄仁杰在唐高宗时期担任官员。

description.zh-cn: 阎立本发现狄仁杰的才能并推荐了他。
description.en: Yan Liben discovered Di Renjie's talent and recommended him.

description.en: Wu Chengsi colluded with Lai Junchen to falsely accuse Di Renjie of rebellion, leading to his imprisonment.

description.zh-cn: 来俊臣诬陷狄仁杰谋反，将其逮捕下狱。
description.en: Lai Junchen framed Di Renjie for rebellion and had him arrested and imprisoned.

description.zh-cn: 劝说武则天顺应民心，还政于庐陵王李显，使李唐得以维系。
description.en: Persuaded Wu Zetian to follow the will of the people and restore power to Li Xian, Prince of Luling, thus preserving the Tang lineage.

description.zh-cn: 娄师德在狄仁杰未入相时曾经举荐他。
description.en: Lou Shide recommended Di Renjie before he became chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 狄仁杰在当上宰相后，因不知娄师德曾举荐自己而排挤他。
description.en: After becoming chancellor, unaware that Lou Shide had recommended him, Di Renjie sidelined him.

description.zh-cn: 狄仁杰在武则天时代的贡献为后来的开元盛世奠定了基础。
description.en: Di Renjie's contributions during the Wu Zetian era laid the foundation for the subsequent Kaiyuan Flourishing Age.

description.zh-cn: 举荐了张柬之等数十位干练的官员。

description.zh-cn: 举荐了姚崇等数十位干练的官员。

description.zh-cn: 上谏劝阻武则天停止建造耗资巨大的浮屠大像。

description.en: Zhuangzi's thought inherited and developed Laozi's thought; his doctrine is fundamentally based on Laozi's words.

description.zh-cn: 庄周与孟子是同时代的人物。
description.en: Zhuangzi and Mencius were contemporaries.

description.zh-cn: 庄子为宋国蒙人。
description.en: Zhuangzi was a native of Meng in the state of Song.

description.zh-cn: 于天宝初年下诏，追封庄周为南华真人。
description.en: In the early Tianbao era, he issued an edict to posthumously honor Zhuang Zhou as Nanhua Zhenren.

description.zh-cn: 追封庄周为“微妙元通真君”。
description.en: Posthumously honored Zhuang Zhou as 'Weimiao Yuantong Zhenjun'.

description.zh-cn: 庄周与魏惠王是同时代的人物。
description.en: Zhuangzi and King Hui of Wei were contemporaries.

description.zh-cn: 庄周与齐宣王是同时代的人物。
description.en: Zhuangzi and King Xuan of Qi were contemporaries.

description.zh-cn: 庄周和惠施交好。
description.en: Zhuangzi and Hui Shi were good friends.

description.zh-cn: 曾派人邀请庄周为楚国宰相。
description.en: Once sent emissaries to invite Zhuangzi to serve as the chancellor of Chu.

description.zh-cn: 以“泥中之龟”为喻，拒绝了楚威王的邀请。
description.en: He refused King Wei of Chu's invitation using the metaphor of a 'turtle in the mud'.

description.zh-cn: 创作了《庄子》一书，阐述其哲学思想。
description.en: Authored the book 'Zhuangzi' to expound his philosophical ideas.

description.zh-cn: 批评儒家的“仁义”违背人性，反对其等级观念和礼法治国。
description.en: Criticized Confucian concepts of 'benevolence and righteousness' as being against human nature, and opposed its hierarchical concepts and rule by rites.

description.zh-cn: 反对法家以法律治国的主张。
description.en: Opposed the Legalist proposition of governing by law.

description.zh-cn: 借盗跖之口批评孔子是“鲁之巧伪人”。
description.en: Through the voice of the character Robber Zhi, criticized Confucius as a 'cunning and hypocritical man of Lu'.

description.zh-cn: 在晋代注释《庄子》，可能在编辑过程中删去部分篇章，形成了现存的33篇版本。
description.en: Commented on 'Zhuangzi' during the Jin Dynasty and may have deleted some chapters during the editing process, resulting in the extant 33-chapter version.

description.en: Gong Li and Zhang Yimou met and fell in love during the filming of 'Red Sorghum'. They had an eight-year romantic relationship, collaborated on several films, and broke up in 1995.

description.zh-cn: 因拍摄《千里走单骑》结下友谊。
description.en: Became friends during the filming of 'Riding Alone for Thousands of Miles'.

description.zh-cn: 在《金陵十三钗》后，与合作16年的制片人张伟平因“矛盾”终止了合作。
description.en: After 'The Flowers of War', he terminated his 16-year collaboration with producer Zhang Weiping due to 'contradictions'.

description.zh-cn: 因与妻子陈婷在婚前育有三名子女，违反了计划生育政策，被媒体曝光后，于2014年被征收社会抚养费共计748万余元。
description.en: He violated the family planning policy by having three children with his wife Chen Ting before marriage. After being exposed by the media, he was fined a total of over 7.48 million RMB in social support fees in 2014.

description.zh-cn: 长子
跟随毛泽东参加秋收起义。
在长征途中举荐起用张宗逊。
在大同集宁战役中，张宗逊率部与傅作义部交战后惨败。
在西北野战军和第一野战军期间，担任司令员彭德怀的副手。
张宗逊在文化大革命期间遭受迫害，被冠以“罗瑞卿的同伙、彭德怀的黑干将、贺龙的心腹”等罪名。
毛泽东向黄永胜询问张宗逊去向，促使其被任命为济南军区副司令员。
介绍张宗逊与杜芳结婚。
长期兼任中央警卫局局长，负责党主席毛泽东的警卫安全，是毛泽东的亲信。
汪东兴在文化大革命开始后逐步受到重用，权力在文革中后期快速提升。
作为主要决策和执行者之一，参与并领导了抓捕四人帮的行动。
邓小平等中共元老在权力斗争中获胜，导致坚持“两个凡是”的汪东兴失势并被迫辞去领导职务。
邓小平等中共元老在权力斗争中获胜，导致坚持“两个凡是”的汪东兴失势并被迫辞去领导职务。
汪东兴在会上受到严肃批评，被免除中共中央办公厅主任职务。
作为“凡是派”的主要领导人之一，支持“两个凡是”的主张。
联合陈云、胡耀邦等人指责“两个凡是”是“极左路线错误”，并推动“实践是检验真理的唯一标准”的讨论，最终取代了“凡是派”的领导地位。
负责整个南巡的安全工作，在主要地点具体安排保卫任务，挫败了林彪集团的暗杀计划。
在1971年毛泽东南巡期间负责安保工作，挫败了林彪集团的暗杀毛泽东计划。
汪东兴接替杨尚昆担任中共中央办公厅主任。
姚依林接替汪东兴担任中共中央办公厅主任。
夏侯氏在200年被张飞所得，成为其妻。
张苞是张飞的长子。
张绍是张飞的次子。
张遵是张苞的儿子。
夏侯氏是夏侯渊的侄女。
吕布袭取下邳，与刘备、张飞交战。
张飞与下邳相曹豹不和，后将其杀死。
在长坂坡之战中，张飞率二十骑据水断桥，阻挡了曹操的追兵。
张飞在攻打益州时生擒严颜，因钦佩其气节而释放并待为上宾。
张飞在巴西之战中击败张郃。
在下辨之战中，张飞所部被曹洪击败。
张达作为张飞的帐下将领，与范彊一同刺杀了张飞。
刘巴看不起出身武人的张飞，不愿与其交谈。
在汉中之战期间，刘备分遣张飞、马超、吴兰等攻取武都。
毕业于其前身爱德华七世医药学院。
description.en: Graduated from its predecessor, the King Edward VII College of Medicine.

description.zh-cn: 因在五一三事件后公开批评时任首相东姑阿都拉曼而被巫统开除。
description.en: Expelled from UMNO for openly criticizing then-Prime Minister Tunku Abdul Rahman after the 13 May incident.

description.zh-cn: 在胡先翁担任首相期间，马哈迪是其副手。
description.en: Mahathir was Hussein Onn's deputy during his premiership.

description.zh-cn: 1998年亚洲金融危机期间，马哈迪因政策分歧革除了安华的副首相职务，两人关系破裂并成为长期的政治对手。他们曾在2018年短暂结盟，但在2020年政治危机后关系再度破裂。
description.en: During the 1998 Asian financial crisis, Mahathir dismissed Anwar as Deputy Prime Minister over policy differences, leading to a breakdown in their relationship and making them long-term political rivals. They formed a brief alliance in 2018 but their relationship broke down again after the 2020 political crisis.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪退休后，开始批评他亲自挑选的继任者阿都拉·巴达威的政策。
description.en: After retiring, Mahathir began to criticize the policies of his handpicked successor, Abdullah Ahmad Badawi.

description.zh-cn: 因一个马来西亚发展有限公司丑闻（1MDB）而成为纳吉的激烈批评者，并领导反对派推翻其政府。
description.en: Became a fierce critic of Najib over the 1MDB scandal and led the opposition to overthrow his government.

description.zh-cn: 该丑闻是导致纳吉·阿都拉萨政府在2018年大选中失败的关键因素。
description.en: The scandal was a key factor in the defeat of Najib Razak's government in the 2018 general election.

description.zh-cn: 在2020年政治危机中，慕尤丁领导土著团结党退出希望联盟，导致马哈迪政府垮台，两人关系破裂。
description.en: During the 2020 political crisis, Muhyiddin led Bersatu out of Pakatan Harapan, causing the collapse of Mahathir's government and the breakdown of their relationship.

description.zh-cn: 在2016年退出巫统后，马哈迪与慕尤丁等人共同创立了土著团结党。
description.en: After leaving UMNO in 2016, Mahathir co-founded Bersatu with Muhyiddin Yassin and others.

description.zh-cn: 在被土著团结党开除党籍后，马哈迪于2020年8月宣布成立新政党“祖国斗士党”。
description.en: After being expelled from Bersatu, Mahathir announced the formation of a new party, Pejuang, in August 2020.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪宣布创立祖国行动联盟以参加第15届全国大选。
description.en: Mahathir announced the establishment of Gerakan Tanah Air to contest in the 15th general election.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪监督了汽车制造商宝腾的成立，这是一个马来西亚政府与三菱的合资企业。
description.en: Mahathir oversaw the establishment of car manufacturer Proton, a joint venture between the Malaysian government and Mitsubishi.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪于1982年初宣布“向东学习”政策，即向日本和韩国学习现代化模式。
description.en: In early 1982, Mahathir announced the "Look East Policy", learning from the modernization models of Japan and South Korea.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪于1991年宣布了“2020年宏愿”，目标是让马来西亚在30年内成为发达国家。
description.en: In 1991, Mahathir announced "Wawasan 2020", with the goal of making Malaysia a developed nation within 30 years.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪领导的希望联盟在选举中获胜，使其再次出任首相。
description.en: The Pakatan Harapan coalition led by Mahathir won the election, allowing him to become Prime Minister again.

description.zh-cn: 该政治危机导致马哈迪辞去首相职务，其领导的希望联盟政府垮台。
description.en: The political crisis led to Mahathir's resignation as Prime Minister and the collapse of his Pakatan Harapan government.

description.zh-cn: 两人在担任首相期间多次会面解决双边问题，关系复杂，既有合作也有纠纷。
description.en: The two met multiple times during their premierships to resolve bilateral issues; their relationship was complex, involving both cooperation and disputes.

description.zh-cn: 习近平与马哈迪通话，马哈迪对新冠肺炎疫情表示慰问，习近平称马哈迪为“中国人民的老朋友”。
description.en: Xi Jinping and Mahathir had a phone call where Mahathir expressed sympathy regarding the COVID-19 pandemic, and Xi referred to Mahathir as an "old friend of the Chinese people".

description.zh-cn: 朱祐杬是明孝宗的异母弟，明世宗是明孝宗之侄。
description.en: Zhu Youyuan was the half-brother of the Hongzhi Emperor, making the Jiajing Emperor the nephew of the Hongzhi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明武宗驾崩后，作为内阁首辅议定由朱厚熜入继大统。
description.en: After the death of the Zhengde Emperor, as Grand Secretary, he arranged for Zhu Houcong to succeed to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 明武宗驾崩后，与杨廷和共同议定由朱厚熜入继大统。
description.en: After the death of the Zhengde Emperor, she and Yang Tinghe arranged for Zhu Houcong to succeed to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 坚持追尊自己的生父为皇帝，引发了大礼议之争。
description.en: Insisted on posthumously honoring his biological father as emperor, triggering the Great Rites Controversy.

description.zh-cn: 率领群臣反对明世宗追尊生父，要求明世宗改以明孝宗为父。
description.en: Led court officials in opposition, demanding that the Jiajing Emperor adopt the Hongzhi Emperor as his father.

description.zh-cn: 上疏支持明世宗追尊生父，成为议礼派核心人物。
description.en: Submitted memorials supporting the emperor's position, becoming a core figure in the pro-rites faction.

description.zh-cn: 在位前期进行改革，锐意图治，革除先朝蠹政，史称嘉靖中兴。
description.en: In his early reign, he carried out reforms, was determined to govern well, and eliminated the corrupt policies of the previous reign, which historians call the Jiajing Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 笃信道教，好长生不老之术，每年不断修设斋醮，并在西苑修仙。
description.en: He was a devout believer in Taoism, sought immortality, held numerous Taoist ceremonies annually, and practiced self-cultivation in the West Park.

description.zh-cn: 因不堪忍受虐待，数名宫女试图缢杀明世宗，致其险些丧命。
description.en: Unable to bear his abuse, several palace maids attempted to strangle him, nearly causing his death.

description.zh-cn: 在壬寅宫变后，使用“虎狼之药”救活了明世宗。
description.en: After the Renyin Palace Incident, he used potent medicine to revive the Jiajing Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明世宗深居西苑后，将政令皆交由严嵩父子打理，使其专权近二十年。
description.en: After retreating to the West Park, the Jiajing Emperor delegated all government affairs to Yan Song and his son, allowing them to monopolize power for nearly 20 years.

description.zh-cn: 地震导致明朝国库连续两年亏空，对国力和财政状况造成严重影响。
description.en: The earthquake caused the Ming dynasty's state treasury to be in deficit for two consecutive years, severely impacting national strength and financial status.

description.zh-cn: 嘉靖朝期间，北方蒙古寇边与东南倭寇侵扰导致边事废弛，对国家安全构成严重威胁。
description.en: During the Jiajing era, border raids by northern Mongols and incursions by southeastern Wokou pirates led to a decline in border defenses, posing a serious threat to national security.

description.zh-cn: 嘉靖年间多次率领蒙古鞑靼部落寇边。
description.en: Led Mongol Tatar tribes to raid the border multiple times during the Jiajing era.

description.zh-cn: 嘉靖年间侵扰中国东南沿海，造成严重破坏。
description.en: Raided the southeastern coast of China during the Jiajing era, causing severe destruction.

description.zh-cn: 率领军队肃清倭寇，保卫了东南沿海地区。
description.en: Led troops to eliminate the Wokou pirates, defending the southeastern coastal regions.

description.zh-cn: 率领军队肃清倭寇，保卫了东南沿海地区。
description.en: Led troops to eliminate the Wokou pirates, defending the southeastern coastal regions.

description.zh-cn: 在明世宗驾崩后，请裕王（后来的明穆宗）入宫主持丧礼，确保了权力平稳交接。
description.en: After the death of the Jiajing Emperor, he invited Prince Yu (later the Longqing Emperor) to preside over the funeral rites, ensuring a smooth transition of power.

description.zh-cn: 莫言出生于山东省高密县
北京师范大学与鲁迅文学院联合培养
莫言称受到《雪国》启发，创建了自己的文学王国“高密东北乡”。
莫言凭借《蛙》获得第八届茅盾文学奖。
莫言获得2012年诺贝尔文学奖。
因文化大革命在小学五年级时辍学。
张艺谋导演了多部由莫言小说改编的电影。
发文为莫言辩护，认为起诉莫言是一场闹剧。
批评莫言支持审查制度，并称其获奖是一场“灾难”。
批评莫言没有公开呼吁释放刘晓波。
批评莫言“胆子小，奉迎、讨好体制”，且“语言粗糙”。
被授予美国陆军航空军上校军衔。
在麦卡锡主义盛行期间，钱学森因被怀疑与共产党有牵连而受到美国政府的迫害，最终被驱逐出境。
description.en: During the McCarthy era, Qian Xuesen was persecuted by the U.S. government on suspicion of communist ties, eventually leading to his deportation.

description.zh-cn: 联邦调查局指控钱学森在入籍申请中隐瞒其共产党外围组织活动，导致其机密工作许可被吊销。
description.en: The FBI accused Qian Xuesen of concealing his activities in communist front organizations on his naturalization application, leading to the revocation of his security clearance.

description.zh-cn: 美国司法部将钱学森拘留并最终将其驱逐出境。
description.en: The U.S. Department of Justice detained Qian Xuesen and eventually deported him.

description.zh-cn: 钱学森为中华人民共和国的火箭、导弹和航天计划做出了重大贡献。
description.en: Qian Xuesen made significant contributions to the People's Republic of China's rocket, missile, and space programs.

description.zh-cn: 钱学森是加州理工学院喷气推进实验室的主要创建者之一，为美国的火箭和航天计划做出了重大贡献。
description.en: Qian Xuesen was one of the main founders of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory at Caltech and made significant contributions to the U.S. rocket and space programs.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间保护了钱学森，使其免受冲击。
description.en: Protected Qian Xuesen from persecution during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 在“批邓反击右倾翻案风”运动中，发表大字报批判上司张爱萍。
description.en: During the 'Counterattack the Right-Deviationist Reversal-of-Verdicts Trend' campaign, published a big-character poster criticizing his superior Zhang Aiping.

description.zh-cn: 钱学森因支持人体特异功能研究，与持反对意见的于光远发生激烈争论。
1999年的美国国会考克斯报告声称钱学森为“间谍”。
description.en: The 1999 U.S. Congressional Cox Report alleged that Qian Xuesen was a 'spy'.

description.zh-cn: 钱学森的传记作者张纯如对考克斯报告中称其为“间谍”的指控予以驳斥。
description.en: Qian Xuesen's biographer, Iris Chang, refuted the Cox Report's accusation that he was a 'spy'.

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国为蒋孝章之父。
蒋方良为蒋孝章之母。
1957年赴美留学后与俞扬和陷入热恋，于1960年8月结婚。
蒋孝文为蒋孝章之兄。
蒋孝武为蒋孝章之弟。
蒋孝勇为蒋孝章之弟。
因俞扬和为有妇之夫，反对女儿蒋孝章与其恋爱及婚事。
因其子俞扬和与蒋孝章相恋，蒋经国曾十分恼火，并向俞大维发飙。
俞大维为俞扬和之父。
据传与蒋家三兄弟关系不和。
据传与蒋家三兄弟关系不和。
据传与蒋家三兄弟关系不和。
耐心说服调解，使蒋经国接受蒋孝章与俞扬和的婚事。
蒋斯千为蒋肇聪之父。
王有则为王采玉之父。
宋高宗是宋徽宗第九子。
显仁皇后韦氏是宋高宗的生母。
宋高宗是宋钦宗之弟。
赵旉是宋高宗唯一的亲生儿子。
宋孝宗为宋高宗的养子。
宋高宗在位初期重用主战派将领岳飞。
宋高宗为与金人缔结和约而重用主和派秦桧。
金朝将领兀术向秦桧提出“必杀飞，始可和”作为议和的条件。
宋高宗罢免主战派大臣李纲。
宋高宗罢免主战派大臣张浚。
宋高宗罢免主战派大臣韩世忠。
宋高宗一心偏安，与金人缔结绍兴和议。
金朝与南宋长期处于军事对峙状态。
在靖康之难中被金兵俘虏北上。
因北宋皇室被俘，赵构成为仅存的希望，得以南下建立南宋。
因禁军将领不满，发动兵变，迫使宋高宗禅让皇位于皇子赵旉。
赵旉因苗刘兵变受到惊吓而病逝。
宋高宗禅让皇位于养子赵昚（宋孝宗）。
作为学生领袖，组织并领导了学生运动，并发起绝食。
description.en: As a student leader, he organized and led the student movement and initiated a hunger strike.

description.zh-cn: 在与时任国务院总理李鹏的会面中，吾尔开希打断其发言，双方立场对立。
description.en: During a meeting with then-Premier Li Peng, Wu'erkaixi interrupted his speech, highlighting their opposing stances.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件后，吾尔开希被通缉并开始流亡生涯。
description.en: After the Tiananmen Square protests, Wu'erkaixi was put on a wanted list and began his life in exile.

description.zh-cn: 将吾尔开希列为21名高自联头头和骨干之一进行通缉。
description.en: Listed Wu'erkaixi as one of the 21 most-wanted student leaders.

description.zh-cn: 协助吾尔开希逃离中国大陆。
description.en: Assisted Wu'erkaixi in fleeing mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 据司徒华本人称，他曾帮助吾尔开希通过“黄雀行动”逃亡。
description.en: According to Szeto Wah, he helped Wu'erkaixi flee through 'Operation Yellowbird'.

description.zh-cn: 与严家其等人共同创立“民主中国阵线”。
description.en: Co-founded the Federation for a Democratic China with Yan Jiaqi and others.

description.zh-cn: 与吾尔开希等人共同创立“民主中国阵线”。
description.en: Co-founded the Federation for a Democratic China with Wu'erkaixi and others.

description.zh-cn: 时任台中市长张温鹰欢迎吾尔开希入籍台中市，并亲自颁发中华民国国民身份证。
description.en: Then-Taichung Mayor Chang Wen-ying welcomed Wu'erkaixi's naturalization in Taichung and personally issued him a Republic of China National Identity Card.

description.zh-cn: 曾批评时任总统陈水扁“宛如共产党”。
description.en: Criticized then-President Chen Shui-bian as being 'like the Communist Party'.

description.zh-cn: 曾批评时任总统马英九帮共产党说话。
description.en: Criticized then-President Ma Ying-jeou for speaking on behalf of the Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 拒绝吾尔开希入境澳门。
description.en: Denied Wu'erkaixi entry into Macau.

description.zh-cn: 多次拒绝吾尔开希入境香港或将其遣返。
description.en: Repeatedly denied Wu'erkaixi entry into Hong Kong or deported him.

description.zh-cn: 到场声援并勉励学生。
description.en: Appeared at the scene to support and encourage the students.

description.zh-cn: 在台北的声援晚会到场声援香港的占领行动。
description.en: Attended a support rally in Taipei to show solidarity with the Occupy movement in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 解散高自联。
description.en: Dissolved the Beijing Students' Autonomous Federation.

description.zh-cn: 因广场策略与柴玲等人产生争执，而被学运组织进一步边缘化。
description.en: Clashed with Chai Ling and others over square strategy and was further marginalized by the student movement organization.

description.zh-cn: 江泽慧是江绵恒的姑姑。
杨雄在江绵恒创办的上海联和投资有限公司担任首任总经理，江绵恒为董事长。
description.en: Yang Xiong was the first general manager of Shanghai Alliance Investment Ltd., founded by Jiang Mianheng, who was the chairman.

description.zh-cn: 陪同曾庆红参观上海韩天衡美术馆。
description.en: Accompanied Zeng Qinghong on a visit to the Han Tianheng Art Museum in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 与韩正一同陪同曾庆红参观上海韩天衡美术馆。
description.en: Together with Han Zheng, accompanied Zeng Qinghong on a visit to the Han Tianheng Art Museum in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 光孝寺内有达摩“洗钵泉”遗迹。
description.en: Guangxiao Temple contains a relic known as Bodhidharma's 'bowl-washing spring'.

description.zh-cn: 张工在陈敏尔担任天津市委书记期间任副书记兼市长。
接替李鸿忠出任中共天津市委书记。
接替孙政才担任重庆市委书记。
接替陈敏尔担任重庆市委书记。
孙志刚在陈敏尔担任贵州省委书记期间任副书记兼省长。
接替赵克志出任中共贵州省委书记。
陈敏尔担任贵州省省长期间，赵克志为省委书记。
陈敏尔担任常务副省长时，吕祖善为省长。
陈敏尔担任常务副省长时，夏宝龙为省长。
陈敏尔担任浙江省委宣传部长时，张德江为省委书记。
陈敏尔担任浙江省委宣传部长时，赵洪祝为省委书记。
陈敏尔任贵州省委副书记时，栗战书为省委书记。
计算机系计算机应用专业本科
应用心理学硕士
根据其维基百科页面分类“清华大学校友”推断。
被外界广泛认为是之江新军主要成员之一。
习近平当选中央政治局常委后，钟绍军随同进入中央并担任此职。
晋升少将军衔。
晋升中将军衔。
钟绍军接替秦生祥出任中央军事委员会办公厅主任。
方永祥接替钟绍军出任中央军事委员会办公厅主任。
钟绍军接替吴志铭（胡锦涛时期）担任中央军委主席办公室主任。
服务于中央军委主席习近平。
服务于中央军委主席胡锦涛。
自1973年当选为中共中央政治局委员起，成为副国级领导人。
抗日战争期间，被推选为大寨村日组织“维持会”代表，后加入“兴亚会”。
1964年，毛泽东号召全国“农业学大寨”。
毛泽东对陈永贵的肯定和支持是其进入中共中央领导层的关键。
陈永贵在文化大革命期间进一步得到毛泽东的肯定，政治地位迅速提升。
周恩来在接见陈永贵时授意他可以组织自己的红卫兵。
谢振华试图以历史问题整倒陈永贵，但因毛泽东支持陈永贵，谢振华被调离山西。
拨乱反正后，陈永贵的极左路线被否定，最终导致其被迫辞职。
改革开放政策与陈永贵的政治路线相抵触，导致其下台。
邓小平主导的改革开放导致陈永贵被迫辞去国务院副总理职务。
陈永贵力劝华国锋不要让邓小平复出，并当面质问邓小平的路线，被邓小平驳斥。
1977年9月，波尔布特访华期间参观大寨；同年12月，陈永贵回访柬埔寨。
在访问柬埔寨后，公开赞扬红色高棉实现了共产主义。
红色高棉在其统治期间推行极端政策，导致了大屠杀的发生。
因胡耀邦的批评而辱骂其为“胡乱邦”。
陈永贵在全国推行“割资本主义尾巴”的左倾政策。
陈永贵于1952年接替贾进才出任大寨大队支部书记。
1885年考入炮兵科一期，1887年以最优等毕业。
description.en: Enrolled in the first class of the artillery department in 1885 and graduated with top honors in 1887.

description.zh-cn: 1889年春抵达柏林，在普鲁士军官学校学习军事理论与操练。
description.en: Arrived in Berlin in the spring of 1889 to study military theory and practice at a Prussian military school.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯在天津小站练兵时，段祺瑞主管砲兵。
description.en: When Yuan Shikai was training the New Army at Xiaozhan, Tianjin, Duan Qirui was in charge of the artillery.

description.zh-cn: 《共和之电》向隆裕太后施压，是促成清帝退位的关键文件之一。
description.en: The 'Telegram for the Republic' pressured Empress Dowager Longyu and was a key document in bringing about the abdication of the Qing emperor.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞联名发布《共和之电》并以武力威胁，向隆裕太后逼宫，促使其下诏清帝退位。
description.en: Duan Qirui co-signed the 'Telegram for the Republic' and used military threats to pressure Empress Dowager Longyu into issuing the abdication edict for the Qing emperor.

description.zh-cn: 《共和之电》由徐树铮起草。
description.en: The 'Telegram for the Republic' was drafted by Xu Shuzheng.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞表示不拥护袁世凯推行的洪宪帝制。
description.en: Duan Qirui expressed his non-support for the Hongxian Monarchy promoted by Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞在天津马厂誓师，率讨逆军镇压了张勋复辟。
description.en: Duan Qirui rallied his troops at Tianjin's Machang and led the 'Rebel-Suppressing Army' to crush the Manchu Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 两人对于以何种方式统一中国意见相左，发生第二次府院之争。
description.en: The two had conflicting views on how to unify China, leading to the second 'Mansion-Courtyard Rivalry'.

description.zh-cn: 皖军在直皖战争中战败，皖系势力被瓦解，段祺瑞因此失势下野。
description.en: The Anhui clique's army was defeated in the Zhili-Anhui War, leading to the collapse of its power and forcing Duan Qirui to step down from office.

description.zh-cn: 冯玉祥发动甲子政变，推翻了大总统曹锟。
description.en: Feng Yuxiang launched the Beijing Coup, overthrowing President Cao Kun.

description.zh-cn: 冯玉祥发动甲子政变后，邀请段祺瑞出山，出任中华民国临时政府的临时执政。
description.en: After launching the Beijing Coup, Feng Yuxiang invited Duan Qirui to come out of retirement and serve as the Provisional Chief Executive of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 惨案的发生导致段祺瑞执政府众叛亲离，并最终于同年4月下野。
description.en: The massacre caused Duan Qirui's government to lose all support, leading to his downfall in April of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 1926年4月9日，鹿钟麟率部将段祺瑞驱逐，迫使其下野。
description.en: On April 9, 1926, Lu Zhonglin led his troops to oust Duan Qirui, forcing him to step down.

description.zh-cn: 九一八事变前，日本关东军特务机关长土肥原贤二多次在天津秘密会晤段祺瑞等人，欲扶植其为代理人。
description.en: Before the Mukden Incident, Kenji Doihara, head of the Kwantung Army's special service, secretly met with Duan Qirui and others in Tianjin multiple times, intending to install him as a Japanese puppet.

description.zh-cn: 为防止段祺瑞被日本人利用，蒋介石邀请其南下上海定居。
description.en: To prevent Duan Qirui from being used by the Japanese, Chiang Kai-shek invited him to move south and reside in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 在冯玉祥发动甲子政变后，段祺瑞出山成立中华民国临时政府。
description.en: After Feng Yuxiang launched the Beijing Coup, Duan Qirui came out of retirement to establish the Provisional Government of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1902年，徐树铮投奔段祺瑞并担任其记室，后成为其重要幕僚和亲信。
description.en: In 1902, Xu Shuzheng joined Duan Qirui as his secretary and later became his key advisor and confidant.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞为推行“武力统一”政策，派兵镇压孙中山倡导的护法运动。
description.en: To implement his policy of 'unification by force', Duan Qirui dispatched troops to suppress the Constitutional Protection Movement advocated by Sun Yat-sen.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞主张武力统一，与领导护法运动的孙中山在政治和军事上对立。
description.en: Duan Qirui advocated for military unification, placing him in political and military opposition to Sun Yat-sen, who led the Constitutional Protection Movement.

description.zh-cn: 王金平出生于日治台湾高雄州冈山郡路竹庄。
description.en: Wang Jin-pyng was born in Luzhu Zhuang, Okayama District, Takao Prefecture, Japanese Taiwan.

degree.en: Junior and Senior High School graduate

description.zh-cn: 王金平毕业于台湾省立台南第一中学（今国立台南第一高级中学）初中部及高中部。
description.en: Wang Jin-pyng graduated from the junior and senior high school departments of Taiwan Provincial Tainan First Senior High School (now National Tainan First Senior High School).

description.zh-cn: 王金平考入台湾省立师范学院（今国立台湾师范大学）数学系并毕业。
description.en: Wang Jin-pyng was admitted to and graduated from the Department of Mathematics at Taiwan Provincial Normal College (now National Taiwan Normal University).

description.zh-cn: 王金平于2000年被选为中国国民党副主席。
description.en: Wang Jin-pyng was elected as the Vice Chairman of the Kuomintang in 2000.

description.zh-cn: 特侦组指控王金平为立法委员柯建铭的司法案件进行关说，引发九月政争。
description.en: The Special Investigation Division accused Wang Jin-pyng of improper lobbying in a judicial case involving legislator Ker Chien-ming, triggering the September Strife.

description.zh-cn: 时任总统兼国民党主席的马英九召开记者会严厉批判王金平，并推动国民党考纪会撤销其党籍，是九月政争的主要推手。
description.en: Then-President and KMT Chairman Ma Ying-jeou held press conferences to severely criticize Wang Jin-pyng and pushed the KMT's Discipline Committee to revoke his party membership, acting as the main driver of the September Strife.

description.zh-cn: 在九月政争期间，王金平被国民党考纪会决议撤销党籍，面临失去不分区立委及立法院长资格的危机。后经司法诉讼及国民党新任主席朱立伦停止诉讼，才确认党籍。
description.en: During the September Strife, the KMT Discipline Committee resolved to revoke Wang Jin-pyng's party membership, facing the crisis of losing his legislator-at-large status and his position as President of the Legislative Yuan. His membership was only confirmed after legal proceedings and the new KMT Chairman Eric Chu's decision to drop the lawsuit.

description.zh-cn: 因被指控在王金平的关说案中涉入，曾勇夫被迫请辞法务部部长。
description.en: Tseng Yung-fu was forced to resign as Minister of Justice due to his alleged involvement in the lobbying case concerning Wang Jin-pyng.

description.zh-cn: 国民党新任主席朱立伦宣布停止对王金平党籍案的诉讼，确认其保有党籍。
description.en: The new KMT chairman, Eric Chu, announced the cessation of the lawsuit concerning Wang Jin-pyng's party membership, confirming that he retained his membership.

description.zh-cn: 为回应太阳花学运，立法院长王金平承诺在《两岸协议监督条例》完成立法前，不召集《服贸协议》的相关党团协商会议，实际上搁置了该协议。
description.en: In response to the Sunflower Student Movement, Legislative Yuan President Wang Jin-pyng promised not to convene party caucus negotiations on the Service Trade Agreement until the Cross-Strait Agreement Supervisory Bill was enacted, effectively shelving the agreement.

description.zh-cn: 为结束太阳花学运，王金平承诺优先处理《两岸协议监督条例》的立法，将其作为审查《服贸协议》的前提条件。
description.en: To end the Sunflower Student Movement, Wang Jin-pyng promised to prioritize the legislation of the Cross-Strait Agreement Supervisory Bill as a precondition for reviewing the Service Trade Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 林锡山长期担任立法院秘书长，是时任立法院院长王金平的幕僚长。
description.en: Lin Hsi-shan served for a long time as the Secretary-General of the Legislative Yuan, acting as the chief of staff to then-President of the Legislative Yuan Wang Jin-pyng.

position.en: Vice President of the Legislative Yuan

description.zh-cn: 王金平在刘松藩担任立法院院长期间，任立法院副院长。
description.en: Wang Jin-pyng served as the Vice President of the Legislative Yuan while Liu Sung-pan was the President.

description.zh-cn: 王金平在连战担任中国国民党主席期间，任副主席。
description.en: Wang Jin-pyng served as Vice Chairman of the Kuomintang while Lien Chan was the Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 白行简是白居易的弟弟。
description.en: Bai Xingjian is Bai Juyi's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 与元稹订交，成为终身的好友，二人齐名，号“元白”。
description.en: Became friends with Yuan Zhen, forming a lifelong friendship. They were equally famous and known as 'Yuan-Bai'.

description.zh-cn: 晚年与刘禹锡唱和甚多，人称为“刘白”。
description.en: In his later years, he frequently exchanged poems with Liu Yuxi, and they were known as 'Liu-Bai'.

description.zh-cn: 在白居易早年拜访时，顾况对其诗篇大加赞赏并为之延誉，使其声名大振。
description.en: When Bai Juyi visited him in his early years, Gu Kuang highly praised his poems and helped promote his reputation, making him famous.

description.zh-cn: 当唐宪宗对白居易的直言感到不快时，李绛为白居易辩护，认为这是其忠心的表现。
description.en: When Emperor Xianzong was displeased with Bai Juyi's directness, Li Jiang defended Bai Juyi, arguing it was a sign of his loyalty.

description.zh-cn: 在武元衡遇刺案后，因白居易越职言事及被诽谤，唐宪宗将其贬为江州司马。
description.en: After the assassination of Wu Yuanheng, Emperor Xianzong demoted Bai Juyi to Sima of Jiangzhou because he overstepped his authority and was slandered.

description.zh-cn: 曾褒白居易为“诗仙”，并在其去世后作吊唁诗，评价其一生。
description.en: He praised Bai Juyi as the 'Poet Immortal' and wrote a eulogy poem after his death, summarizing his life.

description.zh-cn: 倡导新乐府运动，主张“文章合为时而著，歌诗合为事而作”。
description.en: Advocated the New Yuefu Movement, proposing that 'essays should be written for the times, and poems should be created for events'.

description.zh-cn: 在江州司马任上创作了长篇叙事诗《琵琶行》。
description.en: Authored the long narrative poem 'Song of the Pipa Player' while serving as Sima of Jiangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 亲自编辑了自己的文集《白氏长庆集》。
description.en: Personally edited his own literary collection, 'Collected Works of Bai Juyi'.

description.zh-cn: 为《白氏长庆集》作序并协助编成。
description.en: Wrote the preface for and assisted in the compilation of the 'Collected Works of Bai Juyi'.

description.zh-cn: 《长恨歌》是关于唐玄宗与杨贵妃的爱情故事。
description.en: The 'Song of Everlasting Regret' is about the love story of Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei.

description.zh-cn: 《长恨歌》是关于唐玄宗与杨贵妃的爱情故事。
description.en: The 'Song of Everlasting Regret' is about the love story of Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei.

description.zh-cn: 郑小龙是古龙与郑月霞的儿子。
description.en: Zheng Xiaolong is the son of Gu Long and Zheng Yuexia.

description.zh-cn: 1957年秋，古龙考入淡江英专（淡江大学前身）夜间部英语科，后因谋生而辍学。
description.en: In the autumn of 1957, Gu Long was admitted to the English Department of the Evening Division at Tamkang English College (the predecessor of Tamkang University), but later dropped out to make a living.

description.zh-cn: 传闻古龙在离家出走后，曾短暂加入学生帮派四海帮。
description.en: It is rumored that after running away from home, Gu Long briefly joined the student gang, the Four Seas Gang.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡代表香港《明报》向古龙邀稿，促成了小说《绝代双骄》的诞生。
description.en: Representing Hong Kong's Ming Pao newspaper, Ni Kuang commissioned a manuscript from Gu Long, which led to the creation of the novel 'Juedai Shuangjiao'.

description.zh-cn: 金庸在自己封笔后，于1972年亲自为旗下的《明报》向古龙邀稿，促成了《陆小凤》系列的创作，此举有世代传承的意味。
description.en: After retiring from writing, Jin Yong personally invited Gu Long in 1972 to write for his newspaper Ming Pao, which led to the creation of the 'Lu Xiaofeng Series'. This act was seen as a passing of the torch between generations.

description.zh-cn: 香港邵氏公司于1976年将古龙的小说改编成电影，大获成功，开创了古龙的电影时代，使其作品声名鹊起。
description.en: In 1976, Hong Kong's Shaw Brothers Studio successfully adapted Gu Long's novels into films, initiating the Gu Long movie era and skyrocketing the popularity of his works.

description.zh-cn: 在1980年的吟松阁事件中，因古龙不愿向柯俊雄敬酒，柯的友人叶庆辉等人用刀刺伤古龙，导致其身受重伤。
description.en: During the 1980 Yinsong Pavilion incident, Gu Long was unwilling to offer a toast to Ko Chun-hsiung. As a result, Ko's associate Ye Qinghui and others stabbed and severely injured Gu Long.

description.zh-cn: 1974年，《中国时报》因认为小说《天涯‧明月‧刀》的理念过于前卫，在连载中途将其停止刊登（腰斩）。
description.en: In 1974, the China Times discontinued the serialization of the novel 'Tianya, Mingyue, Dao' midway, deeming its concepts too avant-garde.

description.zh-cn: 古龙于1938年6月7日出生于香港。
description.en: Gu Long was born in Hong Kong on June 7, 1938.

description.zh-cn: 古龙去世后，时任行政院长俞国华为其墓碑题字“英才早凋”，此举是对其文学成就的官方肯定和纪念。
description.en: After Gu Long's death, then-Premier Yu Kuo-hwa inscribed 'A brilliant talent passed away too soon' on his tombstone, an act of official recognition and commemoration of his literary achievements.

description.zh-cn: 王健林是王思聪的父亲。
description.en: Wang Jianlin is the father of Wang Sicong.

description.zh-cn: 王健林出生于四川省绵阳专区第二人民医院。
description.en: Wang Jianlin was born in the Second People's Hospital of Mianyang Prefecture, Sichuan Province.

description.zh-cn: 1978年进入大连陆军学院学习，1979年8月毕业。
description.en: He entered the Dalian Army Academy for studies in 1978 and graduated in August 1979.

description.zh-cn: 1983年就读辽宁大学党政专修班，1986年毕业获得经济管理专业的学位。
description.en: He attended the Party and Government Cadre training class at Liaoning University from 1983, graduating in 1986 with a degree in Economic Management.

description.zh-cn: 王健林是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Wang Jianlin is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 王健林是大连万达集团股份有限公司的董事长。
description.en: Wang Jianlin is the Chairman of Dalian Wanda Group.

description.zh-cn: 王健林接手大连足球队后，成立了大连万达足球俱乐部。
description.en: After taking over the Dalian football team, Wang Jianlin founded the Dalian Wanda Football Club.

description.zh-cn: 2012年，万达集团以26亿美元并购了全球第二大影院公司AMC。
description.en: In 2012, Wanda Group acquired AMC, the world's second-largest cinema chain, for $2.6 billion.

description.zh-cn: 2012年底，万达集团成立万达文化产业集团。
description.en: At the end of 2012, Wanda Group established the Wanda Cultural Industry Group.

description.zh-cn: 万达集团将13个万达文化旅游项目以438.44亿人民币出售给融创中国。
description.en: Wanda Group sold 13 Wanda Cultural Tourism projects to Sunac China for 43.844 billion RMB.

description.zh-cn: 万达集团将旗下77家酒店项目以199.06亿人民币出售给富力地产。
description.en: Wanda Group sold 77 of its hotel projects to R&F Properties for 19.906 billion RMB.

description.zh-cn: 万达集团与中国足协达成战略合作，承诺三年内至少出资5亿元人民币，全面支援中国足球振兴。
description.en: Wanda Group reached a strategic partnership with the Chinese Football Association, promising to invest at least 500 million RMB over three years to fully support the revitalization of Chinese football.

description.zh-cn: 在百万大裁军的背景下，王健林从军队转业，进入地方政府工作，为其后来的商业生涯奠定了基础。
description.en: Against the backdrop of the one-million-man military reduction, Wang Jianlin transitioned from the army to local government, laying the foundation for his later business career.

description.zh-cn: 由于冠状病毒大流行，王健林的房地产和影视事业都急剧下降，导致其财富缩水并跌出富豪榜前列。
description.en: Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, Wang Jianlin's real estate and film businesses declined sharply, causing his wealth to shrink and drop him from the top ranks of the rich list.

description.zh-cn: 王义全是参加过长征的中国工农红军成员。
description.en: Wang Yiquan was a member of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army who participated in the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军进行了长征军事转移。
description.en: The Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army undertook the Long March military retreat.

description.zh-cn: 允禩是康熙帝的第八子。
description.en: Yinsi was the eighth son of the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 允禩的生母是良妃卫氏。
description.en: Yinsi's biological mother was Consort Liang, née Wei.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，将允禩革去爵位、开除宗籍、勒令改名，并将其圈禁于宗人府，允禩最终在拘禁中病故。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Yongzheng Emperor stripped Yinsi of his titles, expelled him from the imperial clan, forced him to change his name, and imprisoned him in the Imperial Clan Court, where Yinsi eventually died.

description.zh-cn: 允禩是雍正帝的异母弟。
description.en: Yinsi was the younger half-brother of the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 允禩在九子夺嫡中失败，未能继承皇位，并为其后来的悲惨结局埋下伏笔。
description.en: Yinsi failed in the nine sons' succession struggle, did not inherit the throne, which foreshadowed his later tragic end.

description.zh-cn: 在九子夺嫡期间，允禩是争夺储君之位的主要人物之一，与时为皇太子的胤礽形成政治对立。
description.en: During the nine sons' succession struggle, Yinsi was one of the main contenders for the position of crown prince, forming a political opposition to the then Crown Prince Yinreng.

description.zh-cn: 在争储后期，允禩转而支持皇十四子胤禵继承大统，二人结成政治同盟。
description.en: In the later stages of the succession struggle, Yinsi shifted his support to the 14th prince, Yinti, to inherit the throne, forming a political alliance.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆四十三年，乾隆帝下旨恢复允禩的原名，并将其及其子孙重新录入玉牒，恢复宗籍。
description.en: In 1778, the Qianlong Emperor issued an edict to restore Yinsi's original name and re-admit him and his descendants into the imperial genealogy, restoring their clan status.

description.zh-cn: 郭络罗氏是允禩的嫡福晋。
description.en: Guoluoluo was the primary consort of Yinsi.

description.zh-cn: 雍正四年正月，雍正帝下令革去郭络罗氏的福晋头衔，并将其逐回母家。
description.en: In January 1726, the Yongzheng Emperor ordered that Guoluoluo be stripped of her title as consort and sent back to her maternal home.

description.zh-cn: 弘旺是允禩的儿子。
description.en: Hongwang was the son of Yinsi.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝即位后，下令恢复弘旺的原名。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Qianlong Emperor ordered the restoration of Hongwang's original name.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝下令将获罪的皇三子弘时过继给允禩为子嗣。
description.en: The Yongzheng Emperor ordered his disgraced third son, Hongshi, to be adopted into Yinsi's lineage as his heir.

description.zh-cn: 康熙三十七年，17岁的允禩受封为多罗贝勒。
description.en: In 1698, the 17-year-old Yinsi was ennobled as a Duoluo Beile.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，允禩任理藩院尚书。
description.en: After the Yongzheng Emperor's accession, Yinsi served as the Minister of the Lifan Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，允禩负责管理工部事务。
description.en: After the Yongzheng Emperor's accession, Yinsi was in charge of the affairs of the Ministry of Works.

description.zh-cn: 雍正四年，允禩被削去宗籍后，发往正蓝旗卓鼐佐领下。
description.en: In 1726, after being expelled from the imperial clan, Yinsi was dispatched to the Plain Blue Banner under Zuoling Zhuo Nai.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，命允禩与允祥、马齐、隆科多四人总理事务。
description.en: After the Yongzheng Emperor's accession, he appointed Yinsi, Yunxiang, Maci, and Longkodo to jointly manage state affairs.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，命允禩与允祥、马齐、隆科多四人总理事务。
description.en: After the Yongzheng Emperor's accession, he appointed Yinsi, Yunxiang, Maci, and Longkodo to jointly manage state affairs.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，命允禩与允祥、马齐、隆科多四人总理事务。
description.en: After the Yongzheng Emperor's accession, he appointed Yinsi, Yunxiang, Maci, and Longkodo to jointly manage state affairs.

description.zh-cn: 郭络罗氏是安亲王岳乐的外孙女。
description.en: Guoluoluo was the maternal granddaughter of Prince An Yue Le.

description.zh-cn: 允禩幼时由惠妃抚养。
description.en: Yinsi was raised by Consort Hui during his childhood.

description.zh-cn: 允禩是胤禔的异母弟。
description.en: Yinsi was the younger half-brother of Yinzhi.

description.zh-cn: 康熙四十二年，康熙帝命令书法家何焯为允禩的侍读。
description.en: In 1703, the Kangxi Emperor ordered the calligrapher He Zhuo to be Yinsi's attendant-reader.

description.zh-cn: 允禩是和硕悫靖公主的异母兄。
description.en: Yinsi was the elder half-brother of Princess Heshuo Quejing.

description.zh-cn: 作为中央政治局委员，接受中共中央总书记习近平的领导。
description.en: As a member of the Politburo, he is under the leadership of CPC General Secretary Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 在担任天津市市长期间，市委书记是李鸿忠。
description.en: During his tenure as Mayor of Tianjin, the Municipal Party Secretary was Li Hongzhong.

description.zh-cn: 在担任中共重庆市委副书记和重庆市市长期间，市委书记是孙政才。
description.en: During his tenure as Deputy Party Secretary and Mayor of Chongqing, the Municipal Party Secretary was Sun Zhengcai.

description.zh-cn: 在担任重庆市市长期间，孙政才被免职后，市委书记是陈敏尔。
description.en: During his tenure as Mayor of Chongqing, after Sun Zhengcai was removed from office, the Municipal Party Secretary was Chen Min'er.

description.zh-cn: 参加哈佛大学商学院高级管理培训班的学习。
description.en: Attended the Advanced Management Program at Harvard Business School.

position.zh-cn: 副总裁，党委书记，总裁；总经理、党组副书记
position.en: Vice President, Party Secretary, President; General Manager, Deputy Party Secretary

description.zh-cn: 1996年晋升公司副总裁；1998年起兼任党委书记；2004年4月任北方工业公司总裁。2008年10月至2013年4月任总经理、党组副书记。
description.en: Promoted to Vice President in 1996; served concurrently as Party Secretary from 1998; appointed President of Norinco in April 2004. From October 2008 to April 2013, served as General Manager and Deputy Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 在中共二十届一中全会上当选为中共中央政治局委员，晋升副国级。
description.en: Was elected as a member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee at the First Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee, promoted to a sub-national level leader.

description.zh-cn: 在十四届全国人大一次会议上，经国务院总理李强提名，当选为国务院副总理。
description.en: At the First Session of the 14th National People's Congress, he was elected Vice Premier of the State Council upon nomination by Premier Li Qiang.

description.zh-cn: 共同担任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Serve together as Vice Premiers of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 共同担任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Serve together as Vice Premiers of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 共同担任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Serve together as Vice Premiers of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 张国清接替陈求发担任中共辽宁省委书记。
description.en: Zhang Guoqing succeeded Chen Qiufa as Secretary of the CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 郝鹏接替张国清担任中共辽宁省委书记。
description.en: Hao Peng succeeded Zhang Guoqing as Secretary of the CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 张国清接替王东峰担任天津市市长。
description.en: Zhang Guoqing succeeded Wang Dongfeng as Mayor of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 廖国勋接替张国清担任天津市市长。
description.en: Liao Guoxun succeeded Zhang Guoqing as Mayor of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 张国清接替黄奇帆担任重庆市市长。
description.en: Zhang Guoqing succeeded Huang Qifan as Mayor of Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 唐良智接替张国清担任重庆市市长。
description.en: Tang Liangzhi succeeded Zhang Guoqing as Mayor of Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 作为国家主席习近平特别代表出席在德黑兰举行的伊朗已故总统莱希吊唁活动。
description.en: As the special representative of President Xi Jinping, attended the memorial service for the late Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi in Tehran.

description.zh-cn: 率国务院工作组紧急赶赴甘肃、青海地震灾区指导抗震救灾工作。
description.en: Led a State Council working group to the earthquake-stricken areas in Gansu and Qinghai to guide the earthquake relief work.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来是薄一波的次子。
description.en: Bo Xilai is the second son of Bo Yibo.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来是胡明之子。
description.en: Bo Xilai is the son of Hu Ming.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来与薄谷开来于1987年结婚。
description.en: Bo Xilai and Bo Gu Kailai married in 1987.

description.zh-cn: 李望知是薄熙来与前妻李丹宇所生的长子。
description.en: Li Wangzhi is the eldest son of Bo Xilai and his ex-wife Li Danyu.

description.zh-cn: 薄瓜瓜是薄熙来与妻子薄谷开来所生的幼子。
description.en: Bo Guagua is the youngest son of Bo Xilai and his wife Bo Gu Kailai.

description.zh-cn: 对海伍德死亡案的复查揭示了薄熙来家庭的犯罪行为，成为其被立案调查的关键原因之一。
description.en: The re-investigation of the Neil Heywood death case exposed the criminal activities of Bo Xilai's family, becoming a key reason for the official investigation against him.

description.zh-cn: 文强是薄熙来“打黑”运动中的重点打击对象，最终被判处死刑。
description.en: Wen Qiang was a key target in Bo Xilai's 'strike black' campaign and was ultimately sentenced to death.

description.zh-cn: 王立军与薄熙来决裂后，进入美国领事馆，揭露了薄家的内幕，成为薄熙来的主要政治对手。
description.en: After breaking with Bo Xilai, Wang Lijun entered the U.S. consulate and exposed the Bo family's secrets, becoming Bo's primary political adversary.

description.zh-cn: 据报道，时任总理温家宝反对薄熙来晋升为副总理，并在2012年两会记者会上公开批评重庆市委，对薄熙来的倒台起到了关键作用。
description.en: Then-Premier Wen Jiabao reportedly opposed Bo Xilai's promotion to Vice Premier and played a key role in his downfall by publicly criticizing the Chongqing Municipal Committee at a 2012 press conference.

description.zh-cn: 据报道，薄熙来在重庆发起窃听行动，其监控对象包括时任中共中央总书记胡锦涛。
description.en: Bo Xilai reportedly initiated an eavesdropping operation in Chongqing, with targets including then-General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, Hu Jintao.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来在主政重庆期间，推行了以“唱红打黑”和注重民生为特点的“重庆模式”。
description.en: During his tenure in Chongqing, Bo Xilai promoted the 'Chongqing Model', characterized by 'singing red songs and striking black' and a focus on people's livelihood.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来担任商务部长期间，中国商务部颁给蚁力神公司直销执照。
description.en: While Bo Xilai was Minister of Commerce, the Ministry of Commerce granted a direct selling license to the Yilishen company.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，薄熙来被关押在北京市立水桥北苑少管所，并参加劳动。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Bo Xilai was detained at the Lishuiqiao Beiyuan Juvenile Detention Center in Beijing and participated in labor.

description.zh-cn: 载沣是醇贤亲王奕𫍽的第五子。
description.en: Zaifeng was the fifth son of Yixuan, Prince Chun the First.

description.zh-cn: 载沣的生母是奕𫍽的侧福晋刘佳氏。
description.en: Zaifeng's biological mother was Yixuan's secondary consort, Lady Liuja.

description.zh-cn: 奕𫍽是道光皇帝的第七子。
description.en: Yixuan was the seventh son of the Daoguang Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 载沣是光绪帝（载湉）的异母弟。
description.en: Zaifeng was the younger half-brother of the Guangxu Emperor (Zaitian).

description.zh-cn: 嫡福晋瓜尔佳氏是载沣的元配妻子。
description.en: Primary Consort Gūwalgiya was Zaifeng's first wife.

description.zh-cn: 嫡福晋瓜尔佳氏是大学士荣禄之女。
description.en: Primary Consort Gūwalgiya was the daughter of the Grand Secretary Ronglu.

description.zh-cn: 溥杰是载沣的次子。
description.en: Pujie was the second son of Zaifeng.

description.zh-cn: 溥任是载沣的第四子。
description.en: Puren was the fourth son of Zaifeng.

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后在临终前发布懿旨，授载沣为摄政王，监国辅佐幼帝。
description.en: Before her death, Empress Dowager Cixi issued an edict appointing Zaifeng as the Prince-Regent to govern and assist the young emperor.

description.zh-cn: 在决定权力交接时，张之洞建议给予载沣摄政王的封号，并被慈禧太后采纳。
description.en: During the power transition, Zhang Zhidong suggested giving Zaifeng the title of Prince-Regent, which was adopted by Empress Dowager Cixi.

description.zh-cn: 根据慈禧太后的安排，载沣作为摄政王在遇到重大事件时，需请示隆裕太后懿旨施行。
description.en: According to Empress Dowager Cixi's arrangements, Zaifeng, as the Prince-Regent, was required to seek instructions from Empress Dowager Longyu for implementation when encountering major events.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义的爆发动摇了清朝的统治，导致载沣的摄政权力迅速瓦解。
description.en: The outbreak of the Wuchang Uprising shook the rule of the Qing dynasty, leading to the rapid collapse of Zaifeng's regency power.

description.zh-cn: 在袁世凯的劝说下，隆裕太后命令载沣辞去监国摄政王职位。
description.en: Persuaded by Yuan Shikai, Empress Dowager Longyu ordered Zaifeng to resign from his position as Prince-Regent.

description.zh-cn: 在辛亥革命的浪潮中，载沣被迫辞去监国摄政王的职务。
description.en: In the tide of the Xinhai Revolution, Zaifeng was forced to resign from his position as Prince-Regent.

description.zh-cn: 作为清朝的实际统治者，载沣的肖像被印在1910年大清银行发行的兑换券上。
description.en: As the de facto ruler of the Qing dynasty, Zaifeng's portrait was printed on the exchange notes issued by the Ta-Ching Government Bank in 1910.

description.zh-cn: 庚子事变后，载沣被授为头等专使，赴德国为德国公使被杀一事道歉。
description.en: After the Boxer Rebellion, Zaifeng was appointed as a first-class special envoy to Germany to apologize for the killing of the German minister.

description.zh-cn: 载沣是清朝皇族成员，并担任过军机大臣、监国摄政王等要职。
description.en: Zaifeng was a member of the Qing imperial family and held important positions such as Grand Councilor and Prince-Regent.

description.zh-cn: 载沣于光绪九年（1883年）出生于北京太平湖醇亲王府。
description.en: Zaifeng was born in the Prince Chun Mansion at Taiping Lake, Beijing, in 1883 (the 9th year of the Guangxu reign).

description.zh-cn: 载沣在北京病故，并葬于北京西郊福田公墓。
description.en: Zaifeng died of illness in Beijing and was buried in the Futian Cemetery in the western suburbs of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 肖建华出生于山东省泰安地区肥城县（今肥城市）安驾庄镇夏辉村。
description.en: Xiao Jianhua was born in Xiahui Village, Anjiazhuang Town, Feicheng County (now Feicheng City), Tai'an Prefecture, Shandong Province.

description.zh-cn: 1986年，年仅14岁的肖建华作为泰安市高考状元进入北京大学法律系就读。
description.en: In 1986, at the age of 14, Xiao Jianhua entered the Law Department of Peking University as the top scorer of the college entrance examination in Tai'an City.

description.zh-cn: 在校期间曾担任全国学联副主席。
description.en: Served as Vice Chairman of the All-China Students' Federation during his time at the university.

description.zh-cn: 对被告人肖建华数罪并罚，决定执行有期徒刑13年，并处罚金人民币650万元。
description.en: Sentenced the defendant Xiao Jianhua to 13 years in prison for multiple crimes and imposed a fine of RMB 6.5 million.

description.zh-cn: 据《纽约时报》报道，肖建华在六四事件期间与校方合作试图平息抗议，毕业后在北京大学的资助下经商，其财富被认为与此段经历有关。
description.en: According to The New York Times, Xiao Jianhua cooperated with the university to quell protests during the 1989 Tiananmen Square incident. He started his business with funding from Peking University after graduation, and his wealth is believed to be related to this experience.

description.zh-cn: 据《纽约时报》报道，毕业之后，肖建华在北京大学的直接资助下步入了商界。
description.en: According to The New York Times, after graduation, Xiao Jianhua entered the business world with direct funding from Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 《纽约时报》发文揭秘了肖建华和马云之间的隐秘商业联系。
description.en: The New York Times published an article revealing the secret business connections between Xiao Jianhua and Jack Ma.

description.zh-cn: 依法委托机构托管明天系旗下的新时代证券、国盛证券、国盛期货。
description.en: Legally entrusted institutions to take custody of New Times Securities, Guosheng Securities, and Guosheng Futures under the Tomorrow Group.

description.zh-cn: 作为中共一大代表，是中国共产党的创始人之一。
description.en: As a delegate to the First National Congress of the CCP, he was one of the founders of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 因张国焘投靠中国国民党而被开除党籍。
description.en: Expelled from the party after defecting to the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 在投靠国民党后，加入军统从事反共特务活动。
description.en: After defecting to the Kuomintang, he joined the Bureau of Investigation and Statistics to engage in anti-communist secret service activities.

description.zh-cn: 在长征途中，因坚持南下和反对中共中央北上决定而与毛泽东等人产生严重分歧，并另立“中央”，导致党内分裂。1937年3月遭到毛泽东等人的批判斗争。
description.en: During the Long March, he had serious disagreements with Mao Zedong and others over his insistence on going south and opposing the Central Committee's decision to go north. He established a rival 'Central Committee', leading to a split in the party. He was criticized and struggled against by Mao Zedong and others in March 1937.

description.zh-cn: 向毛泽东报告了张国焘要求武力解决分歧的密电，促使毛泽东率领中央纵队先行北上。
description.en: Reported to Mao Zedong about Zhang Guotao's secret cable demanding a forceful resolution of their differences, which prompted Mao to lead the central column north ahead of schedule.

description.zh-cn: 发动了白雀园肃反运动。
description.en: Launched the Baiqueyuan Purge.

description.zh-cn: 吕不韦在秦庄襄王元年（前249年）被任命为相邦，至秦王政十年（前237年）被罢免。
description.en: Lü Buwei was appointed Chancellor in the first year of King Zhuangxiang of Qin (-249) and was dismissed in the tenth year of King Zheng of Qin's reign (-237).

description.zh-cn: 吕不韦在赵国邯郸结识当时作为人质的嬴异人，认为其“奇货可居”，于是资助并帮助他返回秦国，通过游说华阳夫人使其被立为嫡子，最终登上王位。
description.en: In Handan, the capital of Zhao, Lü Buwei met Ying Yiren who was a hostage there. Believing him to be a 'rare commodity', Lü funded and assisted his return to Qin. By persuading Lady Huayang, he had Yiren established as the legitimate heir, ultimately enabling him to ascend the throne.

description.zh-cn: 吕不韦招揽门客，合力编撰了《吕氏春秋》。
description.en: Lü Buwei recruited scholars and retainers to collaboratively compile the 'Lüshi Chunqiu'.

description.zh-cn: 秦庄襄王元年（前249年），吕不韦奉命灭亡东周国。
description.en: In the first year of King Zhuangxiang's reign (-249), Lü Buwei was ordered to conquer the state of Eastern Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 在灭亡东周国时，奉命诛杀东周君。
description.en: During the conquest of the Eastern Zhou, he was ordered to execute the Lord of Eastern Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 秦王政十年（前237年），秦始皇下令调查并平定了嫪毐发动的叛乱，并将其诛杀。
description.en: In the tenth year of his reign (-237), Qin Shi Huang ordered an investigation and suppressed the rebellion launched by Lao Ai, subsequently having him executed.

description.zh-cn: 在平定嫪毐之乱后，秦始皇将母亲赵姬软禁，并毒杀了她与嫪毐的两个私生子。
description.en: After suppressing the Lao Ai rebellion, Qin Shi Huang placed his mother, Queen Dowager Zhao, under house arrest and poisoned her two illegitimate sons with Lao Ai.

description.zh-cn: 嫪毐集团发动叛乱，此事牵连了吕不韦，导致其被秦王政免除相邦职务。
