description.en: The commissioning of Beijing Daxing International Airport led to a diversion of passengers from Capital Airport, creating a competitive relationship.

description.zh-cn: 受疫情打击，首都机场的旅客吞吐量大幅下滑。
description.en: Affected by the pandemic, the passenger throughput of Capital Airport declined sharply.

description.zh-cn: 于1950年报请中共中央，拟新建一座民航专用机场，即后来的首都机场。
description.en: In 1950, it proposed to the Central Committee of the CCP to build a new civil aviation airport, which later became Capital Airport.

description.zh-cn: 机场建设因朝鲜战争爆发而搁置。
description.en: The construction of the airport was postponed due to the outbreak of the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 在苏联专家的指导下开始规划设计。
description.en: Planning and design began under the guidance of Soviet experts.

description.zh-cn: 为适应尼克松访华后日益增长的国际交流需求，首都机场提出了第二次扩建计划。
description.en: To meet the growing demand for international exchanges after Nixon's visit, the second expansion plan for Capital Airport was proposed.

description.zh-cn: 为2号航站楼的建设提供了超过300亿日元的长期贷款。
description.en: Provided a long-term loan of over 30 billion yen for the construction of Terminal 2.

description.zh-cn: 北京申奥成功是推动首都机场进行第三次大规模扩建（包括新建3号航站楼）的关键因素。
description.en: Beijing's successful bid for the Olympics was a key factor in promoting the third large-scale expansion of Capital Airport, including the construction of Terminal 3.

description.zh-cn: 先后批准了首都机场2号航站楼扩建工程的可行性研究报告（1992年）和3号航站楼建设方案（2003年）。
description.en: Successively approved the feasibility study report for the Terminal 2 expansion project (1992) and the construction plan for Terminal 3 (2003).

description.zh-cn: 曾长期在首都机场运营，后于2020年10月25日将全部航班转移至北京大兴国际机场，结束了在首都机场29年的运营历史。
description.en: Operated at Capital Airport for a long time, and later transferred all its flights to Beijing Daxing International Airport on October 25, 2020, ending its 29-year operational history at Capital Airport.

description.zh-cn: 北京首都国际机场是2022年北京冬奥会和冬残奥会的唯一官方入境口岸。
description.en: Beijing Capital International Airport was the sole official port of entry for the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics and Paralympics.

description.zh-cn: 温云松是温家宝的儿子。
description.en: Wen Yunsong is the son of Wen Jiabao.

description.zh-cn: 温云松是张培莉的儿子。
description.en: Wen Yunsong is the son of Zhang Peili.

description.zh-cn: 温云松是温如春的哥哥。
description.en: Wen Yunsong is the brother of Wen Ruchun.

description.zh-cn: 张培莉是温家宝的夫人。
description.en: Zhang Peili is the wife of Wen Jiabao.

description.zh-cn: 温家宝曾任中华人民共和国国务院总理。
description.en: Wen Jiabao served as the Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 凯洛管理学院是西北大学的商学院。
description.en: The Kellogg School of Management is the business school of Northwestern University.

description.zh-cn: 因温云松身份敏感为由，拒绝其求职申请。
description.en: Rejected his job application due to his sensitive background.

description.zh-cn: 电讯盈科与中国电信成立合资公司，中盈优创后并入该公司。
description.en: PCCW and China Telecom formed a joint venture, into which Unihub was later incorporated.

description.zh-cn: 温云松于2010年10月转任中国卫星通信集团副董事长，并于2012年2月15日升任董事长。
description.en: Wen Yunsong was appointed Vice Chairman of China Satcom in October 2010, and was promoted to Chairman on February 15, 2012.

description.zh-cn: 中国卫星通信集团是中国航天科技集团下属公司。
description.en: China Satcom is a subsidiary of China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 何晶是新加坡总理李显龙的夫人。
description.en: Ho Ching is the wife of Singapore's Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.

description.zh-cn: 据博讯新闻称，媒体对温云松的负面报道与当时温家宝和江泽民派系（上海帮）的政治权力斗争有关。
description.en: According to Boxun News, negative media reports about Wen Yunsong were related to the political power struggle between Wen Jiabao and the Jiang Zemin faction (Shanghai clique) at the time.

description.zh-cn: 于2010年3月发表报道，批评包括温云松在内的中共太子党竞相参与私募基金以获取暴利。
description.en: Published a report in March 2010 criticizing CCP princelings, including Wen Yunsong, for flocking to private equity to make huge profits.

description.zh-cn: 由于防火长城的审查机制，“温云松”成为网络搜索敏感词，导致其信息在百度、搜狗、新浪微博等平台被封锁或限制。
description.en: Due to the Great Firewall's censorship mechanism, 'Wen Yunsong' became a sensitive search term, leading to the blocking or restriction of his information on platforms like Baidu, Sogou, and Sina Weibo.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉出生于摄津国大坂堂岛。
description.en: Fukuzawa Yukichi was born in Dōjima, Ōsaka, Settsu Province.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉反对并激烈抨击封建社会的身份等级制度和专制压抑。
description.en: Fukuzawa Yukichi opposed and fiercely criticized the status system and authoritarian oppression of the feudal society.

description.zh-cn: 1855年，福泽谕吉前往绪方洪庵的适塾学习兰学，并于1857年成为塾长。
description.en: In 1855, Fukuzawa Yukichi went to Ogata Kōan's Tekijuku to study Rangaku, and became the head of the school in 1857.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉在绪方洪庵的适塾中学习兰学，是其学生。
description.en: Fukuzawa Yukichi studied Rangaku at Ogata Kōan's Tekijuku, being his student.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉于1858年在江户设立的兰学塾是庆应义塾的前身，他被认为是庆应义塾大学的创立者。
description.en: The Rangaku school established by Fukuzawa Yukichi in Edo in 1858 was the predecessor of Keio Gijuku, and he is considered the founder of Keio University.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉曾受雇于江户幕府，从事政府公文的翻译工作，并随幕府使节团出访海外。
description.en: Fukuzawa Yukichi was employed by the Edo Shogunate to translate government documents and accompanied its missions abroad.

description.zh-cn: 在1860年乘坐咸临丸前往美国期间，福泽谕吉与该船的指挥官胜海舟同行。
description.en: During the voyage to the United States aboard the Kanrin Maru in 1860, Fukuzawa Yukichi was accompanied by the ship's commander, Katsu Kaishū.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉于1882年创办了日报《时事新报》。
description.en: Fukuzawa Yukichi founded the daily newspaper 'Jiji Shinpō' in 1882.

description.zh-cn: 大隈重信被描述为福泽谕吉的盟友。
description.en: Ōkuma Shigenobu was described as an ally of Fukuzawa Yukichi.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉通过其教育和著述活动，极大地影响和推动了明治维新运动，传播西方思想，倡导“文明开化”。
description.en: Through his educational and literary activities, Fukuzawa Yukichi greatly influenced and promoted the Meiji Restoration by disseminating Western ideas and advocating for 'Civilization and Enlightenment'.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉在其《脱亚论》中对清朝持蔑视态度，视其为“恶友”，主张与其绝交。
description.en: In his 'Datsu-A Ron', Fukuzawa Yukichi held a contemptuous attitude towards the Qing dynasty, regarding it as a 'bad friend' and advocating for breaking ties.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉在其《脱亚论》中对朝鲜王朝持蔑视态度，视其为“恶友”，主张与其绝交。
description.en: In his 'Datsu-A Ron', Fukuzawa Yukichi held a contemptuous attitude towards the Joseon dynasty, regarding it as a 'bad friend' and advocating for breaking ties.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉将中日甲午战争描述为一场“文野之战”，并支持日本对华开战。
description.en: Fukuzawa Yukichi described the First Sino-Japanese War as a 'war between civilization and barbarism' and supported Japan's decision to go to war with China.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉通过出资购买武器来资助朝鲜改革派发动的甲申政变。
description.en: Fukuzawa Yukichi supported the Gapsin Coup, initiated by Korean reformers, by funding the purchase of weapons.

description.zh-cn: 1880年，福泽谕吉担任兴亚会的顾问。
description.en: In 1880, Fukuzawa Yukichi served as an advisor to the Kōakai.

description.zh-cn: 绪方洪庵是兰学私塾“适塾”的创办人。
description.en: Ogata Kōan was the founder of the Rangaku private school, Tekijuku.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉在《劝学篇》中多次提及亚当斯密的自由市场经济论，其经济思想受到其影响。
description.en: Fukuzawa Yukichi repeatedly mentioned Adam Smith's free-market economic theory in 'An Encouragement of Learning', indicating his economic thought was influenced by it.

description.zh-cn: 《劝学篇》在当时的日本几乎人手一本，对日本的“文明开化”产生了巨大影响。
description.en: 'An Encouragement of Learning' was so popular in Japan at the time that nearly everyone had a copy, having a profound impact on Japan's 'Civilization and Enlightenment'.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉1860年访问美国，这次经历让他受到文化震撼，并深刻认识到学习英语和西方制度的必要性。
description.en: Fukuzawa Yukichi's visit to the United States in 1860 caused him culture shock and made him profoundly aware of the necessity of learning English and Western systems.

description.zh-cn: 列夫·托洛茨基是共产国际的创始人之一。
description.en: Leon Trotsky was one of the founders of the Communist International.

description.zh-cn: 格里戈里·季诺维也夫是共产国际的创始人之一。
description.en: Grigory Zinoviev was one of the founders of the Communist International.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·拉狄克是共产国际的创始人之一。
description.en: Karl Radek was one of the founders of the Communist International.

description.zh-cn: 尼古拉·布哈林是共产国际的创始人之一。
description.en: Nikolai Bukharin was one of the founders of the Communist International.

description.zh-cn: 俄国十月革命的成功，为第三国际的成立提供了政治基础和号召力。
description.en: The success of the October Revolution in Russia provided the political basis and appeal for the establishment of the Third International.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际由第二国际中的革命派分裂出来而成立，以区别于后者的改良主义路线。
description.en: The Communist International was formed by a split of the revolutionary wing from the Second International, distinguishing itself from the latter's reformist line.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际执行委员会主席团于1943年5月15日作出提议解散共产国际的决定，并于6月10日正式宣告解散。
description.en: The Presidium of the Executive Committee of the Communist International made the decision to propose the dissolution of the Comintern on May 15, 1943, and officially announced its dissolution on June 10.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际解散后，其相关人员和组织转入新成立的苏联共产党中央委员会国际部。
description.en: After the dissolution of the Comintern, its personnel and organizations were transferred to the newly established International Department of the Central Committee of the CPSU.

description.zh-cn: 为在反法西斯战争中拉拢英美等国，苏联主导解散了以反对资本主义国家为目的的共产国际。
description.en: In order to win over countries like the United Kingdom and the United States in the anti-fascist war, the Soviet Union led the dissolution of the Comintern, which was originally established to oppose capitalist countries.

description.zh-cn: 共产党和工人党情报局是共产国际的后继组织。
description.en: The Cominform was the successor organization to the Communist International.

description.zh-cn: 格里戈里·季诺维也夫是共产国际执行委员会的第一任主席。
description.en: Grigory Zinoviev was the first Chairman of the Executive Committee of the Communist International.

description.zh-cn: 尼古拉·布哈林于1926年至1929年间担任共产国际执行委员会主席。
description.en: Nikolai Bukharin served as Chairman of the Executive Committee of the Communist International from 1926 to 1929.

description.zh-cn: 格奥尔基·季米特洛夫于1935年至1943年解散前担任共产国际执行委员会主席。
description.en: Georgi Dimitrov served as Chairman of the Executive Committee of the Communist International from 1935 until its dissolution in 1943.

description.zh-cn: 克拉拉·蔡特金在1929年私下批评共产国际已从一个活的政治体变成一个只会复述苏联指令的僵死机构，但公开场合仍表示支持。
description.en: In 1929, Klara Zetkin privately criticized the Comintern as having transformed from a living political body into a dead machine that only repeated Soviet directives, although she continued to support it publicly.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际将纳粹德国等法西斯政权视为主要敌人，并号召建立反法西斯统一战线。
description.en: The Comintern regarded fascist regimes like Nazi Germany as its primary enemy and called for the establishment of an anti-fascist united front.

description.zh-cn: 解散共产国际是苏联为在第二次世界大战中拉拢美国作为盟友而采取的妥协举动。
description.en: The dissolution of the Comintern was a compromise made by the Soviet Union to win over the United States as an ally in World War II.

description.zh-cn: 解散共产国际是苏联为在第二次世界大战中拉拢英国作为盟友而采取的妥协举动。
description.en: The dissolution of the Comintern was a compromise made by the Soviet Union to win over the United Kingdom as an ally in World War II.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际第二次代表大会通过了加入共产国际的条件《二十一条》。
description.en: The Second World Congress of the Communist International adopted the "Twenty-one Conditions" for admission to the Comintern.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际第七次代表大会决定采取人民阵线策略，联合各国力量建立广泛的反法西斯统一战线。
description.en: The 7th World Congress of the Comintern decided to adopt the Popular Front strategy, uniting forces in various countries to build a broad anti-fascist united front.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际执行委员会是共产国际的执行机构。
description.en: The Executive Committee of the Communist International was the executive body of the Comintern.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培曾两度担任北京大学校长，期间革新北大，开“学术”与“自由”之风，大量引进新人物，使北大成为新文化运动的中心。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei served as the President of Peking University twice, during which he reformed the university, fostering a spirit of 'academics' and 'freedom'. He brought in many new figures, making Peking University the center of the New Culture Movement.

description.zh-cn: 1927年，蔡元培在主持教育行政委员会期间，筹设并创办了中央研究院。
description.en: In 1927, while presiding over the Education Administrative Committee, Cai Yuanpei planned and founded the Academia Sinica.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培担任中央研究院首任院长直至去世。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei served as the first President of Academia Sinica until his death.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培在南京临时政府担任首任教育总长，奠定了民国教育的基本规模。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei served as the first Minister of Education in the Nanjing Provisional Government, laying the foundation for the educational system of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培曾任国民政府监察院首任院长。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei served as the first President of the Control Yuan of the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培倡议成立中华民国大学院作为全国最高学术教育行政机关，并担任首任院长。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei proposed the establishment of the Daxue Yuan as the nation's highest academic and educational administrative body and served as its first Chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培与吴稚晖、张静江、李石曾等人提出发动“护党救国”运动，并主持中央监察委员会会议，通过了要求对共产党人进行紧急处置的决议，推动了随后的“清党”行动。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei, along with Wu Zhihui, Zhang Jingjiang, Li Shizeng, and others, proposed the 'Protect the Party, Save the Nation' movement and presided over the Central Supervisory Committee meeting that passed resolutions for emergency measures against Communists, thus promoting the subsequent 'Party purge'.

description.zh-cn: 在1927年，蔡元培积极主张并参与了针对中国共产党的“清党”行动。
description.en: In 1927, Cai Yuanpei actively advocated for and participated in the 'Party purge' targeting the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培主持的国民党中央监察委员会会议审定了一份应予看管的共产党人名单，其中包括毛泽东。
description.en: A meeting of the KMT Central Supervisory Committee, presided over by Cai Yuanpei, approved a list of Communists to be placed under surveillance, which included Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培主持的国民党中央监察委员会会议审定了一份应予看管的共产党人名单，其中包括周恩来。
description.en: A meeting of the KMT Central Supervisory Committee, presided over by Cai Yuanpei, approved a list of Communists to be placed under surveillance, which included Zhou Enlai.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培主持的国民党中央监察委员会会议审定了一份应予看管的共产党人名单，其中包括陈独秀。
description.en: A meeting of the KMT Central Supervisory Committee, presided over by Cai Yuanpei, approved a list of Communists to be placed under surveillance, which included Chen Duxiu.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培在莱比锡大学研究哲学、美学、心理学和民族学。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei studied philosophy, aesthetics, psychology, and ethnology at Leipzig University.

description.zh-cn: 与陶成章等人在上海发起建立光复会，并担任会长。
description.en: Co-founded the Guangfuhui in Shanghai with Tao ChengZhang and others, and served as its president.

description.zh-cn: 1905年加入同盟会，并被孙中山委任为上海分会负责人。
description.en: Joined the Tongmenghui in 1905 and was appointed by Sun Yat-sen as the head of its Shanghai branch.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培与李石曾等人于1920年成立中法大学，蔡元培任校长。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei, along with Li Shizeng and others, founded the Sino-French University in 1920, with Cai serving as its president.

description.zh-cn: 与宋庆龄、鲁迅、杨杏佛等人共同组织中国民权保障同盟，并被选为副主席。
description.en: Co-founded the China League for Civil Rights with Soong Ching-ling, Lu Xun, and Yang Xingfo, and was elected as its vice-chairman.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培因不满袁世凯的专制统治，于1912年7月辞去教育总长职务。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei resigned from his post as Minister of Education in July 1912 due to his dissatisfaction with Yuan Shikai's autocratic rule.

description.zh-cn: 在蒋桂战争期间，李济深应蔡元培等人之邀前往南京调停，结果遭到蒋介石扣留。
description.en: During the Chiang-Gui War, Li Jishen went to Nanjing to mediate at the invitation of Cai Yuanpei and others, but was detained by Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 因蒋介石扣留应其邀请前来调停的李济深，蔡元培对此十分气愤，二人关系出现裂痕。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei was infuriated by Chiang Kai-shek's detention of Li Jishen, who had come to mediate at his invitation, causing a rift in their relationship.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在蔡元培逝世后发出唁电，称其为“学界泰斗，人世楷模”，高度评价并巩固其历史地位。
description.en: After Cai Yuanpei's death, Mao Zedong sent a condolence telegram praising him as a 'titan of the academic world and a model for all,' highly evaluating and solidifying his historical status.

description.zh-cn: 作为中国共产党最高领导人，毛泽东主导了土地改革运动，并坚持以阶级斗争的激烈方式进行。
description.en: As the supreme leader of the Communist Party of China, Mao Zedong led the Land Reform Movement and insisted on carrying it out through intense class struggle.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党作为执政党，在全国范围内发起并领导了土地改革运动。
description.en: As the ruling party, the Communist Party of China initiated and led the Land Reform Movement nationwide.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国建国后的土地改革运动是第二次国共内战期间中共在“解放区”所实行土地改革的延续，内战期间的经验为全国性运动奠定了基础。
description.en: The post-1949 Land Reform Movement was a continuation of the land reforms implemented by the CCP in 'liberated areas' during the Second Chinese Civil War; experiences from the war period laid the foundation for the nationwide movement.

description.zh-cn: 土地改革运动彻底消灭了在中国存在两千多年的地主阶级，其土地及财产被没收。据各方估计，该过程导致100万至500万地主及相关人员非正常死亡。
description.en: The Land Reform Movement completely eliminated the landlord class that had existed in China for over two thousand years, confiscating their land and property. According to various estimates, the process resulted in 1 to 5 million unnatural deaths among landlords and related individuals.

description.zh-cn: 土地改革运动使约3亿无地或少地的农民无偿分得了约7亿亩土地及生产资料，暂时成为土地的主人。
description.en: The Land Reform Movement enabled about 300 million landless or land-poor peasants to receive approximately 700 million mu of land and means of production free of charge, temporarily making them landowners.

description.zh-cn: 家庭联产承包责任制的实施使农民重新获得了土地的使用权和经营权。
description.en: The implementation of the household-responsibility system allowed peasants to regain the right to use and manage land.

description.zh-cn: 《中国土地法大纲》于1947年10月10日经中共中央批准正式公布。
description.en: The 'Outline Land Law of China' was officially promulgated with the approval of the CPC Central Committee on October 10, 1947.

description.zh-cn: 1952年2月，毛泽东在中共中央书记处会议上当面批评方方在广东土改中犯了“土改右倾”的错误。
description.en: In February 1952, at a meeting of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee, Mao Zedong personally criticized Fang Fang for making 'right-deviationist' errors in the Guangdong land reform.

description.zh-cn: 因不满广东土改进展缓慢，毛泽东于1951年11月后将陶铸调往广东主管土改工作，以加强和加速运动。
description.en: Dissatisfied with the slow progress of land reform in Guangdong, Mao Zedong transferred Tao Zhu after November 1951 to take charge of the work there to strengthen and accelerate the movement.

description.zh-cn: 因不满广东土改进展缓慢，毛泽东于1951年11月后将赵紫阳与陶铸一同调往广东参与领导土改工作。
description.en: Dissatisfied with the slow progress of land reform in Guangdong, Mao Zedong transferred Zhao Ziyang along with Tao Zhu after November 1951 to participate in leading the land reform work.

description.zh-cn: 1948年1月，任弼时发表《土地改革中的几个问题》，纠正了当时土改运动中出现的“左”倾偏向。
description.en: In January 1948, Ren Bishi published 'Several Issues in Land Reform', correcting the 'leftist' deviations that had emerged in the land reform movement at the time.

description.zh-cn: 阎慧卿是阎锡山的堂妹。
description.en: Yan Huiqing was Yan Xishan's cousin.

description.zh-cn: 辛亥革命太原起义成功后，阎锡山被推举为山西都督。
description.en: After the success of the Taiyuan Uprising during the Xinhai Revolution, Yan Xishan was elected as the military governor of Shanxi.

description.zh-cn: 与吴禄贞商讨组织燕晋联军，共同反清。
description.en: Conspired with Wu Luzhen to organize the Yan-Jin Allied Army to fight against the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯曾派兵进攻山西，阻挠阎锡山回太原。
description.en: Yuan Shikai once sent troops to attack Shanxi and obstruct Yan Xishan's return to Taiyuan.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山于1912年9月视察山西，与阎锡山密谈，鼓励其保守山西革命基地。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen inspected Shanxi in September 1912, had a secret talk with Yan Xishan, and encouraged him to defend the revolutionary base in Shanxi.

description.zh-cn: 在中原大战中与冯玉祥结盟，共同反对蒋介石。
description.en: Allied with Feng Yuxiang during the Central Plains War to jointly oppose Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 在中原大战中与李宗仁结盟，共同反对蒋介石。
description.en: Allied with Li Zongren during the Central Plains War to jointly oppose Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 张学良通电支持蒋介石，并派兵入关，导致阎锡山在中原大战中失败。
description.en: Zhang Xueliang declared his support for Chiang Kai-shek and sent troops into the Shanhai Pass, leading to Yan Xishan's defeat in the Central Plains War.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山在中原大战中战败，宣布下野并赴大连。
description.en: Yan Xishan was defeated in the Central Plains War, announced his retirement from politics, and went to Dalian.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山试图控制的山西新军公开叛变并倒向共产党，使其在与中共的权力斗争中受挫。
description.en: The Shanxi New Army, which Yan Xishan tried to control, openly mutinied and defected to the Communist Party, causing a setback in his power struggle with the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山部在战役中被解放军歼灭3.5万人，遭受重创。
description.en: Yan Xishan's forces were annihilated by the PLA in the campaign, with 35,000 casualties, suffering a major blow.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次国共内战期间，阎锡山作为国民党将领与中国人民解放军作战。
description.en: During the second Chinese Civil War, Yan Xishan, as a KMT general, fought against the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军攻占太原，结束了阎锡山在山西长达38年的统治。
description.en: The People's Liberation Army captured Taiyuan, ending Yan Xishan's 38-year rule in Shanxi.

description.zh-cn: 在太原城破后自杀。
description.en: Committed suicide after the fall of Taiyuan.

description.zh-cn: 在太原城破后自杀。
description.en: Committed suicide after the fall of Taiyuan.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山在重庆提议进行土地改革，遭到陈立夫的愤怒反对。
description.en: Yan Xishan proposed land reform in Chongqing, which was met with angry opposition from Chen Lifu.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山接替何应钦出任行政院院长及国防部长。
description.en: Yan Xishan succeeded He Yingqin as Premier of the Executive Yuan and Minister of National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山辞去行政院院长职务，由陈诚接任。
description.en: Yan Xishan resigned as Premier of the Executive Yuan, and was succeeded by Chen Cheng.

description.zh-cn: 约瑟夫·张伯伦是内维尔·张伯伦的父亲。
description.en: Joseph Chamberlain was Neville Chamberlain's father.

description.zh-cn: 奥斯汀·张伯伦是内维尔·张伯伦的异母长兄。
description.en: Austen Chamberlain was Neville Chamberlain's elder half-brother.

description.zh-cn: 在担任国家服务总监期间与首相劳合·乔治关系不佳并辞职，两人在政治生涯中始终互相排斥。
description.en: Had a poor relationship with Prime Minister Lloyd George while serving as Director of National Service and resigned; the two remained mutually antagonistic throughout their careers.

position.en: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom

description.zh-cn: 内维尔·张伯伦接替斯坦利·鲍德温成为英国首相。
description.en: Neville Chamberlain succeeded Stanley Baldwin as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 温斯顿·丘吉尔接替内维尔·张伯伦出任英国首相。
description.en: Winston Churchill succeeded Neville Chamberlain as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 内维尔·张伯伦接替斯坦利·鲍德温出任英国首相。
description.en: Neville Chamberlain succeeded Stanley Baldwin as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 内维尔·张伯伦以其对纳粹德国的绥靖外交政策而闻名。
description.en: Neville Chamberlain was known for his foreign policy of appeasement towards Nazi Germany.

description.zh-cn: 温斯顿·丘吉尔是绥靖政策的坚定反对者。
description.en: Winston Churchill was a staunch opponent of the policy of appeasement.

description.zh-cn: 内维尔·张伯伦是《慕尼黑协定》的签署者之一，该协定允许德国吞并捷克斯洛伐克的苏台德地区。
description.en: Neville Chamberlain was one of the signatories of the Munich Agreement, which allowed Germany to annex the Sudetenland from Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 《慕尼黑协定》允许纳粹德国吞并捷克斯洛伐克的苏台德地区。
description.en: The Munich Agreement permitted Nazi Germany to annex the Sudetenland from Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 德国入侵波兰后，英国于1939年9月3日对德宣战。
description.en: Following the German invasion of Poland, the United Kingdom declared war on Germany on September 3, 1939.

description.zh-cn: 盟军在挪威战役中的失败导致了议会对张伯伦政府的信任危机，并最终使其辞职。
description.en: The failure of the Allied forces in the Norwegian campaign led to a crisis of confidence in Chamberlain's government, ultimately causing his resignation.

description.zh-cn: 工党拒绝加入由内维尔·张伯伦领导的联合政府，这是导致他辞职的直接原因之一。
description.en: The Labour Party refused to join a national government led by Neville Chamberlain, which was one of the direct causes of his resignation.

description.zh-cn: 辞去首相后，内维尔·张伯伦在丘吉尔的战时内阁中担任枢密院议长。
description.en: After resigning as Prime Minister, Neville Chamberlain served as Lord President of the Council in Churchill's war cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 2016年8月前，北京卫戍区隶属于北京军区。
description.en: Before August 2016, the Beijing Garrison was subordinate to the Beijing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 北京卫戍区接受中央军事委员会直接指挥。
description.en: The Beijing Garrison receives direct command from the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 田明建在北京市区中心地带制造了建国门枪战事件。
description.en: Tian Mingjian caused the Jianguomen shooting incident in the central area of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 2016年7月，潘良时由北京卫戍区司令员调任陆军副司令员。
description.en: In July 2016, Pan Liangshi was transferred from the position of Commander of the Beijing Garrison to Deputy Commander of the PLA Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 傅崇碧曾两度担任北京卫戍区司令员。
description.en: Fu Chongbi served as the commander of the Beijing Garrison on two separate occasions.

description.zh-cn: 孟晚舟是孟军的女儿。
description.en: Meng Wanzhou is the daughter of Meng Jun.

description.zh-cn: 任平是孟晚舟的胞弟。
description.en: Ren Ping is Meng Wanzhou's full brother.

description.zh-cn: 姚安娜是孟晚舟的异母妹妹。
description.en: Yao Anna is Meng Wanzhou's half-sister.

description.zh-cn: 姚安娜是任正非的女儿。
description.en: Yao Anna is the daughter of Ren Zhengfei.

description.zh-cn: 孟晚舟是孟东波的外孙女。
description.en: Meng Wanzhou is the maternal granddaughter of Meng Dongbo.

description.zh-cn: 1990年从深圳华明学校（现深圳大学附属中学）高中毕业。
description.en: Graduated from Shenzhen Huaming School (now The High School Affiliated to Shenzhen University) in 1990.

description.zh-cn: 据一种说法，孟晚舟于1993年从深圳大学会计系毕业。
description.en: According to one account, Meng Wanzhou graduated from the accounting department of Shenzhen University in 1993.

description.zh-cn: 大学毕业后曾在中国建设银行工作。
description.en: Worked at China Construction Bank after graduating from university.

description.zh-cn: 因欺诈罪指控并通缉孟晚舟，要求加拿大将其逮捕并引渡。
description.en: Accused and issued a warrant for Meng Wanzhou on fraud charges, requesting Canada to arrest and extradite her.

description.zh-cn: 应美国司法互助要求逮捕并拘留孟晚舟。
description.en: Arrested and detained Meng Wanzhou at the request of the U.S. for judicial assistance.

description.zh-cn: 孟晚舟事件的核心是孟晚舟本人被逮捕和面临引渡程序。
description.en: The core of the Meng Wanzhou incident was her arrest and the extradition proceedings she faced.

description.zh-cn: 作为美国代理司法部长，宣布正式要求引渡孟晚舟。
description.en: As acting U.S. Attorney General, announced the formal request for the extradition of Meng Wanzhou.

description.zh-cn: 以23项罪名起诉华为公司。
description.en: Indicted Huawei on 23 criminal charges.

description.zh-cn: 美国司法部与孟晚舟达成了延期起诉协议。
description.en: The U.S. Department of Justice reached a deferred prosecution agreement with Meng Wanzhou.

description.zh-cn: 该协议的达成使得加拿大结束对孟晚舟的引渡程序，使其获释并返回中国。
description.en: The agreement led to Canada ending the extradition proceedings against Meng Wanzhou, allowing her to be released and return to China.

description.zh-cn: 在孟晚舟被拘留期间向其提供支持，孟晚舟获释后对此表示感谢。
description.en: Provided support to Meng Wanzhou during her detention, for which she expressed gratitude upon her release.

description.zh-cn: 在孟晚舟回国时发布微博表示欢迎，称其为自己的榜样。
description.en: Welcomed Meng Wanzhou's return to China with a Weibo post, calling her a role model.

description.zh-cn: 发现华罗庚的才能，邀请他至清华大学，并于1933年破格任用其为助教。
description.en: Discovered Hua Luogeng's talent, invited him to Tsinghua University, and unconventionally appointed him as a teaching assistant in 1933.

description.zh-cn: 熊庆来是华罗庚的学术导师。
description.en: Xiong Qinglai was Hua Luogeng's academic mentor.

description.zh-cn: 华罗庚在剑桥大学期间，受到了哈代-李特尔伍德学派的影响。
description.en: During his time at Cambridge University, Hua Luogeng was influenced by the Hardy-Littlewood school.

description.zh-cn: 注意到华罗庚的才能，并向数学家哈代推荐了他。
description.en: Noticed Hua Luogeng's talent and recommended him to the mathematician G. H. Hardy.

description.zh-cn: 邀请华罗庚建立中国科学院数学研究所。
description.en: Invited Hua Luogeng to establish the Institute of Mathematics of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

position.zh-cn: 助教、讲师、正教授、数学系主任
position.en: Teaching Assistant, Lecturer, Full Professor, Head of Mathematics Department

description.zh-cn: 1931年起在清华大学工作学习，先后任助教（1933年）、讲师（1934年）、正教授（1937-1945年）。1950年回国后担任数学系主任。
description.en: Began working and studying at Tsinghua University in 1931, successively serving as a teaching assistant (1933), lecturer (1934), and full professor (1937-1945). After returning to China in 1950, he became the head of the mathematics department.

description.zh-cn: 在担任清华大学教授期间，经历了西南联合大学时期（1937-1945）。
description.en: During his tenure as a professor at Tsinghua University, he was part of the National Southwestern Associated University (1937-1945).

description.zh-cn: 在1950年代后期的反右斗争中曾遭受冲击和批判。
description.en: He was impacted and criticized during the Anti-Rightist Campaign in the late 1950s.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命中曾遭受冲击和批判。
description.en: He was impacted and criticized during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 在反右斗争、文化大革命等政治运动中，华罗庚受到毛泽东的特别关照和保护。
description.en: During political campaigns such as the Anti-Rightist Campaign and the Cultural Revolution, Hua Luogeng received special attention and protection from Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 在反右斗争、文化大革命等政治运动中，华罗庚受到周恩来的特别关照和保护。
description.en: During political campaigns such as the Anti-Rightist Campaign and the Cultural Revolution, Hua Luogeng received special attention and protection from Zhou Enlai.

description.zh-cn: 介绍华罗庚重新加入中国国民党，并联名将其推荐为“最优秀教授党员”。
description.en: Introduced Hua Luogeng to rejoin the Kuomintang and jointly recommended him as one of the "most outstanding professor party members."

description.zh-cn: 与朱家骅联名将华罗庚推荐为“最优秀教授党员”。
description.en: Jointly with Zhu Jiahua, recommended Hua Luogeng as one of the "most outstanding professor party members."

description.zh-cn: 1952年9月加入中国民主同盟，1979年起任副主席。
description.en: Joined the China Democratic League in September 1952 and served as its Vice Chairman from 1979.

description.zh-cn: 在台湾戒严时期后期，曾捐助党外运动。
description.en: In the later period of martial law in Taiwan, he donated to the Tangwai movement.

description.zh-cn: 在民主进步党成立后，对其提供捐助。
description.en: After the establishment of the Democratic Progressive Party, he provided donations to it.

description.zh-cn: 在其书中称蔡洁生曾经娶五任妻子。
description.en: Claimed in her book that Tsai Chieh-sheng had married five wives.

description.zh-cn: 蔡洁生的母亲为排湾族人，其本人带有排湾族血统。
description.en: Tsai Chieh-sheng's mother was of the Paiwan people, and he himself has Paiwan ancestry.

description.zh-cn: 奥匈帝国在第一次世界大战后解体，为捷克斯洛伐克的独立建国创造了条件。
description.en: The dissolution of Austria-Hungary after World War I created the conditions for the independent state of Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国于1939年3月出兵吞并整个捷克斯洛伐克，导致其亡国。
description.en: Nazi Germany sent troops to annex the entirety of Czechoslovakia in March 1939, leading to the fall of the state.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国在吞并的捷克地区成立了波希米亚和摩拉维亚保护国作为傀儡政权。
description.en: Nazi Germany established the Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia as a puppet state in the annexed Czech territory.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国在斯洛伐克地区成立了受其保护的斯洛伐克共和国傀儡政权。
description.en: Nazi Germany established the Slovak Republic, a protectorate puppet state, in the Slovak territory.

description.zh-cn: 捷克斯洛伐克共产党在苏联扶持下发动了“二月事件”政变。
description.en: The Communist Party of Czechoslovakia, with Soviet support, launched the 'February coup'.

description.zh-cn: 二月事件政变后，捷克斯洛伐克成为亲苏联的社会主义国家。
description.en: After the February coup, Czechoslovakia became a pro-Soviet socialist state.

description.zh-cn: 1955年，捷克斯洛伐克加入华沙公约组织，与东欧大部分共产主义国家结成军事同盟。
description.en: In 1955, Czechoslovakia joined the Warsaw Pact, forming a military alliance with most of the communist countries in Eastern Europe.

description.zh-cn: 时任捷克斯洛伐克共产党第一书记的亚历山大·杜布切克发动了“布拉格之春”的经济和政治改革运动。
description.en: Then First Secretary of the Communist Party of Czechoslovakia, Alexander Dubček, launched the 'Prague Spring' economic and political reform movement.

description.zh-cn: 由于“布拉格之春”改革为苏联所不容，苏联主导了对捷克斯洛伐克的军事入侵。
description.en: As the 'Prague Spring' reforms were unacceptable to the Soviet Union, it led the military invasion of Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 苏联及华约成员国入侵捷克斯洛伐克，导致布拉格之春改革运动戛然而止。
description.en: The invasion of Czechoslovakia by the Soviet Union and Warsaw Pact members brought the Prague Spring reform movement to an abrupt end.

description.zh-cn: 天鹅绒革命结束了捷克斯洛伐克共产党的一党专政。
description.en: The Velvet Revolution ended the one-party rule of the Communist Party of Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 天鹅绒革命后，捷克斯洛伐克废除社会主义体制，并改名为捷克和斯洛伐克联邦共和国。
description.en: After the Velvet Revolution, Czechoslovakia abolished its socialist system and was renamed the Czech and Slovak Federative Republic.

description.zh-cn: 天鹅绒分离事件导致捷克斯洛伐克正式解体。
description.en: The Velvet Divorce event led to the formal dissolution of Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 捷克斯洛伐克通过天鹅绒分离事件解体，成立了独立的捷克共和国。
description.en: Czechoslovakia dissolved through the Velvet Divorce, leading to the establishment of the independent Czech Republic.

description.zh-cn: 捷克斯洛伐克通过天鹅绒分离事件解体，成立了独立的斯洛伐克共和国。
description.en: Czechoslovakia dissolved through the Velvet Divorce, leading to the establishment of the independent Slovak Republic.

description.zh-cn: 捷克斯洛伐克第一任总统。
description.en: First President of Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 捷克斯洛伐克第二任及第四任总统。
description.en: Second and fourth President of Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 捷克斯洛伐克第五任总统，也是第一位共产党总统。
description.en: Fifth President of Czechoslovakia, and the first communist president.

description.zh-cn: 担任捷克斯洛伐克共产党主席。
description.en: Served as Chairman of the Communist Party of Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 担任捷克斯洛伐克共产党第一书记。
description.en: Served as First Secretary of the Communist Party of Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 担任捷克斯洛伐克共产党第一书记，领导了布拉格之春改革。
description.en: Served as First Secretary of the Communist Party of Czechoslovakia, leading the Prague Spring reforms.

description.zh-cn: 担任捷克斯洛伐克总统。
description.en: Served as President of Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 担任捷克斯洛伐克共产党最高领导人。
description.en: Served as the supreme leader of the Communist Party of Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 担任捷克斯洛伐克最后一任总统。
description.en: Served as the last President of Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 2017年2月7日，时任副总统迈克·彭斯投下关键一票，使贝琪·德沃斯得以成为教育部长，这是美国国会史上首次由副总统在内阁提名投票中打破僵局。
description.en: On February 7, 2017, then-Vice President Mike Pence cast a tie-breaking vote to confirm Betsy DeVos as Secretary of Education, the first time in U.S. history a Vice President broke a tie on a cabinet nomination.

description.zh-cn: 1841年，在威廉·亨利·哈里森总统逝世后，副总统约翰·泰勒继任总统职务，并确立了副总统完全继承总统职位的先例，即“泰勒先例”。
description.en: In 1841, after the death of President William Henry Harrison, Vice President John Tyler succeeded to the presidency, establishing the precedent that the vice president fully inherits the presidential office, known as the 'Tyler Precedent'.

description.zh-cn: “泰勒先例”为后来于1967年通过的美国宪法第二十五修正案提供了法理基础，该修正案将这一继任程序正式化。
description.en: The 'Tyler Precedent' provided the basis for the Twenty-fifth Amendment to the U.S. Constitution, ratified in 1967, which formalized this succession procedure.

description.zh-cn: 约翰·泰勒在威廉·亨利·哈里森总统任内担任副总统，并在哈里森总统逝世后继任总统。
description.en: John Tyler served as Vice President during President William Henry Harrison's term and succeeded him as president upon his death.

description.zh-cn: 由于水门事件导致理查德·尼克松总统辞职，时任副总统杰拉尔德·福特继任成为美国总统。
description.en: Following President Richard Nixon's resignation due to the Watergate scandal, Vice President Gerald Ford succeeded to the presidency.

description.zh-cn: 明仁是昭和天皇的长子。
description.en: Akihito is the eldest son of Emperor Shōwa.

description.zh-cn: 明仁是香淳皇后的长子。
description.en: Akihito is the eldest son of Empress Kōjun.

description.zh-cn: 明仁于1959年4月10日与正田美智子结婚。
description.en: Akihito married Michiko Shōda on April 10, 1959.

description.zh-cn: 德仁是明仁的长子。
description.en: Naruhito is the eldest son of Akihito.

description.zh-cn: 文仁亲王是明仁的次子。
description.en: Prince Fumihito is the second son of Akihito.

description.zh-cn: 黑田清子是明仁的女儿。
description.en: Sayako Kuroda is the daughter of Akihito.

description.zh-cn: 明仁曾在学习院大学政治经济学系学习。
description.en: Akihito studied at the Department of Politics and Economics of Gakushuin University.

description.zh-cn: 伊莉莎白·格雷·维宁曾担任明仁的家庭教师。
description.en: Elizabeth Gray Vining served as a private tutor to Akihito.

description.zh-cn: 明仁经由其家庭教师伊莉莎白·格雷·维宁的介绍与驻日盟军总司令麦克阿瑟见面。
description.en: Akihito met with Douglas MacArthur, the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, through an introduction by his tutor, Elizabeth Gray Vining.

description.zh-cn: 1975年7月17日，明仁夫妇以皇太子和太子妃身份访问冲绳时，遭遇燃烧瓶袭击事件。
description.en: On July 17, 1975, while visiting Okinawa as Crown Prince and Princess, Akihito and his wife were attacked with a Molotov cocktail.

description.zh-cn: 平成是明仁在位期间使用的年号。
description.en: Heisei was the era name used during Akihito's reign.

description.zh-cn: 1992年10月，明仁天皇访华期间，与时任中共中央总书记江泽民会见。
description.en: In October 1992, during his visit to China, Emperor Akihito met with then-General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, Jiang Zemin.

description.zh-cn: 时任中国国家主席杨尚昆邀请明仁天皇伉俪访问中国。
description.en: Then-President of China Yang Shangkun invited Emperor Akihito and his wife to visit China.

description.zh-cn: 2014年4月24日，明仁与美国总统贝拉克·奥巴马会面。
description.en: On April 24, 2014, Akihito met with U.S. President Barack Obama.

description.zh-cn: 明仁于1933年12月23日在宫城（现皇居）内的御产殿诞生。
description.en: Akihito was born on December 23, 1933, in the Gosan-den (delivery hall) within the Kyūjō (present-day Imperial Palace).

description.zh-cn: 明仁于2016年8月8日正式表达在世退位的意向，推动了《天皇退位特例法》的制定。
description.en: On August 8, 2016, Akihito formally expressed his intention to abdicate, which pushed for the enactment of the 'Special Measures Law on the Emperor's Abdication'.

position.zh-cn: 皇太子, 天皇, 上皇

description.zh-cn: 明仁自出生起即为日本皇室成员。
description.en: Akihito has been a member of the Imperial House of Japan since his birth.

description.zh-cn: 1945年8月，美国向苏联提议以北纬38度线作为双方在朝鲜半岛的受降分界线。
description.en: In August 1945, the United States proposed to the Soviet Union to use the 38th parallel north as the demarcation line for accepting surrender on the Korean Peninsula.

description.zh-cn: 1945年8月，苏联接受了美国以北纬38度线作为双方在朝鲜半岛的受降分界线的提议。
description.en: In August 1945, the Soviet Union accepted the United States' proposal to use the 38th parallel north as the demarcation line for accepting surrender on the Korean Peninsula.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国于1948年在美国占领军的支持下建立。
description.en: The Republic of Korea was established in 1948 with the support of the U.S. occupation forces.

description.zh-cn: 联合国军于1953年在黄海划定了北方界线作为事实上的海上军事分界线。
description.en: The United Nations Command established the Northern Limit Line in the Yellow Sea in 1953 as the de facto maritime military demarcation line.

description.zh-cn: 由于《朝鲜停战协定》中未提及，北方界线不被朝鲜方面承认。
description.en: Because it was not mentioned in the Korean Armistice Agreement, the Northern Limit Line is not recognized by North Korea.

description.zh-cn: 周作人是周建人的哥哥。
description.en: Zhou Zuoren was the elder brother of Zhou Jianren.

description.zh-cn: 周作人在日本留学时，曾师从章太炎学习《说文解字》。
description.en: While studying in Japan, Zhou Zuoren was a student of Zhang Taiyan, learning the 'Shuowen Jiezi'.

description.zh-cn: 1901年进入江南水师学堂管轮班学习，共6年。
description.en: Enrolled in the marine engineering class at Jiangnan Naval Academy in 1901 for 6 years.

description.zh-cn: 五四运动之后，与郑振铎、沈雁冰、叶绍钧、许地山等人共同发起成立“文学研究会”。
description.en: After the May Fourth Movement, co-founded the 'Literary Research Association' with Zheng Zhenduo, Shen Yanbing, Ye Shaojun, Xu Dishan, and others.

position.zh-cn: 国史编纂处编纂、文科教授、东方文学系主任、图书馆馆长、文学院院长
position.en: Compiler at the National History Compilation Office, Professor of the Faculty of Arts, Head of the Department of Oriental Literature, Director of the Library, Dean of the Faculty of Arts

description.zh-cn: 周作人自1917年起在北京大学任职，抗战期间留守北平后，于1939年起担任汪精卫政权下的北京大学图书馆馆长及文学院院长等职务。
description.en: Zhou Zuoren worked at Peking University starting in 1917. After staying in Beiping during the Anti-Japanese War, he served as the Director of the Peking University Library and Dean of the Faculty of Arts under the Wang Jingwei regime from 1939.

position.zh-cn: 常务委员兼教育总署督办
position.en: Standing Committee Member and Director-General of the Education Bureau

description.zh-cn: 1940年12月，汪精卫政权任命周作人为华北政务委员会委员，并指定为常务委员兼教育总署督办。
description.en: In December 1940, the Wang Jingwei regime appointed Zhou Zuoren as a member of the North China Political Council, designated as a Standing Committee Member and Director-General of the Education Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 1927年4月28日，奉系军阀张作霖在北京下令将中共创始人之一李大钊等20余名国民党及共产党员处以绞刑。
description.en: On April 28, 1927, warlord Zhang Zuolin ordered the execution by hanging of Li Dazhao, one of the founders of the CCP, and over 20 other Kuomintang and Communist party members in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 在李大钊被杀害后，周作人将李大钊的儿子李葆华藏在家中加以保护。
description.en: After Li Dazhao was killed, Zhou Zuoren hid his son Li Baohua in his home for protection.

description.zh-cn: 在李大钊被杀害后，周作人将李大钊的女儿李星华藏在家中加以保护。
description.en: After Li Dazhao was killed, Zhou Zuoren hid his daughter Li Xinghua in his home for protection.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争结束后，国民政府于1945年12月以汉奸罪名逮捕周作人，并将其判刑监禁，直至1949年1月释放。
description.en: After the end of the Anti-Japanese War, the Nationalist Government arrested Zhou Zuoren in December 1945 on charges of treason and imprisoned him until his release in January 1949.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命开始后，周作人遭到红卫兵的批斗和殴打，家产被查封，最终在迫害中于1967年5月去世。
description.en: After the Cultural Revolution began, Zhou Zuoren was denounced and beaten by Red Guards, his property was confiscated, and he eventually died amid the persecution in May 1967.

description.zh-cn: 根据周作人日记记载，毛泽东于1920年4月7日拜访了他。
description.en: According to Zhou Zuoren's diary, Mao Zedong visited him on April 7, 1920.

description.zh-cn: 在收到周作人的信后，毛泽东批示“养起来，做翻译工作”，使得周作人能在中华人民共和国成立后以翻译为生。
description.en: After receiving a letter from Zhou Zuoren, Mao Zedong instructed to 'support him and let him do translation work,' which allowed Zhou Zuoren to make a living as a translator after the founding of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 与哥哥鲁迅合作翻译并出版了《域外小说集》。
description.en: Collaborated with his brother Lu Xun to translate and publish 'Tales from Abroad'.

description.zh-cn: 与弟弟周作人合作翻译并出版了《域外小说集》，并校订了周作人翻译的各篇。
description.en: Collaborated with his brother Zhou Zuoren to translate and publish 'Tales from Abroad', and proofread the pieces translated by Zhou Zuoren.

description.zh-cn: 1206年，铁木真在鄂嫩河源头召开忽里勒台，即皇帝位，建立大蒙古国，并获得“成吉思汗”的尊号。
description.en: In 1206, at a kurultai on the banks of the Onon River, Temüjin was acknowledged as emperor, establishing the Great Mongol State and receiving the title of 'Genghis Khan'.

description.zh-cn: 窝阔台是成吉思汗的第三子。
description.en: Ögedei was the third son of Genghis Khan.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥是拖雷的长子。
description.en: Möngke was the eldest son of Tolui.

description.zh-cn: 旭烈兀是拖雷的儿子。
description.en: Hulagu was a son of Tolui.

description.zh-cn: 阿里不哥是拖雷的幼子。
description.en: Ariq Böke was the youngest son of Tolui.

description.zh-cn: 成吉思汗建立大蒙古国后，发动了一系列对外扩张战争。
description.en: After establishing the Great Mongol State, Genghis Khan launched a series of external expansionist wars.

description.zh-cn: 经过多次征伐，成吉思汗于1227年最终灭亡西夏。
description.en: After several campaigns, Genghis Khan finally destroyed the Western Xia in 1227.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国自成吉思汗起开始攻打金朝，最终由窝阔台于1234年彻底灭亡金朝。
description.en: The Mongol Empire began its assault on the Jin dynasty under Genghis Khan, and finally completed the conquest under Ögedei Khan in 1234.

description.zh-cn: 1218年，成吉思汗派遣大将哲别征服西辽。
description.en: In 1218, Genghis Khan dispatched his general Jebe to conquer the Qara Khitai.

description.zh-cn: 因讹答剌事件，成吉思汗于1219年亲率大军西征，征服了花剌子模王朝。
description.en: Triggered by the Otrar incident, Genghis Khan personally led a large-scale invasion in 1219 and conquered the Khwarazmian dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 1258年，旭烈兀率领的蒙古军队攻陷巴格达，灭亡了阿拔斯王朝。
description.en: In 1258, Mongol forces led by Hulagu sacked Baghdad and destroyed the Abbasid Caliphate.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国对南宋进行了长达数十年的战争，最终由忽必烈建立的元朝于1279年灭亡南宋。
description.en: The Mongol Empire waged war against the Southern Song dynasty for decades, culminating in its final conquest in 1279 by the Yuan dynasty, founded by Kublai Khan.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥是蒙古帝国的第四位大汗，也是最后一位统治整个统一帝国的蒙古大汗。
description.en: Möngke was the fourth Great Khan of the Mongol Empire and the last to rule over a united empire.

description.zh-cn: 忽必烈与阿里不哥的汗位之争导致了拖雷家族内战，这场内战标志着统一的蒙古帝国走向分裂。
description.en: The struggle for the throne between Kublai and Ariq Böke led to the Toluid Civil War, which marked the beginning of the fragmentation of the unified Mongol Empire.

description.zh-cn: 忽必烈在内战期间于开平自行即位，并以汉地为基础，最终建立了元朝，使之成为帝国分裂后的主要实体之一。
description.en: During the civil war, Kublai enthroned himself in Kaiping and, using his power base in Chinese territory, eventually established the Yuan dynasty, making it one of the main entities after the empire's fragmentation.

description.zh-cn: 内战后，钦察汗国等汗国取得了事实上的独立地位。
description.en: After the civil war, khanates like the Golden Horde achieved de facto independence.

description.zh-cn: 内战后，察合台汗国等汗国取得了事实上的独立地位。
description.en: After the civil war, khanates like the Chagatai Khanate achieved de facto independence.

description.zh-cn: 内战后，伊儿汗国等汗国取得了事实上的独立地位。
description.en: After the civil war, khanates like the Ilkhanate achieved de facto independence.

description.zh-cn: 元朝被明朝推翻后，其残余势力退回蒙古高原，史称北元。
description.en: After the Yuan dynasty was overthrown by the Ming, its remnants retreated to the Mongolian Plateau, historically known as the Northern Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 明朝攻陷元大都，元廷北撤，标志着作为统一帝国的蒙古帝国最终瓦解。
description.en: The Ming dynasty's capture of the Yuan capital Dadu and the retreat of the Yuan court to the north marked the final dissolution of the Mongol Empire as a unified entity.

description.zh-cn: 在厓山海战战败后，陆秀夫背负幼主赵昺投海殉国。
description.en: After the defeat at the Battle of Yamen, Lu Xiufu committed suicide by drowning, taking the child emperor Zhao Bing with him.

description.zh-cn: 在厓山海战战败后，南宋末代皇帝赵昺由丞相陆秀夫背负投海殉国。
description.en: After the defeat at the Battle of Yamen, Zhao Bing, the last emperor of the Southern Song, died after his chancellor Lu Xiufu jumped into the sea with him.

description.zh-cn: 亨利八世发起了英格兰的宗教改革。
description.en: Henry VIII initiated the Reformation in England.

description.zh-cn: 教宗良十世下令将马丁·路德处以破门律，驱逐出教。
description.en: Pope Leo X ordered Martin Luther to be excommunicated and expelled from the Church.

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马皇帝查理五世发布诏书通缉马丁·路德。
description.en: Holy Roman Emperor Charles V issued an edict declaring Martin Luther an outlaw.

description.zh-cn: 萨克森选帝侯腓特烈三世是马丁·路德最坚定的支持者，为他提供了保护，使其免于被捕。
description.en: Elector Frederick III of Saxony was Martin Luther's staunchest supporter, providing him with protection from arrest.

description.zh-cn: 马丁·路德创立了信义宗（路德会）。
description.en: Martin Luther founded Lutheranism (the Lutheran Church).

description.zh-cn: 约翰·威克里夫是宗教改革的先驱，早于马丁·路德便提出了改革思想。
description.en: John Wycliffe was a forerunner of the Reformation, proposing reformist ideas before Martin Luther.

description.zh-cn: 扬·胡斯因阅读约翰·威克里夫的著作后深受感动，并采纳其改革思想。
description.en: Jan Hus was deeply moved after reading the works of John Wycliffe and adopted his reformist ideas.

description.zh-cn: 康士坦斯大公会议将扬·胡斯拘留，并于1415年7月6日将其处以火刑。
description.en: The Council of Constance detained Jan Hus and sentenced him to be burned at the stake on July 6, 1415.

description.zh-cn: 将扬·胡斯处死引起了波希米亚反教廷的胡斯战争。
description.en: The execution of Jan Hus triggered the Hussite Wars in Bohemia against the Papacy.

description.zh-cn: 《西发里亚和约》的签订结束了三十年战争。
description.en: The signing of the Peace of Westphalia ended the Thirty Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 天主教会的“反宗教改革”运动是对新教宗教改革的回应。
description.en: The Catholic Church's 'Counter-Reformation' movement was a response to the Protestant Reformation.

description.zh-cn: 天主教会发起了反宗教改革运动以进行内部革新并对抗新教。
description.en: The Catholic Church initiated the Counter-Reformation for internal reform and to counter Protestantism.

description.zh-cn: 特伦托会议的召开是反宗教改革运动的核心。
description.en: The convening of the Council of Trent was central to the Counter-Reformation movement.

description.zh-cn: 耶稣会是反宗教改革革新运动的先锋。
description.en: The Society of Jesus (Jesuits) were pioneers of the Counter-Reformation movement.

description.zh-cn: 人文主义思想重视思考和研究，对宗教改革运动有很大的影响。
description.en: Humanist thought, which valued critical thinking and research, had a great influence on the Reformation.

description.zh-cn: 伊拉斯谟就自由意志的议题与马丁·路德展开激烈的论战。
description.en: Erasmus engaged in a fierce debate with Martin Luther on the issue of free will.

description.zh-cn: 教宗克勉七世拒绝了亨利八世的婚姻无效请求。
description.en: Pope Clement VII refused Henry VIII's request for an annulment of his marriage.

description.zh-cn: 亨利八世宣布脱离罗马教廷，使英格兰教会独立于天主教会之外。
description.en: Henry VIII declared a break from the Roman Papacy, making the Church of England independent of the Catholic Church.

description.zh-cn: 亨利八世通过《至尊法案》创立了英格兰教会，并成为其最高领袖。
description.en: Henry VIII founded the Church of England through the Act of Supremacy, becoming its supreme head.

description.zh-cn: 《至尊法案》从法律上确立了英格兰教会的独立地位以及英国君主的领袖身份。
description.en: The Act of Supremacy legally established the independence of the Church of England and the monarch's role as its head.

description.zh-cn: 约翰·加尔文是归正宗（加尔文派）神学的主要奠基人。
description.en: John Calvin was the principal founder of the theology of Reformed Christianity (Calvinism).

description.zh-cn: 约翰·加尔文主张并系统阐述了预选说。
description.en: John Calvin advocated and systematically articulated the doctrine of predestination.

description.zh-cn: 在1529年的马尔堡会议中，慈运理因对圣餐的看法与路德不同而与信义宗分道扬镳。
description.en: At the Marburg Colloquy in 1529, Zwingli's different view on the Eucharist led to a split with Luther and the Lutherans.

description.zh-cn: 英王查理一世迫害清教徒，试图在英国恢复旧教仪式。
description.en: King Charles I of England persecuted the Puritans, attempting to restore Catholic rituals in England.

description.zh-cn: 查理一世与国会（主要由清教徒控制）的冲突最终引发了英国内战。
description.en: The conflict between Charles I and Parliament (largely controlled by Puritans) ultimately triggered the English Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 宋神宗是宋英宗的长子。
description.en: Emperor Shenzong was the eldest son of Emperor Yingzong.

description.zh-cn: 宋神宗是宣仁圣烈皇后高氏所生的长子。
description.en: Emperor Shenzong was the eldest son born to Empress Xuanren, née Gao.

description.zh-cn: 宋哲宗是宋神宗的第六子和皇位继承人。
description.en: Emperor Zhezong was the sixth son and heir of Emperor Shenzong.

description.zh-cn: 宋神宗即位后，任命其所欣赏的王安石为宰相，推行变法。
description.en: After ascending the throne, Emperor Shenzong appointed Wang Anshi, whom he admired, as chancellor to implement reforms.

description.zh-cn: 宋神宗重用将领王韶，任命他主持熙河开边事宜。
description.en: Emperor Shenzong heavily relied on General Wang Shao, appointing him to lead the Xihe Expansion.

description.zh-cn: 宋神宗在作为太子时喜爱阅读《韩非子》，并对法家“富国强兵”之术很感兴趣，这影响了他后来的执政理念。
description.en: As Crown Prince, Emperor Shenzong enjoyed reading 'Han Feizi' and was interested in the Legalist methods of 'enriching the state and strengthening the military,' which influenced his later governing philosophy.

description.zh-cn: 宋神宗在即位前读过王安石的《上仁宗皇帝言事书》，非常赞赏其理财治国思想，这促使他后来任用王安石进行变法。
description.en: Before his accession, Emperor Shenzong read Wang Anshi's 'Memorial to Emperor Renzong' and greatly admired his ideas on financial management and state governance, which prompted him to later appoint Wang Anshi to carry out reforms.

description.zh-cn: 作为宋神宗的母亲，高太后对新法持反对态度，曾对神宗说：“王安石是在变乱天下呀！”
description.en: As Emperor Shenzong's mother, Empress Dowager Gao opposed the New Policies, once telling the emperor: 'Wang Anshi is turning the world upside down!'

description.zh-cn: 在御史弹劾苏轼讥讽新法后，宋神宗下令将其拘捕，从而引发了乌台诗案。
description.en: After censors impeached Su Shi for satirizing the New Policies, Emperor Shenzong ordered his arrest, thereby triggering the Crow Terrace Poetry Case.

description.zh-cn: 乌台诗案导致苏轼被捕入狱近四个月，虽免于一死，但最终被贬谪至黄州，政治生涯遭受重创。
description.en: The Crow Terrace Poetry Case led to Su Shi's imprisonment for nearly four months. Although spared from death, he was ultimately exiled to Huangzhou, dealing a severe blow to his political career.

description.zh-cn: 在乌台诗案中，太皇太后曹氏（慈圣皇后）出面力挽，是苏轼最终能免于一死的关键因素之一。
description.en: During the Crow Terrace Poetry Case, Grand Empress Dowager Cao (Empress Cisheng) intervened forcefully, which was one of the key factors that saved Su Shi from execution.

description.zh-cn: 宋神宗意图雪数世之耻，重用王韶发动了“熙河开边”军事行动，意在开拓疆土，削弱西夏。
description.en: Seeking to avenge generations of shame, Emperor Shenzong heavily utilized Wang Shao to launch the 'Xihe Expansion' military campaign, aiming to expand territory and weaken Western Xia.

description.zh-cn: 通过熙河开边，宋军收复河、洮、岷等五州，占领了西夏两千里土地，对西夏形成了战略包围态势。
description.en: Through the Xihe Expansion, the Song army recovered five prefectures including He, Tao, and Min, occupied two thousand li of Western Xia's territory, and formed a strategic encirclement of Western Xia.

description.zh-cn: 在位期间，宋神宗将西夏视为主要外部威胁，发动多次军事行动，意图一举将其歼灭。
description.en: During his reign, Emperor Shenzong regarded Western Xia as a major external threat and launched multiple military campaigns with the intent of annihilating it.

description.zh-cn: 永乐城之战的惨败是宋神宗执政期间最大的军事挫折，导致宋军损失二十万，使他深受打击，在朝中当众痛哭，此后不再轻言开战。
description.en: The disastrous defeat at the Battle of Yongle City was the greatest military setback of Emperor Shenzong's reign, resulting in the loss of 200,000 Song troops. He was deeply affected, wept publicly in court, and refrained from lightly initiating wars thereafter.

description.zh-cn: 在进攻西夏期间，将领种谔反对在永乐城筑城，但其建议被指挥官徐禧拒绝。
description.en: During the campaign against Western Xia, General Zhong E opposed building a fortress at Yongle City, but his advice was rejected by commander Xu Xi.

description.zh-cn: 明末清初思想家王夫之在《宋论》中对宋神宗的执政给予负面评价，认为“宋政之乱，自神宗始”，对其历史地位造成了负面影响。
description.en: The late-Ming, early-Qing thinker Wang Fuzhi gave a negative evaluation of Emperor Shenzong's reign in his 'Song Lun', stating that 'the chaos of Song governance began with Shenzong,' which negatively impacted his historical standing.

description.zh-cn: 宋真宗是宋太宗的第三个儿子。
description.en: Emperor Zhenzong was the third son of Emperor Taizong.

description.zh-cn: 宋真宗的生母是元德皇后李氏。
description.en: Emperor Zhenzong's biological mother was Empress Yuande (née Li).

description.zh-cn: 宋仁宗是宋真宗的第六个儿子。
description.en: Emperor Renzong was the sixth son of Emperor Zhenzong.

description.zh-cn: 宋仁宗的生母是章懿皇后李氏。
description.en: Emperor Renzong's biological mother was Empress Zhangyi (née Li).

description.zh-cn: 宋真宗与楚王赵元佐是同母兄弟，赵元佐是其长兄。
description.en: Emperor Zhenzong and Prince Zhao Yuanzuo of Chu were full brothers; Zhao Yuanzuo was his elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 宋真宗作为宋朝的第三位皇帝，在位共25年。
description.en: Emperor Zhenzong reigned as the third emperor of the Song Dynasty for 25 years.

description.zh-cn: 景德元年（1004年），辽朝大举入侵宋朝，兵锋直指澶州。
description.en: In the first year of the Jingde era (1004), the Liao dynasty launched a major invasion of the Song dynasty, with their forces advancing directly on Chanzhou.

description.zh-cn: 寇准是宋真宗时期的宰相。
description.en: Kou Zhun was a prime minister during the reign of Emperor Zhenzong.

description.zh-cn: 面对辽国入侵，寇准极力主张抵抗，并说服宋真宗御驾亲征以鼓舞士气。
description.en: Facing the Liao invasion, Kou Zhun strongly advocated for resistance and persuaded Emperor Zhenzong to personally lead the expedition to boost morale.

description.zh-cn: 宋真宗御驾亲征至澶州，与辽国对峙后，最终决定派使臣谈判，促成了澶渊之盟的签订。
description.en: Emperor Zhenzong personally led his army to Chanzhou, and after a standoff with the Liao forces, he decided to send an envoy for negotiations, which led to the signing of the Treaty of Chanyuan.

description.zh-cn: 宋真宗统治前期勤于政事，其政策促进了农业和手工业的发展，开创了“咸平之治”的繁荣局面。
description.en: In his early reign, Emperor Zhenzong was diligent in state affairs, and his policies promoted the development of agriculture and handicrafts, creating the prosperous situation of the 'Reign of Xianping'.

description.zh-cn: 王钦若是宋真宗统治后期的宰相。
description.en: Wang Qinruo was a prime minister during the late reign of Emperor Zhenzong.

description.zh-cn: 丁谓是宋真宗统治后期的宰相。
description.en: Ding Wei was a prime minister during the late reign of Emperor Zhenzong.

description.zh-cn: 王钦若迎合宋真宗，导演了天降“天书”的事件，并积极推动后续的封禅大典。
description.en: Wang Qinruo catered to Emperor Zhenzong by orchestrating the event of the 'Heavenly Book' descending from the sky and actively promoted the subsequent Feng and Shan grand ceremonies.

description.zh-cn: 丁谓与王钦若一同支持并参与了“天书封祀”活动，以此巩固自己的政治地位。
description.en: Ding Wei, along with Wang Qinruo, supported and participated in the 'Heavenly Book and Feng Shan Sacrifices' to consolidate his political position.

description.zh-cn: 宋真宗统治后期信奉道教，亲自导演并推动了“天书”降临和封禅泰山等一系列政治活动。
description.en: In his later reign, Emperor Zhenzong became a devout follower of Daoism, personally directing and promoting a series of political activities including the descent of the 'Heavenly Book' and the Feng and Shan sacrifices at Mount Tai.

description.zh-cn: 宋仁宗即位后，将宋真宗遗留的“天书”随之殉葬，表明了对这一系列事件的否定态度。
description.en: After ascending the throne, Emperor Renzong had the 'Heavenly Book' left by Emperor Zhenzong buried with him, indicating his disapproval of the affair.

description.zh-cn: 章献明肃皇后刘氏是宋真宗的第三位皇后。
description.en: Empress Zhangxian Mingsu (née Liu) was the third empress of Emperor Zhenzong.

description.zh-cn: 章穆皇后郭氏是宋真宗的第二位皇后。
description.en: Empress Zhangmu (née Guo) was the second empress of Emperor Zhenzong.

description.zh-cn: 章懿李皇后是宋真宗的妃嫔，宋仁宗的生母。
description.en: Empress Zhangyi (née Li) was a consort of Emperor Zhenzong and the biological mother of Emperor Renzong.

description.zh-cn: 章献明肃皇后没有生育，抚养了宋仁宗赵祯。
description.en: Empress Zhangxian Mingsu was childless and raised Emperor Renzong, Zhao Zhen.

description.zh-cn: 赵玄祐是宋真宗的第二子。
description.en: Zhao You was the second son of Emperor Zhenzong.

description.zh-cn: 赵玄祐的生母是章穆皇后郭氏。
description.en: Zhao You's biological mother was Empress Zhangmu (née Guo).

description.zh-cn: 曹利用是宋真宗派遣的谈判使臣。
description.en: Cao Liyong was the negotiating envoy sent by Emperor Zhenzong.

description.zh-cn: 宋希濂与储安平当时的妻子易吟先有染，后易吟先与储安平离婚并与宋希濂结婚。
description.en: Song Xilian had an affair with Chu Anping's then-wife Yi Yinxian, who later divorced Chu and married Song.

description.zh-cn: 考入黄埔军校第一期，成为最年轻的毕业生之一。
description.en: Enrolled in the first class of the Whampoa Military Academy, becoming one of its youngest graduates.

description.zh-cn: 被保送至日本千叶陆军步兵学校中国学生队就读。
description.en: Was sent to study in the Chinese student corps at the Army Infantry School in Chiba, Japan.

description.zh-cn: 入读陆军大学将官班甲级第一期。
description.en: Enrolled in the first Class-A general officers course at the Army University.

description.zh-cn: 经陈赓介绍，宋希濂加入中国共产党。
description.en: Through Chen Geng's introduction, Song Xilian joined the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 宋希濂是蒋介石的嫡系重要将领，长期在其麾下任职。
description.en: Song Xilian was a key general loyal to Chiang Kai-shek and served under his command for a long time.

description.zh-cn: 下达“着将瞿秋白就地处决具报”的命令给宋希濂。
description.en: Issued an order to Song Xilian to 'execute Qu Qiubai on the spot and report back'.

description.zh-cn: 奉蒋介石之命，将瞿秋白枪决。
description.en: Under Chiang Kai-shek's orders, he executed Qu Qiubai by firing squad.

description.zh-cn: 率领第36师参与镇压由十九路军成立的福建人民政府。
description.en: Led the 36th Division to participate in the suppression of the Fujian People's Government established by the 19th Route Army.

description.zh-cn: 宋希濂在西南战役中兵败，于四川峨边县被中国人民解放军俘虏。
description.en: Song Xilian was defeated in the Southwest Campaign and captured by the People's Liberation Army in Ebian County, Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 作为中国人民解放军第五兵团司令员，其部队俘虏了宋希濂。
description.en: As the commander of the PLA's 5th Army Group, his troops captured Song Xilian.

position.en: Commissioner for Historical and Cultural Materials, Standing Committee Member

description.zh-cn: 1959年获特赦后，先后担任全国政协文史专员和常务委员。
description.en: After being granted amnesty in 1959, he served as a Commissioner for Historical and Cultural Materials and a Standing Committee Member of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期，秦承志曾担任宋希濂的机要处长。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, Qin Chengzhi served as Song Xilian's confidential section chief.

description.zh-cn: 陈明仁在长沙起义后，致电宋希濂，邀请其共同起义。
description.en: After the Changsha Uprising, Chen Mingren telegraphed Song Xilian, inviting him to join the uprising.

description.zh-cn: 宋希濂以“事关甚大，正在慎重研究中”为由，拒绝了陈明仁的起义邀请。
description.en: Song Xilian rejected Chen Mingren's invitation to defect, stating that 'the matter is of great importance and is under careful consideration'.

description.zh-cn: 邱清泉于1943年1月至1947年9月担任第五军军长。
description.en: Qiu Qingquan served as the commander of the 5th Corps from January 1943 to September 1947.

description.zh-cn: 1922年半工半读于上海大学社会学系。
description.en: Studied at the Department of Sociology at Shanghai University on a work-study basis in 1922.

description.zh-cn: 1924年7月录入黄埔军官学校工兵科第二期。
description.en: Enrolled in the second class of the Engineering Branch at the Whampoa Military Academy in July 1924.

description.zh-cn: 在徐蚌会战末期的陈官庄被解放军包围，兵败阵亡。
description.en: He was surrounded by the People's Liberation Army at Chenguanzhuang in the final stage of the Huaihai Campaign, where he was defeated and killed in action.

description.zh-cn: 日军第5师团第21旅团旅团长中村正雄少将在昆仑关战役中阵亡。
description.en: Major General Nakamura Masao, commander of the 21st Brigade of the Japanese 5th Division, was killed in action during the Battle of Kunlun Pass.

description.zh-cn: 在徐蚌会战陈官庄被围期间，邱清泉所在的第二兵团归属杜聿明所主持的徐州剿匪总司令部前进指挥部指挥。
description.en: During the siege of Chenguanzhuang in the Huaihai Campaign, the 2nd Army Group commanded by Qiu Qingquan was under the command of the Xuzhou Bandit Suppression General Headquarters' forward command post, which was headed by Du Yuming.

description.zh-cn: 在豫东战役中，邱清泉因怀疑国防部情报有误，放缓了对被围的区寿年兵团的援助，间接导致其覆灭。
description.en: During the Eastern Henan Campaign, Qiu Qingquan, suspecting faulty intelligence from the Ministry of National Defense, slowed his relief efforts for the besieged army group of Qu Shounian, indirectly contributing to its annihilation.

description.zh-cn: 在徐蚌会战初期，奉命增援被解放军围困于碾庄地区的黄伯韬第七兵团，但未能成功。
description.en: In the early stages of the Huaihai Campaign, he was ordered to reinforce Huang Botao's 7th Army Group, which was besieged by the PLA in the Nianzhuang area, but the attempt was unsuccessful.

description.zh-cn: 豫东战役后，蒋介石在战后检讨中认为邱清泉所部“行动迟缓，应另行议处”，对其进行批评。
description.en: After the Eastern Henan Campaign, Chiang Kai-shek criticized Qiu Qingquan in a post-battle review, stating that his unit's 'actions were slow and should be dealt with separately'.

description.zh-cn: 1945年10月3日，邱清泉率第五军奉命解除了龙云的云南省政府主席职务及其部队武装。
description.en: On October 3, 1945, Qiu Qingquan led the 5th Corps to carry out orders to remove Long Yun from his post as Chairman of the Yunnan Provincial Government and to disarm his troops.

description.zh-cn: 台中公馆机场于1966年3月20日改名为清泉岗机场，以纪念邱清泉。
description.en: Taichung's Kung Kuan Airport was renamed Ching Chuan Kang Airport on March 20, 1966, to commemorate Qiu Qingquan.

description.zh-cn: 台7甲线上的清泉桥于1954年4月3日完工，其命名为纪念邱清泉。
description.en: The Ching Chuan Bridge on Taiwan's Provincial Highway 7A, completed on April 3, 1954, was named in memory of Qiu Qingquan.

description.zh-cn: 李书磊接替黄坤明担任中共中央宣传部部长。
description.en: Li Shulei succeeded Huang Kunming as the Head of the Propaganda Department of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 李书磊先后在北京大学获得图书馆学学士、中国现代文学硕士和博士学位。
description.en: Li Shulei obtained his bachelor's degree in library science, and master's and doctoral degrees in modern Chinese literature from Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 李书磊在北京大学攻读博士学位期间的导师是严家炎。
description.en: Yan Jiayan was Li Shulei's doctoral advisor at Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 参加了“高级行政人员班”培训项目。
description.en: Participated in the 'Senior Executive Fellows program'.

description.zh-cn: 赴地方挂职锻炼。
description.en: Temporarily assigned to a local post for practical experience.

description.zh-cn: 在中央党校共事期间，李书磊受到时任校长习近平的赏识，为其后续的政治晋升奠定了基础。
description.en: During their time working together at the Central Party School, Li Shulei was appreciated by then-President Xi Jinping, which laid the foundation for his subsequent political advancement.

description.zh-cn: 担任福建省委宣传部长期间，亲自倡议、策划并修改了《福建日报》上关于习近平福建工作往事的三万余字系列报道，旨在宣传习近平的执政理念和经历。
description.en: While serving as the Head of the Propaganda Department of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee, he personally initiated, planned, and edited a series of reports in the Fujian Daily totaling over 30,000 words about Xi Jinping's past work in Fujian, aiming to promote Xi's governing philosophy and experience.

description.zh-cn: 李书磊接替叶青纯担任中共北京市委常委、市纪委书记。
description.en: Li Shulei succeeded Ye Qingchun as a member of the Standing Committee of the CCP Beijing Municipal Committee and Secretary of the Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 张硕辅接替李书磊担任中共北京市委常委、市纪委书记。
description.en: Zhang Shuofu succeeded Li Shulei as a member of the Standing Committee of the CCP Beijing Municipal Committee and Secretary of the Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection.

position.en: Deputy Director, Secretary of the Organ Party Committee

description.zh-cn: 李书磊于2020年7月当选机关党委书记，并于2020年12月26日卸任国家监委副主任职务。
description.en: Li Shulei was elected Secretary of the Organ Party Committee in July 2020 and resigned from his position as Deputy Director of the National Supervisory Commission on December 26, 2020.

description.zh-cn: 在中共二十届一中全会上，李书磊当选为中共中央政治局委员、中央书记处书记，晋升副国级。
description.en: At the First Plenary Session of the 20th CCP Central Committee, Li Shulei was elected a member of the Politburo and a secretary of the Central Secretariat, being promoted to the deputy national level.

description.zh-cn: 李书磊接替王晓晖担任中共中央宣传部常务副部长。
description.en: Li Shulei succeeded Wang Xiaohui as the Executive Deputy Head of the Propaganda Department of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 李书磊接替何毅亭担任中共中央党校（国家行政学院）常务副校（院）长。
description.en: Li Shulei succeeded He Yiting as the Executive Vice President of the Central Party School (Chinese Academy of Governance).

description.zh-cn: 谢春涛接替李书磊担任中共中央党校（国家行政学院）常务副校（院）长。
description.en: Xie Chuntao succeeded Li Shulei as the Executive Vice President of the Central Party School (Chinese Academy of Governance).

description.zh-cn: 李书磊接替袁荣祥担任中共福建省委宣传部部长。
description.en: Li Shulei succeeded Yuan Rongxiang as the Head of the Propaganda Department of the CCP Fujian Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 三家分晋事件后，周天子正式承认韩、赵、魏为诸侯国，韩国由此建立。
description.en: After the Partition of Jin, the King of Zhou formally recognized Han, Zhao, and Wei as vassal states, leading to the establishment of the State of Han.

description.zh-cn: 周威烈王册封晋国大夫韩虔为诸侯，使韩国正式成为诸侯国。
description.en: King Weilie of Zhou enfeoffed Han Qian, a grand master of Jin, as a feudal lord, officially making Han a vassal state.

description.zh-cn: 韩景侯韩虔是韩国的始封之君，被周威烈王册封为诸侯。
description.en: Marquis Jing of Han, Han Qian, was the founding monarch of the State of Han, enfeoffed by King Weilie of Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 秦国发动灭韩之战，俘虏韩王安，韩国灭亡，成为六国中第一个被秦所灭的诸侯国。
description.en: The State of Qin launched the war to conquer Han, captured King An, and the State of Han was destroyed, becoming the first of the six states to be eliminated by Qin.

description.zh-cn: 秦国在灭韩之战中俘虏了韩王安。
description.en: The State of Qin captured King An of Han during its conquest of Han.

description.zh-cn: 韩国灭亡郑国，并迁都至其故都新郑。
description.en: The State of Han conquered the State of Zheng and moved its capital to Zheng's former capital, Xinzheng.

description.zh-cn: 韩昭侯任用申不害为相，推行法家“术”治，使韩国国力达到鼎盛。
description.en: Marquis Zhao of Han appointed Shen Buhai as Chancellor, who implemented the Legalist concept of 'shu' (administrative methods), bringing the State of Han to the peak of its power.

description.zh-cn: 担任宰相期间，内修政教，外应诸侯，使韩国国治兵强，十五年间无他国侵犯。
description.en: During his tenure as Chancellor, he reformed the administration and managed foreign relations, making the state well-governed and its military strong, preventing invasions for fifteen years.

description.zh-cn: 秦国攻取韩国野王城，切断了上党郡与韩国本土的联系。上党郡守不愿降秦，转而将该郡献给赵国，从而引发了秦赵之间的长平之战。
description.en: The State of Qin captured Han's Yewang city, cutting off the Shangdang Commandery from the Han mainland. The commandery governor, unwilling to surrender to Qin, offered the territory to the State of Zhao, which triggered the Battle of Changping between Qin and Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 奉韩王之命入秦实施疲秦之计，但他修建的郑国渠极大地促进了秦国的农业发展，增加了其国力，加速了秦统一的进程。
description.en: Sent by the King of Han to Qin to implement a 'fatigue Qin' strategy, but the Zheng Guo Canal he built greatly boosted Qin's agricultural development, strengthened its national power, and accelerated its unification process.

description.zh-cn: 韩非出使秦国，后被迫侍奉秦始皇。
description.en: Han Fei went to the State of Qin as an envoy and was later forced to serve Qin Shi Huang.

description.zh-cn: 侠累在韩烈侯在位初期担任韩国的相国。
description.en: Xia Lei served as the Chancellor of the State of Han during the early reign of Marquis Lie of Han.

description.zh-cn: 受严遂雇佣，刺杀了韩相侠累。
description.en: Hired by Yan Sui, Nie Zheng assassinated the Han Chancellor Xia Lei.

description.zh-cn: 严遂与韩相侠累争夺权力，失败后出走。
description.en: Yan Sui vied for power with Chancellor Xia Lei, and fled after his failure.

description.zh-cn: 魏国在马陵之战前曾发兵攻打韩国。
description.en: The State of Wei had dispatched troops to attack the State of Han before the Battle of Maling.

description.zh-cn: 在担任山东巡抚期间，袁世凯采取强硬措施镇压义和团运动，维持了山东省的稳定。
description.en: As governor of Shandong, Yuan Shikai took strong measures to suppress the Boxer Rebellion, maintaining stability in the province.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯通过其手下段祺瑞等北洋将领通电威胁，迫使隆裕太后代表宣统皇帝颁布退位诏书，结束了清朝的统治。
description.en: Through his subordinate Duan Qirui and other Beiyang generals, Yuan Shikai threatened the court, forcing Empress Dowager Longyu to issue the abdication edict on behalf of the Xuantong Emperor, ending the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 孙文辞去临时大总统一职，让位于袁世凯，以换取清帝退位和国家统一。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen resigned as provisional president in favor of Yuan Shikai in exchange for the Qing emperor's abdication and national unification.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯在北京就任中华民国临时大总统，建立了北洋政府，开启了北洋军阀统治时期。
description.en: Yuan Shikai took office as the Provisional President of the Republic of China in Beijing, establishing the Beiyang government and initiating the Beiyang warlord era.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯动用北洋军武力迅速镇压了由国民党发动的“二次革命”，最终导致其失败。
description.en: Yuan Shikai's Beiyang Army militarily and quickly suppressed the 'Second Revolution' launched by the Kuomintang, ultimately leading to its failure.

description.zh-cn: 日本帝国向袁世凯政府秘密提出旨在将中国纳入其保护国的“二十一条”要求。
description.en: The Empire of Japan secretly presented the 'Twenty-One Demands' to Yuan Shikai's government, aiming to turn China into a Japanese protectorate.

description.zh-cn: 在与日本进行了105天的谈判并收到最后通牒后，袁世凯政府被迫接受了“二十一条”的部分条款，签署了《中日民四条约》。
description.en: After 105 days of negotiations with Japan and receiving an ultimatum, Yuan Shikai's government was forced to accept parts of the 'Twenty-One Demands' and signed the 'Sino-Japanese Treaties of 1915'.

description.zh-cn: 杨度等人成立筹安会，为袁世凯称帝制造理论和舆论支持。
description.en: Yang Du and others established the Chou'anhui to create theoretical and public support for Yuan Shikai's accession to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 蔡锷与唐继尧等人在云南宣布独立，发动护国运动，武力讨伐袁世凯。
description.en: Cai E, Tang Jiyao, and others declared independence in Yunnan, launching the National Protection War to militarily oppose Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 在护国运动的军事和政治压力下，袁世凯被迫于1916年3月22日宣布取消帝制。
description.en: Under military and political pressure from the National Protection War, Yuan Shikai was forced to announce the cancellation of the monarchy on March 22, 1916.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯指挥清军击退日军，平定了朝鲜开化党人发动的甲申政变。
description.en: Yuan Shikai commanded Qing troops to repel Japanese forces, suppressing the Gapsin Coup launched by Korean reformists.

description.zh-cn: 袁克定是袁世凯与原配于氏所生的嫡长子。
description.en: Yuan Keding was the eldest legitimate son of Yuan Shikai and his primary wife, Lady Yu.

description.zh-cn: 1881年，袁世凯弃文就武，投靠淮军将领吴长庆，任“庆军”营务处会办。
description.en: In 1881, Yuan Shikai abandoned his civil pursuits for a military career, joining the command of Huai Army general Wu Changqing and serving as a staff officer.

description.zh-cn: 在戊戌变法期间，康有为派谭嗣同秘密游说手握重兵的袁世凯，希望他发动兵变支持光绪帝。
description.en: During the Hundred Days' Reform, Kang Youwei sent Tan Sitong to secretly lobby Yuan Shikai, who controlled a powerful army, hoping he would launch a coup to support the Guangxu Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 在陈炯明部队炮轰总统府时，叶挺奉命守卫并掩护宋庆龄安全脱险。
陈炯明的部队炮轰总统府，叶挺率部抵抗。
经王若飞介绍，中共旅莫支部决定接受叶挺为候补党员。
在国民革命军第四军中，张发奎是叶挺的上级。
在北伐战争中，叶挺率部讨伐吴佩孚势力。
夏斗寅发表讨共通电，趁机攻打武汉，叶挺率部迎击并迅速将其击溃。
叶挺领导了广州起义。
在广州起义期间，叶挺主张撤出部队，但遭到共产国际代表海因茨·纽曼的斥责。
广州起义失败后，叶挺在苏联受到李立三的无端指责，是其决定退出共产党的原因之一。
广州起义失败后，叶挺在苏联受到王明的无端指责，是其决定退出共产党的原因之一。
认为叶挺动摇，不允许其作报告，导致叶挺决定退出共产党。
周恩来多次与叶挺沟通，鼓励并说服其重返革命队伍，最终促成叶挺出任新四军军长并重返部队。
邀请叶挺访问延安，打消了中共方面对其脱党的疑虑，促使其顺利就任新四军军长。
两人在新四军的一系列战略问题上产生分歧，关系不睦，导致叶挺多次离军出走。
叶挺收到蒋介石的命令后，执行了对新四军第四支队司令员高敬亭的处决。
在皖南事变中，叶挺率领的新四军军部及皖南部队被国民党军队包围攻击，叶挺最终被俘，并被长期囚禁。
时任第三战区司令长官的顾祝同指挥部队向新四军发起总攻，导致叶挺被俘。
叶挺下山与上官云相的部队谈判时被扣押。
在皖南事变后，蒋介石下令取消新四军番号，并将叶挺交军事法庭审判，导致叶挺被长期囚禁。
在邯郸战役中被俘的国民党将领马法五成为交换条件，促成了叶挺的获释。
叶挺乘坐的飞机在山西兴县黑茶山失事，导致其遇难身亡。
叶挺夫人李秀文在黑茶山空难中一同遇难。
中共领导人王若飞在黑茶山空难中一同遇难。
中共领导人博古在黑茶山空难中一同遇难。
1948年，田中角荣发表演讲支持吉田茂连任总裁，随后被吉田茂任命为法务省政务次官。
description.en: In 1948, Kakuei Tanaka gave a speech supporting Shigeru Yoshida's re-election as party president and was subsequently appointed by Yoshida as Parliamentary Vice-Minister of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 在岸信介内阁中担任邮政大臣。
description.en: Served as Minister of Posts in the cabinet of Nobusuke Kishi.

description.zh-cn: 在池田勇人内阁中担任大藏大臣。
description.en: Served as Minister of Finance in the cabinet of Hayato Ikeda.

position.zh-cn: 大藏大臣、通商产业大臣
position.en: Minister of Finance, Minister of International Trade and Industry

description.zh-cn: 在佐藤荣作内阁中先后担任大藏大臣和通商产业大臣。
description.en: Served successively as Minister of Finance and Minister of International Trade and Industry in the cabinet of Eisaku Satō.

position.zh-cn: 总裁、干事长、政务调查会长
position.en: President, Secretary-General, Chairman of the Policy Research Council

description.zh-cn: 田中角荣长期是自由民主党的核心成员，并曾担任党总裁等最高职务，后因洛克希德事件退党。
description.en: Kakuei Tanaka was a core member of the LDP for many years, holding top positions including Party President, but left the party due to the Lockheed scandal.

description.zh-cn: 田中角荣在1972年的自民党总裁选举（角福战争）中，通过拉拢中曾根康弘等小派系，成功击败福田赳夫，当选总裁并成为首相。
description.en: In the 1972 LDP presidential election (Kaku-Fuku War), Kakuei Tanaka defeated Takeo Fukuda by aligning with smaller factions like Yasuhiro Nakasone's, securing the presidency and thus the premiership.

description.zh-cn: 福田赳夫在1972年的自民党总裁选举（角福战争）中败于田中角荣。
description.en: Takeo Fukuda was defeated by Kakuei Tanaka in the 1972 LDP presidential election (Kaku-Fuku War).

description.zh-cn: 田中角荣就任首相仅两个月后便访问中华人民共和国，签署了《中日联合声明》，实现了两国邦交正常化。
description.en: Just two months after taking office as Prime Minister, Kakuei Tanaka visited the People's Republic of China and signed the Joint Communiqué, normalizing diplomatic relations between the two countries.

description.zh-cn: 随着与中华人民共和国建交，田中角荣政府宣布与中华民国断绝外交关系。
description.en: Upon establishing diplomatic relations with the People's Republic of China, the Kakuei Tanaka government announced the severance of diplomatic relations with the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1973年，田中角荣在美国白宫与时任美国总统理查·尼克森会面。
description.en: In 1973, Kakuei Tanaka met with then-US President Richard Nixon at the White House.

description.zh-cn: 1974年，《文艺春秋》杂志刊文揭露田中角荣的金权问题，直接引发了“田中金脉问题”丑闻，并导致其辞去首相职务。
description.en: In 1974, the magazine Bungeishunjū published an article exposing Kakuei Tanaka's financial dealings, directly triggering the 'Tanaka Kinmyaku Mondai' scandal and leading to his resignation as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 因被揭发在洛克希德事件中收受贿赂，田中角荣于1976年被捕，其政治生涯和声誉遭受重创。
description.en: After being exposed for accepting bribes in the Lockheed scandal, Kakuei Tanaka was arrested in 1976, causing severe damage to his political career and reputation.

description.zh-cn: 1983年，东京地方法院因洛克希德事件一审判处田中角荣4年徒刑。
description.en: In 1983, the Tokyo District Court sentenced Kakuei Tanaka to 4 years in prison in the first trial of the Lockheed scandal.

description.zh-cn: 1985年2月，田中角荣因突发脑梗塞导致身体和语言功能障碍，从此无法参与政治活动，被迫引退。
description.en: In February 1985, Kakuei Tanaka suffered a cerebral infarction that caused physical and speech impairments, preventing him from participating in political activities and forcing his retirement.

description.zh-cn: 田中角荣撰写并出版了《日本列岛改造论》，以此作为其内政的主要方针。
description.en: Kakuei Tanaka authored and published 'Building a New Japan' ('Nihon Rettō Kaizōron') as the main guideline for his domestic policy.

description.zh-cn: 田中真纪子是田中角荣的嫡长女。
description.en: Makiko Tanaka is the eldest daughter of Kakuei Tanaka.

description.zh-cn: 李泰是唐太宗李世民的第四子。
description.en: Li Tai was the fourth son of Emperor Taizong, Li Shimin.

description.zh-cn: 李泰是长孙皇后的次子。
description.en: Li Tai was the second son of Empress Zhangsun.

description.zh-cn: 长子
description.en: Eldest son

description.zh-cn: 李泰与李承干是同父同母的兄弟。
description.en: Li Tai and Li Chengqian were full brothers.

description.zh-cn: 李泰与李治是同父同母的兄弟。
description.en: Li Tai and Li Zhi were full brothers.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗对李泰的宠爱超过了其他皇子，史载“宠冠诸王”，特许其长驻京畿、开文学馆，这种过度的宠爱是引发储位之争的重要原因。
description.en: Emperor Taizong's favor towards Li Tai surpassed that for his other sons. Historical records state he was 'the most favored among all princes,' granted special permissions to reside in the capital and establish a literary salon. This excessive favor was a major cause of the succession struggle.

description.zh-cn: 李泰因父亲的宠爱而图谋太子之位，与时任太子李承干构成了直接的竞争关系，最终导致李承干因谋反被废。
description.en: Favored by his father, Li Tai coveted the position of crown prince, becoming a direct rival to the incumbent Crown Prince Li Chengqian, which ultimately led to Li Chengqian's deposition for treason.

description.zh-cn: 侯君集与太子李承干共谋政变。
description.en: Hou Junji conspired with Crown Prince Li Chengqian to stage a coup.

description.zh-cn: 在李承干谋反事败后，唐太宗将其废为庶人。
description.en: After Li Chengqian's rebellion failed, Emperor Taizong deposed him and reduced him to the status of a commoner.

description.zh-cn: 在太子李承干被废后，褚遂良向唐太宗进谏，指出过分宠爱李泰是导致李承干之祸的根源，反对立李泰为新太子。
description.en: After Crown Prince Li Chengqian was deposed, Chu Suiliang advised Emperor Taizong that excessive favor towards Li Tai was the root cause of Li Chengqian's downfall and argued against appointing Li Tai as the new crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 在储位之争中，长孙无忌支持立晋王李治为太子。
description.en: During the succession struggle, Zhangsun Wuji supported the appointment of Prince Jin, Li Zhi, as the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 在储位之争期间，李泰以汉王李元昌因谋反被杀之事来恫吓与李元昌交好的晋王李治。
description.en: During the succession struggle, Li Tai intimidated Prince Jin, Li Zhi, by referencing the case of Prince of Han, Li Yuanchang, who was executed for treason and had been on good terms with Li Zhi.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗最终决定不立李泰为太子，并将其降封为东莱郡王，迁往均州。
