description.en: Emperor Taizong ultimately decided not to make Li Tai the crown prince, demoting him to Prince of Donglai Commandery and exiling him to Junzhou.

description.zh-cn: 在废黜李承干和排除李泰后，唐太宗最终决定立晋王李治为皇太子。
description.en: After deposing Li Chengqian and excluding Li Tai, Emperor Taizong decided to establish Prince Jin, Li Zhi, as the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 李泰奏请并主编了地理著作《括地志》。
description.en: Li Tai requested permission to and served as the chief editor for the geographical work 'Kuodi Zhi'.

position.zh-cn: 公安部常务副部长、司法部部长
position.en: Executive Vice Minister of Public Security, Minister of Justice

description.zh-cn: 在李克强担任国务院总理期间，傅政华先后担任公安部常务副部长和司法部部长。
description.en: During Li Keqiang's premiership of the State Council, Fu Zhenghua served successively as Executive Vice Minister of Public Security and Minister of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 在郭声琨担任公安部部长期间，傅政华为其下属。
description.en: When Guo Shengkun was the Minister of Public Security, Fu Zhenghua was his subordinate.

position.en: Executive Vice Minister of Public Security

description.zh-cn: 在赵克志担任公安部部长期间，傅政华为其下属。
description.en: When Zhao Kezhi was the Minister of Public Security, Fu Zhenghua was his subordinate.

description.zh-cn: 接替张军出任中华人民共和国司法部部长。
description.en: Succeeded Zhang Jun as the Minister of Justice of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 司法部部长一职由唐一军接任。
description.en: His position as Minister of Justice was succeeded by Tang Yijun.

description.zh-cn: 2008年结识孙力军，后成为孙力军政治团伙的重要成员，并承认对其唯命是从。
description.en: Met Sun Lijun in 2008, later became an important member of Sun Lijun's political clique, and admitted to being completely subservient to him.

description.zh-cn: 官方通报指其参加孙力军政治团伙，拉帮结派，结党营私。
description.en: Official reports stated that he participated in Sun Lijun's political clique, forming factions and engaging in cronyism.

description.zh-cn: 在担任公安部副部长期间，曾负责调查周永康案。
description.en: While serving as Vice Minister of Public Security, he was responsible for investigating the Zhou Yongkang case.

description.zh-cn: 媒体认为，该专项行动的猛烈开展与傅政华新进兼任公安部副部长有关。
description.en: Media believed that the vigorous implementation of this special campaign was related to Fu Zhenghua's new concurrent appointment as Vice Minister of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 升任北京市公安局局长后不久，查封了包括“天上人间”在内的四家顶级夜总会。
description.en: Shortly after becoming the Director of the Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau, he shut down four top nightclubs, including 'Tian Shang Ren Jian'.

description.zh-cn: 有媒体指傅政华策划了709维权律师大抓捕事件。
description.en: Some media outlets pointed to Fu Zhenghua as the planner of the 709 crackdown on human rights lawyers.

description.zh-cn: 法轮功团体指控傅政华多次参与取缔法轮功的行动。
description.en: Falun Gong groups accused Fu Zhenghua of participating multiple times in actions to suppress Falun Gong.

description.zh-cn: 曾负责查办黄光裕案。
description.en: Was responsible for investigating the case of Huang Guangyu.

description.zh-cn: 曾负责查办马加爵案。
description.en: Was responsible for investigating the Ma Jiajue case.

description.zh-cn: 张纯如出生于新泽西州普林斯顿。
description.en: Iris Chang was born in Princeton, New Jersey.

description.zh-cn: 张纯如毕业于伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校新闻系。
description.en: Iris Chang graduated from the Department of Journalism at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

description.zh-cn: 张纯如在约翰·霍普金斯大学获得写作研讨班的文学硕士学位。
description.en: Iris Chang received her Master of Arts degree from the Writing Seminars at Johns Hopkins University.

description.zh-cn: 张纯如曾在美联社工作。
description.en: Iris Chang worked at the Associated Press.

description.zh-cn: 张纯如曾在《芝加哥论坛报》工作。
description.en: Iris Chang worked at the Chicago Tribune.

description.zh-cn: 张纯如生前是美国华人组织百人会的成员。
description.en: During her lifetime, Iris Chang was a member of the Committee of 100, a Chinese American organization.

description.zh-cn: 张纯如撰写并出版了《南京暴行：被遗忘的大屠杀》。
description.en: Iris Chang wrote and published 'The Rape of Nanking: The Forgotten Holocaust of World War II'.

description.zh-cn: 张纯如撰写并出版了她的第一本著作《中国导弹之父——钱学森之谜》。
description.en: Iris Chang wrote and published her first book, 'Thread of the Silkworm'.

description.zh-cn: 该书详细叙述了南京大屠杀的历史，首次让西方国家全面了解了日本犯下的罪行，打破了长期的沉默。
description.en: The book details the history of the Nanjing Massacre, providing the Western world with a comprehensive understanding of the crimes committed by Japan for the first time, breaking a long silence.

description.zh-cn: 该书是关于钱学森返回中国的史实和时代背景的传记。
description.en: The book is a biography about the historical facts and context of Qian Xuesen's return to China.

description.zh-cn: 张纯如因患上严重的忧郁症，于2004年11月9日自杀身亡。
description.en: Due to severe depression, Iris Chang committed suicide on November 9, 2004.

description.zh-cn: 张纯如在遗书中声称自己被中央情报局等组织盯上，这加剧了她的精神压力。
description.en: In her suicide note, Iris Chang claimed she was being targeted by organizations like the CIA, which exacerbated her mental distress.

description.zh-cn: 在李文和被控间谍案时，张纯如公开谴责对他的不公平做法。
description.en: During the Wen Ho Lee espionage case, Iris Chang publicly condemned the unfair practices against him.

description.zh-cn: 张纯如曾公开反驳《考克斯报告》中的错误。
description.en: Iris Chang publicly rebutted errors in the Cox Report.

description.zh-cn: 《拉贝日记》是张纯如撰写《南京暴行：被遗忘的大屠杀》时引用的重要资料之一。
description.en: The Diaries of John Rabe was one of the key sources used by Iris Chang when writing 'The Rape of Nanking'.

description.zh-cn: 历史学家斯蒂芬·E·安布罗斯形容张纯如为“可能是美国最优秀的年轻历史学家”。
description.en: Historian Stephen E. Ambrose described Iris Chang as 'possibly the best young historian in the U.S.'

description.zh-cn: 麦克阿瑟基金会授予张纯如“和平及国际合作奖”。
description.en: The MacArthur Foundation awarded Iris Chang the 'Peace and International Cooperation Award'.

description.zh-cn: 加州州立大学东湾分校授予张纯如荣誉博士学位。
description.en: California State University, East Bay awarded an honorary doctorate to Iris Chang.

description.zh-cn: 时任中华民国总统马英九亲自颁发褒扬令以表彰已故的张纯如。
description.en: Then-President of the Republic of China, Ma Ying-jeou, personally issued a presidential citation to honor the late Iris Chang.

description.zh-cn: 胡佛研究所内存放有张纯如的纪念雕塑。
description.en: The Hoover Institution houses a memorial sculpture of Iris Chang.

description.zh-cn: 位于张纯如祖籍地淮安的张纯如纪念馆于2017年开馆，以纪念她的生平和贡献。
description.en: Located in her ancestral hometown of Huai'an, the Iris Chang Memorial Hall opened in 2017 to commemorate her life and contributions.

description.zh-cn: 在Alphabet成立后，桑德尔·皮蔡接任成为Google的首席执行官。
description.en: After the formation of Alphabet, Sundar Pichai took over as the CEO of Google.

description.zh-cn: 埃里克·施密特曾担任Google的首席执行官，后由拉里·佩奇接替。
description.en: Eric Schmidt served as the CEO of Google and was succeeded by Larry Page.

description.zh-cn: 2011年4月，拉里·佩奇接替埃里克·施密特担任Google首席执行官。
description.en: In April 2011, Larry Page succeeded Eric Schmidt as the CEO of Google.

description.zh-cn: 2011年8月15日，Google宣布以约125亿美元收购摩托罗拉移动。
description.en: On August 15, 2011, Google announced its acquisition of Motorola Mobility for approximately $12.5 billion.

description.zh-cn: 由于内容审查和黑客攻击，Google将其在中国大陆的搜索服务从谷歌中国重定向至Google香港， фактически прекратив поисковую деятельность на материке。
description.en: Due to censorship and hacking attacks, Google redirected its search services in mainland China from Google China to Google Hong Kong, effectively ceasing search operations on the mainland.

description.zh-cn: 谷歌退出中国大陆事件导致Google香港开始为中国大陆用户提供未经审查的搜索服务。
description.en: The withdrawal of Google from mainland China led Google Hong Kong to begin providing uncensored search services to users from mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 由于中华人民共和国政府的网络审查政策，Google将其搜索服务移出中国大陆，此后Google的服务在中国大陆持续受到防火长城的干扰和屏蔽。
description.en: Due to the Chinese government's internet censorship policies, Google moved its search services out of mainland China. Since then, Google's services have been continuously interfered with and blocked by the Great Firewall in mainland China.

description.zh-cn: Google被指控参与美国国家安全局的“棱镜计划”，向政府提供用户数据，引发了全球范围内的隐私担忧。
description.en: Google was accused of participating in the U.S. National Security Agency's PRISM program by providing user data to the government, sparking global privacy concerns.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯培植了北洋新军（北洋军）。
description.en: Yuan Shikai cultivated the Beiyang New Army (Beiyang Army).

description.zh-cn: 北洋军阀由北洋新军（北洋军）的主要将领组成。
description.en: The Beiyang Warlords were composed of the main generals of the Beiyang New Army (Beiyang Army).

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯担任新建陆军（新军）的督办。
description.en: Yuan Shikai served as the supervisor of the Newly Created Army (New Army).

description.zh-cn: 北洋武备学堂的毕业生是新建陆军（新军）的主要军官来源之一。
description.en: Graduates from the Beiyang Military Academy were one of the main sources of officers for the Newly Created Army (New Army).

description.zh-cn: 淮军的旧部是新建陆军（新军）的主要军官来源之一。
description.en: Former members of the Huai Army were one of the main sources of officers for the Newly Created Army (New Army).

description.zh-cn: 北洋军阀在名义上接受北京政府的支配。
description.en: The Beiyang Warlords nominally accepted the authority of the Beijing Government.

description.zh-cn: 北京政权实际上由北洋军阀中的不同派系所控制。
description.en: The Beijing government was actually controlled by various factions within the Beiyang Warlords.

description.zh-cn: 皖系是北洋军阀的主要派系之一。
description.en: The Anhui clique was one of the main factions of the Beiyang Warlords.

description.zh-cn: 奉系是北洋军阀的主要派系之一。
description.en: The Fengtian clique was one of the main factions of the Beiyang Warlords.

description.zh-cn: 美国扶植直系军阀。
description.en: The United States supported the Zhili clique.

description.zh-cn: 英国扶植直系军阀。
description.en: The United Kingdom supported the Zhili clique.

description.zh-cn: 日本扶植皖系军阀。
description.en: Japan supported the Anhui clique.

description.zh-cn: 日本扶植奉系军阀。
description.en: Japan supported the Fengtian clique.

description.zh-cn: 日本扶植晋系军阀。
description.en: Japan supported the Jin clique.

description.zh-cn: 苏联自1923年起扶植西北军。
description.en: The Soviet Union supported the Northwest Army starting from 1923.

description.zh-cn: 苏联自1923年起扶植粤系军阀。
description.en: The Soviet Union supported the Yue clique starting from 1923.

description.zh-cn: 直系与皖系军阀之间曾爆发直皖战争。
description.en: The Zhili-Anhui War broke out between the Zhili and Anhui cliques.

description.zh-cn: 直系与奉系军阀之间曾爆发直奉战争。
description.en: The Zhili-Fengtian War broke out between the Zhili and Fengtian cliques.

description.zh-cn: 冯玉祥使用暗杀的手段除去了皖系重要人物徐树铮。
description.en: Feng Yuxiang eliminated Xu Shuzheng, an important figure of the Anhui clique, by assassination.

description.zh-cn: 第一次直奉战争结束后，杨荫杭发表时评《北洋正统》表达对北洋的唾弃。
description.en: After the end of the First Zhili-Fengtian War, Yang Yinhang published a commentary 'Beiyang Orthodoxy' to express his disdain for the Beiyang establishment.

description.zh-cn: 杨荫杭发表时评《北洋正统》，表达了时人对于北洋军阀的普遍唾弃，主张绝口不谈北洋二字。
description.en: Yang Yinhang published the commentary 'Beiyang Orthodoxy', expressing the general contemporary disdain for the Beiyang Warlords and advocating for abandoning the 'Beiyang' name.

description.zh-cn: 墨索里尼早年是意大利社会党成员，后因支持意大利参加一战而被开除。
description.en: Mussolini was an early member of the Italian Socialist Party but was expelled in 1914 for his support of Italy's intervention in WWI.

description.zh-cn: 1921年，墨索里尼建立了国家法西斯党。
description.en: In 1921, Mussolini founded the National Fascist Party.

description.zh-cn: 向罗马进军事件迫使意大利国王任命墨索里尼为首相，使其成功夺取政权。
description.en: The March on Rome compelled the King of Italy to appoint Mussolini as Prime Minister, allowing him to seize power.

description.zh-cn: 在向罗马进军后，国王维托里奥·埃马努埃莱三世任命墨索里尼为首相。
description.en: After the March on Rome, King Victor Emmanuel III appointed Mussolini as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 作为意大利王国首相，墨索里尼在名义上对国王维托里奥·埃马努埃莱三世负责。
description.en: As Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Italy, Mussolini was nominally subordinate to King Victor Emmanuel III.

description.zh-cn: 墨索里尼接替路易吉·法克塔成为意大利首相。
description.en: Mussolini succeeded Luigi Facta as Prime Minister of Italy.

description.zh-cn: 墨索里尼发动了第二次意阿战争，旨在将埃塞俄比亚变为意大利的殖民地。
description.en: Mussolini launched the Second Italo-Ethiopian War with the goal of turning Ethiopia into an Italian colony.

description.zh-cn: 意大利军队入侵并占领了埃塞俄比亚帝国。
description.en: Italian forces invaded and occupied the Ethiopian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 墨索里尼与希特勒是政治盟友，共同组建了轴心国联盟。
description.en: Mussolini and Hitler were political allies who formed the Axis powers.

description.zh-cn: 法西斯大委员会通过了对墨索里尼的不信任动议，即格兰迪决议，直接导致其下台。
description.en: The Grand Council of Fascism's passage of the Order of the Day Grandi, a vote of no confidence, directly led to Mussolini's downfall.

description.zh-cn: 1943年7月25日，法西斯大委员会投票通过了格兰迪决议，剥夺了墨索里尼的权力。
description.en: On July 25, 1943, the Grand Council of Fascism voted to pass the Order of the Day Grandi, stripping Mussolini of his power.

description.zh-cn: 在法西斯大委员会投票后，国王维托里奥·埃马努埃莱三世下令逮捕墨索里尼并解除其职务。
description.en: Following the vote by the Grand Council of Fascism, King Victor Emmanuel III ordered Mussolini's arrest and dismissal from office.

description.zh-cn: 德国发动的橡树行动将墨索里尼从囚禁中解救出来。
description.en: Operation Oak, launched by Germany, rescued Mussolini from his imprisonment.

description.zh-cn: 希特勒下令执行橡树行动以营救被软禁的墨索里尼。
description.en: Hitler ordered Operation Oak to rescue the imprisoned Mussolini.

description.zh-cn: 被救出后，墨索里尼在希特勒的协助下于意大利北部建立了意大利社会共和国。
description.en: After his rescue, Mussolini, with Hitler's assistance, established the Italian Social Republic in northern Italy.

description.zh-cn: 意大利社会共和国是德国的傀儡政权，完全受纳粹德国控制。
description.en: The Italian Social Republic was a German puppet state, completely controlled by Nazi Germany.

description.zh-cn: 1945年4月27日，墨索里尼在逃亡途中被意大利共产党游击队加里波第旅俘虏。
description.en: On April 27, 1945, Mussolini was captured by the communist partisans of the Garibaldi Brigades while attempting to flee.

description.zh-cn: 俘虏墨索里尼的游击队员在次日执行了对他的处决。
description.en: The partisans who captured Mussolini executed him the following day.

description.zh-cn: 1945年4月28日，墨索里尼被枪决。
description.en: On April 28, 1945, Mussolini was executed by firing squad.

description.zh-cn: 墨索里尼的情人克拉拉·贝塔西与他一同被处决。
description.en: Mussolini's mistress, Clara Petacci, was executed alongside him.

description.zh-cn: 克拉拉·贝塔西是墨索里尼的情妇，直到两人一同被处决。
description.en: Clara Petacci was Mussolini's mistress until their joint execution.

description.zh-cn: 伊达·达尔塞是墨索里尼的第一任妻子。
description.en: Ida Dalser was Mussolini's first wife.

description.zh-cn: 雷切尔·墨索里尼是墨索里尼的第二任妻子。
description.en: Rachele Mussolini was Mussolini's second wife.

description.zh-cn: 曹昂是曹操的长子。
description.en: Cao Ang was the eldest son of Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 刘夫人是曹昂的生母。
description.en: Lady Liu was the birth mother of Cao Ang.

description.zh-cn: 丁夫人是曹操的原配正室。
description.en: Lady Ding was Cao Cao's first official wife.

description.zh-cn: 刘夫人是曹操的妾室。
description.en: Lady Liu was a concubine of Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 因曹昂在宛城战死，丁夫人将责任归咎于曹操，与他反目并最终决裂。
description.en: Because Cao Ang died in the Battle of Wancheng, Lady Ding blamed Cao Cao, turned against him, and eventually broke off the relationship.

description.zh-cn: 曹铄是曹昂的同母弟。
description.en: Cao Shuo was Cao Ang's full younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 清河公主是曹昂的同母妹。
description.en: Princess Qinghe was Cao Ang's full younger sister.

description.zh-cn: 曹均是曹琬的生父。
description.en: Cao Jun was the biological father of Cao Wan.

description.zh-cn: 曹昂在曹操与张绣的战争中为救其父而战死于宛城。
description.en: Cao Ang was killed in the Battle of Wancheng while saving his father.

description.zh-cn: 典韦在曹操与张绣的战争中为保护曹操撤退而战死。
description.en: Dian Wei was killed in the Battle of Wancheng while covering Cao Cao's retreat.

description.zh-cn: 曹安民在曹操与张绣的战争中与曹昂、典韦一同战死。
description.en: Cao Anmin was killed alongside Cao Ang and Dian Wei in the Battle of Wancheng.

description.zh-cn: 张绣因曹操纳其婶母而感到被羞辱，发动夜间叛变，袭击曹操军营，从而引发了战斗。
description.en: Feeling humiliated by Cao Cao taking his aunt as a concubine, Zhang Xiu launched a surprise night rebellion, attacking Cao Cao's camp and initiating the battle.

description.zh-cn: 张绣在宛城发动叛乱，与曹操军队交战。
description.en: Zhang Xiu rebelled in Wancheng and engaged in battle with Cao Cao's forces.

description.zh-cn: 在宛城之战中，曹昂将自己的坐骑让给被射伤的曹操，并步行保护其突围，使曹操得以幸免于难。
description.en: During the Battle of Wancheng, Cao Ang gave his own horse to the wounded Cao Cao and protected him on foot during the breakout, allowing Cao Cao to escape.

description.zh-cn: 典韦是曹操的近身侍卫。
description.en: Dian Wei was Cao Cao's personal guard.

description.zh-cn: 曹丕称帝后，于黄初二年（221年）追尊曹昂为丰悼公，黄初五年（224年）追封为丰悼王，以示哀悼和尊崇。
description.en: After becoming emperor, Cao Pi posthumously honored Cao Ang as Duke Dao of Feng in 221 AD and later as King Dao of Feng in 224 AD, to show mourning and respect.

description.zh-cn: 魏明帝曹叡继位后，于太和三年（229年）改谥曹昂为丰愍王。
description.en: After ascending the throne, Emperor Ming of Wei, Cao Rui, changed Cao Ang's posthumous title to King Min of Feng in 229 AD.

description.zh-cn: 曹昂在二十岁时被举为孝廉，这是东汉的一种官吏选拔科目。
description.en: At the age of twenty, Cao Ang was nominated as a Xiaolian, which was a category for official selection in the Eastern Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 曹昂出生于沛国谯县。
description.en: Cao Ang was born in Qiao County, Pei Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 与张申府一同在德国柏林介绍朱德加入中国共产党。
description.en: Together with Zhang Shenfu, introduced Zhu De to join the Communist Party of China in Berlin, Germany.

description.zh-cn: 与周恩来一同在德国柏林介绍朱德加入中国共产党。
description.en: Together with Zhou Enlai, introduced Zhu De to join the Communist Party of China in Berlin, Germany.

description.zh-cn: 在上海初次会面时，因认为朱德军阀气息太重而拒绝其入党申请。
description.en: During their first meeting in Shanghai, rejected Zhu De's application to join the party, believing he had too much of a warlord air.

description.zh-cn: 与毛泽东一同将井冈山会师的两支部队合编为工农革命军第四军。
description.en: Together with Mao Zedong, merged the two forces that met at Jinggangshan into the Fourth Army of the Workers' and Peasants' Revolutionary Army.

description.zh-cn: 与朱德一同将井冈山会师的两支部队合编为工农革命军第四军。
description.en: Together with Zhu De, merged the two forces that met at Jinggangshan into the Fourth Army of the Workers' and Peasants' Revolutionary Army.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间，任改编后的八路军（后称第十八集团军）总指挥/总司令。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, he served as the Commander-in-Chief of the reorganized Eighth Route Army (later known as the 18th Group Army).

description.zh-cn: 作为八路军总司令，指挥部队在华北敌后开辟根据地，开展游击战争。
description.en: As the Commander-in-Chief of the Eighth Route Army, he commanded troops to open up base areas and conduct guerrilla warfare behind enemy lines in North China.

description.zh-cn: 朱德是中国人民解放军的主要缔造者之一。
description.en: Zhu De is one of the main founders of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 在庐山会议期间，因朱德在批判彭德怀时肯定其积极一面，而批评朱德“未抓到痒处”。
description.en: During the Lushan Conference, criticized Zhu De for 'not scratching the itch' because Zhu affirmed Peng Dehuai's positive side while criticizing him.

description.zh-cn: 长期作为军事搭档，共同指挥了多次重要战役。在1959年庐山会议上，朱德因发言肯定彭德怀的积极面而受到毛泽东批评。
description.en: Served as long-term military partners, jointly commanding numerous important campaigns. At the 1959 Lushan Conference, Zhu De was criticized by Mao Zedong for affirming Peng Dehuai's positive aspects in his speech.

description.zh-cn: 颜回是孔子最得意的弟子，位居孔门七十二贤之首。
description.en: Yan Hui was Confucius's most favored disciple, ranked first among the Seventy-two Disciples.

description.zh-cn: 颜回是颜无繇的儿子。
description.en: Yan Hui is the son of Yan Wuyou.

description.zh-cn: 颜回是鲁国人。
description.en: Yan Hui was a native of the State of Lu.

description.zh-cn: 颜回出生于鲁国兖州。
description.en: Yan Hui was born in Yanzhou, State of Lu.

description.zh-cn: 颜回位列孔门十哲，属德行科。
description.en: Yan Hui was listed among the Ten Wise Ones of Confucianism, in the category of virtuous conduct.

description.zh-cn: 颜回被列为七十二贤之首。
description.en: Yan Hui was ranked first among the Seventy-two Disciples.

description.zh-cn: 颜回与子路同为孔子弟子，曾一同侍奉孔子。
description.en: Yan Hui and Zilu were fellow disciples of Confucius and once served him together.

description.zh-cn: 孔鲤是孔子的儿子。
description.en: Kong Li was the son of Confucius.

description.zh-cn: 鲁哀公曾向孔子询问其弟子中谁最好学，孔子回答是颜回。
description.en: Duke Ai of Lu once asked Confucius which of his disciples was the most eager to learn, and Confucius replied that it was Yan Hui.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗于贞观二年（628年）下诏尊称颜回为“先师”，提升了其历史地位。
description.en: In 628 (the 2nd year of the Zhenguan era), Emperor Taizong of Tang issued an edict honoring Yan Hui as 'Former Master', elevating his historical status.

description.zh-cn: 唐高宗于总章元年（668年）追封颜回为太子少保。
description.en: In 668 (the 1st year of the Zongzhang era), Emperor Gaozong of Tang posthumously enfeoffed Yan Hui as 'Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent'.

description.zh-cn: 唐玄宗于开元二十七年（739年）封颜回为“兖公”。
description.en: In 739 (the 27th year of the Kaiyuan era), Emperor Xuanzong of Tang enfeoffed Yan Hui as 'Duke of Yan'.

description.zh-cn: 宋真宗于大中祥符二年（1009年）加封颜回为“兖国公”。
description.en: In 1009 (the 2nd year of the Dazhong Xiangfu era), Emperor Zhenzong of Song further enfeoffed Yan Hui as 'Duke of the State of Yan'.

description.zh-cn: 元文宗于至顺元年（1330年）加封颜回为“兖国复圣公”。
description.en: In 1330 (the 1st year of the Zhishun era), Emperor Wenzong of Yuan further enfeoffed Yan Hui as 'Duke of the State of Yan, the Continuator Sage'.

description.zh-cn: 明世宗于嘉靖九年（1530年）改封颜回为“复圣”。
description.en: In 1530 (the 9th year of the Jiajing era), the Jiajing Emperor changed Yan Hui's title to 'Continuator Sage'.

description.zh-cn: 子贡是孔子的弟子。
description.en: Zigong was a disciple of Confucius.

description.zh-cn: 子贡与颜回同为孔子弟子。子贡曾在孔子面前表示自己不敢与颜回相比。
description.en: Zigong and Yan Hui were fellow disciples of Confucius. Zigong once expressed to Confucius that he dared not compare himself to Yan Hui.

description.zh-cn: 曾子称颜回为自己的朋友，并赞扬其谦虚、不计较的品德。
description.en: Zengzi referred to Yan Hui as his friend and praised his virtues of modesty and magnanimity.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·马克思于1844年4月至8月间撰写了《1844年经济学哲学手稿》。
description.en: Karl Marx wrote the 'Economic and Philosophic Manuscripts of 1844' between April and August 1844.

description.zh-cn: 于1927年将《1844年经济学哲学手稿》的第三部分整理后发表。
description.en: In 1927, compiled and published the third part of the 'Economic and Philosophic Manuscripts of 1844'.

description.zh-cn: 其研究人员于1932年首次完整发行了《1844年经济学哲学手稿》。
description.en: Its researchers first published the 'Economic and Philosophic Manuscripts of 1844' in their entirety in 1932.

description.zh-cn: 《1844年经济学哲学手稿》曾被视为《神圣家族》的草稿。
description.en: The 'Economic and Philosophic Manuscripts of 1844' was once considered a draft of 'The Holy Family'.

description.zh-cn: 马克思在《1844年经济学哲学手稿》中引用并发展了亚里士多德关于市场体系和人类活动的观点。
description.en: In the 'Economic and Philosophic Manuscripts of 1844', Marx cited and developed Aristotle's views on the market system and human activity.

description.zh-cn: 《1844年经济学哲学手稿》系统阐述了马克思的异化论，是该理论的 foundational text。
description.en: The 'Economic and Philosophic Manuscripts of 1844' systematically elaborates Marx's theory of alienation, serving as its foundational text.

description.zh-cn: 马克思的异化论是对资本主义制度下工人被剥削和非人化现象的深刻批判。
description.en: Marx's theory of alienation is a profound critique of the exploitation and dehumanization of workers under capitalism.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·马克思是《资本论》的作者。
description.en: Karl Marx is the author of 'Das Kapital'.

description.zh-cn: 蒋孝武是蒋经国的次子。
description.en: Chiang Hsiao-wu is the second son of Chiang Ching-kuo.

description.zh-cn: 蒋孝武是蒋方良的次子。
description.en: Chiang Hsiao-wu is the second son of Chiang Fang-liang.

description.zh-cn: 蒋友松是蒋孝武的儿子。
description.en: Chiang Yu-sung is the son of Chiang Hsiao-wu.

description.zh-cn: 蒋孝武于1986年与蔡惠媚结婚，婚姻关系因蒋孝武逝世而结束。
description.en: Chiang Hsiao-wu married Tsai Hui-mei in 1986; the marriage ended with his death.

description.zh-cn: 蒋孝文是蒋孝武的哥哥。
description.en: Chiang Hsiao-wen is the older brother of Chiang Hsiao-wu.

description.zh-cn: 蒋孝勇是蒋孝武的弟弟。
description.en: Chiang Hsiao-yung is the younger brother of Chiang Hsiao-wu.

description.zh-cn: 蒋纬国是蒋经国的弟弟（名义上）。
description.en: Chiang Wei-kuo is the (nominal) younger brother of Chiang Ching-kuo.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正是蒋孝武的祖父。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek is the grandfather of Chiang Hsiao-wu.

description.zh-cn: 蒋纬国是蒋孝武的叔父。
description.en: Chiang Wei-kuo is the uncle of Chiang Hsiao-wu.

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国对蒋孝武进行特殊安排，使其进入国家安全会议。
description.en: Chiang Ching-kuo made special arrangements for Chiang Hsiao-wu to enter the National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 在江南案中，国防部情报局授意竹联帮杀手暗杀刘宜良。
description.en: In the Henry Liu case, the Military Intelligence Bureau instructed assassins from the United Bamboo Gang to assassinate Henry Liu.

description.zh-cn: 在江南案中，竹联帮成员刺杀了刘宜良。
description.en: In the Henry Liu case, members of the United Bamboo Gang assassinated Henry Liu.

description.zh-cn: 因被怀疑是江南案主谋，蒋孝武从此失宠，被外放至新加坡及日本。
description.en: Suspected of being the mastermind behind the Henry Liu case, Chiang Hsiao-wu fell out of favor and was posted to Singapore and Japan.

description.zh-cn: 蒋孝武公开批评其叔父蒋纬国竞选总统，使其失去竞选的正当性。
description.en: Chiang Hsiao-wu publicly criticized his uncle Chiang Wei-kuo's presidential bid, causing him to lose the legitimacy of his campaign.

description.zh-cn: 1970年代初，蒋孝武与歌星崔苔菁陷入热恋。
description.en: In the early 1970s, Chiang Hsiao-wu and singer Tsui Tai-ching were passionately in love.

description.zh-cn: 时任总统李登辉出席蒋孝武的丧礼并致祭。
description.en: Then-President Lee Teng-hui attended and paid his respects at the funeral of Chiang Hsiao-wu.

description.zh-cn: 时任副总统李元簇出席蒋孝武的丧礼并致祭。
description.en: Then-Vice President Li Yuan-tsu attended and paid his respects at the funeral of Chiang Hsiao-wu.

description.zh-cn: 时任行政院院长郝柏村出席蒋孝武的丧礼并致祭。
description.en: Then-Premier Hau Pei-tsun attended and paid his respects at the funeral of Chiang Hsiao-wu.

description.zh-cn: 马来亚联合邦与北婆罗洲（今沙巴）、砂拉越及新加坡共同组成马来西亚联邦。
description.en: The Federation of Malaya, together with North Borneo (present-day Sabah), Sarawak, and Singapore, formed the Federation of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 该协定促成了马来西亚联邦的建立。
description.en: This agreement led to the establishment of the Federation of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 该协议确认了新加坡从马来西亚联邦独立，成为一个主权国家。
description.en: This agreement confirmed Singapore's independence from the Federation of Malaysia, making it a sovereign state.

description.zh-cn: 马来亚联合邦原为英国保护国，于1957年8月31日独立。
description.en: The Federation of Malaya was a British protectorate until it gained independence on August 31, 1957.

description.zh-cn: 担任马来西亚国家元首。
description.en: Serves as the head of state of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 担任马来西亚政府首脑。
description.en: Serves as the head of government of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 来自三佛齐皇室的王子拜里米苏拉建立了马六甲苏丹王朝。
description.en: Parameswara, a prince from the Srivijayan royal house, founded the Malacca Sultanate.

description.zh-cn: 1511年，葡萄牙舰队攻占马六甲，导致马六甲苏丹王朝在马六甲的统治终结。
description.en: In 1511, a Portuguese fleet captured Malacca, ending the rule of the Malacca Sultanate in the city.

description.zh-cn: 荷兰于1641年联合柔佛攻下葡属马六甲。
description.en: The Dutch, in alliance with Johor, captured Portuguese Malacca in 1641.

description.zh-cn: 柔佛王朝于1641年联合荷兰攻下葡属马六甲。
description.en: The Johor Sultanate, in alliance with the Dutch, captured Portuguese Malacca in 1641.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次世界大战期间，日本占领了英属马来亚。
description.en: During World War II, Japan occupied British Malaya.

description.zh-cn: 马来亚共产党在马来亚紧急状态期间与英国殖民政府及英联邦军队进行武装斗争。
description.en: The Malayan Communist Party engaged in armed struggle against the British colonial government and Commonwealth forces during the Malayan Emergency.

description.zh-cn: 担任马来亚联合邦第一任首相。
description.en: Served as the first Prime Minister of the Federation of Malaya.

description.zh-cn: 印度尼西亚总统苏卡诺反对马来西亚的成立，并引发了马印对抗。
description.en: Indonesian President Sukarno opposed the formation of Malaysia, leading to the Indonesia-Malaysia confrontation.

description.zh-cn: 在时任首相阿都拉萨的领导下，马来西亚政府开始推行新经济政策。
description.en: Under the leadership of then-Prime Minister Abdul Razak, the Malaysian government began implementing the New Economic Policy.

description.zh-cn: 时任首相纳吉·阿都拉萨设立了一个马来西亚发展有限公司（1MDB）。
description.en: Then-Prime Minister Najib Razak established 1Malaysia Development Berhad (1MDB).

description.zh-cn: 国民阵线在2018年大选中败给希望联盟，结束了长达61年的执政。
description.en: Barisan Nasional was defeated by Pakatan Harapan in the 2018 general election, ending its 61-year-long rule.

description.zh-cn: 希望联盟在2018年大选中获胜，成为执政联盟。
description.en: Pakatan Harapan won the 2018 general election, becoming the ruling coalition.

description.zh-cn: 荷兰是荷兰王国的主要构成国。
description.en: The Netherlands is the main constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands.

description.zh-cn: 自2013年起，威廉-亚历山大担任荷兰的国家元首。
description.en: Since 2013, Willem-Alexander has served as the head of state of the Netherlands.

description.zh-cn: 迪克·斯霍夫是现任荷兰首相。
description.en: Dick Schoof is the current Prime Minister of the Netherlands.

description.zh-cn: 荷兰北方省份为反抗西班牙统治而发动了八十年战争。
description.en: The northern provinces of the Netherlands launched the Eighty Years' War to resist Spanish rule.

description.zh-cn: 西班牙与寻求独立的尼德兰七省共和国进行了长达八十年的战争。
description.en: Spain fought a war lasting eighty years against the Dutch Republic, which was seeking independence.

description.zh-cn: 乌特勒支同盟的成立被视为现代荷兰的开始，并于1581年正式宣布独立，成立尼德兰七省共和国。
description.en: The formation of the Union of Utrecht is considered the beginning of the modern Netherlands, which formally declared independence in 1581, establishing the Dutch Republic.

description.zh-cn: 《明斯特和约》的签订标志着八十年战争的结束，西班牙正式承认尼德兰七省共和国的独立。
description.en: The signing of the Peace of Münster marked the end of the Eighty Years' War, with Spain officially recognizing the independence of the Dutch Republic.

description.zh-cn: 1795年，尼德兰七省共和国被法兰西第一帝国占领，共和国终结。
description.en: In 1795, the Dutch Republic was occupied by the First French Empire, bringing the republic to an end.

description.zh-cn: 拿破仑在占领荷兰后，扶植建立了巴达维亚共和国。
description.en: After occupying the Netherlands, Napoleon established the Batavian Republic.

description.zh-cn: 比利时于1830年从荷兰联合王国独立，导致联合王国瓦解。
description.en: Belgium became independent from the United Kingdom of the Netherlands in 1830, leading to the dissolution of the united kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次世界大战期间，纳粹德国于1940年5月至1945年间占领荷兰。
description.en: During World War II, Nazi Germany occupied the Netherlands from May 1940 to 1945.

description.zh-cn: 荷兰是欧洲联盟（其前身为欧洲经济共同体）的创始成员国之一。
description.en: The Netherlands is one of the founding members of the European Union (formerly the European Economic Community).

description.zh-cn: 荷兰是北大西洋公约组织的创始成员国之一。
description.en: The Netherlands is one of the founding members of NATO.

description.zh-cn: 1949年，荷兰承认前殖民地荷属东印度独立为印度尼西亚。
description.en: In 1949, the Netherlands recognized the independence of its former colony, the Dutch East Indies, as Indonesia.

description.zh-cn: 1975年，荷兰承认前殖民地苏里南独立。
description.en: In 1975, the Netherlands recognized the independence of its former colony, Suriname.

description.zh-cn: 身为军人及学生来到天安门参加了天安门抗议。
description.en: As a soldier and student, he went to Tiananmen Square to participate in the protests.

description.zh-cn: 被认为是战狼外交式言辞的早期倡导者。
description.en: Considered an early advocate for the style of Wolf Warrior diplomacy.

description.zh-cn: 发文对中国不断的封城表达不满，表示只有成本可控的清零才更有意义，过度清零后果严重。
description.en: Published an article expressing dissatisfaction with China's continuous lockdowns, stating that only a zero-COVID policy with controllable costs is meaningful and that excessive measures would have severe consequences.

description.zh-cn: 在2022年南希·佩洛西访问台湾前，胡锡进在推特上发文威胁，若解放军警告与驱离佩洛西专机无效，可将其击落。
description.en: Prior to Nancy Pelosi's visit to Taiwan in 2022, Hu Xijin posted on Twitter threatening that if the PLA's warnings and attempts to drive away Pelosi's plane were ineffective, it could be shot down.

description.zh-cn: 胡锡进卸任《环球时报》党委书记兼社长，由范正伟接任。
description.en: Hu Xijin stepped down as Party Secretary and President of the Global Times, and was succeeded by Fan Zhengwei.

description.zh-cn: 胡锡进卸任《环球时报》总编辑，由吴绮敏接任。
description.en: Hu Xijin stepped down as Editor-in-Chief of the Global Times, and was succeeded by Wu Qimin.

description.zh-cn: 据香港《明报》报道，习近平肯定了胡锡进的宣传方式，并要求中共文宣系统加以效仿。
description.en: According to Hong Kong's Ming Pao, Xi Jinping affirmed Hu Xijin's propaganda methods and instructed the CCP's propaganda system to emulate them.

description.zh-cn: 因组织公款旅游，中纪委驻人民日报社纪检组对其进行调查并给予行政警告处分。
description.en: Due to organizing a tour with public funds, the CCDI's discipline inspection group stationed at the People's Daily investigated him and issued an administrative warning.

description.zh-cn: 网信办批评《环球时报》下属环球网“炒作”六四等敏感政治话题，并下令其整改。
description.en: The Cyberspace Administration of China criticized Global Times' website for 'hyping' sensitive political topics like the June 4th incident and ordered it to rectify.

description.zh-cn: 吴建民在讲座中批评胡锡进及其领导的《环球时报》文章极端，胡锡进则回应称吴建民是外交圈的“鸽派”。该论战因吴建民意外逝世而中止。
description.en: Wu Jianmin criticized articles by Hu Xijin and his Global Times as extremist in a lecture, to which Hu responded by calling Wu a 'dove' in diplomatic circles. The debate ended with Wu's accidental death.

description.zh-cn: 因胡锡进批评其电影《江湖儿女》充满“负能量”，贾樟柯发表长文逐条回应，引发论战。胡锡进后删除微博并表示接受回应。
description.en: After Hu Xijin criticized his film 'Ash Is Purest White' for being full of 'negative energy,' Jia Zhangke published a lengthy article responding point by point, sparking a debate. Hu later deleted his post and accepted the response.

description.zh-cn: 就中国官方微博发布的“中国点火VS印度点火”图片，沈逸反驳胡锡进应高举人道主义大旗的观点，引发论战。
description.en: Regarding the 'China ignition vs. India ignition' image posted on an official Chinese Weibo account, Shen Yi rebutted Hu Xijin's view that China should uphold the banner of humanitarianism, sparking a debate.

description.zh-cn: 就佩洛西访台事件，兔主席指责胡锡进的言论拔高调门、透支政府公信力，并要求其向全国人民道歉。
description.en: Regarding the Pelosi visit to Taiwan, Rabbit Chairman accused Hu Xijin of raising the tone excessively, overdrawing the government's credibility, and demanded he apologize to the entire nation.

description.zh-cn: 在胡锡进的讲座上，因不满其“中共代表13亿人民意志”的言论，当场发起举手投票并脱鞋离场抗议。
description.en: During a lecture by Hu Xijin, Chow Po Chung, dissatisfied with his statement that 'the CCP represents the will of 1.3 billion people,' initiated a show of hands and protested by taking off his shoes and leaving the venue.

description.zh-cn: 《环球时报》是《人民日报》社主办与出版的报刊。
description.en: The Global Times is a newspaper sponsored and published by the People's Daily.

description.zh-cn: 五代十国是唐朝末年藩镇割据的延续。
description.en: The Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period was a continuation of the fragmentation by military governors (fanzhen) of the late Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 李存勗灭后梁。
description.en: Li Cunxu destroyed the Later Liang.

description.zh-cn: 李存勗在灭亡后梁后，建国后唐。
description.en: After destroying the Later Liang, Li Cunxu founded the Later Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 石敬瑭引契丹军攻灭后唐。
description.en: Shi Jingtang led Khitan forces to destroy the Later Tang.

description.zh-cn: 石敬瑭向契丹国借兵反叛后唐。
description.en: Shi Jingtang borrowed troops from the Khitan state to rebel against the Later Tang.

description.zh-cn: 在契丹的帮助下建立后晋。
description.en: He established the Later Jin dynasty with the help of the Khitans.

description.zh-cn: 向契丹可汗耶律德光称儿皇帝。
description.en: He referred to himself as the 'son-emperor' to the Khitan khan Yelü Deguang.

description.zh-cn: 契丹军南下灭亡后晋。
description.en: Khitan forces marched south and destroyed the Later Jin.

description.zh-cn: 在契丹灭后晋后，于太原称帝建立后汉。
description.en: After the Khitans destroyed the Later Jin, he declared himself emperor in Taiyuan and established the Later Han.

description.zh-cn: 郭威篡后汉。
description.en: Guo Wei usurped the Later Han.

description.zh-cn: 建立后周。
description.en: Established the Later Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 赵匡胤通过陈桥兵变篡夺后周，结束五代。
description.en: Zhao Kuangyin usurped the Later Zhou through the Chen Bridge Mutiny, ending the Five Dynasties period.

description.zh-cn: 建立宋朝。
description.en: Established the Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 建立吴国。
description.en: Established the Wu state.

description.zh-cn: 篡夺吴国政权。
description.en: Usurped the throne of the Wu state.

description.zh-cn: 建立南唐。
description.en: Established the Southern Tang.

description.zh-cn: 南唐趁楚国内乱之际发兵攻灭。
description.en: The Southern Tang took advantage of internal strife in Chu to send troops and destroy it.

description.zh-cn: 后周于957年发兵南征南唐，南唐战败，割让江北十四州，称臣。
description.en: In 957, the Later Zhou launched a southern campaign against the Southern Tang. The Southern Tang was defeated, ceded fourteen prefectures north of the Yangtze River, and submitted as a vassal.

description.zh-cn: 宋朝于963年并吞荆南。
description.en: The Song dynasty annexed Jingnan in 963.

description.zh-cn: 宋朝于965年派兵灭亡后蜀。
description.en: The Song dynasty sent troops to destroy the Later Shu in 965.

description.zh-cn: 宋朝于971年灭亡南汉。
description.en: The Song dynasty destroyed the Southern Han in 971.

description.zh-cn: 宋朝于975年发兵南征，灭亡南唐。
description.en: The Song dynasty launched a southern campaign in 975 and destroyed the Southern Tang.

description.zh-cn: 宋朝于979年灭亡北汉，结束十国时期。
description.en: The Song dynasty destroyed the Northern Han in 979, ending the Ten Kingdoms period.

description.zh-cn: 三大战役是第二次国共内战中的三次关键战役。
description.en: The Three Great Campaigns were three key battles within the Second Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 三大战役结束后，中国国民党所领导的中华民国政府在中国大陆的统治逐渐崩溃。
description.en: After the Three Great Campaigns, the rule of the Kuomintang-led Government of the Republic of China on mainland China gradually collapsed.

description.zh-cn: 解放军通过三大战役的胜利，取得了对国军的决定性优势。
description.en: Through the victories in the Three Great Campaigns, the People's Liberation Army gained a decisive advantage over the National Army.

description.zh-cn: 三大战役的胜利为解放军发动渡江战役，向全中国进军创造了条件。
description.en: The victory in the Three Great Campaigns created the conditions for the People's Liberation Army to launch the Yangtze River Crossing Campaign and advance across China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在中国抗日战争中磨练了灵活的游击战术。
description.en: The Communist Party of China honed its flexible guerrilla warfare tactics during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 解放军在三大战役中充分展现了其游击战术的优势。
description.en: The People's Liberation Army fully demonstrated the advantages of its guerrilla tactics during the Three Great Campaigns.

description.zh-cn: 罗荣桓是辽沈战役的指挥官之一。
description.en: Luo Ronghuan was one of the commanders of the Liaoshen Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在辽沈战役中，国军东北剿匪总司令部所属的主力部队被歼灭或俘虏，共计47万2千余人。
description.en: In the Liaoshen Campaign, the main forces of the National Army's Northeast Bandit Suppression Headquarters were eliminated or captured, totaling over 472,000 personnel.

description.zh-cn: 卫立煌在辽沈战役期间担任国军东北剿匪总司令部总司令。
description.en: Wei Lihuang served as the commander-in-chief of the National Army's Northeast Bandit Suppression Headquarters during the Liaoshen Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 粟裕是淮海战役的指挥官之一。
description.en: Su Yu was one of the commanders of the Huaihai Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平是淮海战役的指挥官之一。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping was one of the commanders of the Huaihai Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在淮海战役中，国军徐州剿匪总司令部所属的主力部队被消灭及改编。
description.en: In the Huaihai Campaign, the main forces of the National Army's Xuzhou Bandit Suppression Headquarters were eliminated and reorganized.

description.zh-cn: 在淮海战役中，国军华中剿匪总司令部所属的增援部队被消灭。
description.en: In the Huaihai Campaign, the reinforcement troops from the National Army's Central China Bandit Suppression Headquarters were eliminated.

description.zh-cn: 刘峙在淮海战役期间担任国军徐州剿匪总司令部总司令。
description.en: Liu Zhi served as the commander-in-chief of the National Army's Xuzhou Bandit Suppression Headquarters during the Huaihai Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 白崇禧在淮海战役期间担任国军华中剿匪总司令部总司令。
description.en: Bai Chongxi served as the commander-in-chief of the National Army's Central China Bandit Suppression Headquarters during the Huaihai Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东评价粟裕在淮海战役中“立了第一功”。
description.en: Mao Zedong commented that Su Yu 'achieved the premier merit' in the Huaihai Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 罗荣桓是平津战役的指挥官之一。
description.en: Luo Ronghuan was one of the commanders of the Pingjin Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在平津战役中，国军华北剿匪总司令部所属的主力部队52万余人被歼灭及改编。
description.en: In the Pingjin Campaign, over 520,000 troops from the main forces of the National Army's North China Bandit Suppression Headquarters were eliminated and reorganized.

description.zh-cn: 张爱萍与李又兰于1942年8月8日结婚。
description.en: Zhang Aiping and Li Youlan married on August 8, 1942.

description.zh-cn: 张翔是张爱萍的长子。
description.en: Zhang Xiang is the eldest son of Zhang Aiping.

description.zh-cn: 张品是张爱萍的三子。
description.en: Zhang Pin is the third son of Zhang Aiping.

description.zh-cn: 张小艾是张爱萍的女儿。
description.en: Zhang Xiao'ai is the daughter of Zhang Aiping.

description.zh-cn: 张灿明是张爱萍的胞弟。
description.en: Zhang Canming is the younger brother of Zhang Aiping.

description.zh-cn: 张辛亮是汪洋的女婿。
description.en: Zhang Xinliang is the son-in-law of Wang Yang.

description.zh-cn: 1928年8月由中国共产主义青年团转为中国共产党党员。
description.en: Transferred from the Communist Youth League of China to become a member of the Communist Party of China in August 1928.

description.zh-cn: 1934年春及1936年6月进入红军大学学习。
description.en: Entered the Red Army University for study in the spring of 1934 and June 1936.

description.zh-cn: 在赵紫阳担任国务院总理期间，张爱萍先后任副总理和国防部长。
description.en: During Zhao Ziyang's premiership, Zhang Aiping served successively as Vice Premier and Minister of National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 1938年3月，奉周恩来之命前往徐州面见李宗仁。
description.en: In March 1938, under the order of Zhou Enlai, he went to Xuzhou to meet Li Zongren.

description.zh-cn: 文革期间，在周恩来关照下，张爱萍得以匿名保外就医。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, under the care of Zhou Enlai, Zhang Aiping was able to get medical parole anonymously.

description.zh-cn: 1938年3月，张爱萍前往徐州面见李宗仁，提出对日作战意见。
description.en: In March 1938, Zhang Aiping went to Xuzhou to meet with Li Zongren and propose opinions on the war against Japan.

description.zh-cn: 1943年3月，在新四军袭击国军韩德勤部的战斗中，张爱萍指挥部队生擒韩德勤。
description.en: In March 1943, during the New Fourth Army's attack on KMT troops led by Han Deqin, forces commanded by Zhang Aiping captured Han Deqin alive.

description.zh-cn: 1944年9月，张爱萍接替阵亡的彭雪枫，任新四军第四师师长。
description.en: In September 1944, Zhang Aiping succeeded the fallen Peng Xuefeng as the commander of the 4th Division of the New Fourth Army.

description.zh-cn: 1949年4月23日华东军区海军成立，张爱萍成为第一任司令员，负责组建该部队。
description.en: On April 23, 1949, the East China Military Region Navy was established, and Zhang Aiping became its first commander, responsible for its formation.

description.zh-cn: 1954年8月，张爱萍任浙东前线指挥部司令员兼政治委员，负责组织指挥大陈列岛战役。
description.en: In August 1954, Zhang Aiping served as Commander and Political Commissar of the Zhedong Front Command, responsible for organizing and commanding the Battle of the Dachen Archipelago.

description.zh-cn: 张爱萍时任解放军华东军区参谋长、副总参谋长，统一指挥了攻占一江山岛的作战行动。
description.en: Zhang Aiping, then Chief of Staff of the PLA's East China Military Region and Deputy Chief of the General Staff, organized and commanded the operation to capture the Yijiangshan Islands.

description.zh-cn: 张爱萍具体负责“两弹一星”工程。
description.en: Zhang Aiping was specifically in charge of the 'Two Bombs, One Satellite' project.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命中，张爱萍受到批判，被关押五年，左腿致残。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Zhang Aiping was criticized, imprisoned for five years, and his left leg was disabled.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平1975年主持整顿工作后，张爱萍得以复出。
description.en: After Deng Xiaoping presided over the rectification work in 1975, Zhang Aiping was able to make a comeback.

description.zh-cn: 在“反击右倾翻案风”运动中，张爱萍再次被打倒。
description.en: During the 'Counterattack the Right-Deviationist Reversal-of-Verdicts Trend' movement, Zhang Aiping was purged again.

description.zh-cn: 张爱萍对军队经商持批评态度，认为这“无异于自毁长城”。
description.en: Zhang Aiping was critical of the military engaging in business, believing it was 'tantamount to destroying the Great Wall'.

description.zh-cn: 1989年六四事件中，张爱萍与其他六位将军共同强调，人民解放军的枪口不能对着人民群众。
description.en: During the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, Zhang Aiping, along with six other generals, emphasized that the guns of the People's Liberation Army should not be aimed at the people.

description.zh-cn: 1989年六四事件中，叶飞与其他六位将军共同强调，人民解放军的枪口不能对着人民群众。
description.en: During the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, Ye Fei, along with six other generals, emphasized that the guns of the People's Liberation Army should not be aimed at the people.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东曾评价张爱萍：“好犯上！”
description.en: Mao Zedong once commented on Zhang Aiping: 'Likes to offend superiors!'

description.zh-cn: 叶剑英曾评价张爱萍：“浑身带刺！”
description.en: Ye Jianying once commented on Zhang Aiping: 'Covered in thorns!'

description.zh-cn: 邓小平曾评价张爱萍：“军队中有两个人惹不起，你张爱萍，就是一个！”
description.en: Deng Xiaoping once commented on Zhang Aiping: 'There are two people in the army you can't mess with, and you, Zhang Aiping, are one of them!'

description.zh-cn: 1989年，张爱萍与王震在一个“重大问题”（指六四事件）上发生了争执。
description.en: In 1989, Zhang Aiping and Wang Zhen had a dispute over a 'major issue' (referring to the Tiananmen Square protests).

description.zh-cn: 为联合西域国家打击匈奴，派遣张骞出使西域。
description.en: To form an alliance with the Western Regions states against the Xiongnu, he dispatched Zhang Qian on a mission.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝时期，汉朝为打击匈奴势力，积极寻求与西域各国建立军事同盟。
description.en: During the reign of Emperor Wu, the Han dynasty actively sought military alliances with states in the Western Regions to attack the Xiongnu forces.

description.zh-cn: 在张骞首次西行途中将其俘虏并软禁长达十余年。
description.en: During Zhang Qian's first journey to the west, they captured and held him in captivity for over ten years.

description.zh-cn: 在东汉时期再次出使西域，打通了因战乱而荒废已久的丝绸之路。
description.en: During the Eastern Han Dynasty, he led a mission to the Western Regions again, reopening the Silk Road which had been long abandoned due to warfare.

description.zh-cn: 在北宋时期，西夏政权地处河西走廊，阻隔了宋朝与西域的传统陆上商路。
description.en: During the Northern Song Dynasty, the Western Xia regime was located in the Hexi Corridor, blocking the traditional overland trade route between the Song court and the Western Regions.

description.zh-cn: 通过西征和建立蒙古帝国，重新打通并保障了欧亚大陆的商路（尤其是草原丝绸之路）的畅通。
description.en: Through his western conquests and the establishment of the Mongol Empire, he reopened and secured the trade routes across Eurasia, especially the Steppe Silk Road.

description.zh-cn: 在辖境内推行驿站交通系统，极大地促进了丝绸之路的畅通和沿线商贸往来。
description.en: Implemented the Yam (postal station) system within its territory, greatly facilitating the flow of traffic and trade along the Silk Road.

description.zh-cn: 随着航海贸易的兴起，海上丝绸之路逐渐取代了陆上丝绸之路，成为对外贸易的主力。
description.en: With the rise of maritime trade, the Maritime Silk Road gradually replaced the Land Silk Road to become the main force of foreign trade.

description.zh-cn: 佛教自于阗沿丝绸之路全面传入西域各国，并最终传播至中原。
description.en: Buddhism spread comprehensively from Khotan to the states of the Western Regions along the Silk Road, and eventually reached the Central Plains of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国的造纸术沿着丝绸之路向西传播，对世界文明产生了巨大影响。
description.en: China's papermaking technology spread westward along the Silk Road, having a profound impact on world civilization.

description.zh-cn: 战后，唐军战俘中的造纸工匠被带到撒马尔罕，成为造纸术传入伊斯兰世界的关键事件。
description.en: After the battle, papermaking artisans among the Tang prisoners of war were taken to Samarkand, marking a key event in the transmission of papermaking to the Islamic world.

description.zh-cn: 景教（基督教聂斯脱里派）随着丝绸之路商旅来到中国，并于唐朝得到发展。
description.en: Nestorianism (a branch of Christianity) arrived in China with merchants along the Silk Road and developed during the Tang Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 在会昌法难中，景教与佛教等外来宗教一同受到打击，从此在中国走向衰落。
description.en: During the Great Anti-Buddhist Persecution, Nestorianism, along with Buddhism and other foreign religions, was suppressed, leading to its decline in China.

description.zh-cn: 在第38届世界遗产委员会会议上，正式批准“丝绸之路：长安－天山廊道的路网”项目列入世界遗产名录。
description.en: At the 38th session of the World Heritage Committee, officially approved the inclusion of 'Silk Roads: the Routes Network of Chang'an-Tianshan Corridor' on the World Heritage List.

description.zh-cn: 李克农担任副总参谋长期间，黄克诚为时任总参谋长。
description.en: When Li Kenong served as Deputy Chief of the General Staff, Huang Kecheng was the Chief of the General Staff.

description.zh-cn: 李克农担任副总参谋长期间，罗瑞卿为时任总参谋长。
description.en: When Li Kenong served as Deputy Chief of the General Staff, Luo Ruiqing was the Chief of the General Staff.

description.zh-cn: 孔原接替李克农出任中共中央调查部部长。
description.en: Kong Yuan succeeded Li Kenong as Minister of the Central Investigation Department of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 作为中共情报人员参与第一次国共内战。
description.en: Participated in the First Chinese Civil War as a CCP intelligence agent.

description.zh-cn: 在抗日战争期间从事统战和情报工作。
description.en: Engaged in united front and intelligence work during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次国共内战期间负责情报工作。
description.en: Was in charge of intelligence work during the Second Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 作为朝鲜停战谈判中方代表团的总指挥和最高负责人，参与停战谈判。
description.en: Participated in the armistice negotiations as the commander-in-chief and highest responsible person of the Chinese delegation for the Korean War Armistice Negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 同为“龙潭三杰”成员，在中共中央特科共事。
description.en: Both were members of the 'Longtan Three Heroes' and worked together in the CCP Central Special Branch.

description.zh-cn: 同为“龙潭三杰”成员，在中共中央特科共事。
description.en: Both were members of the 'Longtan Three Heroes' and worked together in the CCP Central Special Branch.

description.zh-cn: 在顾顺章叛变后，李克农及时向中共中央传递情报，避免了重大损失。
description.en: After Gu Shunzhang's defection, Li Kenong promptly passed on intelligence to the CCP Central Committee, preventing major losses.

description.zh-cn: 获取顾顺章叛变的情报后，派人通知李克农。
description.en: After obtaining intelligence about Gu Shunzhang's defection, sent someone to inform Li Kenong.

description.zh-cn: 及时转报顾顺章叛变的情报，使中共中央机关得以安全转移。
description.en: Promptly relayed the intelligence of Gu Shunzhang's defection, allowing the CCP Central Committee organs to safely relocate.

description.zh-cn: 在中共中央特科领导下从事秘密情报工作。
description.en: Engaged in secret intelligence work under the leadership of the CCP Central Special Branch.

description.zh-cn: 在潜伏于上海无线电管理局期间，任徐恩曾下属。
description.en: Served under Xu Enzeng while undercover at the Shanghai Radio Administration Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 参加长征，负责敌情侦察和保卫中共中央机关安全。
description.en: Participated in the Long March, responsible for enemy reconnaissance and the security of the CCP Central Committee organs.

description.zh-cn: 作为中共代表团秘书长，协助周恩来处理西安事变，促进国共谈判。
description.en: As secretary-general of the CCP delegation, assisted Zhou Enlai in handling the Xi'an Incident and promoting KMT-CCP negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 在西安事变及日内瓦会议等多个场合，作为周恩来的助手开展工作。
description.en: Worked as Zhou Enlai's assistant on multiple occasions, including the Xi'an Incident and the Geneva Conference.

description.zh-cn: 在潼关与顾祝同进行停止内战的谈判。
description.en: Negotiated with Gu Zhutong in Tongguan to cease the civil war.

description.zh-cn: 在张国焘叛逃中共时将其扣留。
description.en: Detained Zhang Guotao when he defected from the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 在中共中央后方委员会期间，于叶剑英领导下开展情报工作。
description.en: During his time at the CCP Central Rear Committee, he conducted intelligence work under the leadership of Ye Jianying.

description.zh-cn: 与康生共同下令将王实味秘密处死。
description.en: Jointly with Kang Sheng, ordered the secret execution of Wang Shiwei.

description.zh-cn: 与李克农共同下令将王实味秘密处死。
description.en: Jointly with Li Kenong, ordered the secret execution of Wang Shiwei.

description.zh-cn: 与康生共同下令将王实味秘密处死。
description.en: Jointly with Kang Sheng, ordered the secret execution of Wang Shiwei.

description.zh-cn: 李克农接替康生出任中共中央社会部（前身为情报部）部长。
description.en: Li Kenong succeeded Kang Sheng as Minister of the Central Social Affairs Department (formerly the Intelligence Department).

description.zh-cn: 领导破获了国民党特工密谋刺杀毛泽东的案件，保护了其安全。
description.en: Led the effort to foil a Kuomintang assassination plot against Mao Zedong, ensuring his safety.

description.zh-cn: 出席日内瓦会议，协助周恩来工作，并主持代表团的内外事务和联络工作。
description.en: Attended the Geneva Conference, assisted Zhou Enlai, and presided over the internal and external affairs and liaison work of the delegation.

description.zh-cn: 在李克农诞辰九十周年时，作为中华人民共和国主席高度评价李克农。
description.en: As President of the People's Republic of China, highly praised Li Kenong on the 90th anniversary of his birth.

position.en: Prefect of the Gentlemen of the Palace, Middle Chancellor

description.zh-cn: 秦二世登基后，赵高升任郎中令，后又成为中丞相，独揽朝政。
description.en: After Qin Er Shi ascended the throne, Zhao Gao was promoted to Prefect of the Gentlemen of the Palace and later became the Middle Chancellor, monopolizing state power.

description.zh-cn: 赵高曾担任公子胡亥（后来的秦二世）的老师，教授他决断讼案。
description.en: Zhao Gao served as a tutor to Prince Huhai (later Qin Er Shi), teaching him how to adjudicate legal cases.

description.zh-cn: 赵高曾犯下重罪，秦王政让蒙毅依法惩处，蒙毅依法判赵高死刑，但秦始皇最终赦免了他。
description.en: Zhao Gao once committed a serious crime. King Zheng of Qin ordered Meng Yi to handle it according to the law. Meng Yi sentenced Zhao Gao to death, but Qin Shi Huang ultimately pardoned him.

description.zh-cn: 秦二世即位后，赵高因旧怨日夜在秦二世面前毁谤蒙毅，并进谗言称其阻挠立胡亥为太子，最终致其被杀。
description.en: After Qin Er Shi ascended the throne, Zhao Gao, holding a grudge, slandered Meng Yi day and night before the emperor, falsely accusing him of obstructing Huhai's enthronement, which ultimately led to Meng Yi's execution.

description.zh-cn: 在沙丘之变后，赵高挑唆秦二世，致使蒙恬被囚禁并最终服毒自尽。
description.en: After the Shaqiu Coup, Zhao Gao incited Qin Er Shi, leading to Meng Tian's imprisonment and eventual suicide by poison.

description.zh-cn: 因害怕秦二世追究关东起义之事而对自己不利，赵高先发制人，发动了望夷宫之变。
description.en: Fearing that Qin Er Shi would hold him accountable for the eastern rebellions, Zhao Gao launched a preemptive strike by initiating the Wangyi Palace Coup.

description.zh-cn: 在望夷宫之变中，秦二世被赵高所派的阎乐逼迫自杀。
description.en: During the Wangyi Palace Coup, Qin Er Shi was forced to commit suicide by Yan Le, who was sent by Zhao Gao.

description.zh-cn: 奉赵高之命，率吏卒一千多人包围望夷宫，当面历数秦二世罪状并逼其自杀。
description.en: Under Zhao Gao's orders, he led over a thousand soldiers to surround Wangyi Palace, enumerated Qin Er Shi's crimes to his face, and forced him to commit suicide.

description.zh-cn: 阎乐是赵高的女婿，并听从其命令发动了望夷宫之变。
description.en: Yan Le was Zhao Gao's son-in-law and followed his orders to launch the Wangyi Palace Coup.

description.zh-cn: 在杀死秦二世后，赵高召集群臣和诸公子，拥立子婴为秦王。
description.en: After killing Qin Er Shi, Zhao Gao summoned the ministers and princes and installed Ziying as the King of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 子婴登基五天后，设计诱骗赵高亲自前来，并派宦官韩谈在斋宫中将其刺杀，随后诛灭其三族。
description.en: Five days after ascending the throne, Ziying devised a plan to lure Zhao Gao to come in person and had the eunuch Han Tan assassinate him in the fasting palace, subsequently exterminating his clan to the third degree.

description.zh-cn: 奉秦王子婴之命，在斋宫中刺杀了赵高。
description.en: Under the order of Prince Ziying of Qin, he assassinated Zhao Gao in the fasting palace.

description.zh-cn: 赵高为测试群臣，策划了指鹿为马事件，以清除异己，巩固权力。
description.en: To test the ministers, Zhao Gao orchestrated the 'pointing to a deer and calling it a horse' incident to eliminate dissenters and consolidate power.

description.zh-cn: 在巨鹿之战中，项羽率领的军队击败了章邯率领的秦军主力。
description.en: At the Battle of Julu, the army led by Xiang Yu defeated the main force of the Qin army led by Zhang Han.

description.zh-cn: 章邯派长史司马欣向赵高请示，赵高拒不接见，加剧了章邯的恐惧和不信任，最终导致其投降。
description.en: Zhang Han sent his chief clerk Sima Xin to consult Zhao Gao, but Zhao Gao refused to see him, exacerbating Zhang Han's fear and distrust, which ultimately led to his surrender.

description.zh-cn: 赵高在杀死秦二世后，曾派使者联络刘邦，欲与关东诸侯共同瓜分秦朝，但遭到刘邦拒绝。
description.en: After killing Qin Er Shi, Zhao Gao sent an emissary to contact Liu Bang, intending to divide the Qin territory with the eastern lords, but was refused by Liu Bang.

description.zh-cn: 李斯死后，秦二世任命赵高任中丞相。
description.en: After the death of Li Si, Qin Er Shi appointed Zhao Gao as the Middle Chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 1950年，孟小冬在香港与杜月笙办理结婚手续，成为其妾室，直至1951年杜月笙去世。
description.en: In 1950, Meng Xiaodong married Du Yuesheng in Hong Kong, becoming his concubine until his death in August 1951.

description.zh-cn: 1927年与梅兰芳结合，但此段关系未被梅家正式承认，被视为外室。两人于1931年正式分手。
description.en: She entered into a relationship with Mei Lanfang in 1927, but it was not formally recognized by Mei's family, and she was considered his outside wife. they formally separated in 1931.

description.zh-cn: 孟小冬师承余叔岩，是其门下唯一的女弟子，被公认为“余派”主要传人。
description.en: Meng Xiaodong studied under Yu Shuyan and was his only female disciple, recognized as a primary successor of the 'Yu School'.

description.zh-cn: 辜振甫在香港工作时曾向孟小冬请教京剧艺术。
description.en: Koo Chen-fu consulted Meng Xiaodong on the art of Peking opera while working in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 孟小冬聘请律师郑毓秀处理与梅兰芳的分手事宜。
description.en: Meng Xiaodong hired lawyer Zheng Yuxiu to handle her separation from Mei Lanfang.

description.zh-cn: 陆京士曾与姚玉兰一同多次邀请孟小冬移居台湾。
description.en: Lu Jingshi, along with Yao Yulan, repeatedly invited Meng Xiaodong to move to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 1966年文化大革命爆发后，香港亦受影响，促使孟小冬于1967年迁居台湾。
description.en: After the Cultural Revolution broke out in 1966, Hong Kong was affected, prompting Meng Xiaodong to move to Taiwan in 1967.

description.zh-cn: 为孟小冬的墓碑题字“杜母孟太夫人墓”。
description.en: Inscribed the epitaph 'Tomb of Matriarch Meng, Mother of Du' on Meng Xiaodong's tombstone.

description.zh-cn: 科学革命为工业革命奠定了理论基础，工业革命被认为是由现代科学革命所引发。
description.en: The Scientific Revolution laid the theoretical foundation for the Industrial Revolution, which is considered to have been triggered by the modern Scientific Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 英国农业革命导致农业劳动力过剩，为工业革命提供了大量寻求新就业机会的劳动力。
description.en: The British Agricultural Revolution resulted in a surplus of agricultural labor, providing a large workforce seeking new employment opportunities for the Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 圈地运动造成大量农民失去土地涌向城市，为工业革命提供了劳动力，并推动了纺织产业的工业化。
description.en: The Enclosure Movement caused a large number of peasants to lose their land and flock to the cities, providing labor for the Industrial Revolution and promoting the industrialization of the textile industry.

description.zh-cn: 哥伦布大交换导致欧洲人口爆炸，社会生产需求大增，为工业革命创造了前提条件。
description.en: The Columbian Exchange led to a population explosion in Europe and a massive increase in production demand, creating preconditions for the Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 光荣革命后建立的政治和金融体系约束了政府行为，保障了财产权，为工业革命创造了稳定的环境和廉价的资金来源。
description.en: The political and financial systems established after the Glorious Revolution constrained government actions, protected property rights, and created a stable environment and sources of cheap capital for the Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 英国自1623年开始设立专利权以保护新发明，此举刺激了大量新发明的产生，推动了工业革命的进程。
description.en: Britain established patent rights in 1623 to protect new inventions, which stimulated the creation of numerous new inventions and drove the progress of the Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 英国国王詹姆士六世及一世于1623年允许设立专利权，以保护新发明的权利。
description.en: King James VI and I of Great Britain allowed the establishment of patent rights in 1623 to protect the rights of new inventions.

description.zh-cn: 蒸汽机的发明和改进是工业革命的核心，它提供了廉价而充足的动力，使生产摆脱了对人力、畜力和自然力的依赖，引发了从手工劳动向动力机器生产转变的重大飞跃。
description.en: The invention and improvement of the steam engine were central to the Industrial Revolution, providing cheap and abundant power that freed production from reliance on human, animal, and natural forces, triggering a major leap from manual labor to machine-powered production.

description.zh-cn: 煤炭是工业革命的主要能源，为蒸汽机提供了动力，并且在冶金技术革新中取代木炭，是促成工业革命技术加速发展的四项主要因素之一。
description.en: Coal was the primary energy source of the Industrial Revolution, powering steam engines and replacing charcoal in metallurgical innovations, making it one of the four main factors accelerating technological development during the revolution.

description.zh-cn: 钢铁生产工法的进步为技术革新生产的各种新机器提供了必要的原材料，促进了工业革命的发展。
description.en: Advances in iron and steel production methods provided the necessary raw materials for the various new machines produced by technological innovation, promoting the development of the Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 于1712年发明了第一台实用的蒸汽机。
description.en: Invented the first practical steam engine in 1712.

description.zh-cn: 于1781年改良了纽科门的蒸汽机，大大提高了其效率，使其适用于工业用途。
description.en: Improved Newcomen's steam engine in 1781, greatly increasing its efficiency and making it suitable for industrial use.

description.zh-cn: 第一次工业革命为第二次工业革命奠定了技术和社会基础。
description.en: The First Industrial Revolution laid the technological and social foundations for the Second Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 第一次工业革命开启了现代化的进程，为后续的技术革命，如第三次工业革命，创造了条件。
description.en: The First Industrial Revolution initiated the process of modernization, creating conditions for subsequent technological revolutions like the Third Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 工业革命自英格兰发生后，扩散到整个欧洲大陆。
description.en: After originating in England, the Industrial Revolution spread throughout the European continent.

description.zh-cn: 工业革命于19世纪传播到北美地区。
description.en: The Industrial Revolution spread to North America in the 19th century.

description.zh-cn: 工业革命的自由经济和工厂制度催生了一个新的富裕阶层，即资产阶级。
description.en: The free economy and factory system of the Industrial Revolution gave rise to a new wealthy class, the bourgeoisie.

description.zh-cn: 工厂制度的建立和都市化进程造就了大量的工厂工人，形成了新的社会阶层——工人阶级。
description.en: The establishment of the factory system and the process of urbanization created a large number of factory workers, forming a new social class—the working class.

description.zh-cn: 由于恶劣的工作环境、微薄的收入和经济危机带来的失业，工业革命导致了劳资双方，即资产阶级与工人阶级的对立。
description.en: Due to harsh working conditions, low wages, and unemployment caused by economic crises, the Industrial Revolution led to antagonism between labor and capital, namely the bourgeoisie and the working class.

description.zh-cn: 工业革命造成的工人阶级悲惨生活和劳资对立的社会环境，为马克思主义及共产主义思想的产生提供了土壤。
description.en: The miserable life of the working class and the social environment of labor-capital antagonism caused by the Industrial Revolution provided fertile ground for the emergence of Marxism and communist ideas.

description.zh-cn: 马克思在工业革命的社会背景下，创立了共产主义学说。
description.en: Karl Marx founded the doctrine of communism against the social backdrop of the Industrial Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 英国工人卢德于1811年捣毁机器的行为，引发了反对机械化的卢德运动。
description.en: The act of English worker Ned Ludd destroying machinery in 1811 sparked the Luddite movement against mechanization.

description.zh-cn: 卢德运动是一场反对机械化的社会运动，其参与者通过捣毁机器来表达抗议。
description.en: The Luddite movement was a social movement against mechanization, in which participants protested by destroying machines.

description.zh-cn: 自光荣革命后的18世纪，圈地运动开始愈演愈烈。
description.en: From the 18th century after the Glorious Revolution, the enclosure movement began to intensify.

description.zh-cn: 发明了珍妮纺纱机。
description.en: Invented the spinning jenny.

description.zh-cn: 发明了蒸汽轮船。
description.en: Invented the steamboat.

description.zh-cn: 徐宗汉是黄兴的第二任妻子（二房）。
description.en: Xu Zonghan was the second wife of Huang Xing.

description.zh-cn: 时任湖广总督的张之洞推荐黄兴入武昌两湖书院读书。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong, then Viceroy of Huguang, recommended Huang Xing to study at Lianghu Academy in Wuchang.

description.zh-cn: 与刘揆一、章士钊、宋教仁等人共同创立华兴会。
description.en: Co-founded the Huaxinghui with Liu Kuiyi, Zhang Shizhao, Song Jiaoren, and others.

description.zh-cn: 将兴中会、华兴会、光复会等团体合并，成立中国同盟会。
description.en: Merged groups such as the Xingzhonghui, Huaxinghui, and Guangfuhui to establish the Tongmenghui.

description.zh-cn: 拥护孙中山将华兴会等团体合并，成立中国同盟会。
description.en: Supported Sun Yat-sen in merging groups like the Huaxinghui to establish the Tongmenghui.

description.zh-cn: 华兴会与兴中会等团体合并成立中国同盟会。
description.en: The Huaxinghui merged with the Xingzhonghui and other groups to form the Tongmenghui.

description.zh-cn: 光复会与兴中会等团体合并成立中国同盟会。
description.en: The Guangfuhui merged with the Xingzhonghui and other groups to form the Tongmenghui.

description.zh-cn: 在同盟会成立会上，提议公推孙中山为总理。
description.en: At the founding meeting of the Tongmenghui, proposed to elect Sun Yat-sen as Premier by public acclaim.

description.zh-cn: 与孙中山共同策划并发动了镇南关起义。
description.en: Jointly planned and launched the Zhennanguan Uprising with Sun Yat-sen.

description.zh-cn: 率领部队在广西钦州、廉州、上思地区发动起义。
description.en: Led troops to launch an uprising in the Qinzhou, Lianzhou, and Shangsi areas of Guangxi.

description.zh-cn: 担任黄花岗起义副总指挥，并亲率敢死队进攻两广总督府。
description.en: Served as the deputy commander of the Huanghuagang Uprising and personally led the suicide squad to attack the Viceroy's office of Liangguang.

description.zh-cn: 担任黄花岗起义总指挥。
description.en: Served as the commander-in-chief of the Huanghuagang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 在黄花岗起义失败后，将受伤的黄兴护送至香港就医。
description.en: After the failure of the Huanghuagang Uprising, she escorted the wounded Huang Xing to Hong Kong for medical treatment.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义爆发后，黄兴被推举为中华民国军政府战时总司令。
description.en: After the Wuchang Uprising broke out, Huang Xing was elected as the wartime commander-in-chief of the Military Government of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 在南京就任江苏讨袁军总司令，发动二次革命。
description.en: Assumed the post of Commander-in-Chief of the Jiangsu Punitive Army against Yuan in Nanjing, launching the Second Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 发动二次革命武装讨伐袁世凯。
description.en: Launched the Second Revolution, an armed campaign against Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 强迫时任江苏都督程德全宣布独立，共同讨袁。
description.en: Forced Cheng Dequan, then Governor of Jiangsu, to declare independence and jointly oppose Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 二次革命失败后，在日本组织中华革命党。
description.en: After the failure of the Second Revolution, organized the Chinese Revolutionary Party in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 积极策动讨袁，派人促进云南护国军起义，并在美洲为护国军筹款。
description.en: Actively planned to oppose Yuan Shikai, sent people to promote the uprising of the Yunnan National Protection Army, and raised funds for it in the Americas.

description.zh-cn: 护国战争旨在反对袁世凯称帝，最终迫使其取消帝制。
description.en: The National Protection War aimed to oppose Yuan Shikai's proclamation as emperor, ultimately forcing him to abandon the monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 时任大总统黎元洪遵国会议决，颁令为黄兴举行国葬。
description.en: Then-President Li Yuanhong, following a resolution of the National Assembly, issued an order for a state funeral for Huang Xing.

description.zh-cn: 革命时期长期紧密合作，被时人以“孙黄”并称。虽在国旗方案等问题上有分歧，但黄兴最终以大局为重支持孙中山。孙中山在黄兴逝世后为其主丧。
description.en: They collaborated closely for a long time during the revolutionary period and were known as 'Sun-Huang.' Although they had disagreements on issues like the national flag design, Huang Xing ultimately supported Sun Yat-sen for the sake of the greater good. Sun Yat-sen presided over Huang Xing's funeral.

description.zh-cn: 因潮州起义失败等事，要求罢免孙中山同盟会总理职务，并起草《孙文罪状》发难。
description.en: Due to the failure of the Chaozhou Uprising and other matters, demanded the removal of Sun Yat-sen from his position as Premier of the Tongmenghui and drafted the 'Indictment of Sun Wen' to attack him.

description.zh-cn: 拒绝陶成章等人提出的取代孙中山任总理的要求，并表示“当以身力拒之”，坚定维护孙中山的领导地位。
description.en: Refused the request by Tao Cheng-chang and others to replace Sun Yat-sen as Premier, stating he would 'resist it with all my strength,' firmly upholding Sun's leadership.

description.zh-cn: 派遣人员刺杀了陶成章。
description.en: Dispatched personnel to assassinate Tao Cheng-chang.

description.zh-cn: 在陈其美的指派下，执行了对陶成章的刺杀。
description.en: Under the direction of Chen Qimei, carried out the assassination of Tao Cheng-chang.

description.zh-cn: 黄兴逝世时，蔡锷写下挽联悼念，两人同为革命元勋，并同葬于岳麓山。
description.en: When Huang Xing passed away, Cai E wrote a couplet in mourning. Both were founding fathers of the revolution and are buried together on Yuelu Mountain.

description.zh-cn: 章太炎很敬重黄兴，曾愿拥戴其为同盟会领袖，并在其追悼会上送挽联：“无公则无民国，有史必有斯人。”
description.en: Zhang Taiyan held great respect for Huang Xing, once wishing to support him as the leader of the Tongmenghui, and sent a couplet to his memorial service that read: 'Without you, there would be no Republic; as long as there is history, there will be this man.'

description.zh-cn: 哈什屯由顺治帝特恩屡次晋封至一等男兼一云骑尉。
description.en: Hašitun was repeatedly promoted by special grace of the Shunzhi Emperor to the rank of First-Class Baron and Yiyunqiwei.

description.zh-cn: 孝贤纯皇后是李荣保之女。
description.en: Empress Xiaoxianchun was the daughter of Lirongbao.

description.zh-cn: 傅恒是李荣保的第十子。
description.en: Fuheng was the tenth son of Lirongbao.

description.zh-cn: 明瑞在清缅战争中兵败后自缢身亡。
description.en: Mingrui was defeated in the Sino-Burmese War and committed suicide.

description.zh-cn: 景寿是咸丰帝任命的顾命八大臣之一。
description.en: Jingshou was one of the eight regents appointed by the Xianfeng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 顾命八大臣由咸丰帝在临终前任命，以辅佐其子同治帝。
description.en: The Eight Regent Ministers were appointed by the Xianfeng Emperor on his deathbed to assist his son, the Tongzhi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 傅恒因平定大小金川之役的战功被封为一等忠勇公。
description.en: Fuheng was ennobled as a First-Class Duke Zhongyong for his military achievements in quelling the Jinchuan campaigns.

description.zh-cn: 福康安是傅恒的第三子。
description.en: Fuk'anggan was the third son of Fuheng.

description.zh-cn: 福康安因平定林爽文事件等战功，被追赠为嘉勇郡王。
description.en: Fuk'anggan was posthumously created Prince Jiayong of the Second Rank for his military merits, including the suppression of the Lin Shuangwen rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 福康安因廓尔喀之役等战功，被追赠为嘉勇郡王。
description.en: Fuk'anggan was posthumously created Prince Jiayong of the Second Rank for his military merits, including his role in the Sino-Nepalese War.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤派兵迎接策穆特赫途中与乌拉兵遭遇，引发了乌碣岩之战。
description.en: Nurhaci dispatched troops to welcome Cemtehe, which led to an encounter with Ula forces and triggered the Battle of Wujieyan.

description.zh-cn: 富宁安被授为靖逆将军，成功击退了准噶尔大汗策妄阿拉布坦的进攻。
description.en: Funinggan was appointed General Jingni and successfully repelled the attack of the Dzungar Khan Tsewang Rabtan.

description.zh-cn: 萨布素因雅克萨之战的战功被授予一等轻车都尉。
description.en: Sabsu was awarded the title of First-Class Lieutenant Colonel (Yideng Qingche Duwei) for his military achievements in the Battle of Yakesa.

description.zh-cn: 米思翰是哈什屯之子。
description.en: Mishan was the son of Hašitun.

description.zh-cn: 李荣保是米思翰的第四子。
description.en: Lirongbao was the fourth son of Mishan.

description.zh-cn: 马齐是米思翰之子。
description.en: Macai was the son of Mishan.

description.zh-cn: 明瑞是富文之子。
description.en: Mingrui was the son of Fuwen.

description.zh-cn: 富文是李荣保第四子。
description.en: Fuwen was the fourth son of Lirongbao.

description.zh-cn: 阿兰泰是安达理之子。
description.en: Alantai was the son of Andali.

description.zh-cn: 项羽在楚汉战争中最终失败，于垓下被围，突围至乌江边自刎而死。
description.en: Xiang Yu was ultimately defeated in the Chu-Han Contention, surrounded at Gaixia, and committed suicide at the Wu River after a failed breakout.

description.zh-cn: 秦末民变导致了秦朝的最终灭亡。
description.en: The uprisings at the end of the Qin dynasty led to its final collapse.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝的灭亡造成了权力真空，直接引发了各路诸侯之间的楚汉战争。
description.en: The fall of the Qin dynasty created a power vacuum, directly leading to the Chu-Han Contention among the various lords.

description.zh-cn: 项羽在尊熊心为义帝后，不久便派英布等人将其刺杀。
description.en: Shortly after honoring Xiong Xin as Emperor Yi, Xiang Yu dispatched Ying Bu and others to assassinate him.

description.zh-cn: 巨鹿之战的胜利确立了项羽在各路反秦诸侯中的领袖地位。
description.en: The victory at the Battle of Julu established Xiang Yu's leadership status among the anti-Qin rebel lords.

description.zh-cn: 项羽在彭城之战中以三万精兵大破刘邦五十六万联军，是其军事生涯的巅峰之作。
description.en: Xiang Yu's defeat of Liu Bang's 560,000-strong coalition with just 30,000 elite troops at the Battle of Pengcheng was a pinnacle of his military career.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦在彭城之战中遭遇惨败，其家人被楚军俘虏，诸侯纷纷背汉归楚。
description.en: Liu Bang suffered a disastrous defeat at the Battle of Pengcheng; his family was captured by the Chu army, and many vassals defected back to Chu.

description.zh-cn: 陈平使用反间计，成功使项羽猜忌范增，导致范增辞归，最终病死途中，为刘邦清除了一个重要障碍。
description.en: Chen Ping used a stratagem to successfully make Xiang Yu suspicious of Fan Zeng, which led to Fan Zeng's resignation and subsequent death, removing a major obstacle for Liu Bang.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦还定三秦时，击败章邯，将其围困于废丘，章邯最终自杀。
description.en: When Liu Bang conquered the Three Qins, he defeated Zhang Han and besieged him in Feiqiu, leading to Zhang Han's suicide.

description.zh-cn: 清政府在鸦片战争中失败，被迫开放通商口岸。
description.en: The Qing government was defeated in the Opium War and was forced to open treaty ports.

description.zh-cn: 英国政府在鸦片战争后迫使清政府签订《南京条约》。
description.en: The British government forced the Qing government to sign the Treaty of Nanking after the Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 为设立上海英租界进行多次谈判。
description.en: Held multiple negotiations to establish the Shanghai British Concession.

description.zh-cn: 作为上海道台，以官方告示形式公布了《上海土地章程》。
description.en: As the Shanghai Daotai, he officially promulgated the 'Shanghai Land Regulations' by public notice.

description.zh-cn: 为美国商人在虹口地区租地建屋进行交涉。
description.en: Negotiated for American merchants to rent land and build houses in the Hongkou area.

description.zh-cn: 太平军向上海的军事行动促使租界英侨组建“万国商团”以进行自卫。
description.en: The military actions of the Taiping army towards Shanghai prompted British residents in the concession to form the 'Shanghai Volunteer Corps' for self-defense.

description.zh-cn: 太平洋战争爆发后，日本对英美等国宣战，随即全面占领了上海租界。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Pacific War, Japan declared war on countries like the UK and the US, and subsequently occupied the entire Shanghai concessions.

description.zh-cn: 为设立上海法租界进行谈判并获得同意。
description.en: Negotiated and obtained consent for the establishment of the Shanghai French Concession.

description.zh-cn: 在上海起事中杀死时任县令袁祖德。
description.en: Killed the incumbent county magistrate Yuan Zude during the uprising in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 在上海起事中囚禁时任上海道吴健彰。
description.en: Imprisoned the incumbent Shanghai Daotai Wu Jianzhang during the uprising in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 在泥城之战中，万国商团（英美义勇队）主动进攻清军兵营。
description.en: In the Battle of Muddy Flat, the Shanghai Volunteer Corps (Anglo-American volunteers) actively attacked Qing army barracks.

description.zh-cn: 法军与清军联合作战，共同攻击占领上海县城的小刀会。
description.en: French troops and Qing forces conducted joint operations to attack the Small Swords Society, which had occupied the Shanghai county seat.

description.zh-cn: 法军与清军联合作战，攻击小刀会。
description.en: French troops conducted joint operations with Qing forces to attack the Small Swords Society.

description.zh-cn: 张澜是中国民主同盟的主要创始人之一。
description.en: Zhang Lan was one of the main founders of the China Democratic League.

description.zh-cn: 沈钧儒是中国民主同盟的主要创始人之一。
description.en: Shen Junru was one of the main founders of the China Democratic League.

description.zh-cn: 章伯钧是中国民主同盟的主要创始人之一。
description.en: Zhang Bojun was one of the main founders of the China Democratic League.

description.zh-cn: 黄炎培是统一建国同志会的发起人之一。
description.en: Huang Yanpei was one of the initiators of the Tongyi Jianguo Tongzhihui.

description.zh-cn: 罗隆基是统一建国同志会的发起人之一。
description.en: Luo Longji was one of the initiators of the Tongyi Jianguo Tongzhihui.

description.zh-cn: 中国青年党是中国民主同盟的创始成员党派之一，于1946年被开除。
description.en: The Chinese Youth Party was one of the founding member parties of the China Democratic League and was expelled in 1946.

description.zh-cn: 中国国家社会党是中国民主同盟的创始成员党派之一，后改名为中国民主社会党并于1946年被开除。
description.en: The China National Socialist Party was one of the founding member parties of the China Democratic League, later renamed the China Democratic Social Party and was expelled in 1946.

description.zh-cn: 中华职业教育社是中国民主同盟的创始成员团体之一。
description.en: The China Vocational Education Society was one of the founding member groups of the China Democratic League.

description.zh-cn: 全国各界救国联合会是中国民主同盟的创始成员团体之一。
description.en: The National Salvation Association of All Circles was one of the founding member groups of the China Democratic League.

description.zh-cn: 因单独参加南京制宪国民大会，中国青年党被中国民主同盟开除。
description.en: The Chinese Youth Party was expelled from the China Democratic League for unilaterally participating in the Nanjing Constituent National Assembly.

description.zh-cn: 因单独参加南京制宪国民大会，中国民主社会党被中国民主同盟开除。
description.en: The China Democratic Social Party was expelled from the China Democratic League for unilaterally participating in the Nanjing Constituent National Assembly.

description.zh-cn: 1948年1月，民盟公开宣布与中国共产党合作，共同反对国民党的一党专政。
description.en: In January 1948, the China Democratic League publicly announced its cooperation with the Communist Party of China to jointly oppose the Kuomintang's one-party dictatorship.

description.zh-cn: 1947年10月，由国民党执政的中华民国政府宣布民盟为“非法团体”。
description.en: In October 1947, the Government of the Republic of China, led by the Kuomintang, declared the China Democratic League an 'illegal organization'.

description.zh-cn: 1949年中华人民共和国成立后，民盟接受中国共产党的政治领导，成为参政党。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China in 1949, the China Democratic League accepted the political leadership of the Communist Party of China and became a participating political party.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，毛泽东建议包括民盟在内的八个民主党派继续保留下来。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, Mao Zedong suggested that the eight democratic parties, including the China Democratic League, should be preserved.

description.zh-cn: 张澜当选为中央人民政府副主席。
description.en: Zhang Lan was elected as Vice Chairman of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 沈钧儒出任最高人民法院院长。
description.en: Shen Junru served as the President of the Supreme People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 章伯钧出任政务院部长。
description.en: Zhang Bojun served as a minister in the Government Administration Council.

description.zh-cn: 史良出任政务院部长。
description.en: Shi Liang served as a minister in the Government Administration Council.

description.zh-cn: 胡愈之出任政务院部长。
description.en: Hu Yuzhi served as a minister in the Government Administration Council.

description.zh-cn: 在1957年的反右运动中，许多民盟成员被划为“右派”，民盟从此一蹶不振。
description.en: During the 1957 Anti-Rightist Campaign, many members of the China Democratic League were labeled as 'rightists', and the league suffered a major setback from which it never fully recovered.

description.zh-cn: 章伯钧在反右运动中被划为“大右派”。
description.en: Zhang Bojun was labeled a 'major rightist' during the Anti-Rightist Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 罗隆基在反右运动中被划为“大右派”。
description.en: Luo Longji was labeled a 'major rightist' during the Anti-Rightist Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 费孝通在反右运动中被划为“右派”。
description.en: Fei Xiaotong was labeled a 'rightist' during the Anti-Rightist Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，民盟各级组织被迫停止活动。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, all levels of the China Democratic League's organizations were forced to cease their activities.

description.zh-cn: “粉碎四人帮”事件后，民盟逐步恢复组织活动。
description.en: After the 'Smashing of the Gang of Four', the China Democratic League gradually resumed its organizational activities.

position.en: Chairman of the Central Executive Committee

description.zh-cn: 黄炎培担任中国民主政团同盟第一任主席，后辞职。
description.en: Huang Yanpei served as the first Chairman of the China Democratic Political Groups League, and later resigned.

description.zh-cn: 张澜自1941年起长期担任中国民主同盟主席，直至1955年逝世。
description.en: Zhang Lan served as the Chairman of the China Democratic League for a long period from 1941 until his death in 1955.

description.zh-cn: 沈钧儒在张澜逝世后担任代理主席，后正式当选主席，直至1963年逝世。
