description.zh-cn: 担任新加坡共和国总统，为国家元首。
description.en: Serves as the President of the Republic of Singapore, the head of state.

description.zh-cn: 担任新加坡总理，为政府首脑。
description.en: Serves as the Prime Minister of Singapore, the head of government.

description.zh-cn: 担任新加坡国会议长。
description.en: Serves as the Speaker of the Parliament of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 担任新加坡首席大法官。
description.en: Serves as the Chief Justice of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡军队与台湾有合作关系，将其被称为“星光部队”的军队移至台湾进行训练。
description.en: The Singapore Armed Forces has a cooperative relationship with Taiwan, sending its troops, known as the 'Starlight Force', to train in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡与以色列的军事关系紧密，其军队的建立曾受到一批以色列军官的亲自指导。
description.en: Singapore and Israel have close military relations; the establishment of the Singaporean army was personally guided by a group of Israeli military officers.

description.zh-cn: 羽毛球选手骆建佑为新加坡获得首枚羽毛球世锦赛金牌，提升了国家在体育领域的声誉。
description.en: Badminton player Loh Kean Yew won Singapore's first-ever Badminton World Championships gold medal, enhancing the nation's reputation in the field of sports.

description.zh-cn: 蜀郡是秦国下辖的一个郡。
description.en: Shu Commandery was a commandery under the jurisdiction of the State of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 二王庙的古建筑群在汶川大地震中全部垮塌。
description.en: The ancient building complex of Erwang Temple completely collapsed during the Wenchuan earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 隆科多是佟国维之子。
description.en: Longkodo was the son of Tung-gowei.

description.zh-cn: 佟国维是佟图赖之子，隆科多是佟图赖之孙。
description.en: Tung-gowei was the son of Tulai, and Longkodo was the grandson of Tulai.

description.zh-cn: 佟国纲是隆科多的二伯父。
description.en: Tung-gogang was Longkodo's second paternal uncle.

description.zh-cn: 隆科多是康熙帝的表弟。
description.en: Longkodo was the Kangxi Emperor's maternal cousin.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝称隆科多为舅舅，因为隆科多的姐姐孝懿仁皇后是雍正帝的嫡母。
description.en: The Yongzheng Emperor addressed Longkodo as 'maternal uncle' because Longkodo's sister, Empress Xiaoyiren, was Yongzheng's adoptive mother.

description.zh-cn: 隆科多是孝懿仁皇后的弟弟。
description.en: Longkodo was the younger brother of Empress Xiaoyiren.

description.zh-cn: 隆科多是悫惠皇贵妃的弟弟。
description.en: Longkodo was the younger brother of Imperial Noble Consort Quehui.

description.zh-cn: 隆科多是满洲镶黄旗人。
description.en: Longkodo was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

description.zh-cn: 隆科多出身于佟佳氏家族。
description.en: Longkodo was from the Tonggiya clan.

description.zh-cn: 隆科多于康熙五十年至雍正三年担任步军统领。
description.en: Longkodo served as the Infantry Commander from 1711 to 1725.

description.zh-cn: 隆科多于康熙六十一年被任命为吏部尚书。
description.en: Longkodo was appointed Minister of Personnel in the 61st year of Kangxi's reign.

description.zh-cn: 因所属人违法，康熙帝责备隆科多不实心任事，罢免其副都统、銮仪使职务。
description.en: Due to illegal activities by his subordinates, the Kangxi Emperor reprimanded Longkodo for dereliction of duty and dismissed him from his posts as Deputy Commander and Master of the Imperial Guard.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝于康熙五十年授予隆科多步军统领之职。
description.en: The Kangxi Emperor appointed Longkodo as the Infantry Commander in the 50th year of his reign (1711).

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝继位后，立即封隆科多为总理事务大臣、吏部尚书，加太保等职务，使其成为两朝重臣。
description.en: Upon his accession, the Yongzheng Emperor immediately appointed Longkodo as Grand Minister Regent and Minister of Personnel, with the additional title of Grand Tutor, making him a powerful figure spanning two reigns.

description.zh-cn: 雍正五年，隆科多被定41款大罪，雍正帝下令从宽，将其在畅春园外禁锢，直至其于次年六月死于禁所。
description.en: In the fifth year of the Yongzheng reign (1727), Longkodo was convicted of 41 major crimes. The emperor showed leniency by commuting his sentence to confinement outside the Changchun Garden, where he died in June of the following year.

description.zh-cn: 雍正时期大兴的文字狱，其打击范围波及到了隆科多。
description.en: The literary inquisitions during the Yongzheng era also implicated Longkodo.

description.zh-cn: 雍正时期大兴的文字狱，其打击范围波及到了年羹尧。
description.en: The literary inquisitions during the Yongzheng era also implicated Nian Gengyao.

description.zh-cn: 夸岱是隆科多的堂兄弟。
description.en: Kuadai was Longkodo's paternal cousin.

description.zh-cn: 拥有中华民国国籍。
description.en: Held Republic of China citizenship.

description.zh-cn: 拥有美国国籍，后于2015年放弃。
description.en: Held United States citizenship, which he renounced in 2015.

description.zh-cn: 2015年起拥有中华人民共和国国籍。
description.en: Has held People's Republic of China citizenship since 2015.

description.zh-cn: 分别于1996年和2000年授予姚期智高德纳奖和图灵奖。
description.en: Awarded Andrew Yao the Knuth Prize in 1996 and the Turing Award in 2000, respectively.

description.zh-cn: 卓荣泰内阁是赖清德政府的首任内阁。
description.en: The Cho Jung-tai cabinet is the first cabinet of the Lai Ching-te administration.

description.zh-cn: 随着赖清德政府于2024年5月20日就任，陈建仁内阁结束其看守阶段并正式卸任。
description.en: With the inauguration of the Lai Ching-te administration on May 20, 2024, the Chen Chien-jen cabinet concluded its caretaker period and formally stepped down.

description.zh-cn: 赖清德在2024年中华民国总统选举中获胜，从而得以组建新一届政府。
description.en: Lai Ching-te won the 2024 ROC presidential election, which enabled the formation of a new government administration.

description.zh-cn: 时任候任总统的赖清德于2024年4月10日宣布由卓荣泰出任行政院院长。
description.en: On April 10, 2024, then-President-elect Lai Ching-te announced the appointment of Cho Jung-tai as the Premier of the Executive Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 根据中华民国宪法，行政院为国家最高行政机关，向总统负责。
description.en: According to the Constitution of the Republic of China, the Executive Yuan is the highest administrative organ of the state and is responsible to the President.

description.zh-cn: 作为立法院的反对党，中国国民党对卓荣泰内阁构成政治上的制衡与挑战。
description.en: As an opposition party in the Legislative Yuan, the Kuomintang poses a political check and challenge to the Cho Jung-tai cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 作为立法院的反对党，台湾民众党对卓荣泰内阁构成政治上的制衡与挑战。
description.en: As an opposition party in the Legislative Yuan, the Taiwan People's Party poses a political check and challenge to the Cho Jung-tai cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 卓荣泰内阁为民主进步党籍总统赖清德所任命，其主要成员也多具该党背景。
description.en: The Cho Jung-tai cabinet was appointed by DPP President Lai Ching-te, and many of its key members have a background in the party.

description.zh-cn: 杨宇霆深受张作霖信任，历任奉军参谋长、东北陆军训练总监等要职。
description.en: Yang Yuting was deeply trusted by Zhang Zuolin and held key positions such as Chief of Staff of the Fengtian Army and Inspector-General of the Northeast Army Training.

description.zh-cn: 杨宇霆是奉系军阀的重要将领，长期担任奉军总参谋长等职务。
description.en: Yang Yuting was an important general of the Fengtian clique, serving as the Chief of General Staff of the Fengtian Army for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 杨宇霆毕业于日本陆军士官学校第八期砲兵科。
description.en: Yang Yuting graduated from the 8th class of the artillery department of the Imperial Japanese Army Academy.

description.zh-cn: 郭松龄素遭杨宇霆排挤，这是其起兵反奉的原因之一。
description.en: Guo Songling was consistently sidelined by Yang Yuting, which was one of the reasons for his rebellion against the Fengtian clique.

description.zh-cn: 郭松龄于1925年起兵反奉。
description.en: Guo Songling launched a rebellion against the Fengtian clique in 1925.

description.zh-cn: 郭松龄兵败后被奉军处死。
description.en: After his military defeat, Guo Songling was executed by the Fengtian army.

description.zh-cn: 郭松龄是张学良的恩师。
description.en: Guo Songling was Zhang Xueliang's mentor.

description.zh-cn: 杨宇霆坚决反对东北易帜，认为不应该服从蒋介石。
description.en: Yang Yuting firmly opposed the Northeast Flag Replacement, believing that they should not submit to Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 1925年，孙传芳联合陈调元在江苏袭击奉军，将其击败。
description.en: In 1925, Sun Chuanfang, along with Chen Tiaoyuan, attacked and defeated the Fengtian army in Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 1925年，陈调元与孙传芳联合在江苏袭击奉军，将其击败。
description.en: In 1925, Chen Tiaoyuan, along with Sun Chuanfang, attacked and defeated the Fengtian army in Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 第二次直奉战争奉军获胜后，杨宇霆被任命为江苏军务督办。
description.en: After the Fengtian clique's victory in the Second Zhili–Fengtian War, Yang Yuting was appointed as the military governor of Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 杨春元是杨宇霆的长子。
description.en: Yang Chunyuan is the eldest son of Yang Yuting.

description.zh-cn: 1928年9月，杨宇霆两次与白崇禧在冀东会晤。
description.en: In September 1928, Yang Yuting met with Bai Chongxi twice in eastern Hebei.

description.zh-cn: 1918年，徐树铮在天津枪杀直系将领陆建章。
description.en: In 1918, Xu Shuzheng shot and killed Zhili clique general Lu Jianzhang in Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 徐树铮枪杀陆建章后，张作霖与徐树铮不和。
description.en: After Xu Shuzheng killed Lu Jianzhang, Zhang Zuolin and Xu were at odds.

description.zh-cn: 声称宗教与神话和哲学相辅相成，相当于人文社科中的一门包罗万象的“生存之道”。
description.en: Claimed that religion, complemented by myth and philosophy, is equivalent to an all-encompassing 'way of life' within the humanities and social sciences.

description.zh-cn: 通过对拉丁语religio的词源学解释，影响了宗教概念的形成，认为其本意包含“重视”和“小心考虑”。
description.en: Influenced the concept of religion through his etymological explanation of the Latin word 'religio', suggesting its original meaning included 'to pay heed' and 'to consider carefully'.

description.zh-cn: 使用拉丁语religare等词来解释宗教，强调其作为人与神之间重新结合、修好的关系，深化了宗教的神学内涵。
description.en: Used Latin words like 'religare' to interpret religion, emphasizing its role as a relationship of reconnection and reconciliation between humanity and God, thereby deepening its theological meaning.

description.zh-cn: 提出理论认为，宗教是人的本质的异化，即人把自己身上优质的特性凝集为上帝，并反过来崇拜这个自己创造出的形象。
description.en: Proposed the theory that religion is the alienation of the human essence, where humans project their best qualities onto a divine being (God) and then worship this creation.

description.zh-cn: 释圣严是法鼓山的创办人。
description.en: Sheng-yen is the founder of Dharma Drum Mountain.

description.zh-cn: 提出了“有所宗而以为教者，即为宗教”的定义。
description.en: Proposed the definition that 'that which has a principle and is taken as a teaching, is religion'.

description.zh-cn: 提出了“万物有灵论”作为解释宗教起源的理论。
description.en: Proposed 'animism' as a theory to explain the origin of religion.

description.zh-cn: 提出巫术论，将巫术视为人类精神发展的第一个阶段。
description.en: Proposed the theory of magic, viewing magic as the first stage of human intellectual development.

description.zh-cn: 根据詹姆斯·弗雷泽的巫术论，当人类发现巫术无法控制自然时，便转向宗教，寻求超自然力量的帮助，因此巫术的发展推动了宗教的产生。
description.en: According to James Frazer's theory of magic, when humans realized magic could not control nature, they turned to religion to seek help from supernatural powers, thus the development from magic pushed the emergence of religion.

description.zh-cn: 根据詹姆斯·弗雷泽的理论，宗教是人类精神发展的第二个阶段，其后发展为科学阶段。
description.en: According to James Frazer's theory, religion is the second stage of human intellectual development, which later evolves into the stage of science.

description.zh-cn: 最先提出功能论，认为宗教等文化现象是为了满足个体的心理和社会需求。
description.en: First proposed functionalism, arguing that cultural phenomena like religion exist to satisfy individual psychological and social needs.

description.zh-cn: 从逻辑和科学角度对宗教，尤其是有神论，提出了批判，例如质疑“第一起因”论证的逻辑性。
description.en: Criticized religion, especially theism, from logical and scientific perspectives, for instance, questioning the logic of the 'first cause' argument.

description.zh-cn: 批评威廉·詹姆士的宗教意志论为“功利、主观”，认为其将信仰问题简化为利益计算。
description.en: Criticized William James's religious voluntarism as 'utilitarian and subjective', arguing that it reduces the matter of faith to a calculation of benefits.

description.zh-cn: 作为理性论护教者，他认为宇宙的高度秩序和规律性为一神论提供了强有力的支持。
description.en: As a proponent of rational theism, he argues that the high degree of order and regularity in the universe provides strong support for monotheism.

description.zh-cn: 提出分离论，主张宗教与科学寻求的真理在不同意域，不应混为一谈，从而在哲学上为宗教划定了独立的领域。
description.en: Proposed the separation theory, arguing that religion and science seek truths in different domains and should not be confused, thereby defining an independent sphere for religion in philosophy.

description.zh-cn: 提出宗教情感论，认为宗教的本质并非理智或道德，而是人对神的“绝对依赖感”。
description.en: Proposed the theory of religious feeling, arguing that the essence of religion is not intellect or morality, but a 'feeling of absolute dependence' on God.

description.zh-cn: 发展了宗教体验理论，认为宗教的核心是对“神圣者”的体验，这种体验是既敬畏又向往的非理性情感交织。
description.en: Developed the theory of religious experience, arguing that the core of religion is the experience of 'the Numinous', a non-rational mixture of awe and fascination.

description.zh-cn: 提出“信仰的赌注”论证，开创了宗教意志论，即在理性无法决断时，根据利害得失来选择信仰是合理的。
description.en: Proposed the 'Pascal's Wager' argument, pioneering religious voluntarism, which posits that it is rational to choose faith based on a cost-benefit analysis when reason is inconclusive.

description.zh-cn: 作为宗教意志论的代表，他主张在面对“真正的抉择”时，信仰的意志和带来的实际好处是做出选择的合法依据。
description.en: As a representative of religious voluntarism, he argued that when faced with a 'genuine option', the will to believe and the practical benefits it brings are legitimate grounds for making a choice.

description.zh-cn: 在清末民初，康有为试图仿效西方基督教国家，将儒家思想改造为“孔教”，并争取将其立为国教。
description.en: In the late Qing and early Republican era, Kang Youwei attempted to transform Confucianism into a 'Confucian Religion' and campaigned to establish it as the state religion, modeling it after Christianity in Western nations.

description.zh-cn: 作为新文化运动的领袖之一，陈独秀等反孔力量强烈反对康有为将孔教立为国教的企图。
description.en: As a leader of the New Culture Movement, Chen Duxiu and other anti-Confucian forces strongly opposed Kang Youwei's attempt to establish Confucianism as the state religion.

description.zh-cn: 在是否将孔教立为国教的问题上，康有为代表的支持方与陈独秀代表的反对方形成了尖锐的政治和思想对立。
description.en: On the issue of establishing Confucianism as the state religion, Kang Youwei, representing the proponents, and Chen Duxiu, representing the opponents, were in sharp political and ideological opposition.

description.zh-cn: 梅葆玖是梅兰芳的第五子。
description.en: Mei Baojiu was the fifth son of Mei Lanfang.

description.zh-cn: 1924年，梅兰芳拜师齐白石学画工虫。
description.en: In 1924, Mei Lanfang became a student of Qi Baishi to learn insect painting.

description.zh-cn: 齐如山是梅兰芳的良师益友。
description.en: Qi Rushan was a good teacher and helpful friend to Mei Lanfang.

description.zh-cn: 1920年，由齐如山介绍，梅兰芳与齐白石相识，后结为师友。
description.en: In 1920, introduced by Qi Rushan, Mei Lanfang met Qi Baishi, and they later became teacher and friend.

description.zh-cn: 梅兰芳得到中共领导人毛泽东的赏识，毛泽东甚至称呼他为“梅老板”。
description.en: Mei Lanfang was admired by the Communist Party leader Mao Zedong, who even addressed him as "Boss Mei".

description.zh-cn: 梅兰芳拒绝为汪精卫政府演出，并蓄须明志，导致在此期间经济来源断绝。
description.en: Mei Lanfang refused to perform for the Wang Jingwei government and grew a beard to show his resolve, which cut off his source of income during this period.

description.zh-cn: 1945年日本投降后，梅兰芳于10月重出舞台。
description.en: After Japan's surrender in 1945, Mei Lanfang returned to the stage in October.

description.zh-cn: 以蒙哥为养子，并由其皇后昂灰抚育长大。
description.en: Adopted Möngke as his son, and had his queen Anghui raise him.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥是蒙古帝国第四任大汗。
description.en: Möngke was the fourth Great Khan of the Mongol Empire.

description.zh-cn: 以长支宗王的身份召集忽里台，极力称赞并推举蒙哥为大汗。
description.en: As the senior prince, he convened a Kurultai and strongly praised and nominated Möngke to be the Great Khan.

description.zh-cn: 奉其兄拔都之命，率大军随同蒙哥前往斡难河畔召开忽里台，以武力确保蒙哥顺利登基。
description.en: Under his brother Batu's order, he led a large army to accompany Möngke to the Kurultai on the Onon River, ensuring his successful enthronement with military force.

description.zh-cn: 命其子蒙哥应召参与拔都召开的忽里台，并利用其威望笼络多数宗王大臣支持蒙哥登基。
description.en: She ordered her son Möngke to attend the Kurultai convened by Batu and used her prestige to persuade the majority of princes and ministers to support Möngke's enthronement.

description.zh-cn: 钦淑皇后作为窝阔台系的代表反对蒙哥即位，在蒙哥巩固汗位时被其母唆鲁禾帖尼下令处死。
description.en: As a representative of the Ögedeid line, Oghul Qaimish opposed Möngke's accession and was executed by order of Möngke's mother Sorghaghtani while Möngke was consolidating his power.

description.zh-cn: 为了巩固其子蒙哥的汗位，亲自下令处死反对者贵由汗的皇后斡兀立海迷失。
description.en: To consolidate her son Möngke's throne, she personally ordered the execution of the opponent Oghul Qaimish, the empress of Güyük Khan.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥年轻时参与第二次蒙古西征，征讨钦察、斡罗思等地，屡立战功。
description.en: In his youth, Möngke participated in the second Mongol invasion of the West, campaigning against the Kipchaks and Rus', and repeatedly achieved military merit.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次蒙古西征期间，于里海附近活捉钦察首领八赤蛮。
description.en: During the second Mongol invasion of the West, he captured the Kipchak leader Bachman alive near the Caspian Sea.

description.zh-cn: 任命其弟忽必烈统领漠南汉地军政事务，并命其南征大理国。
description.en: Appointed his younger brother Kublai to oversee military and political affairs in Northern China and ordered him to conquer the Dali Kingdom to the south.

description.zh-cn: 奉蒙哥之命率军南征，攻克大理城，灭亡大理国。
description.en: Under Möngke's order, he led an army south, captured the city of Dali, and destroyed the Dali Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 命令其弟旭烈兀率领大军西征。
description.en: Ordered his younger brother Hulagu to lead a large army to the west.

description.zh-cn: 旭烈兀西征军于1256年攻灭位于波斯西部的木剌夷国（阿萨辛派）。
description.en: Hulagu's expeditionary army destroyed the Nizari Ismaili state (Assassins) in western Persia in 1256.

description.zh-cn: 旭烈兀西征军于1258年攻陷巴格达，灭亡阿拔斯王朝。
description.en: Hulagu's expeditionary army captured Baghdad in 1258, destroying the Abbasid Caliphate.

description.zh-cn: 旭烈兀西征军于1260年攻占叙利亚，灭亡阿尤布王朝。
description.en: Hulagu's expeditionary army captured Syria in 1260, destroying the Ayyubid dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 因蒙哥去世，旭烈兀东返途中留在西亚自成一方，建立了伊儿汗国。
description.en: Due to Möngke's death, Hulagu remained in West Asia during his return journey and established the Ilkhanate.

description.zh-cn: 1258年，蒙哥亲率主力大举进攻南宋四川地区。
description.en: In 1258, Möngke personally led the main army in a major invasion of the Sichuan region of the Southern Song.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥亲率的蒙古大军在钓鱼城下受阻数月，蒙哥本人最终在此役中身亡。
description.en: The Mongol army personally led by Möngke was bogged down at Diaoyu Fortress for several months, and Möngke himself eventually died during this battle.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥在钓鱼城之战中去世，直接引发了其弟忽必烈与阿里不哥之间争夺汗位的内战。
description.en: Möngke's death during the Battle of Diaoyu Fortress directly triggered a civil war for the succession to the khanship between his younger brothers Kublai and Ariq Böke.

description.zh-cn: 这场内战标志着蒙古帝国走向分裂，各汗国开始独立发展。
description.en: This civil war marked the beginning of the fragmentation of the Mongol Empire, as the various khanates began to develop independently.

description.zh-cn: 派遣传教士卢布鲁克前往东方觐见蒙古大汗。
description.en: Dispatched the missionary William of Rubruck to the East for an audience with the Great Khan of the Mongols.

description.zh-cn: 法国国王路易九世派遣的传教士卢布鲁克到达蒙哥的营地并觐见了他。
description.en: The missionary William of Rubruck, sent by King Louis IX of France, arrived at Möngke's camp and had an audience with him.

description.zh-cn: 作为蒙古的属国国王，海屯一世前往哈拉和林朝见蒙哥。
description.en: As the king of a Mongol vassal state, Hethum I traveled to Karakorum for an audience with Möngke.

description.zh-cn: 小亚美尼亚王国于1244年归附大蒙古国，成为其属国。
description.en: The Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia submitted to the Mongol Empire in 1244, becoming its vassal state.

description.zh-cn: 元朝建立后，忽必烈追尊蒙哥庙号为宪宗，谥号为桓肃皇帝。
description.en: After the establishment of the Yuan Dynasty, Kublai Khan posthumously honored Möngke with the temple name Xianzong and the posthumous title Emperor Huansu.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军第七十三集团军隶属于东部战区陆军。
description.en: The PLA 73rd Group Army is subordinate to the Eastern Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 丁来富自2022年4月起担任中国人民解放军陆军第七十三集团军军长。
description.en: Ding Laifu has served as the commander of the PLA 73rd Group Army since April 2022.

description.zh-cn: 在深化国防和军队改革中，以原陆军第三十一集团军为基础，调整组建为中国人民解放军陆军第七十三集团军。
description.en: During the deepening of national defense and military reform, the 73rd Group Army was formed based on the former 31st Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军第三十一军由华东野战军第13纵队于1949年2月改编而成。
description.en: The PLA 31st Corps was reorganized from the 13th Column of the East China Field Army in February 1949.

description.zh-cn: 1949年改编后，第三十一军隶属于第三野战军第十兵团。
description.en: After its reorganization in 1949, the 31st Corps was subordinate to the 10th Army Group of the Third Field Army.

description.zh-cn: 周志坚担任中国人民解放军第三十一军首任军长。
description.en: Zhou Zhijian served as the first commander of the PLA 31st Corps.

description.zh-cn: 陈华堂担任中国人民解放军第三十一军首任政治委员。
description.en: Chen Huatang served as the first political commissar of the PLA 31st Corps.

description.zh-cn: 华东野战军第13纵队（第三十一军前身）参加了济南战役。
description.en: The 13th Column of the East China Field Army (predecessor of the 31st Corps) participated in the Jinan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 华东野战军第13纵队（第三十一军前身）参加了淮海战役。
description.en: The 13th Column of the East China Field Army (predecessor of the 31st Corps) participated in the Huaihai Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军第三十一军参加了渡江战役。
description.en: The PLA 31st Corps participated in the Yangtze River Crossing Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军第三十一军参加了上海战役。
description.en: The PLA 31st Corps participated in the Shanghai Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 胡中强担任中国人民解放军陆军第七十三集团军首任军长。
description.en: Hu Zhongqiang served as the first commander of the PLA 73rd Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 杨诚担任中国人民解放军陆军第七十三集团军首任政治委员。
description.en: Yang Cheng served as the first political commissar of the PLA 73rd Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 丁来富接替胡中强担任中国人民解放军陆军第七十三集团军军长。
description.en: Ding Laifu succeeded Hu Zhongqiang as the commander of the PLA 73rd Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 朱利安·阿桑奇于2006年创建了揭密网站维基解密，并担任其首席编辑与发言人。
description.en: Julian Assange founded the whistle-blowing website WikiLeaks in 2006 and served as its editor-in-chief and spokesperson.

description.zh-cn: 朱利安·阿桑奇是维基解密的核心人物，担任首席编辑与主要发言人。
description.en: Julian Assange is the central figure of WikiLeaks, serving as its editor-in-chief and primary spokesperson.

description.zh-cn: 2010年，时任美国陆军情报分析员的切尔西·曼宁向维基解密提供了一系列机密文件，引发国际关注。
description.en: In 2010, Chelsea Manning, then a U.S. Army intelligence analyst, provided a series of classified documents to WikiLeaks, sparking international attention.

description.zh-cn: 在维基解密公布机密文件后，美国政府对阿桑奇展开了长期的刑事调查，并以违反《间谍法》等多项罪名起诉他，寻求将其引渡至美国。
description.en: After WikiLeaks published classified documents, the U.S. government launched a long-term criminal investigation against Assange, indicting him on multiple charges including violations of the Espionage Act and seeking his extradition.

description.zh-cn: 瑞典检方以涉嫌性犯罪为由对阿桑奇展开调查并寻求引渡，该调查最终于2019年11月中止。
description.en: Swedish prosecutors initiated an investigation and sought the extradition of Assange on allegations of sexual offenses, an investigation that was ultimately dropped in November 2019.

description.zh-cn: 时任厄瓜多尔总统利宁·莫雷诺以阿桑奇违反庇护条款为由，撤销了对他的政治庇护，并允许英国警方进入大使馆将其逮捕。
description.en: Then-President of Ecuador, Lenín Moreno, revoked Assange's political asylum, citing violations of his asylum conditions, and permitted British police to enter the embassy to arrest him.

description.zh-cn: 在厄瓜多尔政府撤销庇护后，伦敦警察厅于2019年4月11日进入厄瓜多尔大使馆逮捕了朱利安·阿桑奇。
description.en: After the Ecuadorian government revoked his asylum, the Metropolitan Police entered the Ecuadorian embassy on April 11, 2019, and arrested Julian Assange.

description.zh-cn: 朱利安·阿桑奇与他的律师史黛拉·亚桑杰于2015年开始交往，并于2022年3月23日在贝尔马什监狱结婚。他们育有两个儿子。
description.en: Julian Assange began a relationship with his lawyer, Stella, in 2015, and they married in Belmarsh Prison on March 23, 2022. They have two sons together.

description.zh-cn: 据雅虎新闻报道，在维基解密发布“七号保险库”文件后，时任中情局局长迈克·蓬佩奥领导下的中情局曾讨论绑架甚至暗杀在厄瓜多尔大使馆的阿桑奇。
description.en: According to Yahoo News, after WikiLeaks published the 'Vault 7' documents, the CIA, under then-Director Mike Pompeo, discussed kidnapping and even assassinating Assange while he was in the Ecuadorian embassy.

description.zh-cn: 美国政府利用《1917年间谍法》对朱利安·阿桑奇提出多项刑事指控。
description.en: The U.S. government used the Espionage Act of 1917 to bring multiple criminal charges against Julian Assange.

description.zh-cn: 2003年至2006年间，朱利安·阿桑奇在墨尔本大学学习物理与数学，但未完成学位。
description.en: From 2003 to 2006, Julian Assange studied physics and mathematics at the University of Melbourne but did not complete his degree.

description.zh-cn: 1949年至1971年间，由于冷战格局，中美处于全面敌对状态。美国承认退守台湾的中华民国政府，并在朝鲜战争中与中国直接交战。
description.en: From 1949 to 1971, due to the Cold War structure, China and the U.S. were in a state of comprehensive hostility. The U.S. recognized the Republic of China government in Taiwan and directly fought against China in the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争爆发后，中国共产党对美国发表的《中美关系白皮书》反应强烈，毛泽东连续撰文批判，双方关系急速恶化。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Korean War, the Chinese Communist Party reacted strongly to the US 'China White Paper', with Mao Zedong writing successive articles of criticism, leading to a rapid deterioration in relations.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争的爆发，使得中美建立外交关系的可能性破灭，美国派遣第七舰队巡逻台湾海峡。
description.en: The outbreak of the Korean War shattered the possibility of establishing diplomatic relations between China and the US, and the US dispatched the Seventh Fleet to patrol the Taiwan Strait.

description.zh-cn: 中国在北越的存在，使得美国林登·约翰逊政府因害怕重演朝鲜战争，排除了对北越进行地面入侵的可能性。
description.en: China's presence in North Vietnam made the administration of US President Lyndon B. Johnson rule out the possibility of a ground invasion of North Vietnam, fearing a repeat of the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 通过“乒乓外交”事件，中美关系实现历史性突破，为关系正常化铺平了道路。
description.en: Through the 'Ping-pong diplomacy' event, China-US relations achieved a historic breakthrough, paving the way for normalization.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国国家安全顾问的基辛格对北京进行了一次秘密访问，为尼克松访华做准备。
description.en: Then-U.S. National Security Advisor Kissinger made a secret visit to Beijing to prepare for President Nixon's visit.

description.zh-cn: 尼克松访华期间，中美双方签署了《上海公报》，承诺为外交关系完全正常化努力。
description.en: During Nixon's visit to China, the two sides signed the Shanghai Communiqué, committing to work towards the complete normalization of diplomatic relations.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件后，美国对中国实施了多项经济制裁，并停止了高层和官方的交流，使中美关系坠入低谷。
description.en: After the Tiananmen Square incident, the United States imposed multiple economic sanctions on China and suspended high-level and official exchanges, causing Sino-US relations to hit a low point.

description.zh-cn: 911袭击事件后，美国不再将中国看作是最大的潜在威胁，转而注重中东局势以及恐怖主义威胁，并寻求与中国在反恐方面进行合作。
description.en: After the 9/11 attacks, the U.S. no longer viewed China as its greatest potential threat, shifting its focus to the situation in the Middle East and the threat of terrorism, and sought cooperation with China on counter-terrorism.

description.zh-cn: 911袭击发生当晚，江泽民致电美国总统小布希表示同情。一个月后，小布什总统访华。
description.en: On the evening of the 9/11 attacks, Jiang Zemin called U.S. President George W. Bush to express his condolences. A month later, President Bush visited China.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统奥巴马提出的“亚太再平衡”战略，旨在应对中国经济和军事力量的持续增加。
description.en: The 'Pivot to Asia' strategy proposed by U.S. President Obama was aimed at responding to the continuous increase in China's economic and military power.

description.zh-cn: 特朗普政府正式对中国进口钢铁和铝产品征收关税，并采取措施限制中国投资，引发了中美贸易战。
description.en: The Trump administration officially imposed tariffs on imported steel and aluminum products from China and took measures to restrict Chinese investment, triggering the US-China trade war.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国副总统彭斯发表演说，全面抨击中国的内外政策，宣告美国以往的对华接触政策已经失败。
description.en: Then-US Vice President Pence delivered a speech comprehensively criticizing China's domestic and foreign policies, declaring the failure of the United States' past engagement policy towards China.

description.zh-cn: 作为对美国关闭中国驻休斯敦总领馆的对等反制，中国于2020年7月24日宣布撤销美国驻成都总领事馆的设立和运行许可。
description.en: As a reciprocal countermeasure to the U.S. closure of the Chinese consulate in Houston, China announced on July 24, 2020, the revocation of the establishment and operation license for the U.S. consulate in Chengdu.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国国务卿蓬佩奥发表演说《共产中国与自由世界的未来》，呼吁改变中国威胁自由世界的行为，被认为是开启新冷战的“铁幕演讲”。
description.en: Then-US Secretary of State Pompeo delivered the speech 'Communist China and the Free World's Future,' calling for a change in China's behavior that threatens the free world, which is considered an 'Iron Curtain' speech marking the beginning of a new Cold War.

description.zh-cn: “高空气球事件”导致美国国务卿布林肯取消原定的访华行程，使双边关系进一步紧张。
description.en: The 'high-altitude balloon incident' caused U.S. Secretary of State Blinken to cancel his planned visit to China, further tensing bilateral relations.

description.zh-cn: 美国财政部长耶伦多次访问中国，与中方经济团队会谈，旨在稳定两国经济关系，并沟通美方对中国“产能过剩”等问题的关切。
description.en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Yellen visited China multiple times for talks with the Chinese economic team, aiming to stabilize bilateral economic relations and communicate U.S. concerns about issues such as China's 'overcapacity'.

description.zh-cn: 美国国务卿布林肯在2023年6月和2024年4月两度访华，并与中国国家主席习近平会面，进行“坦诚、实质性和建设性的会谈”。
description.en: U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken visited China twice, in June 2023 and April 2024, and met with Chinese President Xi Jinping for 'candid, substantive, and constructive talks'.

position.zh-cn: 警务局长；内务总长；主席；国务委员会主席
position.en: Chief of Police Affairs Bureau; Minister of Home Affairs; President; Chairman of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 金九在不同时期担任大韩民国临时政府的多个要职，并长期是其实际领导人。
description.en: Kim Gu held several key positions in the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea at different times and was its de facto leader for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 金九接替洪震成为大韩民国临时政府主席。
description.en: Kim Gu succeeded Hong Jin as the President of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 李东宁接替金九成为大韩民国临时政府主席，后金九又接替李东宁成为主席。
description.en: Yi Dong-nyeong succeeded Kim Gu as the President of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea, and later Kim Gu succeeded Yi Dong-nyeong as Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 李承晚接替金九成为大韩民国临时政府主席。
description.en: Syngman Rhee succeeded Kim Gu as the President of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 三一运动爆发后，金九流亡中国，参与筹建大韩民国临时政府。
description.en: After the outbreak of the March 1st Movement, Kim Gu went into exile in China and participated in the establishment of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 在李东宁的劝说下，金九出任大韩民国临时政府国务领。
description.en: At the persuasion of Yi Dong-nyeong, Kim Gu took office as the State Councillor of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 金九领导的大韩民国临时政府与蒋中正领导的中华民国国民政府保持着良好的关系，并获得了其支持。
description.en: The Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea led by Kim Gu maintained a good relationship with the Nationalist Government of the Republic of China led by Chiang Kai-shek and received its support.

description.zh-cn: 金九与中国共产党保持着良好的关系。
description.en: Kim Gu maintained a good relationship with the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 美国军政府不承认大韩民国临时政府的合法性，并对金九等临时政府人员回国一事进行了封锁。
description.en: The U.S. Military Government did not recognize the legitimacy of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea and blocked the return of its members, including Kim Gu.

description.zh-cn: 美军政府在朝鲜半岛南部扶持李承晚建立亲美政权。
description.en: The U.S. Military Government supported Syngman Rhee in establishing a pro-American regime in the southern Korean Peninsula.

description.zh-cn: 金九与金日成在平壤举行的“四月南北联席会议”上会面，商讨南北统一问题。
description.en: Kim Gu and Kim Il-sung met at the 'April Joint Conference of North and South' in Pyongyang to discuss the issue of Korean unification.

description.zh-cn: 时任韩国宪兵司令张兴在其自传中称，安斗熙是受时任国防部长官申性模的指示暗杀金九的。
description.en: According to the autobiography of Jang Heung, then commander of the Korean Military Police, Ahn Doo-hee assassinated Kim Gu under the orders of then Minister of National Defense Shin Sung-mo.

description.zh-cn: 朴正熙政府追授金九大韩民国建国勋章，并追尊其为韩国国父。
description.en: The Park Chung-hee government posthumously awarded Kim Gu the Order of Merit for National Foundation and honored him as the Father of the Nation.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国中央人民委员会追授金九祖国统一奖，以肯定他对南北统一的努力。
description.en: The Central People's Committee of the DPRK posthumously awarded Kim Gu the National Reunification Prize in recognition of his efforts for the unification of North and South Korea.

description.zh-cn: 考虑到金九是为国母报仇，朝鲜高宗在其死刑执行前特赦了他。
description.en: Considering that Kim Gu had acted to avenge the nation's mother, Emperor Gojong granted him a special pardon before his death sentence was carried out.

description.zh-cn: 金九多次被日本当局逮捕入狱，包括因安重根事件和安明根事件。
description.en: Kim Gu was arrested and imprisoned by Japanese authorities multiple times, including in connection with the An Jung-geun incident and the An Myeong-geun incident.

description.zh-cn: 九一八事变后，为开辟新的斗争方式，金九成立了韩人爱国团敢死队。
description.en: After the Mukden Incident, to open up new methods of struggle, Kim Gu established the Korean Patriotic Corps, a commando unit.

description.zh-cn: 李奉昌在东京樱田门向裕仁天皇投掷手榴弹，但未成功。
description.en: Lee Bong-chang threw a hand grenade at Emperor Hirohito at the Sakuradamon Gate in Tokyo, but the attempt failed.

description.zh-cn: 尹奉吉在上海虹口公园用炸弹炸死了日本上海派遣军司令白川义则大将。
description.en: Yun Bong-gil killed General Yoshinori Shirakawa, commander of the Shanghai Expeditionary Army, with a bomb in Shanghai's Hongkou Park.

description.zh-cn: 尹奉吉在上海虹口公园用炸弹炸死了上海日本居留民团团长河端贞次。
description.en: Yun Bong-gil killed Kawabata Sadatsugu, head of the Japanese Residents' Association in Shanghai, with a bomb in Shanghai's Hongkou Park.

description.zh-cn: 虹口公园爆炸事件后，蒋中正政府开始大力支持金九领导的韩国独立运动。
description.en: After the Hongkou Park bombing, the Chiang Kai-shek government began to strongly support the Korean independence movement led by Kim Gu.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正秘密会见金九，并同意在中央陆军军官学校洛阳分校为韩国独立运动培养军事人才。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek met secretly with Kim Gu and agreed to train military personnel for the Korean independence movement at the Luoyang branch of the Central Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 韩国光复军是在中国国民党的支持下于重庆成立的。
description.en: The Korean Liberation Army was established in Chongqing with the support of the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 在金九回国前，周恩来等中共政要为其举行了送别宴会。
description.en: Before Kim Gu returned to Korea, CCP dignitaries including Zhou Enlai held a farewell banquet for him.

description.zh-cn: 施南生曾就读于玛利诺修院学校的小学部和中学部。
description.en: Nansun Shi attended the primary and secondary sections of Maryknoll Convent School.

description.zh-cn: 施南生于70年代在无线电视担任制作及行政职位。
description.en: Nansun Shi worked in production and administration at TVB during the 1970s.

description.zh-cn: 施南生于70年代在香港电台担任制作及行政职位。
description.en: Nansun Shi worked in production and administration at RTHK during the 1970s.

description.zh-cn: 施南生于70年代在佳视担任制作及行政职位。
description.en: Nansun Shi worked in production and administration at Commercial Television during the 1970s.

description.zh-cn: 施南生于70年代在丽的（亚洲电视）担任制作及行政职位。
description.en: Nansun Shi worked in production and administration at Rediffusion Television (ATV) during the 1970s.

description.zh-cn: 施南生于80年代在新艺城工作，并为港产片开创了黄金时代。
description.en: Nansun Shi worked at Cinema City during the 1980s, helping to create the golden age of Hong Kong cinema.

description.zh-cn: 施南生曾协助香港有线电视开创业务。
description.en: Nansun Shi assisted in the establishment of Hong Kong Cable Television.

description.zh-cn: 施南生曾协助传讯开创收费电视业务。
description.en: Nansun Shi assisted in the establishment of the pay television business for Chinese Television Network.

description.zh-cn: 施南生曾协助电讯盈科开创收费电视业务。
description.en: Nansun Shi assisted in the establishment of the pay television business for PCCW.

description.zh-cn: 施南生于1951年8月8日出生于英属香港。
description.en: Nansun Shi was born in British Hong Kong on August 8, 1951.

description.zh-cn: 在第43届香港电影金像奖上，施南生获颁终身成就奖，以表扬其对香港电影的重大贡献。
description.en: At the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards, Nansun Shi was awarded the Lifetime Achievement Award in recognition of her significant contributions to Hong Kong cinema.

description.zh-cn: 林青霞在第43届香港电影金像奖上为施南生颁发终身成就奖。
description.en: Brigitte Lin presented the Lifetime Achievement Award to Nansun Shi at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards.

description.zh-cn: 在第67届柏林影展上，施南生获得金摄影奖（Berlinale Camera）。
description.en: At the 67th Berlin International Film Festival, Nansun Shi received the Berlinale Camera award.

description.zh-cn: 2012年，施南生加入凤凰卫视香港台担任政论节目主持人。
description.en: In 2012, Nansun Shi joined Phoenix Hong Kong Channel as a host for a political talk show.

description.zh-cn: 林智坚是民主进步党党员，并曾担任党内多项职务。
description.en: Lin Chih-chien is a member of the Democratic Progressive Party and has held several positions within the party.

description.zh-cn: 在从政初期，林智坚曾担任立法委员柯建铭的助理长达九年，柯建铭亦被其视为政治启蒙导师。
description.en: In his early political career, Lin Chih-chien served as an assistant to Legislator Ker Chien-ming for nine years, and he regards Ker as his political mentor.

description.zh-cn: 在2014年林智坚竞选新竹市市长时，苏贞昌为其提供指导并出借选举团队协助辅选。
description.en: During Lin Chih-chien's 2014 campaign for mayor of Hsinchu, Su Tseng-chang provided guidance and lent his campaign team to assist in the election.

description.zh-cn: 时任民进党主席的蔡英文在2014年新竹市长选举中为林智坚授旗站台，宣示民进党启动世代接班，表示对其支持。
description.en: Then-DPP Chairperson Tsai Ing-wen endorsed Lin Chih-chien during the 2014 Hsinchu mayoral election, symbolizing the party's generational shift and showing her support.

description.zh-cn: 林智坚于2010年至2014年担任新竹市议会第八届议员。
description.en: Lin Chih-chien served as a member of the 8th Hsinchu City Council from 2010 to 2014.

description.zh-cn: 林智坚于2014年至2022年担任两届新竹市市长。
description.en: Lin Chih-chien served two terms as the Mayor of Hsinchu City from 2014 to 2022.

description.zh-cn: 林智坚在2014年和2018年两次新竹市市长选举中，均与寻求（再次）当选的许明财为主要竞争对手。
description.en: In both the 2014 and 2018 Hsinchu mayoral elections, Lin Chih-chien was the main competitor against Hsu Ming-tsai, who was seeking election (and re-election).

description.zh-cn: 在2014年新竹市市长选举中，同属泛绿阵营的蔡仁坚脱党参选，与代表民进党参选的林智坚形成三强鼎立的竞争局面。
description.en: In the 2014 Hsinchu mayoral election, Tsai Jen-chien, also from the Pan-Green Coalition, ran as an independent, creating a three-way competitive race against the DPP's candidate, Lin Chih-chien.

description.zh-cn: 国立台湾大学认定林智坚的国家发展研究所硕士论文构成严重抄袭，宣布撤销其硕士学位。
description.en: National Taiwan University determined that Lin Chih-chien's master's thesis from the Graduate Institute of National Development constituted serious plagiarism and announced the revocation of his master's degree.

description.zh-cn: 中华大学认定林智坚的科技管理研究所硕士论文存在抄袭且情节重大，宣布撤销其硕士学位。
description.en: Chung Hua University determined that Lin Chih-chien's master's thesis from the Graduate Institute of Technology Management involved significant plagiarism and announced the revocation of his master's degree.

description.zh-cn: 受硕士学位论文争议的影响，林智坚于2022年8月12日宣布退出桃园市市长选举。
description.en: Influenced by the controversy over his master's theses, Lin Chih-chien announced his withdrawal from the Taoyuan mayoral election on August 12, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 林智坚因论文案退选后，民主进步党推举郑运鹏接替其参选桃园市市长。
description.en: After Lin Chih-chien withdrew from the election due to the plagiarism scandal, the Democratic Progressive Party nominated Cheng Yun-peng to run for mayor of Taoyuan in his place.

description.zh-cn: 2024年，三立董事长张荣华延揽林智坚至旗下永兴资本公司担任总经理，助其由政转商。
description.en: In 2024, Sanlih Chairman Chang Jung-hua recruited Lin Chih-chien to serve as general manager of its subsidiary Yong-Xing Capital, facilitating his transition from politics to business.

description.zh-cn: 林智坚在中华大学夜间部完成学业，取得企业管理学系学士学位。
description.en: Lin Chih-chien completed his studies in the evening division of Chung Hua University, earning a bachelor's degree in Business Administration.

description.zh-cn: 林智坚出生于新竹市香山区。
description.en: Lin Chih-chien was born in Xiangshan District, Hsinchu City.

description.zh-cn: 九届二中全会上毛泽东与林彪的矛盾公开化，直接导致了林彪集团政治地位的垮台和最终的九一三事件。
description.en: The publicization of the conflict between Mao Zedong and Lin Biao at the Second Plenary Session of the 9th Central Committee directly led to the downfall of the Lin Biao clique's political status and the eventual Lin Biao Incident.

description.zh-cn: 九届二中全会结束后，毛泽东立即发起了批陈整风运动，以清算陈伯达及林彪集团在会议上的行为。
description.en: Immediately after the Second Plenary Session of the 9th Central Committee, Mao Zedong launched the 'Criticize Chen and Rectify Work Style' campaign to address the actions of Chen Boda and the Lin Biao clique during the meeting.

description.zh-cn: 在九届二中全会华北组讨论中，陈伯达带头对张春桥进行批判，指责有人反对毛主席和毛泽东思想。
description.en: During the North China group discussion at the Second Plenary Session of the 9th Central Committee, Chen Boda led the criticism against Zhang Chunqiao, accusing some people of opposing Chairman Mao and Mao Zedong Thought.

description.zh-cn: 在九届二中全会前夕及会议期间，以林彪、陈伯达为首的派别和以江青、张春桥为首的派别就宪法草案等问题发生激烈斗争，矛盾激化。
description.en: On the eve of and during the Second Plenary Session of the 9th Central Committee, the faction led by Lin Biao and Chen Boda and the faction led by Jiang Qing and Zhang Chunqiao engaged in a fierce struggle over issues such as the draft constitution, leading to an intensification of their conflict.

description.zh-cn: 叶群是林彪的妻子。
description.en: Ye Qun was the wife of Lin Biao.

description.zh-cn: 吴法宪是林彪集团的主要成员。
description.en: Wu Faxian was a key member of the Lin Biao clique.

description.zh-cn: 叶群是林彪集团的核心成员。
description.en: Ye Qun was a core member of the Lin Biao clique.

description.zh-cn: 黄永胜是林彪集团的主要成员。
description.en: Huang Yongsheng was a key member of the Lin Biao clique.

description.zh-cn: 李作鹏是林彪集团的主要成员。
description.en: Li Zuopeng was a key member of the Lin Biao clique.

description.zh-cn: 邱会作是林彪集团的主要成员。
description.en: Qiu Huizuo was a key member of the Lin Biao clique.

description.zh-cn: 整风运动的主要目标是清算以王明为代表的国际派（教条主义）路线，削弱其在党内的影响。
description.en: The main objective of the Rectification Movement was to purge the Internationalist Faction (dogmatism) line represented by Wang Ming and weaken his influence within the party.

description.zh-cn: 整风运动清算了以王明、博古为代表的国际派路线。
description.en: The Rectification Movement purged the Internationalist Faction line represented by Wang Ming and Bo Gu.

description.zh-cn: 整风运动通过批判教条主义，打击并清算了在中共党内以王明为首的国际派。
description.en: By criticizing dogmatism, the Rectification Movement targeted and purged the Internationalist Faction led by Wang Ming within the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 整风运动强调马克思主义中国化，旨在摆脱共产国际对中国共产党的领导和思想束缚。
description.en: The Rectification Movement emphasized the Sinicization of Marxism, aiming to break free from the leadership and ideological constraints of the Comintern on the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 许多学者认为，延安整风运动是毛泽东个人崇拜的开端。
description.en: Many scholars consider the Yan'an Rectification Movement to be the beginning of the personality cult of Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 1941年苏德战争爆发，使苏联和共产国际无暇经营中共事务，为毛泽东发动整风运动、摆脱苏联控制提供了时机。
description.en: The outbreak of the Soviet-German War in 1941 left the Soviet Union and the Comintern unable to manage CCP affairs, providing Mao Zedong with an opportunity to launch the Rectification Movement and break free from Soviet control.

description.zh-cn: 在整风运动后期的高级干部整风中，周恩来因其与国际派的关联而被迫进行检讨认错。
description.en: During the rectification of high-ranking cadres in the later stage of the movement, Zhou Enlai was forced to make a self-criticism and admit his mistakes due to his association with the Internationalist Faction.

description.zh-cn: 在整风运动后期的高级干部整风中，彭德怀被迫进行检讨认错。
description.en: During the rectification of high-ranking cadres in the later stage of the movement, Peng Dehuai was forced to make a self-criticism and admit his mistakes.

description.zh-cn: 季米特洛夫致电毛泽东，批评康生在整风运动中的做法扭曲了正确的党内措施，要求加以纠正。
description.en: Dimitrov sent a telegram to Mao Zedong, criticizing Kang Sheng's methods in the Rectification Movement for distorting correct intra-party measures and demanded corrections.

description.zh-cn: 在其致毛泽东的电报中，季米特洛夫特别要求保护王明。
description.en: In his telegram to Mao Zedong, Dimitrov specifically requested the protection of Wang Ming.

description.zh-cn: 在其致毛泽东的电报中，季米特洛夫特别要求保护周恩来。
description.en: In his telegram to Mao Zedong, Dimitrov specifically requested the protection of Zhou Enlai.

description.zh-cn: 整风运动中形成的斗争手段和思想控制模式，为后来的文化大革命等政治运动提供了范本。
description.en: The struggle tactics and ideological control models formed during the Rectification Movement provided a template for later political campaigns such as the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 整风运动中形成的斗争手段和思想控制模式，在后来的反右运动中被重复运用。
description.en: The struggle tactics and ideological control models formed during the Rectification Movement were repeatedly applied in the later Anti-Rightist Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 整风运动中形成的“延安精神”取代了五四运动所倡导的自由、民主和个性解放精神。
description.en: The 'Yan'an Spirit' formed during the Rectification Movement replaced the spirit of freedom, democracy, and individual liberation advocated by the May Fourth Movement.

description.zh-cn: 在1943年3月的中共中央政治局扩大会议上，总书记的设置被取消，代之以党主席。
description.en: At the enlarged Politburo meeting in March 1943, the position of General Secretary was abolished and replaced by that of Party Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 整风运动促成了中共领导体制的改变，于1943年3月设立了党主席一职，由毛泽东担任。
description.en: The Rectification Movement led to a change in the CCP's leadership structure, establishing the position of Party Chairman in March 1943, which was assumed by Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 作为整风前的名义最高领导人（总书记），张闻天的职位在运动中被取消，从而失去了其领导地位。
description.en: As the nominal top leader (General Secretary) before the rectification, Zhang Wentian's position was abolished during the movement, causing him to lose his leadership role.

description.zh-cn: 在整风学习文件中，该著作被指为是毛泽东思想最重要的基础理论著作。
description.en: In the rectification study documents, this work was identified as the most important foundational theoretical work of Mao Zedong Thought.

description.zh-cn: 1948年12月1日，以华北银行为基础，合并北海银行和西北农民银行组建中国人民银行。
description.en: On December 1, 1948, the People's Bank of China was established based on Huabei Bank, through the merger of Beihai Bank and Northwest Farmers Bank.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民银行是中华人民共和国国务院的组成部门之一。
description.en: The People's Bank of China is one of the constituent departments of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民银行是国务院组成部门之一。
description.en: The People's Bank of China is one of the constituent departments of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民银行的前身是中华苏维埃共和国国家银行。
description.en: The predecessor of the People's Bank of China was the National Bank of the Chinese Soviet Republic.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党于1931年在中华苏维埃共和国成立了中华苏维埃共和国国家银行。
description.en: The Communist Party of China established the National Bank of the Chinese Soviet Republic in the Chinese Soviet Republic in 1931.

description.zh-cn: 根据董必武的提议，中共中央于1947年10月决定筹备建立中国人民银行。
description.en: Based on the proposal of Dong Biwu, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China decided in October 1947 to prepare for the establishment of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 2003年，中国人民银行对银行、金融资产管理公司、信托投资公司及其他存款类金融机构的监管职能被分离出来，成立了中国银行业监督管理委员会。
description.en: In 2003, the regulatory functions of the People's Bank of China over banks, financial asset management companies, trust and investment companies, and other deposit-taking financial institutions were separated to establish the China Banking Regulatory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 国务院金融稳定发展委员会办公室曾设在中国人民银行，并接受其直接领导。
description.en: The office of the State Council's Financial Stability and Development Committee was located in the People's Bank of China and was under its direct leadership.

description.zh-cn: 根据2023年《党和国家机构改革方案》，原国务院金融稳定发展委员会办公室职责划入中央金融委员会办公室。
description.en: According to the 2023 'Plan for the Reform of Party and State Institutions', the responsibilities of the former office of the State Council's Financial Stability and Development Committee were transferred to the office of the Central Financial Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命初期去职。
description.en: Left office in the early stages of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 国家外汇管理局由中国人民银行管理。
description.en: The State Administration of Foreign Exchange is managed by the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 首任民选县长。
description.en: The first democratically elected magistrate.

description.zh-cn: 杨仲鲸是中国民主社会党籍。
description.en: Yang Chung-ching was a member of the China Democratic Socialist Party.

description.zh-cn: 首位中国国民党籍县长。
description.en: The first Kuomintang magistrate.

description.zh-cn: 1976-1977年间为台湾省政府委员代理。
description.en: Served as acting magistrate as a member of the Taiwan Provincial Government Council from 1976 to 1977.

description.zh-cn: 于任内出任台湾肥料董事长而卸任。
description.en: Left office to become the chairman of Taiwan Fertilizer Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 台湾省政府委员代理。
description.en: Served as acting magistrate as a member of the Taiwan Provincial Government Council.

description.zh-cn: 因病逝世于任内。
description.en: Passed away in office due to illness.

description.zh-cn: 以台湾省政府主席身份兼任。
description.en: Served concurrently as Chairman of the Taiwan Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 于2003年8月19日补选上任。
description.en: Took office on August 19, 2003, after winning a by-election.

description.zh-cn: 因涉及合机股票案被判刑而解职。
description.en: Removed from office due to a conviction in the Hochy stock case.

description.zh-cn: 傅崐萁在首任县长任内曾恢复亲民党籍。
description.en: Fu Kun-chi rejoined the People First Party during his first term as magistrate.

description.zh-cn: 代理花莲县长前担任法务部次长。
description.en: Served as Deputy Minister of Justice before acting as Magistrate of Hualien County.

description.zh-cn: 首位女性县长，并成功连任。
description.en: The first female magistrate, and was successfully re-elected.

description.zh-cn: 行政院指派时任法务部次长蔡碧仲代理花莲县县长。
description.en: The Executive Yuan appointed then-Deputy Minister of Justice Tsai Pi-chung to act as the Magistrate of Hualien County.

description.zh-cn: 花莲县县长是花莲县政府的最高行政首长。
description.en: The Magistrate of Hualien County is the chief executive of the Hualien County Government.

description.zh-cn: 李伯禽是李白与许氏所生的儿子。
description.en: Li Boqin is the son of Li Bai and Lady Xu.

description.zh-cn: 李天然是李白的儿子。
description.en: Li Tianran is the son of Li Bai.

description.zh-cn: 约749年，李白与前宰相宗楚客的孙女宗氏结婚。
description.en: Around 749, Li Bai married Lady Zong, the granddaughter of former chancellor Zong Chuke.

description.zh-cn: 根据多种记载，李白出生于唐朝绵州彰明县。
description.en: According to multiple records, Li Bai was born in Zhangming County, Mian Prefecture during the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 742年，李白因其才名获唐玄宗征召入京，出任翰林供奉，但两年后即被赐金放还。
description.en: In 742, Li Bai was summoned to the capital by Emperor Xuanzong due to his fame and appointed as an attendant in the Hanlin Academy, but he was dismissed with a grant of gold two years later.

description.zh-cn: 李白于742年至744年间在翰林院担任供奉官。
description.en: Li Bai served as an Attendant Scholar in the Hanlin Academy from 742 to 744.

description.zh-cn: 贺知章在长安初见李白时，对其诗文大加赞赏，称其为“谪仙人”，使李白名声大振，并引起了唐玄宗的注意。
description.en: When He Zhizhang first met Li Bai in Chang'an, he highly praised his poetry, calling him a 'banished immortal,' which greatly enhanced Li Bai's reputation and brought him to the attention of Emperor Xuanzong.

description.zh-cn: 因高力士进谗言，杨贵妃开始排斥李白，导致李白失去唐玄宗的恩宠。
description.en: Due to Gao Lishi's slander, Consort Yang began to ostracize Li Bai, causing him to lose Emperor Xuanzong's favor.

description.zh-cn: 安史之乱爆发后，李白的生活陷入动荡，并最终因卷入永王李璘事件而获罪。
description.en: After the outbreak of the An Lushan Rebellion, Li Bai's life was thrown into turmoil, and he was eventually convicted for his involvement in the Prince of Yong, Li Lin's affair.

description.zh-cn: 永王李璘起兵失败后，唐肃宗将李白视为附逆，判其下狱并流放夜郎。
description.en: After the failure of the Prince of Yong, Li Lin's uprising, Emperor Suzong considered Li Bai a traitor, sentencing him to imprisonment and exile to Yelang.

description.zh-cn: 李白因永王李璘案下狱后，曾向时任淮南节度使的故友高适求救，但未获援手。
description.en: After being imprisoned for his involvement with the Prince of Yong, Li Lin, Li Bai sought help from his old friend Gao Shi, who was then the military governor of Huainan, but received no assistance.

description.zh-cn: 李白去世后，其族叔李阳冰将李白生前托付的诗文手稿编成《草堂集》十卷行世，使李白的作品得以流传。
description.en: After Li Bai's death, his clansman Li Yangbing compiled the manuscripts entrusted to him by the poet into the ten-volume 'Caotang Collection', ensuring the preservation and circulation of Li Bai's works.

description.zh-cn: 道教宗师司马承祯曾称赞李白有“仙风道骨”，对其声誉有所提升。
description.en: The Daoist patriarch Sima Chengzhen praised Li Bai as having the 'air and bone of an immortal,' which enhanced his reputation.

description.zh-cn: 721年，李白拜谒益州长史苏颋，获其称赞“天才英丽，下笔不休”，认为他将来可与司马相如媲美。
description.en: In 721, Li Bai visited Su Ting, the governor of Yizhou, who praised him for his 'brilliant talent and ceaseless writing' and believed he could rival Sima Xiangru in the future.

description.zh-cn: 陈炯明是中国致公党的创始人之一，并被推举为首任总理。
description.en: Chen Jiongming was one of the founders of the China Zhi Gong Party and was elected as its first Premier.

description.zh-cn: 唐继尧是中国致公党的创始人之一，并被推举为副总理。
description.en: Tang Jiyao was one of the founders of the China Zhi Gong Party and was elected as its Vice Premier.

description.zh-cn: 中央委员会是中国致公党的最高执行机关。
description.en: The Central Committee is the highest executive body of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 中国致公党是接受中国共产党政治领导的参政党。
description.en: The China Zhi Gong Party is a participating party that accepts the political leadership of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 作为致公党代表参加了中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议。
description.en: As a representative of the Zhi Gong Party, attended the first plenary session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 作为致公党代表参加了中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议。
description.en: As a representative of the Zhi Gong Party, attended the first plenary session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 作为致公党代表参加了中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议。
description.en: As a representative of the Zhi Gong Party, attended the first plenary session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 作为致公党代表参加了中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议。
description.en: As a representative of the Zhi Gong Party, attended the first plenary session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 作为致公党代表参加了中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议。
description.en: As a representative of the Zhi Gong Party, attended the first plenary session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 作为致公党代表参加了中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议。
description.en: As a representative of the Zhi Gong Party, attended the first plenary session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 在国民革命军东征时，陈炯明军队被击败。
description.en: During the Eastern Expedition of the National Revolutionary Army, Chen Jiongming's army was defeated.

description.zh-cn: 反右运动期间，致公党遭到中共打击。
description.en: During the Anti-Rightist Campaign, the Zhi Gong Party was targeted by the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 在反右运动期间，陈其尤被划为右派分子。
description.en: During the Anti-Rightist Campaign, Chen Qiyou was labeled a rightist.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，致公党与其他民主党派一同被查禁。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, the Zhi Gong Party, along with other democratic parties, was banned.

description.zh-cn: 陈其尤在文化大革命期间遭迫害而死。
description.en: Chen Qiyou was persecuted to death during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 1978年，经邓小平决定，中国致公党恢复活动。
description.en: In 1978, by the decision of Deng Xiaoping, the China Zhi Gong Party resumed its activities.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山在海外檀香山担任洪门总会掌管刑罚的洪棍。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen served as a "Hung Kwun" (enforcer) for the Hongmen general society in Honolulu.

description.zh-cn: 朱德年轻时曾经加入哥老会。
description.en: Zhu De joined the Gelaohui in his youth.

description.zh-cn: 袍哥会曾协助朱德起兵。
description.en: The Paoge Hui assisted Zhu De in his uprising.

description.zh-cn: 李济深参与了中国国民党革命委员会的组建工作。
description.en: Li Jishen participated in the formation of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 曹小红曾任天津市副市长。
description.en: Cao Xiaohong formerly served as Vice Mayor of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 作为中共高层领导人，参与了反右运动并扮演了重要角色。
description.en: As a high-ranking CCP leader, he participated in the Anti-Rightist Campaign and played an important role.

description.zh-cn: 发起并领导了反右运动。
description.en: Initiated and led the Anti-Rightist Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在反右运动中，科学家钱伟长被划为“右派分子”并遭到迫害。
description.en: During the Anti-Rightist Campaign, scientist Qian Weichang was labeled a "rightist" and persecuted.

description.zh-cn: 在反右运动中，经济学家顾准被划为“右派分子”并遭到迫害。
description.en: During the Anti-Rightist Campaign, economist Gu Zhun was labeled a "rightist" and persecuted.

description.zh-cn: 反右运动对中国大陆的知识分子造成了极大打击，摧毁了其独立思考和批评精神。
description.en: The Anti-Rightist Campaign dealt a severe blow to intellectuals in mainland China, destroying their spirit of independent thought and criticism.

description.zh-cn: 反右运动消除了党内外对激进经济政策的潜在反对声音，为大跃进运动的开展埋下了祸根。
description.en: The Anti-Rightist Campaign eliminated potential opposition to radical economic policies from within and outside the party, paving the way for the Great Leap Forward.

description.zh-cn: 反右运动的斗争模式和对阶级斗争的强调，为后来的文化大革命埋下了伏笔。
description.en: The struggle model of the Anti-Rightist Campaign and its emphasis on class struggle set a precedent for the later Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 反右运动压制了所有不同政见，巩固并强化了中国共产党实质性的一党专政局面。
description.en: The Anti-Rightist Campaign suppressed all political dissent, consolidating and strengthening the de facto one-party dictatorship of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 反右运动后，毛泽东在中国共产党内的影响力进一步提高，造成了一人独裁的局面。
description.en: After the Anti-Rightist Campaign, Mao Zedong's influence within the CPC was further enhanced, leading to a situation of one-man dictatorship.

description.zh-cn: 在拨乱反正时期，中共中央承认反右运动犯有“扩大化”的错误，并对绝大多数被错划的右派分子予以平反。
description.en: During the Boluan Fanzheng period, the CPC Central Committee admitted that the Anti-Rightist Campaign had been "overly broad" and rehabilitated the vast majority of those wrongly labeled as rightists.

description.zh-cn: 匈牙利十月事件的发生使毛泽东对于政权稳固感到担忧，影响了他从鼓励“鸣放”转向镇压异议的决策。
description.en: The Hungarian Revolution of 1956 made Mao Zedong concerned about the stability of his regime, influencing his decision to shift from encouraging free speech to suppressing dissent.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东撰写的这篇文章为反右运动提供了理论依据，明确了将“鸣放”中的批评者定义为敌人的策略。
description.en: This article written by Mao Zedong provided the theoretical basis for the Anti-Rightist Campaign, clarifying the strategy of defining critics from the "Blooming and Contending" period as enemies.

description.zh-cn: 富田事变是因AB团肃反运动扩大化而造成的兵变。
description.en: The Futian Incident was a mutiny caused by the escalation of the anti-AB League purge movement.

description.zh-cn: 红二十军发动了富田事变兵变。
description.en: The Red 20th Army launched the Futian Incident mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在成为红军最高领导人后，下令由彭德怀、林彪执行，将红二十军缴械并处决其大部分中高级军官，最终剿灭该部队。
description.en: After becoming the supreme leader of the Red Army, Mao Zedong ordered Peng Dehuai and Lin Biao to disarm the Red 20th Army, execute most of its mid-to-high-ranking officers, and ultimately annihilate the unit.

description.zh-cn: 由于第一次反围剿战争爆发，毛泽东、朱德等主要领导人奔赴前线，从而将后方肃反工作委托给李韶九主持。
description.en: Due to the outbreak of the First Encirclement Campaign, main leaders like Mao Zedong and Zhu De went to the front, thus entrusting the rear-area purge work to Li Shaojiu.

description.zh-cn: 李韶九在富田主持肃反时采用严酷手段，逮捕并处决了红二十军及地方苏维埃政府的一批干部，直接引发了兵变。
description.en: Li Shaojiu's use of harsh methods while presiding over the purge in Futian, arresting and executing a number of cadres from the Red 20th Army and the local Soviet government, directly triggered the mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 发动兵变的红二十军攻占富田城后，逮捕了包括李韶九在内的中共肃反人员。
description.en: After occupying Futian city, the mutinying Red 20th Army arrested CCP purge personnel, including Li Shaojiu.

description.zh-cn: 事变后，红二十军领导层指责肃反是毛泽东的密谋，并要求朱德、彭德怀等人逮捕毛泽东。
description.en: After the incident, the leadership of the Red 20th Army accused the purge of being Mao Zedong's conspiracy and demanded that Zhu De, Peng Dehuai, and others arrest Mao.

description.zh-cn: 红二十军的领导表示支持当时已失势的李立三。
description.en: The leaders of the Red 20th Army expressed their support for the then-disgraced Li Lisan.

description.zh-cn: 彭德怀率领红三军团前往平定富田事变。
description.en: Peng Dehuai led the 3rd Army Group to suppress the Futian Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在收到红二十军伪造的信件后，彭德怀判断其为伪造，并率红三军团发表声明支持毛泽东。
description.en: After receiving a forged letter from the Red 20th Army, Peng Dehuai judged it to be a fake and led the 3rd Army Group to issue a statement in support of Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 夺取中共领导权的王明派出代表，宣布富田事变是“反革命暴动”，否定了项英的温和定性。
description.en: After seizing leadership of the CCP, Wang Ming sent representatives to declare the Futian Incident a "counter-revolutionary riot," overturning Xiang Ying's moderate characterization.

description.zh-cn: 在王明主导下，主张温和处理富田事变的项英被解除中共苏区中央局代理书记职务。
description.en: Under Wang Ming's direction, Xiang Ying, who advocated a moderate handling of the Futian Incident, was removed from his position as acting secretary of the CPC Central Soviet Area Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 项英被免职后，毛泽东接替其成为中共苏区中央局代理书记及中革军委负责人。
description.en: After Xiang Ying's dismissal, Mao Zedong replaced him as the acting secretary of the CPC Central Soviet Area Bureau and head of the Central Revolutionary Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 林彪率部参与包围缴械红二十军，并处决了包括政委曾炳春在内的700余名干部。
description.en: Lin Biao led his troops to participate in surrounding and disarming the Red 20th Army, executing over 700 cadres, including Political Commissar Zeng Bingchun.

description.zh-cn: 富田事变被镇压后，各地的反AB团运动被掀起新高潮，审讯手段也变得更加残酷。
description.en: After the Futian Incident was suppressed, the anti-AB League movement in various regions reached a new peak, and interrogation methods became more brutal.

description.zh-cn: 在萧克等将领的呼吁下，时任中共领导人胡耀邦指示对富田事变进行重新调查以推动平反。
description.en: Following appeals from generals like Xiao Ke, then-CCP leader Hu Yaobang instructed a reinvestigation of the Futian Incident to promote its rehabilitation.

description.zh-cn: 在胡耀邦辞职导致调查中断后，时任国家主席杨尚昆批示调查工作重新展开。
description.en: After the investigation was halted due to Hu Yaobang's resignation, then-President Yang Shangkun instructed that the investigation be resumed.

description.zh-cn: 由于1989年六四天安门事件爆发，要求为富田事变全面平反的调查报告被搁置。
description.en: Due to the outbreak of the 1989 Tiananmen Square incident, the investigation report calling for the full rehabilitation of the Futian Incident was shelved.

description.zh-cn: 撰写并出版了《历史与阶级意识：关于马克思主义辩证法的研究》。
description.en: Authored and published 'History and Class Consciousness: Studies in Marxist Dialectics'.

description.zh-cn: 《历史与阶级意识》反映了当时国际共产主义运动中出现的“左翼共产主义”倾向。
description.en: 'History and Class Consciousness' reflects the 'Left Communism' tendency that emerged in the international communist movement at the time.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战后资本主义面临的严重危机，是卢卡奇撰写该书的历史背景。
description.en: The severe crisis faced by capitalism after World War I formed the historical context for Lukács's writing of the book.

description.zh-cn: 俄国十月革命的影响是卢卡奇撰写该书的历史背景之一。
description.en: The influence of the Russian October Revolution was part of the historical context for Lukács's writing of the book.

description.zh-cn: 该书系统地重新审视和解释了马克思主义，将其视为一种社会理论。
description.en: The book systematically re-examines and interprets Marxism, treating it as a social theory.

description.zh-cn: 在《历史与阶级意识》中，卢卡奇批评恩格斯将辩证法扩展到自然界是受到黑格尔的错误引导，会削弱辩证法的革命性。
description.en: In 'History and Class Consciousness', Lukács criticized Engels's extension of dialectics to nature as being misguided by Hegel, which would weaken the revolutionary nature of the dialectic.

description.zh-cn: 在《历史与阶级意识》中，卢卡奇否定“自然辩证法”，认为辩证法仅适用于社会历史领域。
description.en: In 'History and Class Consciousness', Lukács rejected the 'Dialectics of Nature', arguing that dialectics only apply to the socio-historical realm.

description.zh-cn: 根据卢卡奇的观点，恩格斯将辩证法扩展到自然界是受到了黑格尔的错误引导。
description.en: According to Lukács's view, Engels was misguided by Hegel in extending dialectics to nature.

description.zh-cn: 卢卡奇借用了黑格尔的“总体性”概念来分析资本主义，其思想被认为受到“黑格尔主义”的影响。
description.en: Lukács borrowed Hegel's concept of 'totality' to analyze capitalism, and his thought is considered to be influenced by 'Hegelianism'.

description.zh-cn: 根据卢卡奇在《历史与阶级意识》中的分析，物化是生活在资本主义社会中的每个人直接面对的现实。
description.en: According to Lukács's analysis in 'History and Class Consciousness', reification is a reality directly faced by everyone living in capitalist society.

description.zh-cn: 《历史与阶级意识》出版后，很快遭到共产国际的批判。
description.en: After its publication, 'History and Class Consciousness' was soon criticized by the Communist International.

description.zh-cn: 因其著作《历史与阶级意识》受到共产国际批判，卢卡奇被撤销在匈牙利国共产党中的领导职务。
description.en: Due to the criticism of his work 'History and Class Consciousness' by the Communist International, Lukács was removed from his leadership position in the Communist Party of Hungary.

description.zh-cn: 曾在匈牙利国共产党中担任领导职务，后因其著作被批判而遭撤职。
description.en: Held a leadership position in the Communist Party of Hungary, but was later dismissed after his book was criticized.

description.zh-cn: 因其著作《历史与阶级意识》，卢卡奇被视为“西方马克思主义”的创始人。
description.en: Due to his work 'History and Class Consciousness', Lukács is regarded as the founder of 'Western Marxism'.

description.zh-cn: 该书所表现出来的思想被认为是“黑格尔主义的马克思主义”的一种。
description.en: The ideas expressed in the book are considered a form of 'Hegelian Marxism'.

description.zh-cn: 该书认为只有无产阶级才能理解和掌握总体性辩证法，并承担起从总体上认识和改造社会的历史任务。
description.en: The book argues that only the proletariat can understand and master the dialectic of totality and undertake the historical task of understanding and transforming society as a whole.

description.zh-cn: 唐屹峰自2024年10月起担任中国共产党佛山市委员会书记。
description.en: Tang Yifeng has served as the Secretary of the Foshan Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China since October 2024.

description.zh-cn: 胡钛自2021年11月起担任佛山市人民代表大会常务委员会主任。
description.en: Hu Ti has served as the Director of the Standing Committee of the Foshan Municipal People's Congress since November 2021.

description.zh-cn: 白涛自2021年10月起担任佛山市人民政府市长。
description.en: Bai Tao has served as the Mayor of the Foshan Municipal People's Government since October 2021.

description.zh-cn: 唐屹峰接替郑轲担任佛山市委书记职务。
description.en: Tang Yifeng succeeded Zheng Ke as the Secretary of the Foshan Municipal Party Committee.

description.zh-cn: 李文茂是太平军将领，以佛山为基地发动起义响应太平天国运动。
description.en: Li Wenmao was a Taiping Army general who launched an uprising based in Foshan in response to the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom movement.

description.zh-cn: 清咸丰年间，叶名琛的部下击败了围攻广州的李文茂部队。
description.en: During the Xianfeng era of the Qing dynasty, Ye Mingchen's subordinates defeated Li Wenmao's troops that were besieging Guangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 比尔·盖茨与保罗·艾伦于1975年共同创立了微软公司。
description.en: Bill Gates co-founded Microsoft Corporation with Paul Allen in 1975.

description.zh-cn: 保罗·艾伦与比尔·盖茨于1975年共同创立了微软公司。
description.en: Paul Allen co-founded Microsoft Corporation with Bill Gates in 1975.

description.zh-cn: 盖茨于1973年进入哈佛大学就读，但在大三时（1975年）退学以全身心投入微软的创建和发展。
description.en: Gates enrolled at Harvard University in 1973 but dropped out in his junior year (1975) to devote himself fully to the creation and development of Microsoft.

description.zh-cn: 在湖滨中学相识，成为朋友和商业伙伴，后共同创立微软公司。
description.en: Met at Lakeside School, became friends and business partners, and later co-founded Microsoft Corporation.

position.zh-cn: 首席执行官、董事长、首席软件架构师、董事
position.en: CEO, Chairman, Chief Software Architect, Board Member

description.zh-cn: 比尔·盖茨曾担任微软首席执行官（至2000年）、董事长（至2014年），并于2020年3月离开董事会。
description.en: Bill Gates served as CEO of Microsoft until 2000, Chairman until 2014, and left the board in March 2020.

description.zh-cn: 2000年1月，巴尔默接任微软首席执行官，而盖茨担任董事长。在此期间，巴尔默向以盖茨为首的董事会汇报。
description.en: In January 2000, Ballmer took over as CEO of Microsoft while Gates served as Chairman. During this period, Ballmer reported to the board of directors, which was chaired by Gates.

description.zh-cn: 盖茨在2014年2月辞去董事长后，担任技术顾问，协助新任首席执行官纳德拉的工作。
description.en: After stepping down as chairman in February 2014, Gates served as a technology advisor to assist the newly appointed CEO, Satya Nadella.

description.zh-cn: 比尔·盖茨于2020年3月离任伯克希尔·哈撒韦的董事。
description.en: Bill Gates stepped down from the board of Berkshire Hathaway in March 2020.

description.zh-cn: 微软向IBM授权其PC-DOS操作系统，用于IBM于1981年正式推出的个人电脑，此举推动了IBM个人电脑市场的成功。
description.en: Microsoft licensed its PC-DOS operating system to IBM for its personal computer, which was officially launched in 1981, boosting the success of the IBM PC market.

description.zh-cn: 苹果电脑曾就微软Windows操作系统的图形用户界面侵犯其版权提起诉讼。
description.en: Apple Computer, Inc. sued Microsoft for copyright infringement over the graphical user interface of the Microsoft Windows operating system.

description.zh-cn: 1990年代末，美国政府对微软公司提起一系列反垄断诉讼。
description.en: In the late 1990s, the U.S. government filed a series of antitrust lawsuits against Microsoft.

description.zh-cn: 共同投资了研发“人造蛋”的美国加州汉普顿溪食品公司。
description.en: Co-invested in Hampton Creek Foods, a California-based company developing 'artificial eggs'.

description.zh-cn: 比尔·盖茨旗下的泰拉能源与中国核工业集团探讨关于第四代反应堆的行波反应堆建设合作事宜。
description.en: TerraPower, a company under Bill Gates, discussed cooperation with China National Nuclear Corporation on the construction of a traveling wave reactor, a type of fourth-generation nuclear reactor.

description.zh-cn: 在2019冠状病毒病疫情期间，盖茨基金会捐助资金支持中国政府的防疫工作及相关药物研发。
description.en: During the COVID-19 pandemic, the Gates Foundation donated funds to support the Chinese government's epidemic response and related drug development.

description.zh-cn: 就2019冠状病毒病疫情进行书信往来，盖茨在信中表达了对中国防疫行动的支持，习近平则回信表示感谢。
description.en: Corresponded regarding the COVID-19 pandemic, with Gates expressing support for China's epidemic prevention actions in his letter, and Xi Jinping replying with a letter of thanks.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党提出并不断发展中国特色社会主义理论，将其作为党的全部理论和实践的主题。
description.en: The Communist Party of China proposed and continuously developed the theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics, making it the theme of all the Party's theories and practices.

description.zh-cn: 作为中国共产党的指导思想，马克思列宁主义是中国特色社会主义的理论基础之一。
description.en: As a guiding ideology of the Communist Party of China, Marxism–Leninism is one of the theoretical foundations of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

description.zh-cn: 作为中国共产党的指导思想，毛泽东思想是中国特色社会主义的理论基础之一。
description.en: As a guiding ideology of the Communist Party of China, Mao Zedong Thought is one of the theoretical foundations of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十二大上提出，要把中国建设成为高度文明、高度民主的社会主义国家，明确了中国特色社会主义初期的发展目标。
description.en: At the 12th Party Congress, he proposed to build China into a socialist country with a high level of civilization and democracy, clarifying the development goals for the initial stage of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十三大上作报告，将中国特色社会主义的发展目标明确为建设“富强、民主、文明”的社会主义现代化国家。
description.en: Delivered a report at the 13th Party Congress, defining the development goal of socialism with Chinese characteristics as building a 'prosperous, democratic, and civilized' socialist modernized country.

description.zh-cn: 中国特色社会主义理论将建设社会主义市场经济作为其核心经济建设目标之一。
description.en: The theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics regards the construction of a socialist market economy as one of its core economic construction goals.

description.zh-cn: 对中国特色社会主义的社会主义性质提出质疑。
description.en: Questions the socialist nature of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

description.zh-cn: 对中国特色社会主义的社会主义性质提出质疑。
description.en: Questions the socialist nature of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

description.zh-cn: 认为中国特色社会主义是社会帝国主义。
description.en: Considers socialism with Chinese characteristics to be social imperialism.

description.zh-cn: 认为中国特色社会主义是社会帝国主义。
description.en: Considers socialism with Chinese characteristics to be social imperialism.

description.zh-cn: 评价称“中国特色社会主义是资本主义和威权主义的完美结合”，对其性质持批判态度。
description.en: Commented that 'socialism with Chinese characteristics is the perfect combination of capitalism and authoritarianism,' holding a critical view of its nature.

description.zh-cn: 认为“二十一世纪的中国是个资本主义社会”，否定了中国特色社会主义的社会主义性质。
description.en: Argues that 'twenty-first-century China is a capitalist society,' denying the socialist nature of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

description.zh-cn: “两个凡是”原则的核心是维护毛泽东生前作出的所有决策和指示，完全基于其个人权威。
description.en: The core of the 'Two Whatevers' principle was to uphold all decisions and instructions made by Mao Zedong during his lifetime, based entirely on his personal authority.

description.zh-cn: 华国锋是“凡是派”的代表人物。
description.en: Hua Guofeng was the representative figure of the 'Whateverist Faction'.

description.zh-cn: 汪东兴是“凡是派”的代表人物之一。
description.en: Wang Dongxing was one of the representative figures of the 'Whateverist Faction'.

description.zh-cn: 汪东兴指示李鑫组织撰写社论《学好文件抓住纲》。
description.en: Wang Dongxing instructed Li Xin to organize the writing of the editorial 'Study the Documents Well and Grasp the Key Link'.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共中央组织部部长的胡耀邦审定了《实践是检验真理的唯一标准》一文。
description.en: Hu Yaobang, then head of the CPC Central Committee's Organization Department, reviewed and approved the article 'Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth'.

description.zh-cn: 发表了评论文章《实践是检验真理的唯一标准》。
description.en: Published the commentary article 'Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth'.

description.zh-cn: 中共十一届三中全会公开批评了“两个凡是”的思想。
description.en: The Third Plenum of the 11th CPC Central Committee publicly criticized the ideology of the 'Two Whatevers'.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十一届三中全会上，邓小平等人批评了与华国锋有直接关系的“两个凡是”，最终导致华国锋下台。
description.en: At the Third Plenum of the 11th CPC Central Committee, Deng Xiaoping and others criticized the 'Two Whatevers', which were directly linked to Hua Guofeng, ultimately leading to Hua's removal from power.

description.zh-cn: 因坚持“两个凡是”的错误，华国锋先后辞去国务院总理、中共中央主席和中央军委主席职务。
description.en: Due to his insistence on the mistake of the 'Two Whatevers', Hua Guofeng resigned successively from his posts as Premier, CPC Chairman, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 主持兴建长春园，作为自己退位后的颐养之所。
作为邱园的拥有者，委托威廉·肯特进行建造。
在劫掠圆明园时盗走了海晏堂前的十二生肖兽首铜像。
在香港佳士得拍卖会上购得牛首、虎首、猴首铜像，使其回归中国。
出资购回猪首和马首铜像，并捐赠给国家。
从原持有人手中买下鼠首和兔首，并无偿捐赠给中国。
郑欣宜是沈殿霞的独生女。
description.en: Joyce Cheng is the only daughter of Lydia Shum.

description.zh-cn: 郑欣宜是郑少秋的女儿。
description.en: Joyce Cheng is the daughter of Adam Cheng.

description.zh-cn: 沈殿霞与郑少秋曾有过三年的婚姻。
description.en: Lydia Shum and Adam Cheng were married for three years.

description.zh-cn: 在结婚前，沈殿霞与郑少秋同居11年。
description.en: Before getting married, Lydia Shum and Adam Cheng lived together for 11 years.

description.zh-cn: 郑少秋在与沈殿霞离婚后，于1989年与官晶华结婚。
description.en: After divorcing Lydia Shum, Adam Cheng married Kuan Ching-hua in 1989.

description.zh-cn: 森森是郑少秋在与沈殿霞交往前的女友。
description.en: Sam-sam was Adam Cheng's girlfriend before he started dating Lydia Shum.

description.zh-cn: 沈殿霞曾在上海市第三女子中学就读。
description.en: Lydia Shum studied at Shanghai No. 3 Girls' High School.

description.zh-cn: 沈殿霞在无线电视工作多年，是其长寿综艺节目《欢乐今宵》的核心主持。
description.en: Lydia Shum worked at TVB for many years and was a core host of its long-running variety show 'Enjoy Yourself Tonight'.

description.zh-cn: 沈殿霞曾于1990年至1994年间短暂加盟亚洲电视。
description.en: Lydia Shum briefly joined Asia Television from 1990 to 1994.

description.zh-cn: 1960年，沈殿霞被邵氏电影公司招聘为童星，开始其演艺生涯。
description.en: In 1960, Lydia Shum was recruited by Shaw Brothers Studio as a child star, beginning her acting career.

description.zh-cn: 在沈殿霞的追思会上，邓光荣公开指责郑少秋未尽到丈夫和父亲的责任。
description.en: At Lydia Shum's memorial service, Alan Tang publicly accused Adam Cheng of failing in his duties as a husband and father.

description.zh-cn: 为了褒扬沈殿霞的贡献，温哥华市议会宣布2008年6月1日为“肥肥日”（Ms. Fei Fei Day）。
description.en: To honor Lydia Shum's contributions, the Vancouver City Council declared June 1, 2008, as "Ms. Fei Fei Day".

description.zh-cn: 沈殿霞于1973年加入“银色鼠队”，是团体中的“七妹”。
description.en: Lydia Shum joined 'The Silver Rats' in 1973 as the 'Seventh Sister' of the group.

description.zh-cn: 沈殿霞与汪明荃、王爱明及张德兰组成“四朵金花”。
description.en: Lydia Shum formed 'Four Golden Flowers' with Liza Wang, Wong Oi-ming, and Cheung Tak-lan.

description.zh-cn: 1947年结婚。1973年离婚，离婚报中共中央批准但未履行法律手续，1998年张春桥保外就医后两人继续共同生活。
description.en: Married in 1947. Divorced in 1973; the divorce was approved by the CPC Central Committee but legal procedures were not completed. They resumed living together after Zhang Chunqiao was released on medical parole in 1998.

description.zh-cn: “一月风暴”打倒了以陈丕显为首的上海市委。
description.en: The 'January Storm' overthrew the Shanghai Municipal Committee led by Chen Pixian.

description.zh-cn: 在怀仁堂召开的中央政治局碰头会上，严厉批评张春桥打倒陈丕显的做法，该事件后被定性为“二月逆流”。
description.en: At a Politburo meeting in Huairen Hall, he severely criticized Zhang Chunqiao's actions in overthrowing Chen Pixian. The incident was later labeled the 'February Countercurrent'.

description.zh-cn: 张春桥于1998年1月送保外就医，被安置在江苏江阴，并于2005年4月21日在该地病逝。
description.en: Zhang Chunqiao was sent for medical parole in January 1998 and was placed in Jiangyin, Jiangsu, where he died of illness on April 21, 2005.

description.zh-cn: 1980年考入北京大学法律系，就读于新开设的经济法专业。
description.en: Enrolled in the Law Department of Peking University in 1980, studying in the newly established Economic Law program.

description.zh-cn: 在吉林大学法学院获得法学理论专业在职研究生学历和法学博士学位。
description.en: Obtained an on-the-job postgraduate qualification in legal theory and a Doctor of Law degree from the Law School of Jilin University.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命初期被关押到伊克昭盟的牛棚。
description.en: Was detained in a cowshed in Ikh Juu League during the early stages of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 接替布小林出任内蒙古自治区主席职务。
description.en: Succeeded Bu Xiaolin as the Chairwoman of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region People's Government.

position.zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区人民政府主席
position.en: Chairwoman of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region People's Government

description.zh-cn: 在布小林担任主席期间，王君任中共内蒙古自治区党委书记。
description.en: While Bu Xiaolin served as Chairwoman, Wang Jun was the Secretary of the CCP Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Committee.

position.zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区人民政府主席
position.en: Chairwoman of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region People's Government

description.zh-cn: 在布小林担任主席期间，石泰峰任中共内蒙古自治区党委书记。
description.en: While Bu Xiaolin served as Chairwoman, Shi Taifeng was the Secretary of the CCP Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Committee.

description.zh-cn: 黎元洪出生于湖北省汉阳府黄陂县。
description.en: Li Yuanhong was born in Huangpi County, Hanyang Prefecture, Hubei Province.

description.zh-cn: 1883年考入天津北洋水师学堂，1888年毕业。
description.en: He was admitted to the Beiyang Naval Academy in Tianjin in 1883 and graduated in 1888.

description.zh-cn: 毕业后在广东水师广甲号任职，甲午战争时所在舰船被击沉。
description.en: After graduation, he served on the Guangjia in the Guangdong Fleet. His ship was sunk during the First Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 甲午战争后投靠张之洞督练新军，在清末新军和民国北洋陆军中长期服役。
description.en: After the First Sino-Japanese War, he joined Zhang Zhidong to train the New Army, serving long-term in the late Qing New Army and the Beiyang Army of the Republic.

description.zh-cn: 黎元洪在北洋水师学堂就读时，严复是其师长，并评价其“德高才疏”。
description.en: When Li Yuanhong studied at the Beiyang Naval Academy, Yan Fu was his teacher and commented that he was 'of high moral character but limited talent'.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义爆发后，革命党人因军中无主，拥立时任协统的黎元洪出任湖北军政府都督。
description.en: After the Wuchang Uprising broke out, with no leader in their ranks, the revolutionaries endorsed Li Yuanhong, then a brigade commander, to be the military governor of the Hubei Military Government.
