description.zh-cn: 南京临时政府成立后被选为临时副总统，1913年10月正式当选副总统。
description.en: He was elected Provisional Vice President after the establishment of the Nanjing Provisional Government, and formally elected Vice President in October 1913.

description.zh-cn: 在孙中山担任临时大总统期间，黎元洪任临时副总统。
description.en: Li Yuanhong served as Provisional Vice President while Sun Yat-sen was the Provisional President.

description.zh-cn: 在袁世凯担任大总统期间，黎元洪任副总统。
description.en: Li Yuanhong served as Vice President while Yuan Shikai was President.

description.zh-cn: 1913年12月，黎元洪被段祺瑞等人胁迫进入北京，并被袁世凯迁入瀛台居住，实际上是加以软禁。
description.en: In December 1913, Li Yuanhong was coerced into Beijing by Duan Qirui and others and was moved into the Yingtai by Yuan Shikai, effectively placing him under house arrest.

description.zh-cn: 黎元洪曾两次担任中华民国大总统。第一次是在袁世凯死后继任，第二次是在直奉战争后复任。
description.en: Li Yuanhong served as President of the Republic of China twice. The first time was succeeding Yuan Shikai after his death, and the second time was resuming office after the First Zhili-Fengtian War.

description.zh-cn: 张勋以调解府院之争为名率军入京，随即要求黎元洪解散国会，黎被迫同意。
description.en: Under the pretext of mediating the 'Manor-Court Rivalry', Zhang Xun led his troops into Beijing and immediately demanded that Li Yuanhong dissolve the parliament, which Li was forced to agree to.

description.zh-cn: 张勋拥立溥仪复辟后，黎元洪逃入东交民巷的日本公使馆寻求庇护，并通电去职，以此表示反对。
description.en: After Zhang Xun restored Puyi to the throne, Li Yuanhong fled to the Japanese legation in the Legation Quarter for asylum and announced his resignation by telegram to show his opposition.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞在天津组织讨逆军，讨伐张勋复辟。
description.en: Duan Qirui organized the Rebel-suppressing Army in Tianjin to crusade against Zhang Xun's restoration.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞率领的讨逆军攻入北京，迅速击败了张勋的军队，结束了复辟闹剧。
description.en: The Rebel-suppressing Army led by Duan Qirui attacked Beijing and quickly defeated Zhang Xun's forces, ending the restoration farce.

description.zh-cn: 第一次直奉战争后，直系军阀控制北京政府，大总统徐世昌被驱逐，黎元洪被拥立复任大总统。
description.en: After the First Zhili-Fengtian War, the Zhili clique controlled the Beijing government. President Xu Shichang was ousted, and Li Yuanhong was supported to resume the presidency.

description.zh-cn: 第一次直奉战争后，直系军阀控制北京政府，大总统徐世昌被迫下台。
description.en: After the First Zhili-Fengtian War, the Zhili clique took control of the Beijing government, forcing President Xu Shichang to step down.

description.zh-cn: 1923年6月，曹锟驱逐大总统黎元洪，随后通过贿选上台。
description.en: In June 1923, Cao Kun ousted President Li Yuanhong and subsequently came to power through bribery.

description.zh-cn: 张勋拥立已退位的清朝皇帝溥仪，宣布清朝复辟。
description.en: Zhang Xun enthroned the abdicated Qing Emperor Puyi, announcing the restoration of the Qing dynasty.

position.en: Vice President of the United States

description.zh-cn: 在奥巴马担任总统期间担任其副总统。
description.en: Served as Vice President during Barack Obama's presidency.

position.en: Vice President of the United States

description.zh-cn: 在拜登担任总统期间担任其副总统。
description.en: Serves as Vice President during Joe Biden's presidency.

description.zh-cn: 作为主要政党对手，拜登在2020年总统选举中击败了时任总统川普。
description.en: As a major political opponent, Biden defeated incumbent President Trump in the 2020 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 作为参议院司法委员会主席，拜登反对罗伯特·博克的最高法院大法官提名，该提名最终被否决。
description.en: As Chairman of the Senate Judiciary Committee, Biden opposed Robert Bork's nomination to the Supreme Court, which was ultimately rejected.

description.zh-cn: 在克拉伦斯·托马斯提名听证会期间，主持了安妮塔·希尔关于性骚扰指控的作证。他对听证会的处理方式受到了批评。
description.en: During the Clarence Thomas confirmation hearings, he presided over Anita Hill's testimony regarding sexual harassment allegations. His handling of the hearing drew criticism.

description.zh-cn: 投票反对授权发动海湾战争。
description.en: Voted against the authorization for the Gulf War.

description.zh-cn: 最早呼吁解除对波斯尼亚的武器禁运、进行空袭并调查战争罪行。
description.en: Was one of the earliest to call for lifting the arms embargo, training Bosnian Muslims, supporting with NATO airstrikes, and investigating war crimes in Bosnia.

description.zh-cn: 在巴尔干地区访问期间与米洛舍维奇会面，并称他为“该死的战犯”。
description.en: Met with Milošević during a visit to the Balkans and called him a 'damned war criminal'.

description.zh-cn: 投票赞成授权对伊拉克使用军事力量的决议，但后来成为该战争的批评者。
description.en: Voted in favor of the resolution authorizing military force against Iraq, but later became a critic of the war.

description.zh-cn: 在2008年总统选举中选择拜登作为他的竞选搭档。
description.en: Chose Biden as his running mate in the 2008 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 作为副总统，多次与时任参议院少数党领袖麦康诺就重大立法进行谈判，包括2010年税收法案和2011年债务上限危机。
description.en: As Vice President, frequently negotiated with then-Senate Minority Leader McConnell on major legislation, including the 2010 tax deal and the 2011 debt-ceiling crisis.

description.zh-cn: 枪击案发生后，奥巴马总统任命拜登领导枪支暴力特别工作组。
description.en: Following the shooting, President Obama appointed Biden to lead a task force on gun violence.

description.zh-cn: 博·拜登的去世是乔·拜登决定不参加2016年总统竞选的一个主要因素。
description.en: The death of Beau Biden was a major factor in Joe Biden's decision not to run for president in 2016.

description.zh-cn: 在上任第一天签署行政命令，让美国重返《巴黎协定》。
description.en: Signed an executive order on his first day in office for the United States to rejoin the Paris Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 提出并签署了1.9万亿美元的COVID-19经济刺激救济方案。
description.en: Proposed and signed the $1.9 trillion COVID-19 economic stimulus relief package.

description.zh-cn: 下令从阿富汗撤出所有美军，结束了长达20年的阿富汗战争。
description.en: Ordered the withdrawal of all U.S. troops from Afghanistan, ending the 20-year war.

description.zh-cn: 撤军的混乱以及阿富汗政府的迅速垮台导致拜登的民意支持率大幅下降。
description.en: The chaotic nature of the withdrawal and the swift collapse of the Afghan government led to a significant drop in Biden's public approval ratings.

description.zh-cn: 签署了1.2万亿美元的跨党派基础设施法案。
description.en: Signed the $1.2 trillion bipartisan infrastructure bill into law.

description.zh-cn: 签署了《2022年降低通胀法》，涉及气候、医疗保健和税收改革。
description.en: Signed the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, addressing climate, healthcare, and tax reform.

description.zh-cn: 在2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后，坚决支持乌克兰，并领导国际社会对俄罗斯实施制裁和向乌克兰提供援助。
description.en: After the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine, strongly supported Ukraine, leading international efforts to sanction Russia and provide aid to Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 与澳大利亚和英国领导人共同宣布成立AUKUS安全伙伴关系。
description.en: Announced the AUKUS security partnership with the leaders of Australia and the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 大力支持芬兰加入北大西洋公约组织。
description.en: Strongly supported Finland's accession to NATO.

description.zh-cn: 大力支持瑞典加入北大西洋公约组织。
description.en: Strongly supported Sweden's accession to NATO.

description.zh-cn: 由于健康和年龄问题受到质疑，宣布放弃竞选连任。
description.en: Announced he was withdrawing his campaign for re-election amid questions about his health and age.

description.zh-cn: 在宣布退出2024年总统竞选后，表态支持副总统贺锦丽代表民主党参选。
description.en: After announcing his withdrawal from the 2024 presidential race, he endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to run as the Democratic Party's nominee.

description.zh-cn: 动用总统权力特赦其儿子亨特·拜登的联邦罪行。
description.en: Used his presidential power to pardon his son, Hunter Biden, for federal crimes.

description.zh-cn: 作为副总统和总统，多次与俄罗斯总统普京会晤，讨论军控和地缘政治问题。
description.en: As Vice President and President, has met with Russian President Vladimir Putin on several occasions to discuss arms control and geopolitical issues.

description.zh-cn: 毛岸龙于1927年在武昌出生。
description.en: Mao Anlong was born in Wuchang in 1927.

description.zh-cn: 据传闻，黄金荣曾安排养母收养毛岸龙，并为其改名。
description.en: According to rumors, Huang Jinrong arranged for an adoptive mother to take in Mao Anlong and change his name.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东是毛贻昌的儿子。
description.en: Mao Zedong was the son of Mao Yichang.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东是文素勤的儿子。
description.en: Mao Zedong was the son of Wen Suqin.

description.zh-cn: 毛贻昌是毛恩普的儿子。
description.en: Mao Yichang was the son of Mao Enpu.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会组织部是中国共产党中央委员会的职能部门。
description.en: The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee is a functional department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1924年5月，中共中央正式决定分设宣传、组织、工农等部，成立了中央组织部。
description.en: In May 1924, the CPC Central Committee formally decided to establish several departments including propaganda, organization, and workers-peasants, thus founding the Central Organization Department.

description.zh-cn: 中国浦东干部学院为中央直属事业单位，由中央组织部管理。
description.en: China Executive Leadership Academy Pudong is a public institution directly under the Central Committee and managed by the Central Organization Department.

description.zh-cn: 中国井冈山干部学院为中央直属事业单位，由中央组织部管理。
description.en: China Executive Leadership Academy Jinggangshan is a public institution directly under the Central Committee and managed by the Central Organization Department.

description.zh-cn: 中国延安干部学院为中央直属事业单位，由中央组织部管理。
description.en: China Executive Leadership Academy Yan'an is a public institution directly under the Central Committee and managed by the Central Organization Department.

description.zh-cn: 根据《深化党和国家机构改革方案》，不再保留单设的国家公务员局。
description.en: According to the 'Plan for Deepening the Reform of Party and State Institutions', the separately established National Civil Service Administration was abolished.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命开始后不久，中共中央组织部业务工作停顿。
description.en: Shortly after the beginning of the Cultural Revolution, the operational work of the Central Organization Department of the CPC came to a halt.

description.zh-cn: 江宜桦与李淑珍为夫妻关系，两人在就读大学时结识。
description.en: Jiang Yi-huah and Li Shu-chen are married. They met when they were university students.

degree.zh-cn: 政治学学士、政治学硕士
degree.en: Bachelor of Political Science, Master of Political Science

description.zh-cn: 江宜桦于1983年获得国立台湾大学政治学学士学位，1987年获得硕士学位。
description.en: Jiang Yi-huah received his Bachelor's degree in Political Science from National Taiwan University in 1983, and his Master's degree in 1987.

description.zh-cn: 江宜桦于1993年获得耶鲁大学政治学博士学位。
description.en: Jiang Yi-huah received his Ph.D. in Political Science from Yale University in 1993.

description.zh-cn: 江宜桦于2012年10月重回中国国民党。
description.en: Jiang Yi-huah rejoined the Kuomintang in October 2012.

description.zh-cn: 在马英九总统任内，江宜桦被任命为行政院院长。
description.en: During President Ma Ying-jeou's term, Jiang Yi-huah was appointed as the Premier of the Executive Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 在吴敦义担任行政院院长期间，江宜桦是其内阁的内政部部长。
description.en: While Wu Den-yih was Premier, Jiang Yi-huah served as the Minister of the Interior in his cabinet.

position.zh-cn: 行政院研究发展考核委员会主任委员
position.en: Minister of the Research, Development and Evaluation Commission

description.zh-cn: 在刘兆玄担任行政院院长期间，江宜桦是其内阁的行政院研究发展考核委员会主任委员。
description.en: While Liu Chao-shiuan was Premier, Jiang Yi-huah served as the Minister of the Research, Development and Evaluation Commission in his cabinet.

position.en: Vice Premier of the Executive Yuan

description.zh-cn: 在江宜桦担任行政院院长期间，毛治国是其内阁的行政院副院长。
description.en: While Jiang Yi-huah was Premier, Mao Chi-kuo served as the Vice Premier in his cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 由于执政的国民党在2014年地方公职人员选举中败选，时任行政院院长江宜桦为此请辞下台。
description.en: Due to the ruling Kuomintang's defeat in the 2014 local elections, then-Premier Jiang Yi-huah resigned to take responsibility.

description.zh-cn: 2009年9月，时任内政部部长的江宜桦以国家安全为由，禁止世界维吾尔代表大会主席热比娅入境台湾。
description.en: In September 2009, then-Minister of the Interior Jiang Yi-huah denied entry to Taiwan for Rebiya Kadeer, president of the World Uyghur Congress, citing national security concerns.

position.en: Associate Professor, Professor of Political Science

description.zh-cn: 江宜桦自1995年起在国立台湾大学政治学系任教，1999年升任教授，直至2012年进入行政院任职。
description.en: Jiang Yi-huah taught at the Department of Political Science at National Taiwan University starting in 1995, was promoted to full professor in 1999, and served until he joined the Executive Yuan in 2012.

description.zh-cn: 列昂尼德·勃列日涅夫于1928年与维多利亚·勃列日涅娃结婚。
description.en: Leonid Brezhnev married Viktoria Brezhneva in 1928.

description.zh-cn: 加林娜·勃列日涅娃是列昂尼德·勃列日涅夫的女儿。
description.en: Galina Brezhneva was the daughter of Leonid Brezhnev.

description.zh-cn: 尤里·勃列日涅夫是列昂尼德·勃列日涅夫的儿子。
description.en: Yuri Brezhnev was the son of Leonid Brezhnev.

description.zh-cn: 在推翻赫鲁晓夫后，勃列日涅夫与众人一起解除了谢列平的职务。
description.en: After overthrowing Khrushchev, Brezhnev and others jointly dismissed Shelepin from his posts.

description.zh-cn: 勃列日涅夫的执政时期被称为“停滞时代”，其政策趋于保守和僵化，导致社会衰落。
description.en: Brezhnev's period in power is known as the 'Era of Stagnation'; his policies tended towards conservatism and rigidity, leading to social decline.

description.zh-cn: 勃列日涅夫于1966年初决定终止赫鲁晓夫时期的“非斯大林化”进程。
description.en: In early 1966, Brezhnev decided to terminate the process of 'de-Stalinization' from the Khrushchev era.

description.zh-cn: 在勃列日涅夫时代，作家索尔仁尼琴被流放。
description.en: During the Brezhnev era, writer Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn was exiled.

description.zh-cn: 勃列日涅夫的政策与赫鲁晓夫的政治改革（赫鲁晓夫解冻）相对立。
description.en: Brezhnev's policies were antagonistic to Khrushchev's political reforms (the Khrushchev Thaw).

description.zh-cn: 戈尔巴乔夫在1985年上台后，谴责勃列日涅夫政府的无能且不灵活。
description.en: After coming to power in 1985, Gorbachev condemned the Brezhnev government for its incompetence and inflexibility.

description.zh-cn: 勃列日涅夫派军队入侵捷克斯洛伐克以镇压“布拉格之春”运动。
description.en: Brezhnev sent troops to invade Czechoslovakia to suppress the 'Prague Spring' movement.

description.zh-cn: 由于阿富汗新政府取消了亲苏联政策，勃列日涅夫发动了阿富汗战争。
description.en: Brezhnev launched the Soviet–Afghan War because the new Afghan government had canceled its pro-Soviet policies.

description.zh-cn: 勃列日涅夫执政时期，苏联与毛泽东领导下的中华人民共和国爆发了珍宝岛等地的边界冲突，两国关系长期敌对。
description.en: During Brezhnev's rule, the Soviet Union and the People's Republic of China under Mao Zedong had border conflicts at places like Zhenbao Island, leading to a long period of hostile relations.

description.zh-cn: 第四次中东战争后，萨达特领导下的埃及与苏联彻底闹翻，反目成仇。
description.en: After the Yom Kippur War, Egypt under Sadat's leadership had a complete falling out with the Soviet Union, becoming enemies.

description.zh-cn: 1979年，勃列日涅夫与美国总统卡特签订SALT II条约。
description.en: In 1979, Brezhnev and U.S. President Carter signed the SALT II treaty.

description.zh-cn: 1974年，勃列日涅夫与美国总统福特签订SALT I条约。
description.en: In 1974, Brezhnev and U.S. President Ford signed the SALT I treaty.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统里根的“星球大战计划”耗费了苏联大量财力，加剧了其经济困境。
description.en: U.S. President Reagan's 'Strategic Defense Initiative' drained significant financial resources from the Soviet Union, exacerbating its economic difficulties.

description.zh-cn: 丁磊于1997年在广州创立了网易公司。
description.en: Ding Lei founded NetEase in Guangzhou in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 丁磊是网易公司的董事长兼首席执行官。
description.en: Ding Lei is the Chairman and CEO of NetEase.

description.zh-cn: 2001年的互联网泡沫破灭对网易产生了很大影响，导致其股价一度跌破一美元。
description.en: The burst of the dot-com bubble in 2001 had a significant impact on NetEase, causing its stock price to fall below one dollar.

description.zh-cn: 因涉嫌财务欺诈，纳斯达克将网易公司的股票停牌。
description.en: NASDAQ suspended trading of NetEase's stock due to suspected financial fraud.

description.zh-cn: 暴雪娱乐宣布将《魔兽世界》在中国大陆的代理权从第九城市移交给网易公司。
description.en: Blizzard Entertainment announced the transfer of the operating license for World of Warcraft in mainland China from The9 to NetEase.

description.zh-cn: 暴雪娱乐将《魔兽世界》在中国大陆的代理权从第九城市移交给网易公司，结束了与第九城市的合作关系。
description.en: Blizzard Entertainment transferred the operating license for World of Warcraft in mainland China from The9 to NetEase, ending its partnership with The9.

description.zh-cn: 动视暴雪宣布由于未能达成新的代理协议，由网易代理的大部分暴雪游戏将在2023年1月23日暂停服务，结束了双方长期的合作关系。
description.en: Activision Blizzard announced that due to the failure to reach a new licensing agreement, most Blizzard games operated by NetEase would suspend service on January 23, 2023, ending the long-term partnership between the two parties.

description.zh-cn: 网易与中国电信合作推出移动社交应用“易信”。
description.en: NetEase partnered with China Telecom to launch the mobile social app 'Yixin'.

description.zh-cn: 中国电信与网易合作推出移动社交应用“易信”。
description.en: China Telecom partnered with NetEase to launch the mobile social app 'Yixin'.

description.zh-cn: 网易与微软达成协议，取得《我的世界》在中国市场的独家代理权。
description.en: NetEase reached an agreement with Microsoft to obtain the exclusive agency rights for Minecraft in the Chinese market.

description.zh-cn: 阿里巴巴集团参与了网易云音乐的B2轮融资，投资约7亿美元。
description.en: Alibaba Group participated in NetEase Cloud Music's Series B2 financing round with an investment of approximately $700 million.

description.zh-cn: 阿里巴巴集团以20亿美元全资收购网易考拉，使其成为旗下子公司。
description.en: Alibaba Group wholly acquired NetEase Kaola for $2 billion, making it a subsidiary.

description.zh-cn: 网易新闻于2024年1月8日发布了反映农民工生存状况的纪录片《如此打工三十年》。
description.en: On January 8, 2024, NetEase News released the documentary 'Thus Have I Toiled for Thirty Years', which depicts the living conditions of migrant workers.

description.zh-cn: 纪录片《如此打工三十年》发布后不久即被中国网络审查机构下架。
description.en: Shortly after its release, the documentary 'Thus Have I Toiled for Thirty Years' was taken down by Chinese internet censorship authorities.

description.zh-cn: 林德冠是中华人民共和国的政治人物。
description.en: Lin Deguan is a political figure in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 徐丰曾任中国共产主义青年团中央委员会书记处书记。
description.en: Xu Feng formerly served as a secretary of the Secretariat of the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党安仁县委员会依据《中国共产党章程》设立。
description.en: The CPC Anren County Committee is established in accordance with the Constitution of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党安仁县委员会是中国共产党的地方组织。
description.en: The CPC Anren County Committee is a local organization of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 在中国大陆的政治体制中，地方政府通常接受同级党委的领导。
description.en: In mainland China's political system, the local government is typically led by the party committee at the same level.

description.zh-cn: 根据Infobox信息，中央人民政府铁道部是中央人民政府政务院的下属机构。
description.en: According to the infobox, the Ministry of Railways of the Central People's Government was a subordinate agency of the State Administration Council of the Central People's Government.

relationships.source: BAIDU:中华人民共和国中央人民政府组织法

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府铁道部是根据《中华人民共和国中央人民政府组织法》第十八条的规定而设置的部门。
description.en: The Ministry of Railways of the Central People's Government was a department established in accordance with Article 18 of the 'Organic Law of the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China'.

relationships.target: BAIDU:中华人民共和国中央人民政府组织法

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议通过了《中华人民共和国中央人民政府组织法》。
description.en: The First Plenary Session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference passed the 'Organic Law of the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China'.

description.zh-cn: 第一届全国人民代表大会第一次会议后，中央人民政府政务院改组为中华人民共和国国务院，中央人民政府铁道部随之结束。
description.en: After the First Session of the First National People's Congress, the State Administration Council of the Central People's Government was reorganized into the State Council of the People's Republic of China, and the Ministry of Railways of the Central People's Government was subsequently dissolved.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院成立后，将原中央人民政府铁道部改为中华人民共和国铁道部。
description.en: After the establishment of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, the former Ministry of Railways of the Central People's Government was changed to the Ministry of Railways of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府铁道部在政务院财政经济委员会的指导下展开工作。
description.en: The Ministry of Railways of the Central People's Government operated under the guidance of the Finance and Economics Committee of the State Administration Council.

description.zh-cn: 中央军委铁道部是中央人民政府铁道部的前身。
description.en: The Railway Department of the Central Military Commission was the predecessor of the Ministry of Railways of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中央军委铁道部是中国人民解放军中央军事委员会所辖的部门。
description.en: The Railway Department of the Central Military Commission was a department under the jurisdiction of the Central Military Commission of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 为确保铁路运输以支援解放战争，中共中央决定成立中央军委铁道部。
description.en: To ensure railway transport to support the War of Liberation, the Central Committee of the CCP decided to establish the Railway Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民革命军事委员会于1949年1月10日做出《关于成立军委铁道部的决定》。
description.en: The People's Revolutionary Military Commission issued the 'Decision on the Establishment of the Railway Department of the Military Commission' on January 10, 1949.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次全国铁路工作会议上宣布成立军委铁道部的命令。
description.en: Announced the order to establish the Railway Department of the Military Commission at the first national railway work conference.

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府铁道部组织续建成渝铁路。
description.en: The Ministry of Railways of the Central People's Government organized the continued construction of the Chengdu-Chongqing Railway.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省人民代表大会常务委员会是浙江省人民代表大会的常设机构。
description.en: The Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress is the permanent body of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省人民代表大会是浙江省的地方级国家权力机关。
description.en: The Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress is the local state power organ of Zhejiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国宪法》是设立浙江省人民代表大会的授权法源。
description.en: The Constitution of the People's Republic of China is the authorizing legal source for the establishment of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国地方各级人民代表大会和地方各级人民政府组织法》是浙江省人民代表大会的组织法规。
description.en: The 'Organic Law of the Local People's Congresses and Local People's Governments of the People's Republic of China' serves as the organizational regulation for the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 纳尔逊·曼德拉与伊芙琳·梅斯于1944年结婚，并于1958年离婚。
description.en: Nelson Mandela and Evelyn Mase were married in 1944 and divorced in 1958.

description.zh-cn: 纳尔逊·曼德拉与温妮·马迪基泽拉于1958年结婚，1992年分居，并于1996年离婚。
description.en: Nelson Mandela and Winnie Madikizela married in 1958, separated in 1992, and divorced in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 纳尔逊·曼德拉与格拉萨·马谢尔于1998年结婚，直至曼德拉去世。
description.en: Nelson Mandela and Graça Machel married in 1998 and remained together until Mandela's death.

description.zh-cn: 纳尔逊·曼德拉长期是非洲人国民大会的核心成员，并于1991年至1997年担任其主席。
description.en: Nelson Mandela was a key member of the African National Congress for many years and served as its President from 1991 to 1997.

description.zh-cn: 历史研究及南非共产党官方确认，曼德拉在50年代末或60年代初曾加入南非共产党并在其中央委员会任职，直至1962年被捕。
description.en: Historical research and the SACP have confirmed that Mandela joined the South African Communist Party in the late 1950s or early 1960s and served on its Central Committee until his arrest in 1962.

description.zh-cn: 1961年，纳尔逊·曼德拉与乔·斯洛沃、瓦尔特·西苏卢共同创立了非洲人国民大会的武装组织“民族之矛”，并担任其主席。
description.en: In 1961, Nelson Mandela co-founded Umkhonto we Sizwe, the armed wing of the ANC, with Joe Slovo and Walter Sisulu, and served as its chairman.

description.zh-cn: 1961年，乔·斯洛沃与纳尔逊·曼德拉、瓦尔特·西苏卢共同创立了非洲人国民大会的武装组织“民族之矛”。
description.en: In 1961, Joe Slovo co-founded Umkhonto we Sizwe, the armed wing of the ANC, with Nelson Mandela and Walter Sisulu.

description.zh-cn: “民族之矛”是作为非洲人国民大会的武装联盟而成立的。
description.en: Umkhonto we Sizwe was established as the armed wing of the African National Congress.

description.zh-cn: 由于领导反对南非种族隔离制度的运动，纳尔逊·曼德拉被南非政府监禁了27年。
description.en: For leading the movement against the apartheid system, Nelson Mandela was imprisoned by the South African government for 27 years.

description.zh-cn: 1990年，时任南非总统的戴克拉克宣布无条件释放纳尔逊·曼德拉，并解除对非洲人国民大会等政党的禁令，开启了终结种族隔离的谈判进程。
description.en: In 1990, then-President F. W. de Klerk announced the unconditional release of Nelson Mandela and unbanned political parties like the ANC, initiating the negotiation process to end apartheid.

description.zh-cn: 纳尔逊·曼德拉在1994年南非首次多种族大选中当选为总统。
description.en: Nelson Mandela was elected president in South Africa's first multiracial general election in 1994.

description.zh-cn: 在曼德拉领导的全国统一政府中，戴克拉克担任第一副总统，直至1996年其所在的国民党退出联合政府。
description.en: In Mandela's Government of National Unity, F. W. de Klerk served as First Deputy President until his National Party withdrew from the coalition in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 在曼德拉担任总统期间，塔博·姆贝基担任副总统，并在曼德拉退休后接任总统。
description.en: During Mandela's presidency, Thabo Mbeki served as Deputy President and succeeded him as president upon his retirement.

description.zh-cn: 因其在结束南非种族隔离制度方面所作的努力，纳尔逊·曼德拉与戴克拉克共同获得1993年诺贝尔和平奖。
description.en: For their work in ending the apartheid system in South Africa, Nelson Mandela and F. W. de Klerk were jointly awarded the 1993 Nobel Peace Prize.

description.zh-cn: 因其在结束南非种族隔离制度方面所作的努力，戴克拉克与纳尔逊·曼德拉共同获得1993年诺贝尔和平奖。
description.en: For their work in ending the apartheid system in South Africa, F. W. de Klerk and Nelson Mandela were jointly awarded the 1993 Nobel Peace Prize.

description.zh-cn: 作为总统，纳尔逊·曼德拉监督成立了真相与和解委员会，以调查种族隔离时期的侵犯人权行为。
description.en: As president, Nelson Mandela oversaw the establishment of the Truth and Reconciliation Commission to investigate human rights abuses during apartheid.

description.zh-cn: 纳尔逊·曼德拉在1998年至1999年间担任不结盟运动秘书长。
description.en: Nelson Mandela served as the Secretary-General of the Non-Aligned Movement from 1998 to 1999.

description.zh-cn: 复兴路上工作室于2013年10月推出了其第一个视频作品《领导人是怎样炼成的》。
description.en: Studio on Fuxing Road launched its first video work, 'How Leaders Are Made', in October 2013.

description.zh-cn: 视频《领导人是怎样炼成的》介绍了美国国家领导人产生的过程。
description.en: The video 'How Leaders Are Made' introduces the process by which national leaders of the United States are selected.

description.zh-cn: 视频《领导人是怎样炼成的》介绍了英国国家领导人产生的过程。
description.en: The video 'How Leaders Are Made' introduces the process by which national leaders of the United Kingdom are selected.

description.zh-cn: 视频《领导人是怎样炼成的》介绍了中国国家领导人产生的过程。
description.en: The video 'How Leaders Are Made' introduces the process by which national leaders of China are selected.

description.zh-cn: 复兴路上工作室制作了多个以习近平为主题的宣传视频，例如关于其外交旅行和参与博鳌亚洲论坛的视频。
description.en: Studio on Fuxing Road has produced multiple propaganda videos featuring Xi Jinping, such as those about his diplomatic trips and his participation in the Boao Forum for Asia.

description.zh-cn: 复兴路上工作室于2015年10月推出了单曲MV《十三五之歌》。
description.en: Studio on Fuxing Road released the music video single 'The Song of the 13th Five-Year Plan' in October 2015.

description.zh-cn: 《十三五之歌》以说唱方式对十三五规划进行了解释和宣传。
description.en: 'The Song of the 13th Five-Year Plan' explains and promotes the 13th Five-Year Plan through rap music.

description.zh-cn: 中共十八届五中全会讨论并审议通过了《中共中央关于制定国民经济和社会发展第十三个五年规划的建议》。
description.en: The Fifth Plenary Session of the 18th CPC Central Committee discussed, deliberated on, and adopted the 'Proposals of the CPC Central Committee for the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development'.

description.zh-cn: 复兴路上工作室通常在优酷网上发布其制作的视频。
description.en: Studio on Fuxing Road typically releases its videos on Youku.

description.zh-cn: 复兴路上工作室将其制作的一小部分视频发布在YouTube上。
description.en: Studio on Fuxing Road releases a small portion of its videos on YouTube.

description.zh-cn: 2022年12月13日被开除党籍。
description.en: Expelled from the Communist Party of China on December 13, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 美国国务院是美国联邦政府负责外交事务的行政部门。
description.en: The Department of State is an executive department of the U.S. federal government responsible for foreign affairs.

description.zh-cn: 美国外交部于1789年9月15日更名为美国国务院，成为其前身。
description.en: The Department of Foreign Affairs was renamed the Department of State on September 15, 1789, becoming its predecessor.

description.zh-cn: 美国宪法规定美国总统负责处理国家的外交事务。
description.en: The U.S. Constitution stipulates that the President of the United States is responsible for handling the nation's foreign affairs.

description.zh-cn: 美国国务卿是美国总统外交政策的主要顾问，直接对总统负责。
description.en: The Secretary of State is the principal foreign policy advisor to the President of the United States and reports directly to the President.

description.zh-cn: 担任首任美国国务卿。
description.en: Served as the first United States Secretary of State.

description.zh-cn: 担任美国副国务卿。
description.en: Serves as the United States Deputy Secretary of State.

description.zh-cn: 美国副国务卿是美国国务院中次于国务卿的官员。
description.en: The Deputy Secretary of State is the official second in rank to the Secretary of State in the U.S. Department of State.

description.zh-cn: 郭澄清曾担任中国作家协会山东分会副主席。
description.en: Guo Chenqing served as the vice-chairman of the Shandong branch of the China Writers Association.

description.zh-cn: 根据其维基百科页面的分类“中国共产党党员”可知，郭澄清是中国共产党的党员。
description.en: According to the category 'Communist Party of China members' on his Wikipedia page, Guo Chenqing was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据其维基百科页面的分类“中国作家协会会员”可知，郭澄清是中国作家协会的会员。
description.en: According to the category 'China Writers Association members' on his Wikipedia page, Guo Chenqing was a member of the China Writers Association.

description.zh-cn: 中国作家协会山东分会是中国作家协会的分支机构。
description.en: The Shandong Branch of the China Writers Association is a branch of the China Writers Association.

description.zh-cn: 财讯传媒是无界传媒的共同投资创立方之一。
description.en: Caijing Media is one of the co-founding investors of Wujie Media.

description.zh-cn: 新疆维吾尔自治区人民政府是无界传媒的共同投资创立方之一。
description.en: The Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region People's Government is one of the co-founding investors of Wujie Media.

description.zh-cn: 阿里巴巴集团是无界传媒的共同投资创立方之一。
description.en: Alibaba Group is one of the co-founding investors of Wujie Media.

description.zh-cn: 无界新闻是由无界传媒举办和运营的新闻网站。
description.en: Wujie News is a news website organized and operated by Wujie Media.

description.zh-cn: 2016年3月4日，无界新闻刊登了《关于要求习近平同志辞去党和国家领导职务的公开信》。
description.en: On March 4, 2016, Wujie News published the 'Open Letter Requesting Comrade Xi Jinping to Resign from Party and State Leadership Positions'.

description.zh-cn: 公开信以“忠诚的共产党员”名义，要求习近平辞去党和国家领导职务。
description.en: The open letter, in the name of 'loyal Communist Party members', demanded that Xi Jinping resign from his party and state leadership positions.

description.zh-cn: 事件发生后，无界新闻网站停止更新并最终结束运营。
description.en: After the incident, the Wujie News website stopped updating and eventually ceased operations.

description.zh-cn: 事件发生后，股东之一的阿里巴巴集团提出将无界传媒清盘。
description.en: After the incident, Alibaba Group, one of the shareholders, proposed to liquidate Wujie Media.

description.zh-cn: 因公开信事件，无界新闻执行主编黄志杰被警方扣押调查，后于5月初获释。
description.en: Due to the open letter incident, Wujie News Executive Editor Huang Zhijie was detained by police for investigation and was released in early May.

description.zh-cn: 因被认为与公开信事件有关，贾葭于2016年3月15日被公安带走，被扣10日后获释。
description.en: Believed to be related to the open letter incident, Jia Jia was taken away by public security on March 15, 2016, and released after being detained for 10 days.

description.zh-cn: 温云超声称其在中国的家人因公开信事件而被捕。
description.en: Wen Yunchao claimed that his family in China was arrested because of the open letter incident.

description.zh-cn: 长平声称其家人因他对此事件发表评论而被带走。
description.en: Chang Ping claimed his family was taken away because of his comments on this incident.

description.zh-cn: 2016年3月30日，中华人民共和国外交部就公开信事件作出回应，表示“任何企图破坏中国国家稳定的行为，都不可能得逞”。
description.en: On March 30, 2016, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China responded to the open letter incident, stating that 'any attempt to destabilize China is doomed to fail'.

description.zh-cn: 黄志杰是无界新闻的执行主编。
description.en: Huang Zhijie was the Executive Editor of Wujie News.

position.en: Former Editor of the Commentary Section

description.zh-cn: 贾葭曾是《端传媒》传媒评论部的主编。
description.en: Jia Jia was formerly the editor of the commentary section at Initium Media.

description.zh-cn: 王光谦在2023年3月10日当选为中国人民政治协商会议第十四届全国委员会副主席。
description.en: Wang Guangqian was elected as a Vice Chairman of the 14th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference on March 10, 2023.

description.zh-cn: 在中国人民政治协商会议第十四届全国委员会中，王光谦担任副主席，主席是王沪宁。
description.en: In the 14th National Committee of the CPPCC, Wang Guangqian serves as Vice Chairman under Chairman Wang Huning.

description.zh-cn: 王光谦出生于河南省镇平县。
description.en: Wang Guangqian was born in Zhenping County, Henan Province.

description.zh-cn: 王光谦自2023年3月起担任全国政协副主席，成为副国级领导人。
description.en: Since March 2023, Wang Guangqian has served as the Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, becoming a national-level deputy leader.

description.zh-cn: 王光谦作为全国政协副主席，是党和国家领导人之一。
description.en: As a Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, Wang Guangqian is one of the Party and state leaders.

description.zh-cn: 1978年至1982年，王光谦在武汉水利电力学院治河工程专业学习。
description.en: From 1978 to 1982, Wang Guangqian studied River Engineering at Wuhan Institute of Hydraulic and Electric Engineering.

description.zh-cn: 1985年，王光谦获得清华大学水利工程硕士学位。1989年，王光谦获得清华大学水利工程博士学位。
description.en: In 1985, Wang Guangqian obtained a Master's degree in Hydraulic Engineering from Tsinghua University. In 1989, Wang Guangqian obtained a Doctoral degree in Hydraulic Engineering from Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 1990年至1992年，王光谦在中国科学院力学研究所从事博士后研究。
description.en: From 1990 to 1992, Wang Guangqian was a postdoctoral researcher at the Institute of Mechanics, Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 王光谦于1992年起在清华大学水利水电工程系任教，后成为博士生导师；并于2021年10月被任命为清华大学副校长。
description.en: Wang Guangqian began teaching at the Department of Hydraulic and Hydroelectric Engineering at Tsinghua University in 1992, later becoming a doctoral supervisor; he was also appointed as the Vice President of Tsinghua University in October 2021.

description.zh-cn: 2009年，王光谦当选为中国科学院院士。
description.en: In 2009, Wang Guangqian was elected as an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 2013年7月至2021年10月，王光谦担任青海大学校长。
description.en: From July 2013 to October 2021, Wang Guangqian served as the president of Qinghai University.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，王光谦当选为第十一届全国政协常务委员。
description.en: In 2008, Wang Guangqian was elected as a member of the Standing Committee of the 11th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 2018年1月，王光谦当选为第十三届全国政协委员。
description.en: In January 2018, Wang Guangqian was elected as a member of the 13th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 2022年12月，王光谦当选民盟中央常务副主席。
description.en: In December 2022, Wang Guangqian was elected Executive Vice Chairman of the Central Committee of the China Democratic League.

description.zh-cn: 武汉水利电力学院后来并入武汉大学，其相关院系成为武汉大学的一部分（如武汉大学水利水电学院）。
description.en: Wuhan Institute of Hydraulic and Electric Engineering was later merged into Wuhan University, and its related departments became part of Wuhan University (e.g., the School of Water Resources and Hydropower Engineering).

description.zh-cn: 王光谦卸任青海大学校长，由史元春接任。
description.en: Wang Guangqian stepped down as the president of Qinghai University, and was succeeded by Shi Yuanchun.

description.zh-cn: 王光谦接替陈晓光，出任中国民主同盟中央委员会常务副主席。
description.en: Wang Guangqian succeeded Chen Xiaoguang as the Executive Vice Chairman of the Central Committee of the China Democratic League.

description.zh-cn: 北京时间是中国大陆的标准时间。
description.en: Beijing Time is the standard time for Mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 北京时间定义为UTC+8，比世界协调时快八小时。
description.en: Beijing Time is defined as UTC+8, which is 8 hours ahead of Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

description.zh-cn: 通过其原子钟组精密计算和比对来生成和发布北京时间。
description.en: Generates and disseminates Beijing Time through precise calculation and comparison of its atomic clock ensembles.

description.zh-cn: 1912年中华民国建立后，将全国划分为五个时区。
description.en: After the establishment of the Republic of China in 1912, it divided the country into five time zones.

description.zh-cn: 召开标准时间会议，确认了1912年划分的五个时区为中国标准时区。
description.en: Convened a conference on standard time and confirmed the five time zones established in 1912 as the standard time zones of China.

description.zh-cn: 决定自1947年4月1日起，东北解放区统一实行东经120度上海时间（即后来的北京时间）。
description.en: Decided that from April 1, 1947, the Northeast Liberated Area would uniformly adopt the Shanghai time of 120th meridian east (which later became Beijing Time).

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，正式将UTC+8时区命名为北京时间，并在全国范围内推行单一时区。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, the UTC+8 time zone was officially named Beijing Time, and a single time zone was implemented nationwide.

description.zh-cn: 宣布电台时间一律以北京时间为准。
description.en: Announced that the station's time would be based on Beijing Time.

description.zh-cn: 通知全市自1949年11月3日起改用北京时间。
description.en: Notified the entire city to switch to Beijing Time starting from November 3, 1949.

description.zh-cn: 于1949年12月27日进驻成都后，宣布改用北京时间。
description.en: After entering Chengdu on December 27, 1949, announced the switch to Beijing Time.

description.zh-cn: 废除了中华民国时期的多时区划分，逐步在全国推行统一的北京时间。
description.en: Abolished the multi-time zone system of the Republic of China era and gradually implemented a unified Beijing Time across the country.

description.zh-cn: 在新疆，由于统一采用北京时间，导致政府和部分民众的作息时间通常会比东部地区延后2小时，以适应当地的日照情况。
description.en: In Xinjiang, the uniform use of Beijing Time leads to government and some public schedules being typically delayed by 2 hours compared to eastern regions to align with local daylight conditions.

description.zh-cn: 1986年2月，批准新疆维吾尔自治区实行新疆时间（UTC+6），主要用于民用作息，但此方案未完全实施。
description.en: In February 1986, it approved the implementation of Xinjiang Time (UTC+6) in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, primarily for civilian schedules, though this plan was not fully implemented.

description.zh-cn: 在新疆的维吾尔族等民族的民众中，普遍在日常生活中使用新疆时间（乌鲁木齐时间）。
description.en: Among the Uyghur and other ethnic groups in Xinjiang, Xinjiang Time (Ürümqi Time) is commonly used in daily life.

description.zh-cn: 当用户定位在乌鲁木齐时，iOS 8系统会自动显示为UTC+6的新疆时间。
description.en: When a user's location is set to Ürümqi, the iOS 8 system automatically displays the time as UTC+6, which is Xinjiang Time.

description.zh-cn: 在2005年两会期间，一些代表提出将中国时区进行细分的建议。
description.en: During the Two Sessions in 2005, some deputies proposed to subdivide China's time zones.

description.zh-cn: 1986年4月，与国务院办公厅联合发出《在全国范围内实行夏时制的通知》。
description.en: In April 1986, jointly issued the 'Notice on the Implementation of Daylight Saving Time Nationwide' with the General Office of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 1986年4月，与中共中央办公厅联合发出《在全国范围内实行夏时制的通知》。
description.en: In April 1986, jointly issued the 'Notice on the Implementation of Daylight Saving Time Nationwide' with the General Office of the Central Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 在1986年至1991年间，在全国范围实行了六年夏时制。
description.en: Implemented daylight saving time nationwide for six years from 1986 to 1991.

description.zh-cn: 发文宣布自1992年起暂停实行夏时制，此后未再恢复。
description.en: Issued a document announcing the suspension of daylight saving time from 1992, and it has not been resumed since.

description.zh-cn: 高素是阎明复的母亲。
description.en: Gao Su is the mother of Yan Mingfu.

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆时任中共中央办公厅主任。
description.en: Yang Shangkun was the Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee at the time.

description.zh-cn: 汪东兴时任中共中央办公厅主任。
description.en: Wang Dongxing was the Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee at the time.

description.zh-cn: 阎宝航因被指控为“东北帮叛党投敌反革命集团”成员而被捕，并于1968年在秦城监狱去世。
description.en: Yan Baohang was arrested for being accused as a member of the 'Northeast Gang Treason and Defection Counter-revolutionary Clique' and died in Qincheng Prison in 1968.

description.zh-cn: 阎明复受父亲阎宝航的案件牵连，以“苏修特务”等罪名被捕，在秦城监狱关押至1975年。
description.en: Implicated in his father Yan Baohang's case, Yan Mingfu was arrested on charges such as 'Soviet revisionist special agent' and was imprisoned in Qincheng Prison until 1975.

description.zh-cn: 在毛泽东的指示下，阎明复于1975年4月获释出狱。
description.en: Under Mao Zedong's instruction, Yan Mingfu was released from prison in April 1975.

position.zh-cn: 全国人大常委会副秘书长
position.en: Deputy Secretary-General of the NPC Standing Committee

description.zh-cn: 彭真时任全国人大常委会委员长。
description.en: Peng Zhen was the Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee at the time.

description.zh-cn: 1985年，经杨尚昆推荐，阎明复出任中共中央统战部部长。
description.en: In 1985, upon Yang Shangkun's recommendation, Yan Mingfu was appointed as the Head of the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 赵紫阳时任中共中央总书记。
description.en: Zhao Ziyang was the General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee at the time.

description.zh-cn: 因在六四事件过程中的表现，阎明复被免去中央书记处书记等职务。
description.en: Due to his actions during the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, Yan Mingfu was dismissed from his positions, including Secretary of the Central Secretariat.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十三届四中全会上，阎明复被免去中央书记处书记职务。
description.en: At the Fourth Plenary Session of the 13th Central Committee of the CPC, Yan Mingfu was removed from his post as Secretary of the Central Secretariat.

description.zh-cn: 崔乃夫时任民政部部长。
description.en: Cui Naifu was the Minister of Civil Affairs at the time.

description.zh-cn: 多吉才让时任民政部部长。
description.en: Doje Cering was the Minister of Civil Affairs at the time.

description.zh-cn: 阎明复参与创办了中华慈善总会。
description.en: Yan Mingfu participated in the founding of the China Charity Federation.

description.zh-cn: 阎明复在担任中国大百科全书出版社副总编辑期间，大力推动了《中国大百科全书》的编纂工作。
description.en: During his tenure as deputy editor-in-chief of the Encyclopedia of China Publishing House, Yan Mingfu vigorously promoted the compilation of the Encyclopedia of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年11月，温家宝前往医院看望阎明复。
description.en: In November 2018, Wen Jiabao visited Yan Mingfu in the hospital.

position.en: Deputy Head of the United Front Work Department

description.zh-cn: 阎明复时任中共中央统战部部长。
description.en: Yan Mingfu was the Head of the United Front Work Department at the time.

description.zh-cn: 李松泉是拉祜族人。
description.en: Li Songquan is of the Lahu ethnicity.

description.zh-cn: 毕业于中央党校经济管理专业。
description.en: Graduated from the Central Party School with a major in Economic Management.

description.zh-cn: 2013年，担任第十二届全国人民代表大会云南地区代表。
description.en: In 2013, served as a delegate from the Yunnan region to the 12th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 李庆华是前行政院院长李焕之子。
description.en: Lee Ching-hua is the son of former Premier Lee Huan.

description.zh-cn: 李庆华是李庆安的哥哥。
description.en: Lee Ching-hua is the brother of Lee Ching-an.

description.zh-cn: 与赵少康、郁慕明等人共同脱离国民党创立新党。
description.en: Co-founded the New Party with Jaw Shaw-kong and Yok Mu-ming after leaving the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 在2016年立法委员选举中击败李庆华，使其无缘八连霸，结束其23年的立委生涯。
description.en: Defeated Lee Ching-hua in the 2016 legislative election, preventing him from securing an eighth term and ending his 23-year career as a legislator.

description.zh-cn: 在2000年总统选举前夕退出新党，转而支持亲民党候选人宋楚瑜。
description.en: Left the New Party before the 2000 presidential election to support People First Party candidate James Soong.

description.zh-cn: 在国民党立委初选中败给张庆忠后，公开批评张庆忠买人头党员作弊、贿选。
description.en: After losing to Chang Ching-chung in a KMT legislative primary, he publicly criticized Chang for cheating and vote-buying through bogus party members.

description.zh-cn: 在立法院与邱议莹发生冲突，李庆华骂其为泼妇，邱议莹则回赏巴掌。
description.en: Had a conflict with Chiu Yi-ying in the Legislative Yuan, where Lee called her a shrew and Chiu slapped him in response.

description.zh-cn: 作为强势挑战者参选2012年立法委员选举，与李庆华竞争。罗福助曾于立法院殴打李庆华的妹妹李庆安。
description.en: Competed against Lee Ching-hua as a strong challenger in the 2012 legislative election. Lo Fu-chu had previously assaulted Lee's sister, Lee Ching-an, in the Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 因李庆华在贪污案中两次传唤未到庭，新北地方法院对其发布通缉。
description.en: The New Taipei District Court issued an arrest warrant for Lee Ching-hua after he failed to appear in court twice for his corruption case.

description.zh-cn: 李庆华因被以贪污罪起诉，其政治生涯终结并成为通缉犯。
description.en: Lee Ching-hua's political career ended and he became a fugitive after being indicted on corruption charges.

description.zh-cn: 时任中国奥委会主席何振梁与时任中华奥委会秘书长李庆华签署协议，确定了“中华台北”的称谓。
description.en: Then-Chairman of the Chinese Olympic Committee He Zhenliang and then-Secretary-General of the Chinese Taipei Olympic Committee Lee Ching-hua signed an agreement confirming the use of the name 'Chinese Taipei'.

description.zh-cn: 因不满党主席宋楚瑜与时任总统陈水扁会面，与邱毅共同退出亲民党。
description.en: Left the People First Party together with Chiu Yi due to dissatisfaction with party chairman James Soong's meeting with then-president Chen Shui-bian.

description.zh-cn: 在2017年中国国民党主席选举中，表态支持吴敦义。
description.en: Expressed support for Wu Den-yih in the 2017 Kuomintang chairmanship election.

description.zh-cn: 发动罢免李庆华的行动。
description.en: Initiated a movement to recall Lee Ching-hua.

description.zh-cn: 与其他五位立法委员共同提出修正草案，旨在提高罢免门槛。
description.en: Co-proposed an amendment with five other legislators to raise the threshold for recalls.

description.zh-cn: 1945年9月，中国共产党命令党员蔡孝干返回台湾成立组织。
description.en: In September 1945, the Communist Party of China ordered party member Cai Xiaogan to return to Taiwan to establish an organization.

description.zh-cn: 1946年8月，蔡孝干返台后召集会议，成立了中国共产党台湾省工作委员会。
description.en: In August 1946, after returning to Taiwan, Cai Xiaogan convened a meeting and established the Taiwan Provincial Work Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，中国共产党台湾省工作委员会是中共中央华东局的下级机构。
description.en: According to the infobox, the Taiwan Provincial Work Committee of the Communist Party of China was a subordinate body of the East China Bureau of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 蔡孝干担任中国共产党台湾省工作委员会的首任书记。
description.en: Cai Xiaogan served as the first secretary of the Taiwan Provincial Work Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 陈福星在蔡孝干被捕后接任中国共产党台湾省工作委员会书记。
description.en: Chen Fuxing took over as secretary of the Taiwan Provincial Work Committee of the Communist Party of China after Cai Xiaogan was arrested.

position.en: Deputy Secretary, Standing Committee Member, Head of Armed Work Department

description.zh-cn: 张志忠担任中国共产党台湾省工作委员会副书记、常委及武工部长。
description.en: Zhang Zhizhong served as Deputy Secretary, Standing Committee Member, and Head of the Armed Work Department of the Taiwan Provincial Work Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 金尧如于1947年加入，担任中国共产党台湾省工作委员会常委兼宣传部长。
description.en: Jin Yaoru joined in 1947 and served as a Standing Committee Member and Propaganda Minister of the Taiwan Provincial Work Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 作为中共在台组织，与执政的国民党处于敌对状态，并最终被其瓦解。
description.en: As a CPC organization in Taiwan, it was in a hostile state with the ruling Kuomintang and was eventually dismantled by it.

description.zh-cn: 1952年，中国国民党瓦解了中共台湾省工委在台的领导机构。
description.en: In 1952, the Kuomintang dismantled the leadership structure of the CPC Taiwan Provincial Work Committee in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党台湾省工作委员会在台北市发行《光明报》作为其机关报。
description.en: The Taiwan Provincial Work Committee of the Communist Party of China published the "Guangming Daily" in Taipei as its official newspaper.

description.zh-cn: 1949年8月，中华民国政府破获了中共台湾省工委发行的《光明报》。
description.en: In August 1949, the government of the Republic of China uncovered the "Guangming Daily" published by the CPC Taiwan Provincial Work Committee.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争的爆发迫使中国人民解放军放弃跨海进攻台湾的计划。
description.en: The outbreak of the Korean War forced the People's Liberation Army to abandon its plan to attack Taiwan across the sea.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争爆发后，美国海军开进台湾海峡，阻止了解放军进攻台湾。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Korean War, the U.S. Navy entered the Taiwan Strait, preventing the People's Liberation Army from attacking Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 1950年3月，中共台湾省工委书记蔡孝干被捕。
description.en: In March 1950, Cai Xiaogan, secretary of the CPC Taiwan Provincial Work Committee, was arrested.

description.zh-cn: 蔡孝干被捕后变节，并供出中共在台人员，导致千余人遭到株连，严重打击了省工委组织。
description.en: After his arrest, Cai Xiaogan defected and exposed CPC personnel in Taiwan, implicating over a thousand people and severely damaging the Provincial Work Committee's organization.

description.zh-cn: 张志忠于1950年5月被捕，并于1954年3月遭到枪决。
description.en: Zhang Zhizhong was arrested in May 1950 and executed by firing squad in March 1954.

description.zh-cn: 张志忠被捕后，蒋经国多次到狱中探望并试图劝降，但遭到拒绝。
description.en: After Zhang Zhizhong's arrest, Chiang Ching-kuo visited him in prison multiple times to persuade him to surrender, but was refused.

description.zh-cn: 李毅章是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Li Yizhang was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 李毅章于1918年出生于河南偃师。
description.en: Li Yizhang was born in Yanshi, Henan in 1918.

description.zh-cn: 在卸任中共萍乡市委书记后转任江西省革命委员会副主任。
description.en: After leaving his post as Secretary of the CPC Pingxiang Municipal Committee, he was transferred to the position of Vice Chairman of the Jiangxi Provincial Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh-cn: 第五届全国人民代表大会的任期为1978年3月至1983年6月。李毅章于1981年任内逝世。
description.en: The term of the 5th National People's Congress was from March 1978 to June 1983. Li Yizhang passed away in office in 1981.

description.zh-cn: 李斌担任新疆生产建设兵团第十二师政治委员、党委书记。
description.en: Li Bin serves as the Political Commissar and Party Secretary of the 12th Division of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps.

description.zh-cn: 第十二师是新疆生产建设兵团的下属师级单位。
description.en: The 12th Division is a subordinate division-level unit of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps.

description.zh-cn: 2012年12月，新疆生产建设兵团农业建设第十二师更名为新疆生产建设兵团第十二师。
description.en: In December 2012, the 12th Agricultural Construction Division of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps was renamed the 12th Division of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps.

description.zh-cn: 2004年2月，原属农十三师的二二一团划归农十二师管辖。
description.en: In February 2004, the 221st Regiment, formerly of the 13th Agricultural Division, was placed under the jurisdiction of the 12th Agricultural Division.

description.zh-cn: 二二二团原为兵团直属单位，于2013年12月划归第十二师管辖。
description.en: The 222nd Regiment was originally a unit directly under the Corps and was transferred to the jurisdiction of the 12th Division in December 2013.

description.zh-cn: 2013年12月，兵团直属二二二团划归第十二师管辖。
description.en: In December 2013, the 222nd Regiment, a unit directly under the Corps, was placed under the jurisdiction of the 12th Division.

description.zh-cn: 老兵镇由新疆生产建设兵团第十二师代管。
description.en: Laobing Town is managed by the 12th Division of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps.

description.zh-cn: 老兵镇与新疆生产建设兵团第十四师四十七团实行“团镇合一”的管理模式。
description.en: Laobing Town and the 47th Regiment of the 14th Division of the XPCC operate under a unified management model of 'regiment-town integration'.

description.zh-cn: 四十七团是新疆生产建设兵团第十四师的下属团级单位。
description.en: The 47th Regiment is a subordinate regiment-level unit of the 14th Division of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps.

description.zh-cn: 王薇君是王昊的姑姑。
description.en: Wang Wei-chun is Wang Hao's aunt.

position.en: Chairperson of the New Taipei City Chapter

description.zh-cn: 王薇君于2022年3月加入时代力量并担任新北党部主委，后于2023年10月23日完成退党程序。
description.en: Wang Wei-chun joined the New Power Party in March 2022 and served as the chairperson of its New Taipei City chapter, later completing the procedure to withdraw from the party on October 23, 2023.

description.zh-cn: 1982年毕业于山东大学哲学系。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Philosophy at Shandong University in 1982.

description.zh-cn: 2003年获西北政法学院法律硕士学位。
description.en: Obtained a Master of Laws degree from Northwest University of Political Science and Law in 2003.

position.en: Officer, Deputy Division Chief, Division Chief

description.zh-cn: 1982年至1993年期间，在中共中央纪律检查委员会历任干事、副处长、处长。
description.en: From 1982 to 1993, he served successively as an officer, deputy division chief, and division chief at the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 2007年12月转任河南省高级人民法院党组书记，次年1月任院长。
description.en: Transferred to the position of Party Group Secretary of the Henan High People's Court in December 2007, and became President the following January.

description.zh-cn: 曾任第十一届、第十二届全国人大代表（河南省）。
description.en: Served as a delegate to the 11th and 12th National People's Congress (Henan).

description.zh-cn: 张立勇接替宋洪武担任中国共产党咸阳市委员会书记职务。
description.en: Zhang Liyong succeeded Song Hongwu as the Secretary of the CCP Xianyang Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 张立勇的中国共产党咸阳市委员会书记和咸阳市市长职务均由千军昌接替。
description.en: Qian Junchang succeeded Zhang Liyong as both the Secretary of the CCP Xianyang Municipal Committee and the Mayor of Xianyang.

description.zh-cn: 张立勇接替马铁山担任中国共产党咸阳市秦都区委员会书记职务。
description.en: Zhang Liyong succeeded Ma Tieshan as the Secretary of the CCP Qindu District Committee in Xianyang.

description.zh-cn: 张立勇的中国共产党咸阳市秦都区委员会书记职务由徐新荣接替。
description.en: Xu Xinrong succeeded Zhang Liyong as the Secretary of the CCP Qindu District Committee in Xianyang.

description.zh-cn: 张立勇接替李堂堂担任咸阳市市长职务。
description.en: Zhang Liyong succeeded Li Tangtang as the Mayor of Xianyang.

description.zh-cn: 张立勇接替李道民担任河南省高级人民法院院长职务。
description.en: Zhang Liyong succeeded Li Daomin as the President of the Henan High People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 张立勇的河南省高级人民法院院长职务由胡道才接替。
description.en: Hu Daocai succeeded Zhang Liyong as the President of the Henan High People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 段晓赛于2021年10月29日当选为衡山县人民政府县长。
description.en: Duan Xiaosai was elected as the County Mayor of the Hengshan County People's Government on October 29, 2021.

description.zh-cn: 蒋青于2016年7月至2021年4月期间担任衡山县人民政府县长。
description.en: Jiang Qing served as the County Mayor of the Hengshan County People's Government from July 2016 to April 2021.

description.zh-cn: 衡山县人民政府是衡阳市人民政府的业务下级机构。
description.en: The Hengshan County People's Government is professionally subordinate to the Hengyang Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 杨亮才出生于云南洱源。
description.en: Yang Liangcai was born in Eryuan, Yunnan.

description.zh-cn: 杨亮才曾担任中国民间文艺出版社的社长兼总编辑。
description.en: Yang Liangcai was the former president and editor-in-chief of the China Folk Literature and Art Publishing House.

position.zh-cn: 第三届理事会常务理事

description.zh-cn: 杨亮才担任中国民间文艺家协会第三届理事会常务理事，该协会亦曾被称为中国民间文艺研究会。
description.en: Yang Liangcai served as the Standing Director of the 3rd Council of the China Folk Literature and Art Association, which was also referred to as the China Folk Art Research Association.

position.zh-cn: 第四届、第五届全国委员会委员
position.en: Member of the 4th and 5th National Committees

description.zh-cn: 根据页面模板信息，杨亮才是中国文学艺术界联合会第四届和第五届全国委员会的委员。
description.en: According to the page template information, Yang Liangcai was a member of the 4th and 5th National Committees of the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，杨亮才是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the page category information, Yang Liangcai is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，杨亮才是中国作家协会会员。
description.en: According to the page category information, Yang Liangcai is a member of the China Writers Association.

description.zh-cn: 2018年3月，刘修文当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员。
description.en: In March 2018, Liu Xiuwen was elected as a member of the Standing Committee of the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 2018年3月，刘修文当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会财政经济委员会委员。
description.en: In March 2018, Liu Xiuwen was elected as a member of the Financial and Economic Affairs Committee of the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 刘修文担任全国人大财政经济委员会委员，该委员会的主任是徐绍史。
description.en: Liu Xiuwen served as a member of the Financial and Economic Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress, while Xu Shaoshi was the chairman of the committee.

description.zh-cn: 刘修文自2013年10月起担任全国人大常委会预算工作委员会副主任，此前曾任该委员会法案室副主任。
description.en: Since October 2013, Liu Xiuwen has served as the Deputy Director of the Budgetary Affairs Commission of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. He previously served as the Deputy Director of the Bill Office of the same commission.

description.zh-cn: 刘修文担任全国人大常委会预算工作委员会副主任期间，廖晓军是其上级主任之一。
description.en: During Liu Xiuwen's tenure as Deputy Director of the Budgetary Affairs Commission of the NPC Standing Committee, Liao Xiaojun was one of his superior directors.

description.zh-cn: 刘修文担任全国人大常委会预算工作委员会副主任期间，刘昆是其上级主任之一。
description.en: During Liu Xiuwen's tenure as Deputy Director of the Budgetary Affairs Commission of the NPC Standing Committee, Liu Kun was one of his superior directors.

description.zh-cn: 刘修文担任全国人大常委会预算工作委员会副主任期间，史耀斌是其上级主任之一。
description.en: During Liu Xiuwen's tenure as Deputy Director of the Budgetary Affairs Commission of the NPC Standing Committee, Shi Yaobin was one of his superior directors.

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，刘修文当选为第十三届全国人大代表（山东省）。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Liu Xiuwen was elected as a delegate to the 13th National People's Congress, representing Shandong Province.

description.zh-cn: 先后代表爱丁堡鹏特兰选区（1974-1997）和肯辛顿选区（2005-2015）担任国会议员。
description.en: Served as Member of Parliament, first for Edinburgh Pentlands (1974-1997) and then for Kensington (2005-2015).

description.zh-cn: 在玛格丽特·撒切尔担任首相期间，马尔康·芮夫金在其内阁中担任苏格兰事务大臣。
description.en: During Margaret Thatcher's premiership, Malcolm Rifkind served in her cabinet as Secretary of State for Scotland.

position.zh-cn: 交通大臣、国防大臣、外交及国协事务大臣
position.en: Secretary of State for Transport, Secretary of State for Defence, Secretary of State for Foreign and Commonwealth Affairs

description.zh-cn: 在约翰·梅杰担任首相期间，马尔康·芮夫金先后在其内阁中担任交通大臣、国防大臣和外交及国协事务大臣。
description.en: During John Major's premiership, Malcolm Rifkind served successively in his cabinet as Secretary of State for Transport, Secretary of State for Defence, and Secretary of State for Foreign and Commonwealth Affairs.

position.en: Shadow Secretary of State for Work and Pensions

description.zh-cn: 在迈克尔·霍华德担任保守党党魁期间，马尔康·芮夫金在影子内阁中担任就业及年金影子大臣。
description.en: While Michael Howard was Leader of the Conservative Party, Malcolm Rifkind served in the Shadow Cabinet as Shadow Secretary of State for Work and Pensions.

description.zh-cn: 首相甘民乐上任后，任命马尔康·芮夫金为情报和安全委员会主席。
description.en: After becoming Prime Minister, David Cameron appointed Malcolm Rifkind as Chairman of the Intelligence and Security Committee.

description.zh-cn: 马尔康·芮夫金的就业及年金影子大臣职位由夏文达接替。
description.en: Malcolm Rifkind was succeeded as Shadow Secretary of State for Work and Pensions by Philip Hammond.

description.zh-cn: 马尔康·芮夫金接替韩达德担任外交及国协事务大臣。
description.en: Malcolm Rifkind succeeded Douglas Hurd as Secretary of State for Foreign and Commonwealth Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 马尔康·芮夫金的外交及国协事务大臣职位由郭伟邦接替。
description.en: Malcolm Rifkind was succeeded as Secretary of State for Foreign and Commonwealth Affairs by Robin Cook.

description.zh-cn: 刘伟全于2003年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Liu Weiquan joined the Communist Party of China in 2003.

description.zh-cn: 1998年的亚洲金融风暴导致刘伟全的房地产生意失败。
description.en: The 1998 Asian financial crisis led to the failure of Liu Weiquan's real estate business.

description.zh-cn: 中国证券监督管理委员会于1992年10月成立，是国务院直属机构。
description.en: The China Securities Regulatory Commission was established in October 1992 as an institution directly under the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国证券监督管理委员会是中华人民共和国国务院的直属机构。
description.en: The China Securities Regulatory Commission is a directly subordinate institution of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据1997年全国金融工作会议的决定，中国证监会接管了原由中国人民银行监管的证券经营机构。
description.en: Following the decision of the 1997 National Financial Work Conference, the CSRC took over the regulation of securities operating institutions from the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 2023年3月，中国证监会的投资者保护职责被划入新成立的国家金融监督管理总局。
description.en: In March 2023, the CSRC's investor protection responsibilities were transferred to the newly established National Financial Regulatory Administration.

description.zh-cn: 2023年3月，国家发展和改革委员会的企业债券发行审核职责划入中国证监会。
description.en: In March 2023, the responsibility for reviewing corporate bond issuance was transferred from the National Development and Reform Commission to the CSRC.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本“湖北松滋人”推断。
description.en: Inferred from the text 'a native of Songzi, Hubei'.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本“中国共产党党员”推断。
description.en: Inferred from the text 'a member of the Communist Party of China'.

position.en: Delegate to the National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 于2018年2月24日当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会四川地区代表。
description.en: Elected as a delegate from the Sichuan region to the 13th National People's Congress on February 24, 2018.

description.zh-cn: 通过微博曝光该案二审卷宗在最高人民法院神秘丢失等细节，引发社会舆论强烈关注，并促使中共中央政法委牵头成立联合调查组进行调查。
description.en: Exposed details via Weibo, such as the mysterious disappearance of the second-instance case files at the Supreme People's Court, sparking intense public attention and prompting the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission to lead a joint investigation.

description.zh-cn: 在网上实名举报时任陕西省委书记赵正永等人干预司法，操纵案件，此举对赵正永后来的落马起到了推动作用。
description.en: Publicly reported then-Shaanxi Party Secretary Zhao Zhengyong and others online for judicial interference and case manipulation, which contributed to Zhao's eventual downfall.

description.zh-cn: 向最高法院发函，称凯奇莱与西勘院的合同无效，并警告“如果维持省高级法院的判决，将会产生一系列严重后果”，试图影响案件审理。
description.en: Sent a letter to the Supreme Court, claiming the contract between Kailai and Xikanyuan was invalid and warning that 'upholding the provincial high court's verdict would lead to a series of serious consequences,' in an attempt to influence the case.

description.zh-cn: 牵头成立联合调查组，最终认定案卷丢失是王林清故意所为，并将其涉嫌犯罪线索移交公安机关。
description.en: Led a joint investigation team that ultimately concluded Wang Linqing intentionally stole the case files and transferred his suspected criminal case to public security organs.

description.zh-cn: 根据官方调查结果，王林清将该案二审的部分正副卷材料带回家中，导致案卷“丢失”，严重干扰了司法程序。
description.en: According to the official investigation, Wang Linqing took parts of the main and supplementary files from the case's second instance home, causing the files to be 'lost' and severely disrupting judicial proceedings.

position.en: Assistant Judge of the First Civil Tribunal

description.zh-cn: 王林清曾任最高人民法院民一庭助理审判员，并承办陕西千亿矿权案。
description.en: Wang Linqing served as an assistant judge in the First Civil Tribunal of the Supreme People's Court and was the presiding judge for the 'Shaanxi Hundred-Billion-Yuan Mining Rights Case'.

description.zh-cn: 据承办法官王林清在自述视频中称，时任最高法院院长的周强曾指示将该案发回重审，后又指示判解除合同，干预了合议庭的独立审判。
description.en: According to presiding judge Wang Linqing's self-recorded video, then-President of the Supreme Court Zhou Qiang instructed to remand the case for retrial and later instructed to rule for contract termination, interfering with the independent judgment of the collegial panel.

description.zh-cn: 时任最高法院副院长的奚晓明邀请陕西省政府官员到最高法院“商议案情”，对案件审理进行干预。
description.en: Then-Vice President of the Supreme Court Xi Xiaoming invited officials from the Shaanxi government to the Supreme Court to 'discuss the case,' interfering with the trial.

description.zh-cn: 在陕西省政府干预司法被媒体曝光后，时任中央政法委书记的周永康作出批示，要求“正确引导舆论”，被认为是试图压制对官方的批评。
description.en: After the Shaanxi government's judicial interference was exposed by the media, then-Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission Zhou Yongkang issued an instruction to 'correctly guide public opinion,' which was seen as an attempt to suppress criticism of officials.

description.zh-cn: 文本中提到，胡志强是原中共山西省委书记胡富国的长子。
description.en: The text mentions that Hu Zhiqiang is the eldest son of Hu Fuguo, the former Party Secretary of Shanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 在联合调查组公布调查结果当天，王林清在中国中央电视台节目中承认自己因个人不满而窃取了案卷。
description.en: On the day the joint investigation team announced its findings, Wang Linqing confessed on a China Central Television program that he had stolen the case files out of personal resentment.

description.zh-cn: 根据崔永元公布的文件，杜万华在本案判决书上批示，称判决书已经周强院长审核。
description.en: According to documents released by Cui Yongyuan, Du Wanhua noted in his approval of the case's verdict that the judgment had been reviewed by President Zhou Qiang.

description.zh-cn: 1949年加入中国共产党，1964年在四清运动中被开除党籍，1978年平反后恢复党籍。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in 1949, was expelled from the party during the Four Cleanups Movement in 1964, and had his membership restored after his rehabilitation in 1978.

description.zh-cn: 肄业于史地系。
description.en: Discontinued studies in the Department of History and Geography.

description.zh-cn: 在四清运动中被开除党籍、下放劳动。
description.en: During the Four Cleanups Movement, he was expelled from the party and sent to perform manual labor.

description.zh-cn: 朱厚泽的工作表现引起时任中共中央总书记胡耀邦的注意，后出任中共中央宣传部部长，成为胡耀邦的重要助手。
description.en: Zhu Houze's work performance caught the attention of then-General Secretary Hu Yaobang. He was later appointed as the head of the CPC Central Committee's Publicity Department, becoming an important aide to Hu Yaobang.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十三大上落选中央委员。
description.en: Failed to be elected as a member of the Central Committee at the 13th National Congress of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共中央总书记赵紫阳创造机会使其复出，担任全国总工会领导职务。
description.en: Then-General Secretary Zhao Ziyang created an opportunity for his political comeback, appointing him to a leadership position in the All-China Federation of Trade Unions.

description.zh-cn: 朱厚泽接替邓力群出任中国共产党中央宣传部部长。
description.en: Zhu Houze succeeded Deng Liqun as the head of the Publicity Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 王忍之接替朱厚泽出任中国共产党中央宣传部部长。
description.en: Wang Renzhi succeeded Zhu Houze as the head of the Publicity Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 朱厚泽接替池必卿（原第一书记）成为中共贵州省委主要负责人。
description.en: Zhu Houze succeeded Chi Biqing (former First Secretary) as the main leader of the CPC Guizhou Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛接替朱厚泽出任中国共产党贵州省委员会书记。
description.en: Hu Jintao succeeded Zhu Houze as Secretary of the CPC Guizhou Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 朱厚泽接替倪志福出任中华全国总工会书记处第一书记。
description.en: Zhu Houze succeeded Ni Zhifu as the First Secretary of the Secretariat of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions.

description.zh-cn: 于洪恩接替朱厚泽出任中华全国总工会书记处第一书记。
description.en: Yu Hong'en succeeded Zhu Houze as the First Secretary of the Secretariat of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions.

description.zh-cn: 杨晓堂是山东武城人。
description.en: Yang Xiaotang is a native of Wucheng, Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 杨晓堂毕业于扬州师范学院中文系。
description.en: Yang Xiaotang graduated from the Chinese Department of Yangzhou Normal College.

description.zh-cn: 1981年，担任江苏省金陵石化公司副经理、经理。1982年改任中国石化集团金陵石化公司总经理。
description.en: In 1981, he served as Deputy Manager and Manager of Jiangsu Jinling Petrochemical Company. In 1982, he was appointed General Manager of Sinopec Jinling Petrochemical Company.

description.zh-cn: 1992年，升任江苏省副省长。
description.en: In 1992, he was promoted to Deputy Governor of Jiangsu Province.

description.zh-cn: 1994年，任江苏省委常委。
description.en: In 1994, he became a member of the Standing Committee of the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1998年，升任国家开发银行副行长。
description.en: In 1998, he was promoted to Vice President of the China Development Bank.

description.zh-cn: 2002年，任中国电子信息产业集团公司总经理。
description.en: In 2002, he was appointed General Manager of China Electronics Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 杨晓堂是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Yang Xiaotang is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 杨晓堂是中国共产党第十五届中央委员会候补委员。
description.en: Yang Xiaotang was an alternate member of the 15th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1994年7月，杨晓堂接替王敏生出任中国共产党苏州市委员会书记。
description.en: In July 1994, Yang Xiaotang succeeded Wang Minsheng as Secretary of the Suzhou Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1998年6月，梁保华接替杨晓堂出任中国共产党苏州市委员会书记。
description.en: In June 1998, Liang Baohua succeeded Yang Xiaotang as Secretary of the Suzhou Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 梁兵是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Liang Bing is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，梁兵被选为河南省出席第十三届全国人民代表大会的代表。
description.en: In 2018, Liang Bing was elected as a deputy from Henan Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 梁兵是中华人民共和国公民。
description.en: Liang Bing is a citizen of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 邵维铭是邵逸夫的长子。
description.en: Shao Vee-Meng is the eldest son of Run Run Shaw.

description.zh-cn: 邵淑琦是邵维铭的独生女。
description.en: Shao Shuqi is the only daughter of Shao Vee-Meng.

description.zh-cn: 邵维铭毕业于牛津大学圣凯瑟琳学院法律系。
description.en: Shao Vee-Meng graduated from the Faculty of Law at St Catherine's College, Oxford.

description.zh-cn: 圣凯瑟琳学院是牛津大学的组成学院之一。
description.en: St Catherine's College is a constituent college of the University of Oxford.

description.zh-cn: 邵维铭在格雷律师学院获得执业律师资格。
description.en: Shao Vee-Meng qualified as a barrister at Gray's Inn.

description.zh-cn: 邵维铭回到新加坡后，协助其伯父兼养父邵仁枚打理生意。
description.en: After returning to Singapore, Shao Vee-Meng assisted his uncle and adoptive father Shao Ren Me in managing his business.

description.zh-cn: 邵维铭担任邵氏基金会主席。
description.en: Shao Vee-Meng serves as the Chairman of the Shaw Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 2006年11月，亚太影展授予邵逸夫“终生成就奖”，由其子邵维铭代为领取。
description.en: In November 2006, the Asia-Pacific Film Festival awarded Run Run Shaw the 'Lifetime Achievement Award', which was accepted on his behalf by his son Shao Vee-Meng.

description.zh-cn: 邵维铭是新加坡国立大学最久和最慷慨的单独赞助人之一，曾捐赠逾千万美元。
description.en: Shao Vee-Meng is one of the longest and most generous individual benefactors of the National University of Singapore, having donated over ten million US dollars.

description.zh-cn: 2011年，法国政府授予邵维铭法国国家荣誉军团司令级勋章。
description.en: In 2011, the French government awarded Shao Vee-Meng the rank of Commander of the Legion of Honour.

description.zh-cn: 1994年，新加坡政府授予邵维铭公众服务勋章。
description.en: In 1994, the Government of Singapore awarded Shao Vee-Meng the Public Service Medal.

description.zh-cn: 西藏警官高等专科学校位于西藏自治区拉萨市城关区。
description.en: Tibet Police College is located in Chengguan District, Lhasa, Tibet Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 西藏警官高等专科学校是西藏自治区公安厅下属的院校。
description.en: Tibet Police College is an institution subordinate to the Public Security Department of Tibet Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 神舟五号是中国载人航天工程的第五次飞行任务，也是首次载人飞行任务。
description.en: Shenzhou 5 was the fifth flight mission of the China Manned Space Program, and its first human spaceflight mission.

description.zh-cn: 长征二号F运载火箭成功将神舟五号飞船发射至预定轨道。
description.en: The Long March 2F rocket successfully launched the Shenzhou 5 spacecraft into its predetermined orbit.

description.zh-cn: 在发射过程中，火箭与飞船发生低频共振，叠加6G的过载，剧烈震动对杨利伟的身体造成了极大的负荷和生命危险。
description.en: During the launch, the rocket and spacecraft experienced low-frequency resonance, which, combined with a 6G overload, caused severe vibrations that posed a significant physical burden and life-threatening danger to Yang Liwei.

description.zh-cn: 神舟五号任务的成功，标志着中国成为继前苏联/俄罗斯和美国之后第三个独立掌握载人航天能力的国家。
description.en: The success of the Shenzhou 5 mission marked China as the third country, after the former Soviet Union/Russia and the United States, to independently master human spaceflight technology.

description.zh-cn: 于2002年10月专门召开会议，同意在2003年实施首次载人航天飞行，并确定了“一名航天员，飞行一天”的具体方案。
description.en: Convened a special meeting in October 2002, approving the implementation of the first human spaceflight in 2003 and defining the specific plan of 'one astronaut, one day'.

description.zh-cn: 作为载人航天工程总指挥，宣布了神舟五号载人飞船发射成功，并在任务结束后宣布飞行获得圆满成功。
description.en: As Commander-in-Chief of the manned space program, he announced the successful launch of Shenzhou 5 and its complete success upon mission conclusion.

description.zh-cn: 作为时任国家最高领导人，在酒泉卫星发射中心现场观看了飞船发射，并在发射成功后发表讲话表示祝贺，体现了国家对该任务的支持。
description.en: As the then-top national leader, he watched the spacecraft launch on-site at the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center and delivered a congratulatory speech after the successful launch, reflecting the state's support for the mission.

description.zh-cn: 在航天员出征仪式上发表讲话，为即将执行任务的杨利伟壮行。
description.en: Delivered a speech at the astronaut's departure ceremony, encouraging Yang Liwei before his mission.

description.zh-cn: 在太空飞行期间，杨利伟与时任国防部长曹刚川进行了第一次“天地对话”。
description.en: During his spaceflight, Yang Liwei conducted the first 'space-to-ground call' with then-Minister of National Defense Cao Gangchuan.

description.zh-cn: 在杨利伟乘坐的返回舱成功着陆后，时任国务院总理温家宝与他通话，祝贺其顺利返航。
description.en: After the successful landing of Yang Liwei's return capsule, then-Premier Wen Jiabao spoke with him via phone to congratulate him on his safe return.

description.zh-cn: 时任中央军委主席江泽民在获悉中国首次载人航天飞行圆满成功后，打电话表示祝贺。
description.en: Then-Chairman of the Central Military Commission Jiang Zemin made a phone call to offer congratulations after learning of the complete success of China's first human spaceflight.

description.zh-cn: 在太空飞行期间，杨利伟在舱内展示了中华人民共和国国旗。
description.en: During his spaceflight, Yang Liwei displayed the flag of the People's Republic of China inside the capsule.

description.zh-cn: 在成为航天员之前，杨利伟曾是中国人民解放军空军的一名歼击机飞行员。
description.en: Before becoming an astronaut, Yang Liwei was a fighter pilot in the People's Liberation Army Air Force.

description.zh-cn: 神舟五号任务的返回舱现收藏于中国国家博物馆。
description.en: The return capsule from the Shenzhou 5 mission is now housed in the National Museum of China.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡《联合早报》发表题为《历史性的飞天》的社论，称中国成功发射神五为人类宇航史上又一个“辉煌的时刻”。
description.en: Singapore's Lianhe Zaobao published an editorial titled 'A Historic Flight', calling China's successful launch of Shenzhou 5 another 'glorious moment' in the history of human spaceflight.

description.zh-cn: 神舟五号飞船搭载了来自台湾的多种植物种子进行空间实验。
description.en: The Shenzhou 5 spacecraft carried various plant seeds from Taiwan for space experiments.

description.zh-cn: 北京市司法局是北京市人民政府的组成部门。
description.en: The Beijing Municipal Bureau of Justice is a constituent department of the Beijing Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国司法部是北京市司法局的业务上级机构。
description.en: The Ministry of Justice of the People's Republic of China is the professional superior of the Beijing Municipal Bureau of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 北京市司法局主管北京市的司法行政工作。
description.en: The Beijing Municipal Bureau of Justice is in charge of the judicial administration work in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 台湾海峡危机是第二次国共内战的延续，内战导致的两岸分治是危机产生的背景。
description.en: The Taiwan Strait Crisis is a continuation of the Second Chinese Civil War; the cross-strait separation resulting from the civil war is the background of the crisis.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军对驻守金门的中华民国国军发动了榴弹炮突击，开启了第一次台湾海峡危机。
description.en: The People's Liberation Army launched a howitzer assault on the ROC forces stationed in Kinmen, starting the First Taiwan Strait Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 一江山岛指挥官王生明将军在解放军占领该岛后引爆手榴弹自杀。
description.en: General Wang Shengming, commander of the Yijiangshan Islands, committed suicide with a grenade after the PLA captured the island.

description.zh-cn: 美国海军与中华民国海军合作，将大陈岛军民船运撤退至台湾。
description.en: The U.S. Navy and the ROC Navy cooperated to evacuate military personnel and civilians from the Dachen Islands to Taiwan by ship.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统艾森豪威尔表示不排除在远东使用战术核武器，对中华人民共和国形成威慑。
description.en: U.S. President Eisenhower stated he would not rule out the use of tactical nuclear weapons in the Far East, creating a deterrent against the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 在美国发出核威慑后，周恩来声明愿意与美国谈判缓和远东局势，最终结束了危机。
description.en: After the U.S. nuclear deterrent threat, Zhou Enlai stated his willingness to negotiate with the U.S. to ease tensions in the Far East, which ultimately ended the crisis.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军对驻守金门的国军部队发动了榴弹炮突击，引发第二次台湾海峡危机。
description.en: The People's Liberation Army launched a howitzer assault on the ROC forces stationed in Kinmen, triggering the Second Taiwan Strait Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 金门防卫司令部副司令官吉星文在金门炮战中阵亡。
description.en: Ji Xingwen, Deputy Commander of the Kinmen Defense Command, was killed in action during the Kinmen Artillery Duel.

description.zh-cn: 金门防卫司令部副司令官赵家骧在金门炮战中阵亡。
description.en: Zhao Jiaxiang, Deputy Commander of the Kinmen Defense Command, was killed in action during the Kinmen Artillery Duel.

description.zh-cn: 金门防卫司令部副司令官章杰在金门炮战中阵亡。
description.en: Zhang Jie, Deputy Commander of the Kinmen Defense Command, was killed in action during the Kinmen Artillery Duel.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次台湾海峡危机期间，美国紧急运送AIM-9响尾蛇飞弹给台湾部队，帮助其取得空战优势。
description.en: During the Second Taiwan Strait Crisis, the United States urgently supplied AIM-9 Sidewinder missiles to the Taiwanese forces, helping them gain an advantage in air combat.

description.zh-cn: 大跃进失败导致中国大陆国力虚弱，蒋中正认为这是反攻大陆的良机。
description.en: The failure of the Great Leap Forward weakened mainland China's national strength, which Chiang Kai-shek saw as an opportune moment to counterattack the mainland.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正急欲趁大跃进失败之时反攻大陆，因而制定了国光计划。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek was eager to counterattack the mainland while it was weakened by the failure of the Great Leap Forward, and thus formulated Project National Glory.

description.zh-cn: 时任中华民国国防部情报局局长叶翔之开始策画「海威」行动。
description.en: Yeh Hsiang-chih, then Director of the Intelligence Bureau of the Ministry of National Defense of the ROC, began planning 'Operation Hai Wei'.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统比尔·克林顿决定允许时任中华民国总统的李登辉访问美国。
description.en: U.S. President Bill Clinton decided to allow then-President of the Republic of China Lee Teng-hui to visit the United States.

description.zh-cn: 针对李登辉访美，中华人民共和国进行了两次大规模导弹实弹发射演习，引发了危机。
description.en: In response to Lee Teng-hui's visit to the US, the People's Republic of China conducted two large-scale live-fire missile exercises, triggering the crisis.

description.zh-cn: 受危机影响，中华人民共和国推迟了第二轮“汪辜会谈”。
description.en: Affected by the crisis, the People's Republic of China postponed the second round of the 'Koo-Wang talks'.

description.zh-cn: 时任中央军委主席江泽民亲临现场观看了军事演习。
description.en: Jiang Zemin, then Chairman of the Central Military Commission, personally observed the military exercises.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国以军事演习吓阻并试图干涉中华民国首次民选总统大选。
description.en: The People's Republic of China used military exercises to intimidate and attempt to interfere with the first democratic presidential election in the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 美国派遣第七舰队航空母舰战斗群协防台湾海峡，以应对危机。
description.en: The United States dispatched the Seventh Fleet's aircraft carrier battle group to help defend the Taiwan Strait in response to the crisis.

description.zh-cn: 曾就读于直隶省立第四师范学校，并担任学生会主席。
description.en: Studied at the Fourth Provincial Normal School of Zhili and served as the president of the student union.

description.zh-cn: 1925年，刘宁一参加了当地的五卅运动。
description.en: In 1925, Liu Ningyi participated in the local May 30th Movement.

description.zh-cn: 1925年9月加入中国共产党，并长期担任党内多项重要职务。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in September 1925 and held various important positions within the party for a long time.

description.zh-cn: 曾三次被国民政府逮捕关押。
description.en: Was arrested and imprisoned by the Nationalist Government three times.

description.zh-cn: 1937年8月，经八路军南京办事处交涉，刘宁一获释。
description.en: In August 1937, Liu Ningyi was released after negotiations by the Eighth Route Army's Nanjing Office.

description.zh-cn: 1943年7月赴延安中央党校学习。
description.en: In July 1943, he went to study at the Central Party School in Yan'an.

description.zh-cn: 自1946年起，刘宁一与时任中国劳动协会理事长朱学范多次合作，共同致力于中国工会运动的统一，并一同出席国际会议、转赴解放区。
