description.en: Starting from 1946, Liu Ningyi collaborated multiple times with Zhu Xuefan, then chairman of the Chinese Association of Labour, to jointly work towards the unification of the Chinese trade union movement, attending international conferences and traveling to liberated areas together.

description.zh-cn: 1946年，经周恩来批准，刘宁一帮助朱学范和中国劳协总部撤往香港。
description.en: In 1946, with Zhou Enlai's approval, Liu Ningyi helped Zhu Xuefan and the headquarters of the Chinese Association of Labour to retreat to Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 作为中共代表团成员，参加了由邓小平为团长的代表团，赴莫斯科与苏共中央举行会谈。
description.en: As a member of the CCP delegation, he participated in the delegation led by Deng Xiaoping to Moscow for talks with the Central Committee of the CPSU.

description.zh-cn: 在1963年莫斯科会谈中，刘宁一作为中共代表团成员，与苏斯洛夫为首的苏共代表团就国际共产主义运动问题展开激烈论争。
description.en: During the 1963 Moscow talks, Liu Ningyi, as a member of the CCP delegation, engaged in intense debates with the CPSU delegation led by Mikhail Suslov on issues of the international communist movement.

description.zh-cn: 刘宁一曾任第一、二、三届全国人大常委会委员，并在1965年1月当选为第三届全国人大常委会副委员长兼秘书长。
description.en: Liu Ningyi served as a member of the Standing Committees of the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd National People's Congress, and was elected Vice Chairman and Secretary-General of the Standing Committee of the 3rd NPC in January 1965.

description.zh-cn: 1913年至1919年，徐旭生在法国巴黎大学留学学习哲学。
description.en: From 1913 to 1919, Xu Xusheng studied philosophy at the University of Paris in France.

description.zh-cn: 1919年回国后，徐旭生在河南留学欧美预备学校任教。
description.en: After returning to China in 1919, Xu Xusheng taught at the Henan Preparatory School for Study in Europe and America.

description.zh-cn: 1927年，徐旭生作为中瑞西北科学考察团中方团长，率团前往中国西北地区进行考察。
description.en: In 1927, as the Chinese leader of the Sino-Swedish Scientific Expedition, Xu Xusheng led the team to investigate Northwest China.

description.zh-cn: 1927年，徐旭生与瑞方团长斯文赫定共同率领中瑞西北科学考察团。
description.en: In 1927, Xu Xusheng and the Swedish leader Sven Hedin jointly led the Sino-Swedish Scientific Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 1929年，徐旭生担任国立北平大学女子师范学院院长。
description.en: In 1929, Xu Xusheng served as the President of the Women's Normal College of National Peiping University.

description.zh-cn: 1931年2月至1932年5月，徐旭生担任国立北平师范大学校长。
description.en: From February 1931 to May 1932, Xu Xusheng served as the Chancellor of National Peiping Normal University.

position.en: Director of the Institute of History

description.zh-cn: 1937年，徐旭生出任国立北平研究院史学研究所所长。
description.en: In 1937, Xu Xusheng became the Director of the Institute of History at the National Academy of Peiping.

description.zh-cn: 自1940年起，徐旭生担任第二至四届国民参政会参政员。
description.en: Starting from 1940, Xu Xusheng served as a council member for the second to the fourth sessions of the People's Political Council.

position.en: Delegate to the First National Assembly

description.zh-cn: 1947年，徐旭生当选为第一届国民大会代表。
description.en: In 1947, Xu Xusheng was elected as a delegate to the First National Assembly.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，徐旭生任中国科学院考古研究所一级研究员。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, Xu Xusheng served as a first-class researcher at the Institute of Archaeology, Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 1954年，徐旭生担任中国史学会第一届理事会常务理事。
description.en: In 1954, Xu Xusheng served as a standing council member of the first council of the Chinese Historical Association.

description.zh-cn: 1957年，徐旭生加入中国共产党。
description.en: In 1957, Xu Xusheng joined the Communist Party of China.

position.en: Delegate to the Third National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 1964年，徐旭生当选为第三届全国人大代表。
description.en: In 1964, Xu Xusheng was elected as a delegate to the Third National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，徐旭生受到迫害。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Xu Xusheng was persecuted.

description.zh-cn: 1954年在中国史学会第一届理事会共事，郭沫若任主席，徐旭生任常务理事。
description.en: Worked together in 1954 on the first council of the Chinese Historical Association, where Guo Moruo was chairman and Xu Xusheng was a standing council member.

description.zh-cn: 1954年在中国史学会第一届理事会共事，吴玉章任副主席，徐旭生任常务理事。
description.en: Worked together in 1954 on the first council of the Chinese Historical Association, where Wu Yuzhang was vice-chairman and Xu Xusheng was a standing council member.

description.zh-cn: 1954年在中国史学会第一届理事会共事，范文澜任副主席，徐旭生任常务理事。
description.en: Worked together in 1954 on the first council of the Chinese Historical Association, where Fan Wenlan was vice-chairman and Xu Xusheng was a standing council member.

description.zh-cn: 徐旭生接替陈大齐担任国立北京大学哲学系主任职务。
description.en: Xu Xusheng succeeded Chen Daxi as the Head of the Philosophy Department at National Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 邓以蛰接替徐旭生担任国立北京大学哲学系主任职务。
description.en: Deng Yizhe succeeded Xu Xusheng as the Head of the Philosophy Department at National Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 徐旭生接替李石曾担任国立北平师范大学校长职务。
description.en: Xu Xusheng succeeded Li Shizeng as the Chancellor of National Peiping Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 李蒸接替徐旭生担任国立北平师范大学校长职务。
description.en: Li Zheng succeeded Xu Xusheng as the Chancellor of National Peiping Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 河北省科学技术厅是河北省人民政府的组成部门。
description.en: The Hebei Provincial Department of Science and Technology is a constituent department of the Hebei Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 阎济民是河南永城县芒山镇磨山村人。
description.en: Yan Jimin was a native of Moshan Village, Mangshan Town, Yongcheng County, Henan.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，阎济民是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Yan Jimin was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 阎济民曾任共青团河南省委书记。
description.en: Yan Jimin served as the Secretary of the Henan Provincial Committee of the Communist Youth League.

description.zh-cn: 1954年，阎济民调入洛阳轴承厂，任厂长。
description.en: In 1954, Yan Jimin was transferred to the Luoyang Bearing Factory and served as its director.

description.zh-cn: 1979年，阎济民担任河南省副省长。
description.en: In 1979, Yan Jimin served as the Vice Governor of Henan Province.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，阎济民是第七届全国政协委员。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Yan Jimin was a member of the 7th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 籍贯为广东东莞。
description.en: His native place is Dongguan, Guangdong.

description.zh-cn: 曾任华中工学院教授、博士生导师。
description.en: Served as a professor and doctoral supervisor at the Huazhong Institute of Technology.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类“中国共产党党员”推断其成员身份。
description.en: His membership is inferred from the Wikipedia category 'Members of the Communist Party of China'.

description.zh-cn: 毕业于复旦大学经济学系政治经济学专业。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Economics, majoring in Political Economy, at Fudan University.

description.zh-cn: 徐一平接替刘永忠担任连云港市人民政府市长职务。
description.en: Xu Yiping succeeded Liu Yongzhong as the Mayor of Lianyungang Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 徐一平的连云港市人民政府市长职务由杨省世接任。
description.en: Xu Yiping was succeeded by Yang Shingshi as the Mayor of Lianyungang Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 李达出生于陕西省眉县。
description.en: Li Da was born in Mei County, Shaanxi Province.

position.en: Platoon Leader, Company Commander, Brigade Staff Officer

description.zh-cn: 1927年毕业后，在国民革命军第2集团军任职，直至1931年参加宁都起义。
description.en: After graduating in 1927, he served in the 2nd Group Army of the National Revolutionary Army until participating in the Ningdu Uprising in 1931.

description.zh-cn: 李达参加宁都起义后，其所在的部队被编入红军，这成为他军事生涯的转折点。
description.en: After Li Da participated in the Ningdu Uprising, his unit was incorporated into the Red Army, which became a turning point in his military career.

description.zh-cn: 李达于1932年9月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Li Da joined the Communist Party of China in September 1932.

description.zh-cn: 1934年，李达任红六军团参谋长，随军团长萧克、政委任弼时西征。
description.en: In 1934, Li Da served as Chief of Staff of the Red Sixth Army Corps and followed its commander Xiao Ke and political commissar Ren Bishi on the Westward Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 1934年10月，李达调任红二军团参谋长，协助贺龙指挥部队。
description.en: In October 1934, Li Da was transferred to be the Chief of Staff of the Red Second Army Corps, assisting He Long in commanding the troops.

description.zh-cn: 在抗日战争和第二次国共内战期间，李达长期担任刘伯承领导的129师、晋冀鲁豫野战军及第二野战军的参谋长，协助其指挥作战。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War and the Second Chinese Civil War, Li Da served for a long time as the Chief of Staff under Liu Bocheng's command in the 129th Division, the Shanxi-Hebei-Shandong-Henan Field Army, and the Second Field Army, assisting him in command.

description.zh-cn: 在抗日战争和第二次国共内战期间，李达作为参谋长，协助129师政委、中原野战军政委邓小平进行指挥。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War and the Second Chinese Civil War, Li Da, as Chief of Staff, assisted Deng Xiaoping, the political commissar of the 129th Division and the Central Plains Field Army, in command.

description.zh-cn: 1938年1月，李达与邓小平、刘伯承、蔡树藩等129师领导人在山西辽县桐峪镇合影。
description.en: In January 1938, Li Da was photographed with Deng Xiaoping, Liu Bocheng, Cai Shufan, and other leaders of the 129th Division in Tongyu Town, Liao County, Shanxi.

description.zh-cn: 1945年邯郸战役期间，李达参与并促成国民党将领高树勋率部起义。
description.en: During the Handan Campaign in 1945, Li Da participated in and contributed to persuading KMT general Gao Shuxun to lead his troops in an uprising.

description.zh-cn: 1953年4月，李达参加抗美援朝，任中国人民志愿军参谋长。
description.en: In April 1953, Li Da participated in the Korean War and served as the Chief of Staff of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army.

description.zh-cn: 1954年10月，李达被任命为中华人民共和国国防部副部长。
description.en: In October 1954, Li Da was appointed as the Vice Minister of National Defense of the People's Republic of China.

position.en: Deputy Chief of the General Staff

description.zh-cn: 1972年10月，李达被任命为中国人民解放军副总参谋长。
description.en: In October 1972, Li Da was appointed as the Deputy Chief of the General Staff of the Chinese People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，李达遭受迫害。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Li Da was persecuted.

description.zh-cn: 两位李达因同名在工作中相识，并结下友谊，被传为佳话。
description.en: The two Li Das met at work due to their shared name, developed a friendship, and their story became well-known.

description.zh-cn: 哲学家李达曾任武汉大学校长。
description.en: Philosopher Li Da once served as the president of Wuhan University.

description.zh-cn: 哲学家李达曾批评毛泽东的大跃进运动。
description.en: Philosopher Li Da criticized Mao Zedong's Great Leap Forward movement.

description.zh-cn: 1966年8月，哲学家李达被红卫兵批斗殴打致死。
description.en: In August 1966, philosopher Li Da was beaten to death during a struggle session by the Red Guards.

description.zh-cn: 李刚是山东莱阳人。
description.en: Li Gang is a native of Laiyang, Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 1970年至1974年，为辽宁外语专科学校（大连外国语大学前身）英语系学生。
description.en: From 1970 to 1974, he was a student in the English Department of Liaoning Foreign Languages Vocational School (predecessor of Dalian University of Foreign Languages).

position.en: English Teacher, Youth League Committee Secretary

description.zh-cn: 1974年至1978年，任辽宁外语专科学校英语教师、团委书记。
description.en: From 1974 to 1978, he served as an English teacher and Secretary of the Youth League Committee at Liaoning Foreign Languages Vocational School.

position.zh-cn: 国际联络部翻译、副处长、处长、副部长、部长，团中央常委
position.en: Translator, Deputy Division Chief, Division Chief, Deputy Minister, Minister of the International Liaison Department; Standing Committee Member of the CYL Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 1978年至1993年，在共青团中央国际联络部历任翻译、副处长、处长、副部长、部长，并担任共青团中央常委。
description.en: From 1978 to 1993, he served successively as translator, deputy division chief, division chief, deputy minister, and minister of the International Liaison Department of the CYL Central Committee, and was a member of the Standing Committee of the CYL Central Committee.

position.zh-cn: 国际部副部长、常委、副秘书长
position.en: Deputy Minister of the International Department, Standing Committee Member, Deputy Secretary-General

description.zh-cn: 1978年至1993年间，曾任全国青联国际部副部长、常委、副秘书长。
description.en: Between 1978 and 1993, he served as Deputy Minister of the International Department, Standing Committee Member, and Deputy Secretary-General of the All-China Youth Federation.

position.zh-cn: 对外文化联络局副局长、局长，港澳台文化事务司司长
position.en: Deputy Director-General and Director-General of the Bureau for External Cultural Relations, Director-General of the Department of Culture of Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan Affairs

description.zh-cn: 1993年至1994年任文化部对外文化联络局副局长。1998年至2001年，任文化部对外文化联络局局长、港澳台文化事务司司长。
description.en: From 1993 to 1994, he served as Deputy Director-General of the Bureau for External Cultural Relations of the Ministry of Culture. From 1998 to 2001, he served as Director-General of the Bureau for External Cultural Relations and Director-General of the Department of Culture of Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan Affairs of the Ministry of Culture.

description.zh-cn: 1994年至1998年，任中国驻美国大使馆正局级公使衔文化参赞。
description.en: From 1994 to 1998, he served as Minister-Counselor for Cultural Affairs (Director-General level) at the Chinese Embassy in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 2001年至2003年，任国务院新闻办公室副主任。
description.en: From 2001 to 2003, he served as Deputy Director of the State Council Information Office.

description.zh-cn: 2001年至2003年，任中国人权研究会副会长。
description.en: From 2001 to 2003, he served as Vice President of the China Society for Human Rights Studies.

description.zh-cn: 2003年至2012年，任中央人民政府驻香港特别行政区联络办公室副主任。
description.en: From 2003 to 2012, he served as Deputy Director of the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 在担任中央人民政府驻香港特别行政区联络办公室副主任期间，协助促成2012年香港政治制度改革。
description.en: During his tenure as Deputy Director of the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, he assisted in facilitating the 2012 Hong Kong electoral reform.

description.zh-cn: 2012年12月19日至2014年1月9日任副主任，2014年1月9日至2016年7月任主任。
description.en: Served as Deputy Director from December 19, 2012, to January 9, 2014, and as Director from January 9, 2014, to July 2016.

description.zh-cn: 2016年7月至2017年8月22日，任国务院侨务办公室副主任（正部长级）。
description.en: From July 2016 to August 22, 2017, he served as Deputy Director (ministerial level) of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 国务院于2017年8月22日免去李刚的国务院侨务办公室副主任职务。
description.en: The State Council removed Li Gang from his position as Deputy Director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office on August 22, 2017.

description.zh-cn: 因涉嫌严重违纪，李刚被责令辞去第十二届全国人民代表大会代表职务，其辞职于2017年8月23日被广东省人大常委会接受，并于2017年9月1日由全国人大常委会会议确认。
description.en: Due to suspected serious violations of discipline, Li Gang was ordered to resign from his position as a deputy to the 12th National People's Congress. His resignation was accepted by the Standing Committee of the Guangdong Provincial People's Congress on August 23, 2017, and confirmed by a meeting of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on September 1, 2017.

description.zh-cn: 刘敏是李刚的妻子。
description.en: Liu Min is Li Gang's wife.

description.zh-cn: 李刚接替白志健出任中央人民政府驻澳门特别行政区联络办公室主任。
description.en: Li Gang succeeded Bai Zhijian as the Director of the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Macao Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 王志民接替李刚出任中央人民政府驻澳门特别行政区联络办公室主任。
description.en: Wang Zhimin succeeded Li Gang as the Director of the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Macao Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 在2007年中共十七大上当选为第十七届中央纪律检查委员会委员。
description.en: Elected as a member of the 17th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection at the 17th National Congress of the CPC in 2007.

description.zh-cn: 在2012年中共十八大上当选为第十八届中央纪律检查委员会委员，其违纪处分于2017年10月9日被确认。
description.en: Elected as a member of the 18th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection at the 18th National Congress of the CPC in 2012. His disciplinary punishment was confirmed on October 9, 2017.

description.zh-cn: 担任第十二届全国人大代表，于2017年8月23日辞职被接受。
description.en: Served as a deputy to the 12th National People's Congress, his resignation was accepted on August 23, 2017.

description.zh-cn: 李刚是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Li Gang is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 河南警察学院隶属于河南省公安厅。
description.en: Henan Police College is affiliated with the Henan Provincial Public Security Department.

description.zh-cn: 1974年，河南省政法干部学校中原属河南省公安干部学校的部分被分出，复校为河南省公安干部学校。
description.en: In 1974, the part of Henan Political and Legal Cadre School that originally belonged to Henan Public Security Cadre School was separated to re-establish Henan Public Security Cadre School.

description.zh-cn: 2010年3月18日，中华人民共和国教育部批准河南公安高等专科学校升格为河南警察学院。
description.en: On March 18, 2010, the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China approved the upgrade of Henan Public Security Advanced College to Henan Police College.

description.zh-cn: 周学文是辽宁辽阳人。
description.en: Zhou Xuewen was a native of Liaoyang, Liaoning.

description.zh-cn: 周学文是辽宁中医药大学附属医院的主任医师。
description.en: Zhou Xuewen was a chief physician at the Affiliated Hospital of Liaoning University of Traditional Chinese Medicine.

description.zh-cn: 周学文是第三届国医大师。
description.en: Zhou Xuewen was awarded the title of the 3rd 'National Master of Chinese Medicine'.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，周学文是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the Wikipedia category, Zhou Xuewen was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，周学文是享受国务院政府特殊津贴专家。
description.en: According to the Wikipedia category, Zhou Xuewen was an expert who enjoyed the special government allowances of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 刘景范在陕甘宁特区从事政权管理工作期间，组织了土地改革。
description.en: Liu Jingfan organized land reform while engaged in administrative work in the Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia Special Region.

position.en: First Deputy Director, Party Group Secretary

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，刘景范担任政务院人民监察委员会第一副主任，并于1953年升任党组书记。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, Liu Jingfan served as the First Deputy Director of the People's Supervision Committee of the Government Administration Council, and was promoted to Party Group Secretary in 1953.

description.zh-cn: 深圳市政协的上级机构是中国人民政治协商会议广东省委员会。
description.en: The superior body of the Shenzhen CPPCC is the Guangdong Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 深圳市政协的中共上级是中国共产党深圳市委员会。
description.en: The superior CPC organization of the Shenzhen CPPCC is the Shenzhen Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国宪法》是深圳市政协的授权法源之一。
description.en: The Constitution of the People's Republic of China is one of the legal sources of authority for the Shenzhen Municipal Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 《中国人民政治协商会议章程》是深圳市政协的授权法源之一。
description.en: The Charter of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference is one of the legal sources of authority for the Shenzhen Municipal Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 朱育诚曾任北京市政协副主席。
description.en: Zhu Yucheng formerly served as Vice Chairman of the Beijing Municipal Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

position.en: Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Research Institute

description.zh-cn: 朱育诚曾任国务院发展研究中心港澳研究所所长。
description.en: Zhu Yucheng formerly served as Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Research Institute of the Development Research Center of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类“新华社香港分社副社长”可知，朱育诚曾担任该职务。
description.en: Based on the category 'Deputy Director of Xinhua News Agency Hong Kong Branch', it is known that Zhu Yucheng held this position.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类“中国共产党党员”可知，朱育诚是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Based on the category 'Chinese Communist Party members', it is known that Zhu Yucheng is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 司马干是司马懿的嫡三子。
description.en: Sima Gan was the third legitimate son of Sima Yi.

description.zh-cn: 司马干是张春华所生的第三子。
description.en: Sima Gan was the third son born to Zhang Chunhua.

description.zh-cn: 司马干与司马师是同胞兄弟。
description.en: Sima Gan and Sima Shi were full brothers.

description.zh-cn: 司马干与司马昭是同胞兄弟。
description.en: Sima Gan and Sima Zhao were full brothers.

description.zh-cn: 司马干与司马亮是异母兄弟。
description.en: Sima Gan and Sima Liang were half-brothers.

description.zh-cn: 司马干与司马伦是异母兄弟。
description.en: Sima Gan and Sima Lun were half-brothers.

description.zh-cn: 司马干与南阳公主是同胞兄妹。
description.en: Sima Gan and Princess Nanyang were full siblings.

description.zh-cn: 司马广是司马干的世子。
description.en: Sima Guang was the heir apparent of Sima Gan.

description.zh-cn: 司马炎是司马干的侄子。
description.en: Sima Yan was Sima Gan's nephew.

description.zh-cn: 司马衷是司马干的侄孙。
description.en: Sima Zhong was Sima Gan's grandnephew.

description.zh-cn: 司马冏是司马干的侄孙。
description.en: Sima Jiong was Sima Gan's grandnephew.

description.zh-cn: 司马越是司马干的族侄。
description.en: Sima Yue was Sima Gan's clan nephew.

description.zh-cn: 司马干娶了满宠的女儿为妻，是满宠的女婿。
description.en: Sima Gan married the daughter of Man Chong, making him Man Chong's son-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 司马干的妻子是满伟的妹妹，司马干是满伟的妹夫。
description.en: Sima Gan's wife was the sister of Man Wei, making Sima Gan his brother-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏皇帝曹髦在位时曾亲自率兵攻打权臣司马昭。
description.en: Emperor Cao Mao of Cao Wei personally led troops to attack the powerful minister Sima Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 曹髦攻打司马昭时，司马昭的掾属满长武和孙佑阻止司马干进入阊阖掖门，导致其未能及时与司马昭会合。
description.en: When Cao Mao attacked Sima Zhao, Sima Zhao's aides Man Changwu and Sun You prevented Sima Gan from entering the Changheye Gate, causing him to fail to join Sima Zhao in time.

description.zh-cn: 因满长武未能让其弟司马干及时进入，司马昭下令将其处死。
description.en: Because Man Changwu failed to let his brother Sima Gan enter in time, Sima Zhao ordered his execution.

description.zh-cn: 因其子满长武之事，司马昭将卫尉满伟免为庶人。
description.en: Due to the incident involving his son Man Changwu, Sima Zhao dismissed Man Wei, the Commandant of the Guards, to the status of a commoner.

description.zh-cn: 晋武帝司马炎登基后，封司马干为平原王。后因其有疾病，特诏留他在洛阳，不必就藩。
description.en: After ascending the throne, Emperor Wu of Jin (Sima Yan) enfeoffed Sima Gan as the Prince of Pingyuan. Later, due to his illness, he was specially decreed to stay in Luoyang instead of going to his fief.

description.zh-cn: 赵王司马伦辅政时，任命司马干为卫将军。
description.en: When Sima Lun, the Prince of Zhao, was regent, he appointed Sima Gan as the General of the Guards.

description.zh-cn: 晋惠帝司马衷复位后，加封司马干为太保。
description.en: After Emperor Hui of Jin (Sima Zhong) was restored to the throne, he granted Sima Gan the title of Grand Protector.

description.zh-cn: 在八王之乱中，齐王司马冏起兵平定了篡位的赵王司马伦。
description.en: During the War of the Eight Princes, Sima Jiong, the Prince of Qi, raised troops and defeated the usurper Sima Lun, the Prince of Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 司马冏平定司马伦后，司马干前往祝贺并告诫他；司马冏辅政时，司马干再次到访并警告他不要效法司马伦。
description.en: After Sima Jiong defeated Sima Lun, Sima Gan went to congratulate and warn him; when Sima Jiong was regent, Sima Gan visited again to warn him not to follow Sima Lun's example.

description.zh-cn: 东海王司马越在八王之乱后期得势后，曾前往探望司马干，但司马干闭门不见。
description.en: After Sima Yue, the Prince of Donghai, gained power in the later stages of the War of the Eight Princes, he visited Sima Gan, but Sima Gan refused to see him.

description.zh-cn: 汉赵君主刘聪派遣军队攻陷西晋首都洛阳，是永嘉之乱的核心事件。
description.en: The Han Zhao ruler Liu Cong dispatched forces to capture the Western Jin capital Luoyang, which was the central event of the Disaster of Yongjia.

description.zh-cn: 其农业学院与惠灵顿维多利亚大学的农业学院合并组建了新西兰农业学院（梅西大学前身）。
description.en: Its agricultural school merged with that of Victoria University of Wellington to form the New Zealand Agricultural College (a predecessor of Massey University).

description.zh-cn: 1926年，其农业学院与奥克兰大学的农业学院合并组建了新西兰农业学院（梅西大学前身）。1963年，其北帕默斯顿校区与梅西学院合并成立了玛纳瓦图梅西大学学院，为梅西大学成为独立大学奠定了基础。
description.en: In 1926, its agricultural school merged with that of the University of Auckland to form the New Zealand Agricultural College (a predecessor of Massey University). In 1963, its Palmerston North campus merged with Massey College to form the Massey University College of Manawatu, paving the way for Massey to become an independent university.

description.zh-cn: 前身新西兰农业学院作为新西兰大学的第六所学院成立。
description.en: Its predecessor, the New Zealand Agricultural College, was established as the sixth college of the University of New Zealand.

description.zh-cn: 在纽西兰大学解散后，梅西学院成为了惠灵顿维多利亚大学的一部分。
description.en: After the dissolution of the University of New Zealand, Massey College became part of the Victoria University of Wellington.

description.zh-cn: 钱正英与黄辛白是夫妻关系。
description.en: Qian Zhengying and Huang Xinbai were married.

description.zh-cn: 钱正英于1939年进入上海大同大学土木工程系学习，后肄业。
description.en: Qian Zhengying entered the Department of Civil Engineering at Shanghai Datong University in 1939 but did not graduate.

description.zh-cn: 钱正英于1941年9月参加了上海中共地下党组织。
description.en: Qian Zhengying joined the underground organization of the CCP in Shanghai in September 1941.

description.zh-cn: 1944年春，21岁的钱正英负责淮河北堤修复工程的技术领导工作，并长期主持淮河等流域的治理和规划。
description.en: In the spring of 1944, 21-year-old Qian Zhengying was responsible for the technical leadership of the restoration project of the north embankment of the Huai River, and later oversaw the governance and planning of basins including the Huai River for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 1950年3月，经中央人民政府内政部部长曾山的推荐，钱正英被任命为华东军政委员会水利部副部长。
description.en: In March 1950, upon the recommendation of Zeng Shan, Minister of Internal Affairs of the Central People's Government, Qian Zhengying was appointed as the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Water Conservancy of the East China Military and Political Committee.

position.en: Vice Minister of the Ministry of Water Conservancy

description.zh-cn: 钱正英曾任华东军政委员会水利部副部长兼治淮委员会工程部副部长。
description.en: Qian Zhengying served as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Water Conservancy of the East China Military and Political Committee and concurrently as Vice Minister of the Engineering Department of the Huai River Harnessing Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在1967年至1970年的“文化大革命”期间，钱正英受到冲击。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution from 1967 to 1970, Qian Zhengying was persecuted.

position.zh-cn: 副部长、革委会副主任、部长
position.en: Vice Minister, Vice Director of the Revolutionary Committee, Minister

description.zh-cn: 钱正英在水利电力部担任过多个职务，包括副部长、革委会副主任以及两度出任部长。
description.en: Qian Zhengying held multiple positions in the Ministry of Water Resources and Electric Power, including Vice Minister, Vice Director of the Revolutionary Committee, and served as Minister twice.

description.zh-cn: 钱正英在水利部长期任职，曾任副部长和部长。
description.en: Qian Zhengying had a long tenure at the Ministry of Water Resources, serving as both Vice Minister and Minister.

description.zh-cn: 钱正英曾任第七、八、九届全国政协副主席。
description.en: Qian Zhengying served as the Vice Chairperson of the 7th, 8th, and 9th National Committees of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 钱正英在1988年当选为全国政协副主席后，位列“党和国家领导人”。
description.en: After being elected as Vice Chairperson of the CPPCC National Committee in 1988, Qian Zhengying was ranked among the 'Party and State Leaders'.

description.zh-cn: 钱正英曾兼任第六届中国红十字会会长。
description.en: Qian Zhengying concurrently served as the 6th President of the Red Cross Society of China.

description.zh-cn: 捷克斯洛伐克于1989年11月1日向钱正英颁发了“友谊勋章”。
description.en: On November 1, 1989, Czechoslovakia awarded the 'Order of Friendship' to Qian Zhengying.

description.zh-cn: 钱正英于1997年当选为中国工程院院士。
description.en: Qian Zhengying was elected as an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 2004年3月，钱正英获得香港大学名誉科学博士学位。
description.en: In March 2004, Qian Zhengying was awarded an Honorary Doctor of Science degree by the University of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 钱正英逝世后，时任全国政协主席汪洋受中共中央委托前往八宝山革命公墓为其送别。
description.en: After Qian Zhengying's death, then-Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee Wang Yang, entrusted by the CCP Central Committee, went to the Babaoshan Revolutionary Cemetery to bid her farewell.

description.zh-cn: 钱正英主持领导了“三峡工程”的可行性论证工作。
description.en: Qian Zhengying presided over and led the feasibility study for the Three Gorges Project.

description.zh-cn: 钱正英主编出版了《中国大百科全书·水利卷》。
description.en: Qian Zhengying served as the editor-in-chief for the publication of the 'Water Conservancy Volume' of the Encyclopedia of China.

description.zh-cn: 钱正英的丈夫黄辛白曾任中华人民共和国教育部副部长。
description.en: Qian Zhengying's husband, Huang Xinbai, served as the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 钱正英是清代大臣钱陈群的后代。
description.en: Qian Zhengying is a descendant of Qian Chenqun, an official of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 钱正英是清代大臣钱应溥的后代。
description.en: Qian Zhengying is a descendant of Qian Yingpu, an official of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 钱正英是中国共产党第十届至第十四届中央委员会委员。
description.en: Qian Zhengying was a member of the 10th to 14th Central Committees of the Communist Party of China.

position.en: Vice Chairperson of the CPPCC National Committee

description.zh-cn: 钱正英担任全国政协副主席期间，李先念是时任全国政协主席。
description.en: While Qian Zhengying served as Vice Chairperson of the CPPCC National Committee, Li Xiannian was the serving Chairman.

position.en: Vice Chairperson of the CPPCC National Committee

description.zh-cn: 钱正英担任全国政协副主席期间，李瑞环是时任全国政协主席。
description.en: While Qian Zhengying served as Vice Chairperson of the CPPCC National Committee, Li Ruihuan was the serving Chairman.

position.zh-cn: 水利电力部/水利部部长
position.en: Minister of Water Resources and Electric Power / Minister of Water Resources

description.zh-cn: 钱正英担任部长期间，华国锋是时任中华人民共和国国务院总理。
description.en: While Qian Zhengying served as a minister, Hua Guofeng was the serving Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

position.zh-cn: 水利部/水利电力部部长
position.en: Minister of Water Resources / Minister of Water Resources and Electric Power

description.zh-cn: 钱正英担任部长期间，赵紫阳是时任中华人民共和国国务院总理。
description.en: While Qian Zhengying served as a minister, Zhao Ziyang was the serving Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

position.en: Minister of Water Resources and Electric Power

description.zh-cn: 钱正英担任水利电力部部长期间，李鹏是时任中华人民共和国国务院代总理及总理。
description.en: While Qian Zhengying served as Minister of Water Resources and Electric Power, Li Peng was the serving Acting Premier and Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 厦门市人民政府的业务上级为福建省人民政府。
description.en: The operational superior of the Xiamen Municipal People's Government is the Fujian Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 厦门市人民政府的组织上级为厦门市人民代表大会常务委员会。
description.en: The organizational superior of the Xiamen Municipal People's Government is the Standing Committee of the Xiamen Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 1955年5月，厦门市人民政府改称为厦门市人民委员会。1980年5月，厦门市人民政府恢复，取代了厦门市革命委员会。
description.en: In May 1955, the Xiamen Municipal People's Government was renamed the Xiamen Municipal People's Committee. In May 1980, the Xiamen Municipal People's Government was restored, replacing the Xiamen Municipal Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命开始后，厦门市人民委员会陷入瘫痪并于1967年1月被夺权。
description.en: After the start of the Cultural Revolution, the Xiamen Municipal People's Committee was paralyzed and its power was seized in January 1967.

description.zh-cn: 厦门市人民委员会在造反派的冲击下陷入瘫痪。
description.en: The Xiamen Municipal People's Committee was paralyzed under the impact of the rebel factions.

description.zh-cn: 批准成立厦门市革命委员会。
description.en: Approved the establishment of the Xiamen Municipal Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh-cn: 批准成立厦门市革命委员会。
description.en: Approved the establishment of the Xiamen Municipal Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh-cn: 厦门医学院由福建省人民政府、厦门市人民政府共建，以厦门市人民政府管理为主。
description.en: Xiamen Medical College is jointly established by the Fujian Provincial People's Government and the Xiamen Municipal People's Government, with management primarily by the Xiamen Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 厦门医学院由福建省人民政府、厦门市人民政府共建。
description.en: Xiamen Medical College is jointly established by the Fujian Provincial People's Government and the Xiamen Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 厦门理工学院由福建省人民政府、厦门市人民政府共建，以厦门市人民政府管理为主。
description.en: Xiamen University of Technology is jointly established by the Fujian Provincial People's Government and the Xiamen Municipal People's Government, with management primarily by the Xiamen Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 厦门理工学院由福建省人民政府、厦门市人民政府共建。
description.en: Xiamen University of Technology is jointly established by the Fujian Provincial People's Government and the Xiamen Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 厦门市人民政府的工作部门。
description.en: A working department of the Xiamen Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 厦门市人民政府的工作部门。
description.en: A working department of the Xiamen Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 厦门市人民政府直属事业单位。
description.en: A public institution directly under the Xiamen Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 厦门市人民政府直属事业单位。
description.en: A public institution directly under the Xiamen Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 毕业于莱阳农学院农学专业。
description.en: Graduated from the Agronomy Department of Laiyang Agricultural College.

description.zh-cn: 担任第八届全国人大常委会委员。1998年3月，在第九届全国人大第一次会议上当选为全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Served as a member of the Standing Committee of the 8th National People's Congress. In March 1998, was elected as a member of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress at the first session of the 9th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 在机电排灌系机电排灌专业学习。
description.en: Studied in the Mechanical and Electrical Irrigation and Drainage specialty at the Department of Mechanical and Electrical Irrigation and Drainage.

description.zh-cn: 在哲学系马克思主义哲学专业研究生课程进修班学习。
description.en: Attended the postgraduate course in Marxist Philosophy at the Department of Philosophy.

description.zh-cn: 在水文水资源学院水文学及水资源专业在职研究生学习。
description.en: Pursued postgraduate studies in Hydrology and Water Resources at the College of Hydrology and Water Resources.

description.zh-cn: 在函授学院省部级干部在职研究生班进修。
description.en: Studied at the in-service postgraduate program for provincial and ministerial-level cadres at the correspondence school.

description.zh-cn: 黄莉新被派赴该校高级管理人才经济研究班培训。
description.en: Huang Lixin was sent to attend a training program for senior management personnel in economic research at this school.

description.zh-cn: 黄莉新因在1998年抗洪救灾中表现突出，被评为“长江防汛抗洪先进个人”。
description.en: Due to her outstanding performance in the 1998 flood relief efforts, Huang Lixin was named an 'Advanced Individual in Yangtze River Flood Control and Fighting'.

description.zh-cn: 先后当选为第十八届、第十九届中央候补委员。
description.en: Was successively elected as an alternate member of the 18th and 19th Central Committees.

description.zh-cn: 当选为第十三届全国政协委员。
description.en: Elected as a member of the 13th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 补选为第十四届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: By-elected as a deputy to the 14th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 第十一届全国人大常委会是第十一届全国人民代表大会的常设机关。
description.en: The Standing Committee of the 11th NPC is the permanent body of the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 国务院是最高国家权力机关的执行机关，对全国人民代表大会负责并报告工作。
description.en: The State Council is the executive body of the highest organ of state power and is responsible to and reports to the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 最高人民法院由全国人民代表大会产生，对它负责并报告工作。
description.en: The Supreme People's Court is created by the National People's Congress, to which it is responsible and reports.

description.zh-cn: 最高人民检察院由全国人民代表大会产生，对它负责并报告工作。
description.en: The Supreme People's Procuratorate is created by the National People's Congress, to which it is responsible and reports.

description.zh-cn: 由第十一届全国人民代表大会选举产生。
description.en: Elected by the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 由第十一届全国人民代表大会选举产生。
description.en: Elected by the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 由第十一届全国人民代表大会选举产生。
description.en: Elected by the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 在2010年3月召开的十一届全国人大三次会议上确认其辞去委员职务。
description.en: His resignation as a member was confirmed at the Third Session of the 11th NPC in March 2010.

description.zh-cn: 在2011年3月召开的十一届全国人大四次会议上确认其辞去委员职务。
description.en: His resignation as a member was confirmed at the Fourth Session of the 11th NPC in March 2011.

description.zh-cn: 第十一届全国人民代表大会第五次会议表决通过了关于修改《中华人民共和国刑事诉讼法》的决定。
description.en: The Fifth Session of the 11th National People's Congress voted to pass the decision on amending the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 陈传阔于1966年1月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Chen Chuankuo joined the Communist Party of China in January 1966.

description.zh-cn: 陈传阔于1970年1月参加中国人民解放军。
description.en: Chen Chuankuo joined the People's Liberation Army in January 1970.

description.zh-cn: 陈传阔于1986年9月至1988年7月在国防大学基本一系学习。
description.en: Chen Chuankuo studied in the Basic Department I of the National Defence University from September 1986 to July 1988.

description.zh-cn: 2008年当选第十一届全国政协常务委员，代表特别邀请人士，分入第五十六组，并担任经济委员会专委。
description.en: In 2008, he was elected as a Standing Committee member of the 11th National Committee of the CPPCC, representing specially invited personages in the 56th group, and served as a special committee member of the Economic Committee.

description.zh-cn: 龙川曾任广西壮族自治区人民政府副主席。
description.en: Long Chuan once served as the Vice Chairman of the People's Government of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 龙川曾任广西壮族自治区政协副主席。
description.en: Long Chuan once served as the Vice Chairman of the CPPCC of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，龙川是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Long Chuan is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 孝肃皇后周氏是明英宗的贵妃，明宪宗的生母。
description.en: Empress Xiaosu, née Zhou, was a noble consort of Emperor Yingzong and the birth mother of Emperor Xianzong.

description.zh-cn: 在土木堡之变中，明英宗的护卫将军樊忠以“为天下诛此贼”为名，用棰击杀了导致战败的王振。
description.en: During the Tumu Crisis, Emperor Yingzong's guard general Fan Zhong, declaring 'I execute this traitor for the realm,' killed Wang Zhen, who was responsible for the defeat, with a club.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗被瓦剌送还后，景泰帝将其软禁于南内崇质宫，长达七年。
description.en: After Emperor Yingzong was returned by the Oirats, the Jingtai Emperor placed him under house arrest in the Southern Palace for seven years.

description.zh-cn: 鸿胪卿杨善出使瓦剌，说服也先，成功将明英宗迎回。
description.en: The official Yang Shan went on a mission to the Oirats, persuaded Esen, and successfully brought Emperor Yingzong back.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗复辟后，以谋逆罪将大学士王文和于谦等人杀害。
description.en: After his restoration, Emperor Yingzong executed Grand Secretary Wang Wen and Yu Qian on charges of treason.

description.zh-cn: 徐有贞向复位的明英宗进言“不杀于谦，今日之事无名”，力主将于谦处死。
description.en: Xu Youzhen advised the restored Emperor Yingzong, 'If we do not execute Yu Qian, this affair (the coup) will have no legitimacy,' strongly advocating for Yu Qian's execution.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗在识破曹石之变后，将曹吉祥凌迟处死。
description.en: After uncovering the Cao-Shi Rebellion, Emperor Yingzong had Cao Jixiang executed by slow slicing.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗在识破曹石之变后，将石亨囚禁至死。
description.en: After uncovering the Cao-Shi Rebellion, Emperor Yingzong imprisoned Shi Heng until his death.

description.zh-cn: 在天顺年间，明英宗勤于理政，并任用李贤等贤臣。
description.en: During the Tianshun era, Emperor Yingzong was diligent in governance and appointed virtuous ministers such as Li Xian.

description.zh-cn: 在土木堡之变期间，明朝与瓦剌处于战争状态。
description.en: During the Tumu Crisis, the Ming Dynasty was in a state of war with the Oirats.

description.zh-cn: 范瑾是浙江绍兴人。
description.en: Fan Jin was born in Shaoxing, Zhejiang.

description.zh-cn: 范瑾是历史学家范文澜的甥女。
description.en: Fan Jin is the niece of historian Fan Wenlan.

degree.zh-cn: 实验学校, 理学院地质系
degree.en: Experimental School, Department of Geology, College of Science

description.zh-cn: 范瑾于1928年起在国立中央大学实验学校学习，1936年考入该校理学院地质系。
description.en: Fan Jin began studying at the Experimental School of National Central University in 1928 and was admitted to the Department of Geology in the College of Science in 1936.

description.zh-cn: 范瑾于1938年在延安加入中国共产党。
description.en: Fan Jin joined the Communist Party of China in Yan'an in 1938.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争爆发后，范瑾于1937年底赴延安，在陕北公学学习。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Second Sino-Japanese War, Fan Jin went to Yan'an at the end of 1937 to study at Shaanbei Public School.

description.zh-cn: 在北京市任职期间，范瑾领导创办了《北京日报》等报刊。
description.en: During her tenure in Beijing, Fan Jin led the founding of newspapers such as the Beijing Daily.

description.zh-cn: 在北京市任职期间，范瑾领导创办了《北京晚报》等报刊。
description.en: During her tenure in Beijing, Fan Jin led the founding of newspapers such as the Beijing Evening News.

description.zh-cn: 1966年文化大革命爆发，范瑾随即被打倒。1968年被关进监狱，1975年获释并受到平反。
description.en: When the Cultural Revolution broke out in 1966, Fan Jin was immediately purged. She was imprisoned in 1968 and released and rehabilitated in 1975.

description.zh-cn: 改革开放后，范瑾历任北京市人大常委会副主任。
description.en: After the Reform and Opening-up, Fan Jin served as Vice Chairwoman of the Standing Committee of the Beijing Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 改革开放后，范瑾历任北京市政协主席。
description.en: After the Reform and Opening-up, Fan Jin served as Chairwoman of the Beijing Municipal Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 范瑾与乔冠华原配妻子龚澎是好友。
description.en: Fan Jin was a good friend of Gong Peng, the first wife of Qiao Guanhua.

description.zh-cn: 1939年同范瑾在冀中根据地结婚。
description.en: Married Fan Jin in the Central Hebei Base Area in 1939.

description.zh-cn: 在石油地质专业学习。
description.en: Studied in the petroleum geology major.

position.zh-cn: 技术员、地质师、副主任地质师

description.zh-cn: 历任大庆油田开发研究院和科学研究院技术员、一级技术员、地质师、开发室副主任地质师。
description.en: Served successively as Technician, First-level Technician, Geologist, and Deputy Chief Geologist of the Development Office at the Daqing Oilfield Development Research Institute and Scientific Research Institute.

description.zh-cn: 于1978年6月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in June 1978.

description.zh-cn: 获得“人民楷模”国家荣誉称号。
description.en: Received the national honorary title of 'People's Role Model'.

description.zh-cn: 根据籍贯信息“四川郫县”和分类“成都人”推断。
description.en: Inferred from ancestry information 'Pixian, Sichuan' and category 'People from Chengdu'.

description.zh-cn: 朱世宏是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Zhu Shihong is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 朱世宏曾担任西南石油大学党委书记。
description.en: Zhu Shihong formerly served as the Party Committee Secretary of Southwest Petroleum University.

description.zh-cn: 朱世宏曾担任四川省教育厅厅长。
description.en: Zhu Shihong formerly served as the Director of the Sichuan Provincial Department of Education.

description.zh-cn: 于2018年2月24日当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会四川地区代表。
description.en: Was elected as a deputy from the Sichuan region to the 13th National People's Congress on February 24, 2018.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“中国高等教育学会常务理事”推断，朱世宏是中国高等教育学会的常务理事。
description.en: Inferred from the page category 'Standing Council Members of the China Association of Higher Education', Zhu Shihong is a standing council member of the China Association of Higher Education.

description.zh-cn: 杰尼斯·曼图罗夫自2012年2月2日起代理俄罗斯联邦工业和贸易部部长，并于同年5月21日正式就任。
description.en: Denis Manturov served as Acting Minister of Industry and Trade of the Russian Federation from February 2, 2012, and was formally appointed on May 21 of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 在米哈伊尔·米舒斯京担任总理期间，杰尼斯·曼图罗夫在其政府中先后担任工业和贸易部长、副总理及第一副总理。
description.en: During Mikhail Mishustin's premiership, Denis Manturov served in his government successively as Minister of Industry and Trade, Deputy Prime Minister, and First Deputy Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 在德米特里·梅德维杰夫担任总理期间，杰尼斯·曼图罗夫担任工业和贸易部长。
description.en: During Dmitry Medvedev's premiership, Denis Manturov served as Minister of Industry and Trade.

description.zh-cn: 在维克托·祖布科夫代理总理期间，杰尼斯·曼图罗夫担任代理工业和贸易部长。
description.en: During Viktor Zubkov's acting premiership, Denis Manturov served as Acting Minister of Industry and Trade.

description.zh-cn: 在弗拉迪米尔·普丁担任总理期间，杰尼斯·曼图罗夫担任代理工业和贸易部长。在普丁担任总统期间，曼图罗夫被任命为副总理并随其出访。
description.en: During Vladimir Putin's premiership, Denis Manturov served as Acting Minister of Industry and Trade. During Putin's presidency, Manturov was appointed Deputy Prime Minister and accompanied him on foreign visits.

description.zh-cn: 杰尼斯·曼图罗夫接替安德烈·别洛乌索夫出任俄罗斯第一副总理。
description.en: Denis Manturov succeeded Andrey Belousov as the First Deputy Prime Minister of Russia.

description.zh-cn: 杰尼斯·曼图罗夫接替辞去职务的维克托·赫里斯坚科，担任代理俄罗斯联邦工业和贸易部长。
description.en: Denis Manturov succeeded Viktor Khristenko, who had resigned, as the Acting Minister of Industry and Trade of the Russian Federation.

description.zh-cn: 弗拉迪米尔·普京签署总统令，任命杰尼斯·曼图罗夫为副总理。
description.en: Vladimir Putin signed a presidential decree appointing Denis Manturov as Deputy Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 杰尼斯·曼图罗夫于1994年毕业于莫斯科国立大学。
description.en: Denis Manturov graduated from Moscow State University in 1994.

description.zh-cn: 杰尼斯·曼图罗夫随同俄罗斯总统普京出访朝鲜。
description.en: Denis Manturov accompanied Russian President Vladimir Putin on his visit to North Korea.

description.zh-cn: 1930年2月24日，彭德怀下令杀害了袁文才。此事导致袁文才的部众反水，彭德怀的红五军被迫撤出井冈山。
description.en: On February 24, 1930, Peng Dehuai ordered the killing of Yuan Wencai. This incident caused Yuan's followers to rebel, forcing Peng Dehuai's Red Fifth Army to withdraw from the Jinggang Mountains.

description.zh-cn: 1930年2月24日，彭德怀下令杀害了王佐。此事导致王佐的部众反水，彭德怀的红五军被迫撤出井冈山。
description.en: On February 24, 1930, Peng Dehuai ordered the killing of Wang Zuo. This incident caused Wang's followers to rebel, forcing Peng Dehuai's Red Fifth Army to withdraw from the Jinggang Mountains.

description.zh-cn: 红五军由彭德怀领导。
description.en: The Red Fifth Army was led by Peng Dehuai.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军是中国共产党领导的武装力量。
description.en: The Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army was the armed force led by the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 许贡是名士许靖的好友，在许靖为躲避董卓之乱逃到江东时收留了他。
description.en: Xu Gong was a friend of the renowned scholar Xu Jing and gave him shelter when Xu Jing fled to Jiangdong to escape the turmoil of Dong Zhuo.

description.zh-cn: 许靖为躲避董卓之乱而逃离。
description.en: Xu Jing fled to escape the turmoil caused by Dong Zhuo.

description.zh-cn: 许贡任吴郡都尉时，其上司是吴郡太守盛宪。
description.en: When Xu Gong served as the Commandant of Wu Commandery, his superior was the Grand Administrator Sheng Xian.

description.zh-cn: 许贡成为吴郡太守后，试图迫害前任太守盛宪。
description.en: After becoming the Grand Administrator of Wu Commandery, Xu Gong attempted to persecute his predecessor, Sheng Xian.

description.zh-cn: 周喁与兄弟们被袁术的势力击败。
description.en: Zhou Yong and his brothers were defeated by the forces of Yuan Shu.

description.zh-cn: 周昕与兄弟们被袁术的势力击败。
description.en: Zhou Xin and his brothers were defeated by the forces of Yuan Shu.

description.zh-cn: 在周喁被袁术击败并逃回会稽的途中，许贡杀害了他。
description.en: While Zhou Yong was fleeing back to Kuaiji after being defeated by Yuan Shu, Xu Gong killed him.

description.zh-cn: 当许贡任吴郡太守时，朱治是其下属，担任吴郡都尉。
description.en: When Xu Gong was the Grand Administrator of Wu Commandery, Zhu Zhi was his subordinate, serving as the Commandant.

description.zh-cn: 朱治是孙坚的旧部。
description.en: Zhu Zhi was a former subordinate of Sun Jian.

description.zh-cn: 高岱帮助盛宪躲藏，以逃避许贡的迫害。
description.en: Gao Dai helped Sheng Xian go into hiding to escape persecution by Xu Gong.

description.zh-cn: 许昭将受到许贡迫害的盛宪藏匿于家中。
description.en: Xu Zhao hid Sheng Xian, who was being persecuted by Xu Gong, in his home.

description.zh-cn: 因高岱帮助盛宪，许贡试图加害高岱。
description.en: Because Gao Dai helped Sheng Xian, Xu Gong attempted to harm him.

description.zh-cn: 严白虎被孙策击败后，投奔了许昭。
description.en: After being defeated by Sun Ce, Yan Baihu sought refuge with Xu Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 许昭是许贡的部下。
description.en: Xu Zhao was a subordinate of Xu Gong.

description.zh-cn: 作为吴郡太守，许贡向汉献帝上表。
description.en: As the Grand Administrator of Wu Commandery, Xu Gong submitted a memorial to Emperor Xian.

description.zh-cn: 石双琪是河北唐县人。
description.en: Shi Shuangqi was a native of Tang County, Hebei.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争爆发后，石双琪参加了本村的抗日自卫队，开始其政治军事生涯。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Anti-Japanese War, Shi Shuangqi joined his village's anti-Japanese self-defense force, beginning his political and military career.

description.zh-cn: 石双琪于1940年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Shi Shuangqi joined the Communist Party of China in 1940.

description.zh-cn: 1947年夏，石双琪率民兵团支援前线，参加第二次国共内战。
description.en: In the summer of 1947, Shi Shuangqi led a militia regiment to support the front lines, participating in the Second Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，石双琪受到迫害。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Shi Shuangqi was persecuted.

description.zh-cn: 石双琪的保定市人民政府市长职务由田福庭接替。
description.en: Shi Shuangqi's position as Mayor of the Baoding Municipal People's Government was succeeded by Tian Futing.

description.zh-cn: 毕业于第四军医大学医疗专业。
description.en: Graduated from the Fourth Military Medical University with a degree in medicine.

description.zh-cn: 2013年，担任第十二届全国人民代表大会解放军代表。
description.en: In 2013, he served as a PLA deputy to the 12th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 1849年，木户孝允入吉田松阴门下学习兵术，松阴评价其“有成事之才”。
description.en: In 1849, Kido Takayoshi became a disciple of Yoshida Shōin to study military strategy. Shōin remarked that he 'had the talent to accomplish great things'.

description.zh-cn: 木户孝允是长州藩藩士，其藩主为毛利敬亲。毛利敬亲对他有深厚的信赖，并于1866年赐予其“木户”姓氏。
description.en: Kido Takayoshi was a samurai of the Chōshū Domain, and his lord was Mōri Takachika. Mōri had deep trust in him and granted him the surname 'Kido' in 1866.

description.zh-cn: 木户松子原为京都艺妓几松，是木户孝允的妻子，在幕末动乱时期曾是他的救命恩人。
description.en: Kido Matsuko, formerly the Kyoto geisha Ikumatsu, was Kido Takayoshi's wife and had saved his life during the turbulent Bakumatsu period.

description.zh-cn: 作为尊王攘夷派的中心人物，木户孝允在幕末时期受到幕府通缉，不得不多次使用化名进行活动。
description.en: As a central figure of the Sonnō jōi faction, Kido Takayoshi was wanted by the Shogunate during the Bakumatsu period and had to use various aliases to carry out his activities.

description.zh-cn: 作为长州藩和萨摩藩的代表，木户孝允与西乡隆盛等人缔结了萨长同盟，并在维新后并称为“维新三杰”，共同辅佐政府。
description.en: As representatives of the Chōshū and Satsuma domains, Kido Takayoshi and Saigō Takamori concluded the Satchō Alliance and were later known as the 'Three Great Nobles of the Restoration', working together in the new government.

description.zh-cn: 坂本龙马等人作为中介，斡旋促成了萨摩藩与长州藩之间的军事同盟。
description.en: Sakamoto Ryōma and others acted as intermediaries to broker the military alliance between the Satsuma and Chōshū domains.

description.zh-cn: 木户孝允基于福冈孝弟的草案，对《五条御誓文》进行了关键性修改，并说服守旧派，促成了由天皇亲率百官宣誓的仪式。
description.en: Based on the draft by Fukuoka Takachika, Kido Takayoshi made crucial revisions to the Charter Oath and persuaded conservatives, leading to a ceremony where the Emperor personally led officials in taking the oath.

description.zh-cn: 木户孝允作为岩仓使节团的全权副使之一，前往欧美进行条约修改的预备交涉并考察西方文明。
description.en: As one of the Vice-Ambassadors of the Iwakura Mission, Kido Takayoshi traveled to the United States and Europe for preliminary negotiations on treaty revisions and to study Western civilization.

description.zh-cn: 作为岩仓使节团的归国成员，木户孝允痛感内治优先的必要性，坚决反对西乡隆盛等人主张的征韩论，尤其是立即征韩的提议。
description.en: As a returning member of the Iwakura Mission, Kido Takayoshi felt a strong need to prioritize domestic affairs and resolutely opposed the Seikanron advocated by Saigō Takamori and others, particularly the proposal for an immediate expedition to Korea.

description.zh-cn: 木户孝允一贯反对出兵台湾，当政府于1874年5月决定出兵时，他辞去参议职务以示抗议。
description.en: Kido Takayoshi consistently opposed the expedition to Taiwan. When the government decided to dispatch troops in May 1874, he resigned from his post as Sangi in protest.

description.zh-cn: 板垣退助是留守政府中主张以武力迫使朝鲜开国的领导者之一。
description.en: Itagaki Taisuke was one of the leaders in the caretaker government who advocated for using military force to open Korea.

description.zh-cn: 江藤新平是留守政府中主张以武力迫使朝鲜开国的领导者之一。
description.en: Etō Shinpei was one of the leaders in the caretaker government who advocated for using military force to open Korea.

description.zh-cn: 后藤象二郎是留守政府中主张以武力迫使朝鲜开国的领导者之一。
description.en: Gotō Shōjirō was one of the leaders in the caretaker government who advocated for using military force to open Korea.

description.zh-cn: 副岛种臣是留守政府中主张以武力迫使朝鲜开国的领导者之一。
description.en: Soejima Taneomi was one of the leaders in the caretaker government who advocated for using military force to open Korea.

description.zh-cn: 征韩论背后的目的之一在于解决武士于明治维新后严重的失业问题。
description.en: One of the aims behind the Seikanron was to solve the serious unemployment problem of the samurai class after the Meiji Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 李氏朝鲜因日本国书中有“大日本皇帝”字样而拒绝建交，其锁国政策激化了日本国内的“征韩论”。
description.en: The Joseon dynasty's refusal to establish diplomatic relations due to the term 'Emperor of Great Japan' in the Japanese state letter and its isolationist policy intensified the 'Seikanron' debate within Japan.

description.zh-cn: 1873年9月归国的岩仓使节团成员以时机尚早为由反对征韩，最终导致该计划被取消。
description.en: Members of the Iwakura Mission, upon their return in September 1873, opposed the expedition to Korea on the grounds that it was premature, ultimately leading to the cancellation of the plan.

description.zh-cn: 作为岩仓使节团的归国成员，大久保利通反对立即征韩。
description.en: As a returning member of the Iwakura Mission, Ōkubo Toshimichi opposed an immediate expedition to Korea.

description.zh-cn: 因征韩论争议引发的明治六年政变，导致板垣退助下野。
description.en: The Meiji Six Year Coup, sparked by the Seikanron controversy, led to the resignation of Itagaki Taisuke.

description.zh-cn: 明治六年政变成为1874年佐贺之乱的起点。
description.en: The Meiji Six Year Coup became the starting point for the Saga Rebellion of 1874.

description.zh-cn: 明治六年政变成为1877年西南战争的起点。
description.en: The Meiji Six Year Coup became the starting point for the Satsuma Rebellion of 1877.

description.zh-cn: 明治六年政变成为自由民权运动的起点。
description.en: The Meiji Six Year Coup became the starting point for the Freedom and People's Rights Movement.

description.zh-cn: 尊王攘夷运动中关于古代日本拥有朝鲜半岛支配权的政治主张，为征韩论提供了思想基础。
description.en: The political claims within the Sonnō jōi movement about ancient Japan's dominion over the Korean peninsula provided an ideological basis for the Seikanron.

description.zh-cn: 根据部分媒体报道，陈良宇事件是由令计划等人炮制的一起冤案。
description.en: According to some media reports, the Chen Liangyu incident was a wrongful conviction case orchestrated by Ling Jihua and others.

description.zh-cn: 胡温政府需要打击削弱江泽民派系（上海帮）的势力，陈良宇事件被视为这一政治斗争的一部分。
description.en: The Hu-Wen administration needed to weaken the power of the Jiang Zemin faction (Shanghai clique), and the Chen Liangyu incident is seen as part of this political struggle.

description.zh-cn: 陈良宇因反对中央的宏观调控政策，曾反驳顶撞时任总理温家宝。
description.en: Chen Liangyu, opposing the central government's macroeconomic control policies, once confronted and contradicted then-Premier Wen Jiabao.

description.zh-cn: 陈良宇认为宏观经济调控压制上海发展，于是对中央经济方针进行抵制，导致中央经济政策无法通行于全国。
description.en: Chen Liangyu believed that macroeconomic control suppressed Shanghai's development and thus resisted the central economic policies, preventing them from being implemented nationwide.

description.zh-cn: 在黄菊患病离职后，中纪委开始调查上海社保基金案件，派调查组进驻上海，从而引发了整个事件。
description.en: After Huang Ju fell ill and left his post, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection began investigating the Shanghai social security fund case, sending an investigation team to Shanghai, which triggered the entire incident.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央政治局会议决定对陈良宇立案调查，并免去其在上海市一切职务，停止其在中央担任的职务。
description.en: A meeting of the Politburo of the CCP Central Committee decided to open an investigation into Chen Liangyu, remove him from all his posts in Shanghai, and suspend his duties at the central level.

description.zh-cn: 因卷入陈良宇事件，时任上海市宝山区区长的秦裕被双规，并最终被判处无期徒刑。
description.en: Due to his involvement in the Chen Liangyu incident, Qin Yu, then Mayor of Baoshan District in Shanghai, was placed under 'shuanggui' and ultimately sentenced to life imprisonment.

description.zh-cn: 因卷入陈良宇事件，时任上海市社保局长的祝均一被调查，并最终被判处有期徒刑18年。
description.en: Due to his involvement in the Chen Liangyu incident, Zhu Junyi, then Director of the Shanghai Social Security Bureau, was investigated and ultimately sentenced to 18 years in prison.

description.zh-cn: 因卷入陈良宇事件，时任国家统计局局长的邱晓华被捕，并最终被判处有期徒刑一年。
description.en: Due to his involvement in the Chen Liangyu incident, Qiu Xiaohua, then Director of the National Bureau of Statistics, was arrested and ultimately sentenced to one year in prison.

description.zh-cn: 秦裕曾是陈良宇的秘书。
description.en: Qin Yu was formerly Chen Liangyu's secretary.

description.zh-cn: 张荣坤被控行贿已故政治局常委黄菊的秘书王维工九百三十三万元。
description.en: Zhang Rongkun was accused of bribing Wang Weigong, the secretary of the late Politburo Standing Committee member Huang Ju, with 9.33 million yuan.

description.zh-cn: 王维工因涉嫌向陈良宇通风报信而遭到中纪委“双规”。
description.en: Wang Weigong was placed under 'shuanggui' by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection for allegedly tipping off Chen Liangyu.

description.zh-cn: 据媒体称，令计划等人将陈良宇事件炮制成一起冤案。
description.en: According to media reports, Ling Jihua and others fabricated the Chen Liangyu incident into a case of wrongful conviction.

description.zh-cn: 毕业于汽车系。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Automotive Engineering.

description.zh-cn: 王云鹏接替徐惠彬担任北京航空航天大学校长职务。
description.en: Wang Yunpeng succeeded Xu Huibin as the President of Beihang University.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，“中国民主促进会广西壮族自治区委员会”的上级机构是“中国民主促进会中央委员会”。
description.en: According to the infobox, the superior organization of the 'Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy' is the 'Central Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy'.

description.zh-cn: “中国民主促进会广西壮族自治区委员会”是“中国民主促进会”在广西壮族自治区的地方组织。
description.en: The 'Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy' is the local organization of the 'China Association for Promoting Democracy' in the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，“中国民主促进会广西壮族自治区委员会”的机构类型为“民主党派”。
description.en: According to the infobox, the organization type of the 'Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy' is 'Democratic party'.

description.zh-cn: 中央财经委员会是中国共产党中央委员会领导财经工作的决策议事协调机构。
description.en: The Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission is a decision-making, deliberative, and coordinating body under the leadership of the CCP Central Committee for financial and economic work.

description.zh-cn: 中央财经委员会办公室是中央财经委员会的办事机构。
description.en: The Office of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission is the administrative body of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 担任中央财经委员会主任。
description.en: Serves as the Director of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 担任第二十届中央委员会时期的中央财经委员会副主任。
description.en: Serves as the Deputy Director of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission during the term of the 20th Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任第二十届中央委员会时期的中央财经委员会委员。
description.en: Serves as a Member of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission during the term of the 20th Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任第二十届中央委员会时期的中央财经委员会委员。
description.en: Serves as a Member of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission during the term of the 20th Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任第二十届中央委员会时期的中央财经委员会办公室主任。
description.en: Serves as the Director of the Office of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission during the term of the 20th Central Committee.

relationships.source: BAIDU:深化党和国家机构改革方案

description.zh-cn: 根据该方案，中央财经领导小组改为中央财经委员会。
description.en: According to this plan, the Central Leading Group for Financial and Economic Affairs was transformed into the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission.

relationships.source: BAIDU:中华人民共和国中央人民政府组织法

description.zh-cn: 根据该法，中央财经委员会更名为政务院财政经济委员会。
description.en: According to this law, the Central Financial and Economic Commission was renamed the Financial and Economic Committee of the Government Administration Council.

description.zh-cn: 金晓昀出生于黑龙江省克山县。

description.zh-cn: 金晓昀曾担任宁夏回族自治区政协副主席。

description.zh-cn: 金晓昀曾任第七届全国人大代表。

description.zh-cn: 金晓昀是中国共产党党员。

description.zh-cn: “焚书”政策导致《论语》等儒家经典几乎失传。
description.en: The 'book burning' policy caused Confucian classics like the Analects to be nearly lost.

description.zh-cn: 该政策确立了儒家思想的官方地位，从而极大地提升了《论语》等儒家经典的社会重要性。
description.en: This policy established the official status of Confucianism, thereby greatly enhancing the social importance of Confucian classics like the Analects.

description.zh-cn: 朱熹将《大学》、《论语》、《孟子》、《中庸》合编为“四书”，确立了它们在儒家经典中的核心地位。
description.en: Zhu Xi compiled the Great Learning, the Analects, Mencius, and the Doctrine of the Mean into the 'Four Books', establishing their core status in the Confucian canon.

description.zh-cn: 通过将《论语》纳入“四书”并为其作注，朱熹极大地提升了《论语》在儒家经典体系中的地位。
description.en: By including the Analects in the 'Four Books' and writing commentaries on it, Zhu Xi greatly elevated the status of the Analects within the Confucian classics system.

description.zh-cn: 郑玄综合多个早期版本，完成了《论语注》，为后世流传的《论语》定本奠定了基础。
description.en: Zheng Xuan synthesized several early versions to complete his 'Commentary on the Analects', laying the foundation for the standard text of the Analects passed down to later generations.

description.zh-cn: 皇侃在编纂《论语义疏》时受到了佛教思想的影响。
description.en: Huang Kan was influenced by Buddhist thought when compiling the 'Subcommentary on the Analects'.

description.zh-cn: 黑格尔在他的著作中对《论语》提出了尖锐批评，认为其内容平庸，缺乏思辨哲学。
description.en: In his works, Hegel sharply criticized the Analects, arguing that its content was mundane and lacked speculative philosophy.

description.zh-cn: 程颐高度赞扬《论语》，认为随着研读的深入，其意味会愈发深长，他的评价推动了后世对《论语》的重视。
description.en: Cheng Yi highly praised the Analects, believing that its meaning becomes more profound with deeper study. His evaluation promoted the importance attached to the Analects by later generations.

description.zh-cn: 王仁将《论语》及其注疏从百济带到日本，献给应神天皇，开启了《论语》在日本的传播。
description.en: Wani brought the Analects and its commentaries from Baekje to Japan, presenting them to Emperor Ōjin, which initiated the dissemination of the Analects in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 王仁将《论语》和汉字文化传入日本，对日本的文化发展产生了重要影响。
description.en: Wani introduced the Analects and Chinese writing culture to Japan, having a significant impact on Japan's cultural development.

description.zh-cn: 和信集团是以台湾水泥为核心的企业集团。
description.en: Koos Group is a corporate group with Taiwan Cement as its core.

degree.zh-cn: 半导体物理与器件专业本科；经济学博士

description.zh-cn: 在华中工学院（现华中科技大学）固体电子系就读本科。后在华中科技大学以在职博士研究生身份主修西方经济学专业，并获得经济学博士学位。
description.en: Studied for his bachelor's degree in the Department of Solid State Electronics at Huazhong Institute of Technology (now Huazhong University of Science and Technology). Later, he majored in Western Economics as an on-the-job doctoral student at Huazhong University of Science and Technology and obtained a Ph.D. in Economics.

description.zh-cn: 1982年7月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in July 1982.

description.zh-cn: 唐良智在中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会上当选为中国共产党第十九届中央委员会候补委员。
description.en: Tang Liangzhi was elected as an alternate member of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China at the 19th National Congress of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 在唐良智担任重庆市市长期间，陈敏尔是其上级，担任中共重庆市委书记。
description.en: While Tang Liangzhi served as Mayor of Chongqing, Chen Min'er was his superior, serving as the Secretary of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 胡衡华接替唐良智，担任重庆市人民政府市长。
description.en: Hu Henghua succeeded Tang Liangzhi as Mayor of the Chongqing Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 唐良智接替黄新初，担任中国共产党成都市委员会书记。

description.zh-cn: 范锐平接替唐良智，担任中国共产党成都市委员会书记。

description.zh-cn: 唐良智接替葛红林，担任成都市人民政府市长。

description.zh-cn: 罗强接替唐良智，担任成都市人民政府市长。

description.zh-cn: 唐良智接替阮成发，担任武汉市人民政府市长。

description.zh-cn: 万勇接替唐良智，担任武汉市人民政府市长。
description.en: Wan Yong succeeded Tang Liangzhi as Mayor of the Wuhan Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 李新华接替唐良智，先后担任襄樊市人民政府市长、中国共产党襄樊市委员会书记。
description.en: Li Xinhua succeeded Tang Liangzhi, serving consecutively as Mayor of the Xiangfan Municipal People's Government and Secretary of the CPC Xiangfan Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 任学锋接替唐良智，担任中国共产党重庆市委员会专职副书记。

description.zh-cn: 唐良智接替田承忠，担任中国共产党襄樊市委员会书记。

description.en: Tang Liangzhi succeeded Zhang Chang'er as Chairman of the Anhui Provincial Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 宁夏回族自治区人民代表大会常务委员会是宁夏回族自治区人民代表大会的常设机关，对其负责并报告工作。

description.zh-cn: 根据中华人民共和国的政治体制，中国共产党宁夏回族自治区委员会是宁夏回族自治区人民代表大会常务委员会的上级领导机构。

description.zh-cn: 1998年5月至2003年1月任秘书长，2003年1月至2008年1月任副主任。
description.en: Served as Secretary-General from May 1998 to January 2003, and as Deputy Director from January 2003 to January 2008.

description.zh-cn: 2003年1月至2008年1月任秘书长，2008年1月至2013年1月任副主任。
description.en: Served as Secretary-General from January 2003 to January 2008, and as Deputy Director from January 2008 to January 2013.

description.zh-cn: 2008年1月至2013年1月任秘书长，2013年1月至2018年1月任副主任。
description.en: Served as Secretary-General from January 2008 to January 2013, and as Deputy Director from January 2013 to January 2018.

description.zh-cn: 2013年1月至2015年1月8日任秘书长，2015年1月23日至2018年1月任副主任。
description.en: Served as Secretary-General from January 2013 to January 8, 2015, and as Deputy Director from January 23, 2015 to January 2018.

description.en: Liu Yuejin was born in Guilin, Guangxi.

description.zh-cn: 毕业于西南政法学院刑事侦查专业。
description.en: Graduated from Southwest College of Political Science and Law with a major in Criminal Investigation.
